Each chapter starts with the practice / example questions, followed by the past-exam parts on that chapter (orange "Past final exam" tag). 所有练习都在这一页，按章节排：每章先放练习 / 例题，再放这一章考过的真题。英文在上、中文在下；右下角「中文 ✓」可以隐藏全部中文。

  • Q2(a) in all 4 years: "error probability with residual ISI": Pe = ½[Q((1−a)/σ) + Q((1+a)/σ)], where a is the residual ISI coefficient. These are the safest marks on the paper.Q2(a) 4 年都考"有残余 ISI 时的误码率"：Pe = ½[Q((1−a)/σ) + Q((1+a)/σ)]，a 是残余 ISI 系数。这是最稳的送分题。

Ch. 1 · Overview of wireless systems and probability review

1 practice · 0 past-examNotes →
Part 2 practice
Mock A · Q1

Two channel states: total probability, Bayes and discrete SNR

Original question · bilingualMock Quiz A (self-written)

A wireless link alternates between two states. In the "good" state, which occurs with probability 0.7, the bit error probability is \(10^{-4}\). In the "bad" state, which occurs with probability 0.3, the bit error probability is \(10^{-2}\).

一条无线链路在两种状态之间切换。"好"状态出现的概率为 0.7，此时误比特率为 \(10^{-4}\)；"坏"状态出现的概率为 0.3，此时误比特率为 \(10^{-2}\)。

(a) Find the average bit error probability of the link. (3 marks)

(a) 求该链路的平均误比特率。（3 分）

(b) A bit is found to be in error. What is the probability that the link was in the bad state when this bit was sent? (3 marks)

(b) 发现某个比特出错了。发送这个比特时，链路处于"坏"状态的概率是多少？（3 分）

(c) The received SNR is 10 dB in the good state and 0 dB in the bad state. Find the mean and the variance of the SNR (in linear scale), and express the mean SNR in dB. (4 marks)

(c) 好状态下接收 SNR 为 10 dB，坏状态下为 0 dB。求 SNR（线性值）的均值和方差，并把平均 SNR 用 dB 表示。（4 分）

Total probabilityBayes (memorise)Discrete mean and varianceCh. 1b of the notes p.5–14
What the question is asking: what does this question actually want?

ScenarioWhat the question is about

A wireless link is sometimes good and sometimes bad: e.g. sometimes blocked, sometimes clear. The question reduces it to two states, and the probability and bit error rate of each state are known.一条无线链路时好时坏：比如有时被遮挡、有时畅通。题目把它简化成两种状态，每种状态出现的概率和误比特率都已知。

This is a typical Ch. 1b probability-revision question: case analysis (total probability), inferring the cause from the outcome (Bayes), and the mean and variance of a discrete random variable.这是第 1b 章概率复习的典型题：分情况讨论（全概率）、由结果反推原因（贝叶斯）、离散随机变量的期望和方差。

SymbolsWhat each quantity in the question means

good / badTwo channel states, with probabilities 0.7 and 0.3 (they add up to 1)两种信道状态，概率分别是 0.7 和 0.3（加起来是 1）
\(10^{-4},\ 10^{-2}\)Bit error rate in each state, i.e. the conditional probability P(error | state)各状态下的误比特率，也就是条件概率 P(出错 | 状态)
10 dB / 0 dBReceived SNR in each state (dB); convert to the linear values 10 and 1 before computing the mean and variance各状态下的接收 SNR（dB），算均值方差前要换成线性值 10 和 1

What each part asksWhat each part is asking for

  • (a) Without knowing which state the channel is in, what is the total probability that a bit is in error? Compute each case separately, then weight by how likely each state is.(a) 不知道当时处于哪个状态，一个比特出错的总概率是多少：两种情况各自算，再按出现概率加权。
  • (b) Given that "this bit is in error", find the probability that the channel was in the bad state. You know the effect and ask for the cause: that is Bayes' rule.(b) 已经知道"这个比特出错了"，反过来问"当时是坏状态"的概率：先有结果、再问原因，就是贝叶斯。
  • (c) Treat the SNR as a discrete random variable (10 with probability 0.7, 1 with probability 0.3), find its mean and variance, then convert the mean back to dB.(c) 把 SNR 看成一个离散随机变量（10 的概率 0.7，1 的概率 0.3），求它的均值和方差，再把均值换回 dB。

Watch outEasy ways to misread the question

  • The answer to (b) is not 0.3: 0.3 is the prior probability of the bad state, but the question asks for the probability once you know an error occurred.(b) 的答案不是 0.3：0.3 是"事先"处于坏状态的概率，题目问的是"知道出错以后"的概率。
  • In (c) you cannot average the dB values directly: dB is logarithmic, so convert to linear values first, then average.(c) 不能直接平均 dB 值：dB 是对数，先换成线性值再平均。

PurposeWhat the question wants you to understand

Total probability (weighting over cases) and Bayes' rule (reasoning from effect to cause) are the two core tools of Ch. 1b. You also need the mean and variance of a discrete distribution, and you must watch the dB/linear conversion.全概率（分情况加权）和贝叶斯（由果推因）是第 1b 章的两个核心工具；还要会求离散分布的期望和方差，并注意 dB 和线性值的换算。

In one line: two-state channel: (a) average error probability by total probability, (b) probability of the bad state given an error by Bayes' rule, (c) mean and variance of the SNR (convert to linear first).一句话：两状态信道：(a) 用全概率求平均误码率，(b) 用贝叶斯求"出错时处于坏状态"的概率，(c) 求 SNR 的均值和方差（先换线性值）。

Approach: (a) Split into cases and weight them: total probability. (b) The result (an error) is known and we ask about the cause (the state): Bayes' rule. (c) Mean and variance of a discrete random variable, after converting dB to linear values.

  1. (a) Table of states: the two states are mutually exclusive and cover all cases: P(G) + P(B) = 0.7 + 0.3 = 1 ✓, so {G, B} is a partition. The given bit error probabilities are conditional probabilities \(P(e\mid G)=10^{-4}\) and \(P(e\mid B)=10^{-2}\). First use the multiplication rule (Ch 1b p.6) for the two joint probabilities: \[\begin{aligned}P(G\cap e)&=P(G)\,P(e\mid G)\\&=0.7\times10^{-4}=7\times10^{-5}\\P(B\cap e)&=P(B)\,P(e\mid B)\\&=0.3\times10^{-2}=3\times10^{-3}\end{aligned}\]
  2. (a) Total probability: when an error occurs the link is in exactly one of G or B, so add the two terms; this is the total probability theorem (p.8): \[\begin{aligned}P_e&=P(G)P(e\mid G)+P(B)P(e\mid B)\\&=7\times10^{-5}+3\times10^{-3}\\&=0.00307=3.07\times10^{-3}\end{aligned}\] Check: the average lies between \(10^{-4}\) and \(10^{-2}\) ✓; it is close to the bad-state term because \(3\times10^{-3}\) is 43 times \(7\times10^{-5}\).
  3. (b) Bayes' rule: the result (an error) is known and we ask about the cause (the bad state), so use Bayes' rule (p.9). The numerator is the bad-state term of (a); the denominator is the total from (a): \[\begin{aligned}P(B\mid e)&=\frac{P(B)\,P(e\mid B)}{P_e}\\&=\frac{3\times10^{-3}}{3.07\times10^{-3}}=0.977\end{aligned}\]
  4. (b) Check: for the other state \(P(G\mid e)=\dfrac{7\times10^{-5}}{3.07\times10^{-3}}=0.023\), and the two posterior probabilities add up to 0.977 + 0.023 = 1 ✓. The probability of the bad state rises from 0.3 before the observation (a priori) to 0.977 after it (a posteriori), because an error is 100 times more likely in the bad state.
  5. (c) dB to linear: \(\gamma=10^{\gamma_{dB}/10}\): 10 dB → \(10^{1}=10\), 0 dB → \(10^{0}=1\). So the SNR is a discrete random variable: γ = 10 with probability 0.7 and γ = 1 with probability 0.3. dB is logarithmic and cannot be averaged directly; convert to linear first.
  6. (c) Mean: expectation of a discrete random variable, \(E[\gamma]=\sum\gamma\,P(\gamma)\) (p.10): \[\begin{aligned}E[\gamma]&=0.7\times10+0.3\times1=7+0.3=7.3\\ \bar\gamma_{dB}&=10\log_{10}7.3=10\times0.8633\\&=8.63\text{ dB}\end{aligned}\]
  7. (c) Variance: use \(\mathrm{Var}(\gamma)=E[\gamma^2]-(E[\gamma])^2\) (p.11), so find the second moment first: \[\begin{aligned}E[\gamma^2]&=0.7\times10^2+0.3\times1^2\\&=70+0.3=70.3\\ \mathrm{Var}(\gamma)&=70.3-7.3^2=70.3-53.29\\&=17.01\end{aligned}\] Standard deviation \(\sqrt{17.01}=4.12\). Check with the definition \(E[(\gamma-\mu)^2]\): \[\begin{aligned}&0.7\times(10-7.3)^2+0.3\times(1-7.3)^2\\&=5.103+11.907=17.01\ \checkmark\end{aligned}\]
(a) 3.07 × 10⁻³; (b) 0.977; (c) E[γ] = 7.3 (8.63 dB), Var(γ) = 17.0
Official answer: none (self-written mock question); all numbers checked by src/p2build/verify_mock.py
Averaging the dB values gives 0.7 × 10 + 0.3 × 0 = 7 dB, which is wrong: dB is logarithmic, so convert to linear before averaging. The lecturer said a missing dB ↔ linear conversion loses marks. Part (b) is typical: the bad state occupies only 30% of the time but causes 97.7% of the errors.
Concept + step by step: total probability, Bayes, discrete mean and variance知识讲解 + 详细解析：全概率、贝叶斯与离散期望方差

ConceptConditional probability, total probability and Bayes are one toolkit

Conditional probability P(A | B) reads "the probability of A, given that B has happened". The bit error probabilities in this question are conditional probabilities: P(e | G) = 10⁻⁴ means "the probability that a bit is in error when the link is in the good state".条件概率（conditional probability）P(A | B) 读作"已知 B 发生了，A 发生的概率"。本题给的误比特率就是条件概率：P(e | G) = 10⁻⁴ 的意思是"在好状态下，一个比特出错的概率"。

Multiplication rule (Ch 1b p.6): P(A ∩ B) = P(A) P(B | A). For example, the probability of "bad state and error" = P(B) P(e | B) = 0.3 × 10⁻² = 3 × 10⁻³.乘法规则（multiplication rule，讲义第 1b 章 p.6）：P(A ∩ B) = P(A) P(B | A)。例如"处于坏状态并且出错"的概率 = P(B) P(e | B) = 0.3 × 10⁻² = 3 × 10⁻³。

Total probability theorem (p.8): split all possible cases A₁, A₂, … (non-overlapping, together covering everything), compute "this case happens and B happens" for each, then add them all: P(B) = Σ P(Ai) P(B | Ai). The slide calls it "divide and conquer".全概率定理（total probability theorem，p.8）：把所有可能的情况 A₁、A₂、……（互不重叠、合起来是全部）分开，每种情况各算"这种情况发生并且 B 发生"，再全部加起来：P(B) = Σ P(Ai) P(B | Ai)。讲义叫它"分而治之"（divide and conquer）。

Bayes' rule (p.9, blue box, memorise): given the result B, ask backwards about the cause Ai: \(P(A_i\mid B)=\dfrac{P(A_i)\,P(B\mid A_i)}{\sum_j P(A_j)\,P(B\mid A_j)}\). The numerator is the multiplication rule, the denominator is total probability. P(Ai) is the a priori probability and P(Ai | B) the a posteriori probability.贝叶斯公式（Bayes' rule，p.9，蓝框必背）：已知结果 B，反过来问原因 Ai：\(P(A_i\mid B)=\dfrac{P(A_i)\,P(B\mid A_i)}{\sum_j P(A_j)\,P(B\mid A_j)}\)。分子是乘法规则，分母就是全概率。P(Ai) 叫先验概率（a priori），P(Ai | B) 叫后验概率（a posteriori）。

The lecturer stressed in class: in past years some students wrote P(B) as the single term P(A₁)P(B | A₁); total probability must sum over all cases. Bayes' rule comes back again and again in Ch 3 and Ch 6 (maximum likelihood detection, MLSE).老师课上强调：往年有人把 P(B) 只写成一项 P(A₁)P(B | A₁)，全概率必须对所有情况求和；贝叶斯在第 3、6 章（最大似然检测、MLSE）还会反复用到。

Turning probabilities into counts makes it easiest to see. Suppose 1 million bits are sent:把概率换成"个数"最好理解。假设发送 100 万个比特：

StateBits sent发送的比特数Bits in error出错的比特数
Good (probability 0.7)0.7 million0.7 million × 10⁻⁴ = 70
Bad (probability 0.3)0.3 million0.3 million × 10⁻² = 3000
Total1 million3070

(a) The overall error rate = 3070 / 1 million; (b) among all bits in error, the share from the bad state is 3000 / 3070. That is the intuitive version of total probability and Bayes.(a) 总误码率 = 3070 / 100 万；(b) 在所有出错的比特里，坏状态贡献的占 3000 / 3070。这就是全概率和贝叶斯的直观版。

Step by step(a) Total probability: split into cases, then a weighted sum

  1. What: split "error" by the state at the time the bit was sent. Why: the error rate in each state is known, but we do not know which state a given bit was sent in, so we compute both and weight them by how often each state occurs.做什么：把"出错"按发送时的状态分成两种情况。为什么：每种状态下的误码率已知，但不知道某个比特是在哪种状态下发的，只能两种都算、按出现概率加权。
  2. How: 怎么算：
    P(G) P(e | G) = 0.7 × 10⁻⁴ = 7 × 10⁻⁵
    P(B) P(e | B) = 0.3 × 10⁻² = 3 × 10⁻³
    Pe = 7 × 10⁻⁵ + 3 × 10⁻³ = 0.00007 + 0.003 = 3.07 × 10⁻³
  3. Calculator hint: the two numbers differ by two orders of magnitude; write both as decimals before adding so the digits line up.计算器提示：两个数差两个数量级，先都写成小数再相加，不容易错位。

Step by step(b) Bayes: from the result back to the cause

What: knowing "an error happened", find the a posteriori probability that the link was in the bad state. Why the answer is not 0.3: 0.3 is the a priori probability before seeing the result; the information "error" makes the bad state much more likely, because errors are 100 times more likely in the bad state than in the good state.做什么：已知"出错了"，求"当时是坏状态"的后验概率。为什么答案不是 0.3：0.3 是看到结果之前的先验；"出错"这个信息让坏状态的可能性大大增加，因为坏状态下出错的概率是好状态的 100 倍。

P(B | e) = P(B) P(e | B) / Pe = 3 × 10⁻³ / 3.07 × 10⁻³ = 0.977
P(G | e) = 7 × 10⁻⁵ / 3.07 × 10⁻³ = 0.023
Check: 0.977 + 0.023 = 1

For comparison: if we know the bit was not in error, the probability of the bad state = 0.3 × 0.99 / (1 − 0.00307) = 0.298, still almost 0.3. "Error" carries a lot of information; "no error" hardly changes the picture, because almost all bits are correct in both states.对比一下：如果知道这个比特没有出错，坏状态的概率 = 0.3 × 0.99 / (1 − 0.00307) = 0.298，几乎还是 0.3。"出错"带来的信息很多，"没出错"几乎不改变判断，因为两种状态下绝大多数比特都是对的。

ConceptMean and variance of a discrete random variable

A discrete random variable takes only a few values, each with a probability. The expectation (mean, p.10, the lecturer said to memorise it) E[X] = Σ x PX(x) is the probability-weighted average. The variance (p.11) V[X] = E[(X − E[X])²] = E[X²] − (E[X])² measures how spread out the values are around the mean; the standard deviation is its square root and has the same unit as X.离散随机变量（discrete random variable）只取有限几个值，每个值有一个概率。期望（expectation，也叫均值 mean，p.10，老师说要背）E[X] = Σ x PX(x)，就是"按概率加权的平均"。方差（variance，p.11）V[X] = E[(X − E[X])²] = E[X²] − (E[X])²，衡量取值离平均值有多分散；标准差是方差开根号，单位和 X 一样。

Slide p.10 also says: in general E[g(X)] ≠ g(E[X]) (the lecturer said this is a common past mistake). Converting to dB is such a g: g(γ) = 10 log₁₀γ. "Convert to dB, then average" computes E[g(γ)]; "average, then convert to dB" computes g(E[γ]); they are not equal. The question asks for the mean SNR expressed in dB, which is the second one.讲义 p.10 还有一句：一般来说 E[g(X)] ≠ g(E[X])（老师说这是往年常见错误）。dB 换算就是一个 g：g(γ) = 10 log₁₀γ。"先换成 dB 再平均"算的是 E[g(γ)]，"先平均再换成 dB"算的是 g(E[γ])，两者不相等。题目问"平均 SNR 用 dB 表示"，要的是后者。

Step by step(c) Convert to linear first, then use a table

StateProbability pSNR (dB)Linear γγ·pγ²·p
Good0.710 dB10770
Bad0.30 dB10.30.3
Total17.370.3
10 dB → 10^(10/10) = 10; 0 dB → 10⁰ = 1
E[γ] = 7 + 0.3 = 7.3
E[γ²] = 70 + 0.3 = 70.3
Var(γ) = 70.3 − 7.3² = 70.3 − 53.29 = 17.01; standard deviation = √17.01 = 4.12
mean SNR = 10 log₁₀7.3 = 10 × 0.8633 = 8.63 dB

Check (variance from the definition): 0.7 × (10 − 7.3)² + 0.3 × (1 − 7.3)² = 0.7 × 7.29 + 0.3 × 39.69 = 5.103 + 11.907 = 17.01, the same as above.检验（按定义算方差）：0.7 × (10 − 7.3)² + 0.3 × (1 − 7.3)² = 0.7 × 7.29 + 0.3 × 39.69 = 5.103 + 11.907 = 17.01，和上面一样。

PitfallsWhere marks are usually lost

  • (b) answered as 0.3: the a priori probability taken as the a posteriori one.(b) 写成 0.3：把先验当成了后验。
  • Only the bad-state term in the Bayes denominator, giving 1, which is clearly wrong; the denominator is the total from (a).贝叶斯的分母只写了坏状态那一项，结果等于 1，显然不对；分母是 (a) 的总和。
  • Averaging the dB values directly: 0.7 × 10 + 0.3 × 0 = 7 dB, i.e. 5.01 in linear scale, smaller than the correct 7.3. The lecturer said a missing dB ↔ linear conversion loses marks.直接平均 dB 值：0.7 × 10 + 0.3 × 0 = 7 dB，相当于线性 5.01，比正确的 7.3 小。老师说没做 dB ↔ 线性换算会扣分。
  • Forgetting to subtract (E[γ])² in the variance and writing 70.3; also do not convert the variance to dB, it has no meaning in dB and the question does not ask for it.方差忘了减 (E[γ])²，写成 70.3；也不要把方差再换成 dB，方差没有 dB 的意义，题目也没问。
  • Misaligning the orders of magnitude when adding 10⁻⁴ and 10⁻² terms.10⁻⁴ 和 10⁻² 相加时数量级对错。

ExamHow to write it in English

Let G and B denote the good and bad states and e a bit error: P(G) = 0.7, P(B) = 0.3, P(e | G) = 10⁻⁴, P(e | B) = 10⁻².

(a) By the total probability theorem, Pe = P(G)P(e | G) + P(B)P(e | B) = 0.7 × 10⁻⁴ + 0.3 × 10⁻² = 3.07 × 10⁻³.

(b) By Bayes' rule, P(B | e) = P(B)P(e | B) / Pe = (3 × 10⁻³) / (3.07 × 10⁻³) = 0.977.

(c) In linear scale the SNR is 10 (10 dB) with probability 0.7 and 1 (0 dB) with probability 0.3. E[γ] = 0.7 × 10 + 0.3 × 1 = 7.3, i.e. 10 log₁₀7.3 = 8.63 dB. E[γ²] = 0.7 × 100 + 0.3 × 1 = 70.3, so Var(γ) = 70.3 − 7.3² = 17.01. The dB values must not be averaged directly, because E[g(X)] ≠ g(E[X]).

In one line: first make a "state – probability – conditional probability" table; total probability is a weighted sum, Bayes is "one term ÷ the total"; convert dB to linear before taking the mean and variance.一句话：先列"状态—概率—条件概率"表；全概率是加权求和，贝叶斯是"其中一项 ÷ 总和"；求均值和方差前先把 dB 换成线性值。
◆ Key points
What it tests
Total probability, Bayes' rule (blue box, memorise), mean and variance of a discrete random variable (Ch 1b p.5–14, Quiz scope).
Background
P(B) = ΣP(Ai)P(B | Ai); P(Ai | B) = P(Ai)P(B | Ai)/P(B); E[X] = Σx·p(x); Var(X) = E[X²] − (E[X])².
Method
Make a table of state, probability and conditional probability. (a) Weighted sum; (b) the matching term of (a) divided by the total of (a); (c) convert to linear, then E[X] and E[X²] from the table.
Common mistakes
Averaging dB values (7 dB, wrong); forgetting to subtract the squared mean; the Bayes denominator is the total error probability from total probability; total probability must sum over all states (a past mistake the lecturer pointed out).
Intuition
The bad state is 30% of the time but gives 97.7% of the errors: the average error rate is set almost entirely by the bad periods, which is why Ch 4 uses diversity.
Variations
A three-state channel works the same with one more row; or "probability that two consecutive bits are both wrong" (multiply if independent).
Link
Practice 4 Q2 (average error rate over a discrete SNR); P2 Q2 (c) is the continuous version of total probability.

思路：(a) 分情况讨论再加权，就是全概率；(b) 已经看到结果（出错），反过来问原因（处于哪个状态），就是贝叶斯；(c) 离散分布求期望和方差，先把 dB 换成线性值。

  1. (a) 列状态表：两种状态互斥，合起来是全部情况：P(G) + P(B) = 0.7 + 0.3 = 1 ✓，所以 {G, B} 是一个划分（partition）。题目给的误比特率是条件概率（conditional probability）\(P(e\mid G)=10^{-4}\)、\(P(e\mid B)=10^{-2}\)。先用乘法规则（multiplication rule，讲义第 1b 章 p.6）算两个联合概率： \[\begin{aligned}P(G\cap e)&=P(G)\,P(e\mid G)\\&=0.7\times10^{-4}=7\times10^{-5}\\P(B\cap e)&=P(B)\,P(e\mid B)\\&=0.3\times10^{-2}=3\times10^{-3}\end{aligned}\]
  2. (a) 全概率求和：出错时链路一定处于 G 或 B 之一，所以把两项加起来，这就是全概率定理（total probability theorem，p.8）： \[\begin{aligned}P_e&=P(G)P(e\mid G)+P(B)P(e\mid B)\\&=7\times10^{-5}+3\times10^{-3}\\&=0.00307=3.07\times10^{-3}\end{aligned}\] 自检：平均值落在 \(10^{-4}\) 和 \(10^{-2}\) 之间 ✓；它更靠近坏状态那一项，因为 \(3\times10^{-3}\) 是 \(7\times10^{-5}\) 的 43 倍。
  3. (b) 贝叶斯：已知结果（出错），反过来问原因（坏状态），用贝叶斯公式（Bayes' rule，p.9）。分子是 (a) 里坏状态那一项，分母是 (a) 的总和： \[\begin{aligned}P(B\mid e)&=\frac{P(B)\,P(e\mid B)}{P_e}\\&=\frac{3\times10^{-3}}{3.07\times10^{-3}}=0.977\end{aligned}\]
  4. (b) 自检：另一个状态 \(P(G\mid e)=\dfrac{7\times10^{-5}}{3.07\times10^{-3}}=0.023\)，两个后验概率之和 0.977 + 0.023 = 1 ✓。坏状态的概率从事先的 0.3（先验，a priori）升到 0.977（后验，a posteriori），因为坏状态下出错的可能性是好状态的 100 倍。
  5. (c) dB 换线性：\(\gamma=10^{\gamma_{dB}/10}\)：10 dB → \(10^{1}=10\)，0 dB → \(10^{0}=1\)。所以 SNR 是一个离散随机变量：γ = 10 的概率 0.7，γ = 1 的概率 0.3。dB 是对数，不能直接平均，必须先换成线性值。
  6. (c) 均值：离散随机变量的期望 \(E[\gamma]=\sum\gamma\,P(\gamma)\)（讲义 p.10）： \[\begin{aligned}E[\gamma]&=0.7\times10+0.3\times1=7+0.3=7.3\\ \bar\gamma_{dB}&=10\log_{10}7.3=10\times0.8633\\&=8.63\text{ dB}\end{aligned}\]
  7. (c) 方差：用 \(\mathrm{Var}(\gamma)=E[\gamma^2]-(E[\gamma])^2\)（p.11），先求二阶矩： \[\begin{aligned}E[\gamma^2]&=0.7\times10^2+0.3\times1^2\\&=70+0.3=70.3\\ \mathrm{Var}(\gamma)&=70.3-7.3^2=70.3-53.29\\&=17.01\end{aligned}\] 标准差 \(\sqrt{17.01}=4.12\)。自检（按定义 \(E[(\gamma-\mu)^2]\)）： \[\begin{aligned}&0.7\times(10-7.3)^2+0.3\times(1-7.3)^2\\&=5.103+11.907=17.01\ \checkmark\end{aligned}\]
(a) 3.07 × 10⁻³；(b) 0.977；(c) E[γ] = 7.3（8.63 dB），Var(γ) = 17.0
官方答案：无（自编模拟题）。所有数字已用 src/p2build/verify_mock.py 验算。
直接把 dB 值平均，得到 0.7 × 10 + 0.3 × 0 = 7 dB，是错的：dB 是对数，要先换成线性值再求平均。老师说没做 dB ↔ 线性换算会扣分。另外 (b) 很有代表性：坏状态只占 30% 的时间，却贡献了 97.7% 的错误，误码几乎全来自信道差的时候。
知识讲解 + 详细解析：全概率、贝叶斯与离散期望方差

知识讲解条件概率、全概率、贝叶斯是一套工具

条件概率（conditional probability）P(A | B) 读作"已知 B 发生了，A 发生的概率"。本题给的误比特率就是条件概率：P(e | G) = 10⁻⁴ 的意思是"在好状态下，一个比特出错的概率"。

乘法规则（multiplication rule，讲义第 1b 章 p.6）：P(A ∩ B) = P(A) P(B | A)。例如"处于坏状态并且出错"的概率 = P(B) P(e | B) = 0.3 × 10⁻² = 3 × 10⁻³。

全概率定理（total probability theorem，p.8）：把所有可能的情况 A₁、A₂、……（互不重叠、合起来是全部）分开，每种情况各算"这种情况发生并且 B 发生"，再全部加起来：P(B) = Σ P(Ai) P(B | Ai)。讲义叫它"分而治之"（divide and conquer）。

贝叶斯公式（Bayes' rule，p.9，蓝框必背）：已知结果 B，反过来问原因 Ai：\(P(A_i\mid B)=\dfrac{P(A_i)\,P(B\mid A_i)}{\sum_j P(A_j)\,P(B\mid A_j)}\)。分子是乘法规则，分母就是全概率。P(Ai) 叫先验概率（a priori），P(Ai | B) 叫后验概率（a posteriori）。

老师课上强调：往年有人把 P(B) 只写成一项 P(A₁)P(B | A₁)，全概率必须对所有情况求和；贝叶斯在第 3、6 章（最大似然检测、MLSE）还会反复用到。

把概率换成"个数"最好理解。假设发送 100 万个比特：

状态发送的比特数出错的比特数
好（概率 0.7）70 万70 万 × 10⁻⁴ = 70
坏（概率 0.3）30 万30 万 × 10⁻² = 3000
合计100 万3070

(a) 总误码率 = 3070 / 100 万；(b) 在所有出错的比特里，坏状态贡献的占 3000 / 3070。这就是全概率和贝叶斯的直观版。

详细解析(a) 全概率：分情况，再加权求和

  1. 做什么：把"出错"按发送时的状态分成两种情况。为什么：每种状态下的误码率已知，但不知道某个比特是在哪种状态下发的，只能两种都算、按出现概率加权。
  2. 怎么算：
    P(G) P(e | G) = 0.7 × 10⁻⁴ = 7 × 10⁻⁵
    P(B) P(e | B) = 0.3 × 10⁻² = 3 × 10⁻³
    Pe = 7 × 10⁻⁵ + 3 × 10⁻³ = 0.00007 + 0.003 = 3.07 × 10⁻³
  3. 计算器提示：两个数差两个数量级，先都写成小数再相加，不容易错位。

详细解析(b) 贝叶斯：由结果反推原因

做什么：已知"出错了"，求"当时是坏状态"的后验概率。为什么答案不是 0.3：0.3 是看到结果之前的先验；"出错"这个信息让坏状态的可能性大大增加，因为坏状态下出错的概率是好状态的 100 倍。

P(B | e) = P(B) P(e | B) / Pe = 3 × 10⁻³ / 3.07 × 10⁻³ = 0.977
P(G | e) = 7 × 10⁻⁵ / 3.07 × 10⁻³ = 0.023
检验：0.977 + 0.023 = 1

对比一下：如果知道这个比特没有出错，坏状态的概率 = 0.3 × 0.99 / (1 − 0.00307) = 0.298，几乎还是 0.3。"出错"带来的信息很多，"没出错"几乎不改变判断，因为两种状态下绝大多数比特都是对的。

知识讲解离散随机变量的期望和方差

离散随机变量（discrete random variable）只取有限几个值，每个值有一个概率。期望（expectation，也叫均值 mean，p.10，老师说要背）E[X] = Σ x PX(x)，就是"按概率加权的平均"。方差（variance，p.11）V[X] = E[(X − E[X])²] = E[X²] − (E[X])²，衡量取值离平均值有多分散；标准差是方差开根号，单位和 X 一样。

讲义 p.10 还有一句：一般来说 E[g(X)] ≠ g(E[X])（老师说这是往年常见错误）。dB 换算就是一个 g：g(γ) = 10 log₁₀γ。"先换成 dB 再平均"算的是 E[g(γ)]，"先平均再换成 dB"算的是 g(E[γ])，两者不相等。题目问"平均 SNR 用 dB 表示"，要的是后者。

详细解析(c) 先换线性值，再列表算

状态概率 pSNR（dB）线性 γγ·pγ²·p
好0.710 dB10770
坏0.30 dB10.30.3
合计17.370.3
10 dB → 10^(10/10) = 10；0 dB → 10⁰ = 1
E[γ] = 7 + 0.3 = 7.3
E[γ²] = 70 + 0.3 = 70.3
Var(γ) = 70.3 − 7.3² = 70.3 − 53.29 = 17.01；标准差 = √17.01 = 4.12
平均 SNR = 10 log₁₀7.3 = 10 × 0.8633 = 8.63 dB

检验（按定义算方差）：0.7 × (10 − 7.3)² + 0.3 × (1 − 7.3)² = 0.7 × 7.29 + 0.3 × 39.69 = 5.103 + 11.907 = 17.01，和上面一样。

易错常见丢分点

  • (b) 写成 0.3：把先验当成了后验。
  • 贝叶斯的分母只写了坏状态那一项，结果等于 1，显然不对；分母是 (a) 的总和。
  • 直接平均 dB 值：0.7 × 10 + 0.3 × 0 = 7 dB，相当于线性 5.01，比正确的 7.3 小。老师说没做 dB ↔ 线性换算会扣分。
  • 方差忘了减 (E[γ])²，写成 70.3；也不要把方差再换成 dB，方差没有 dB 的意义，题目也没问。
  • 10⁻⁴ 和 10⁻² 相加时数量级对错。

考试英文写法

Let G and B denote the good and bad states and e a bit error: P(G) = 0.7, P(B) = 0.3, P(e | G) = 10⁻⁴, P(e | B) = 10⁻².

(a) By the total probability theorem, Pe = P(G)P(e | G) + P(B)P(e | B) = 0.7 × 10⁻⁴ + 0.3 × 10⁻² = 3.07 × 10⁻³.

(b) By Bayes' rule, P(B | e) = P(B)P(e | B) / Pe = (3 × 10⁻³) / (3.07 × 10⁻³) = 0.977.

(c) In linear scale the SNR is 10 (10 dB) with probability 0.7 and 1 (0 dB) with probability 0.3. E[γ] = 0.7 × 10 + 0.3 × 1 = 7.3, i.e. 10 log₁₀7.3 = 8.63 dB. E[γ²] = 0.7 × 100 + 0.3 × 1 = 70.3, so Var(γ) = 70.3 − 7.3² = 17.01. The dB values must not be averaged directly, because E[g(X)] ≠ g(E[X]).

一句话：先列"状态—概率—条件概率"表；全概率是加权求和，贝叶斯是"其中一项 ÷ 总和"；求均值和方差前先把 dB 换成线性值。
◆ 本题知识点
考什么
全概率、贝叶斯（蓝框必背）、离散随机变量的期望和方差（第 1b 章 p.5–14，Quiz 范围）。
前置知识
P(B) = ΣP(Ai)P(B | Ai)；P(Ai | B) = P(Ai)P(B | Ai)/P(B)；E[X] = Σx·p(x)；Var(X) = E[X²] − (E[X])²。
解题套路
先列"状态—概率—条件概率"表；(a) 加权求和；(b) 用 (a) 里对应那一项除以 (a) 的总和；(c) 换成线性值后列表求 E[X]、E[X²]。
易错
直接平均 dB 值（得 7 dB，错）；方差忘了减均值的平方；贝叶斯的分母是全概率算出的总误码率；全概率必须对所有状态求和（老师点名的往年错误）。
直觉
坏状态只占 30% 的时间，却贡献了 97.7% 的错误：平均误码率几乎完全由信道差的时候决定，这也是第 4 章要用分集的原因。
举一反三
三个状态的信道同理，表里多一行；也可以问"连续两个比特都出错的概率"（独立时相乘）。
联系
Practice 4 第 2 题（离散 SNR 求平均误码率）；P2 Q2 (c) 是全概率的连续版本。

P1 · Q1

Fit the path-loss model, then find the outage probability

Original question · Chinese and EnglishPractice 1

A set of empirical path loss measurements is given in Table 1, where \(P_t\) and \(P_r\) are the transmitted power and received power respectively.

表 1 给出了一组实测路径损耗数据，其中 \(P_t\) 和 \(P_r\) 分别是发射功率和接收功率。

Distance from Transmitter \(d_i\) (m)
距发射机距离		\((P_r/P_t)_{dB}\)
5−60
25−80
65−105
110−115
400−130
1,000−150

(a) Using the path loss model, \(P_r=P_tK[1/d]^{\gamma}\), find the values of K in dB and γ that best fit the data shown in the Table.

(a) 使用路径损耗模型 \(P_r=P_tK[1/d]^{\gamma}\)，求最能拟合表中数据的 K（以 dB 表示）和 γ。

(b) Assuming the presence of shadowing and that the received power at a distance d due to path loss alone is 10 dB above the required minimum power for non-outage, find the outage probability at d.

(b) 假设存在阴影衰落，并且在距离 d 处仅由路径损耗决定的接收功率比“不中断”所需的最小功率高 10 dB，求距离 d 处的中断概率。

Simplified path-loss modelLeast-squares fitShadowing variance = MSEOutage probability via the Q functionNotes Ch. 2 p.8, 12–15
What the question is asking: what does this question actually want?

ScenarioWhat the question is about

Someone took a receiver to six spots, 5 m, 25 m, 65 m, 110 m, 400 m and 1000 m from the transmitter, and at each one measured once "how much smaller the received power is than the transmitted power". The \((P_r/P_t)_{dB}\) in the table is this ratio (negative = loss).有人拿着接收机，在离发射机 5 m、25 m、65 m、110 m、400 m、1000 m 六个地方各测了一次"收到的功率比发出的功率小多少"，表里的 \((P_r/P_t)_{dB}\) 就是这个比值（负数 = 损耗）。

The question gives a path-loss model \(P_r=P_tK(1/d)^{\gamma}\) and asks you to use these 6 measured points to pin down the two unknown parameters of the model, then use it to compute the outage probability.题目给了一个路径损耗模型 \(P_r=P_tK(1/d)^{\gamma}\)，要你用这 6 个实测点把模型里的两个未知参数定下来，再用它算中断概率。

In dB the model becomes a straight line: \((P_r/P_t)_{dB}=K_{dB}-\gamma\cdot10\log_{10}d\). So (a) is really "given 6 points, draw the straight line that fits them best".取 dB 以后模型变成一条直线：\((P_r/P_t)_{dB}=K_{dB}-\gamma\cdot10\log_{10}d\)。所以 (a) 本质上就是"给 6 个点，画一条最贴合的直线"。

SymbolsWhat each quantity in the question means

\(d_i\)Distance from the measurement point to the transmitter (m)测量点离发射机的距离（m）
\((P_r/P_t)_{dB}\)Measured path gain (dB); the more negative, the larger the loss实测的路径增益（dB），负得越多损耗越大
KGain at the reference distance of 1 m; the intercept of the line参考距离 1 m 处的增益，直线的截距
γPath-loss exponent: each 10× increase in distance adds 10γ dB of loss; free space γ = 2, urban 3–5. The slope of the line is −γ路径损耗指数：距离每增大 10 倍，损耗多 10γ dB；自由空间 γ = 2，城市 3–5。直线的斜率是 −γ
ShadowingThe 6 points will not lie exactly on the line. Their deviation from the line is the shadowing, which you need in (b)6 个点不会正好落在直线上，偏离直线的那部分就是阴影，(b) 要用它

What each part asksWhat each part is asking for

  • (a) Use least squares to find the line that best fits the 6 points, and read off K (dB) and γ.(a) 用最小二乘（least squares）找最贴合 6 个点的直线，读出 K（dB）和 γ。
  • (b) "Considering only path loss, the received power is 10 dB above the minimum power needed to avoid outage": the average power given by the line is 10 dB above the threshold, i.e. the margin is 10 dB. Outage happens when shadowing pushes the power down by more than 10 dB. The question does not give the shadowing standard deviation σ; you get it from the fitting residuals in (a): σ² = mean squared error (MSE).(b) "只考虑路径损耗时，接收功率比不中断所需的最低功率高 10 dB"：直线给出的平均功率比门限高 10 dB，即余量 10 dB。阴影把功率往下压超过 10 dB 就中断。题目没给阴影的标准差 σ，要从 (a) 的拟合残差里算：σ² = 均方误差（MSE）。

Watch outEasy ways to misread the question

  • The x-axis is 10 log₁₀d, not log₁₀d; otherwise γ is off by a factor of 10.横坐标用 10 log₁₀d，不是 log₁₀d，否则 γ 会差 10 倍。
  • "10 dB above" is the margin, not the threshold itself. It means the same as Δ in P2 Q2: outage probability = Q(margin/σ)."10 dB above" 是余量，不是门限本身；和 P2 Q2 的 Δ 是同一个意思，中断概率 = Q(余量/σ)。
  • The MSE is the variance σ²; take the square root before putting it into Q.MSE 是方差 σ²，代进 Q 之前要开根号。

PurposeWhat the question wants you to understand

How measured data becomes a model: the line is the path loss (the average trend), the scatter of the points around the line is the shadowing (random fluctuation), and the size of that scatter directly sets the outage probability.实测数据怎么变成模型：直线部分是路径损耗（平均趋势），点在直线周围的散布是阴影（随机波动），散布的大小直接决定中断概率。

In one line: fit a dB line to the 6 measured points to get K and γ, then treat the deviation of the points from the line as the shadowing σ, and find the probability of being "more than 10 dB below the average".一句话：用 6 个测量点拟合一条 dB 直线得到 K、γ，再把点偏离直线的程度当作阴影 σ，求"比平均低 10 dB 以上"的概率。

Approach: In dB the model is a straight line \(y=K_{dB}-\gamma x\) with \(x=10\log_{10}d\) (\(d_0\) = 1 m). Least squares finds the line closest to the 6 points; the remaining mean squared error is the shadowing variance.

  1. (a) Turn the model into a straight line: take 10 log₁₀ of both sides (d₀ = 1 m, Ch 2 p.8, p.12): \[\begin{aligned}M=\Big(\frac{P_r}{P_t}\Big)_{dB}&=K_{dB}-\gamma\cdot10\log_{10}d\\&=K_{dB}-\gamma\,x,\qquad x=10\log_{10}d\end{aligned}\] With x on the horizontal axis and the measured M on the vertical axis, the 6 points should lie close to a straight line with intercept \(K_{dB}\) and slope \(-\gamma\). First convert the distances (in metres) to x:
    10 log₁₀5 = 6.99, 10 log₁₀25 = 13.98
    10 log₁₀65 = 18.13, 10 log₁₀110 = 20.41
    10 log₁₀400 = 26.02, 10 log₁₀1000 = 30.00
  2. (a) The four sums: least squares needs only these four sums (a calculator's statistics mode gives them directly); also find the two means:
    Σx = 115.53, Σx² = 2566.75
    ΣM = −640, ΣxM = −13671.57
    x̄ = 115.53 / 6 = 19.26
    M̄ = −640 / 6 = −106.67
  3. (a) Normal equations for γ: least squares minimises the sum of squared errors \(F=\sum_i(M_i-K_{dB}+\gamma x_i)^2\) (Ch 2 p.13: minimise the MSE between measured and model path loss). Setting \(\partial F/\partial K=0\) and \(\partial F/\partial\gamma=0\) (the normal equations) gives \(K_{dB}=\bar M+\gamma\bar x\) and \(\gamma=-S_{xM}/S_{xx}\): \[\begin{aligned}S_{xx}&=\textstyle\sum x^2-(\sum x)^2/6\\&=2566.75-2224.64=342.11\\ S_{xM}&=\textstyle\sum xM-\sum x\sum M/6\\&=-13671.57+12323.49\\&=-1348.08\end{aligned}\] \[\gamma=-\frac{S_{xM}}{S_{xx}}=\frac{1348.08}{342.11}=3.94\] \(S_{xx}=\sum(x_i-\bar x)^2\) and \(S_{xM}=\sum(x_i-\bar x)(M_i-\bar M)\); the expanded forms above are easier on a calculator. The slope is −3.94, so γ = +3.94.
  4. (a) Intercept K: from \(\partial F/\partial K=0\), the best line always passes through the mean point \((\bar x,\bar M)\): \[\begin{aligned}K_{dB}&=\bar M+\gamma\bar x\\&=-106.67+3.94\times19.26\\&=-106.67+75.88=-30.79\approx-30.8\ \text{dB}\end{aligned}\] γ = 3.94 lies in the 3.7–6.5 range for urban macro-cells in the table on Ch 2 p.9, so it is reasonable.
  5. (b) Residuals → shadowing variance: residual \(e_i=M_i-\hat y_i\): first compute the fitted prediction \(\hat y_i=K_{dB}-\gamma x_i=-30.79-3.94\,x_i\), then subtract it from the measurement \(M_i\).
    d (m)\(x_i\)\(\gamma x_i\)prediction \(\hat y_i\)measured \(M_i\)residual \(e_i\)\(e_i^2\)
    56.9927.54−58.33−60−1.672.78
    2513.9855.09−85.88−80+5.8834.53

    11020.4180.44−111.23−115−3.7714.20

    \(\sum e_i^2=71.23\), so the MSE is \(\sigma_\psi^2=71.23/6=11.87\) and \(\sigma_\psi=3.45\) dB. (Least-squares residuals always sum to 0, a quick arithmetic check.) Row example (d = 5 m): \(\hat y_1=-30.79-27.54=-58.33\), \(e_1=-60-(-58.33)=-1.67\), \(e_1^2=2.78\). Why the MSE is the shadowing variance: Ch 2 p.13 defines the error \(X_i\) (measured − model) and sets its mean square \(E[X_i^2]=\sigma_\psi^2\), so divide by n = 6 (not 5), as in the definition.
  6. (b) Write the outage probability: the mean received power from path loss alone is 10 dB above the minimum required power, i.e. the margin is x = 10 dB. Outage means shadowing pulls the power down by more than 10 dB (Ch 2 p.14–15): \[\begin{aligned}P_{out}&=P\big(P_{r,dB}\lt P_{m,dB}\big)\\&=P\big(\psi_{dB}\lt-10\big)=Q\Big(\frac{10}{\sigma_\psi}\Big)\end{aligned}\] Last step: divide by \(\sigma_\psi\) to standardise, then use the symmetry of the Gaussian, P(N < −a) = P(N > a) = Q(a). Use the margin in dB directly; do not convert it to linear.
  7. (b) Substitute and look up Q: the MSE is a variance, so take the square root before putting it in Q:
    σψ = √11.87 = 3.45 dB
    10 / σψ = 10 / 3.45 = 2.90
    Pout = Q(2.90) ≈ 1.85 × 10⁻³ (about 0.19%)
    A two-decimal Q table gives Q(2.90) = 1.87 × 10⁻³; 1.85 × 10⁻³ uses the unrounded 10/3.446 = 2.902. The difference is only rounding.
  8. Check: ① the residuals sum to −1.67 + 5.88 − 2.77 − 3.77 + 3.32 − 0.99 = 0 ✓ (a property of least squares); ② the line passes through the mean point: −30.79 − 3.94 × 19.26 = −106.67 = M̄ ✓; ③ order of magnitude: a 10 dB margin is about 2.9σ, a little less than the 3.09σ for Q(3.09) = 10⁻³, so the outage is a little above 10⁻³ ✓.
Standard least squares: K ≈ −30.8 dB, γ ≈ 3.94, σ²ψ ≈ 11.9 dB², Pout ≈ 1.85 × 10⁻³
Official answer: (a) KdB = −31.4 dB, γ = 3.86; (b) 6.19 × 10⁻⁴
Part (b) of the official answer comes from the MSE the lecturer used in class, 9.656: he took 10/√9.656 ≈ 3.23 and read Q(3.23) = 6.19 × 10⁻⁴ from the table (week 10 recording; precisely 10/3.107 = 3.22 and Q ≈ 6.5 × 10⁻⁴). But 9.656 does not match the official K and γ either: substituting K = −31.4, γ = 3.86 back into the 6 points gives an MSE of 13.1, and standard least squares gives 11.87. In class the lecturer said the numbers depend on rounding and anything "around −31.4 and 3.86" is fine. In the exam, state the method clearly (least squares, σ² = MSE, Pout = Q(10/σ)) and use the numbers you obtain.
Concept + walkthrough: least-squares fit of K, γ, then shadowing outage知识讲解 + 详细解析：最小二乘拟合 K、γ，再求阴影中断

ConceptPath loss + shadowing = a straight line + random scatter

Simplified path loss model (lecture Ch 2 p.8): \(P_r=P_tK(d_0/d)^{\gamma}\), d₀ = 1 m. K is the power gain at 1 m (a constant set by the environment and antennas), and γ is the path loss exponent. The lecturer stressed in class that this is a fixed name, and that both the linear and the dB forms must be memorised; they are not given in the exam.简化路径损耗模型（simplified path loss model，讲义第 2 章 p.8）：\(P_r=P_tK(d_0/d)^{\gamma}\)，d₀ = 1 m。K 是 1 m 处的功率增益（由环境、天线决定的常数），γ 是路径损耗指数（path loss exponent）。老师课上强调：这是专有名词，线性和 dB 两种形式都要背，考试不给。

Take 10 log₁₀ of both sides to get dB: \(M=(P_r/P_t)_{dB}=K_{dB}-\gamma\cdot10\log_{10}(d/d_0)\). With \(x=10\log_{10}d\) this is a straight line \(M=K_{dB}-\gamma x\): the intercept is KdB and the slope is −γ.两边取 10 log₁₀ 变成 dB：\(M=(P_r/P_t)_{dB}=K_{dB}-\gamma\cdot10\log_{10}(d/d_0)\)。令 \(x=10\log_{10}d\)，它就是一条直线 \(M=K_{dB}-\gamma x\)：截距是 KdB，斜率是 −γ。

The measured points never lie exactly on the line; the deviation is the shadowing \(\psi_{dB}\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma_\psi^2)\) (p.11–12). The method on p.13: find the line that minimises the mean squared error (MSE) between measurement and model, and MSE = E[Xi²] = σψ². So one data set gives two things: the line (mean trend) and the scatter of the points (shadowing variance).实测点不会正好落在直线上，偏离的部分就是阴影（shadowing）\(\psi_{dB}\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma_\psi^2)\)（p.11–12）。讲义 p.13 的做法：找让"实测 − 模型"的均方误差（MSE）最小的直线，并且 MSE = E[Xi²] = σψ²。所以一组数据同时给出两样东西：直线（平均趋势）和点的散布（阴影方差）。

Outage probability (p.14–15): \(P_{out}=P(\psi_{dB}\lt-x)=Q(x/\sigma_\psi)\), where x = mean received power without shadowing − minimum required power, i.e. the margin.中断概率（outage probability，p.14–15）：\(P_{out}=P(\psi_{dB}\lt-x)=Q(x/\sigma_\psi)\)，x = 不含阴影时的平均接收功率 − 最低要求功率，也就是余量（margin）。

SymbolMeaningHere
xi10 log₁₀di, horizontal axis of the line10 log₁₀di，直线的横坐标6.99 … 30.00
Mimeasured (Pr/Pt)dB, vertical axis实测 (Pr/Pt)dB，纵坐标−60 … −150
KdB, γintercept; minus the slope截距；斜率的相反数unknown
σψ²shadowing variance = MSE of the fit阴影方差 = 拟合的 MSEunknown
margin xhow many dB the mean power is above the threshold平均功率比门限高多少 dB10 dB

Step by step(a) K and γ from the two normal equations

  1. What: write the sum of squared errors \(F(K,\gamma)=\sum_i(M_i-K+\gamma x_i)^2\). Why: least squares means minimising F; this is how the lecturer wrote it in class.做什么：写出误差平方和 \(F(K,\gamma)=\sum_i(M_i-K+\gamma x_i)^2\)。为什么：最小二乘就是让 F 最小，老师课上就是这样写的。
  2. Set the derivative with respect to K to 0: \(\sum_i(M_i-K+\gamma x_i)=0\) → \(K=\bar M+\gamma\bar x\). So the best line always passes through the mean point (x̄, M̄).对 K 求偏导令其为 0：\(\sum_i(M_i-K+\gamma x_i)=0\) → \(K=\bar M+\gamma\bar x\)。意思是最佳直线一定经过平均点 (x̄, M̄)。
  3. Set the derivative with respect to γ to 0: \(\sum_i x_i(M_i-K+\gamma x_i)=0\); substitute the previous result and simplify to \(\gamma=-S_{xM}/S_{xx}\).对 γ 求偏导令其为 0：\(\sum_i x_i(M_i-K+\gamma x_i)=0\)，把上一式代入整理，得 \(\gamma=-S_{xM}/S_{xx}\)。
  4. How to compute: on the calculator first get four sums, then the two S values (fewer slips than computing x − x̄ point by point):怎么算：计算器上先求四个和，再算两个 S（这样比逐点算 x − x̄ 少出错）：
xi = 10 log₁₀di: 6.99, 13.98, 18.13, 20.41, 26.02, 30.00
Σx = 115.53, Σx² = 2566.75, ΣM = −640, ΣxM = −13671.57
Sxx = Σx² − (Σx)²/6 = 2566.75 − 2224.64 = 342.11
SxM = ΣxM − ΣxΣM/6 = −13671.57 + 12323.49 = −1348.08
γ = 1348.08 / 342.11 = 3.94
KdB = M̄ + γx̄ = −106.67 + 3.94 × 19.26 = −30.8 dB

Step by step(b) Residuals → σ → Q function

  1. Residuals ei = measured − predicted (listed point by point in the solution table): −1.67, +5.88, −2.77, −3.77, +3.32, −0.99. They add up to 0, a property of least squares and a handy check.残差 ei = 实测 − 预测（解答里的表已逐点列出）：−1.67、+5.88、−2.77、−3.77、+3.32、−0.99。它们加起来是 0，这是最小二乘的性质，正好用来检查。
  2. Shadowing variance: σψ² = Σe²/6. Why divide by 6 and not 5: the slides define MSE = E[Xi²], a plain average, so in the exam divide by n as the slides do.阴影方差：σψ² = Σe²/6。为什么除以 6 而不是 5：讲义定义 MSE = E[Xi²]，就是简单平均，考试照讲义除以 n。
  3. Margin: "10 dB above the minimum power due to path loss alone" → x = 10 dB. Outage = shadowing pulls the power down by more than 10 dB: \(P_{out}=P(\psi_{dB}\lt-10)=Q(10/\sigma_\psi)\).余量："只算路径损耗时比最低功率高 10 dB" → x = 10 dB。中断 = 阴影把功率往下拉超过 10 dB：\(P_{out}=P(\psi_{dB}\lt-10)=Q(10/\sigma_\psi)\)。
σψ² = 71.23 / 6 = 11.87 dB²
σψ = √11.87 = 3.45 dB
10 / 3.45 = 2.90
Pout = Q(2.90) ≈ 1.85 × 10⁻³ (about 0.19%; the table entry at exactly 2.90 gives 1.87 × 10⁻³, the difference is only rounding)

CheckThree quick checks

  • The line passes through the mean point (19.26, −106.67); the residuals sum to 0.直线经过平均点 (19.26, −106.67)；残差之和 = 0。
  • γ = 3.94 lies in the urban macro-cell range 3.7–6.5 of the table on p.9, which is reasonable.γ = 3.94 落在讲义 p.9 表里城市宏蜂窝的 3.7–6.5 范围内，合理。
  • A 10 dB margin ≈ 2.9σ gives an outage of about two in a thousand. For comparison, a margin of 2.33σ gives 1%, so the order of magnitude fits.余量 10 dB ≈ 2.9σ，中断约千分之二。对比：余量 2.33σ 才对应 1%，量级对得上。

Official answerWhy it does not match standard least squares

The official answer is K = −31.4 dB, γ = 3.86, Pout = 6.19 × 10⁻⁴. Substituting the official K and γ back into the 6 points gives MSE = 13.1, larger than the least-squares 11.87, so it is not the least-squares solution for these data. Part (b) uses the lecturer's in-class MSE of 9.656: 10/√9.656 = 3.22, and the table at 3.23 gives 6.19 × 10⁻⁴. The lecturer said anything "around −31.4 and 3.86" is fine. In the exam, write every step of the method above and use your own numbers.官方答案是 K = −31.4 dB、γ = 3.86、Pout = 6.19 × 10⁻⁴。把官方的 K、γ 代回 6 个点，MSE = 13.1，比最小二乘的 11.87 还大，所以它不是这组数据的最小二乘解。(b) 用的是老师课上的 MSE = 9.656：10/√9.656 = 3.22，查表取 3.23 得 6.19 × 10⁻⁴。老师说结果"在 −31.4、3.86 附近就可以"。考试照上面的方法写清每一步、用自己算出的数即可。

PitfallsWhere marks are usually lost

  • Using log₁₀d instead of 10 log₁₀d on the horizontal axis: γ becomes 39.4, which is clearly unreasonable.横坐标用 log₁₀d 而不是 10 log₁₀d：γ 会变成 39.4，明显不合理。
  • The slope is −γ: the slope is −3.94, so γ = +3.94; do not write it as negative.斜率是 −γ：算出斜率 −3.94，所以 γ = +3.94，别写成负的。
  • Substitute d in metres (d₀ = 1 m). The lecturer said that in this year's Quiz some students wrote 2 km as log 2.d 用米代入（d₀ = 1 m）。老师说今年 Quiz 有人把 2 km 写成 log 2。
  • The MSE is a variance: take the square root before putting it into Q; Q(10/11.87) is wrong.MSE 是方差，进 Q 之前要开根号；写成 Q(10/11.87) 是错的。
  • Use the 10 dB margin directly in dB, do not convert to linear: this outage formula was derived in dB (the lecturer pointed this out in class).余量 10 dB 直接用 dB，不要换成线性：这个中断公式本来就是 dB 形式推出来的（老师课上特别提醒）。

ExamHow to write it in English

(a) In dB the model is a straight line, \(M=K_{dB}-\gamma x\), with \(x=10\log_{10}(d/d_0)\) and \(d_0\) = 1 m. Least squares minimises \(F(K,\gamma)=\sum_i(M_i-K_{dB}+\gamma x_i)^2\). Setting \(\partial F/\partial K=0\) and \(\partial F/\partial\gamma=0\) gives \(K_{dB}=\bar M+\gamma\bar x\) and \(\gamma=-S_{xM}/S_{xx}\).

With Σx = 115.53, Σx² = 2566.75, ΣM = −640 and ΣxM = −13671.57: Sxx = 342.11, SxM = −1348.08, so γ = 3.94 and KdB = −106.67 + 3.94 × 19.26 = −30.8 dB.

(b) The shadowing variance equals the MSE of the fit: σψ² = (1/6)Σei² = 71.23/6 = 11.87 dB², σψ = 3.45 dB. Outage occurs when shadowing lowers the power by more than the 10 dB margin: Pout = P(ψdB < −10) = Q(10/σψ) = Q(2.90) ≈ 1.85 × 10⁻³.

In one line: in dB the path loss is a straight line; least squares gives K and γ, the remaining mean squared error is the shadowing variance σ², and the outage probability is Q(margin / σ).一句话：dB 下路径损耗是一条直线，最小二乘给出 K、γ，剩下的均方误差就是阴影方差 σ²；中断概率 = Q(余量 / σ)。
◆ Key points
What it tests
Fitting K and γ of the simplified path-loss model to measured data by least squares, then using the fitted MSE as the shadowing variance to find the outage probability (Ch 2 p.8, p.12–15).
Background
dB arithmetic; least squares (set the partial derivatives with respect to K and γ to zero, see the derivation box in Section 2.1 of the learning page); the Q function (Ch 1b).
Method
① xi = 10 log₁₀(di/d₀); ② tabulate x, M, x², xM and sum each column; ③ solve the two normal equations for K and γ; ④ compute the residuals ei = measured − predicted, MSE = σψ²; ⑤ Pout = Q(margin/σψ).
Key formulas
γ = −Σ(xi − x̄)(Mi − M̄) / Σ(xi − x̄)²; KdB = M̄ + γx̄; σψ² = (1/n)Σei²; Pout = Q(10/σψ).
Common mistakes
The slope of the line is −γ, so keep the minus sign. Use 10 log₁₀d, not log₁₀d (otherwise γ comes out 10 times too large). The MSE is a variance: take the square root before putting it in Q. "10 dB above" means a 10 dB margin.
Check
The residuals sum to 0; the fitted line passes through the mean point (19.26, −106.67); Σe² = 71.23 from the table in step 4.
Variations
Given K, γ and σ, find the outage probability at some distance, or the maximum coverage distance for a target outage (lecture p.16 example, Section 2.2 of the learning page). See the note above on why the official answer cannot be reproduced.

思路：取 dB 后模型变成一条直线 \(y=K_{dB}-\gamma x\)，其中 \(x=10\log_{10}d\)（\(d_0\) = 1 m）。用最小二乘找最贴近 6 个点的直线；剩下的均方误差就是阴影方差。

  1. (a) 化成直线：模型两边取 10 log₁₀（d₀ = 1 m，讲义第 2 章 p.8、p.12）： \[\begin{aligned}M=\Big(\frac{P_r}{P_t}\Big)_{dB}&=K_{dB}-\gamma\cdot10\log_{10}d\\&=K_{dB}-\gamma\,x,\qquad x=10\log_{10}d\end{aligned}\] 以 x 为横坐标、实测 M 为纵坐标，6 个点应该落在一条直线附近：截距 = \(K_{dB}\)，斜率 = \(-\gamma\)。先把距离（用米代入）换成 x：
    10 log₁₀5 = 6.99，10 log₁₀25 = 13.98
    10 log₁₀65 = 18.13，10 log₁₀110 = 20.41
    10 log₁₀400 = 26.02，10 log₁₀1000 = 30.00
  2. (a) 列四个和：最小二乘只用到这四个和（计算器统计模式可以直接给出），顺便求两个平均：
    Σx = 115.53，Σx² = 2566.75
    ΣM = −640，ΣxM = −13671.57
    x̄ = 115.53 / 6 = 19.26
    M̄ = −640 / 6 = −106.67
  3. (a) 正规方程求 γ：最小二乘（least squares）让误差平方和 \(F=\sum_i(M_i-K_{dB}+\gamma x_i)^2\) 最小（讲义 p.13：最小化实测与模型之差的 MSE）。令 \(\partial F/\partial K=0\)、\(\partial F/\partial\gamma=0\)（正规方程，normal equations），解得 \(K_{dB}=\bar M+\gamma\bar x\)、\(\gamma=-S_{xM}/S_{xx}\)： \[\begin{aligned}S_{xx}&=\textstyle\sum x^2-(\sum x)^2/6\\&=2566.75-2224.64=342.11\\ S_{xM}&=\textstyle\sum xM-\sum x\sum M/6\\&=-13671.57+12323.49\\&=-1348.08\end{aligned}\] \[\gamma=-\frac{S_{xM}}{S_{xx}}=\frac{1348.08}{342.11}=3.94\] \(S_{xx}=\sum(x_i-\bar x)^2\)，\(S_{xM}=\sum(x_i-\bar x)(M_i-\bar M)\)；上面是展开后方便按计算器的形式。斜率是 −3.94，所以 γ = +3.94。
  4. (a) 求截距 K：由 \(\partial F/\partial K=0\)，最佳直线一定经过平均点 \((\bar x,\bar M)\)： \[\begin{aligned}K_{dB}&=\bar M+\gamma\bar x\\&=-106.67+3.94\times19.26\\&=-106.67+75.88=-30.79\approx-30.8\ \text{dB}\end{aligned}\] γ = 3.94 落在讲义 p.9 表中城市宏蜂窝（urban macro-cell）的 3.7–6.5 之间，合理。
  5. (b) 残差 → 阴影方差：残差 \(e_i=M_i-\hat y_i\)：先用拟合直线算预测值 \(\hat y_i=K_{dB}-\gamma x_i=-30.79-3.94\,x_i\)，再用实测值 \(M_i\) 减去它
    d (m)\(x_i\)\(\gamma x_i\)预测 \(\hat y_i\)实测 \(M_i\)残差 \(e_i\)\(e_i^2\)
    56.9927.54−58.33−60−1.672.78
    2513.9855.09−85.88−80+5.8834.53
    6518.1371.44−102.23−105−2.777.68
    11020.4180.44−111.23−115−3.7714.20
    40026.02102.53−133.32−130+3.3211.05
    100030.00118.22−149.01−150−0.990.99
    \(\sum e_i^2=71.23\)，均方误差 \(\sigma_\psi^2=71.23/6=11.87\)，\(\sigma_\psi=3.45\) dB。（最小二乘的残差加起来正好是 0，可以用来检查有没有算错。） 逐行举例（d = 5 m）：\(\hat y_1=-30.79-27.54=-58.33\)，\(e_1=-60-(-58.33)=-1.67\)，\(e_1^2=2.78\)。为什么 MSE 就是阴影方差：讲义 p.13 把误差 \(X_i\)（实测 − 模型）的均方值定义为 \(E[X_i^2]=\sigma_\psi^2\)，所以按定义除以 n = 6（不是 5）。
  6. (b) 写出中断概率：只算路径损耗时的平均接收功率比最低要求高 10 dB，即余量（margin）x = 10 dB。中断 = 阴影把功率压低超过 10 dB（讲义 p.14–15）： \[\begin{aligned}P_{out}&=P\big(P_{r,dB}\lt P_{m,dB}\big)\\&=P\big(\psi_{dB}\lt-10\big)=Q\Big(\frac{10}{\sigma_\psi}\Big)\end{aligned}\] 最后一步：除以 \(\sigma_\psi\) 标准化，再用高斯对称性 P(N < −a) = P(N > a) = Q(a)。余量直接用 dB，不换成线性值。
  7. (b) 代入、查表：MSE 是方差，先开根号再放进 Q：
    σψ = √11.87 = 3.45 dB
    10 / σψ = 10 / 3.45 = 2.90
    Pout = Q(2.90) ≈ 1.85 × 10⁻³（约 0.19%）
    两位小数的 Q 表给 Q(2.90) = 1.87 × 10⁻³；1.85 × 10⁻³ 用的是没取整的 10/3.446 = 2.902，差别只是取整。
  8. 自检：① 残差之和 −1.67 + 5.88 − 2.77 − 3.77 + 3.32 − 0.99 = 0 ✓（最小二乘的性质）；② 直线过平均点：−30.79 − 3.94 × 19.26 = −106.67 = M̄ ✓；③ 量级：余量 10 dB ≈ 2.9σ，比 Q(3.09) = 10⁻³ 对应的 3.09σ 略小，所以中断概率略大于 10⁻³ ✓。
按标准最小二乘：K ≈ −30.8 dB，γ ≈ 3.94，σ²_ψ ≈ 11.9 dB²，P_out ≈ 1.85 × 10⁻³
官方答案：(a) K_dB = −31.4 dB，γ = 3.86；(b) 6.19 × 10⁻⁴
官方答案的 (b) 来自老师课上用的 MSE = 9.656：他算出 10/√9.656 ≈ 3.23，查表 Q(3.23) = 6.19 × 10⁻⁴（第 10 周录音；精确值是 10/3.107 = 3.22，Q ≈ 6.5 × 10⁻⁴）。但 9.656 和官方的 K、γ 对不上：把 K = −31.4、γ = 3.86 代回 6 个点，均方误差是 13.1；标准最小二乘得到的是 11.87。老师在课上也说，结果取决于小数怎么取舍，"在 −31.4、3.86 附近就可以"。考试写清楚方法（最小二乘、σ² = MSE、Pout = Q(10/σ)），用自己算出的数代入即可。
知识讲解 + 详细解析：最小二乘拟合 K、γ，再求阴影中断

知识讲解路径损耗 + 阴影 = 一条直线 + 随机散布

简化路径损耗模型（simplified path loss model，讲义第 2 章 p.8）：\(P_r=P_tK(d_0/d)^{\gamma}\)，d₀ = 1 m。K 是 1 m 处的功率增益（由环境、天线决定的常数），γ 是路径损耗指数（path loss exponent）。老师课上强调：这是专有名词，线性和 dB 两种形式都要背，考试不给。

两边取 10 log₁₀ 变成 dB：\(M=(P_r/P_t)_{dB}=K_{dB}-\gamma\cdot10\log_{10}(d/d_0)\)。令 \(x=10\log_{10}d\)，它就是一条直线 \(M=K_{dB}-\gamma x\)：截距是 KdB，斜率是 −γ。

实测点不会正好落在直线上，偏离的部分就是阴影（shadowing）\(\psi_{dB}\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma_\psi^2)\)（p.11–12）。讲义 p.13 的做法：找让"实测 − 模型"的均方误差（MSE）最小的直线，并且 MSE = E[Xi²] = σψ²。所以一组数据同时给出两样东西：直线（平均趋势）和点的散布（阴影方差）。

中断概率（outage probability，p.14–15）：\(P_{out}=P(\psi_{dB}\lt-x)=Q(x/\sigma_\psi)\)，x = 不含阴影时的平均接收功率 − 最低要求功率，也就是余量（margin）。

符号含义本题
xi10 log₁₀di，直线的横坐标6.99 … 30.00
Mi实测 (Pr/Pt)dB，纵坐标−60 … −150
KdB，γ截距；斜率的相反数待求
σψ²阴影方差 = 拟合的 MSE待求
余量 x平均功率比门限高多少 dB10 dB

详细解析(a) 用两个正规方程求 K 和 γ

  1. 做什么：写出误差平方和 \(F(K,\gamma)=\sum_i(M_i-K+\gamma x_i)^2\)。为什么：最小二乘就是让 F 最小，老师课上就是这样写的。
  2. 对 K 求偏导令其为 0：\(\sum_i(M_i-K+\gamma x_i)=0\) → \(K=\bar M+\gamma\bar x\)。意思是最佳直线一定经过平均点 (x̄, M̄)。
  3. 对 γ 求偏导令其为 0：\(\sum_i x_i(M_i-K+\gamma x_i)=0\)，把上一式代入整理，得 \(\gamma=-S_{xM}/S_{xx}\)。
  4. 怎么算：计算器上先求四个和，再算两个 S（这样比逐点算 x − x̄ 少出错）：
xi = 10 log₁₀di：6.99、13.98、18.13、20.41、26.02、30.00
Σx = 115.53，Σx² = 2566.75，ΣM = −640，ΣxM = −13671.57
Sxx = Σx² − (Σx)²/6 = 2566.75 − 2224.64 = 342.11
SxM = ΣxM − ΣxΣM/6 = −13671.57 + 12323.49 = −1348.08
γ = 1348.08 / 342.11 = 3.94
KdB = M̄ + γx̄ = −106.67 + 3.94 × 19.26 = −30.8 dB

详细解析(b) 残差 → σ → Q 函数

  1. 残差 ei = 实测 − 预测（解答里的表已逐点列出）：−1.67、+5.88、−2.77、−3.77、+3.32、−0.99。它们加起来是 0，这是最小二乘的性质，正好用来检查。
  2. 阴影方差：σψ² = Σe²/6。为什么除以 6 而不是 5：讲义定义 MSE = E[Xi²]，就是简单平均，考试照讲义除以 n。
  3. 余量："只算路径损耗时比最低功率高 10 dB" → x = 10 dB。中断 = 阴影把功率往下拉超过 10 dB：\(P_{out}=P(\psi_{dB}\lt-10)=Q(10/\sigma_\psi)\)。
σψ² = 71.23 / 6 = 11.87 dB²
σψ = √11.87 = 3.45 dB
10 / 3.45 = 2.90
Pout = Q(2.90) ≈ 1.85 × 10⁻³（约 0.19%；查表取 2.90 得 1.87 × 10⁻³，差别只是取整）

自检三个快速检查

  • 直线经过平均点 (19.26, −106.67)；残差之和 = 0。
  • γ = 3.94 落在讲义 p.9 表里城市宏蜂窝的 3.7–6.5 范围内，合理。
  • 余量 10 dB ≈ 2.9σ，中断约千分之二。对比：余量 2.33σ 才对应 1%，量级对得上。

官方答案为什么和标准最小二乘对不上

官方答案是 K = −31.4 dB、γ = 3.86、Pout = 6.19 × 10⁻⁴。把官方的 K、γ 代回 6 个点，MSE = 13.1，比最小二乘的 11.87 还大，所以它不是这组数据的最小二乘解。(b) 用的是老师课上的 MSE = 9.656：10/√9.656 = 3.22，查表取 3.23 得 6.19 × 10⁻⁴。老师说结果"在 −31.4、3.86 附近就可以"。考试照上面的方法写清每一步、用自己算出的数即可。

易错常见丢分点

  • 横坐标用 log₁₀d 而不是 10 log₁₀d：γ 会变成 39.4，明显不合理。
  • 斜率是 −γ：算出斜率 −3.94，所以 γ = +3.94，别写成负的。
  • d 用米代入（d₀ = 1 m）。老师说今年 Quiz 有人把 2 km 写成 log 2。
  • MSE 是方差，进 Q 之前要开根号；写成 Q(10/11.87) 是错的。
  • 余量 10 dB 直接用 dB，不要换成线性：这个中断公式本来就是 dB 形式推出来的（老师课上特别提醒）。

考试英文写法

(a) In dB the model is a straight line, \(M=K_{dB}-\gamma x\), with \(x=10\log_{10}(d/d_0)\) and \(d_0\) = 1 m. Least squares minimises \(F(K,\gamma)=\sum_i(M_i-K_{dB}+\gamma x_i)^2\). Setting \(\partial F/\partial K=0\) and \(\partial F/\partial\gamma=0\) gives \(K_{dB}=\bar M+\gamma\bar x\) and \(\gamma=-S_{xM}/S_{xx}\).

With Σx = 115.53, Σx² = 2566.75, ΣM = −640 and ΣxM = −13671.57: Sxx = 342.11, SxM = −1348.08, so γ = 3.94 and KdB = −106.67 + 3.94 × 19.26 = −30.8 dB.

(b) The shadowing variance equals the MSE of the fit: σψ² = (1/6)Σei² = 71.23/6 = 11.87 dB², σψ = 3.45 dB. Outage occurs when shadowing lowers the power by more than the 10 dB margin: Pout = P(ψdB < −10) = Q(10/σψ) = Q(2.90) ≈ 1.85 × 10⁻³.

一句话：dB 下路径损耗是一条直线，最小二乘给出 K、γ，剩下的均方误差就是阴影方差 σ²；中断概率 = Q(余量 / σ)。
◆ 本题知识点
考什么
用最小二乘从测量数据拟合简化路径损耗模型的 K、γ，再把拟合的均方误差当作阴影方差，求中断概率（第 2 章 p.8、p.12–15）。
前置知识
dB 运算；最小二乘（对 K、γ 求偏导令其为 0，讲解页 2.1 节的推导框）；Q 函数（第 1b 章）。
解题套路
① xi = 10 log₁₀(di/d₀)；② 列 x、M、x²、xM 四列并求和；③ 解两个正规方程得 K、γ；④ 逐点算残差 ei = 实测 − 预测，MSE = σψ²；⑤ Pout = Q(余量/σψ)。
关键公式
γ = −Σ(xi − x̄)(Mi − M̄) / Σ(xi − x̄)²；KdB = M̄ + γx̄；σψ² = (1/n)Σei²；Pout = Q(10/σψ)。
易错
直线斜率是 −γ，别丢负号；x 用 10 log₁₀d，只用 log₁₀d 会让 γ 大 10 倍；MSE 是方差，Q 里要用开根号后的 σ；"高 10 dB"就是余量 10 dB。
自检
残差之和为 0；拟合直线经过平均点 (19.26, −106.67)；上面的步骤 4 有逐点残差，Σe² = 71.23。
举一反三
已知 K、γ、σ，求某距离的中断概率，或给定中断概率求最大覆盖距离（讲义 p.16 例题，讲解页 2.2 节）。官方答案无法复现，原因见上面的补充框。

He said the result depends on how you round, it need not match exactly; anything near K ≈ −31.4, γ ≈ 3.86 is fine.老师课上的做法：写出均方误差 F(K, γ)，分别对 K、γ 求偏导令其为 0，解两个方程。他说结果取决于小数怎么取舍，不一定完全一样，在 K ≈ −31.4、γ ≈ 3.86 附近就可以。

In the exam, use the MSE you computed yourself and show your steps clearly.(b) 他代入的是 MSE = 9.656，算出 10/√9.656 ≈ 3.23，查表 Q(3.23) = 6.19×10⁻⁴，这就是官方答案的来源。我们按题目数据算出的标准最小二乘结果是 11.87（见上面的残差表）。考试按自己算出的 MSE 代入、写清楚步骤即可。
