Part 2 practice
P1 · Q2

Outage probability under log-normal shadowing

Original question · Chinese and EnglishPractice 1

Consider a cellular system where the received signal power has a log-normal distribution with mean \(\mu_\psi\) dBm and standard deviation \(\sigma_\psi\) dBm. In order to avoid outage, the received signal power is required to be above 10 dBm.

考虑一个蜂窝系统，接收信号功率服从对数正态分布，均值为 \(\mu_\psi\) dBm，标准差为 \(\sigma_\psi\) dBm。为避免中断，接收信号功率必须高于 10 dBm。

(a) What is the outage probability when \(\mu_\psi\) = 15 dBm and \(\sigma_\psi\) = 8 dBm?

(a) 当 \(\mu_\psi\) = 15 dBm、\(\sigma_\psi\) = 8 dBm 时，中断概率是多少？

(b) For \(\sigma_\psi\) = 4 dBm, what value of \(\mu_\psi\) is required such that the outage probability is less than 1%?

(b) 若 \(\sigma_\psi\) = 4 dBm，要使中断概率小于 1%，\(\mu_\psi\) 至少要取多少？

Log-normal = Gaussian in dBQ function and its inverseCh. 2 of the notes p.11–15
What the question is asking: what does this question actually want?

ScenarioWhat the question is about

The power received by the phone fluctuates randomly because of shadowing. The question says it is log-normal, which means: expressed in dBm, the power is Gaussian.手机收到的功率因为阴影而随机起伏。题目说它服从对数正态分布（log-normal），意思是：用 dBm 表示时，功率服从高斯分布。

For the phone to work, the received power must be above 10 dBm; below that it is in outage.手机要正常工作，接收功率必须高于 10 dBm，低于就算中断。

SymbolsWhat each quantity in the question means

\(\mu_\psi\)Mean received power (dBm), set by the path loss接收功率的平均值（dBm），由路径损耗决定
\(\sigma_\psi\)Standard deviation of the shadowing, i.e. how large the fluctuations are (the question writes dBm, but the actual unit is dB)阴影的标准差，表示起伏有多大（题目写 dBm，实际单位是 dB）
10 dBmThreshold: below it you are in outage门限：低于它就中断

What each part asksWhat each part is asking for

  • (a) Forward calculation: with mean 15 dBm and σ = 8 dB, what is the probability that the power drops below 10 dBm?(a) 正着算：平均 15 dBm、σ = 8 dB 时，功率掉到 10 dBm 以下的概率是多少。
  • (b) Inverse calculation: with σ = 4 dB, how large must the mean power be for the outage probability to be below 1%? In other words, "how much margin do you need".(b) 反着算：σ = 4 dB 时，平均功率至少要多大，才能让中断概率小于 1%。也就是"需要留多少余量"。

Watch outEasy ways to misread the question

  • Log-normal is Gaussian in dB, so work directly in dB; no need to convert back to linear.对数正态在 dB 上就是高斯，直接在 dB 上算，不用换回线性值。
  • (b) is an inverse Q lookup: Q(x) = 0.01 → x = 2.326, then solve for the mean.(b) 是 Q 函数反查：Q(x) = 0.01 → x = 2.326，再解出平均值。

PurposeWhat the question wants you to understand

Margin vs outage probability: the more standard deviations the threshold is from the mean, the less outage; for 1% outage, the margin is about 2.33σ.余量和中断概率的关系：门限离平均值越多个标准差，中断越少；要中断 1%，余量约为 2.33σ。

In one line: the power in dB is Gaussian; (a) find the probability of being below 10 dBm, (b) in reverse, find how high the mean must be for this probability to be < 1%.一句话：功率在 dB 上服从高斯，(a) 求低于 10 dBm 的概率，(b) 反过来求平均值要多高才能让这个概率 < 1%。

Approach: The received power in dBm is Gaussian. Probability of falling below the threshold: subtract the mean, divide by the standard deviation, look up the Q table.

  1. Model (standardise): log-normal means the value in dBm is Gaussian, \(P_r\sim\mathcal N(\mu_\psi,\sigma_\psi^2)\). Shadowing is a product of many obstruction losses; the logarithm turns the product into a sum, so it is Gaussian in dB (Ch 2 p.11). Outage means below 10 dBm; subtract the mean and divide by the standard deviation (Ch 2 p.14–15): \[\begin{aligned}P_{out}&=P(P_r\lt10)=P\Big(N\lt\frac{10-\mu_\psi}{\sigma_\psi}\Big)\\&=Q\Big(\frac{\mu_\psi-10}{\sigma_\psi}\Big)\end{aligned}\] N ~ N(0, 1); the last step uses the symmetry P(N < −a) = Q(a). The numerator μψ − 10 is the margin; the difference of two dBm values is in dB.
  2. (a) Substitute: μψ = 15 dBm, σψ = 8 dB: \[P_{out}=Q\Big(\frac{15-10}{8}\Big)=Q\Big(\frac{5}{8}\Big)=Q(0.625)\] The threshold is 5 dB below the mean, i.e. 0.625 standard deviations.
  3. (a) Look up the Q table: the table has two decimals, so take the value halfway between Q(0.62) = 0.2676 and Q(0.63) = 0.2643:
    Q(0.625) ≈ (0.2676 + 0.2643) / 2 = 0.266 ≈ 26.6%
    Sanity check: with zero margin Q(0) = 0.5, with a 1σ margin Q(1) = 0.159; 0.625σ lies in between ✓.
  4. (b) Set up the inequality and invert Q: σψ = 4 dB and μψ is the unknown: \[Q\Big(\frac{\mu_\psi-10}{4}\Big)\lt0.01\] From the table, Q(2.32) = 0.0102 and Q(2.33) = 0.0099, so \(Q^{-1}(0.01)=2.326\). Q is decreasing, so "Q value < 0.01" becomes "argument > 2.326": \[\frac{\mu_\psi-10}{4}\gt2.326\]
  5. (b) Solve for μ: multiply both sides by 4, then add 10: \[\begin{aligned}\mu_\psi&\gt10+4\times2.326\\&=10+9.30=19.3\ \text{dBm}\end{aligned}\] The required margin is 9.3 dB = 2.326σ. The official 19.32 uses Q⁻¹(0.01) ≈ 2.33: 10 + 4 × 2.33 = 19.32, so the two agree.
  6. Check: substitute μψ = 19.3 dBm back: (19.3 − 10)/4 = 2.325, Q(2.325) ≈ 0.0100, exactly on the 1% boundary ✓. Compare with (a): a margin of only 0.625σ gives 26.6% outage; to bring it down to 1% the margin must grow to 2.326σ (here 9.3 dB).
(a) ≈ 26%; (b) μψ > 19.3 dBm
Official answer: (a) 26%; (b) μψ > 19.32 dB ✓
Concept + walkthrough: log-normal shadowing outage, forwards and backwards知识讲解 + 详细解析：对数正态阴影的中断正算与反算

ConceptWhy shadowing is Gaussian in dB

Shadowing means the signal is attenuated once by each of many obstacles on the way (buildings, trees, walls): the total attenuation ψ = A₁A₂…AM is a product of many factors (lecture Ch 2 p.11). Taking the log turns the product into a sum: log ψ = Σ log Ai. A sum of many random terms tends to a Gaussian (central limit theorem), so ψdB is Gaussian, and ψ itself (the linear value) is called log-normal.阴影（shadowing）是信号沿途被很多障碍物（楼、树、墙）各衰减一次：总衰减 ψ = A₁A₂…AM，是很多因子的乘积（讲义第 2 章 p.11）。取对数后乘积变成和：log ψ = Σ log Ai。很多随机量相加，按中心极限定理趋向高斯，所以 ψdB 服从高斯，ψ 本身（线性值）就叫对数正态（log-normal）。

Conclusion: as long as you work in dB (dBm), the received power is an ordinary Gaussian, \(P_r\sim\mathcal N(\mu_\psi,\sigma_\psi^2)\). μψ is the mean received power without shadowing (shadowing has zero mean, as the lecturer stressed), and σψ is the standard deviation of the shadowing, whose unit is really dB.结论：只要在 dB（dBm）上算，接收功率就是普通的高斯 \(P_r\sim\mathcal N(\mu_\psi,\sigma_\psi^2)\)。μψ 是不含阴影时的平均接收功率（阴影零均值，老师课上强调），σψ 是阴影的标准差，单位其实是 dB。

ConceptThe Q function and the lecturer's "rearrange" trick

The Q function (Ch 1b): \(Q(x)=P(N\gt x)\) with N ~ N(0, 1), i.e. the area of the right tail of the standard Gaussian. Q is decreasing: Q(0) = 0.5 and it gets smaller as x grows; by symmetry Q(−x) = 1 − Q(x).Q 函数（第 1b 章）：\(Q(x)=P(N\gt x)\)，N ~ N(0, 1)，就是标准高斯右尾的面积。Q 是减函数：Q(0) = 0.5，x 越大越小；对称性 Q(−x) = 1 − Q(x)。

The trick the lecturer wants you to master (p.14–15): rewrite "Pr < Pmin" as "random variable < −x", keeping the random variable on the left and moving everything else to the right, then use symmetry to write it as Q(x/σ).老师要求掌握的技巧（p.14–15）：把"Pr < Pmin"整理成"随机量 < −x"，随机量留在左边，其余移到右边，再用对称性写成 Q(x/σ)。

xQ(x)Use
00.5zero margin: outage half the time余量 0：一半时间中断
10.1587margin of 1σ
1.6450.055% outage
2.3260.011% outage (part (b))中断 1%（本题 (b)）
3.0910⁻³outage of one in a thousand中断千分之一

Step by step(a) Forwards: given μ and σ, find the outage

  1. List the data: μψ = 15 dBm, σψ = 8 dB, threshold Pmin = 10 dBm.写已知：μψ = 15 dBm，σψ = 8 dB，门限 Pmin = 10 dBm。
  2. Rearrange: Pr = 15 + ψ, so \(P(P_r\lt10)=P(\psi\lt-5)\). The threshold is 5 dB below the mean.移项：Pr = 15 + ψ，所以 \(P(P_r\lt10)=P(\psi\lt-5)\)。门限比均值低 5 dB。
  3. Standardise: divide by σ = 8, \(P(\psi/8\lt-0.625)=P(N\gt0.625)=Q(0.625)\).标准化：除以 σ = 8，\(P(\psi/8\lt-0.625)=P(N\gt0.625)=Q(0.625)\)。
  4. Table: the table has two decimals, Q(0.62) = 0.2676 and Q(0.63) = 0.2643; halfway gives Q(0.625) ≈ 0.266.查表：表里只有两位小数，Q(0.62) = 0.2676，Q(0.63) = 0.2643，取中间得 Q(0.625) ≈ 0.266。
(15 − 10) / 8 = 0.625
Pout = Q(0.625) ≈ 0.266 ≈ 26.6%

Sanity check: the margin is less than one σ, so the outage is about a quarter; with zero margin it would be Q(0) = 50%.合理性：余量还不到一个 σ，所以中断约四分之一；余量为 0 时是 Q(0) = 50%。

Step by step(b) Backwards: given the outage target, find μ

  1. Write the inequality: treat μ as unknown, \(Q\big((\mu_\psi-10)/4\big)\lt0.01\).列不等式：把 μ 当未知数，\(Q\big((\mu_\psi-10)/4\big)\lt0.01\)。
  2. Invert with the Q table: Q(2.32) = 0.0102 and Q(2.33) = 0.0099, so Q(2.326) = 0.01.反查 Q 表：Q(2.32) = 0.0102，Q(2.33) = 0.0099，所以 Q(2.326) = 0.01。
  3. Flip the inequality: Q is decreasing, so "Q value < 0.01" means "argument > 2.326": \((\mu_\psi-10)/4\gt2.326\).翻转不等号：Q 是减函数，"Q 值 < 0.01"等价于"参数 > 2.326"：\((\mu_\psi-10)/4\gt2.326\)。
  4. Solve for μ: the required margin is 2.326 × 4 = 9.31 dB.解出 μ：需要的余量 = 2.326 × 4 = 9.31 dB。
μψ > 10 + 4 × 2.326 = 19.3 dBm
Check: with μ = 19.3 dBm, (19.3 − 10)/4 = 2.326 and Q = 0.01 ✓

Variation: with σ = 8 dB, μ must exceed 10 + 8 × 2.326 = 28.6 dBm, 9.3 dB more than with σ = 4 dB. The stronger the shadowing, the larger the margin needed for the same outage target.举一反三：σ = 8 dB 时 μ 要 > 10 + 8 × 2.326 = 28.6 dBm，比 σ = 4 dB 多 9.3 dB。阴影越大，同样的中断要求要留的余量越多。

PitfallsWhere marks are usually lost

  • The question writes σ in dBm, but its unit is really dB: the difference of two dBm values is in dB.题目把 σ 写成 dBm，实际单位是 dB：两个 dBm 相减得到的是 dB。
  • Do not convert dBm to mW before computing: log-normal is Gaussian only in dB.不要把 dBm 换成 mW 再算：对数正态只在 dB 上才是高斯。
  • Direction of the inequality in (b): Q is decreasing, so "probability < 1%" becomes "argument > 2.326".(b) 的不等号方向：Q 是减函数，"概率 < 1%"要翻成"参数 > 2.326"。
  • The threshold is below the mean, so the argument of Q is positive and the result must be below 0.5; getting 0.734 (= 1 − 0.266) means a sign is wrong.门限在均值以下，Q 的参数是正的，结果一定小于 0.5；算出 0.734（= 1 − 0.266）说明符号弄反了。

ExamHow to write it in English

Log-normal shadowing means the received power in dBm is Gaussian, \(P_r\sim\mathcal N(\mu_\psi,\sigma_\psi^2)\). Outage: \(P_{out}=P(P_r\lt10\text{ dBm})=Q\big((\mu_\psi-10)/\sigma_\psi\big)\).

(a) Pout = Q((15 − 10)/8) = Q(0.625) ≈ 0.266, i.e. about 26.6%.

(b) Require Q((μψ − 10)/4) < 0.01. Q is decreasing and Q(2.326) = 0.01, so (μψ − 10)/4 > 2.326, i.e. μψ > 10 + 4 × 2.326 = 19.3 dBm.

In one line: shadowing is Gaussian in dB and the outage probability is Q(margin / σ); (a) a forward table lookup gives 26.6%, (b) Q⁻¹(0.01) = 2.326 gives a 9.3 dB margin, so μ > 19.3 dBm.一句话：阴影在 dB 上是高斯，中断概率 = Q(余量 / σ)；(a) 正着查表得 26.6%，(b) 用 Q⁻¹(0.01) = 2.326 反推余量 9.3 dB，μ > 19.3 dBm。
◆ Key points
What it tests
Log-normal shadowing means the dB value is Gaussian; outage probability computed forwards and backwards (Ch 2 p.11–15).
Background
Standardisation: (threshold − mean)/standard deviation; Q is decreasing and Q(−x) = 1 − Q(x); common values Q(1.645) = 0.05, Q(2.326) = 0.01, Q(3.09) = 10⁻³.
Method
(a) How many standard deviations is the threshold from the mean → Q. (b) Treat μ as unknown, write Q((μ − 10)/σ) < 0.01 and invert: (μ − 10)/σ > 2.326.
Key formula
Pout = P(Pr < Pmin) = Q((μψ − Pmin)/σψ). The difference μ − Pmin is the shadowing margin.
Common mistakes
Q is decreasing, so "probability < 1%" becomes "argument > 2.326". Do not confuse σ with σ². The difference of two dBm values is in dB.
Variations
A larger σ needs a larger margin for the same outage: with σ = 8 dB, μ must exceed 10 + 8 × 2.326 = 28.6 dBm, 9.3 dB more than with σ = 4 dB.
Physical meaning
Shadowing is large-scale, slowly varying fading (blocking by buildings and terrain), so it is handled with a margin; small-scale multipath fading is handled with diversity (Ch 4).

思路：dBm 值服从高斯分布。"低于门限"的概率 = 先减均值、再除标准差，查 Q 表。

  1. 建模（标准化）：对数正态（log-normal）的意思是 dBm 值服从高斯：\(P_r\sim\mathcal N(\mu_\psi,\sigma_\psi^2)\)。阴影是很多障碍物衰减的乘积，取对数后变成和，所以在 dB 上是高斯（讲义第 2 章 p.11）。中断 = 低于 10 dBm；减均值、除标准差（讲义 p.14–15）： \[\begin{aligned}P_{out}&=P(P_r\lt10)=P\Big(N\lt\frac{10-\mu_\psi}{\sigma_\psi}\Big)\\&=Q\Big(\frac{\mu_\psi-10}{\sigma_\psi}\Big)\end{aligned}\] N ~ N(0, 1)；最后一步用对称性 P(N < −a) = Q(a)。分子 μψ − 10 就是余量（margin），两个 dBm 相减，单位是 dB。
  2. (a) 代入：μψ = 15 dBm，σψ = 8 dB： \[P_{out}=Q\Big(\frac{15-10}{8}\Big)=Q\Big(\frac{5}{8}\Big)=Q(0.625)\] 门限比均值低 5 dB，即 0.625 个标准差。
  3. (a) 查 Q 表：表只有两位小数，取 Q(0.62) = 0.2676 和 Q(0.63) = 0.2643 的中间值：
    Q(0.625) ≈ (0.2676 + 0.2643) / 2 = 0.266 ≈ 26.6%
    合理性：余量 0 时 Q(0) = 0.5，余量 1σ 时 Q(1) = 0.159；0.625σ 落在两者之间 ✓。
  4. (b) 列不等式、反查 Q 表：σψ = 4 dB，μψ 当未知数： \[Q\Big(\frac{\mu_\psi-10}{4}\Big)\lt0.01\] 反查表：Q(2.32) = 0.0102，Q(2.33) = 0.0099，所以 \(Q^{-1}(0.01)=2.326\)。Q 是减函数，"Q 值 < 0.01"要翻成"参数 > 2.326"： \[\frac{\mu_\psi-10}{4}\gt2.326\]
  5. (b) 解出 μ：两边乘 4、再加 10： \[\begin{aligned}\mu_\psi&\gt10+4\times2.326\\&=10+9.30=19.3\ \text{dBm}\end{aligned}\] 所需余量 9.3 dB = 2.326σ。官方答案 19.32 是用 Q⁻¹(0.01) ≈ 2.33 算的：10 + 4 × 2.33 = 19.32，两者一致。
  6. 自检：把 μψ = 19.3 dBm 代回：(19.3 − 10)/4 = 2.325，Q(2.325) ≈ 0.0100，正好在 1% 的边界上 ✓。对比 (a)：余量只有 0.625σ 时中断 26.6%；要降到 1%，余量要加到 2.326σ（这里 = 9.3 dB）。
(a) ≈ 26%；(b) μ_ψ > 19.3 dBm
官方答案：(a) 26%；(b) μ_ψ > 19.32 dB ✓
知识讲解 + 详细解析：对数正态阴影的中断正算与反算

知识讲解为什么阴影在 dB 上是高斯

阴影（shadowing）是信号沿途被很多障碍物（楼、树、墙）各衰减一次：总衰减 ψ = A₁A₂…AM，是很多因子的乘积（讲义第 2 章 p.11）。取对数后乘积变成和：log ψ = Σ log Ai。很多随机量相加，按中心极限定理趋向高斯，所以 ψdB 服从高斯，ψ 本身（线性值）就叫对数正态（log-normal）。

结论：只要在 dB（dBm）上算，接收功率就是普通的高斯 \(P_r\sim\mathcal N(\mu_\psi,\sigma_\psi^2)\)。μψ 是不含阴影时的平均接收功率（阴影零均值，老师课上强调），σψ 是阴影的标准差，单位其实是 dB。

知识讲解Q 函数与老师要求的"移项"技巧

Q 函数（第 1b 章）：\(Q(x)=P(N\gt x)\)，N ~ N(0, 1)，就是标准高斯右尾的面积。Q 是减函数：Q(0) = 0.5，x 越大越小；对称性 Q(−x) = 1 − Q(x)。

老师要求掌握的技巧（p.14–15）：把"Pr < Pmin"整理成"随机量 < −x"，随机量留在左边，其余移到右边，再用对称性写成 Q(x/σ)。

xQ(x)用途
00.5余量 0：一半时间中断
10.1587余量 1σ
1.6450.05中断 5%
2.3260.01中断 1%（本题 (b)）
3.0910⁻³中断千分之一

详细解析(a) 正算：已知 μ、σ 求中断

  1. 写已知：μψ = 15 dBm，σψ = 8 dB，门限 Pmin = 10 dBm。
  2. 移项：Pr = 15 + ψ，所以 \(P(P_r\lt10)=P(\psi\lt-5)\)。门限比均值低 5 dB。
  3. 标准化：除以 σ = 8，\(P(\psi/8\lt-0.625)=P(N\gt0.625)=Q(0.625)\)。
  4. 查表：表里只有两位小数，Q(0.62) = 0.2676，Q(0.63) = 0.2643，取中间得 Q(0.625) ≈ 0.266。
(15 − 10) / 8 = 0.625
Pout = Q(0.625) ≈ 0.266 ≈ 26.6%

合理性：余量还不到一个 σ，所以中断约四分之一；余量为 0 时是 Q(0) = 50%。

详细解析(b) 反算：已知中断要求求 μ

  1. 列不等式：把 μ 当未知数，\(Q\big((\mu_\psi-10)/4\big)\lt0.01\)。
  2. 反查 Q 表：Q(2.32) = 0.0102，Q(2.33) = 0.0099，所以 Q(2.326) = 0.01。
  3. 翻转不等号：Q 是减函数，"Q 值 < 0.01"等价于"参数 > 2.326"：\((\mu_\psi-10)/4\gt2.326\)。
  4. 解出 μ：需要的余量 = 2.326 × 4 = 9.31 dB。
μψ > 10 + 4 × 2.326 = 19.3 dBm
代回检查：μ = 19.3 dBm 时 (19.3 − 10)/4 = 2.326，Q = 0.01 ✓

举一反三：σ = 8 dB 时 μ 要 > 10 + 8 × 2.326 = 28.6 dBm，比 σ = 4 dB 多 9.3 dB。阴影越大，同样的中断要求要留的余量越多。

易错常见丢分点

  • 题目把 σ 写成 dBm，实际单位是 dB：两个 dBm 相减得到的是 dB。
  • 不要把 dBm 换成 mW 再算：对数正态只在 dB 上才是高斯。
  • (b) 的不等号方向：Q 是减函数，"概率 < 1%"要翻成"参数 > 2.326"。
  • 门限在均值以下，Q 的参数是正的，结果一定小于 0.5；算出 0.734（= 1 − 0.266）说明符号弄反了。

考试英文写法

Log-normal shadowing means the received power in dBm is Gaussian, \(P_r\sim\mathcal N(\mu_\psi,\sigma_\psi^2)\). Outage: \(P_{out}=P(P_r\lt10\text{ dBm})=Q\big((\mu_\psi-10)/\sigma_\psi\big)\).

(a) Pout = Q((15 − 10)/8) = Q(0.625) ≈ 0.266, i.e. about 26.6%.

(b) Require Q((μψ − 10)/4) < 0.01. Q is decreasing and Q(2.326) = 0.01, so (μψ − 10)/4 > 2.326, i.e. μψ > 10 + 4 × 2.326 = 19.3 dBm.

一句话：阴影在 dB 上是高斯，中断概率 = Q(余量 / σ)；(a) 正着查表得 26.6%，(b) 用 Q⁻¹(0.01) = 2.326 反推余量 9.3 dB，μ > 19.3 dBm。
◆ 本题知识点
考什么
对数正态阴影 = dB 值服从高斯；中断概率的正算和反算（第 2 章 p.11–15）。
前置知识
标准化：(门限 − 均值)/标准差；Q 函数的单调性（减函数）和对称性 Q(−x) = 1 − Q(x)；常用值 Q(1.645) = 0.05、Q(2.326) = 0.01、Q(3.09) = 10⁻³。
解题套路
(a) 门限离均值几个标准差 → 查 Q；(b) 把 μ 当未知数，列 Q((μ − 10)/σ) < 0.01，反查得 (μ − 10)/σ > 2.326。
关键公式
Pout = P(Pr < Pmin) = Q((μψ − Pmin)/σψ)。μ − Pmin 叫阴影余量。
易错
Q 是减函数，"概率 < 1%"要翻成"参数 > 2.326"；σ 和 σ² 别混；两个 dBm 相减得到的是 dB。
举一反三
σ 越大，同样的中断概率要求的余量越大：σ = 8 dB 时 μ 要 > 10 + 8 × 2.326 = 28.6 dBm，比 σ = 4 dB 时多 9.3 dB。
物理意义
阴影是大尺度、慢变化的衰落（被楼房、地形挡住），所以用余量来对付；多径是小尺度衰落，靠分集来对付（第 4 章）。
▶ Lecturer's emphasis in class · Part 2 Week 10 recording
  • The 15 dBm in the question is the average received power without shadowing (shadowing has zero mean, so the overall mean is just the simplified path-loss result); 10 dBm is the minimum requirement.题目里的 15 dBm 是不含阴影的平均接收功率（阴影零均值，所以整体均值就是简化路径损耗的结果）；10 dBm 是最低要求。
Part 2 practice
P1 · Q3

Delay spread of a uniform power delay profile

Original question · Chinese and EnglishPractice 1

Consider a channel with the following power delay profile.

考虑一个具有如下功率时延谱（power delay profile）的信道。

\(P_r(\tau)=\begin{cases}1 & 0\le\tau\le10\,\mu s\\ 0 & \text{Otherwise}\end{cases}\)

(a) Compute the mean delay spread and rms delay spread of the channel.

(a) 计算该信道的平均时延扩展（mean delay spread）和均方根时延扩展（rms delay spread）。

(b) What should the symbol rate, \(R_s\), be for this channel to exhibit flat fading? Assume \(R_s=1/T_s\), where \(T_s\) is the signal symbol duration.

(b) 要使该信道表现为平坦衰落，符号速率 \(R_s\) 应取多少？设 \(R_s=1/T_s\)，\(T_s\) 为信号的符号周期。

Mean delay / rms delay spreadFlat-fading condition σ/Ts < 0.1Ch. 2 of the notes p.30–33
What the question is asking: what does this question actually want?

ScenarioWhat the question is about

The signal reaches the receiver over several paths with different delays, arriving one after another like echoes.信号经多条路径到达接收机，各条路径的时延不同，像回声一样陆续到达。

The power delay profile \(P_r(\tau)\) describes "how much power the echoes at delay τ carry". Here it is uniform between 0 and 10 µs: every delay has the same power, and there is nothing after 10 µs.功率时延分布 \(P_r(\tau)\)（power delay profile）描述"时延为 τ 的那部分回声有多少功率"。这里是 0 到 10 µs 之间均匀分布：每个时延的功率都一样，10 µs 之后就没有了。

SymbolsWhat each quantity in the question means

τDelay of a path relative to the earliest-arriving one某条路径相对最早到达那条的时延
\(\mu_{T_m}\)Mean delay (mean delay spread): the power-weighted average arrival delay平均时延（mean delay spread）：按功率加权的平均到达时延
\(\sigma_{T_m}\)rms delay spread: the standard deviation of the delay, measuring how "spread out" the echoes arerms 时延扩展：时延的标准差，衡量回声"拖得有多散"
\(T_s,\ R_s=1/T_s\)Symbol duration and symbol rate符号时长和符号速率

What each part asksWhat each part is asking for

  • (a) Treat \(P_r(\tau)\) as a weight (like a probability distribution) and find the mean and standard deviation of the delay.(a) 把 \(P_r(\tau)\) 当作权重（相当于一个概率分布），求时延的均值和标准差。
  • (b) Flat fading requires the symbol to be much longer than the echo spread, so that echoes do not spill into the next symbol. The criterion in the notes is \(\sigma_{T_m}/T_s\lt0.1\); use it to find the maximum symbol rate.(b) 平坦衰落（flat fading）要求符号比回声的散布长得多，回声才不会拖进下一个符号。讲义的判据是 \(\sigma_{T_m}/T_s\lt0.1\)，由此求符号速率最多能多快。

Watch outEasy ways to misread the question

  • The "mean delay spread" in the question is the mean delay.题目说的 "mean delay spread" 就是平均时延。
  • The answer to (b) is an upper bound: R_s is less than some value, not equal to it.(b) 的答案是一个上限：R_s 小于某个值，不是等于。

PurposeWhat the question wants you to understand

Delay spread limits the maximum symbol rate without equalisation: the faster the symbols, the shorter they are, and the more easily echoes cause ISI.时延扩展限制了不加均衡时的最高符号速率：符号越快越短，回声就越容易造成码间干扰（ISI）。

In one line: treat the uniform power delay profile as a probability distribution, find the mean and standard deviation of the delay, then use σ/T_s < 0.1 to find the maximum symbol rate allowed for flat fading.一句话：把均匀的功率时延分布当成概率分布，求时延的均值和标准差，再用 σ/T_s < 0.1 求平坦衰落允许的最高符号速率。
  1. (a) Denominator (total power): \(\mu_{T_m}\) and \(\sigma_{T_m}\) on Ch 2 p.30 are both averages weighted by \(P_r(\tau)\), so first compute the denominator (τ in µs): \[\int_0^{10}P_r(\tau)\,d\tau=\int_0^{10}1\,d\tau=10\] \(P_r(\tau)=1\) is not normalised, so every integral below is divided by 10. This is the same as treating it as a uniform distribution on 0–10 µs.
  2. (a) Mean delay: \[\begin{aligned}\mu_{T_m}&=\frac{\int_0^{10}\tau\,d\tau}{10}=\frac{[\tau^2/2]_0^{10}}{10}\\&=\frac{50}{10}=5\ \mu s\end{aligned}\] A uniform distribution is symmetric, so the mean is in the middle, 10/2 = 5 µs ✓.
  3. (a) Second moment: with the same weight \(P_r(\tau)\), find \(E[\tau^2]\): \[\begin{aligned}E[\tau^2]&=\frac{\int_0^{10}\tau^2d\tau}{10}=\frac{[\tau^3/3]_0^{10}}{10}\\&=\frac{1000/3}{10}=33.33\ \mu s^2\end{aligned}\]
  4. (a) rms delay spread: the slide definition is \(\sigma_{T_m}^2=\frac{\int(\tau-\mu_{T_m})^2P_r\,d\tau}{\int P_r\,d\tau}\); expanding the square gives "second moment − mean²": \[\begin{aligned}\sigma_{T_m}^2&=E[\tau^2]-\mu_{T_m}^2\\&=33.33-5^2=8.33\ \mu s^2\\ \sigma_{T_m}&=\sqrt{8.33}=2.89\ \mu s\end{aligned}\] The rms delay spread is a standard deviation, so take the square root.
  5. (a) Check: integrate directly with the slide definition: \[\begin{aligned}\int_0^{10}(\tau-5)^2d\tau&=\Big[\tfrac{(\tau-5)^3}{3}\Big]_0^{10}\\&=\tfrac{125}{3}+\tfrac{125}{3}=83.33\end{aligned}\] 83.33 / 10 = 8.33 µs² ✓. Shortcut: the standard deviation of a uniform distribution on [0, a] is a/√12 = 10/3.464 = 2.89 µs ✓.
  6. (b) Flat-fading condition: the rule of thumb on Ch 2 p.33 is flat fading when \(\sigma_{T_m}/T_s\lt0.1\), i.e. the delay spread is at most a tenth of the symbol duration, so there is no ISI: \[\begin{aligned}\frac{\sigma_{T_m}}{T_s}\lt0.1\;&\Rightarrow\;T_s\gt10\,\sigma_{T_m}\\&=10\times2.887=28.87\ \mu s\end{aligned}\]
  7. (b) Convert to symbol rate: \(R_s=1/T_s\); longer symbols mean a lower rate, so the inequality flips; 1 µs = 10⁻⁶ s: \[\begin{aligned}R_s&\lt\frac{1}{28.87\times10^{-6}\ \text{s}}\\&=34\,641\ \text{sym/s}\approx34.6\ \text{ksps}\end{aligned}\] Check: at Rs = 34.6 ksps, Ts = 28.9 µs and σ/Ts = 2.89/28.9 = 0.1, exactly on the boundary ✓. The answer is an upper limit, not an equality.
μ = 5 µs, σ = 2.89 µs; Rs < 34.6 ksps
Official answer: 5 µs, 2.89 µs; 34.6 ksps ✓
Concept + walkthrough: delay spread and the flat-fading rate limit知识讲解 + 详细解析：时延扩展与平坦衰落的速率上限

ConceptPower delay profile, mean delay, rms delay spread

In a multipath channel one transmitted pulse arrives over different paths; the first arrival is τ = 0 and the others arrive τ later. The power delay profile Pr(τ) says how much power arrives with delay τ (lecture Ch 2 p.30).多径信道里，同一个发射脉冲经不同路径到达，最早那条记为 τ = 0，其余晚到 τ。功率时延谱（power delay profile）Pr(τ) 就是"晚到 τ 的那部分有多少功率"（讲义第 2 章 p.30）。

Treat Pr(τ) as a weight (divided by the total power it is a probability distribution) and compute two numbers just as for a random variable (formulas on p.30; they are given in the exam and the lecturer said they need not be memorised):把 Pr(τ) 当成权重（除以总功率后就是一个概率分布），就能像求随机变量那样求两个数（p.30 的公式，考试会给，老师说不用背）：

  • Mean delay (mean delay spread) \(\mu_{T_m}=\int\tau P_r(\tau)d\tau\,/\int P_r(\tau)d\tau\): how late the echoes arrive "on average".平均时延（mean delay spread）\(\mu_{T_m}=\int\tau P_r(\tau)d\tau\,/\int P_r(\tau)d\tau\)：回声"平均"晚到多久。
  • rms delay spread \(\sigma_{T_m}=\sqrt{\int(\tau-\mu_{T_m})^2P_r(\tau)d\tau\,/\int P_r(\tau)d\tau}\): how widely the echoes are spread in time, i.e. the standard deviation.rms 时延扩展 \(\sigma_{T_m}=\sqrt{\int(\tau-\mu_{T_m})^2P_r(\tau)d\tau\,/\int P_r(\tau)d\tau}\)：回声在时间上"散得多开"，就是标准差。

Why σTm matters: if the echoes last longer than a symbol they leak into the next symbol and cause inter-symbol interference (ISI); this is frequency-selective fading (p.32). If the echoes are short compared with the symbol, the fading is the same across the whole signal bandwidth: flat fading (p.33). The rule of thumb on the slides (blue box, memorise it):为什么关心 σTm：回声拖得比符号还长，就会漏进下一个符号，造成码间干扰（ISI），这叫频率选择性衰落（p.32）；回声相对符号很短，整个信号带宽内衰落一样，叫平坦衰落（flat fading，p.33）。讲义的经验判据（蓝框，要背）：

ConditionConclusion
σTm/Ts < 0.1flat fading平坦衰落
σTm/Ts ≫ 1frequency-selective fading频率选择性衰落
in between (e.g. 0.15)介于两者之间（如 0.15）the lecturer: no conclusion can be drawn老师说：不能下结论

Step by step(a) μ and σ of a uniform delay profile

  1. Denominator (total power): \(\int_0^{10}1\,d\tau=10\). Why divide: Pr(τ) = 1 is not normalised; without dividing it is not a weighted average.分母（总功率）：\(\int_0^{10}1\,d\tau=10\)。为什么要除：Pr(τ) = 1 没有归一化，不除就不是加权平均。
  2. Mean delay: \(\int_0^{10}\tau\,d\tau=\tau^2/2\,\big|_0^{10}=50\), μ = 50/10 = 5 µs. Intuition: the uniform distribution is symmetric, so the mean is in the middle.平均时延：\(\int_0^{10}\tau\,d\tau=\tau^2/2\,\big|_0^{10}=50\)，μ = 50/10 = 5 µs。直觉：均匀分布左右对称，均值在正中间。
  3. rms delay spread, two ways with the same result:
    by the slide definition: \(\int_0^{10}(\tau-5)^2d\tau=\big[(\tau-5)^3/3\big]_0^{10}=125/3+125/3=83.33\), divided by 10 gives 8.33 µs²;
    or with E[τ²] − μ²: \(\int_0^{10}\tau^2d\tau/10=(1000/3)/10=33.33\), and 33.33 − 25 = 8.33 µs².rms 时延扩展，两种算法结果一样：
    按讲义定义：\(\int_0^{10}(\tau-5)^2d\tau=\big[(\tau-5)^3/3\big]_0^{10}=125/3+125/3=83.33\)，除以 10 得 8.33 µs²；
    或用 E[τ²] − μ²：\(\int_0^{10}\tau^2d\tau/10=(1000/3)/10=33.33\)，33.33 − 25 = 8.33 µs²。
  4. Square root: σ = √8.33 = 2.89 µs. Shortcut: the standard deviation of a uniform distribution on [0, a] is a/√12 = 10/3.46.开根号：σ = √8.33 = 2.89 µs。捷径：[0, a] 上均匀分布的标准差 = a/√12 = 10/3.46。
μTm = 50 / 10 = 5 µs
σTm² = 83.33 / 10 = 8.33 µs²
σTm = 2.89 µs

Step by step(b) Highest symbol rate for flat fading

  1. Apply the rule: σTm/Ts < 0.1 → Ts > 10σTm. The echoes may occupy at most a tenth of a symbol.套判据：σTm/Ts < 0.1 → Ts > 10σTm。意思是回声最多只占一个符号的十分之一。
  2. Compute Ts: Ts > 10 × 2.887 = 28.87 µs.
  3. Convert to a rate: Rs = 1/Ts; a longer symbol means a lower rate, so the inequality flips. 1/µs = 10⁶/s.换成速率：Rs = 1/Ts，符号越长速率越低，所以不等号翻过来。1/µs = 10⁶/s。
Ts > 28.87 µs
Rs < 1 / (28.87 × 10⁻⁶ s) = 34641 sym/s ≈ 34.6 ksps

Sanity check: a 1 MHz signal (Ts = 1 µs) has σ/Ts = 2.89 ≫ 0.1, so it is frequency-selective and needs equalisation (Ch 6) or OFDM (Ch 7); flat fading is only possible at rates of tens of ksps, which fits.合理性：1 MHz 的信号（Ts = 1 µs）σ/Ts = 2.89 ≫ 0.1，是频率选择性，需要均衡（第 6 章）或 OFDM（第 7 章）；所以平坦衰落只能用几十 ksps 量级，对得上。

PitfallsWhere marks are usually lost

  • Assuming Pr(τ) = 1 is already normalised and using 1 as the denominator: μ would become 50 µs.以为 Pr(τ) = 1 已经归一化，分母写 1：μ 会变成 50 µs。
  • The rms delay spread is a standard deviation: take the square root of 8.33.rms 时延扩展是标准差：8.33 要开根号。
  • Direction of the inequality: flat fading needs long symbols and a low rate, so the answer is an upper limit Rs < 34.6 ksps, not an equality.不等号方向：平坦衰落要求符号长、速率低，答案是上限 Rs < 34.6 ksps，不是"等于"。
  • The "mean delay spread" in the question is the mean delay μTm, not σ.题目说的 mean delay spread 就是平均时延 μTm，不是 σ。

ExamHow to write it in English

(a) Use Pr(τ) as the weight: \(\mu_{T_m}=\dfrac{\int_0^{10}\tau P_r(\tau)d\tau}{\int_0^{10}P_r(\tau)d\tau}=\dfrac{50}{10}=5\) µs, and \(\sigma_{T_m}^2=\dfrac{\int_0^{10}(\tau-\mu_{T_m})^2P_r(\tau)d\tau}{\int_0^{10}P_r(\tau)d\tau}=\dfrac{83.33}{10}=8.33\) µs², so σTm = 2.89 µs.

(b) Flat fading requires σTm/Ts < 0.1, i.e. Ts > 10σTm = 28.87 µs, so Rs = 1/Ts < 34.6 ksps.

In one line: treat the power delay profile as a probability distribution, mean 5 µs and standard deviation 2.89 µs; flat fading needs Ts > 10σ = 28.87 µs, so Rs < 34.6 ksps.一句话：把功率时延谱当成概率分布，均值 5 µs、标准差 2.89 µs；平坦衰落要求 Ts > 10σ = 28.87 µs，所以 Rs < 34.6 ksps。
◆ Key points
What it tests
Mean delay and rms delay spread from a power delay profile, and the flat / frequency-selective decision (Ch 2 p.29–33).
Background
Normalise P(τ) and treat it as a probability density; E[τ], E[τ²] and variance = E[τ²] − (E[τ])² (Ch 1b).
Method
① μ = ∫τP(τ)dτ / ∫P(τ)dτ; ② E[τ²] = ∫τ²P(τ)dτ / ∫P(τ)dτ; ③ σ = √(E[τ²] − μ²); ④ flat if σ/Ts < 0.1 → lower bound on Ts → upper bound on Rs.
Key formula
Uniform on [0, a]: μ = a/2, σ = a/√12. Here a = 10 µs → 5 µs and 2.89 µs.
Common mistakes
The denominator is ∫P = 10, not 1. Flat fading needs long symbols (low rate), so keep the inequality the right way round; 34.6 ksps is an upper limit.
Variations
"Is a 1 MHz signal (Ts = 1 µs) flat?" σ/Ts = 2.89 > 0.1 → frequency-selective, needs equalisation or OFDM. For a discrete profile (a few echoes) replace the integrals by weighted sums (Section 2.4 example on the learning page).
Link
Larger delay spread means smaller coherence bandwidth (BC ∝ 1/σTm); the same σ appears in the Ch 3 error floor (σTm/Tb)².
  1. (a) 分母（总功率）：讲义第 2 章 p.30 的 \(\mu_{T_m}\)、\(\sigma_{T_m}\) 都是以 \(P_r(\tau)\) 为权重的加权平均，先算分母（τ 以 µs 为单位）： \[\int_0^{10}P_r(\tau)\,d\tau=\int_0^{10}1\,d\tau=10\] \(P_r(\tau)=1\) 没有归一化，所以下面每个积分都要除以 10，相当于把它当成 0–10 µs 上的均匀分布（uniform distribution）。
  2. (a) 平均时延： \[\begin{aligned}\mu_{T_m}&=\frac{\int_0^{10}\tau\,d\tau}{10}=\frac{[\tau^2/2]_0^{10}}{10}\\&=\frac{50}{10}=5\ \mu s\end{aligned}\] 均匀分布左右对称，均值就在正中间 10/2 = 5 µs ✓。
  3. (a) 二阶矩：同样以 \(P_r(\tau)\) 为权重求 \(E[\tau^2]\)： \[\begin{aligned}E[\tau^2]&=\frac{\int_0^{10}\tau^2d\tau}{10}=\frac{[\tau^3/3]_0^{10}}{10}\\&=\frac{1000/3}{10}=33.33\ \mu s^2\end{aligned}\]
  4. (a) rms 时延扩展：讲义定义 \(\sigma_{T_m}^2=\frac{\int(\tau-\mu_{T_m})^2P_r\,d\tau}{\int P_r\,d\tau}\)，把平方展开就等于"二阶矩 − 均值²"： \[\begin{aligned}\sigma_{T_m}^2&=E[\tau^2]-\mu_{T_m}^2\\&=33.33-5^2=8.33\ \mu s^2\\ \sigma_{T_m}&=\sqrt{8.33}=2.89\ \mu s\end{aligned}\] rms 时延扩展（rms delay spread）是标准差，所以要开根号。
  5. (a) 自检：按讲义定义直接积分： \[\begin{aligned}\int_0^{10}(\tau-5)^2d\tau&=\Big[\tfrac{(\tau-5)^3}{3}\Big]_0^{10}\\&=\tfrac{125}{3}+\tfrac{125}{3}=83.33\end{aligned}\] 83.33 / 10 = 8.33 µs² ✓。捷径：[0, a] 上均匀分布的标准差 = a/√12 = 10/3.464 = 2.89 µs ✓。
  6. (b) 平坦衰落条件：讲义 p.33 的经验判据：\(\sigma_{T_m}/T_s\lt0.1\) 为平坦衰落（flat fading），即时延扩展不超过符号长度的十分之一，不会造成码间干扰： \[\begin{aligned}\frac{\sigma_{T_m}}{T_s}\lt0.1\;&\Rightarrow\;T_s\gt10\,\sigma_{T_m}\\&=10\times2.887=28.87\ \mu s\end{aligned}\]
  7. (b) 换成符号速率：\(R_s=1/T_s\)，符号越长速率越低，所以不等号翻过来；1 µs = 10⁻⁶ s： \[\begin{aligned}R_s&\lt\frac{1}{28.87\times10^{-6}\ \text{s}}\\&=34\,641\ \text{sym/s}\approx34.6\ \text{ksps}\end{aligned}\] 自检：Rs = 34.6 ksps 时 Ts = 28.9 µs，σ/Ts = 2.89/28.9 = 0.1，正好在边界上 ✓。答案是上限，不是"等于"。
μ = 5 µs，σ = 2.89 µs；R_s < 34.6 ksps
官方答案：5 µs，2.89 µs；34.6 ksps ✓
知识讲解 + 详细解析：时延扩展与平坦衰落的速率上限

知识讲解功率时延谱、平均时延、rms 时延扩展

多径信道里，同一个发射脉冲经不同路径到达，最早那条记为 τ = 0，其余晚到 τ。功率时延谱（power delay profile）Pr(τ) 就是"晚到 τ 的那部分有多少功率"（讲义第 2 章 p.30）。

把 Pr(τ) 当成权重（除以总功率后就是一个概率分布），就能像求随机变量那样求两个数（p.30 的公式，考试会给，老师说不用背）：

  • 平均时延（mean delay spread）\(\mu_{T_m}=\int\tau P_r(\tau)d\tau\,/\int P_r(\tau)d\tau\)：回声"平均"晚到多久。
  • rms 时延扩展 \(\sigma_{T_m}=\sqrt{\int(\tau-\mu_{T_m})^2P_r(\tau)d\tau\,/\int P_r(\tau)d\tau}\)：回声在时间上"散得多开"，就是标准差。

为什么关心 σTm：回声拖得比符号还长，就会漏进下一个符号，造成码间干扰（ISI），这叫频率选择性衰落（p.32）；回声相对符号很短，整个信号带宽内衰落一样，叫平坦衰落（flat fading，p.33）。讲义的经验判据（蓝框，要背）：

条件结论
σTm/Ts < 0.1平坦衰落
σTm/Ts ≫ 1频率选择性衰落
介于两者之间（如 0.15）老师说：不能下结论

详细解析(a) 均匀时延谱的 μ 和 σ

  1. 分母（总功率）：\(\int_0^{10}1\,d\tau=10\)。为什么要除：Pr(τ) = 1 没有归一化，不除就不是加权平均。
  2. 平均时延：\(\int_0^{10}\tau\,d\tau=\tau^2/2\,\big|_0^{10}=50\)，μ = 50/10 = 5 µs。直觉：均匀分布左右对称，均值在正中间。
  3. rms 时延扩展，两种算法结果一样：
    按讲义定义：\(\int_0^{10}(\tau-5)^2d\tau=\big[(\tau-5)^3/3\big]_0^{10}=125/3+125/3=83.33\)，除以 10 得 8.33 µs²；
    或用 E[τ²] − μ²：\(\int_0^{10}\tau^2d\tau/10=(1000/3)/10=33.33\)，33.33 − 25 = 8.33 µs²。
  4. 开根号：σ = √8.33 = 2.89 µs。捷径：[0, a] 上均匀分布的标准差 = a/√12 = 10/3.46。
μTm = 50 / 10 = 5 µs
σTm² = 83.33 / 10 = 8.33 µs²
σTm = 2.89 µs

详细解析(b) 平坦衰落允许的最高符号速率

  1. 套判据：σTm/Ts < 0.1 → Ts > 10σTm。意思是回声最多只占一个符号的十分之一。
  2. 算 Ts：Ts > 10 × 2.887 = 28.87 µs。
  3. 换成速率：Rs = 1/Ts，符号越长速率越低，所以不等号翻过来。1/µs = 10⁶/s。
Ts > 28.87 µs
Rs < 1 / (28.87 × 10⁻⁶ s) = 34641 sym/s ≈ 34.6 ksps

合理性：1 MHz 的信号（Ts = 1 µs）σ/Ts = 2.89 ≫ 0.1，是频率选择性，需要均衡（第 6 章）或 OFDM（第 7 章）；所以平坦衰落只能用几十 ksps 量级，对得上。

易错常见丢分点

  • 以为 Pr(τ) = 1 已经归一化，分母写 1：μ 会变成 50 µs。
  • rms 时延扩展是标准差：8.33 要开根号。
  • 不等号方向：平坦衰落要求符号长、速率低，答案是上限 Rs < 34.6 ksps，不是"等于"。
  • 题目说的 mean delay spread 就是平均时延 μTm，不是 σ。

考试英文写法

(a) Use Pr(τ) as the weight: \(\mu_{T_m}=\dfrac{\int_0^{10}\tau P_r(\tau)d\tau}{\int_0^{10}P_r(\tau)d\tau}=\dfrac{50}{10}=5\) µs, and \(\sigma_{T_m}^2=\dfrac{\int_0^{10}(\tau-\mu_{T_m})^2P_r(\tau)d\tau}{\int_0^{10}P_r(\tau)d\tau}=\dfrac{83.33}{10}=8.33\) µs², so σTm = 2.89 µs.

(b) Flat fading requires σTm/Ts < 0.1, i.e. Ts > 10σTm = 28.87 µs, so Rs = 1/Ts < 34.6 ksps.

一句话：把功率时延谱当成概率分布，均值 5 µs、标准差 2.89 µs；平坦衰落要求 Ts > 10σ = 28.87 µs，所以 Rs < 34.6 ksps。
◆ 本题知识点
考什么
由功率时延谱求平均时延和 rms 时延扩展，再判断平坦 / 频率选择性衰落（第 2 章 p.29–33）。
前置知识
把 P(τ) 归一化后当概率密度；E[τ]、E[τ²]、方差 = E[τ²] − (E[τ])²（第 1b 章）。
解题套路
① μ = ∫τP(τ)dτ / ∫P(τ)dτ；② E[τ²] = ∫τ²P(τ)dτ / ∫P(τ)dτ；③ σ = √(E[τ²] − μ²)；④ 平坦条件 σ/Ts < 0.1 → 求 Ts 下限 → Rs 上限。
关键公式
[0, a] 上均匀分布：μ = a/2，σ = a/√12。本题 a = 10 µs → 5 µs、2.89 µs。
易错
分母是 ∫P = 10，不是 1；平坦衰落要求符号长、速率低，不等号别反；34.6 ksps 是上限。
举一反三
问"信号带宽 1 MHz（Ts = 1 µs）是否平坦"：σ/Ts = 2.89 > 0.1 → 频率选择性衰落，需要均衡或 OFDM。离散时延谱（几条回波）用加权求和代替积分，见讲解页 2.4 节例题。
联系
时延扩展越大，相干带宽越小（BC ∝ 1/σTm）；第 3 章的时延扩展误码平台 (σTm/Tb)² 用的也是这个 σ。
▶ Lecturer's emphasis in class · Part 2 Week 10 recording
  • The formulas for mean delay and rms delay spread are given in the exam, no need to memorise them; but memorise the flat-fading test σ/Ts < 0.1.平均时延和 rms 时延扩展的公式考试会给，不用背；但判断平坦衰落的 σ/Ts < 0.1 要背。
Part 2 practice
P2 · Q1

Average fade duration

Original question · bilingualPractice 2

For Rayleigh fading channels, the average fade duration can be expressed as,

对于瑞利衰落信道，平均衰落持续时间（AFD）可以表示为：

\(AFD=\dfrac{e^{\rho^2}-1}{\sqrt{2\pi}f_D\rho}\)

The maximum Doppler shift is 50 Hz. The minimum signal strength, for acceptable performance is 0.1 of the rms value of the signal strength. Determine the average time duration when the signal strength is below the acceptable value.

最大多普勒频移为 50 Hz。保证可接受性能所需的最小信号强度是信号强度 rms 值的 0.1 倍。求信号强度低于这个可接受值的平均持续时间。

AFDρ = Z_min / Z_rmsCh. 2 of the notes p.42–43
What the question is asking: what does this question actually want?

ScenarioWhat the question is about

As the phone moves, the multipath signals sometimes add in phase and sometimes cancel, so the received amplitude fluctuates quickly. This is Rayleigh fading.手机在移动时，多径信号时而同相相加、时而反相抵消，接收信号的幅度快速起伏，这就是瑞利衰落（Rayleigh fading）。

Now and then the signal falls into a deep "hole" (deep fade), and while it is in the hole the link quality is poor. The question asks: each time the signal falls into a hole, how long on average does it take to climb out? This is the average fade duration (AFD).信号偶尔会掉进很深的"坑"（深衰落），在坑里的这段时间通信质量很差。题目问：每次掉进坑里，平均要多久才爬出来。这就是平均衰落时长（AFD, average fade duration）。

SymbolsWhat each quantity in the question means

\(f_D\)Maximum Doppler shift of 50 Hz; it shows how fast the channel changes: the faster the car, the larger f_D, and the more frequent and shorter the holes最大多普勒频移 50 Hz，表示信道变化有多快：车越快 f_D 越大，坑来得越频繁、也越短
ρRatio of the threshold to the signal rms value: ρ = Z_min / Z_rms门限和信号 rms 值之比：ρ = Z_min / Z_rms
AFD formulaGiven directly in the question; just substitute题目直接给出，代数即可

What each part asksWhat each part is asking for

  • Only part "The minimum acceptable signal strength is 0.1 times the rms value": find ρ and substitute into the formula to get how long, on average, the signal stays below the threshold.唯一一问 "可接受的最低信号强度是 rms 值的 0.1 倍"：求 ρ，代进公式算信号低于门限时平均持续多久。

Watch outEasy ways to misread the question

  • "Signal strength" means amplitude, so substitute ρ = 0.1 directly; only if it said 0.1 times the power would ρ be √0.1."signal strength" 指幅度，所以 ρ = 0.1 直接代；如果说的是功率的 0.1 倍，ρ 才是 √0.1。
  • 0.1 times the amplitude = 20 dB lower power. That is a very deep hole, so the AFD is short.幅度 0.1 倍 = 功率低 20 dB，是很深的坑，所以 AFD 很短。

PurposeWhat the question wants you to understand

The AFD tells you how many symbols one deep fade wipes out; interleaving and coding are designed around it.AFD 告诉你一次深衰落会吞掉多少个符号，交织和编码要按它来设计。

In one line: under Rayleigh fading the signal falls into deep holes; the question asks how long, on average, a hole "below 0.1 of the rms value" lasts. Find ρ and substitute into the formula.一句话：瑞利衰落时信号会掉进深坑，题目问"低于 rms 值 0.1 倍"的坑平均持续多久，求出 ρ 代入公式即可。
  1. Parameters: maximum Doppler shift fD = 50 Hz; ρ = Zmin/Zrms (Ch 2 p.41). "Signal strength" is an amplitude, so "0.1 of the rms value" means ρ = 0.1. In dB: 20 log₁₀0.1 = −20 dB, i.e. a power ratio ρ² = 0.01.
  2. Numerator: square first, then take the exponential: \[\begin{aligned}\rho^2&=0.1^2=0.01\\ e^{\rho^2}-1&=1.01005-1=0.01005\end{aligned}\] Where it comes from (Ch 2 p.43): AFD = P(z < Zmin) / LZ; for Rayleigh fading P(z < Zmin) = 1 − e−ρ² and LZ = √(2π) fD ρ e−ρ²; dividing top and bottom by e−ρ² gives the numerator eρ² − 1. For small x, ex − 1 ≈ x, so it is about 0.01.
  3. Denominator: \[\begin{aligned}\sqrt{2\pi}\,f_D\,\rho&=\sqrt{6.2832}\times50\times0.1\\&=2.5066\times5=12.53\ \text{s}^{-1}\end{aligned}\] fD is in Hz = 1/s, so the denominator is in 1/s and the result of the division is in seconds.
  4. Divide: \[\begin{aligned}AFD&=\frac{e^{\rho^2}-1}{\sqrt{2\pi}\,f_D\,\rho}=\frac{0.01005}{12.53\ \text{s}^{-1}}\\&=8.02\times10^{-4}\ \text{s}\approx0.8\ \text{ms}\end{aligned}\] Meaning: each time the signal drops below 0.1 of its rms value, it takes on average 0.8 ms to come back above the threshold.
  5. Check: verify with the LCR (Ch 2 p.41):
    LCR = √(2π) fD ρ e−ρ² = 12.53 × 0.99005 = 12.41 crossings/s
    AFD × LCR = 8.02 × 10⁻⁴ × 12.41 = 0.00995
    1 − e−0.01 = 0.00995 ✓
    About 12 fades per second, each about 0.8 ms long, add up to about 1% of the time below the threshold, which is exactly the Rayleigh P(z < Zmin). The small-ρ approximation AFD ≈ ρ/(√(2π) fD) = 0.1/125.3 = 7.98 × 10⁻⁴ s agrees too ✓.
AFD ≈ 0.8 ms
Official answer: 0.8 ms ✓
By-product, the level crossing rate: \(\sqrt{2\pi}\times50\times0.1\times e^{-0.01}=12.4\) crossings/s. AFD × LCR = 0.00995 ≈ 1%, the fraction of time the signal is more than 20 dB below its rms value.
Concept + walkthrough: LCR, AFD and the meaning of ρ知识讲解 + 详细解析：LCR、AFD 与 ρ 的含义

ConceptLevel crossing rate (LCR) and average fade duration (AFD)

In Rayleigh fading the received amplitude z(t) fluctuates quickly and now and then drops below the minimum usable level Zmin (a "fade"). Two quantities describe these fades (lecture Ch 2 p.40–43):瑞利衰落下，接收信号幅度 z(t) 随时间快速起伏，时不时掉到最低可用电平 Zmin 以下（一个"坑"）。描述这些坑有两个量（讲义第 2 章 p.40–43）：

  • LCR (level crossing rate) LZ: the number of times per second the signal crosses Zmin downwards, i.e. how many fades per second.LCR（level crossing rate，电平通过率）LZ：每秒钟信号往下穿过 Zmin 的次数，也就是每秒掉进几个坑。
  • AFD (average fade duration): how long each fade lasts on average. Definition (p.42): over T seconds, the total time below, Σti, divided by the number of fades LZT.AFD（average fade duration，平均衰落时长）：每个坑平均待多久。定义（p.42）：在 T 秒里，总的低于时间 Σti 除以坑的个数 LZT。

p.43 rewrites the definition as AFD = P(z < Zmin) / LZ: the fraction of time below the threshold divided by the number of fades per second. For Rayleigh, P(z < Zmin) = 1 − e−ρ² and LZ = √(2π) fm ρ e−ρ²; dividing gives the formula in the question.p.43 把定义改写成 AFD = P(z < Zmin) / LZ：低于门限的时间比例除以每秒的坑数。瑞利分布下 P(z < Zmin) = 1 − e−ρ²，LZ = √(2π) fm ρ e−ρ²，两者相除就是题目给的式子。

SymbolMeaningHere
ρ = Zmin/Zrmsthreshold over rms value (an amplitude ratio)门限与 rms 值之比（幅度比）0.1, i.e. 20 dB down
fm (= fD)maximum Doppler shift, how fast the channel changes, fD = v/λ最大多普勒频移，信道变化有多快，fD = v/λ50 Hz

The lecturer stressed in class: the LCR and AFD formulas are given in the exam, but you must be able to explain ρ = Zmin/Zrms and fm in one sentence; and the two formulas apply only to Rayleigh fading. If the question does not say Rayleigh, use the definitions (many students lost marks on this in Q2 of this year's Quiz).老师课上强调：LCR、AFD 公式考试会给，但要会用一句话解释 ρ = Zmin/Zrms 和 fm；而且这两个公式只适用于瑞利衰落，题目没说瑞利时要按定义算（今年 Quiz 第 2 题很多人在这里丢分）。

Step by stepSubstituting into the formula

  1. Find ρ: the minimum signal strength is 0.1 of the rms value. Signal strength means amplitude, so ρ = 0.1; in dB that is 20 log₁₀0.1 = −20 dB, a deep fade.定 ρ：最低信号强度是 rms 值的 0.1 倍。signal strength 指幅度，所以 ρ = 0.1；换成 dB 是 20 log₁₀0.1 = −20 dB，是很深的坑。
  2. Numerator: square first, ρ² = 0.01, then e0.01 − 1 = 0.01005. Calculator hint: for small x, ex − 1 ≈ x, so it is about 0.01.分子：先平方 ρ² = 0.01，再 e0.01 − 1 = 0.01005。计算器提示：x 很小时 ex − 1 ≈ x，所以约等于 0.01。
  3. Denominator: √(2π) = 2.5066, × 50 × 0.1 = 12.53.分母：√(2π) = 2.5066，× 50 × 0.1 = 12.53。
  4. Divide, then convert seconds to milliseconds.相除，再把秒换成毫秒。
ρ² = 0.01, e0.01 − 1 = 0.01005
√(2π) × 50 × 0.1 = 2.5066 × 5 = 12.53
AFD = 0.01005 / 12.53 = 8.0 × 10⁻⁴ s ≈ 0.8 ms

CheckVerify with the LCR

LCR = 12.53 × e−0.01 = 12.41 crossings/s
AFD × LCR = 8.02 × 10⁻⁴ × 12.41 = 0.00995 = 1 − e−0.01

Meaning: about 12 fades per second, each about 0.8 ms, so the signal is below the threshold about 1% of the time, exactly the Rayleigh P(z < Zmin). Another check: for small ρ, AFD ≈ ρ/(√(2π) fD) = 0.1/125.3 = 7.98 × 10⁻⁴ s, almost the same.意思是：每秒掉坑约 12 次，每次约 0.8 ms，合起来约 1% 的时间低于门限，正好等于瑞利分布 P(z < Zmin)。另一个检查：ρ 很小时 AFD ≈ ρ/(√(2π) fD) = 0.1/125.3 = 7.98 × 10⁻⁴ s，几乎一样。

Engineering meaning: symbols lost per fade = AFD × Rs (covered in class). Example: at 10 ksps, 0.8 ms wipes out about 8 consecutive symbols, so the interleaver depth must be larger than that.工程意义：一次衰落吞掉的符号数 = AFD × Rs（老师课上讲过）。举例：若符号速率 10 ksps，0.8 ms 就连错约 8 个符号，交织深度要比这个大。

PitfallsWhere marks are usually lost

  • ρ is an amplitude ratio: 0.1 of the rms value → ρ = 0.1. If a question says "0.1 of the power", ρ = √0.1 = 0.316 and the AFD becomes 2.65 ms, more than 3 times larger.ρ 是幅度比：rms 值的 0.1 倍 → ρ = 0.1。若题目说"功率是 0.1 倍"，ρ = √0.1 = 0.316，AFD 变成 2.65 ms，差 3 倍多。
  • The exponent is ρ², not ρ: e0.1 − 1 = 0.105 would make the answer 10 times too large.指数是 ρ² 不是 ρ：e0.1 − 1 = 0.105 会让答案大 10 倍。
  • If the question says "20 dB below rms", ρ = 10−20/20 = 0.1 (amplitudes use 20 log).题目给 "20 dB below rms" 时，ρ = 10−20/20 = 0.1（幅度用 20 log）。
  • Without Rayleigh fading this formula does not apply; use the definition: total time below ÷ number of fades.没说瑞利衰落就不能套这个公式，要按定义：总低于时间 ÷ 次数。

ExamHow to write it in English

For Rayleigh fading, AFD = (eρ² − 1)/(√(2π) fD ρ), where ρ = Zmin/Zrms is the ratio of the minimum acceptable signal strength to the rms signal strength, and fD is the maximum Doppler shift.

Here ρ = 0.1 and fD = 50 Hz: AFD = (e0.01 − 1)/(2.5066 × 50 × 0.1) = 0.01005/12.53 = 8.0 × 10⁻⁴ s ≈ 0.8 ms.

So each time the signal falls below 0.1 of its rms value, it stays below for about 0.8 ms on average.

In one line: AFD = fraction of time below the threshold ÷ fades per second; ρ = Zmin/Zrms = 0.1 (an amplitude ratio), and the Rayleigh formula gives 0.8 ms.一句话：AFD = 低于门限的时间比例 ÷ 每秒掉坑次数；ρ = Zmin/Zrms = 0.1（幅度比），代入瑞利公式得 0.8 ms。
◆ Key points
What it tests
Average fade duration (AFD) in Rayleigh fading (Ch 2 p.42–43).
Background
ρ = Zmin/Zrms is an amplitude ratio; Rayleigh P(z < Zmin) = 1 − e−ρ²; Doppler fD = v fc/c.
Method
Find ρ → eρ² − 1 → denominator √(2π) fD ρ → divide.
Key formulas
AFD = (eρ² − 1)/(√(2π) fD ρ); LCR = √(2π) fD ρ e−ρ²; AFD × LCR = 1 − e−ρ² (fraction of time below the threshold).
Common mistakes
"0.1 of the rms value" is an amplitude, so ρ = 0.1 (power 20 dB down). If a question says "0.1 of the power", then ρ = √0.1 = 0.316.
Variations
Given vehicle speed and carrier frequency, compute fD first. Number of symbols lost per fade = AFD × symbol rate: at 1 Msps, 0.8 ms ≈ 800 symbols (Section 2.6 example on the learning page).
Intuition
For small ρ, AFD ≈ ρ/(√(2π) fD): the lower the threshold, the shorter the time spent below it; the faster the vehicle (larger fD), the shorter but more frequent the fades.
  1. 定参数：最大多普勒频移 fD = 50 Hz；ρ = Zmin/Zrms（讲义第 2 章 p.41）。signal strength 指幅度，"rms 值的 0.1 倍"即 ρ = 0.1。换成 dB：20 log₁₀0.1 = −20 dB，对应功率比 ρ² = 0.01。
  2. 分子：先平方，再取指数： \[\begin{aligned}\rho^2&=0.1^2=0.01\\ e^{\rho^2}-1&=1.01005-1=0.01005\end{aligned}\] 来历（讲义 p.43）：AFD = P(z < Zmin) / LZ，瑞利下 P(z < Zmin) = 1 − e−ρ²，LZ = √(2π) fD ρ e−ρ²，上下同除 e−ρ² 就得到分子 eρ² − 1。x 很小时 ex − 1 ≈ x，所以约 0.01。
  3. 分母： \[\begin{aligned}\sqrt{2\pi}\,f_D\,\rho&=\sqrt{6.2832}\times50\times0.1\\&=2.5066\times5=12.53\ \text{s}^{-1}\end{aligned}\] fD 的单位是 Hz = 1/s，所以分母单位是 1/s，相除后结果是秒。
  4. 相除： \[\begin{aligned}AFD&=\frac{e^{\rho^2}-1}{\sqrt{2\pi}\,f_D\,\rho}=\frac{0.01005}{12.53\ \text{s}^{-1}}\\&=8.02\times10^{-4}\ \text{s}\approx0.8\ \text{ms}\end{aligned}\] 意思是：信号每次掉到 rms 值的 0.1 倍以下，平均要过 0.8 ms 才回到门限以上。
  5. 自检：用 LCR（讲义 p.41）反过来验证：
    LCR = √(2π) fD ρ e−ρ² = 12.53 × 0.99005 = 12.41 次/秒
    AFD × LCR = 8.02 × 10⁻⁴ × 12.41 = 0.00995
    1 − e−0.01 = 0.00995 ✓
    每秒约 12 次衰落、每次约 0.8 ms，合起来约 1% 的时间低于门限，正好是瑞利分布的 P(z < Zmin)。小 ρ 近似 AFD ≈ ρ/(√(2π) fD) = 0.1/125.3 = 7.98 × 10⁻⁴ s，也对得上 ✓。
AFD ≈ 0.8 ms
官方答案：0.8 ms ✓
顺便算 LCR：\(\sqrt{2\pi}\times50\times0.1\times e^{-0.01}=12.4\) 次/秒。两者相乘 = 0.00995 ≈ 1%，就是信号低于 rms 值 20 dB 的时间比例。
知识讲解 + 详细解析：LCR、AFD 与 ρ 的含义

知识讲解电平通过率 LCR 和平均衰落时长 AFD

瑞利衰落下，接收信号幅度 z(t) 随时间快速起伏，时不时掉到最低可用电平 Zmin 以下（一个"坑"）。描述这些坑有两个量（讲义第 2 章 p.40–43）：

  • LCR（level crossing rate，电平通过率）LZ：每秒钟信号往下穿过 Zmin 的次数，也就是每秒掉进几个坑。
  • AFD（average fade duration，平均衰落时长）：每个坑平均待多久。定义（p.42）：在 T 秒里，总的低于时间 Σti 除以坑的个数 LZT。

p.43 把定义改写成 AFD = P(z < Zmin) / LZ：低于门限的时间比例除以每秒的坑数。瑞利分布下 P(z < Zmin) = 1 − e−ρ²，LZ = √(2π) fm ρ e−ρ²，两者相除就是题目给的式子。

符号含义本题
ρ = Zmin/Zrms门限与 rms 值之比（幅度比）0.1，即低 20 dB
fm（= fD）最大多普勒频移，信道变化有多快，fD = v/λ50 Hz

老师课上强调：LCR、AFD 公式考试会给，但要会用一句话解释 ρ = Zmin/Zrms 和 fm；而且这两个公式只适用于瑞利衰落，题目没说瑞利时要按定义算（今年 Quiz 第 2 题很多人在这里丢分）。

详细解析一步一步代公式

  1. 定 ρ：最低信号强度是 rms 值的 0.1 倍。signal strength 指幅度，所以 ρ = 0.1；换成 dB 是 20 log₁₀0.1 = −20 dB，是很深的坑。
  2. 分子：先平方 ρ² = 0.01，再 e0.01 − 1 = 0.01005。计算器提示：x 很小时 ex − 1 ≈ x，所以约等于 0.01。
  3. 分母：√(2π) = 2.5066，× 50 × 0.1 = 12.53。
  4. 相除，再把秒换成毫秒。
ρ² = 0.01，e0.01 − 1 = 0.01005
√(2π) × 50 × 0.1 = 2.5066 × 5 = 12.53
AFD = 0.01005 / 12.53 = 8.0 × 10⁻⁴ s ≈ 0.8 ms

自检用 LCR 反过来验证

LCR = 12.53 × e−0.01 = 12.41 次/秒
AFD × LCR = 8.02 × 10⁻⁴ × 12.41 = 0.00995 = 1 − e−0.01

意思是：每秒掉坑约 12 次，每次约 0.8 ms，合起来约 1% 的时间低于门限，正好等于瑞利分布 P(z < Zmin)。另一个检查：ρ 很小时 AFD ≈ ρ/(√(2π) fD) = 0.1/125.3 = 7.98 × 10⁻⁴ s，几乎一样。

工程意义：一次衰落吞掉的符号数 = AFD × Rs（老师课上讲过）。举例：若符号速率 10 ksps，0.8 ms 就连错约 8 个符号，交织深度要比这个大。

易错常见丢分点

  • ρ 是幅度比：rms 值的 0.1 倍 → ρ = 0.1。若题目说"功率是 0.1 倍"，ρ = √0.1 = 0.316，AFD 变成 2.65 ms，差 3 倍多。
  • 指数是 ρ² 不是 ρ：e0.1 − 1 = 0.105 会让答案大 10 倍。
  • 题目给 "20 dB below rms" 时，ρ = 10−20/20 = 0.1（幅度用 20 log）。
  • 没说瑞利衰落就不能套这个公式，要按定义：总低于时间 ÷ 次数。

考试英文写法

For Rayleigh fading, AFD = (eρ² − 1)/(√(2π) fD ρ), where ρ = Zmin/Zrms is the ratio of the minimum acceptable signal strength to the rms signal strength, and fD is the maximum Doppler shift.

Here ρ = 0.1 and fD = 50 Hz: AFD = (e0.01 − 1)/(2.5066 × 50 × 0.1) = 0.01005/12.53 = 8.0 × 10⁻⁴ s ≈ 0.8 ms.

So each time the signal falls below 0.1 of its rms value, it stays below for about 0.8 ms on average.

一句话：AFD = 低于门限的时间比例 ÷ 每秒掉坑次数；ρ = Zmin/Zrms = 0.1（幅度比），代入瑞利公式得 0.8 ms。
◆ 本题知识点
考什么
瑞利衰落的平均衰落持续时间 AFD（第 2 章 p.42–43）。
前置知识
ρ = Zmin/Zrms 是幅度比；瑞利 P(z < Zmin) = 1 − e−ρ²；多普勒 fD = v fc/c。
解题套路
算 ρ → eρ² − 1 → 分母 √(2π) fD ρ → 相除。
关键公式
AFD = (eρ² − 1)/(√(2π) fD ρ)；LCR = √(2π) fD ρ e−ρ²；AFD × LCR = 1 − e−ρ²（低于门限的时间比例）。
易错
"rms 值的 0.1"是幅度，ρ = 0.1（功率低 20 dB）；若题目说"功率的 0.1"，则 ρ = √0.1 = 0.316。
举一反三
已知车速和载频，先求 fD。一次衰落连错几个符号 = AFD × 符号速率：1 Msps 时 0.8 ms ≈ 800 个符号（讲解页 2.6 节例题）。
直觉
ρ 很小时 AFD ≈ ρ/(√(2π) fD)：门限越低，跌到门限以下的时间越短；车越快（fD 越大），衰落越短但越频繁。
