Part 2 practice
P2 · Q2

Macro-diversity with two base stations: independent vs correlated shadowing

Original question · bilingualPractice 2

Consider a mobile station located between two base stations in a cellular network. The received signal powers (in dBm) from the base stations are given by

考虑蜂窝网络中一个位于两个基站之间的移动台。它从两个基站收到的信号功率（dBm）为

\(P_{r,1}=W+Z_1;\quad P_{r,2}=W+Z_2\)

where \(Z_1\) and \(Z_2\) are random variables \(\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2)\). Outage is defined to have occurred when both \(P_{r,1}\) and \(P_{r,2}\) fall below a threshold T, where T is smaller than W by Δ.

其中 \(Z_1\) 和 \(Z_2\) 是随机变量，\(\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2)\)。当 \(P_{r,1}\) 和 \(P_{r,2}\) 都低于门限 T 时，定义为发生中断；T 比 W 小 Δ。

(a) Interpret the terms W, \(Z_1\), \(Z_2\).

(a) 解释 W、\(Z_1\)、\(Z_2\) 这几项的含义。

(b) If \(Z_1\) and \(Z_2\) are statistically independent, show that the outage probability is, \(P_{out}=[Q(\Delta/\sigma)]^2\)

(b) 若 \(Z_1\) 与 \(Z_2\) 统计独立，证明中断概率为 \(P_{out}=[Q(\Delta/\sigma)]^2\)。

(c) Now suppose \(Z_1\) and \(Z_2\) are correlated in the following way: \(Z_1=aY_1+bY\), \(Z_2=aY_2+bY\), where Y, \(Y_1\), \(Y_2\) are independent random variables \(\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2)\). Show that

(c) 现在假设 \(Z_1\) 与 \(Z_2\) 按如下方式相关：\(Z_1=aY_1+bY\)，\(Z_2=aY_2+bY\)，其中 Y、\(Y_1\)、\(Y_2\) 是相互独立的随机变量，\(\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2)\)。证明

\(P_{out}=\displaystyle\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}Q\!\left[\frac{\Delta+by\sigma}{|a|\sigma}\right]^2e^{-y^2/2}dy\)

Macro-diversityIndependent → multiply probabilitiesConditional probability + total probabilityCh. 2 of the notes p.12–15; Ch. 4 p.4
What the question is asking: what does this question actually want?

ScenarioWhat the question is about

The phone is midway between two base stations and receives both at once: BS 1 ))) 📱 ((( BS 2. This arrangement is called macro-diversity: "diversity" means having more than one path, and "macro" means the two paths come from two base stations far apart.手机站在两个基站中间，能同时收到两个基站的信号：基站 1 ))) 📱 ((( 基站 2。这种安排叫宏分集（macro-diversity）："分集"是准备多条路，"宏"是说这两条路来自相隔很远的两个基站。

Purpose: as long as one base station's signal is strong enough, the call stays up; it drops only if both fail.目的：只要有一个基站的信号够强，通话就不断；两个都不行才真的断线。

Example: W = −90 dBm, threshold T = −100 dBm (so Δ = 10 dB). At some instant Z₁ = −12 dB and Z₂ = +3 dB, so P_r,1 = −102 dBm (BS 1 blocked by a building) and P_r,2 = −87 dBm (clear). The phone switches to BS 2; this is not an outage.举例：W = −90 dBm，门限 T = −100 dBm（所以 Δ = 10 dB）。某一时刻 Z₁ = −12 dB、Z₂ = +3 dB，则 P_r,1 = −102 dBm（基站 1 被楼挡住），P_r,2 = −87 dBm（畅通）。手机改用基站 2，不算中断。

SymbolsWhat each quantity in the question means

\(P_{r,1},P_{r,2}\)Power received by the phone from the two base stations (dBm)手机从两个基站收到的功率（dBm）
WMean received power, set only by distance (path loss). The phone is exactly in the middle, so both sides are equal平均接收功率，只由距离决定（路径损耗）。手机在正中间，两边一样
\(Z_1,Z_2\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2)\)Shadow fading (dB): random fluctuation caused by blocking from buildings and trees, mean 0; σ is the size of the fluctuation, typically 6–10 dB阴影衰落（dB）：被楼、树挡住造成的随机起伏，平均为 0，σ 是起伏大小，典型 6–10 dB
TThreshold: below this received power the signal cannot be understood门限：接收功率低于它就听不清
ΔMargin: T is Δ below W, i.e. T = W − Δ

What each part asksWhat each part is asking for

  • (a) Explain what W, Z₁ and Z₂ mean; the sentences in the table above are the answer.(a) 解释 W、Z₁、Z₂ 的含义，就是上面表里那几句。
  • (b) Assume the shadowing on the two sides is uncorrelated (independent): whether BS 1's path is blocked has nothing to do with BS 2's path. Find the probability that both are below the threshold at the same time.(b) 假设两边的阴影互不相关（独立）：基站 1 那边挡不挡，和基站 2 那边无关。求两个同时低于门限的概率。
  • (c) A more realistic case: some obstacles block both paths at once (the phone goes into a basement, into a car, or behind a large building). The question models this with \(Z_1=aY_1+bY\), \(Z_2=aY_2+bY\): Y is the shadowing shared by both links (walls around the phone, the car body), and Y₁, Y₂ are each link's own shadowing. The larger b, the more alike the two links (correlation coefficient ρ = b²); b = 0 is case (b), and a = 0 makes the two links identical. You must show that the outage probability then equals the integral given in the question.(c) 更真实的情况：有些障碍物会同时挡住两条路（手机进了地下室、车里、站到大楼背后）。题目用 \(Z_1=aY_1+bY\)、\(Z_2=aY_2+bY\) 描述：Y 是两条链路共有的阴影（手机周围的墙、车身），Y₁、Y₂ 是各自独有的阴影。b 越大，两条链路越像（相关系数 ρ = b²）；b = 0 就是 (b)，a = 0 就是两条完全一样。要证明这时的中断概率等于题目给的积分式。

Watch outEasy ways to misread the question

  • Outage requires both to be below the threshold, not just either one.中断要求两个都低于门限，不是任意一个。
  • "Power below the threshold" and "shadowing below −Δ" are the same event: \(P_{r,i}\lt T\iff W+Z_i\lt W-\Delta\iff Z_i\lt-\Delta\). −Δ is not the threshold; it is where the threshold sits on the shadowing scale: the mean power is Δ above the threshold, so shadowing must push the signal down by more than Δ to cause outage. You rewrite it in terms of Z because the question only gives the distribution of Z."功率低于门限"和"阴影低于 −Δ"是同一件事：\(P_{r,i}\lt T\iff W+Z_i\lt W-\Delta\iff Z_i\lt-\Delta\)。−Δ 不是门限，而是门限在阴影这个尺度上的对应位置：平均功率本来比门限高 Δ，阴影要把信号压低超过 Δ 才会中断。改写成 Z 的形式，是因为题目只给了 Z 的分布。
  • So the whole question computes one thing: \(P_{out}=P(Z_1\lt-\Delta\ \text{and}\ Z_2\lt-\Delta)\), a number between 0 and 1.所以整道题都在求同一个东西：\(P_{out}=P(Z_1\lt-\Delta\ \text{and}\ Z_2\lt-\Delta)\)，一个 0 到 1 之间的数。

PurposeWhat the question wants you to understand

Correlation weakens macro-diversity. Take Δ = σ: one base station gives 15.9% outage; two independent base stations 2.5%; with correlation ρ = 0.5, 6.3%; fully correlated, back to 15.9%, as if there were no second base station. The gain of macro-diversity comes from "if one fails, the other still works"; if the two often fail together, the backup does not help.相关性会削弱宏分集。取 Δ = σ：一个基站中断 15.9%；两个独立基站 2.5%；相关 ρ = 0.5 时 6.3%；完全相关又回到 15.9%，等于没多一个基站。宏分集的好处来自"一个坏了还有另一个"，两个经常一起坏，备用的就帮不上忙。

In one line: the phone connects to two base stations at once and drops only if both are below the threshold. (b) finds the drop probability with independent shadowing, (c) with shared shadowing, showing that correlation reduces the benefit of "one more base station".一句话：手机同时连两个基站，两个都低于门限才算断线。(b) 算两边阴影独立时的断线概率，(c) 算两边有共同阴影时的断线概率，说明相关会让"多一个基站"的好处变小。
  1. (a) Interpret the terms: W: the mean received power (dBm) due to path loss alone; the mean path loss to the two base stations is the same, so both links share the same W. \(Z_1,Z_2\): the shadowing components (dB) of the two links. Shadowing in dB is zero-mean Gaussian (Ch 2 p.11–12), so \(Z_i\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2)\) and \(E[P_{r,i}]=W\).
  2. (b) Write outage as a condition on Z: the threshold is T = W − Δ, so for each link \[\begin{aligned}P_{r,i}\lt T&\iff W+Z_i\lt W-\Delta\\&\iff Z_i\lt-\Delta\end{aligned}\] The phone can use either base station (macroscopic diversity, Ch 4 p.4), so outage happens only when both links are below T: \(P_{out}=P(Z_1\lt-\Delta\ \text{and}\ Z_2\lt-\Delta)\).
  3. (b) One link → multiply (independent): divide by σ to standardise, then use the symmetry of the Gaussian: \[\begin{aligned}P(Z_i\lt-\Delta)&=P\Big(\frac{Z_i}{\sigma}\lt-\frac{\Delta}{\sigma}\Big)\\&=P\Big(N\gt\frac{\Delta}{\sigma}\Big)=Q\Big(\frac{\Delta}{\sigma}\Big)\end{aligned}\] \(Z_1,Z_2\) are independent, so the probability that both happen is the product: \[P_{out}=Q\Big(\frac{\Delta}{\sigma}\Big)\cdot Q\Big(\frac{\Delta}{\sigma}\Big)=\Big[Q\Big(\frac{\Delta}{\sigma}\Big)\Big]^2\] For a feel of the numbers: with Δ = σ, one base station gives Q(1) = 0.159 and two give 0.159² = 0.025 (Ch 4 p.3: M independent branches give \(P_{out}^M\)).
  4. (c) Why we cannot just square: both links contain the same bY. Y, Y₁, Y₂ are independent with zero mean, so every cross term has zero expectation: \[\begin{aligned}\operatorname{Cov}(Z_1,Z_2)&=E[(aY_1+bY)(aY_2+bY)]\\&=b^2E[Y^2]=b^2\sigma^2\neq0\end{aligned}\] So Z₁ and Z₂ are correlated and \(P(A\cap B)\neq P(A)P(B)\). (To be consistent with \(Z_i\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2)\) we need \(a^2+b^2=1\); the correlation coefficient is then b².) Trick: fix the shared Y first (conditioning).
  5. (c) Fix Y: to match the form of the answer, let \(Y=\sigma u\) with \(u\sim\mathcal N(0,1)\). Given u, \(b\sigma u\) is just a constant shift and the only random part is \(aY_i\sim\mathcal N(0,a^2\sigma^2)\) (standard deviation \(|a|\sigma\)): \[Z_i\mid u\ \sim\ \mathcal N\big(b\sigma u,\ a^2\sigma^2\big)\] Given u, Z₁ depends only on Y₁ and Z₂ only on Y₂, so the two are conditionally independent.
  6. (c) Conditional outage: for one link, standardise as in (b): \[\begin{aligned}P(Z_i\lt-\Delta\mid u)&=P\big(aY_i\lt-(\Delta+b\sigma u)\big)\\&=Q\Big(\frac{\Delta+b\sigma u}{|a|\sigma}\Big)\end{aligned}\] Conditionally independent → multiply: \[P(\text{outage}\mid u)=\Big[Q\Big(\frac{\Delta+b\sigma u}{|a|\sigma}\Big)\Big]^2\] The more negative u (the deeper the common shadow), the smaller the argument of Q and the larger Q: outage becomes more likely.
  7. (c) Average with the total probability theorem: \(P(A)=\int P(A\mid u)\,f_U(u)\,du\), with the density of u \(f_U(u)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}e^{-u^2/2}\): \[\begin{aligned}P_{out}&=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}P(\text{outage}\mid u)\,f_U(u)\,du\\&=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}\Big[Q\Big(\frac{\Delta+b\sigma u}{|a|\sigma}\Big)\Big]^2\\&\qquad\times e^{-u^2/2}\,du\end{aligned}\] Renaming the integration variable u to y gives the question's expression (its \(Q[\cdot]^2\) means \([Q(\cdot)]^2\)). If you integrate over Y = y directly, \(f_Y\) has an extra 1/σ, which cancels after substituting y = σu, dy = σ du; the result is the same.
  8. Check: ① b = 0 (no common shadowing, a = 1): Q no longer depends on u and comes out of the integral, \(\int\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}e^{-u^2/2}du=1\), giving \([Q(\Delta/\sigma)]^2\), part (b) ✓; ② a → 0 (fully shared, b = 1): Q → 1 for u < −Δ/σ and Q → 0 otherwise, so \(P_{out}=P(u\lt-\Delta/\sigma)=Q(\Delta/\sigma)\), the same as one base station: no diversity ✓.
(b) [Q(Δ/σ)]²; (c) ∫ (1/√(2π)) Q[(Δ + bσu)/(|a|σ)]² e−u²/2 du
Official answer: same as above ✓ (the question writes byσ; its integration variable y is the normalised u)
Sanity check: b = 0 reduces to the independent case (b); a = 0 makes the two links identical, Pout = Q(Δ/σ), and diversity is useless. The stronger the correlation, the weaker the macro-diversity gain.
(c) Step by step: fix Y → multiply → integrate over Y → substitute

Step 0Write outage as a condition on Z

\(P_{r,i}=W+Z_i\) and the threshold is \(T=W-\Delta\), so

\[P_{r,i}\lt T\iff W+Z_i\lt W-\Delta\iff Z_i\lt-\Delta,\qquad P_{out}=P\big(Z_1\lt-\Delta\ \text{and}\ Z_2\lt-\Delta\big)\]

The outage condition is the same in (b) and (c); only the relation between Z₁ and Z₂ changes.

Step 1Why we cannot just square, as in (b)

\(Z_1=aY_1+bY\), \(Z_2=aY_2+bY\): both links contain the same \(bY\). When Y is very negative, both links get worse together, so Z₁ and Z₂ are not independent: \(P(A\cap B)\neq P(A)P(B)\), and we cannot simply multiply.

Intuition (not in the slides): \(bY\) is shadowing common to both links, e.g. the phone is behind a building or inside a car, so the signal from either base station must pass through it; \(aY_1\), \(aY_2\) are the shadowing specific to each path, independent of each other.

How strong the correlation is: the cross terms vanish because the variables are independent with zero mean,

\[\operatorname{Cov}(Z_1,Z_2)=E\big[(aY_1+bY)(aY_2+bY)\big]=b^2E[Y^2]=b^2\sigma^2,\qquad \operatorname{Var}(Z_i)=(a^2+b^2)\sigma^2\]

The question says \(Z_i\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2)\), which implies \(a^2+b^2=1\); the correlation coefficient is \(\rho=b^2\). The larger b, the more alike the two links.

Step 2Lecturer's method ①: treat Y as a constant

Suppose Y = y is known. In \(Z_1=aY_1+by\) the term \(by\) is just a constant shift; the only random part is \(aY_1\sim\mathcal N(0,a^2\sigma^2)\) (a constant times a Gaussian, standard deviation \(|a|\sigma\)), so

\[Z_i\mid y\ \sim\ \mathcal N\big(by,\ a^2\sigma^2\big)\]

Key point: given y, Z₁ depends only on Y₁ and Z₂ only on Y₂, and Y₁, Y₂ are independent, so Z₁ and Z₂ are conditionally independent. The shared part is "frozen" and the correlation disappears.

Step 3Conditional outage of one link

\[P(Z_1\lt-\Delta\mid y)=P\big(aY_1\lt-(\Delta+by)\big)=P\Big(N\lt-\frac{\Delta+by}{|a|\sigma}\Big)=P\Big(N\gt\frac{\Delta+by}{|a|\sigma}\Big)=Q\Big(\frac{\Delta+by}{|a|\sigma}\Big)\]

N ~ N(0, 1) is aY₁ divided by its standard deviation |a|σ; the third equality uses the symmetry of the Gaussian about 0; the last step is the definition Q(x) = P(N > x). We write |a| because a standard deviation must be positive; a negative a leaves the distribution unchanged. The more negative y (deeper common shadow), the smaller Δ + by and the larger Q: outage becomes more likely.

Step 4Multiply the two links

\[P(\text{outage}\mid y)=P(Z_1\lt-\Delta\mid y)\,P(Z_2\lt-\Delta\mid y)=\Big[Q\Big(\frac{\Delta+by}{|a|\sigma}\Big)\Big]^2\]

This is the "independent → multiply" of part (b), done under the condition that Y is known.

Step 5Lecturer's method ②: make Y random again and integrate over its PDF

Total probability theorem, continuous form: \(P(A)=\int P(A\mid Y=y)\,f_Y(y)\,dy\) (discrete form \(\sum_k P(A\mid B_k)P(B_k)\)): a weighted average over every case, weighted by how likely it is. With \(f_Y(y)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}\,\sigma}e^{-y^2/(2\sigma^2)}\):

\[P_{out}=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\Big[Q\Big(\frac{\Delta+by}{|a|\sigma}\Big)\Big]^2\,\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}\,\sigma}\,e^{-y^2/(2\sigma^2)}\,dy\]

This is already correct; it just does not look like the required form yet.

Step 6Lecturer's method ③: substitute u = y/σ

\(y=\sigma u\), \(dy=\sigma\,du\), limits still ±∞. The 1/σ in front of the PDF cancels the σ in dy; \(e^{-y^2/(2\sigma^2)}=e^{-u^2/2}\); the argument of Q becomes \((\Delta+b\sigma u)/(|a|\sigma)\):

\[P_{out}=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}\Big[Q\Big(\frac{\Delta+b\sigma u}{|a|\sigma}\Big)\Big]^2e^{-u^2/2}\,du\]

The integration variable is a dummy variable. Renaming u to y gives the question's \((\Delta+by\sigma)/(|a|\sigma)\), so the y in the question is the normalised u, not the original Y. The question's \(Q[\cdot]^2\) means \([Q(\cdot)]^2\), not Q of a squared argument.

CheckTwo extreme cases

  • b = 0 (no common shadowing, a = 1): Q no longer depends on u and comes out of the integral, leaving \(\int\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}e^{-u^2/2}du=1\). The result is \([Q(\Delta/\sigma)]^2\), part (b) ✓
  • a → 0 (fully shared, b = 1): the argument of Q goes to ±∞. For u > −Δ/σ, Q → 0; for u < −Δ/σ, Q → 1. So \(P_{out}=P(u\lt-\Delta/\sigma)=Q(\Delta/\sigma)\), the same as a single base station: no diversity at all ✓
Numbers for intuition (not in the slides; numerical integration, checked by Monte Carlo simulation). With Δ = σ (e.g. both 8 dB), a single base station has outage Q(1) = 0.1587:
ρ = b²00.250.50.750.91
Pout0.02520.04170.06250.09050.11550.1587
For ρ = 0.5 the conditional outage P(outage | u) is 0.52 at u = −2, 0.0062 at u = 0 and about 6×10⁻⁵ at u = +1. Almost all outages happen when the common shadow is deep (u very negative) and both base stations fail together. That is why correlation weakens macro-diversity.

ExamCompact answer (write it in this order)

Outage ⇔ \(Z_1\lt-\Delta\) and \(Z_2\lt-\Delta\). \(Z_1\) and \(Z_2\) share the term \(bY\), so they are correlated; condition on \(Y=y\).

Given y, \(Z_i=aY_i+by\sim\mathcal N(by,\,a^2\sigma^2)\), and \(Z_1,Z_2\) are independent since \(Y_1,Y_2\) are independent.

\(P(Z_i\lt-\Delta\mid y)=P\big(aY_i\lt-(\Delta+by)\big)=Q\big(\tfrac{\Delta+by}{|a|\sigma}\big)\), so \(P(\text{out}\mid y)=Q^2\big(\tfrac{\Delta+by}{|a|\sigma}\big)\).

By the total probability theorem, \(P_{out}=\int P(\text{out}\mid y)f_Y(y)\,dy=\int Q^2\big(\tfrac{\Delta+by}{|a|\sigma}\big)\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}\,\sigma}e^{-y^2/2\sigma^2}dy\).

Let \(u=y/\sigma\) (\(dy=\sigma\,du\)): \(P_{out}=\int\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}Q^2\big(\tfrac{\Delta+b\sigma u}{|a|\sigma}\big)e^{-u^2/2}du\), which is the required result.

In one line: fix the shared variable → conditionally independent, multiply → integrate over its PDF → substitute u = y/σ. Practice 4 Q2(c) is the discrete version of the same method.
◆ Key points
What it tests
Outage with macro-diversity for independent and correlated shadowing; conditional probability plus total probability (Ch 2 p.12–15; Ch 4 p.3–4, p.21).
Background
Independent events multiply; a linear combination of independent Gaussians is Gaussian, aY₁ + bY ~ N(0, (a² + b²)σ²); continuous total probability P(A) = ∫P(A | y)p(y)dy.
Method
(b) Single-link outage P(Zi < −Δ) = Q(Δ/σ), independent → square. (c) Fix the shared Y ("condition on it"), the links are then independent → multiply the conditional outages → integrate over the PDF of Y.
Key step
Let Y = σu, u ~ N(0, 1). Given u: Zi ~ N(bσu, a²σ²), P(Zi < −Δ | u) = Q((Δ + bσu)/(|a|σ)).
Hidden assumption
To be consistent with Zi ~ N(0, σ²) we need a² + b² = 1. The correlation coefficient of Z₁ and Z₂ is then b²: the larger b, the more alike the two links.
Check
b = 0 gives the [Q(Δ/σ)]² of part (b); a = 0 (fully correlated) makes the links identical, Pout = Q(Δ/σ), no diversity at all.
Link
Practice 4 Q1 explains the same idea in words; Ch 4 p.21 "correlation reduces diversity"; Practice 4 Q2(c) is a discrete version with shared shadowing.
  1. (a) 解释各项：W：只考虑路径损耗时的平均接收功率（dBm）；手机到两个基站的平均路径损耗相同，所以两条链路共用同一个 W。\(Z_1,Z_2\)：两条链路各自的阴影衰落（shadowing）分量（dB）。阴影在 dB 上是零均值高斯（讲义第 2 章 p.11–12），所以 \(Z_i\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2)\)，\(E[P_{r,i}]=W\)。
  2. (b) 把中断写成 Z 的条件：门限 T = W − Δ，所以对每条链路 \[\begin{aligned}P_{r,i}\lt T&\iff W+Z_i\lt W-\Delta\\&\iff Z_i\lt-\Delta\end{aligned}\] 手机可以连任一个基站（宏分集，macroscopic diversity，讲义第 4 章 p.4），只有两条都低于 T 才中断：\(P_{out}=P(Z_1\lt-\Delta\ \text{且}\ Z_2\lt-\Delta)\)。
  3. (b) 单条链路 → 独立相乘：除以 σ 标准化，再用高斯对称性： \[\begin{aligned}P(Z_i\lt-\Delta)&=P\Big(\frac{Z_i}{\sigma}\lt-\frac{\Delta}{\sigma}\Big)\\&=P\Big(N\gt\frac{\Delta}{\sigma}\Big)=Q\Big(\frac{\Delta}{\sigma}\Big)\end{aligned}\] \(Z_1,Z_2\) 独立，"两个都发生"的概率 = 各自概率相乘： \[P_{out}=Q\Big(\frac{\Delta}{\sigma}\Big)\cdot Q\Big(\frac{\Delta}{\sigma}\Big)=\Big[Q\Big(\frac{\Delta}{\sigma}\Big)\Big]^2\] 数字感受：Δ = σ 时单个基站 Q(1) = 0.159，两个基站 0.159² = 0.025（讲义第 4 章 p.3：M 条独立支路 \(P_{out}^M\)）。
  4. (c) 为什么不能直接平方：两条链路含有同一个 bY。Y、Y₁、Y₂ 独立且均值为 0，交叉项的期望都是 0： \[\begin{aligned}\operatorname{Cov}(Z_1,Z_2)&=E[(aY_1+bY)(aY_2+bY)]\\&=b^2E[Y^2]=b^2\sigma^2\neq0\end{aligned}\] 所以 Z₁、Z₂ 相关，\(P(A\cap B)\neq P(A)P(B)\)。（要和 \(Z_i\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2)\) 一致，隐含 \(a^2+b^2=1\)，相关系数 = b²。）技巧：先固定共享的 Y（条件化，conditioning）。
  5. (c) 固定 Y：为了和答案形式一致，令 \(Y=\sigma u\)，\(u\sim\mathcal N(0,1)\)。给定 u，\(b\sigma u\) 只是常数平移，随机的只剩 \(aY_i\sim\mathcal N(0,a^2\sigma^2)\)（标准差 \(|a|\sigma\)）： \[Z_i\mid u\ \sim\ \mathcal N\big(b\sigma u,\ a^2\sigma^2\big)\] 给定 u 后 Z₁ 只和 Y₁ 有关、Z₂ 只和 Y₂ 有关，所以两者条件独立（conditionally independent）。
  6. (c) 条件中断概率：一条链路，标准化方法同 (b)： \[\begin{aligned}P(Z_i\lt-\Delta\mid u)&=P\big(aY_i\lt-(\Delta+b\sigma u)\big)\\&=Q\Big(\frac{\Delta+b\sigma u}{|a|\sigma}\Big)\end{aligned}\] 条件独立 → 相乘： \[P(\text{中断}\mid u)=\Big[Q\Big(\frac{\Delta+b\sigma u}{|a|\sigma}\Big)\Big]^2\] u 越负（共同阴影越深），Q 的参数越小、Q 越大，越容易中断。
  7. (c) 全概率定理求平均：\(P(A)=\int P(A\mid u)\,f_U(u)\,du\)，u 的密度 \(f_U(u)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}e^{-u^2/2}\)： \[\begin{aligned}P_{out}&=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}P(\text{中断}\mid u)\,f_U(u)\,du\\&=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}\Big[Q\Big(\frac{\Delta+b\sigma u}{|a|\sigma}\Big)\Big]^2\\&\qquad\times e^{-u^2/2}\,du\end{aligned}\] 积分变量 u 改名为 y，就是题目的式子（题目写的 \(Q[\cdot]^2\) 指 \([Q(\cdot)]^2\)）。若直接对 Y = y 积分，\(f_Y\) 里多一个 1/σ，换元 y = σu、dy = σ du 后正好抵消，结果相同。
  8. 自检：① b = 0（没有共同阴影，a = 1）：Q 里不含 u，可以提到积分外，\(\int\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}e^{-u^2/2}du=1\)，得 \([Q(\Delta/\sigma)]^2\)，回到 (b) ✓；② a → 0（完全共享，b = 1）：u < −Δ/σ 时 Q → 1，否则 Q → 0，\(P_{out}=P(u\lt-\Delta/\sigma)=Q(\Delta/\sigma)\)，和只有一个基站一样，分集无效 ✓。
(b) [Q(Δ/σ)]²；(c) ∫ (1/√(2π)) Q[(Δ + bσu)/(|a|σ)]² e^{−u²/2} du
官方答案：与上面一致 ✓（题目里写成 byσ，积分变量 y 指的是归一化后的 u）
直觉：b = 0 时退化成 (b) 的独立情况；a = 0 时两条链路完全一样，Pout = Q(Δ/σ)，分集完全没用。相关性越强，宏分集效果越差。
(c) 逐步详解：先固定 Y → 相乘 → 对 Y 积分 → 换元

第 0 步把"中断"写成 Z 的条件

\(P_{r,i}=W+Z_i\)，门限 \(T=W-\Delta\)，所以

\[P_{r,i}\lt T\iff W+Z_i\lt W-\Delta\iff Z_i\lt-\Delta,\qquad P_{out}=P\big(Z_1\lt-\Delta\ \text{and}\ Z_2\lt-\Delta\big)\]

(b) 和 (c) 的中断条件完全一样，区别只在 Z₁、Z₂ 之间是什么关系。

第 1 步为什么不能像 (b) 那样直接平方

\(Z_1=aY_1+bY\)，\(Z_2=aY_2+bY\)：两条链路含有同一个 \(bY\)。Y 很负时两条链路一起变差，所以 Z₁、Z₂ 不独立，\(P(A\cap B)\neq P(A)P(B)\)，不能直接相乘。

直观理解（课外补充）：\(bY\) 像两条链路共有的阴影，比如手机站在大楼背后、在车里，信号从哪个基站来都要穿过它；\(aY_1\)、\(aY_2\) 是各条路径独有的阴影，互相独立。

相关程度：交叉项因为独立且均值为 0，全部消掉，

\[\operatorname{Cov}(Z_1,Z_2)=E\big[(aY_1+bY)(aY_2+bY)\big]=b^2E[Y^2]=b^2\sigma^2,\qquad \operatorname{Var}(Z_i)=(a^2+b^2)\sigma^2\]

题目说 \(Z_i\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2)\)，隐含 \(a^2+b^2=1\)，相关系数 \(\rho=b^2\)：b 越大，两条链路越像。

第 2 步老师的方法①：先把 Y 当成常数

假设 Y = y 已经确定。\(Z_1=aY_1+by\) 里的 \(by\) 只是常数平移，唯一随机的是 \(aY_1\sim\mathcal N(0,a^2\sigma^2)\)（常数乘高斯，标准差是 \(|a|\sigma\)），所以

\[Z_i\mid y\ \sim\ \mathcal N\big(by,\ a^2\sigma^2\big)\]

关键：给定 y 以后，Z₁ 只和 Y₁ 有关，Z₂ 只和 Y₂ 有关，而 Y₁、Y₂ 独立，所以 Z₁、Z₂ 条件独立。共享的那部分被"冻结"了，相关性就没有了。

第 3 步一条链路的条件中断概率

\[P(Z_1\lt-\Delta\mid y)=P\big(aY_1\lt-(\Delta+by)\big)=P\Big(N\lt-\frac{\Delta+by}{|a|\sigma}\Big)=P\Big(N\gt\frac{\Delta+by}{|a|\sigma}\Big)=Q\Big(\frac{\Delta+by}{|a|\sigma}\Big)\]

N ~ N(0, 1) 是 aY₁ 除以它的标准差 |a|σ 得到的；第三个等号用高斯关于 0 对称；最后一步就是 Q 的定义 Q(x) = P(N > x)。写 |a| 是因为标准差必须为正，a 为负时分布不变。y 越负（共同阴影越深），Δ + by 越小，Q 越大，越容易中断。

第 4 步两条链路相乘

\[P(\text{outage}\mid y)=P(Z_1\lt-\Delta\mid y)\,P(Z_2\lt-\Delta\mid y)=\Big[Q\Big(\frac{\Delta+by}{|a|\sigma}\Big)\Big]^2\]

这一步就是 (b) 的"独立 → 相乘"，只是放在"Y 已知"这个条件下做。

第 5 步老师的方法②：把 Y 变回随机变量，对它的 PDF 积分

全概率定理的连续形式 \(P(A)=\int P(A\mid Y=y)\,f_Y(y)\,dy\)，离散版是 \(\sum_k P(A\mid B_k)P(B_k)\)，意思就是按每种情况出现的概率加权平均。代入 \(f_Y(y)=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}\,\sigma}e^{-y^2/(2\sigma^2)}\)：

\[P_{out}=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\Big[Q\Big(\frac{\Delta+by}{|a|\sigma}\Big)\Big]^2\,\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}\,\sigma}\,e^{-y^2/(2\sigma^2)}\,dy\]

这个式子已经是对的，只是和题目给的形式还不一样。

第 6 步老师的方法③：换元 u = y/σ

\(y=\sigma u\)，\(dy=\sigma\,du\)，上下限仍是 ±∞。PDF 前面的 1/σ 和 dy 里的 σ 抵消；\(e^{-y^2/(2\sigma^2)}=e^{-u^2/2}\)；Q 的参数变成 \((\Delta+b\sigma u)/(|a|\sigma)\)：

\[P_{out}=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}\Big[Q\Big(\frac{\Delta+b\sigma u}{|a|\sigma}\Big)\Big]^2e^{-u^2/2}\,du\]

积分变量叫什么都可以（哑变量）。把 u 改名成 y，就是题目里的 \((\Delta+by\sigma)/(|a|\sigma)\)，所以题目里的 y 其实是归一化后的 u，不是原来的 Y。题目写的 \(Q[\cdot]^2\) 指 \([Q(\cdot)]^2\)，不是把 Q 里面的东西平方。

自检两个极端

  • b = 0（没有共同阴影，a = 1）：Q 里不含 u，可以提到积分外面，剩下 \(\int\frac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}e^{-u^2/2}du=1\)，结果是 \([Q(\Delta/\sigma)]^2\)，回到 (b) ✓
  • a → 0（完全共享，b = 1）：Q 的参数趋向 ±∞。u > −Δ/σ 时 Q → 0，u < −Δ/σ 时 Q → 1，所以 \(P_{out}=P(u\lt-\Delta/\sigma)=Q(\Delta/\sigma)\)，和只有一个基站时一样，分集完全没用 ✓
数字感受（讲义没有；数值积分计算，蒙特卡洛模拟核对过）。取 Δ = σ（比如都是 8 dB），只有一个基站时中断概率 Q(1) = 0.1587：
ρ = b²00.250.50.750.91
Pout0.02520.04170.06250.09050.11550.1587
ρ = 0.5 时的条件中断概率 P(中断 | u)：u = −2 为 0.52，u = 0 为 0.0062，u = +1 约 6×10⁻⁵。中断几乎都发生在共同阴影很深（u 很负）的时候，两个基站一起失效，这就是相关会削弱宏分集的原因。

考试英文写法（照这个结构写）

Outage ⇔ \(Z_1\lt-\Delta\) and \(Z_2\lt-\Delta\). \(Z_1\) and \(Z_2\) share the term \(bY\), so they are correlated; condition on \(Y=y\).

Given y, \(Z_i=aY_i+by\sim\mathcal N(by,\,a^2\sigma^2)\), and \(Z_1,Z_2\) are independent since \(Y_1,Y_2\) are independent.

\(P(Z_i\lt-\Delta\mid y)=P\big(aY_i\lt-(\Delta+by)\big)=Q\big(\tfrac{\Delta+by}{|a|\sigma}\big)\), so \(P(\text{out}\mid y)=Q^2\big(\tfrac{\Delta+by}{|a|\sigma}\big)\).

By the total probability theorem, \(P_{out}=\int P(\text{out}\mid y)f_Y(y)\,dy=\int Q^2\big(\tfrac{\Delta+by}{|a|\sigma}\big)\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}\,\sigma}e^{-y^2/2\sigma^2}dy\).

Let \(u=y/\sigma\) (\(dy=\sigma\,du\)): \(P_{out}=\int\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{2\pi}}Q^2\big(\tfrac{\Delta+b\sigma u}{|a|\sigma}\big)e^{-u^2/2}du\), which is the required result.

一句话记住：先固定共享变量 → 条件独立，相乘 → 按它的 PDF 积分 → 换元 u = y/σ。Practice 4 第 2(c) 题是同一套路的离散版。
◆ 本题知识点
考什么
宏分集的中断概率：独立阴影和相关阴影两种情况；条件概率 + 全概率（第 2 章 p.12–15；第 4 章 p.3–4、p.21）。
前置知识
独立事件概率相乘；独立高斯的线性组合仍是高斯，aY₁ + bY ~ N(0, (a² + b²)σ²)；全概率的连续形式 P(A) = ∫P(A | y)p(y)dy。
解题套路
(b) 每个基站单独中断 P(Zi < −Δ) = Q(Δ/σ)，独立 → 平方。(c) 先固定两条链路共享的 Y（"条件化"），这时两条链路独立 → 条件中断概率相乘 → 再按 Y 的 PDF 积分。
关键一步
令 Y = σu，u ~ N(0, 1)。给定 u：Zi ~ N(bσu, a²σ²)，P(Zi < −Δ | u) = Q((Δ + bσu)/(|a|σ))。
隐含条件
要和"Zi ~ N(0, σ²)"一致，需要 a² + b² = 1。此时 Z₁、Z₂ 的相关系数等于 b²：b 越大，两条链路越像。
自检
b = 0 时退化成 (b) 的 [Q(Δ/σ)]²；a = 0（完全相关）时两条链路一模一样，Pout = Q(Δ/σ)，分集完全没用。
联系
Practice 4 第 1 题用文字解释同一件事；第 4 章 p.21"相关削弱分集"；Practice 4 第 2(c) 题是离散版本的共享阴影。
▶ Lecturer's emphasis in class · Part 2 Week 10 recording
  • The lecturer's method: when two random variables appear together, first treat one of them as a constant, so only one random variable is left, and find the intermediate result; then turn it back into a random variable and integrate over its PDF. The last step is the substitution u = y/σ.老师讲的方法：两个随机变量同时出现时，先把其中一个当成常数，只剩一个随机变量，求出中间结果；再把它变回随机变量，对它的 PDF 积分。最后一步是换元 u = y/σ。
Part 2 practice
P2 · Q3

Two users: interference as noise vs multi-user detection

Original question · bilingualPractice 2

Two users transmit simultaneously to a single receiver over an AWGN channel. The power received from each transmitter is 10mW. The total received noise power is 0.1mW. The channel bandwidth for each user is 20MHz.

两个用户通过 AWGN 信道同时向同一个接收机发送信号。来自每个发射机的接收功率都是 10 mW，总接收噪声功率为 0.1 mW，每个用户的信道带宽为 20 MHz。

(a) The receiver decodes user 1's signal first. In this decoding, user 2's signal behaves like noise (assume it is AWGN). What is the capacity of user 1's channel?

(a) 接收机先解码用户 1 的信号。解码时，用户 2 的信号相当于噪声（假设它是 AWGN）。用户 1 信道的容量是多少？

(b) After applying MUD, the decoder removes user 1's signal completely from the received signal. What is the capacity of user 2's channel?

(b) 采用多用户检测（MUD）后，解码器把用户 1 的信号从接收信号中完全去掉。用户 2 信道的容量是多少？

Shannon capacitySINRMUDCh. 1a of the notes p.16; Ch. 2 p.48
What the question is asking: what does this question actually want?

ScenarioWhat the question is about

Two users transmit at the same time, in the same band, to the same receiver (e.g. a base station). The receiver gets "user 1's signal + user 2's signal + noise" all mixed together.两个用户在同一时间、同一频段，向同一个接收机（比如基站）发信号。接收机收到的是"用户 1 的信号 + 用户 2 的信号 + 噪声"混在一起。

The channel is an AWGN channel (Additive White Gaussian Noise): the noise is simply added to the signal (additive), has the same power at all frequencies and is uncorrelated between time instants (white), and its amplitude is Gaussian with zero mean; there is no other impairment (no fading, no multipath). The Shannon formula C = B log₂(1 + SNR) holds for this channel.信道是 AWGN 信道（Additive White Gaussian Noise，加性高斯白噪声）：噪声直接加在信号上（加性），所有频率上功率一样、不同时刻互不相关（白），幅度服从均值 0 的高斯分布；除了这种噪声没有别的损伤（没有衰落、没有多径）。香农公式 C = B log₂(1 + SNR) 就是在这种信道下成立的。

SymbolsWhat each quantity in the question means

10 mWPower of each user at the receiver接收机收到的每个用户的功率
0.1 mWTotal noise power
20 MHzBandwidth of each user每个用户的带宽
SINRSignal / (interference + noise): the SNR when the other user is also treated as noise信号 /（干扰 + 噪声）：把别的用户也当成噪声时的信噪比
MUDMulti-user detection: decode one user first, subtract it from the received signal, then decode the next (successive interference cancellation, SIC)多用户检测（multi-user detection）：先解出一个用户，把它从接收信号里减掉，再解下一个（连续干扰消除 SIC）

What each part asksWhat each part is asking for

  • (a) Decode user 1 first. User 2's signal is still present, so it can only be treated as noise. What is user 1's capacity? The key is SINR = P₁ /(P₂ + N).(a) 先解用户 1。这时用户 2 的信号还在，只能把它当噪声。用户 1 的容量是多少？关键是 SINR = P₁ /(P₂ + N)。
  • (b) After user 1 is decoded and fully subtracted, decode user 2, which now sees only noise. What is user 2's capacity? SNR = P₂ / N.(b) 用户 1 解出来并完全减掉以后，再解用户 2，它只剩噪声。用户 2 的容量是多少？SNR = P₂ / N。

Watch outEasy ways to misread the question

  • The SNR in the Shannon formula is linear, not dB.香农公式里的 SNR 用线性值，不是 dB。
  • Use the same power unit for both (mW).两个功率单位要一致（都用 mW）。

PurposeWhat the question wants you to understand

Treating interference as noise is costly (with the same 10 mW, the capacity differs by several times); if you decode one user first and subtract it, the user decoded second sees the channel as if it had it to itself.把干扰当噪声代价很大（同样 10 mW，容量差了好几倍）；先解一个再减掉，后解的那个用户就像独占信道一样。

In one line: two users transmit together; (a) decode user 1 treating user 2 as noise, (b) subtract user 1 and then decode user 2; use the Shannon formula for each capacity.一句话：两个用户同时发，(a) 先解用户 1、把用户 2 当噪声，(b) 减掉用户 1 后再解用户 2，分别用香农公式求容量。
  1. Formula and data: Shannon capacity (Ch 2 p.48) \(C=B\log_2(1+\gamma)\) with γ as a linear ratio. With interference treated as noise, γ becomes the SINR (Ch 1a p.16): \[\text{SINR}=\frac{P}{N+I}\] Data (all powers in mW): P₁ = P₂ = 10 mW, N = 0.1 mW; B = 20 MHz = 20 × 10⁶ Hz.
  2. (a) SINR of user 1: when user 1 is decoded first, user 2 is still transmitting; the question says it behaves like AWGN, so it joins the noise (interference I = P₂): \[\text{SINR}_1=\frac{P_1}{P_2+N}=\frac{10}{10+0.1}=\frac{10}{10.1}=0.990\] This is a linear value (about −0.04 dB), not dB.
  3. (a) Capacity: \(\log_2x=\log_{10}x/\log_{10}2\) with \(\log_{10}2=0.30103\): \[\begin{aligned}\log_2 1.990&=\frac{\log_{10}1.990}{0.30103}=\frac{0.2989}{0.30103}\\&=0.993\\ C_1&=20\times10^6\times0.993\\&=19.86\times10^6\ \text{bit/s}=19.86\ \text{Mbps}\end{aligned}\]
  4. (b) SNR of user 2: MUD has decoded user 1 and removed it completely from the received signal, so only thermal noise is left when user 2 is decoded: \[\text{SNR}_2=\frac{P_2}{N}=\frac{10}{0.1}=100\quad(=20\ \text{dB})\]
  5. (b) Capacity: \[\begin{aligned}\log_2 101&=\frac{\log_{10}101}{0.30103}=\frac{2.0043}{0.30103}\\&=6.658\\ C_2&=20\times10^6\times6.658\\&=133.16\ \text{Mbps}\end{aligned}\] Dividing by 0.301 gives 6.659 and 133.18 Mbps; keep more digits (0.30103) or use the calculator's log₂ to match the official 133.16.
  6. Check: the sum of the two capacities \[\begin{aligned}C_1+C_2&=19.86+133.16=153.02\ \text{Mbps}\\&=20\log_2\Big(1+\frac{10+10}{0.1}\Big)\\&=20\times\log_2 201=20\times7.651\end{aligned}\] 20 × 7.651 = 153.02 ✓: with successive interference cancellation, the sum capacity equals the single-user capacity with the two powers combined. (b) is much larger than (a) because user 2 no longer faces 10 mW of interference, only 0.1 mW of noise.
(a) 19.86 Mbps; (b) 133.16 Mbps
Official answer: 19.86 Mbps; 133.16 Mbps ✓
Step by step: SNR, SIR, SINR, and why the denominator in (a) is 10 + 0.1

Three ratiosThey differ only in the denominator

MeasureDenominatorWhen used
SNR = S/NNoise onlySingle user, no interference (AWGN channel)
SIR = S/IInterference onlyInterference far above noise, noise negligible (Part A co-channel reuse)
SINR = S/(I + N)Interference + noiseThe general case where neither can be ignored

S is the wanted signal, I is the signal of other users or cells (interference), N is the receiver's thermal noise. SINR is the most complete: with I = 0 it becomes SNR, with N = 0 it becomes SIR, so SINR is smaller than both.

(a)Why the denominator is 10 + 0.1, not 0.1

Both users transmit at the same time on the same frequency, so the antenna receives the sum of user 1 (10 mW), user 2 (10 mW) and noise (0.1 mW). The receiver cannot "listen only to user 1".

ComponentPowerFor decoding user 1
User 1's signal10 mWWanted: numerator S
User 2's signal10 mWUnwanted: interference I
Thermal noise0.1 mWUnwanted: noise N

User 2's signal is useful to user 2, but for decoding user 1 it blurs the signal just like noise, and it is 100 times stronger than the noise. Everything unwanted goes in the denominator: SINR₁ = 10/(10 + 0.1) = 0.99. Writing only 0.1 (giving 100) pretends user 2 is silent and badly overestimates the capacity.

Analogy: listening to friend A in a noisy room, the air conditioner is the noise (small) and friend B talking loudly at the same time is the interference. B's voice, not the air conditioner, is the main obstacle.

(b)When the denominator is 0.1

MUD first decodes user 1 and subtracts it, leaving "user 2 + noise". When user 2 is decoded only noise remains, so SNR₂ = 10/0.1 = 100. Compare: (a) user 2 is still present when decoding user 1 → 10 + 0.1; (b) user 1 has been removed when decoding user 2 → 0.1.

ShannonWhy the formula says SNR but SINR is used here

Shannon's result is for the single-user AWGN channel y = x + w: one transmitter and Gaussian noise only, so I = 0 and SINR equals SNR. What the formula really needs is that everything in the denominator together is Gaussian noise. The question says user 2's signal behaves like noise (assume it is AWGN), so in \(y=x_1+(x_2+w)\) the term \(x_2+w\) is one larger Gaussian noise of 10 + 0.1 mW, and the formula still applies with N replaced by I + N.

CaseDenominatorFormula
Single user (Shannon's model)NB log₂(1 + SNR)
Interference treated as Gaussian noiseI + NB log₂(1 + SINR)

Inside the bracket it is always "wanted power / all power treated as noise". Treating interference as Gaussian noise gives a conservative capacity; MUD does better because it uses the fact that the interference is another user's data, decodes it and subtracts it.

ExamCompact answer

(a) When user 1 is decoded, user 2's signal is treated as AWGN, so it adds to the noise: SINR₁ = P₁/(P₂ + N) = 10/(10 + 0.1) = 0.990, C₁ = B log₂(1 + SINR₁) = 19.86 Mbps.

(b) After MUD removes user 1, only noise remains for user 2: SNR₂ = P₂/N = 10/0.1 = 100, C₂ = B log₂(1 + SNR₂) = 133.16 Mbps.

In one line: the denominator is the sum of all unwanted power. User 2 is still present when user 1 is decoded, so 10 + 0.1; after user 1 is subtracted, user 2 sees only the 0.1 mW noise.
◆ Key points
What it tests
Shannon capacity, SINR (interference treated as noise) and multi-user detection / successive interference cancellation (Ch 1a p.16; Ch 2 p.48).
Background
C = B log₂(1 + SNR) with SNR as a linear value; log₂x = ln x / ln 2 = log₁₀x / 0.301.
Method
(a) SINR₁ = P₁/(P₂ + N); (b) user 1 already subtracted, SNR₂ = P₂/N; substitute each into Shannon's formula.
Check
C₁ + C₂ = 19.86 + 133.16 = 153.02 Mbps = 20 log₂(1 + (10 + 10)/0.1): the sum capacity with successive cancellation equals the single-user capacity with the two powers combined, independent of the decoding order.
Common mistakes
SINR 0.990 is linear, not dB; log₂1.99 = 0.993; remember to multiply by the 20 MHz bandwidth; use the same unit (mW) for both powers.
Variations
Decoding user 2 first swaps the two results; the sum stays the same. Without MUD, each user treats the other as noise and the total is only 2 × 19.86 = 39.7 Mbps, less than a third of the MUD total. That is the value of multi-user detection.
  1. 公式与已知：香农容量（Shannon capacity，讲义第 2 章 p.48）\(C=B\log_2(1+\gamma)\)，γ 用线性比值。有干扰并把它当噪声时，γ 换成 SINR（讲义第 1a 章 p.16）： \[\text{SINR}=\frac{P}{N+I}\] 已知（功率统一用 mW）：P₁ = P₂ = 10 mW，N = 0.1 mW；B = 20 MHz = 20 × 10⁶ Hz。
  2. (a) 用户 1 的 SINR：先解用户 1 时用户 2 还在发，题目说它相当于 AWGN，所以并进噪声（干扰 I = P₂）： \[\text{SINR}_1=\frac{P_1}{P_2+N}=\frac{10}{10+0.1}=\frac{10}{10.1}=0.990\] 这是线性值（约 −0.04 dB），不是 dB。
  3. (a) 容量：\(\log_2x=\log_{10}x/\log_{10}2\)，\(\log_{10}2=0.30103\)： \[\begin{aligned}\log_2 1.990&=\frac{\log_{10}1.990}{0.30103}=\frac{0.2989}{0.30103}\\&=0.993\\ C_1&=20\times10^6\times0.993\\&=19.86\times10^6\ \text{bit/s}=19.86\ \text{Mbps}\end{aligned}\]
  4. (b) 用户 2 的 SNR：MUD 已经把用户 1 解出来，并从接收信号里完全减掉，解用户 2 时只剩热噪声： \[\text{SNR}_2=\frac{P_2}{N}=\frac{10}{0.1}=100\quad(=20\ \text{dB})\]
  5. (b) 容量： \[\begin{aligned}\log_2 101&=\frac{\log_{10}101}{0.30103}=\frac{2.0043}{0.30103}\\&=6.658\\ C_2&=20\times10^6\times6.658\\&=133.16\ \text{Mbps}\end{aligned}\] 除数取 0.301 会得到 6.659、133.18 Mbps；多保留几位（0.30103）或直接用计算器的 log₂，才和官方的 133.16 一致。
  6. 自检：两个用户的容量之和 \[\begin{aligned}C_1+C_2&=19.86+133.16=153.02\ \text{Mbps}\\&=20\log_2\Big(1+\frac{10+10}{0.1}\Big)\\&=20\times\log_2 201=20\times7.651\end{aligned}\] 20 × 7.651 = 153.02 ✓：连续干扰消除（successive interference cancellation）的总容量等于两个功率合起来的单用户容量。(b) 远大于 (a)，因为用户 2 不再受 10 mW 干扰，只受 0.1 mW 噪声。
(a) 19.86 Mbps；(b) 133.16 Mbps
官方答案：19.86 Mbps；133.16 Mbps ✓
逐步详解：SNR、SIR、SINR，为什么 (a) 的分母是 10 + 0.1

三个比值差别只在分母

指标分母什么时候用
SNR = S/N只有噪声单用户、没有干扰（AWGN 信道）
SIR = S/I只有干扰干扰远大于噪声，噪声可忽略（Part A 同频复用）
SINR = S/(I + N)干扰 + 噪声两者都不能忽略的一般情况

S 是想要的信号，I 是别的用户、别的小区的信号（干扰），N 是接收机的热噪声。SINR 最完整：I = 0 时就是 SNR，N = 0 时就是 SIR，所以 SINR 比两者都小。

(a)为什么分母是 10 + 0.1，不是 0.1

两个用户同时、同频发，接收机天线上收到的是三样东西加在一起：用户 1（10 mW）+ 用户 2（10 mW）+ 噪声（0.1 mW）。接收机没法"只听用户 1"。

成分功率对解用户 1 来说
用户 1 的信号10 mW有用的，分子 S
用户 2 的信号10 mW捣乱的，干扰 I
热噪声0.1 mW捣乱的，噪声 N

用户 2 的信号对它自己有用，但对"解用户 1"来说和噪声一样会把信号弄模糊，而且比噪声强 100 倍，是主要的捣乱者。分母要把所有捣乱的都算上：SINR₁ = 10 /(10 + 0.1) = 0.99。只写 0.1（得 100）等于假装用户 2 没在发，严重高估。

类比：在嘈杂的房间里听朋友 A 说话，空调声是噪声（很小），朋友 B 同时大声说话是干扰。妨碍你的不只是空调声，B 的声音才是主要障碍。

(b)什么时候分母才是 0.1

用 MUD 先把用户 1 解出来、从接收信号里减掉，剩下"用户 2 + 噪声"。解用户 2 时捣乱的只剩噪声，所以 SNR₂ = 10 / 0.1 = 100。对比：(a) 解用户 1 时用户 2 还在 → 10 + 0.1；(b) 解用户 2 时用户 1 已减掉 → 0.1。

香农公式为什么写 SNR，这里却用 SINR

香农推导的是单用户 AWGN 信道 y = x + w：一个发射机、只有高斯噪声，I = 0，SINR 就等于 SNR，所以公式写成 SNR。公式真正的要求是"分母里的东西整体是高斯噪声"。题目说 user 2's signal behaves like noise (assume it is AWGN)，于是 \(y=x_1+(x_2+w)\) 里的 \(x_2+w\) 就是一个功率 10 + 0.1 mW 的大高斯噪声，公式照用，只是 N 换成 I + N。

情况分母写法
只有一个用户（香农原始模型）NB log₂(1 + SNR)
有干扰，并当成高斯噪声I + NB log₂(1 + SINR)

括号里永远是"想要的功率 / 所有当作噪声处理的功率"。把干扰当高斯噪声算出的是保守的容量；MUD 利用"干扰其实是另一个用户的数据"把它解出来减掉，所以能做得更好。

考试英文写法

(a) When user 1 is decoded, user 2's signal is treated as AWGN, so it adds to the noise: SINR₁ = P₁/(P₂ + N) = 10/(10 + 0.1) = 0.990, C₁ = B log₂(1 + SINR₁) = 19.86 Mbps.

(b) After MUD removes user 1, only noise remains for user 2: SNR₂ = P₂/N = 10/0.1 = 100, C₂ = B log₂(1 + SNR₂) = 133.16 Mbps.

一句话：分母 = 所有不是你想要的功率之和。解用户 1 时用户 2 还在，所以是 10 + 0.1；减掉用户 1 后再解用户 2，只剩噪声 0.1。
◆ 本题知识点
考什么
香农容量、SINR（把干扰当噪声）、多用户检测 MUD / 连续干扰消除（第 1a 章 p.16；第 2 章 p.48）。
前置知识
C = B log₂(1 + SNR)，SNR 用线性值；log₂x = ln x / ln 2 = log₁₀x / 0.301。
解题套路
(a) SINR₁ = P₁/(P₂ + N)；(b) 用户 1 已被减掉，SNR₂ = P₂/N；分别代入香农公式。
检验
C₁ + C₂ = 19.86 + 133.16 = 153.02 Mbps = 20 log₂(1 + (10 + 10)/0.1)：连续消除的总容量等于两个用户功率合起来的单用户容量，和解码顺序无关。
易错
SINR 0.990 是线性值，不是 dB；log₂1.99 = 0.993；别忘了乘带宽 20 MHz；两个功率的单位要一致（都用 mW）。
举一反三
反过来先解用户 2，两个结果对调，总和不变。如果不用 MUD，两个用户都把对方当噪声，总容量只有 2 × 19.86 = 39.7 Mbps，不到 MUD 的 1/3，这就是多用户检测的价值。
Part 2 practice
Mock A · Q2

Simplified path loss model + shadowing: outage probability and maximum coverage distance

Original question · bilingualMock Quiz A (self-written)

A base station transmits 100 mW. Propagation follows the simplified path loss model \(P_r=P_tK(d_0/d)^{\gamma}\) with \(K_{dB}=-31.5\) dB, \(d_0=1\) m and \(\gamma=3.6\). The receiver needs a received power of at least −110 dBm to avoid outage. Log-normal shadowing with a standard deviation of 6 dB is present.

基站发射功率为 100 mW。传播服从简化路径损耗模型 \(P_r=P_tK(d_0/d)^{\gamma}\)，其中 \(K_{dB}=-31.5\) dB，\(d_0=1\) m，\(\gamma=3.6\)。接收功率至少要 −110 dBm 才不中断。存在对数正态阴影，标准差为 6 dB。

(a) Write the model in dB form and find the average received power at d = 300 m. (3 marks)

(a) 写出模型的 dB 形式，并求 d = 300 m 处的平均接收功率。（3 分）

(b) Find the outage probability at d = 300 m. (3 marks)

(b) 求 d = 300 m 处的中断概率。（3 分）

(c) Find the maximum distance at which the outage probability does not exceed 1%. (4 marks)

(c) 求中断概率不超过 1% 的最大距离。（4 分）

Simplified path loss model (memorise)P_out = Q(margin/σ) (memorise)Inverse Q-function lookupCh. 2 of the notes, p.8, p.12–16
What the question is asking: what does this question actually want?

ScenarioWhat the question is about

The base station transmits 100 mW. The signal decays with distance (simplified path loss model), with random shadowing on top. The phone needs at least −110 dBm to communicate.基站以 100 mW 发射，信号随距离衰减（简化路径损耗模型），再叠加随机的阴影起伏。手机要收到至少 −110 dBm 才能通信。

The question first asks for the average received power and the outage probability at 300 m, then works backwards: if the outage probability must not exceed 1%, how far away can the phone be?题目先问 300 m 处平均能收到多少、断线概率多大，再反过来问：要让断线概率不超过 1%，手机最远能离多远。

SymbolsWhat each quantity in the question means

100 mWTransmit power; convert it to 20 dBm first发射功率，先换成 20 dBm
\(K_{dB}=-31.5\) dB, \(d_0=1\) mModel constant and reference distance模型常数和参考距离
γ = 3.6Path loss exponent: every 10× increase in distance adds 36 dB of loss路径损耗指数：距离每大 10 倍，多损耗 36 dB
−110 dBmThreshold: below it you are in outage门限：低于它就中断
σ = 6 dBStandard deviation of the shadowing阴影的标准差

What each part asksWhat each part is asking for

  • (a) Write the model in dB form and substitute d = 300 m to get the average received power.(a) 写出模型的 dB 形式，代 d = 300 m 求平均接收功率。
  • (b) Find how far the average power is above the threshold (the margin), then the probability that shadowing pulls the power down by more than the margin: Q(margin/σ).(b) 平均功率比门限高多少（余量），再求阴影把功率压低超过余量的概率：Q(余量/σ)。
  • (c) Work backwards: what margin gives outage ≤ 1%, what minimum average power that requires, and the corresponding maximum distance.(c) 反过来：中断 ≤ 1% 需要多大的余量，平均功率至少多大，对应的距离最远多少。

Watch outEasy ways to misread the question

  • Convert 100 mW to dBm first; the lecturer said you lose marks if you don't.100 mW 要先换成 dBm，老师说没换会扣分。
  • (c) is an inverse Q lookup: Q(x) = 0.01 → x = 2.326.

PurposeWhat the question wants you to understand

Path loss sets the average power; shadowing sets the fluctuation around that average. The outage probability depends only on "how many standard deviations the margin is". The coverage distance is found by inverting this relation.路径损耗决定平均功率，阴影决定围绕平均值的起伏；中断概率只取决于"余量是几个标准差"。覆盖距离就是由这个关系反推出来的。

In one line: use the path loss model to find the average power and outage probability at 300 m, then invert it to find the maximum coverage distance for outage ≤ 1%.一句话：用路径损耗模型算 300 m 处的平均功率和中断概率，再反推中断 ≤ 1% 时的最大覆盖距离。

Approach: Convert mW to dBm and use the dB form for the average received power. The amount by which the average exceeds the threshold is the margin, and outage = Q(margin/σ). For (c), work backwards: 1% → inverse Q → required margin → distance.

  1. Units first: in the dB form the powers must be in dBm: \(P_t=10\log_{10}\dfrac{100\text{ mW}}{1\text{ mW}}=10\times2=20\) dBm (leaving it in mW loses marks).
  2. (a) dB form: take \(10\log_{10}\) of both sides of \(P_r=P_tK(d_0/d)^{\gamma}\); products become sums and the power becomes a factor (Ch 2 p.8): \[\begin{aligned}P_{r,dBm}&=P_{t,dBm}+K_{dB}-10\gamma\log_{10}\frac{d}{d_0}\\&=20-31.5-36\log_{10}d\end{aligned}\] Here \(10\gamma=10\times3.6=36\); d₀ = 1 m, so d is entered directly in metres.
  3. (a) Substitute d = 300 m: \(\log_{10}300=2.477\): \[\begin{aligned}P_r(300\text{ m})&=20-31.5-36\times2.477\\&=20-31.5-89.18\\&=-100.68\text{ dBm}\end{aligned}\] This is the average due to path loss alone; shadowing makes the actual power fluctuate around it.
  4. (b) Margin: outage means the received power is below −110 dBm. The amount by which the average power exceeds the threshold is the margin: \[x=\bar P_r-P_{min}=-100.68-(-110)=9.32\text{ dB}\] The shadowing is \(\psi_{dB}\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2)\), so \(P_{out}=P(\psi_{dB}\lt-x)=Q(x/\sigma)\) (p.14–15).
  5. (b) Q table: \(x/\sigma=9.32/6=1.553\). From the Q table, Q(1.55) = 0.0606 and Q(1.56) = 0.0594; 1.553 lies between them, so interpolate: \[\begin{aligned}P_{out}=Q(1.553)&\approx0.0606-0.3\times0.0012\\&\approx0.060\end{aligned}\] About 6.0%. Check: 1 < 1.553 < 2, so the result must lie between Q(1) = 0.159 and Q(2) = 0.023 ✓.
  6. (c) Inverse Q lookup: we need \(Q(x/\sigma)\le0.01\). Q decreases as its argument grows, so the margin must be large enough. From the Q table, Q(2.32) = 0.0102 and Q(2.33) = 0.0099, giving \(Q^{-1}(0.01)=2.326\): \[\begin{aligned}x&\ge2.326\times6=13.96\text{ dB}\\ \bar P_r&\ge-110+13.96=-96.04\text{ dBm}\end{aligned}\]
  7. (c) Solve for the distance: put the expression from (a) into the inequality and rearrange: \[\begin{aligned}20-31.5-36\log_{10}d&\ge-96.04\\36\log_{10}d&\le20-31.5+96.04\\&=84.54\\ \log_{10}d&\le84.54/36=2.348\\ d&\le10^{2.348}\approx223\text{ m}\end{aligned}\] Check: put d = 223 m back: \[\begin{aligned}P_r(223\text{ m})&=20-31.5-36\log_{10}223\\&=-11.5-84.54=-96.04\text{ dBm}\ \checkmark\end{aligned}\] and 223 m < 300 m agrees with the 6% > 1% outage found at 300 m in (b) ✓.
(a) Pr,dB = Pt,dB + KdB − 36 log₁₀d, ≈ −100.7 dBm at 300 m; (b) Pout ≈ 6.0%; (c) dmax ≈ 223 m
Official answer: none (self-written mock question); all numbers checked by src/p2build/verify_mock.py
At 300 m the outage is 6%, far above the usual 1% target. To reach 1%, either shrink the coverage radius to about 223 m or raise the transmit power by 13.96 − 9.32 = 4.64 dB.
Step by step: dB versus dBm, and the unit of every quantity

DifferencedBm is "how much", dB is "how many times"

dBdBm
MeaningRatio of two powers, no unitAbsolute power, referenced to 1 mW
Definition10 log₁₀(P₁/P₂)10 log₁₀(P / 1 mW)
Examples×100 = +20 dB; down to 1/1000 = −30 dB100 mW = 20 dBm; 1 mW = 0 dBm

KWhy K is in dB, not dBm

In the linear form \(P_r=P_t\cdot K\cdot(d_0/d)^{\gamma}\), \(P_r\) and \(P_t\) are powers (mW) while K and \((d_0/d)^{\gamma}\) are unitless factors multiplying the power. K means "how many times the transmit power is received at the reference distance d₀", a ratio, so in log form it is in dB. \(K_{dB}=-31.5\) dB means the signal at 1 m is \(10^{-3.15}\approx1/1400\) of the transmit power.

Taking dB turns products into sums; only \(P_t\) is in dBm and everything else is in dB, so the result is in dBm:

\[\underbrace{P_{r,dBm}}_{\text{dBm}}=\underbrace{P_{t,dBm}}_{\text{dBm}}+\underbrace{K_{dB}}_{\text{dB}}-\underbrace{10\gamma\log_{10}(d/d_0)}_{\text{dB}}\]
OperationResultMeaning
dBm + dBdBmA power times a factor is still a power
dBm − dBmdBA ratio of two powers (margin, SNR)
dB + dBdBA factor times a factor is still a factor
dBm + dBmMeaninglessPower times power is not a power

Check: if K were in dBm, the right-hand side would be dBm + dBm, i.e. "power × power", which has no physical meaning.

HereUnit of each quantity

QuantityValueUnit
Transmit power100 mW = 20dBm (absolute power)
K−31.5dB (ratio)
Path loss term 36 log₁₀30089.18dB (ratio)
Average received power−100.68dBm
Threshold−110dBm
Margin = received power − threshold9.32dB (dBm − dBm)
Shadowing standard deviation σ6dB (a fluctuation about the mean, also a ratio)

Practice 1 Q2 writes σ in "dBm"; strictly it should be dB.

In one line: dBm is an absolute power, dB is a ratio. In the path loss model only the transmit and received powers are in dBm; K, path loss, shadowing and margin are all in dB.
◆ Key points
What it tests
dB form of the simplified path loss model (memorise), shadowing outage Pout = Q(margin/σ) (memorise), inverse Q lookup (Ch 2 p.8, p.12–16).
Background
Pr,dB = Pt,dB + KdB − 10γ log₁₀(d/d₀); mW → dBm: 10 log₁₀(value in mW); Q(2.326) = 0.01.
Method
① Convert units; ② average power from the model; ③ margin = average − threshold; ④ Pout = Q(margin/σ). For the distance, reverse it: outage target → inverse Q → margin = xσ → minimum average power → solve for d.
Key step
(c) Margin 13.96 dB → average power ≥ −96.04 dBm → 36 log₁₀d ≤ 84.54 → d ≤ 223 m.
Common mistakes
Using 100 mW without converting to 20 dBm (loses marks); 10γ = 36, not 3.6; Q takes margin over σ, not over σ².
Variations
Required transmit power for a given distance; or the largest allowed σ for a given outage (asked in 2023-24 S2 Q1(a)(ii)).
Link
Practice 1 Q2 (outage forwards and backwards); Practice 1 Q1 (b).

思路：先把 mW 换成 dBm，用 dB 形式算平均接收功率；平均功率比门限高出的部分就是余量，中断概率 = Q(余量/σ)；(c) 反过来：由 1% 反查 Q 得到需要的余量，再解出距离。

  1. 换单位：dB 形式里功率要用 dBm：\(P_t=10\log_{10}\dfrac{100\text{ mW}}{1\text{ mW}}=10\times2=20\) dBm（没换成 dBm 会扣分）。
  2. (a) 写成 dB 形式：对 \(P_r=P_tK(d_0/d)^{\gamma}\) 两边取 \(10\log_{10}\)，乘法变加法、幂次变成系数（讲义第 2 章 p.8）： \[\begin{aligned}P_{r,dBm}&=P_{t,dBm}+K_{dB}-10\gamma\log_{10}\frac{d}{d_0}\\&=20-31.5-36\log_{10}d\end{aligned}\] 其中 \(10\gamma=10\times3.6=36\)；d₀ = 1 m，所以 d 直接用米代入。
  3. (a) 代入 d = 300 m：\(\log_{10}300=2.477\)： \[\begin{aligned}P_r(300\text{ m})&=20-31.5-36\times2.477\\&=20-31.5-89.18\\&=-100.68\text{ dBm}\end{aligned}\] 这是只有路径损耗时的平均值，阴影会让实际功率围绕它上下波动。
  4. (b) 余量：中断 = 接收功率低于 −110 dBm。平均功率比门限高出的部分叫余量（margin）： \[x=\bar P_r-P_{min}=-100.68-(-110)=9.32\text{ dB}\] 阴影 \(\psi_{dB}\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2)\)，所以 \(P_{out}=P(\psi_{dB}\lt-x)=Q(x/\sigma)\)（p.14–15）。
  5. (b) 查 Q 表：\(x/\sigma=9.32/6=1.553\)。Q 表：Q(1.55) = 0.0606，Q(1.56) = 0.0594，1.553 在两者之间，插值： \[\begin{aligned}P_{out}=Q(1.553)&\approx0.0606-0.3\times0.0012\\&\approx0.060\end{aligned}\] 约 6.0%。自检：1 < 1.553 < 2，结果应在 Q(1) = 0.159 和 Q(2) = 0.023 之间 ✓。
  6. (c) 反查 Q 表：要求 \(Q(x/\sigma)\le0.01\)。Q 函数随自变量增大而减小，所以余量要足够大。Q 表：Q(2.32) = 0.0102，Q(2.33) = 0.0099，得 \(Q^{-1}(0.01)=2.326\)： \[\begin{aligned}x&\ge2.326\times6=13.96\text{ dB}\\ \bar P_r&\ge-110+13.96=-96.04\text{ dBm}\end{aligned}\]
  7. (c) 解距离：把 (a) 的式子代进不等式，移项： \[\begin{aligned}20-31.5-36\log_{10}d&\ge-96.04\\36\log_{10}d&\le20-31.5+96.04\\&=84.54\\ \log_{10}d&\le84.54/36=2.348\\ d&\le10^{2.348}\approx223\text{ m}\end{aligned}\] 自检：代回 d = 223 m： \[\begin{aligned}P_r(223\text{ m})&=20-31.5-36\log_{10}223\\&=-11.5-84.54=-96.04\text{ dBm}\ \checkmark\end{aligned}\] 而且 223 m < 300 m，和 (b) 里 300 m 处中断 6% > 1% 一致 ✓。
(a) P_r,dB = P_t,dB + K_dB − 36 log₁₀d，300 m 处 ≈ −100.7 dBm；(b) P_out ≈ 6.0%；(c) d_max ≈ 223 m
官方答案：无（自编模拟题）。所有数字已用 src/p2build/verify_mock.py 验算。
300 m 处中断 6%，远高于 1% 的常用目标。要压到 1%，要么把覆盖半径缩到约 223 m，要么把发射功率提高 13.96 − 9.32 = 4.64 dB。
逐步详解：dB 和 dBm，每个量是什么单位

区别dBm 是"有多少"，dB 是"变了多少倍"

dBdBm
表示什么两个功率的比值（倍数），没有单位绝对功率，以 1 mW 为参考
定义10 log₁₀(P₁/P₂)10 log₁₀(P / 1 mW)
例子放大 100 倍 = +20 dB；衰减到 1/1000 = −30 dB100 mW = 20 dBm；1 mW = 0 dBm

K为什么是 dB，不是 dBm

线性式 \(P_r=P_t\cdot K\cdot(d_0/d)^{\gamma}\) 里，\(P_r\)、\(P_t\) 是功率（mW），K 和 \((d_0/d)^{\gamma}\) 是乘在功率上的倍数，没有单位。K 的意思是"在参考距离 d₀ 处，接收功率是发射功率的多少倍"，所以是比值，取对数后是 dB。\(K_{dB}=-31.5\) dB 表示 1 m 处信号衰减到发射功率的 \(10^{-3.15}\approx1/1400\)。

取 dB 后乘法变加法，只有 \(P_t\) 带 dBm，其余都是 dB，结果自然是 dBm：

\[\underbrace{P_{r,dBm}}_{\text{dBm}}=\underbrace{P_{t,dBm}}_{\text{dBm}}+\underbrace{K_{dB}}_{\text{dB}}-\underbrace{10\gamma\log_{10}(d/d_0)}_{\text{dB}}\]
运算结果意思
dBm + dBdBm功率乘一个倍数，还是功率
dBm − dBmdB两个功率相除得倍数（余量、SNR）
dB + dBdB倍数乘倍数，还是倍数
dBm + dBm没有意义功率乘功率不是功率

反过来验证：如果 K 也是 dBm，右边就成了 dBm + dBm，相当于"功率 × 功率"，没有物理意义。

Discrete delay profile, Doppler, fading type and AFD
