Mock C · Q3

SNR, SIR, SINR, interference cancellation, and outage capacity of a Rayleigh channel

Original question · bilingualMock Quiz C (self-written)

A user's received signal power is 2 mW over a bandwidth of 10 MHz. Co-channel interference from a neighbouring cell arrives with a power of 0.5 mW, and the noise power is 0.05 mW. Treat the interference as Gaussian noise.

某用户在 10 MHz 带宽内的接收信号功率为 2 mW。邻区的同频干扰功率为 0.5 mW，噪声功率为 0.05 mW。把干扰当作高斯噪声处理。

(a) Find the SNR, the SIR and the SINR (in dB), and the Shannon capacity of the link. (4 marks)

(a) 求 SNR、SIR 和 SINR（用 dB 表示），以及该链路的香农容量。（4 分）

(b) An interference canceller removes the interference completely. Find the new capacity. (2 marks)

(b) 干扰消除器把干扰完全去掉，求新的容量。（2 分）

(c) In another cell there is no interference, but the link experiences Rayleigh fading with an average SNR of 20 dB. The capacity that can be maintained with outage probability ε is \(C_\varepsilon=B\log_2\!\big[1+\bar\gamma\ln\frac{1}{1-\varepsilon}\big]\). Find Cε for ε = 1% and compare it with the capacity of an AWGN channel with the same 20 dB SNR. (4 marks)

(c) 另一个小区没有干扰，但链路经历瑞利衰落，平均 SNR 为 20 dB。在中断概率 ε 下能维持的容量为 \(C_\varepsilon=B\log_2\!\big[1+\bar\gamma\ln\frac{1}{1-\varepsilon}\big]\)。求 ε = 1% 时的 Cε，并和同样 20 dB SNR 的 AWGN 信道容量比较。（4 分）

SNR / SIR / SINRShannon capacity (memorise)Outage capacityCh. 2 of the notes, p.48–51
What the question is asking: what does this question actually want?

ScenarioWhat the question is about

A user suffers from both interference from a neighbouring cell and noise. First compare the three ratios SNR, SIR and SINR and find the capacity; then see how much cancelling the interference gains.一个用户同时受到邻区干扰和噪声的影响，先比较 SNR、SIR、SINR 三个比值，算出容量；再看把干扰消掉能提升多少。

Finally, a different scenario: no interference, but Rayleigh fading. If 1% outage is allowed, what capacity can be guaranteed, and how far is it from the no-fading case?最后换一个场景：没有干扰但有瑞利衰落，问在允许 1% 中断的前提下，能保证的容量有多大，和没有衰落时差多少。

SymbolsWhat each quantity in the question means

2 mWDesired signal power S想要的信号功率 S
0.5 mWCo-channel interference power I同频干扰功率 I
0.05 mWNoise power N
CεOutage capacity: the rate that can be guaranteed for the rest of the time when outage is allowed for a fraction ε of the time (the formula is given in the question)中断容量：允许 ε 的时间中断时，剩下的时间里能保证的速率（公式题目给了）
γ̄ = 20 dBAverage SNR of the Rayleigh channel瑞利信道的平均 SNR

What each part asksWhat each part is asking for

  • (a) Compute the three ratios (denominators N, I and I + N) and convert them to dB. Treat the interference as Gaussian noise and use the SINR in Shannon's formula.(a) 算三个比值（分母分别是 N、I、I + N）并换成 dB；干扰当高斯噪声，香农公式用 SINR。
  • (b) With the interference fully cancelled, only noise remains in the denominator; recompute the capacity using the SNR.(b) 干扰被完全消掉，分母只剩噪声，用 SNR 重新算容量。
  • (c) First compute γ̄ ln(1/(1 − ε)) from the formula (the minimum SNR when 1% outage is allowed), then substitute into Shannon's formula; compare with the AWGN capacity at the same 20 dB, B log₂(1 + γ̄).(c) 先算公式里的 γ̄ ln(1/(1 − ε))（就是允许 1% 中断时的最小 SNR），再代香农；和同样 20 dB 的 AWGN 容量 B log₂(1 + γ̄) 比较。

Watch outEasy ways to misread the question

  • With interference, use the SINR in Shannon's formula, not the SNR.有干扰时香农公式里用 SINR，不是 SNR。
  • The ln in (c) is the natural log; convert 20 dB to 100 first.(c) 里的 ln 是自然对数，20 dB 先换成 100。

PurposeWhat the question wants you to understand

When interference is much larger than noise, the system is "interference-limited" and cancelling the interference gains the most. Rayleigh fading needs a margin for the worst moments, so the capacity you can guarantee is far below the capacity at the average SNR.干扰比噪声大得多时系统是"干扰受限"的，消掉干扰收益最大；瑞利衰落要为最坏的时刻留余量，能保证的容量远低于平均 SNR 对应的容量。

In one line: compare SNR, SIR and SINR and find the Shannon capacity, see how much the capacity rises when the interference is cancelled, then find the capacity of a Rayleigh channel at 1% outage and compare it with AWGN.一句话：比较 SNR、SIR、SINR 并求香农容量，看消掉干扰后容量提升多少，再求瑞利信道 1% 中断时的容量并和 AWGN 比较。

Approach: The three ratios differ only in the denominator; with interference treated as Gaussian noise, Shannon's formula uses the SINR; in (c) the formula is given, and \(\bar\gamma\ln\frac{1}{1-\varepsilon}\) is just the minimum SNR obtained by inverting the Rayleigh outage formula.

  1. (a) The three ratios (linear): all have the signal power on top and differ only in the denominator: \[\begin{aligned}\mathrm{SNR}&=\frac SN=\frac{2}{0.05}=40\\ \mathrm{SIR}&=\frac SI=\frac{2}{0.5}=4\\ \mathrm{SINR}&=\frac{S}{I+N}=\frac{2}{0.5+0.05}=\frac{2}{0.55}=3.64\end{aligned}\] All are mW / mW, so they have no unit.
  2. (a) Convert to dB: \(10\log_{10}40=16.0\) dB, \(10\log_{10}4=6.0\) dB, \(10\log_{10}3.64=5.6\) dB. Check: the SINR has the largest denominator, so it is the smallest: 5.6 dB < 6.0 dB < 16.0 dB ✓.
  3. (a) Capacity: with the interference treated as Gaussian noise, the total "noise" is I + N, so Shannon's formula (Ch 2 p.48) uses the SINR: \[\begin{aligned}\log_2(1+3.64)&=\frac{\log_{10}4.64}{0.301}=\frac{0.666}{0.301}=2.213\\C&=10\times10^6\times2.213=22.1\text{ Mbps}\end{aligned}\]
  4. (b) Interference removed: only the noise remains, so use SNR = 40: \[\begin{aligned}\log_2(1+40)&=\frac{\log_{10}41}{0.301}=\frac{1.613}{0.301}=5.358\\C&=10\times10^6\times5.358=53.6\text{ Mbps}\end{aligned}\] That is 53.6 / 22.1 = 2.42 times the value in (a).
  5. (c) Minimum SNR: \(\bar\gamma=10^{20/10}=100\). The term \(\bar\gamma\ln\frac1{1-\varepsilon}\) in the given formula is γmin obtained by inverting the Rayleigh CDF \(1-e^{-\gamma_{min}/\bar\gamma}=\varepsilon\) (p.50–51): \[\begin{aligned}\ln\frac1{1-0.01}&=\ln\frac1{0.99}=0.01005\\ \gamma_{min}&=100\times0.01005=1.005\end{aligned}\] i.e. \(10\log_{10}1.005=0.02\) dB, about 0 dB.
  6. (c) Outage capacity: \[\begin{aligned}C_\varepsilon&=10\times10^6\times\log_2(1+1.005)\\&=10\times10^6\times\frac{\log_{10}2.005}{0.301}\\&=10\times10^6\times\frac{0.3021}{0.301}=10\times10^6\times1.004\\&=10.0\text{ Mbps}\end{aligned}\]
  7. (c) Comparison with AWGN: an AWGN channel with the same 20 dB always has SNR 100: \[\begin{aligned}C_{AWGN}&=10\times10^6\times\frac{\log_{10}101}{0.301}\\&=10\times10^6\times6.658=66.6\text{ Mbps}\end{aligned}\] \(66.6/10.0=6.6\) times more. Reason: to stay out of outage 99% of the time, the Rayleigh link must set its rate by the minimum SNR (about 0 dB). Check: \(\bar\gamma_{dB}-\gamma_{min,dB}=20-0.02=19.98\) dB, exactly the 20 dB fade margin for ε = 1% on p.51 ✓ (same as Mock B Q1 (b)).
(a) SNR 16.0 dB, SIR 6.0 dB, SINR 5.6 dB, C ≈ 22.1 Mbps; (b) C ≈ 53.6 Mbps; (c) Cε ≈ 10.0 Mbps, far below the 66.6 Mbps of the AWGN channel
Official answer: none (self-written mock question); all numbers checked by src/p2build/verify_mock.py
The interference (0.5 mW) is 10 times the noise (0.05 mW), so SINR ≈ SIR: the system is interference-limited, and lowering the noise further barely helps; the interference must be reduced. The SINR is always smaller than both the SNR and the SIR.
Concept + step by step: SINR, Shannon capacity, Rayleigh outage capacity知识讲解 + 详细解析：SINR、香农容量与瑞利中断容量

ConceptSNR, SIR, SINR: only the denominator differs

All three ratios have the useful signal power S on top; the denominators differ:三个比值的分子都是有用信号功率 S，分母不同：

NameDefinitionWhat is in the denominator分母里有什么When to use it什么时候用
SNR (signal-to-noise ratio)S/Nnoise only只有噪声no interference, or the interference has been cancelled没有干扰，或干扰已被消除
SIR (signal-to-interference ratio)S/Iinterference only只有干扰cellular planning, when noise is negligible蜂窝规划，噪声可忽略时
SINR (signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio)S/(I + N)interference + noise干扰 + 噪声both present, interference treated as noise两者都有，把干扰当噪声处理时

SINR is defined on Ch 1a p.16 ("Interference: Friend or Foe?"): when interference is treated as noise it is a "foe", and SINR is used. The lecturer said Ch 1a is not examined, but Practice 2 Q3 needs this definition. A handy relation: 1/SINR = 1/SNR + 1/SIR, so SINR is always smaller than both SNR and SIR.SINR 的定义在讲义第 1a 章 p.16（"Interference: Friend or Foe?"）：干扰当噪声处理时是"敌人"，就用 SINR。第 1a 章老师说不考，但这个定义 Practice 2 第 3 题要用。一个好用的关系：1/SINR = 1/SNR + 1/SIR，所以 SINR 一定比 SNR 和 SIR 都小。

ConceptShannon capacity

Ch 2 p.48: the capacity of an AWGN channel is C = B log₂(1 + γ) (bit/s), where γ is the received SNR (linear value) and B the bandwidth. Meaning: if the rate R < C, codes exist that make the error probability arbitrarily small; if R > C, this is impossible. The lecturer said this is the most basic formula of a communication engineer and must be memorised. When interference is treated as Gaussian noise it is no different from noise, so γ becomes the SINR.讲义第 2 章 p.48：AWGN 信道的容量 C = B log₂(1 + γ)（bit/s），γ 是接收 SNR（线性值），B 是带宽。意义：传输速率 R < C 时，存在编码能让误码率任意小；R > C 时做不到。老师说这是通信工程师最基本的公式，必须背。干扰被当成高斯噪声时，它和噪声没有区别，γ 就换成 SINR。

Calculator hint: log₂x = log₁₀x / 0.301; dB → linear: 10^(dB/10). With B in MHz, C comes out in Mbps.计算器提示：log₂x = log₁₀x / 0.301；dB → 线性：10^(dB/10)。B 用 MHz 代入，C 的单位就是 Mbps。

Step by step(a) The three ratios and the capacity

SNR = 2 / 0.05 = 40 → 10 log₁₀40 = 16.0 dB
SIR = 2 / 0.5 = 4 → 10 log₁₀4 = 6.0 dB
SINR = 2 / (0.5 + 0.05) = 2 / 0.55 = 3.64 → 10 log₁₀3.64 = 5.6 dB
Check: 1/40 + 1/4 = 0.025 + 0.25 = 0.275 = 1/3.64
C = 10 MHz × log₂(1 + 3.64) = 10 × (log₁₀4.64 / 0.301) = 10 × 2.213 = 22.1 Mbps

Why SINR: the question says "treat the interference as Gaussian noise", so the "noise" the receiver sees is I + N. All powers are in mW and the units cancel in the ratios, so there is no need to convert to W.为什么用 SINR：题目说"把干扰当高斯噪声"，那接收机看到的"噪声"就是 I + N。功率都是 mW，相除后单位消掉，不用换成 W。

Step by step(b) Interference completely removed

Only noise is left, so use SNR = 40: C = 10 × log₂41 = 10 × 5.358 = 53.6 Mbps
53.6 / 22.1 ≈ 2.4 times

Why such a big jump: the interference (0.5 mW) is 10 times the noise (0.05 mW), so SINR ≈ SIR; such a system is interference-limited. Compare: halving the noise gives SINR = 2/0.525 and C only rises to 22.7 Mbps; halving the interference gives SINR = 2/0.3 and C rises to 29.4 Mbps. To raise the capacity, deal with the interference (interference cancellation, multi-user detection MUD, sectoring, etc.).为什么提升这么大：干扰 0.5 mW 是噪声 0.05 mW 的 10 倍，SINR ≈ SIR，这种系统叫干扰受限（interference-limited）。对比一下：噪声减半，SINR = 2/0.525，C 只到 22.7 Mbps；干扰减半，SINR = 2/0.3，C 升到 29.4 Mbps。要提升容量，就要对付干扰（干扰消除、多用户检测 MUD、扇区化等）。

ConceptFading channels: ergodic capacity and outage capacity

In a fading channel the SNR γ is a random variable (the lecturer stressed that this runs through Ch 2–7). The slides give two capacities:衰落信道里 SNR γ 是随机变量（老师强调这一点贯穿第 2–7 章）。讲义给了两种容量：

  • Ergodic capacity (p.49): the average of B log₂(1 + γ). By Jensen's inequality it cannot exceed the AWGN capacity with the same average SNR (the lecturer said only the concept of Jensen is required).遍历容量（ergodic capacity，p.49）：对 B log₂(1 + γ) 求平均。由 Jensen 不等式，它不会超过同样平均 SNR 的 AWGN 容量（老师说 Jensen 只要求懂概念）。
  • Outage capacity (p.50, for slow fading): allow outage a fraction ε of the time and guarantee the rate Cε = B log₂(1 + γmin) the rest of the time, where P(γ < γmin) = ε.中断容量（outage capacity，p.50，适用于慢衰落）：允许 ε 的时间中断，其余时间保证速率 Cε = B log₂(1 + γmin)，γmin 满足 P(γ < γmin) = ε。

For Rayleigh fading, P(γ < γmin) = 1 − e−γmin/γ̄ (the Rayleigh outage formula, memorise). Setting it equal to ε gives γmin = γ̄ ln(1/(1 − ε)) (p.51); substituting into Shannon gives the Cε in the question. Slide p.51 also says: the fade margin needed to reach the same capacity as AWGN is 10 log₁₀[1/ln(1/(1 − ε))], which is 20 dB for ε = 1%.瑞利衰落时 P(γ < γmin) = 1 − e−γmin/γ̄（必背的瑞利中断公式）。令它等于 ε，解出 γmin = γ̄ ln(1/(1 − ε))（p.51），代进香农公式就是题目给的 Cε。p.51 还说：和 AWGN 达到同样容量需要的衰落余量（fade margin）= 10 log₁₀[1/ln(1/(1 − ε))]，ε = 1% 时是 20 dB。

Step by step(c) Substituting step by step

  1. dB to linear: γ̄ = 10^(20/10) = 100.dB 换线性：γ̄ = 10^(20/10) = 100。
  2. Find γmin; ln is the natural logarithm. 求 γmin：ln 是自然对数。
    ln(1/0.99) = 0.01005
    γmin = 100 × 0.01005 = 1.005 (about 0.02 dB, i.e. about 0 dB)
  3. Into Shannon: 代香农：
    Cε = 10 × log₂(1 + 1.005) = 10 × log₂2.005 = 10 × 1.004 = 10.0 Mbps
  4. Compare with AWGN: 和 AWGN 比：
    CAWGN = 10 × log₂(1 + 100) = 10 × 6.658 = 66.6 Mbps
    66.6 / 10.0 ≈ 6.6 times
    fade margin = 20 − 0.02 = 19.98 ≈ 20 dB

Why the gap is so large: to avoid outage 99% of the time, the rate must be set by an SNR near the "worst 1%" (about 0 dB), about 20 dB below the average. For small ε, ln(1/(1 − ε)) ≈ ε, so γmin ≈ γ̄ ε: ε = 1% means 20 dB lower. Slide p.50 also gives the "average rate without errors" (1 − ε)Cε = 0.99 × 10.04 = 9.94 Mbps.为什么差这么多：要保证 99% 的时间都不中断，只能按"最差的 1%"附近的 SNR（约 0 dB）来定速率，比平均 SNR 低约 20 dB。ε 很小时 ln(1/(1 − ε)) ≈ ε，所以 γmin ≈ γ̄ ε：ε = 1% 就是低 20 dB。p.50 还给了"不出错的平均速率" (1 − ε)Cε = 0.99 × 10.04 = 9.94 Mbps。

PitfallsWhere marks are usually lost

  • Using SNR in Shannon in (a): there is interference treated as noise, so use SINR.(a) 用 SNR 代香农：题目有干扰且当噪声处理，要用 SINR。
  • Putting the dB value into log₂: log₂(1 + 5.6) is wrong; use the linear value 3.64.把 dB 值代进 log₂：log₂(1 + 5.6) 是错的，必须用线性值 3.64。
  • Pressing log₁₀ instead of ln in (c): log₁₀(1/0.99) = 0.00436 would give γmin = 0.436 and C = 5.2 Mbps, wrong.(c) 把 ln 按成 log₁₀：log₁₀(1/0.99) = 0.00436，会得到 γmin = 0.436、C = 5.2 Mbps，错。
  • Substituting γ̄ = 20 directly (not converted to 100).γ̄ = 20 直接代入（没换成 100）。
  • Giving numbers without the comparison: (c) should explain why Cε is far below the AWGN value (a fade margin of about 20 dB).只给数字不比较：(c) 要说明 Cε 远小于 AWGN 的原因（衰落余量约 20 dB）。

ExamHow to write it in English

(a) SNR = S/N = 2/0.05 = 40 (16.0 dB); SIR = S/I = 2/0.5 = 4 (6.0 dB); SINR = S/(I + N) = 2/0.55 = 3.64 (5.6 dB). Treating the interference as Gaussian noise, C = B log₂(1 + SINR) = 10⁷ × log₂(4.64) = 22.1 Mbps.

(b) With the interference removed, C = B log₂(1 + SNR) = 10⁷ × log₂(41) = 53.6 Mbps, about 2.4 times larger, because the link is interference-limited.

(c) γ̄ = 20 dB = 100. For Rayleigh fading, γmin = γ̄ ln(1/(1 − ε)) = 100 × ln(1/0.99) = 1.005, so Cε = 10⁷ × log₂(2.005) = 10.0 Mbps. An AWGN channel with SNR 20 dB gives C = 10⁷ × log₂(101) = 66.6 Mbps. The outage capacity is much lower because, to avoid outage 99% of the time, the rate must be set by an SNR about 20 dB below the average (the fade margin).

In one line: with interference treated as noise, put SINR = S/(I + N) into Shannon; without interference use SNR; for Rayleigh outage capacity first find γmin = γ̄ ln(1/(1 − ε)), which for ε = 1% is about 20 dB below γ̄, so the capacity is far below AWGN.一句话：干扰当噪声就用 SINR = S/(I + N) 代香农；去掉干扰改用 SNR；瑞利中断容量先算 γmin = γ̄ ln(1/(1 − ε))，ε = 1% 时比 γ̄ 低约 20 dB，所以容量远低于 AWGN。
◆ Key points
What it tests
SNR, SIR and SINR; Shannon capacity with interference treated as Gaussian noise; outage capacity in Rayleigh fading (Ch 2 p.48–51). 2025-26 S2 Q1(a)(iii) gives the same Cε formula.
Background
SNR = S/N, SIR = S/I, SINR = S/(I + N); C = B log₂(1 + x) with x linear; Rayleigh outage 1 − e−γ₀/γ̄ (memorise), inverted γ₀ = γ̄ ln(1/(1 − ε)).
Method
(a) Three ratios → dB → Shannon with the SINR; (b) I = 0, use the SNR; (c) γmin = γ̄ ln(1/(1 − ε)) first, then Shannon, and compare with the AWGN B log₂(1 + γ̄).
Key step
For ε = 1%, ln(1/0.99) = 0.01005, so γmin ≈ γ̄/100: 20 dB below the average, which is the fade margin.
Common mistakes
With interference use the SINR, not the SNR; keep the power units consistent; use linear values inside log₂; the ln in (c) is the natural log.
Intuition
When interference is 10 times the noise, SINR ≈ SIR and the system is interference-limited. Rayleigh fading forces a margin for the worst 1% of the time, so the capacity that can be guaranteed is far below the one for the average SNR.
Link
Practice 2 Q3 (SINR, MUD); mock B·Q1 (Rayleigh outage and fade margin); the SNR/SIR/SINR and fade-margin boxes in section 2.7 of the learning page.

思路：三个比值只差在分母；干扰当高斯噪声时，香农公式里用 SINR；(c) 公式题目给了，\(\bar\gamma\ln\frac{1}{1-\varepsilon}\) 其实就是瑞利中断公式反解出的最小 SNR。

  1. (a) 三个比值（线性）：分子都是信号功率，只差在分母： \[\begin{aligned}\mathrm{SNR}&=\frac SN=\frac{2}{0.05}=40\\ \mathrm{SIR}&=\frac SI=\frac{2}{0.5}=4\\ \mathrm{SINR}&=\frac{S}{I+N}=\frac{2}{0.5+0.05}=\frac{2}{0.55}=3.64\end{aligned}\] 都是 mW / mW，没有单位。
  2. (a) 换成 dB：\(10\log_{10}40=16.0\) dB，\(10\log_{10}4=6.0\) dB，\(10\log_{10}3.64=5.6\) dB。自检：SINR 的分母最大，所以最小：5.6 dB < 6.0 dB < 16.0 dB ✓。
  3. (a) 容量：干扰当作高斯噪声，相当于总"噪声"是 I + N，所以香农公式（讲义第 2 章 p.48）里用 SINR： \[\begin{aligned}\log_2(1+3.64)&=\frac{\log_{10}4.64}{0.301}=\frac{0.666}{0.301}=2.213\\C&=10\times10^6\times2.213=22.1\text{ Mbps}\end{aligned}\]
  4. (b) 消除干扰：只剩噪声，用 SNR = 40： \[\begin{aligned}\log_2(1+40)&=\frac{\log_{10}41}{0.301}=\frac{1.613}{0.301}=5.358\\C&=10\times10^6\times5.358=53.6\text{ Mbps}\end{aligned}\] 是原来的 53.6 / 22.1 = 2.42 倍。
  5. (c) 最小 SNR：\(\bar\gamma=10^{20/10}=100\)。题目公式里的 \(\bar\gamma\ln\frac1{1-\varepsilon}\) 就是由瑞利 CDF \(1-e^{-\gamma_{min}/\bar\gamma}=\varepsilon\) 反解出的 γmin（讲义 p.50–51）： \[\begin{aligned}\ln\frac1{1-0.01}&=\ln\frac1{0.99}=0.01005\\ \gamma_{min}&=100\times0.01005=1.005\end{aligned}\] 即 \(10\log_{10}1.005=0.02\) dB，约 0 dB。
  6. (c) 中断容量： \[\begin{aligned}C_\varepsilon&=10\times10^6\times\log_2(1+1.005)\\&=10\times10^6\times\frac{\log_{10}2.005}{0.301}\\&=10\times10^6\times\frac{0.3021}{0.301}=10\times10^6\times1.004\\&=10.0\text{ Mbps}\end{aligned}\]
  7. (c) 和 AWGN 比较：同样 20 dB 的 AWGN 信道，SNR 一直是 100： \[\begin{aligned}C_{AWGN}&=10\times10^6\times\frac{\log_{10}101}{0.301}\\&=10\times10^6\times6.658=66.6\text{ Mbps}\end{aligned}\] \(66.6/10.0=6.6\) 倍。原因：瑞利信道要保证 99% 的时间不中断，只能按最小 SNR（约 0 dB）来定速率。自检：\(\bar\gamma_{dB}-\gamma_{min,dB}=20-0.02=19.98\) dB，正好是讲义 p.51 里 ε = 1% 对应的 20 dB 衰落余量 ✓（和模拟 B · Q1 (b) 一样）。
(a) SNR 16.0 dB、SIR 6.0 dB、SINR 5.6 dB，C ≈ 22.1 Mbps；(b) C ≈ 53.6 Mbps；(c) Cε ≈ 10.0 Mbps，远低于 AWGN 的 66.6 Mbps
官方答案：无（自编模拟题）。所有数字已用 src/p2build/verify_mock.py 验算。
干扰（0.5 mW）比噪声（0.05 mW）大 10 倍，所以 SINR ≈ SIR，这种系统叫"干扰受限"：再降噪声没什么用，要降干扰。SINR 一定比 SNR、SIR 都小。
知识讲解 + 详细解析：SINR、香农容量与瑞利中断容量

知识讲解SNR、SIR、SINR：只差在分母

三个比值的分子都是有用信号功率 S，分母不同：

名称定义分母里有什么什么时候用
SNR（signal-to-noise ratio）S/N只有噪声没有干扰，或干扰已被消除
SIR（signal-to-interference ratio）S/I只有干扰蜂窝规划，噪声可忽略时
SINR（signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio）S/(I + N)干扰 + 噪声两者都有，把干扰当噪声处理时

SINR 的定义在讲义第 1a 章 p.16（"Interference: Friend or Foe?"）：干扰当噪声处理时是"敌人"，就用 SINR。第 1a 章老师说不考，但这个定义 Practice 2 第 3 题要用。一个好用的关系：1/SINR = 1/SNR + 1/SIR，所以 SINR 一定比 SNR 和 SIR 都小。

知识讲解香农容量

讲义第 2 章 p.48：AWGN 信道的容量 C = B log₂(1 + γ)（bit/s），γ 是接收 SNR（线性值），B 是带宽。意义：传输速率 R < C 时，存在编码能让误码率任意小；R > C 时做不到。老师说这是通信工程师最基本的公式，必须背。干扰被当成高斯噪声时，它和噪声没有区别，γ 就换成 SINR。

计算器提示：log₂x = log₁₀x / 0.301；dB → 线性：10^(dB/10)。B 用 MHz 代入，C 的单位就是 Mbps。

详细解析(a) 三个比值和容量

SNR = 2 / 0.05 = 40 → 10 log₁₀40 = 16.0 dB
SIR = 2 / 0.5 = 4 → 10 log₁₀4 = 6.0 dB
SINR = 2 / (0.5 + 0.05) = 2 / 0.55 = 3.64 → 10 log₁₀3.64 = 5.6 dB
检验：1/40 + 1/4 = 0.025 + 0.25 = 0.275 = 1/3.64
C = 10 MHz × log₂(1 + 3.64) = 10 × (log₁₀4.64 / 0.301) = 10 × 2.213 = 22.1 Mbps

为什么用 SINR：题目说"把干扰当高斯噪声"，那接收机看到的"噪声"就是 I + N。功率都是 mW，相除后单位消掉，不用换成 W。

详细解析(b) 干扰完全消除

只剩噪声，用 SNR = 40：C = 10 × log₂41 = 10 × 5.358 = 53.6 Mbps
53.6 / 22.1 ≈ 2.4 倍

为什么提升这么大：干扰 0.5 mW 是噪声 0.05 mW 的 10 倍，SINR ≈ SIR，这种系统叫干扰受限（interference-limited）。对比一下：噪声减半，SINR = 2/0.525，C 只到 22.7 Mbps；干扰减半，SINR = 2/0.3，C 升到 29.4 Mbps。要提升容量，就要对付干扰（干扰消除、多用户检测 MUD、扇区化等）。

知识讲解衰落信道：遍历容量和中断容量

衰落信道里 SNR γ 是随机变量（老师强调这一点贯穿第 2–7 章）。讲义给了两种容量：

  • 遍历容量（ergodic capacity，p.49）：对 B log₂(1 + γ) 求平均。由 Jensen 不等式，它不会超过同样平均 SNR 的 AWGN 容量（老师说 Jensen 只要求懂概念）。
  • 中断容量（outage capacity，p.50，适用于慢衰落）：允许 ε 的时间中断，其余时间保证速率 Cε = B log₂(1 + γmin)，γmin 满足 P(γ < γmin) = ε。

瑞利衰落时 P(γ < γmin) = 1 − e−γmin/γ̄（必背的瑞利中断公式）。令它等于 ε，解出 γmin = γ̄ ln(1/(1 − ε))（p.51），代进香农公式就是题目给的 Cε。p.51 还说：和 AWGN 达到同样容量需要的衰落余量（fade margin）= 10 log₁₀[1/ln(1/(1 − ε))]，ε = 1% 时是 20 dB。

详细解析(c) 一步一步代

  1. dB 换线性：γ̄ = 10^(20/10) = 100。
  2. 求 γmin：ln 是自然对数。
    ln(1/0.99) = 0.01005
    γmin = 100 × 0.01005 = 1.005（约 0.02 dB，也就是约 0 dB）
  3. 代香农：
    Cε = 10 × log₂(1 + 1.005) = 10 × log₂2.005 = 10 × 1.004 = 10.0 Mbps
  4. 和 AWGN 比：
    CAWGN = 10 × log₂(1 + 100) = 10 × 6.658 = 66.6 Mbps
    66.6 / 10.0 ≈ 6.6 倍
    衰落余量 = 20 − 0.02 = 19.98 ≈ 20 dB

为什么差这么多：要保证 99% 的时间都不中断，只能按"最差的 1%"附近的 SNR（约 0 dB）来定速率，比平均 SNR 低约 20 dB。ε 很小时 ln(1/(1 − ε)) ≈ ε，所以 γmin ≈ γ̄ ε：ε = 1% 就是低 20 dB。p.50 还给了"不出错的平均速率" (1 − ε)Cε = 0.99 × 10.04 = 9.94 Mbps。

易错常见丢分点

  • (a) 用 SNR 代香农：题目有干扰且当噪声处理，要用 SINR。
  • 把 dB 值代进 log₂：log₂(1 + 5.6) 是错的，必须用线性值 3.64。
  • (c) 把 ln 按成 log₁₀：log₁₀(1/0.99) = 0.00436，会得到 γmin = 0.436、C = 5.2 Mbps，错。
  • γ̄ = 20 直接代入（没换成 100）。
  • 只给数字不比较：(c) 要说明 Cε 远小于 AWGN 的原因（衰落余量约 20 dB）。

考试英文写法

(a) SNR = S/N = 2/0.05 = 40 (16.0 dB); SIR = S/I = 2/0.5 = 4 (6.0 dB); SINR = S/(I + N) = 2/0.55 = 3.64 (5.6 dB). Treating the interference as Gaussian noise, C = B log₂(1 + SINR) = 10⁷ × log₂(4.64) = 22.1 Mbps.

(b) With the interference removed, C = B log₂(1 + SNR) = 10⁷ × log₂(41) = 53.6 Mbps, about 2.4 times larger, because the link is interference-limited.

(c) γ̄ = 20 dB = 100. For Rayleigh fading, γmin = γ̄ ln(1/(1 − ε)) = 100 × ln(1/0.99) = 1.005, so Cε = 10⁷ × log₂(2.005) = 10.0 Mbps. An AWGN channel with SNR 20 dB gives C = 10⁷ × log₂(101) = 66.6 Mbps. The outage capacity is much lower because, to avoid outage 99% of the time, the rate must be set by an SNR about 20 dB below the average (the fade margin).

一句话：干扰当噪声就用 SINR = S/(I + N) 代香农；去掉干扰改用 SNR；瑞利中断容量先算 γmin = γ̄ ln(1/(1 − ε))，ε = 1% 时比 γ̄ 低约 20 dB，所以容量远低于 AWGN。
◆ 本题知识点
考什么
SNR、SIR、SINR 的区别；干扰当高斯噪声时的香农容量；瑞利衰落下的中断容量（第 2 章 p.48–51）。2025-26 S2 Q1(a)(iii) 给了同一个 Cε 公式。
前置知识
SNR = S/N，SIR = S/I，SINR = S/(I + N)；C = B log₂(1 + x)，x 用线性值；瑞利中断 1 − e−γ₀/γ̄（必背），反解得 γ₀ = γ̄ ln(1/(1 − ε))。
解题套路
(a) 三个比值 → 换 dB → 用 SINR 代香农；(b) I = 0，用 SNR；(c) 先算 γmin = γ̄ ln(1/(1 − ε))，再代香农，和 AWGN 的 B log₂(1 + γ̄) 比。
关键一步
ε = 1%：ln(1/0.99) = 0.01005，γmin ≈ γ̄/100，也就是比平均低 20 dB，等于衰落余量。
易错
有干扰时用 SINR 不用 SNR；功率单位统一；log₂ 里用线性值；(c) 里的 ln 是自然对数。
直觉
干扰比噪声大 10 倍时 SINR ≈ SIR，系统是"干扰受限"的；瑞利衰落要为最坏的 1% 时间留余量，所以能保证的容量远低于平均 SNR 对应的容量。
联系
Practice 2 第 3 题（SINR、MUD）；模拟 B · Q1（瑞利中断与衰落余量）；讲解页 2.7 节的 SNR/SIR/SINR 和衰落余量补充框。
Part 2 practice
Focused · Q1

Free-space model, and why you cannot use it in place of the simplified model

Original question · bilingualFocused practice (self-written)

A transmitter radiates 1 W at 900 MHz. Both antennas have unity gain (\(G_t=G_r=1\)).

某发射机在 900 MHz 上发射 1 W，收发天线增益都是 1（\(G_t=G_r=1\)）。

(a) Assuming free-space propagation, find the received power in dBm and the path loss in dB at a distance of 1 km. (3 marks)

(a) 假设自由空间传播，求 1 km 处的接收功率（dBm）和路径损耗（dB）。（3 分）

(b) By how many dB does the free-space received power drop when the distance is doubled to 2 km? By how many more dB when the carrier frequency is then doubled to 1.8 GHz? (3 marks)

(b) 距离加倍到 2 km，自由空间接收功率下降多少 dB？再把载频加倍到 1.8 GHz，又下降多少 dB？（3 分）

(c) For an urban macrocell, the simplified path loss model with \(K_{dB}=-31.5\) dB, \(d_0=1\) m and γ = 3.5 is used instead. Find the received power at 1 km and explain why using the free-space model here would be a serious mistake. (4 marks)

(c) 对城区宏蜂窝，改用简化路径损耗模型：\(K_{dB}=-31.5\) dB，\(d_0=1\) m，γ = 3.5。求 1 km 处的接收功率，并说明为什么这里用自由空间模型是严重的错误。（4 分）

Free-space Friis formulaP ∝ d⁻², f⁻²Simplified model vs free spaceCh. 2 of the notes, p.3–4, p.8
What the question is asking: what does this question actually want?

ScenarioWhat the question is about

The free-space model in Ch. 2 of the notes, p.4: nothing blocks the path between transmitter and receiver, and the power spreads evenly over an ever larger sphere, like a balloon being inflated, so it falls as d⁻².讲义第 2 章 p.4 的自由空间模型：发射机和接收机之间什么都不挡，功率像吹气球一样均匀撒到越来越大的球面上，所以按 d⁻² 减少。

This question first uses it once, then repeats the calculation with the simplified path loss model used for urban areas, to see how far apart the two are. The lecturer warned that in past quizzes some students used the free-space model on a simplified-model question.这道题先用它算一次，再换成城区用的简化路径损耗模型算一次，看看两者差多少。老师提醒过，往年 Quiz 有学生把简化模型的题用成了自由空间模型。

SymbolsWhat each quantity in the question means

1 WTransmit power, converted to 30 dBm发射功率，换成 30 dBm
900 MHzCarrier frequency, λ = c/f = 0.333 m
\(G_t=G_r=1\)Transmit and receive antenna gains (0 dB)收发天线增益（0 dB）
\(P_r=P_tG_tG_r(\lambda/4\pi d)^2\)Free-space formula (Friis)自由空间公式（Friis）
γ = 3.5Urban path loss exponent used in (c); free space corresponds to γ = 2(c) 里城区的路径损耗指数；自由空间相当于 γ = 2

What each part asksWhat each part is asking for

  • (a) Use the free-space formula to find the received power and path loss at 1 km.(a) 用自由空间公式算 1 km 处的接收功率和路径损耗。
  • (b) How many dB the power drops when the distance doubles and when the frequency doubles: look at the power each one has in the formula.(b) 距离加倍、频率加倍各让功率少多少 dB：看它们在公式里是几次方。
  • (c) Redo the same scenario with the simplified model (γ = 3.5), compare with free space, and explain why free space cannot be used in urban areas.(c) 同一个场景换成简化模型（γ = 3.5）再算，和自由空间比较，解释为什么城区不能用自由空间。

Watch outEasy ways to misread the question

  • When the question says simplified path loss model, do not use the free-space formula.题目说 simplified path loss model 时，不要套自由空间公式。
  • λ/4πd is an amplitude ratio; to get dB use 20 log₁₀.λ/4πd 是幅度比，取 dB 用 20 log₁₀。

PurposeWhat the question wants you to understand

Free space is an ideal case, valid only when "nothing blocks the path". Urban areas need the simplified model, and the two can differ by tens of dB already at 1 km.自由空间是理想情况，只适合"什么都不挡"的场合；城区要用简化模型，两者在 1 km 处就能差几十 dB。

In one line: use the free-space formula for the received power at 1 km, find how many dB doubling the distance and doubling the frequency each cost, then compare with the simplified model at γ = 3.5 to show why the two must not be mixed up.一句话：用自由空间公式算 1 km 的接收功率，看距离和频率加倍各少几 dB，再和 γ = 3.5 的简化模型比较，说明为什么不能混用。

Approach: Use the free-space formula \(P_r=P_tG_tG_r\big(\frac{\lambda}{4\pi d}\big)^2\) in dB; distance and frequency both appear squared, so each doubling costs 6 dB; in (c) compute with the simplified model and compare: the difference is tens of dB.

  1. (a) Wavelength and transmit power: \[\begin{aligned}\lambda&=\frac cf=\frac{3\times10^8}{9\times10^8}=0.333\text{ m}\\P_t&=1\text{ W}=10\log_{10}\frac{1000\text{ mW}}{1\text{ mW}}=30\text{ dBm}\end{aligned}\]
  2. (a) Free-space gain: Friis formula (Ch 2 p.4) \(P_r=P_tG_tG_r\big(\frac{\lambda}{4\pi d}\big)^2\) with Gt = Gr = 1. The square becomes 20 log in dB: \[\begin{aligned}\frac{\lambda}{4\pi d}&=\frac{0.333}{4\pi\times1000}=\frac{0.333}{12566}\\&=2.65\times10^{-5}\\20\log_{10}\frac{\lambda}{4\pi d}&=20\log_{10}(2.65\times10^{-5})\\&=-91.5\text{ dB}\end{aligned}\]
  3. (a) Received power and path loss: \[\begin{aligned}P_r&=30-91.5=-61.5\text{ dBm}\\ PL&=P_t-P_r=30-(-61.5)=91.5\text{ dB}\end{aligned}\] Check with the Part A formula (f in MHz, d in km): \[\begin{aligned}PL&=32.44+20\log_{10}900+20\log_{10}1\\&=32.44+59.08+0=91.5\text{ dB}\ \checkmark\end{aligned}\]
  4. (b) Double the distance: \(P_r\propto d^{-2}\), so d → 2d makes the power 1/4: \[\Delta=10\log_{10}4=20\log_{10}2=6.02\text{ dB}\] \(P_r(2\text{ km})=-61.53-6.02=-67.5\) dBm.
  5. (b) Then double the frequency: \(P_r\propto\lambda^2\propto f^{-2}\): doubling f halves λ and makes the power 1/4 again, another 6.02 dB down: \(P_r=-67.55-6.02=-73.6\) dBm. Reason: the effective area of a unity-gain antenna is proportional to λ², so at a higher frequency the receiving antenna "catches" less power.
  6. (c) Simplified model: \(P_r=P_t+K_{dB}-10\gamma\log_{10}(d/d_0)\) (p.8) with \(\log_{10}(1000/1)=3\): \[\begin{aligned}P_r&=30+(-31.5)-10\times3.5\times3\\&=30-31.5-105=-106.5\text{ dBm}\end{aligned}\]
  7. (c) Comparison and explanation: the two differ by \(-61.5-(-106.5)=45\) dB, a factor of \(10^{4.5}\approx3\times10^4\). Check: the two models almost agree at 1 m (free space gives \(20\log_{10}(\lambda/4\pi)=-31.5\) dB = KdB), and after that they drift apart by 35 − 20 = 15 dB per decade of distance; 1 m → 1 km is 3 decades, 3 × 15 = 45 dB ✓. Reason: in a city, buildings block the path and cause many reflections, so the power falls much faster with distance (γ = 3.5 instead of 2). The free-space model would overestimate the received power by about 45 dB and get the coverage and outage completely wrong.
(a) Pr ≈ −61.5 dBm, path loss ≈ 91.5 dB; (b) 6 dB each (−67.5 dBm, then −73.6 dBm); (c) −106.5 dBm, about 45 dB below free space, so free space would grossly overestimate
Official answer: none (self-written practice question); all numbers checked by src/p2build/verify_mock.py
A coincidence: at 900 MHz the free-space gain at 1 m, 20 log₁₀(λ/4π) = −31.5 dB, equals the KdB used in (c). So both models agree at 1 m and differ only in the exponent: per decade of distance, free space loses 20 dB while γ = 3.5 loses 35 dB. The lecturer warned that in a past quiz some students used the free-space model on a simplified-model question.
Concept + step by step: free-space formula vs simplified path loss model知识讲解 + 详细解析：自由空间公式与简化路径损耗模型

ConceptThe free-space (Friis) formula: what each symbol means

Ch 2 p.4: with no obstruction and only a direct line-of-sight (LOS) path, \(P_r=\dfrac{P_tG_tG_r\lambda^2}{(4\pi)^2d^2}\). Pt and Pr are the transmit and received powers; Gt and Gr the antenna gains (both 1 here); λ = c/f the wavelength; d the distance. The two conclusions on the slide: the received power is inversely proportional to d² and proportional to λ² (i.e. inversely proportional to f²).讲义第 2 章 p.4：没有任何遮挡、只有一条直射路径（LOS）时，\(P_r=\dfrac{P_tG_tG_r\lambda^2}{(4\pi)^2d^2}\)。Pt、Pr 是发射、接收功率；Gt、Gr 是收发天线增益（本题都是 1）；λ = c/f 是波长；d 是距离。讲义的两句结论：接收功率和 d² 成反比，和 λ² 成正比（也就是和 f² 成反比）。

The dB form is easiest to compute: Pr,dBm = Pt,dBm + Gt,dB + Gr,dB + 20 log₁₀(λ/(4πd)). Why 20: taking 10 log₁₀ of (λ/4πd)² equals 20 log₁₀(λ/4πd). The Part A slides (p.51) give the practical form L(dB) = 32 + 20 log f(MHz) + 20 log d(km); the more precise constant is 32.44.取 dB 形式最好算：Pr,dBm = Pt,dBm + Gt,dB + Gr,dB + 20 log₁₀(λ/(4πd))。为什么是 20：(λ/4πd)² 取 10 log₁₀ 就等于 20 log₁₀(λ/4πd)。Part A 讲义（p.51）给的经验写法是 L(dB) = 32 + 20 log f(MHz) + 20 log d(km)，更精确的常数是 32.44。

Beyond the slidesWhere d² and λ² come from (the slide does not explain why)

The factor d² comes from the power spreading over a sphere of radius d with area 4πd²; the factor λ² comes from the effective area of the receive antenna being proportional to λ², so at a higher frequency an antenna of the same gain "catches" less power.d² 来自功率在半径为 d 的球面上摊开，球面积 4πd²；λ² 来自接收天线的有效面积和 λ² 成正比，频率越高，同样增益的天线"接住"的功率越少。

ConceptThe simplified path loss model: free space is a special case

Slide p.8: Pr,dB = Pt,dB + KdB − 10γ log₁₀(d/d₀), where γ is the path loss exponent and K and γ are fitted to measured data. The lecturer said both the linear and dB forms must be memorised (not given in the exam); "simplified path loss model" is a proper name, and in past Quizzes some students used the free-space model instead.讲义 p.8：Pr,dB = Pt,dB + KdB − 10γ log₁₀(d/d₀)，γ 是路径损耗指数（path loss exponent），K 和 γ 由实测数据拟合。老师说这个模型线性和 dB 两种形式都要背，考试不给；"simplified path loss model"是专有名词，往年 Quiz 有学生把它用成了自由空间模型。

Free space written in the same form: with d₀ = 1 m, KdB = 20 log₁₀(λ/4π) and γ = 2. So the real difference between the two models is the exponent: per factor of 10 in distance, free space loses 20 dB, while γ = 3.5 loses 35 dB.把自由空间写成同样的形式：取 d₀ = 1 m，KdB = 20 log₁₀(λ/4π)，γ = 2。所以两个模型真正的区别是指数：每 10 倍距离，自由空间少 20 dB，γ = 3.5 时少 35 dB。

Step by step(a) Free-space received power at 1 km

  1. Wavelength: 求波长：
    λ = c/f = 3 × 10⁸ / (9 × 10⁸) = 0.3333 m
  2. Transmit power in dBm (the lecturer said a missing W / mW conversion loses marks): 发射功率换 dBm（老师说 W / mW 没换会扣分）：
    Pt = 1 W = 1000 mW → 10 log₁₀1000 = 30 dBm
  3. Into the dB formula (d in metres, the same unit as λ): 代 dB 公式（d 用米，和 λ 单位一致）：
    λ/(4πd) = 0.3333 / (4π × 1000) = 0.3333 / 12566 = 2.65 × 10⁻⁵
    20 log₁₀(2.65 × 10⁻⁵) = 20 × (−4.576) = −91.5 dB
    Pr = 30 − 91.5 = −61.5 dBm; path loss = 30 − (−61.5) = 91.5 dB
  4. Check: 32.44 + 20 log₁₀900 + 20 log₁₀1 = 32.44 + 59.08 + 0 = 91.5 dB (here f in MHz, d in km).核对：32.44 + 20 log₁₀900 + 20 log₁₀1 = 32.44 + 59.08 + 0 = 91.5 dB（这里 f 用 MHz、d 用 km）。

Step by step(b) Doubling the distance, doubling the frequency

Pr ∝ d⁻²: doubling d → 20 log₁₀2 = 6.02 dB less → −61.53 − 6.02 = −67.55 dBm
Pr ∝ λ² ∝ f⁻²: then doubling f → another 6.02 dB less → −67.55 − 6.02 = −73.6 dBm

Rule: if a quantity appears to the power n, doubling it changes the power by n × 3 dB (10 log₁₀2 ≈ 3). In free space d and f both appear to the power −2, so each gives −6 dB.规律：某个量在公式里是 n 次方，它加倍时功率变化 n × 3 dB（10 log₁₀2 ≈ 3）。自由空间里 d 和 f 都是 −2 次方，所以各是 −6 dB。

Note: the −67.6 dBm in the solution above is a rounding slip. The exact value is −67.547 dBm, which rounds to −67.5 dBm to one decimal (−67.55 to two); the 0.05 dB difference does not change any conclusion.说明：上面解答里写的 −67.6 dBm 是舍入差。精确值是 −67.547 dBm，四舍五入到一位小数是 −67.5 dBm（两位小数 −67.55），相差 0.05 dB，不影响结论。

Step by step(c) The simplified model, and why free space must not be used

Pr = 30 + (−31.5) − 10 × 3.5 × log₁₀1000 = 30 − 31.5 − 105 = −106.5 dBm
Difference from free space: −61.5 − (−106.5) = 45 dB (a power ratio of about 31 thousand)

Why almost exactly 45 dB: at 900 MHz the free-space KdB = 20 log₁₀(0.3333/4π) = −31.5 dB, almost the same as the KdB in the question, so the two models agree at 1 m; from 1 m to 1 km is three factors of 10, so free space loses 20 × 3 = 60 dB and the simplified model 35 × 3 = 105 dB, a difference of 45 dB.为什么正好约 45 dB：900 MHz 时自由空间的 KdB = 20 log₁₀(0.3333/4π) = −31.5 dB，和题目的 KdB 几乎一样，所以两个模型在 1 m 处相同；从 1 m 到 1 km 是 3 个"10 倍"，自由空间少 20 × 3 = 60 dB，简化模型少 35 × 3 = 105 dB，差 45 dB。

Why it is a serious mistake: in a city, buildings block the signal and the ground and walls reflect it, so the power decays with distance much faster than in free space. Free space would overestimate the received power by about 45 dB, and coverage, outage probability and capacity would all be wrong. The question says simplified path loss model, so it must be used. Also, the table on slide p.9 gives γ = 3.7–6.5 for urban macrocells (the γ table need not be memorised), so the real decay may be even faster than γ = 3.5 and the gap even larger.为什么是严重错误：城区有楼房遮挡、地面和墙面反射，功率随距离衰减得比自由空间快得多。用自由空间会把接收功率高估约 45 dB，覆盖范围、中断概率、容量全都算错。题目写了 simplified path loss model，就必须用它。另外讲义 p.9 的表里城区宏蜂窝的 γ 是 3.7–6.5（γ 的取值表不用背），实际衰减可能比 γ = 3.5 更快，差距更大。

PitfallsWhere marks are usually lost

  • Using 10 log₁₀(λ/4πd): λ/4πd is an amplitude ratio, so use 20 log₁₀ (or square first, then 10 log₁₀).用 10 log₁₀(λ/4πd)：λ/4πd 是幅度比，要用 20 log₁₀（或者先平方再 10 log₁₀）。
  • Not converting 1 W to 30 dBm and writing Pr = 1 − 91.5.1 W 没换成 30 dBm，直接写 Pr = 1 − 91.5。
  • Putting d in km into Friis while λ is in metres: inconsistent units. In the simplified model with d₀ = 1 m, d must also be in metres: log₁₀1000 = 3, not log₁₀1 = 0 (the lecturer said some students lost the calculation marks this way in this year's Quiz).Friis 公式里 d 代 km（λ 是米）：单位不一致。简化模型 d₀ = 1 m 时 d 也要用米：log₁₀1000 = 3，不是 log₁₀1 = 0（老师说今年 Quiz 有人这样丢了计算分）。
  • In (b), thinking the power increases when the frequency doubles: a higher f means a smaller λ and a smaller received power.(b) 把"再加倍频率"理解成功率增加：f 越高 λ 越小，接收功率越小。

ExamHow to write it in English

(a) λ = c/f = 3 × 10⁸ / 9 × 10⁸ = 0.333 m and Pt = 1 W = 30 dBm. In free space, Pr = PtGtGr(λ/4πd)², so Pr,dBm = 30 + 20 log₁₀(0.333/(4π × 1000)) = 30 − 91.5 = −61.5 dBm, and the path loss is 91.5 dB.

(b) Pr ∝ d⁻², so doubling d reduces Pr by 20 log₁₀2 = 6 dB (to −67.55 dBm). Pr ∝ λ² ∝ f⁻², so doubling f reduces it by another 6 dB (to −73.6 dBm).

(c) Pr,dBm = Pt,dBm + KdB − 10γ log₁₀(d/d₀) = 30 − 31.5 − 35 log₁₀(1000) = −106.5 dBm, about 45 dB below the free-space value. Free space assumes an unobstructed LOS path with γ = 2, whereas in an urban macrocell the power decays much faster (γ = 3.5) because of obstruction and reflections. Using free space would overestimate the received power by about 45 dB and give completely wrong coverage and outage results.

In one line: free space is Pr = PtGtGr(λ/4πd)², computed with 20 log₁₀, and doubling d or f costs 6 dB each; it is the simplified model with γ = 2, and with an urban γ = 3.5 the power at 1 km is about 45 dB lower, so when the question says simplified model, never use free space.一句话：自由空间 Pr = PtGtGr(λ/4πd)²，用 20 log₁₀ 算，d、f 加倍各少 6 dB；它等于 γ = 2 的简化模型，城区 γ = 3.5 时 1 km 处要再低约 45 dB，所以题目说简化模型就绝不能用自由空间。
◆ Key points
What it tests
The free-space (Friis) formula and its d⁻², f⁻² behaviour; how it differs from the simplified path loss model (Ch 2 p.3–4, p.8). Not asked directly in the practices or past papers, but the lecturer warned that past quiz students used free space on a simplified-model question.
Background
Pr = PtGtGr(λ/4πd)²; λ = c/f; 1 W = 30 dBm; simplified model Pr,dB = Pt,dB + KdB − 10γ log₁₀(d/d₀).
Method
(a) Find λ, then in dB Pr = Pt + 20 log₁₀(λ/4πd); (b) squared dependence → 6 dB per doubling; (c) use the simplified model and compare with (a).
Key numbers
900 MHz, 1 km: path loss 91.5 dB; per decade of distance γ = 2 loses 20 dB, γ = 3.5 loses 35 dB; at 1 km the two models differ by about 45 dB.
Common mistakes
If the question says simplified path loss model, do not use free space; convert W to dBm; 20 log₁₀, not 10 log₁₀ (λ/4πd is an amplitude ratio, its square is the power ratio).
Intuition
Free space is the ideal "nothing in the way" case where power only spreads over a sphere; real cities block and reflect, so the power falls much faster.
Link
Part A Ch 5 (n = 2); focused Q2 two-ray (n = 4); mock A·Q2 (simplified model).

  1. (a) 波长和发射功率： \[\begin{aligned}\lambda&=\frac cf=\frac{3\times10^8}{9\times10^8}=0.333\text{ m}\\P_t&=1\text{ W}=10\log_{10}\frac{1000\text{ mW}}{1\text{ mW}}=30\text{ dBm}\end{aligned}\]
  2. (a) 自由空间增益：Friis 公式（讲义第 2 章 p.4）\(P_r=P_tG_tG_r\big(\frac{\lambda}{4\pi d}\big)^2\)，Gt = Gr = 1。平方在 dB 里变成 20 log： \[\begin{aligned}\frac{\lambda}{4\pi d}&=\frac{0.333}{4\pi\times1000}=\frac{0.333}{12566}\\&=2.65\times10^{-5}\\20\log_{10}\frac{\lambda}{4\pi d}&=20\log_{10}(2.65\times10^{-5})\\&=-91.5\text{ dB}\end{aligned}\]
  3. (a) 接收功率和路径损耗： \[\begin{aligned}P_r&=30-91.5=-61.5\text{ dBm}\\ PL&=P_t-P_r=30-(-61.5)=91.5\text{ dB}\end{aligned}\] 自检（Part A 的公式，f 用 MHz、d 用 km）： \[\begin{aligned}PL&=32.44+20\log_{10}900+20\log_{10}1\\&=32.44+59.08+0=91.5\text{ dB}\ \checkmark\end{aligned}\]
  4. (b) 距离加倍：\(P_r\propto d^{-2}\)，d 变成 2d，功率变成 1/4： \[\Delta=10\log_{10}4=20\log_{10}2=6.02\text{ dB}\] \(P_r(2\text{ km})=-61.53-6.02=-67.5\) dBm。
  5. (b) 频率再加倍：\(P_r\propto\lambda^2\propto f^{-2}\)：f 加倍 → λ 减半 → 功率再变成 1/4，再少 6.02 dB：\(P_r=-67.55-6.02=-73.6\) dBm。原因：增益为 1 的天线有效面积 \(\propto\lambda^2\)，频率越高，接收天线"接住"的功率越少。
  6. (c) 简化模型：\(P_r=P_t+K_{dB}-10\gamma\log_{10}(d/d_0)\)（p.8），\(\log_{10}(1000/1)=3\)： \[\begin{aligned}P_r&=30+(-31.5)-10\times3.5\times3\\&=30-31.5-105=-106.5\text{ dBm}\end{aligned}\]

知识讲解 + 详细解析：自由空间公式与简化路径损耗模型

知识讲解自由空间（Friis）公式：每个符号是什么

讲义第 2 章 p.4：没有任何遮挡、只有一条直射路径（LOS）时，\(P_r=\dfrac{P_tG_tG_r\lambda^2}{(4\pi)^2d^2}\)。Pt、Pr 是发射、接收功率；Gt、Gr 是收发天线增益（本题都是 1）；λ = c/f 是波长；d 是距离。讲义的两句结论：接收功率和 d² 成反比，和 λ² 成正比（也就是和 f² 成反比）。

取 dB 形式最好算：Pr,dBm = Pt,dBm + Gt,dB + Gr,dB + 20 log₁₀(λ/(4πd))。为什么是 20：(λ/4πd)² 取 10 log₁₀ 就等于 20 log₁₀(λ/4πd)。Part A 讲义（p.51）给的经验写法是 L(dB) = 32 + 20 log f(MHz) + 20 log d(km)，更精确的常数是 32.44。

课外补充d² 和 λ² 从哪来（讲义没解释原因）

d² 来自功率在半径为 d 的球面上摊开，球面积 4πd²；λ² 来自接收天线的有效面积和 λ² 成正比，频率越高，同样增益的天线"接住"的功率越少。

知识讲解简化路径损耗模型：自由空间是它的特例

讲义 p.8：Pr,dB = Pt,dB + KdB − 10γ log₁₀(d/d₀)，γ 是路径损耗指数（path loss exponent），K 和 γ 由实测数据拟合。老师说这个模型线性和 dB 两种形式都要背，考试不给；"simplified path loss model"是专有名词，往年 Quiz 有学生把它用成了自由空间模型。

把自由空间写成同样的形式：取 d₀ = 1 m，KdB = 20 log₁₀(λ/4π)，γ = 2。所以两个模型真正的区别是指数：每 10 倍距离，自由空间少 20 dB，γ = 3.5 时少 35 dB。

详细解析(a) 1 km 处的自由空间接收功率

  1. 求波长：
    λ = c/f = 3 × 10⁸ / (9 × 10⁸) = 0.3333 m
  2. 发射功率换 dBm（老师说 W / mW 没换会扣分）：
    Pt = 1 W = 1000 mW → 10 log₁₀1000 = 30 dBm
  3. 代 dB 公式（d 用米，和 λ 单位一致）：
    λ/(4πd) = 0.3333 / (4π × 1000) = 0.3333 / 12566 = 2.65 × 10⁻⁵
    20 log₁₀(2.65 × 10⁻⁵) = 20 × (−4.576) = −91.5 dB
    Pr = 30 − 91.5 = −61.5 dBm；路径损耗 = 30 − (−61.5) = 91.5 dB
  4. 核对：32.44 + 20 log₁₀900 + 20 log₁₀1 = 32.44 + 59.08 + 0 = 91.5 dB（这里 f 用 MHz、d 用 km）。

详细解析(b) 距离加倍、频率加倍

Pr ∝ d⁻²：d 加倍 → 少 20 log₁₀2 = 6.02 dB → −61.53 − 6.02 = −67.55 dBm
Pr ∝ λ² ∝ f⁻²：f 再加倍 → 再少 6.02 dB → −67.55 − 6.02 = −73.6 dBm

规律：某个量在公式里是 n 次方，它加倍时功率变化 n × 3 dB（10 log₁₀2 ≈ 3）。自由空间里 d 和 f 都是 −2 次方，所以各是 −6 dB。

说明：上面解答里写的 −67.6 dBm 是舍入差。精确值是 −67.547 dBm，四舍五入到一位小数是 −67.5 dBm（两位小数 −67.55），相差 0.05 dB，不影响结论。

详细解析(c) 简化模型，以及为什么不能用自由空间

Pr = 30 + (−31.5) − 10 × 3.5 × log₁₀1000 = 30 − 31.5 − 105 = −106.5 dBm
和自由空间相差：−61.5 − (−106.5) = 45 dB（功率比约 3.1 万倍）

为什么正好约 45 dB：900 MHz 时自由空间的 KdB = 20 log₁₀(0.3333/4π) = −31.5 dB，和题目的 KdB 几乎一样，所以两个模型在 1 m 处相同；从 1 m 到 1 km 是 3 个"10 倍"，自由空间少 20 × 3 = 60 dB，简化模型少 35 × 3 = 105 dB，差 45 dB。

为什么是严重错误：城区有楼房遮挡、地面和墙面反射，功率随距离衰减得比自由空间快得多。用自由空间会把接收功率高估约 45 dB，覆盖范围、中断概率、容量全都算错。题目写了 simplified path loss model，就必须用它。另外讲义 p.9 的表里城区宏蜂窝的 γ 是 3.7–6.5（γ 的取值表不用背），实际衰减可能比 γ = 3.5 更快，差距更大。

易错常见丢分点

  • 用 10 log₁₀(λ/4πd)：λ/4πd 是幅度比，要用 20 log₁₀（或者先平方再 10 log₁₀）。
  • 1 W 没换成 30 dBm，直接写 Pr = 1 − 91.5。
  • Friis 公式里 d 代 km（λ 是米）：单位不一致。简化模型 d₀ = 1 m 时 d 也要用米：log₁₀1000 = 3，不是 log₁₀1 = 0（老师说今年 Quiz 有人这样丢了计算分）。
  • (b) 把"再加倍频率"理解成功率增加：f 越高 λ 越小，接收功率越小。

考试英文写法

(a) λ = c/f = 3 × 10⁸ / 9 × 10⁸ = 0.333 m and Pt = 1 W = 30 dBm. In free space, Pr = PtGtGr(λ/4πd)², so Pr,dBm = 30 + 20 log₁₀(0.333/(4π × 1000)) = 30 − 91.5 = −61.5 dBm, and the path loss is 91.5 dB.

(b) Pr ∝ d⁻², so doubling d reduces Pr by 20 log₁₀2 = 6 dB (to −67.55 dBm). Pr ∝ λ² ∝ f⁻², so doubling f reduces it by another 6 dB (to −73.6 dBm).

(c) Pr,dBm = Pt,dBm + KdB − 10γ log₁₀(d/d₀) = 30 − 31.5 − 35 log₁₀(1000) = −106.5 dBm, about 45 dB below the free-space value. Free space assumes an unobstructed LOS path with γ = 2, whereas in an urban macrocell the power decays much faster (γ = 3.5) because of obstruction and reflections. Using free space would overestimate the received power by about 45 dB and give completely wrong coverage and outage results.

一句话：自由空间 Pr = PtGtGr(λ/4πd)²，用 20 log₁₀ 算，d、f 加倍各少 6 dB；它等于 γ = 2 的简化模型，城区 γ = 3.5 时 1 km 处要再低约 45 dB，所以题目说简化模型就绝不能用自由空间。
◆ 本题知识点
考什么
自由空间（Friis）公式及其 d⁻²、f⁻² 规律；和简化路径损耗模型的区别（第 2 章 p.3–4、p.8）。练习和历年卷没直接考过，但老师提醒过：往年 Quiz 有学生把简化模型的题用成了自由空间模型。
前置知识
Pr = PtGtGr(λ/4πd)²；λ = c/f；1 W = 30 dBm；简化模型 Pr,dB = Pt,dB + KdB − 10γ log₁₀(d/d₀)。
解题套路
(a) 先求 λ，dB 形式：Pr = Pt + 20 log₁₀(λ/4πd)；(b) 平方关系 → 每加倍一次 6 dB；(c) 代简化模型，和 (a) 比较。
关键数字
900 MHz、1 km：路径损耗 91.5 dB；γ = 2 时每 10 倍距离少 20 dB，γ = 3.5 时少 35 dB；1 km 处两模型差约 45 dB。
易错
题目写 simplified path loss model 就不能用自由空间；W 要换成 dBm；20 log₁₀ 而不是 10 log₁₀（λ/4πd 是幅度比，平方后才是功率比）。
直觉
自由空间是"什么都不挡"的理想情况，功率只按球面扩散减少；真实城区有遮挡和反射，衰减快得多。
联系
Part A 第五章（n = 2）；专项 Q2 双径（n = 4）；模拟 A · Q2（简化模型）。
Part 2 practice
Focused · Q2

Two-ray model: critical distance and d⁻⁴

Original question · bilingualFocused practice (self-written)

A base station antenna at height \(h_t=30\) m transmits 10 W at 900 MHz to a mobile antenna at height \(h_r=1.5\) m. Both antennas have unity gain. Use the two-ray model \(P_r\approx P_tG_tG_r\dfrac{(h_th_r)^2}{d^4}\) for \(d>d_c=\dfrac{4h_th_r}{\lambda}\).

基站天线高 \(h_t=30\) m，在 900 MHz 上发射 10 W，移动台天线高 \(h_r=1.5\) m，两根天线增益都是 1。当 \(d>d_c=\dfrac{4h_th_r}{\lambda}\) 时使用双径模型 \(P_r\approx P_tG_tG_r\dfrac{(h_th_r)^2}{d^4}\)。

(a) Find the critical distance \(d_c\). (2 marks)

(a) 求临界距离 \(d_c\)。（2 分）

(b) Find the received power at d = 5 km with the two-ray model, and compare it with the free-space value at the same distance. (4 marks)

(b) 用双径模型求 d = 5 km 处的接收功率，并和同距离的自由空间值比较。（4 分）

(c) Beyond \(d_c\), how does the two-ray received power change when (i) the distance is doubled, (ii) the carrier frequency is doubled, (iii) the base station antenna height is doubled? (4 marks)

(c) 在 \(d_c\) 以外，以下情况双径接收功率怎么变化：(i) 距离加倍；(ii) 载频加倍；(iii) 基站天线高度加倍？（4 分）

Two-ray modelCritical distance d_cP ∝ d⁻⁴Ch. 2 of the notes, p.5
What the question is asking: what does this question actually want?

ScenarioWhat the question is about

The two-ray model in Ch. 2 of the notes, p.5: besides the direct wave there is a wave reflected off the ground. Far away, the two waves are almost in antiphase and largely cancel, so the power falls faster than in free space, as d⁻⁴.讲义第 2 章 p.5 的双径模型：除了直射波，还有一条从地面反射过来的波。离得远时，两条波几乎反相，大部分互相抵消，所以功率比自由空间掉得快，按 d⁻⁴ 减少。

The question asks you to find the critical distance beyond which the d⁻⁴ formula applies, use it to compute the power far away, then see how the power changes with distance, frequency and antenna height.题目让你算出 d⁻⁴ 公式开始适用的临界距离，用它算远处的功率，再看距离、频率、天线高度变化时功率怎么变。

SymbolsWhat each quantity in the question means

\(h_t=30\) m, \(h_r=1.5\) mAntenna heights of the base station and the phone基站和手机的天线高度
\(d_c=4h_th_r/\lambda\)Critical distance: only beyond it does the power fall monotonically as d⁻⁴临界距离：比它远，才按 d⁻⁴ 单调下降
\(P_r\approx P_tG_tG_r(h_th_r)^2/d^4\)Far-field two-ray formula; it contains no λ远处的双径公式，里面没有 λ
10 W, 900 MHzTransmit power and carrier frequency发射功率和载频

What each part asksWhat each part is asking for

  • (a) Substitute into the formula to find the critical distance.(a) 代公式求临界距离。
  • (b) 5 km is far beyond the critical distance: use the two-ray formula for the received power, then compare with the free-space result at the same distance.(b) 5 km 比临界距离远得多，用双径公式算接收功率，再和同距离的自由空间结果比较。
  • (c) Look at the power to which d, λ and ht each appear in the formula: how many dB the power changes when the distance doubles, the frequency doubles, and the antenna height doubles.(c) 看 d、λ、ht 在公式里分别是几次方：距离加倍、频率加倍、天线加高一倍，功率各变多少 dB。

Watch outEasy ways to misread the question

  • When d is less than dc, you cannot use the d⁻⁴ formula.d 小于 dc 时不能用 d⁻⁴ 公式。
  • The far-field two-ray formula has no λ, so changing the frequency does not change the power.远处的双径公式里没有 λ，所以频率变了，功率不变。

PurposeWhat the question wants you to understand

Two-ray is an example of γ = 4, free space an example of γ = 2. Real environments usually lie in between, which is why γ in the simplified model has to be fitted from measurements.双径是 γ = 4 的例子，自由空间是 γ = 2 的例子；真实环境的 γ 常在两者之间，这就是简化模型里 γ 要靠实测拟合的原因。

In one line: find the critical distance of the two-ray model, use the d⁻⁴ formula for the power at 5 km and compare with free space, then see the effect of doubling the distance, the frequency and the antenna height.一句话：算双径模型的临界距离，用 d⁻⁴ 公式求 5 km 的功率并和自由空间比，再看距离、频率、天线高度加倍的影响。

Approach: Find the critical distance from λ; beyond it, use the two-ray formula directly (note that it contains no λ); for (c), read off the power of each quantity in the formula and convert to dB.

  1. (a) Critical distance: \(\lambda=c/f=3\times10^8/9\times10^8=0.333\) m; use the formula on Ch 2 p.5: \[d_c=\frac{4h_th_r}{\lambda}=\frac{4\times30\times1.5}{0.333}=\frac{180}{0.333}=540\text{ m}\]
  2. (b) Two-ray received power: first confirm the d⁻⁴ formula applies: 5000 m ≫ dc = 540 m ✓. With Gt = Gr = 1: \[\begin{aligned}(h_th_r)^2&=(30\times1.5)^2=45^2=2025\text{ m}^4\\d^4&=5000^4=6.25\times10^{14}\text{ m}^4\\P_r&=\frac{10\times2025}{6.25\times10^{14}}=3.24\times10^{-11}\text{ W}\\&=10\log_{10}\frac{3.24\times10^{-11}}{10^{-3}}\text{ dBm}\\&=-74.9\text{ dBm}\end{aligned}\] To convert to dBm, divide by 1 mW = 10⁻³ W.
  3. (b) Compare with free space: at the same 5 km: \[\begin{aligned}\frac{\lambda}{4\pi d}&=\frac{0.333}{4\pi\times5000}=5.31\times10^{-6}\\P_r&=10\times(5.31\times10^{-6})^2=2.81\times10^{-10}\text{ W}\\&=-65.5\text{ dBm}\end{aligned}\] The two-ray value is −65.5 − (−74.9) = 9.4 dB lower: far away the ground-reflected wave is almost in antiphase with the direct wave, so most of it cancels. Check: the ratio of the two is \(\big(\frac{4\pi h_th_r}{\lambda d}\big)^2=\big(\frac{565.5}{1667}\big)^2=0.115\), and \(10\log_{10}0.115=-9.4\) dB ✓.
  4. (c)(i) Double the distance: \(P_r\propto d^{-4}\), so the power becomes \(1/2^4=1/16\): \(10\log_{10}16=40\log_{10}2=12.0\) dB, 12 dB down (5 km → 10 km: −74.9 → −86.9 dBm). Free space would lose only 6 dB.
  5. (c)(ii) Double the frequency: the formula \(P_tG_tG_r(h_th_r)^2/d^4\) contains no λ, so the received power is unchanged (0 dB), whereas free space would lose 6 dB. Note that \(d_c=4h_th_r/\lambda\) doubles to 1080 m with the frequency; 5 km is still beyond dc, so the formula still applies.
  6. (c)(iii) Double the base station antenna height: \(P_r\propto h_t^2\), so the power becomes 4 times: \(10\log_{10}4=20\log_{10}2=6.0\) dB, 6 dB up. dc also becomes 1080 m, still well below 5 km. This is one reason base station antennas are mounted high.
(a) dc = 540 m; (b) −74.9 dBm, about 9.4 dB below free space (−65.5 dBm); (c) doubling distance −12 dB, doubling frequency no change, doubling antenna height +6 dB
Official answer: none (self-written practice question); all numbers checked by src/p2build/verify_mock.py
For d < dc the direct and reflected waves alternately add and cancel, so the power rises and falls with distance and the d⁻⁴ formula does not apply; only beyond dc does it fall steadily as d⁻⁴. This is the n = 2 (free space) and n = 4 (two-ray, far) of Part A Ch 5, and one reason why γ in the simplified model usually lies between 2 and 4.
Concept + step by step: two-ray model, critical distance, powers to dB知识讲解 + 详细解析：双径模型、临界距离与幂次换 dB

ConceptThe two-ray model: direct ray + one ground reflection

Ch 2 p.5: the receiver gets two signals, one direct (LOS) and one reflected once by the ground. Beyond the critical distance dc, the received power is approximately \(P_r\approx P_tG_tG_r\dfrac{(h_th_r)^2}{d^4}\), with \(d_c=\dfrac{4h_th_r}{\lambda}\). ht and hr are the antenna heights and λ the wavelength. Part A chapter 5 calls this "n = 4 at large distance"; free space is n = 2.讲义第 2 章 p.5：接收端收到两路信号，一路直射（LOS），一路经地面反射一次。超过临界距离（critical distance）dc 后，接收功率近似为 \(P_r\approx P_tG_tG_r\dfrac{(h_th_r)^2}{d^4}\)，\(d_c=\dfrac{4h_th_r}{\lambda}\)。ht、hr 是收发天线高度，λ 是波长。Part A 第五章把它说成"远处 n = 4"，自由空间是 n = 2。

In dB: Pr,dBm = Pt,dBm + Gt,dB + Gr,dB + 20 log₁₀(hthr) − 40 log₁₀d. Note: there is no λ in the far-distance formula; λ appears only in dc.取 dB 形式：Pr,dBm = Pt,dBm + Gt,dB + Gr,dB + 20 log₁₀(hthr) − 40 log₁₀d。注意：远处的公式里没有 λ，λ 只出现在 dc 里。

Beyond the slidesWhy it is d⁻⁴ far away (the slide gives only the result)

At a large distance the reflected path is only about 2hthr/d longer than the direct path, and the ground reflection flips the phase by about 180°, so the two rays are almost equal and opposite and mostly cancel. The amplitude of what is left is proportional to 1/d², so the power is proportional to 1/d⁴. For d < dc the two rays alternately add and cancel, the power oscillates with distance, and the d⁻⁴ formula does not apply.距离很远时，反射路径只比直射路径长约 2hthr/d，而且地面反射会把相位翻转约 180°，两路几乎等大反相、大部分抵消。剩下的差值幅度和 1/d² 成正比，功率就和 1/d⁴ 成正比。d < dc 时两路时而相加、时而抵消，功率随距离上下起伏，d⁻⁴ 公式不适用。

Step by step(a) Critical distance

λ = c/f = 3 × 10⁸ / (9 × 10⁸) = 0.3333 m
dc = 4 × 30 × 1.5 / 0.3333 = 180 / 0.3333 = 540 m

Why compute it first: the two-ray d⁻⁴ formula holds only for d > dc, so (b) and (c) both need to confirm the distance is beyond dc.为什么先算它：双径的 d⁻⁴ 公式只在 d > dc 时成立，(b)(c) 都要先确认距离在 dc 以外。

Step by step(b) At 5 km: two-ray vs free space

  1. Check the condition: 5000 m > 540 m, so the two-ray formula can be used.检查条件：5000 m > 540 m，可以用双径公式。
  2. Linear: 线性算：
    Pr = 10 × (30 × 1.5)² / 5000⁴ = 10 × 2025 / 6.25 × 10¹⁴ = 3.24 × 10⁻¹¹ W
  3. To dBm (10 W = 40 dBm), or check directly with the dB form: 换 dBm（10 W = 40 dBm），也可以直接用 dB 形式核对：
    10 log₁₀(3.24 × 10⁻¹¹) + 30 = −74.9 dBm
    dB form: 40 + 20 log₁₀45 − 40 log₁₀5000 = 40 + 33.06 − 147.96 = −74.9 dBm
  4. Free space at the same distance: 同距离自由空间：
    Pr = 40 + 20 log₁₀(0.3333 / (4π × 5000)) = 40 − 105.5 = −65.5 dBm
    two-ray is lower than free space by −65.5 − (−74.9) = 9.4 dB

Beyond the slidesThe general gap (obtained by dividing the two slide formulas yourself)

Two-ray ÷ free space = (4πhthr/(λd))² = (πdc/d)², so the difference = 20 log₁₀(d/(πdc)) = 20 log₁₀(5000/1696) = 9.4 dB. Beyond π dc ≈ 1.7 km the two-ray power is below free space, and every factor of 10 in distance adds another 20 dB to the gap.双径 ÷ 自由空间 = (4πhthr/(λd))² = (πdc/d)²，所以差值 = 20 log₁₀(d/(πdc)) = 20 log₁₀(5000/1696) = 9.4 dB。π dc ≈ 1.7 km 以外双径比自由空间低，而且距离每远 10 倍，多低 20 dB。

Step by step(c) Read off the powers, convert to dB

Method: if a quantity appears to the power n, doubling it changes the power by 10 log₁₀(2ⁿ) = n × 3.01 dB.方法：某个量在公式里是 n 次方，它加倍时功率变化 10 log₁₀(2ⁿ) = n × 3.01 dB。

ChangeTwo-ray (d > dc)Free space自由空间
(i) d doubledd⁻⁴ → −40 log₁₀2 = −12.04 dBd⁻² → −6.02 dB
(ii) f doubledno λ in the formula → unchanged (0 dB)公式里没有 λ → 不变（0 dB）λ² → −6.02 dB
(iii) ht doubledht² → +20 log₁₀2 = +6.02 dBindependent of height → 0 dB和高度无关 → 0 dB

Do not forget to check the condition: in (ii) doubling the frequency halves λ, so dc becomes 1080 m; in (iii) doubling ht also makes dc 1080 m. In both cases 5 km is still beyond dc, so the conclusions hold.别忘了检查前提：(ii) 频率加倍时 λ 减半，dc 变成 1080 m；(iii) ht 加倍时 dc 也变成 1080 m。两种情况 5 km 仍在 dc 以外，结论成立。

Intuition: raising the base station antenna increases the path-length difference between the two rays, so they cancel less and more power arrives; this is one reason base station antennas are mounted high.直觉：把基站天线架高，两条路径的长度差变大，抵消得少一些，收到的功率就多；这也是基站天线要装得高的原因之一。

PitfallsWhere marks are usually lost

  • Using the d⁻⁴ formula without first checking d > dc.没先检查 d > dc 就用 d⁻⁴ 公式。
  • Thinking the far-distance two-ray power depends on frequency: the frequency only affects dc.以为双径远处功率也和频率有关：频率只影响 dc。
  • Wrong dB coefficients: d⁻⁴ is −40 log₁₀d, (hthr)² is +20 log₁₀(hthr).dB 系数用错：d⁻⁴ 是 −40 log₁₀d，(hthr)² 是 +20 log₁₀(hthr)。
  • Not converting 10 W to 40 dBm, or forgetting the +30 when converting W to dBm.10 W 没换成 40 dBm；或者 W 换 dBm 时忘了加 30。
  • Using the wrong λ for dc (900 MHz corresponds to 1/3 m).算 dc 时 λ 用错（900 MHz 对应 1/3 m）。

ExamHow to write it in English

(a) λ = c/f = 0.333 m, so dc = 4hthr/λ = 4 × 30 × 1.5 / 0.333 = 540 m.

(b) Since d = 5 km > dc, the two-ray approximation applies: Pr = 10 × (30 × 1.5)² / 5000⁴ = 3.24 × 10⁻¹¹ W = −74.9 dBm. In free space, Pr = 10 × (0.333/(4π × 5000))² = 2.81 × 10⁻¹⁰ W = −65.5 dBm. The two-ray power is about 9.4 dB lower, because far from the transmitter the ground-reflected ray nearly cancels the direct ray.

(c) Beyond dc, Pr ∝ (hthr)²/d⁴ and does not depend on λ. (i) Doubling d reduces Pr by 40 log₁₀2 = 12 dB. (ii) Doubling the carrier frequency leaves Pr unchanged (only dc doubles to 1080 m, still below 5 km). (iii) Doubling ht increases Pr by 20 log₁₀2 = 6 dB.

In one line: first compute dc = 4hthr/λ and confirm d > dc; far away Pr ∝ (hthr)²/d⁴, independent of frequency; read off the powers in dB: doubling distance −12 dB, doubling frequency no change, doubling antenna height +6 dB.一句话：先算 dc = 4hthr/λ 并确认 d > dc；远处 Pr ∝ (hthr)²/d⁴ 与频率无关；看幂次换 dB：距离加倍 −12 dB，频率加倍不变，天线高度加倍 +6 dB。
◆ Key points
What it tests
The two-ray model: critical distance dc = 4hthr/λ and Pr ∝ (hthr)²/d⁴ far away (Ch 2 p.5). Not asked directly in the practices or past papers.
Background
λ = c/f; power in dBm = 10 log₁₀(W) + 30; powers to dB: if a quantity appears to the n-th power, doubling it changes the result by n × 3 dB.
Method
(a) Substitute into dc; (b) check d > dc, use the two-ray formula, then compare with free space; (c) read the powers of d, λ and ht: d⁻⁴ → −12 dB, λ⁰ → no change, ht² → +6 dB.
Key numbers
dc = 540 m; at 5 km two-ray −74.9 dBm, free space −65.5 dBm, a 9.4 dB difference.
Common mistakes
The d⁻⁴ formula is not valid for d < dc; the far two-ray formula has no λ, so the power does not change with frequency; antenna height enters squared.
Intuition
Far away the ground reflection is almost opposite in phase to the direct wave and cancels most of it, leaving a small difference, so the power falls faster than in free space; raising the antenna increases the path difference and recovers some power.
Link
Part A Ch 5 (n = 4); focused Q1 free space (n = 2); the derivation box in section 2.1 of the learning page.

思路：先由 λ 算临界距离；d 大于它时直接代双径公式（注意里面没有 λ）；(c) 看每个量在公式里的幂次，换成 dB。

  1. (a) 临界距离：\(\lambda=c/f=3\times10^8/9\times10^8=0.333\) m，代讲义第 2 章 p.5 的公式： \[d_c=\frac{4h_th_r}{\lambda}=\frac{4\times30\times1.5}{0.333}=\frac{180}{0.333}=540\text{ m}\]
  2. (b) 双径接收功率：先确认能用 d⁻⁴ 公式：5000 m ≫ dc = 540 m ✓。Gt = Gr = 1： \[\begin{aligned}(h_th_r)^2&=(30\times1.5)^2=45^2=2025\text{ m}^4\\d^4&=5000^4=6.25\times10^{14}\text{ m}^4\\P_r&=\frac{10\times2025}{6.25\times10^{14}}=3.24\times10^{-11}\text{ W}\\&=10\log_{10}\frac{3.24\times10^{-11}}{10^{-3}}\text{ dBm}\\&=-74.9\text{ dBm}\end{aligned}\] 换 dBm 时除以 1 mW = 10⁻³ W。
  3. (b) 和自由空间比：同样 5 km： \[\begin{aligned}\frac{\lambda}{4\pi d}&=\frac{0.333}{4\pi\times5000}=5.31\times10^{-6}\\P_r&=10\times(5.31\times10^{-6})^2=2.81\times10^{-10}\text{ W}\\&=-65.5\text{ dBm}\end{aligned}\] 双径低了 −65.5 − (−74.9) = 9.4 dB：远处地面反射波和直射波几乎反相，大部分互相抵消。自检：两者之比 \(\big(\frac{4\pi h_th_r}{\lambda d}\big)^2=\big(\frac{565.5}{1667}\big)^2=0.115\)，\(10\log_{10}0.115=-9.4\) dB ✓。
  4. (c)(i) 距离加倍：\(P_r\propto d^{-4}\)，功率变成 \(1/2^4=1/16\)：\(10\log_{10}16=40\log_{10}2=12.0\) dB，少 12 dB（5 km → 10 km：−74.9 → −86.9 dBm）。自由空间只少 6 dB。
  5. (c)(ii) 频率加倍：公式 \(P_tG_tG_r(h_th_r)^2/d^4\) 里没有 λ，所以接收功率不变（0 dB），而自由空间会少 6 dB。注意 \(d_c=4h_th_r/\lambda\) 随频率加倍变成 1080 m，5 km 仍在 dc 之外，公式仍然适用。
  6. (c)(iii) 基站天线加高一倍：\(P_r\propto h_t^2\)，功率变成 4 倍：\(10\log_{10}4=20\log_{10}2=6.0\) dB，多 6 dB。dc 也变成 1080 m，仍远小于 5 km。这是基站天线要架高的原因之一。
(a) d_c = 540 m；(b) −74.9 dBm，比自由空间（−65.5 dBm）低约 9.4 dB；(c) 距离加倍 −12 dB，频率加倍不变，天线高度加倍 +6 dB
官方答案：无（自编模拟题）。所有数字已用 src/p2build/verify_mock.py 验算。
d < dc 时直射和反射时而相加、时而抵消，功率随距离上下起伏，不能用 d⁻⁴ 公式；d > dc 才单调按 d⁻⁴ 下降。这就是 Part A 第五章说的 n = 2（自由空间）和 n = 4（双径远处），也是简化模型里 γ 常在 2 到 4 之间的原因之一。
知识讲解 + 详细解析：双径模型、临界距离与幂次换 dB

知识讲解双径模型：直射 + 一次地面反射

讲义第 2 章 p.5：接收端收到两路信号，一路直射（LOS），一路经地面反射一次。超过临界距离（critical distance）dc 后，接收功率近似为 \(P_r\approx P_tG_tG_r\dfrac{(h_th_r)^2}{d^4}\)，\(d_c=\dfrac{4h_th_r}{\lambda}\)。ht、hr 是收发天线高度，λ 是波长。Part A 第五章把它说成"远处 n = 4"，自由空间是 n = 2。

取 dB 形式：Pr,dBm = Pt,dBm + Gt,dB + Gr,dB + 20 log₁₀(hthr) − 40 log₁₀d。注意：远处的公式里没有 λ，λ 只出现在 dc 里。

课外补充为什么远处是 d⁻⁴（讲义只给结论）

距离很远时，反射路径只比直射路径长约 2hthr/d，而且地面反射会把相位翻转约 180°，两路几乎等大反相、大部分抵消。剩下的差值幅度和 1/d² 成正比，功率就和 1/d⁴ 成正比。d < dc 时两路时而相加、时而抵消，功率随距离上下起伏，d⁻⁴ 公式不适用。

详细解析(a) 临界距离

λ = c/f = 3 × 10⁸ / (9 × 10⁸) = 0.3333 m
dc = 4 × 30 × 1.5 / 0.3333 = 180 / 0.3333 = 540 m

为什么先算它：双径的 d⁻⁴ 公式只在 d > dc 时成立，(b)(c) 都要先确认距离在 dc 以外。

详细解析(b) 5 km 处：双径对比自由空间

  1. 检查条件：5000 m > 540 m，可以用双径公式。
  2. 线性算：
    Pr = 10 × (30 × 1.5)² / 5000⁴ = 10 × 2025 / 6.25 × 10¹⁴ = 3.24 × 10⁻¹¹ W
  3. 换 dBm（10 W = 40 dBm），也可以直接用 dB 形式核对：
    10 log₁₀(3.24 × 10⁻¹¹) + 30 = −74.9 dBm
    dB 形式：40 + 20 log₁₀45 − 40 log₁₀5000 = 40 + 33.06 − 147.96 = −74.9 dBm
  4. 同距离自由空间：
    Pr = 40 + 20 log₁₀(0.3333 / (4π × 5000)) = 40 − 105.5 = −65.5 dBm
    双径比自由空间低：−65.5 − (−74.9) = 9.4 dB

课外补充差值的一般式（由讲义的两个公式自己相除得到）

双径 ÷ 自由空间 = (4πhthr/(λd))² = (πdc/d)²，所以差值 = 20 log₁₀(d/(πdc)) = 20 log₁₀(5000/1696) = 9.4 dB。π dc ≈ 1.7 km 以外双径比自由空间低，而且距离每远 10 倍，多低 20 dB。

详细解析(c) 看幂次，换成 dB

方法：某个量在公式里是 n 次方，它加倍时功率变化 10 log₁₀(2ⁿ) = n × 3.01 dB。

变化双径（d > dc）自由空间
(i) d 加倍d⁻⁴ → −40 log₁₀2 = −12.04 dBd⁻² → −6.02 dB
(ii) f 加倍公式里没有 λ → 不变（0 dB）λ² → −6.02 dB
(iii) ht 加倍ht² → +20 log₁₀2 = +6.02 dB和高度无关 → 0 dB

别忘了检查前提：(ii) 频率加倍时 λ 减半，dc 变成 1080 m；(iii) ht 加倍时 dc 也变成 1080 m。两种情况 5 km 仍在 dc 以外，结论成立。

直觉：把基站天线架高，两条路径的长度差变大，抵消得少一些，收到的功率就多；这也是基站天线要装得高的原因之一。

易错常见丢分点

  • 没先检查 d > dc 就用 d⁻⁴ 公式。
  • 以为双径远处功率也和频率有关：频率只影响 dc。
  • dB 系数用错：d⁻⁴ 是 −40 log₁₀d，(hthr)² 是 +20 log₁₀(hthr)。
  • 10 W 没换成 40 dBm；或者 W 换 dBm 时忘了加 30。
  • 算 dc 时 λ 用错（900 MHz 对应 1/3 m）。

考试英文写法

(a) λ = c/f = 0.333 m, so dc = 4hthr/λ = 4 × 30 × 1.5 / 0.333 = 540 m.

(b) Since d = 5 km > dc, the two-ray approximation applies: Pr = 10 × (30 × 1.5)² / 5000⁴ = 3.24 × 10⁻¹¹ W = −74.9 dBm. In free space, Pr = 10 × (0.333/(4π × 5000))² = 2.81 × 10⁻¹⁰ W = −65.5 dBm. The two-ray power is about 9.4 dB lower, because far from the transmitter the ground-reflected ray nearly cancels the direct ray.

(c) Beyond dc, Pr ∝ (hthr)²/d⁴ and does not depend on λ. (i) Doubling d reduces Pr by 40 log₁₀2 = 12 dB. (ii) Doubling the carrier frequency leaves Pr unchanged (only dc doubles to 1080 m, still below 5 km). (iii) Doubling ht increases Pr by 20 log₁₀2 = 6 dB.

一句话：先算 dc = 4hthr/λ 并确认 d > dc；远处 Pr ∝ (hthr)²/d⁴ 与频率无关；看幂次换 dB：距离加倍 −12 dB，频率加倍不变，天线高度加倍 +6 dB。
◆ 本题知识点
考什么
双径模型：临界距离 dc = 4hthr/λ，远处 Pr ∝ (hthr)²/d⁴（第 2 章 p.5）。练习和历年卷没直接考过。
前置知识
λ = c/f；功率 dB = 10 log₁₀(W) + 30 dBm；幂次换 dB：x 的 n 次方，x 加倍就是 n × 3 dB。
解题套路
(a) 代 dc；(b) 确认 d > dc 后代双径公式，再和自由空间比；(c) 看 d、λ、ht 在公式里的幂次：d⁻⁴ → −12 dB，λ⁰ → 不变，ht² → +6 dB。
关键数字
dc = 540 m；5 km 处双径 −74.9 dBm，自由空间 −65.5 dBm，差 9.4 dB。
易错
d < dc 时不能用 d⁻⁴ 公式；双径远处的公式里没有 λ，频率变了功率不变；天线高度是平方关系。
直觉
远处地面反射波和直射波几乎反相，大部分抵消，只剩一点差值，所以比自由空间衰减得快；把天线架高可以拉大两条路径的差，收到的功率就多一些。
