Part 2 practice
Focused · Q3

Six channel effects in one scenario: path loss, shadowing, Rayleigh, Rician, flat/selective, fast/slow

Original question · bilingualFocused practice (self-written)

A mobile station is 1 km from a base station that transmits 1 W. The simplified path loss model applies with \(K_{dB}=-40\) dB, \(d_0=1\) m and γ = 3. The noise power at the receiver is −120 dBm. The system sends 10 k symbols/s on a 2 GHz carrier, the rms delay spread of the channel is 2 µs, and the mobile moves at 54 km/h.

移动台离基站 1 km，基站发射 1 W。适用简化路径损耗模型：\(K_{dB}=-40\) dB，\(d_0=1\) m，γ = 3。接收机噪声功率为 −120 dBm。系统在 2 GHz 载频上以 10 k 符号/秒发送，信道的 rms 时延扩展为 2 µs，移动台速度为 54 km/h。

(a) Find the average received power and the average SNR. (1 mark)

(a) 求平均接收功率和平均 SNR。（1 分）

(b) Log-normal shadowing with a standard deviation of 8 dB is present, and the receiver needs a received power of at least −110 dBm. Find the outage probability due to shadowing. (2 marks)

(b) 存在标准差为 8 dB 的对数正态阴影，接收功率至少要 −110 dBm。求阴影造成的中断概率。（2 分）

(c) Ignore shadowing. With no line of sight the multipath fading is Rayleigh, with the average SNR found in (a). The receiver needs an instantaneous SNR of at least 10 dB. Find the outage probability. (2 marks)

(c) 忽略阴影。没有直射径时，多径衰落为瑞利衰落，平均 SNR 为 (a) 的结果。接收机要求瞬时 SNR 至少为 10 dB。求中断概率。（2 分）

(d) A line-of-sight path now appears whose power is 4 times the total power of the scattered paths. Find the Rician K factor in dB and state, without calculation, how the outage probability of (c) changes. (2 marks)

(d) 现在出现一条直射径，其功率是所有散射路径总功率的 4 倍。求莱斯因子 K（dB），并定性说明 (c) 的中断概率会怎样变化（不用计算）。（2 分）

(e) Is the fading flat or frequency-selective? Justify. (1 mark)

(e) 衰落是平坦的还是频率选择性的？说明理由。（1 分）

(f) Is the fading fast or slow? Justify. (2 marks)

(f) 衰落是快衰落还是慢衰落？说明理由。（2 分）

Simplified path loss modelShadowing Q(margin/σ)Rayleigh 1 − e^(−γ₀/γ̄)Rician KFlat / selectiveFast / slowCh. 2 of the notes, p.8–36
What the question is asking: what does this question actually want?

ScenarioWhat the question is about

One phone, one base station, with the six channel effects of Ch. 2 put together: path loss sets the average power, shadowing makes it fluctuate slowly, and multipath (Rayleigh or Rician) makes it fluctuate fast. The other two parts ask whether the fading is flat or selective, and fast or slow.同一个手机、同一个基站，把第 2 章讲的六种信道效应放在一起：路径损耗定平均功率，阴影让它慢慢起伏，多径（瑞利或莱斯）让它快速起伏；另外两问判断衰落是平坦还是选择性、是快还是慢。

Each part looks at only one effect, with its own formula. The purpose of this question is to practise "first identify the effect, then choose the formula".每一问只看一种效应，用它自己的公式。这道题的目的就是练"先认出是哪种效应，再选公式"。

SymbolsWhat each quantity in the question means

\(K_{dB}=-40\) dB, γ = 3Parameters of the simplified path loss model简化路径损耗模型的参数
−120 dBmNoise power, used to convert the received power into an SNR噪声功率，用来把接收功率换成 SNR
σ = 8 dBStandard deviation of the shadowing (used only in (b))阴影的标准差（只用于 (b)）
10 dBMinimum instantaneous SNR required in the Rayleigh / Rician parts瑞利 / 莱斯部分要求的最低瞬时 SNR
KRician factor = direct-path power / scattered power莱斯因子 = 直射功率 / 散射功率
2 µs, 54 km/h, 2 GHzDelay spread, vehicle speed, carrier frequency: used to decide flat/selective and fast/slow时延扩展、车速、载频：用于判断平坦/选择性和快/慢

What each part asksWhat each part is asking for

  • (a) Path loss: find the average received power, then subtract the noise to get the average SNR.(a) 路径损耗：算平均接收功率，再减噪声得到平均 SNR。
  • (b) Shadowing: σ is given, so take margin ÷ σ and look up Q.(b) 阴影：有 σ，余量 ÷ σ，查 Q。
  • (c) Rayleigh: no σ, but an average SNR; use 1 − e−γ₀/γ̄ (divide linear values).(c) 瑞利：没有 σ，有平均 SNR，用 1 − e−γ₀/γ̄（线性值相除）。
  • (d) Rician: compute K from the power ratio (convert to dB); you only need to say qualitatively whether outage increases or decreases.(d) 莱斯：由功率比算 K（换 dB），只要定性说中断变大还是变小。
  • (e) Flat or selective: compare σ/Ts with 0.1.(e) 平坦还是选择性：σ/Ts 和 0.1 比。
  • (f) Fast or slow: find fm and TC, and compare with Ts.(f) 快还是慢：算 fm 和 TC，和 Ts 比。

Watch outEasy ways to misread the question

  • (b) and (c) both ask for an outage probability, but the formulas are completely different: shadowing uses Q, Rayleigh uses the exponential.(b) 和 (c) 都是中断概率，但公式完全不同：阴影用 Q，瑞利用指数。
  • In the Rayleigh formula, γ₀ and γ̄ must be linear values.瑞利公式里 γ₀、γ̄ 要用线性值。
  • (e)(f) are a separate issue from Rayleigh/Rician: the former describe how the fading relates to the signal, the latter describe the distribution of the amplitude.(e)(f) 和瑞利/莱斯是两回事：前者说衰落和信号的关系，后者说幅度的分布。

PurposeWhat the question wants you to understand

Each Ch. 2 effect has its own formula, so the first step is to recognise which one the question is about. Path loss, shadowing and multipath are three layers stacked on top of each other.第 2 章的效应各有各的公式，做题第一步是认出题目在问哪一种；路径损耗、阴影、多径是三层叠在一起的。

In one line: in one scenario, answer six parts using path loss, shadowing (Q), Rayleigh (exponential), Rician (K), σ/T_s and T_C in turn, to practise "identify the effect first, then choose the formula".一句话：同一场景依次用路径损耗、阴影（Q）、瑞利（指数）、莱斯（K）、σ/T_s、T_C 回答六问，练"先认效应再选公式"。

Approach: Each part isolates one effect and uses its own formula: path loss gives the mean; shadowing is Gaussian in dB, so use Q; Rayleigh SNR is exponential, so use 1 − e−γ₀/γ̄; Rician needs only K; flat/selective compares σ with Ts; fast/slow compares TC with Ts.

  1. (a) Average received power and SNR: \(P_t=1\) W = 30 dBm and \(\log_{10}(1000/1)=3\); use the simplified model (Ch 2 p.8): \[\begin{aligned}P_r&=P_t+K_{dB}-10\gamma\log_{10}\frac d{d_0}\\&=30-40-10\times3\times3=-100\text{ dBm}\end{aligned}\] Average SNR: dBm − dBm = dB, \(\bar\gamma=-100-(-120)=20\) dB, linear \(10^{20/10}=100\).
  2. (b) Shadowing outage: shadowing makes the received power in dB Gaussian, \(\mathcal N(-100,\ 8^2)\). Margin \(x=-100-(-110)=10\) dB (p.14–15): \[P_{out}=Q\Big(\frac x\sigma\Big)=Q\Big(\frac{10}{8}\Big)=Q(1.25)=0.106\] Q table: Q(1.25) = 0.1056, about 10.6%.
  3. (c) Rayleigh outage: in Rayleigh fading the instantaneous SNR is exponential, \(P_{out}=1-e^{-\gamma_0/\bar\gamma}\) (p.26, p.51). Convert the threshold to linear first: \(\gamma_0=10^{10/10}=10\): \[\begin{aligned}\gamma_0/\bar\gamma&=10/100=0.1\\P_{out}&=1-e^{-0.1}=1-0.905=0.0952\end{aligned}\] About 9.5%. Check: for small x, \(1-e^{-x}\approx x=0.1\), and the exact value is slightly smaller ✓.
  4. (d) Rician K factor: by definition (p.28), K = LOS power / scattered power \(=s^2/2\sigma^2=4\): \[K_{dB}=10\log_{10}4=6.02\text{ dB}\]
  5. (d) How the outage changes: it becomes smaller (below the 9.5% of (c)). Reason: a strong LOS path keeps the envelope away from 0, so deep fades are rarer and the SNR falls below 10 dB less often. The two limits (p.28): K = 0 reduces to Rayleigh, outage 9.5%; K → ∞ approaches AWGN, the SNR stays at 20 dB > 10 dB and the outage → 0.
  6. (e) Flat or selective: \(T_s=1/R_s=1/(10\times10^3)=100\ \mu\)s; rule of thumb (p.33): \[\frac{\sigma_{T_m}}{T_s}=\frac{2\ \mu\text{s}}{100\ \mu\text{s}}=0.02\lt0.1\] → flat fading: the delay spread is only 2% of a symbol, so there is almost no ISI.
  7. (f) Fast or slow: v = 54/3.6 = 15 m/s (p.34, p.36): \[\begin{aligned}f_m&=\frac{vf_c}{c}=\frac{15\times2\times10^9}{3\times10^8}=100\text{ Hz}\\T_C&\approx\frac1{f_m}=\frac1{100}=10\text{ ms}\end{aligned}\] \(T_s/T_C=100\ \mu\text{s}/10\text{ ms}=0.01\ll1\): the channel hardly changes during a symbol → slow fading (p.37). Together with (e): flat, slow fading.
(a) −100 dBm, 20 dB; (b) ≈ 10.6%; (c) ≈ 9.5%; (d) K = 6.0 dB, outage below 9.5%; (e) flat (0.02 < 0.1); (f) slow (TC ≈ 10 ms ≫ 100 µs)
Official answer: none (self-written practice question); all numbers checked by src/p2build/verify_mock.py
Rician numbers for reference (not in the slides; numerical integration; the quiz will not ask you to compute them): with the same 20 dB average and 10 dB threshold, K = 4 gives about 1.6% outage, K = 10 about 0.07%, and K = 0 returns exactly the Rayleigh 9.5%. The stronger the direct path, the fewer the deep fades.
Step by step: what each of the six effects covers and which formula it uses

TableThe differences at a glance

EffectDescribesRandom?FormulaUsed inMemorise?
Path lossLarge scale: mean power falls with distanceNo\(P_r=P_t+K_{dB}-10\gamma\log_{10}(d/d_0)\)(a) mean powerYes
ShadowingLarge scale: buildings and hills, slow fluctuation about the meanGaussian in dB\(P_{r,dB}\sim\mathcal N(\text{mean},\sigma^2)\)(b) Q(margin/σ), subtract in dBYes
RayleighSmall scale: multipath, no line of sightExponential SNR\(p(\gamma)=\frac1{\bar\gamma}e^{-\gamma/\bar\gamma}\)(c) 1 − e−γ₀/γ̄, divide in linearYes
RicianSmall scale: multipath plus a direct pathRician\(K=s^2/2\sigma^2\) (PDF given in the exam)(d) K, qualitativeKnow what K means
Flat / selectiveFrequency: echoes shorter or longer than a symbolA judgement\(\sigma_{T_m}/T_s\lt0.1\), or Bs < BC(e)Memorise 0.1
Fast / slowTime: does the channel change within a symbolA judgement\(f_m=vf_c/c\), \(T_C\approx1/f_m\)(f) Ts ≪ TC → slowWorth remembering

LayersThe first four stack on top of each other

The actual received power = the mean set by path loss (changes over hundreds of metres to kilometres) + the slow fluctuation of shadowing around it (changes when you pass a building, tens of metres) + the fast fluctuation of multipath (Rayleigh or Rician, changes within half a wavelength, about 7.5 cm at 2 GHz). A question usually asks about one layer at a time, so read carefully which one it means. (The comparison of the three scales is a supplement beyond the slides.)

PitfallsThe three pairs most often confused

  • Shadowing vs Rayleigh: shadowing gives σ (dB), so compute the margin in dB and use Q; Rayleigh gives an average SNR and no σ, so convert to linear, divide, and use the exponential formula. With the same 10 dB margin, shadowing (σ = 8 dB) gives 10.6% here and Rayleigh 9.5%, from completely different formulas.
  • Rayleigh vs Rician: Rayleigh is the special case of Rician with K = 0 (no direct path). The larger K, the stronger the direct path and the closer to no fading, so a line-of-sight path lowers the outage probability.
  • Flat/fast vs Rayleigh/Rician: independent questions. Flat/selective and fast/slow describe how the fading relates to the signal (are echoes long, does it change quickly); Rayleigh/Rician describe the distribution of the amplitude. A channel can be "flat, slow and Rayleigh" at the same time.

ExamCompact answer

(a) \(P_r=30-40-30\log_{10}1000=-100\) dBm; average SNR = −100 − (−120) = 20 dB.

(b) Shadowing makes the received power in dB Gaussian with mean −100 dBm and σ = 8 dB; margin = 10 dB, so \(P_{out}=Q(10/8)=Q(1.25)=0.106\).

(c) In Rayleigh fading the SNR is exponential: \(P_{out}=1-e^{-\gamma_0/\bar\gamma}=1-e^{-10/100}=0.0952\).

(d) K = 4 = 6.0 dB. The line-of-sight component makes deep fades less likely, so the outage probability is lower than in (c); K = 0 gives Rayleigh and K → ∞ gives AWGN.

(e) \(\sigma_{T_m}/T_s=2\ \mu s/100\ \mu s=0.02\lt0.1\): flat fading. (f) \(f_m=vf_c/c=100\) Hz, \(T_C\approx1/f_m=10\) ms ≫ \(T_s\): slow fading.

In one line: path loss sets the mean, shadowing uses Q (subtract in dB), Rayleigh uses 1 − e−γ₀/γ̄ (divide in linear), Rician is about K (K = 0 is Rayleigh), flat/selective compares σ with Ts, fast/slow compares TC with Ts.
◆ Key points
What it tests
The formula and use of each of six Ch 2 channel effects: simplified path loss (p.8), shadowing outage (p.12–16), Rayleigh outage (p.25–26), Rician factor (p.27–28), flat/selective (p.31–33), fast/slow (p.34–36).
Background
Path loss in dB (memorise); Pout = Q(margin/σ) (memorise); p(γ) = (1/γ̄)e−γ/γ̄ and 1 − e−γ₀/γ̄ (memorise); K = s²/2σ²; σ/Ts < 0.1 (memorise); fm = v fc/c, TC ≈ 1/fm.
Method
First identify which effect the part asks about, then use its own formula: σ given → Q; average SNR and no line of sight → exponential; line of sight with a power ratio → K; flat? → σ vs Ts; fast or slow? → TC vs Ts.
Key differences
Shadowing subtracts in dB (margin/σ), Rayleigh divides in linear (γ₀/γ̄); Rayleigh = Rician with K = 0; flat/fast describe how the fading relates to the signal, Rayleigh/Rician describe the amplitude distribution, and the two classifications are independent.
Common mistakes
Using the exponential formula for shadowing or Q for Rayleigh; putting dB values into the Rayleigh formula; K is a power ratio, so use 10 log₁₀; answering only one dimension of the fading type.
Numbers
Same 20 dB average, 10 dB threshold: Rayleigh 9.5%, Rician K = 4 about 1.6%, K = 10 about 0.07% (numerical, beyond the slides).
Link
Mock A·Q2 (shadowing), B·Q1 (Rayleigh), A·Q3 (flat / fast-slow), C·Q2 (fading type); the "which outage formula" table at the end of Ch 2 on the learning page.

思路：每一问只看一种效应，用它自己的公式：路径损耗给平均值；阴影在 dB 上是高斯，用 Q；瑞利的 SNR 是指数分布，用 1 − e−γ₀/γ̄；莱斯只看 K；平坦/选择性比 σ 和 Ts；快/慢比 TC 和 Ts。

  1. (a) 平均接收功率和 SNR：\(P_t=1\) W = 30 dBm，\(\log_{10}(1000/1)=3\)，用简化模型（讲义第 2 章 p.8）： \[\begin{aligned}P_r&=P_t+K_{dB}-10\gamma\log_{10}\frac d{d_0}\\&=30-40-10\times3\times3=-100\text{ dBm}\end{aligned}\] 平均 SNR：dBm − dBm = dB，\(\bar\gamma=-100-(-120)=20\) dB，线性 \(10^{20/10}=100\)。
  2. (b) 阴影中断：阴影使接收功率（dB）服从高斯 \(\mathcal N(-100,\ 8^2)\)。余量 \(x=-100-(-110)=10\) dB（p.14–15）： \[P_{out}=Q\Big(\frac x\sigma\Big)=Q\Big(\frac{10}{8}\Big)=Q(1.25)=0.106\] Q 表：Q(1.25) = 0.1056，约 10.6%。
  3. (c) 瑞利中断：瑞利衰落下瞬时 SNR 服从指数分布，\(P_{out}=1-e^{-\gamma_0/\bar\gamma}\)（p.26、p.51）。门限先换线性：\(\gamma_0=10^{10/10}=10\)： \[\begin{aligned}\gamma_0/\bar\gamma&=10/100=0.1\\P_{out}&=1-e^{-0.1}=1-0.905=0.0952\end{aligned}\] 约 9.5%。自检：x 小时 \(1-e^{-x}\approx x=0.1\)，实际值略小一点 ✓。
  4. (d) 莱斯 K 因子：按定义（p.28），K = 直射（LOS）功率 / 散射功率 \(=s^2/2\sigma^2=4\)： \[K_{dB}=10\log_{10}4=6.02\text{ dB}\]
  5. (d) 中断怎么变：变小（低于 (c) 的 9.5%）。原因：强直射径让包络很少接近 0，深衰落变少，SNR 掉到 10 dB 以下的概率下降。两个极端（p.28）：K = 0 时退化成瑞利，中断就是 9.5%；K → ∞ 时接近 AWGN，SNR 一直是 20 dB > 10 dB，中断 → 0。
  6. (e) 平坦还是选择性：\(T_s=1/R_s=1/(10\times10^3)=100\ \mu\)s，经验法则（p.33）： \[\frac{\sigma_{T_m}}{T_s}=\frac{2\ \mu\text{s}}{100\ \mu\text{s}}=0.02\lt0.1\] → 平坦衰落：时延扩展只占符号的 2%，几乎没有 ISI。
  7. (f) 快还是慢：v = 54/3.6 = 15 m/s（p.34、p.36）： \[\begin{aligned}f_m&=\frac{vf_c}{c}=\frac{15\times2\times10^9}{3\times10^8}=100\text{ Hz}\\T_C&\approx\frac1{f_m}=\frac1{100}=10\text{ ms}\end{aligned}\] \(T_s/T_C=100\ \mu\text{s}/10\text{ ms}=0.01\ll1\)，一个符号内信道几乎不变 → 慢衰落（p.37）。综合 (e)(f)：平坦慢衰落。
(a) −100 dBm，20 dB；(b) ≈ 10.6%；(c) ≈ 9.5%；(d) K = 6.0 dB，中断概率比 9.5% 小；(e) 平坦（0.02 < 0.1）；(f) 慢（T_C ≈ 10 ms ≫ 100 µs）
官方答案：无（自编练习题）。所有数字已用 src/p2build/verify_mock.py 验算。
莱斯的数值参考（讲义之外，数值积分计算，考试不会让算）：同样平均 20 dB、门限 10 dB，K = 4 时中断约 1.6%，K = 10 时约 0.07%，K = 0 正好回到瑞利的 9.5%。直射径越强，深衰落越少。
逐步详解：六种效应各管什么、用什么公式

总表一眼看清区别

效应描述什么随机吗公式本题怎么用背不背
路径损耗大尺度：平均功率随距离下降不随机\(P_r=P_t+K_{dB}-10\gamma\log_{10}(d/d_0)\)(a) 得平均功率背
阴影大尺度：楼、山遮挡，围绕平均值慢慢起伏dB 值高斯\(P_{r,dB}\sim\mathcal N(\text{平均},\sigma^2)\)(b) Q(余量/σ)，dB 上相减背
瑞利小尺度：多径叠加，没有直射SNR 指数分布\(p(\gamma)=\frac1{\bar\gamma}e^{-\gamma/\bar\gamma}\)(c) 1 − e−γ₀/γ̄，线性上相除背
莱斯小尺度：多径 + 一条直射莱斯分布\(K=s^2/2\sigma^2\)（PDF 考试给）(d) 算 K，定性比较懂 K 的含义
平坦 / 选择性频率维度：回声比符号短还是长是判断\(\sigma_{T_m}/T_s\lt0.1\)，或 Bs < BC(e)0.1 要背
快 / 慢时间维度：一个符号内信道变不变是判断\(f_m=vf_c/c\)，\(T_C\approx1/f_m\)(f) Ts ≪ TC → 慢建议记

层次前四个是叠在一起的

实际收到的功率 = 路径损耗定下的平均值（随距离变化，几百米到几公里才明显）+ 阴影在它周围的慢起伏（走过一栋楼、几十米才变）+ 多径造成的快起伏（瑞利或莱斯，走半个波长就变；2 GHz 时约 7.5 cm）。题目通常一次只让你考虑其中一层，所以要看清题目说的是哪一种。（三种尺度的直观比较是课外补充。）

易混最容易搞错的三组

  • 阴影 vs 瑞利：阴影给 σ（dB），在 dB 上算余量、用 Q；瑞利给平均 SNR，没有 σ，换成线性值后相除、用指数公式。同样 10 dB 余量，本题阴影（σ = 8 dB）中断 10.6%，瑞利 9.5%，公式完全不同。
  • 瑞利 vs 莱斯：瑞利是莱斯的特例（K = 0，没有直射）。K 越大，直射越强，越接近不衰落；所以有直射径时中断概率会下降。
  • 平坦/快慢 vs 瑞利/莱斯：两类问题互不相干。平坦/选择性、快/慢说的是"衰落和信号的关系"（回声长不长、变得快不快）；瑞利/莱斯说的是"幅度服从什么分布"。一个信道可以同时是"平坦、慢、瑞利"。

考试英文写法

(a) \(P_r=30-40-30\log_{10}1000=-100\) dBm; average SNR = −100 − (−120) = 20 dB.

(b) Shadowing makes the received power in dB Gaussian with mean −100 dBm and σ = 8 dB; margin = 10 dB, so \(P_{out}=Q(10/8)=Q(1.25)=0.106\).

(c) In Rayleigh fading the SNR is exponential: \(P_{out}=1-e^{-\gamma_0/\bar\gamma}=1-e^{-10/100}=0.0952\).

(d) K = 4 = 6.0 dB. The line-of-sight component makes deep fades less likely, so the outage probability is lower than in (c); K = 0 gives Rayleigh and K → ∞ gives AWGN.

(e) \(\sigma_{T_m}/T_s=2\ \mu s/100\ \mu s=0.02\lt0.1\): flat fading. (f) \(f_m=vf_c/c=100\) Hz, \(T_C\approx1/f_m=10\) ms ≫ \(T_s\): slow fading.

一句话：路径损耗定平均值，阴影用 Q（dB 相减），瑞利用 1 − e−γ₀/γ̄（线性相除），莱斯看 K（K = 0 就是瑞利），平坦/选择性比 σ 和 Ts，快/慢比 TC 和 Ts。
◆ 本题知识点
考什么
第 2 章六种信道效应各自的公式和用法：简化路径损耗（p.8）、阴影中断（p.12–16）、瑞利中断（p.25–26）、莱斯因子（p.27–28）、平坦/选择性（p.31–33）、快/慢（p.34–36）。
前置知识
路径损耗 dB 式（背）；Pout = Q(余量/σ)（背）；p(γ) = (1/γ̄)e−γ/γ̄ 和 1 − e−γ₀/γ̄（背）；K = s²/2σ²；σ/Ts < 0.1（背）；fm = v fc/c，TC ≈ 1/fm。
解题套路
先认题目在问哪种效应，再用它自己的公式：有 σ → Q；有平均 SNR、无直射 → 指数；有直射、给功率比 → K；问平坦 → 比 σ 和 Ts；问快慢 → 比 TC 和 Ts。
关键区别
阴影在 dB 上相减（余量/σ），瑞利在线性上相除（γ₀/γ̄）；瑞利 = 莱斯 K = 0；平坦/快慢是"衰落和信号的关系"，瑞利/莱斯是"幅度的分布"，两类互不相干。
易错
阴影题用了指数公式、瑞利题用了 Q；瑞利公式里代 dB 值；K 是功率比，换 dB 用 10 log₁₀；衰落类型只答一个维度。
数值感受
同样平均 20 dB、门限 10 dB：瑞利中断 9.5%，莱斯 K = 4 约 1.6%，K = 10 约 0.07%（数值积分，课外）。
联系
模拟 A · Q2（阴影）、B · Q1（瑞利）、A · Q3（平坦/快慢）、C · Q2（衰落类型）；讲解页第 2 章末尾"求中断概率用哪个公式"总表。
Past final exam
2023-24 S2Q1(a)12 marksQuiz scope
Topics: path loss in dB form · shadowing outage · flat/slow fading test · fade margin考点：路径损耗 dB 形式 · 阴影衰落中断 · 平坦/慢衰落判别 · 衰落余量
Original question (verbatim)

1. (a) A wireless channel can be modelled using a simplified path loss model, or a model incorporating the effect of shadowing, or a more complex fading model, depending on the types of the channels assumed.

(i) The path loss model that includes shadowing can be expressed as, Pr = PtK(d)−γψ where Pr and Pt are the received and transmitted signal power respectively, d is the distance between the transmitter and the receiver, K is a constant, γ is the path loss exponent, and ψ is a random variable due to shadowing. Convert this model into the dB form and use it to sketch a graph of path loss (in dB) versus distance (in dB) and indicate how KdB and γ fit in the graph.

(ii) For the model described in part (a)(i) above, if the mean value of Pr,dB is 10 dB higher than the minimum received signal power needed for non-outage, determine the maximum value of the variance of ψdB that will result in an outage probability lower than 1%.

(iii) A signal, s(t), with a symbol duration of 1 ms, is transmitted through a fading channel. The channel has a time invariant channel impulse response and a rms delay spread of 0.01ms. What is the fading type of this channel? Explain your answer.

(iv) Consider the Rayleigh fading channel. At an outage probability of ε, the outage capacity per Hz of the channel can be expressed as Cε = log2[1 + γ̄R ln(1/(1 − ε))] where γ̄R is the average signal to noise ratio for the fading channel. Determine the fade margin at an outage probability of 0.1%.

(12 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
(i) Take logarithms (convert to dB): Pr = PtK d−γψ is a product. Take 10 log₁₀ of both sides: multiplication becomes addition, and a power becomes a coefficient (10 log₁₀ d−γ = −10γ log₁₀ d):(i) 取对数（化成 dB）：Pr = PtK d−γψ 是乘积，两边取 10 log₁₀，乘法变加法，幂变系数（10 log₁₀ d−γ = −10γ log₁₀ d）：
Pr,dB = Pt,dB + KdB
    − 10γ log₁₀ d + ψdB
where KdB = 10 log₁₀ K and ψdB = 10 log₁₀ ψ. ψ follows a log-normal distribution, so ψdB ~ N(0, σ²ψdB), a zero-mean Gaussian random variable (notes Ch2 p.12).其中 KdB = 10 log₁₀ K，ψdB = 10 log₁₀ ψ。ψ 服从对数正态（log-normal）分布，所以 ψdB ~ N(0, σ²ψdB)，是零均值高斯随机变量（讲义 Ch2 p.12）。
2
(i) Write it as path loss and sketch it: path loss = transmit power − received power:(i) 写成路径损耗、画图：路径损耗（path loss）= 发射功率 − 接收功率：
PL,dB = Pt,dB − Pr,dB
   = −KdB + γ·(10 log₁₀ d) − ψdB
Take x = 10 log₁₀ d ("distance in dB") on the horizontal axis and y = PL,dB on the vertical axis. Without the random term this is the straight line y = −KdB + γx: slope = γ (each 10-fold increase in distance adds 10 dB to x and 10γ dB to the loss); the intercept = −KdB at d = 1 (x = 0). KdB is usually negative (e.g. −26.67 dB in notes p.10), so the intercept lies above the horizontal axis. ψdB scatters the measured points randomly on both sides of the line.横轴取 x = 10 log₁₀ d（"距离的 dB"），纵轴 y = PL,dB，去掉随机项就是直线 y = −KdB + γx：斜率 = γ（距离每大 10 倍，x 加 10 dB，损耗加 10γ dB）；d = 1（x = 0）处的截距 = −KdB（KdB 通常为负，如讲义 p.10 的 −26.67 dB，所以截距在横轴上方）。ψdB 让实测点随机散在直线两侧。
Horizontal axis: 10 log₁₀ d (in dB); vertical axis: path loss (dB). The line's intercept at d = 1 is −KdB and its slope is γ.横轴用 10 log₁₀ d（单位 dB），纵轴是路径损耗（dB）。直线在 d = 1 处的截距是 −KdB，斜率是 γ。
3
(ii) Write the outage probability: outage = received power below the threshold Pmin. Pr,dB = mean μ + ψdB is Gaussian with standard deviation σ = σψdB; σ² is the ψdB variance the question asks for (notes Ch2 p.14–15):(ii) 写出中断概率：中断（outage）= 接收功率低于门限 Pmin。Pr,dB = 均值 μ + ψdB，是高斯分布，标准差 σ = σψdB，σ² 就是题目要的 ψdB 方差（讲义 Ch2 p.14–15）：
Pout = P(Pr,dB < Pmin)
  = P(ψdB < −(μ − Pmin))
  = Q((μ − Pmin)/σ) = Q(10/σ)
The last step uses the symmetry of the Gaussian: P(ψdB < −x) = P(ψdB > x) = Q(x/σ). The question gives μ − Pmin = 10 dB.最后一步用了高斯分布的对称性：P(ψdB < −x) = P(ψdB > x) = Q(x/σ)。题目给出 μ − Pmin = 10 dB。
4
(ii) Invert the Q table to find σ: we need Q(10/σ) < 0.01. From the Q table, Q(2.32) ≈ 0.0102 and Q(2.33) ≈ 0.0099; interpolating gives Q⁻¹(0.01) ≈ 2.326. Q is a decreasing function, so a smaller Q value needs a larger argument:(ii) 查 Q 表反求 σ：要求 Q(10/σ) < 0.01。查 Q 表：Q(2.32) ≈ 0.0102，Q(2.33) ≈ 0.0099，插值得 Q⁻¹(0.01) ≈ 2.326。Q 是减函数，要 Q 值更小，自变量就要更大：
10/σ > 2.326
σ < 10/2.326 = 4.30 dB
σ² < 4.30² = 18.5 dB²
Check: with σ = 4.30 dB, 10/σ = 2.326 and Q(2.326) ≈ 0.0100, exactly on the 1% limit ✓. Any larger σ and the outage exceeds 1%.验算：σ = 4.30 dB 时 10/σ = 2.326，Q(2.326) ≈ 0.0100，正好在 1% 边界上 ✓；σ 再大，中断就超过 1%。
5
(iii) Frequency domain: flat or frequency-selective: compare the rms delay spread with the symbol duration (notes Ch2 p.33 rule of thumb: στ/Ts < 0.1 means flat fading):(iii) 频率维：平坦还是频率选择性：比较 rms 时延扩展和符号时长（讲义 Ch2 p.33 经验法则：στ/Ts < 0.1 为平坦衰落）：
στ/Ts = 0.01 ms / 1 ms = 0.01 < 0.1
So it is flat fading: the multipath echoes all arrive within 1% of a symbol duration, there is almost no inter-symbol interference (ISI), and the whole signal spectrum sees the same fading. In the frequency domain: the signal bandwidth is about 1/Ts = 1 kHz and the coherence bandwidth is of order 1/στ = 100 kHz, far larger than the signal bandwidth, so the conclusion is the same.所以是平坦衰落（flat fading）：多径回波在 1% 个符号时长内就到齐，几乎没有符号间干扰（ISI），整个信号频谱经历相同的衰落。换到频域看：信号带宽约 1/Ts = 1 kHz，相干带宽量级 1/στ = 100 kHz，远大于信号带宽，结论一样。
6
(iii) Time domain: fast or slow: the channel impulse response does not change with time (time invariant) → no Doppler spread → coherence time Tc → ∞. The 1 ms symbol duration is far shorter than Tc, so amplitude and phase stay constant within a symbol: this is slow fading (notes Ch2 p.37).
Conclusion: flat, slow fading. Judge the two dimensions separately: for frequency look at the delay spread; for time look at the Doppler spread / coherence time.(iii) 时间维：快还是慢：信道冲激响应不随时间变化（time invariant）→ 没有多普勒扩展 → 相干时间 Tc → ∞。符号时长 1 ms 远小于 Tc，一个符号内幅度和相位都不变，所以是慢衰落（slow fading，讲义 Ch2 p.37）。
结论：平坦慢衰落（flat, slow fading）。两个维度要分开判断：频率维看时延扩展，时间维看多普勒扩展 / 相干时间。
7
(iv) Derive the fade-margin formula: for a Rayleigh channel the CDF of the SNR is F(γ) = 1 − e−γ/γ̄R. Set F(γmin) = ε and solve for the lowest SNR allowed at outage probability ε (notes Ch2 p.51):(iv) 推衰落余量公式：瑞利信道 SNR 的 CDF 是 F(γ) = 1 − e−γ/γ̄R。令 F(γmin) = ε，解出中断概率为 ε 时允许的最低 SNR（讲义 Ch2 p.51）：
γmin = γ̄R ln(1/(1 − ε))
Cε = log₂(1 + γmin)
For the AWGN channel, C = log₂(1 + γAWGN). Equal capacities ⇒ γAWGN = γ̄R ln(1/(1 − ε)), so the fade margin is the extra average SNR the Rayleigh channel needs:AWGN 信道 C = log₂(1 + γAWGN)。两者容量相等 ⇒ γAWGN = γ̄R ln(1/(1 − ε))，所以衰落余量（fade margin）是瑞利信道要多给的平均 SNR：
FM = γ̄R,dB − γAWGN,dB
  = 10 log₁₀[1 / ln(1/(1 − ε))]
8
(iv) Substitute ε = 0.1%: ε = 0.001:
1/(1 − ε) = 1/0.999 = 1.001001
ln 1.001001 = 0.0010005
1/0.0010005 = 999.5
FM = 10 log₁₀ 999.5 = 30.0 dB
Self-check: for small ε, ln(1/(1 − ε)) ≈ ε, so FM ≈ 10 log₁₀(1/ε) = 10 log₁₀ 1000 = 30 dB ✓. The notes example with ε = 1% gives 20 dB; an outage target 10 times stricter needs 10 dB more margin ✓.自检：ε 很小时 ln(1/(1 − ε)) ≈ ε，FM ≈ 10 log₁₀(1/ε) = 10 log₁₀ 1000 = 30 dB ✓。讲义例子 ε = 1% 时是 20 dB；中断要求严 10 倍，余量多 10 dB ✓。
(ii) σ² < 18.5 dB² (σ < 4.3 dB) (iii) flat, slow fading (iv) fade margin ≈ 30 dB(ii) σ² < 18.5 dB²（σ < 4.3 dB） (iii) 平坦、慢衰落 (iv) 衰落余量 ≈ 30 dB
◆ Key points
What it tests
Path loss as a straight line in dB (slope γ, intercept −KdB), shadowing outage Q(margin/σ), flat / slow fading test, fade margin (Ch. 2 p.8–15, p.33, p.39, p.51).路径损耗的 dB 直线（斜率 γ、截距 −KdB）、阴影中断 Q(余量/σ)、平坦 / 慢衰落判别、衰落余量（第 2 章 p.8–15、p.33、p.39、p.51）。
Knowledge used
PL,dB = −KdB + 10γ log₁₀d − ψdB; Pout = Q(margin/σ); flat: στ/Ts < 0.1; FM = 10 log₁₀[1/ln(1/(1 − ε))].
Method
(i) Take logs, plot a straight line against 10 log₁₀d, mark the slope and intercept; (ii) Q(10/σ) < 0.01 → 10/σ > 2.33; (iii) for frequency, check στ/Ts; for time, check whether the channel changes with time; (iv) substitute ε directly.(i) 取对数，横轴用 10 log₁₀d 画直线，标出斜率和截距；(ii) Q(10/σ) < 0.01 → 10/σ > 2.33；(iii) 频率维看 στ/Ts，时间维看信道是否随时间变；(iv) 直接代入 ε。
Common mistakes
The intercept is −KdB (KdB is negative, so the intercept is a positive loss); (ii) asks for the variance, so write σ² < 18.5 dB²; "impulse response does not change with time" = no Doppler = slow fading.截距是 −KdB（KdB 为负，所以截距是正的损耗）；(ii) 问的是方差，要写 σ² < 18.5 dB²；"冲激响应不随时间变" = 没有多普勒 = 慢衰落。
Quick recall
The fade margin depends only on ε: 10⁻³ → 30 dB, 10⁻² → 20 dB, 5×10⁻³ → 23 dB. Each time ε gets 10 times smaller, the margin grows by 10 dB.衰落余量只看 ε：10⁻³ → 30 dB，10⁻² → 20 dB，5×10⁻³ → 23 dB。ε 每小 10 倍，余量多 10 dB。
Concept + Step by step: path-loss line, shadowing outage, fading type, fade margin

Concept① Why we put the path-loss model in dB

Path loss describes how signal power gets weaker with distance. The linear form Pr = PtK d−γψ is a product of several terms, which is hard to plot and to compute with; after taking 10 log₁₀ of both sides, products become sums, the power of d becomes a coefficient, and the whole model becomes a straight line (Ch. 2 of the notes, p.8–12).路径损耗（path loss）描述信号功率随距离变弱。线性形式 Pr = PtK d−γψ 是几个量相乘，不好画也不好算；两边取 10 log₁₀ 以后，乘法变加法，d 的幂次变成系数，整个模型就成了一条直线（讲义第 2 章 p.8–12）。

  • K: a constant that depends on the antennas and frequency, KdB = 10 log₁₀K, usually negative (e.g. −30 dB).K：和天线、频率有关的常数，KdB = 10 log₁₀K，一般是负数（例如 −30 dB）。
  • γ: the path loss exponent, 2 in free space, typically 3–5 in urban areas. Meaning: each time the distance grows 10 times, the loss grows by 10γ dB.γ：路径损耗指数（path loss exponent），自由空间是 2，城区一般 3–5。含义：距离每变成 10 倍，损耗多 10γ dB。
  • ψ: shadowing, caused by blocking from buildings and terrain. In dB, ψdB is a zero-mean Gaussian random variable with variance σ² (in dB²), which is why it is called log-normal shadowing.ψ：阴影衰落（shadowing），由楼房、地形遮挡造成。取 dB 后 ψdB 是零均值的高斯随机变量，方差 σ²（单位 dB²），所以叫对数正态（log-normal）阴影。

Lecturer's emphasis: memorise both the linear form and the dB form of the simplified path loss model; they are not given in the exam.老师课上强调：简化路径损耗模型的线性形式和 dB 形式都要背，考试不给。

Concept② The other three concepts in this question

ConceptCriterion / formulaNotes
Shadowing outage probability阴影中断概率Pout = Q((μ − Pmin)/σ)Ch. 2, p.14–15
Flat fadingστ/Ts < 0.1p.33
Slow fadingTs much smaller than the coherence time TCTs 远小于相干时间 TCp.37
Fade marginFM = 10 log₁₀[1/ln(1/(1 − ε))]p.51

Outage means the received power falls below the minimum power Pmin needed to work properly. Pr,dB is Gaussian, so "the probability of being below the threshold" is the area of the left tail of the Gaussian curve, written with the Q function: the further the threshold is from the mean (measured in units of σ), the less outage. The fade margin is how many dB more average SNR a Rayleigh fading channel needs, compared with an AWGN channel, to reach the same capacity at outage probability ε.中断（outage）就是接收功率低于能正常工作的最低功率 Pmin。Pr,dB 服从高斯分布，"低于门限的概率"就是高斯曲线左尾的面积，用 Q 函数写出来：门限离均值越远（以 σ 为单位计），中断越少。衰落余量是：在瑞利衰落信道里，平均 SNR 要比 AWGN 信道多给多少 dB，才能在中断概率 ε 下得到同样的容量。

Step by step(i) Convert to dB and plot

  1. What to do: take 10 log₁₀ of both sides. Why: the log splits the product into a sum and turns d−γ into −γ·10 log₁₀d. Result: Pr,dB = Pt,dB + KdB − γ·10 log₁₀d + ψdB.做什么：两边取 10 log₁₀。为什么：log 把乘积拆成和，把 d−γ 变成 −γ·10 log₁₀d。得到：Pr,dB = Pt,dB + KdB − γ·10 log₁₀d + ψdB。
  2. Path loss = transmitted − received: PL,dB = −KdB + γ·(10 log₁₀d) − ψdB.路径损耗 = 发射 − 接收：PL,dB = −KdB + γ·(10 log₁₀d) − ψdB。
  3. Plot: x-axis x = 10 log₁₀d ("distance in dB"), y-axis PL,dB. Without the random term this is y = −KdB + γx: slope γ, and at x = 0 (d = 1) the intercept is −KdB; measured points scatter above and below the line because of ψdB. Example: with γ = 3, going from d = 10 m to 100 m moves 10 dB along the x-axis and adds 30 dB of loss.画图：横轴 x = 10 log₁₀d（"距离的 dB"），纵轴 PL,dB。去掉随机项就是 y = −KdB + γx：斜率 γ，在 x = 0（d = 1）处截距 −KdB；实测点因为 ψdB 散在直线上下。例：γ = 3 时，d 从 10 m 到 100 m，横轴走 10 dB，损耗多 30 dB。

Step by step(ii) Upper bound on the variance of ψdB

  1. Write the outage probability: the mean is 10 dB above the threshold, so Pout = Q(10/σ).写中断概率：均值比门限高 10 dB，所以 Pout = Q(10/σ)。
  2. Look up the Q table in reverse: find Q(x) ≈ 0.01; the table gives Q(2.33) = 0.0099, so x ≈ 2.33 (exact value 2.326).倒查 Q 表：找 Q(x) ≈ 0.01，表中 Q(2.33) = 0.0099，所以 x ≈ 2.33（精确值 2.326）。
  3. Q is a decreasing function: for Pout < 0.01 you need 10/σ > 2.33.Q 是减函数：要 Pout < 0.01，就要 10/σ > 2.33。
σ < 10/2.326 = 4.30 dB
σ² < 4.30² = 18.5 dB²

Check: if σ = 5 dB, Q(10/5) = Q(2) = 0.0228, which is above 1%, so it indeed fails. The larger σ, the more widely the points scatter and the more often they fall below the threshold.检查：若 σ = 5 dB，Q(10/5) = Q(2) = 0.0228，大于 1%，确实不满足。σ 越大，点散得越开，掉到门限下面的机会越多。

Step by step(iii) Classify the fading along two dimensions

  1. Frequency dimension (delay spread vs symbol duration): στ/Ts = 0.01 ms / 1 ms = 0.01 < 0.1 → flat fading. Intuition: the multipath echoes smear over at most 1% of a symbol, so there is almost no ISI.频率维（时延扩展和符号时长比）：στ/Ts = 0.01 ms / 1 ms = 0.01 < 0.1 → 平坦衰落。直觉：多径回波最多只拖 1% 个符号，几乎没有符号间干扰（ISI）。
  2. Time dimension (how fast the channel changes vs symbol duration): the impulse response does not change with time, so there is no Doppler spread and the coherence time tends to infinity; Ts is much smaller than TC → slow fading.时间维（信道变化快慢和符号时长比）：冲激响应不随时间变，说明没有多普勒扩展，相干时间趋于无穷，Ts 远小于 TC → 慢衰落。
  3. Conclusion: flat, slow fading. The lecturer said when marking: answering only one dimension gets only half the marks.结论：平坦、慢衰落（flat, slow fading）。老师改卷时说过：只答一个维度只给一半分。

Step by step(iv) Fade margin

ln(1/(1 − 0.001)) = ln(1.001001) = 0.0010005
FM = 10 log₁₀(1/0.0010005) = 10 log₁₀(999.5) ≈ 30.0 dB

Calculator tip: for small ε, ln(1/(1 − ε)) ≈ ε, so FM ≈ 10 log₁₀(1/ε): ε = 10⁻² → 20 dB (the example in the notes), ε = 10⁻³ → 30 dB. Physical meaning: the average SNR of the Rayleigh channel must be 1000 times the minimum required SNR so that it drops below that minimum only 0.1% of the time.计算器提示：ε 很小时 ln(1/(1 − ε)) ≈ ε，所以 FM ≈ 10 log₁₀(1/ε)：ε = 10⁻² → 20 dB（讲义例子），ε = 10⁻³ → 30 dB。物理意义：瑞利信道的平均 SNR 要比最低需要的 SNR 高 1000 倍，才能保证只有 0.1% 的时间掉到最低值以下。

PitfallsWatch out for these

  • The intercept is −KdB (the y-axis is "loss"), not KdB.截距是 −KdB（纵轴是"损耗"），不是 KdB。
  • (ii) asks for the variance: write σ² < 18.5 dB², and also write σ < 4.3 dB.(ii) 问的是方差：写 σ² < 18.5 dB²，同时写出 σ < 4.3 dB。
  • Q(x) = 0.01 needs a reverse table lookup: find the number closest to 0.01 in the body of the table, then read off x.Q(x) = 0.01 要倒查表：在表的正文里找最接近 0.01 的数，再读出 x。
  • (iii) Answer both the frequency and the time dimension, and give the reason for each.(iii) 频率、时间两个维度都要答，并写出理由。
  • The ln in (iv) is the natural log, not log₁₀.(iv) 里的 ln 是自然对数，不是 log₁₀。

ExamHow to write it in English

(i) Taking 10 log₁₀ of both sides: Pr,dB = Pt,dB + KdB − 10γ log₁₀d + ψdB. The path loss in dB is PL,dB = Pt,dB − Pr,dB = −KdB + γ(10 log₁₀d) − ψdB. Plotting PL,dB against 10 log₁₀d gives a straight line with slope γ and intercept −KdB at d = 1 (0 dB). The shadowing term ψdB is a zero-mean Gaussian random variable, so the measured points scatter about this line.

(ii) Pr,dB is Gaussian with standard deviation σ (in dB). Pout = P(Pr,dB < Pmin) = Q((μ − Pmin)/σ) = Q(10/σ) < 0.01. From the Q-function table, Q(2.33) ≈ 0.01, so 10/σ > 2.33, σ < 4.30 dB, and the maximum variance of ψdB is σ² ≈ 18.5 dB².

(iii) στ/Ts = 0.01 ms / 1 ms = 0.01 < 0.1, so the delay spread is negligible compared with the symbol duration and there is no significant ISI: the channel is flat fading. The impulse response is time invariant, so there is no Doppler spread and the coherence time is much longer than Ts: the channel is slow fading. Hence it is a flat, slow fading channel.

(iv) To achieve the same capacity as the AWGN channel, the required fade margin is FM = 10 log₁₀[1/ln(1/(1 − ε))]. With ε = 0.001, ln(1/0.999) = 1.0005 × 10⁻³, so FM = 10 log₁₀(999.5) ≈ 30 dB.

In one line: in dB it is a straight line (slope γ, intercept −KdB); outage = Q(margin/σ), σ² < 18.5 dB²; answer both dimensions of the fading type (flat + slow); the fade margin depends only on ε, 0.1% → 30 dB.一句话：取 dB 后是一条直线（斜率 γ、截距 −KdB）；中断 = Q(余量/σ)，σ² < 18.5 dB²；衰落类型两个维度都要答（平坦 + 慢）；衰落余量只看 ε，0.1% → 30 dB。

Past final exam
2024-25 S2Q1(a)13 marksQuiz scope
Topics: reading a path-loss plot · symbol errors from LCR/AFD · water-filling power allocation考点：路径损耗图读数 · LCR/AFD 求误符号数 · 注水功率分配
Original question (verbatim)

1. (a) Mobile radio channels introduce path loss and fading to the transmitted radio signals.

(i) Consider the simplified path loss model, Pr = PtK(d)−3.5, where Pr, Pt, K, and d, are the received signal power, transmitted signal power, a constant, and distance between the transmitter and receiver, respectively. Using the dB form of the model, a plot of the path loss (in dB) versus log10(d) is shown in Figure 1 on page 2. Determine the values of A and B if KdB = −30 dB, where KdB is the value of K in dB.

Redrawn from the original Figure 1 (not to scale).按原卷 Figure 1 重画（不按比例）。

(ii) A fading channel has an average fade duration of of 6 × 10−6 second and a level crossing rate of 5. If the average fade duration covers exactly three (3) consecutive symbols, determine the symbol duration. If an error is assumed to have occurred in a symbol when more than half of the symbol lies within a deep fade, determine the average number of symbol errors per second.

(iii) The spectrum of a frequency selective channel is organized into three sub-bands. The signal-to-noise ratios (SNR's) of the sub-bands are 18dB, 10dB, and 3dB, respectively. The transmitted powers of the sub-bands are allocated using the formula below, Pi = P(1/γ0 − 1/γi) when γi ≥ γ0; Pi = 0 when γi < γ0 where P = 1W is the total power, γi and Pi are the signal-to-noise ratio and allocated signal power for the ith sub-band, and γ0 is a suitable threshold value. Determine the allocated powers for the three sub-bands.

(13 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
(i) Write it in dB form and find A: take 10 log₁₀ of both sides of Pr = PtK d−3.5 (notes Ch2 p.8, reference distance d₀ = 1 m):(i) 写成 dB 形式，求 A：Pr = PtK d−3.5 两边取 10 log₁₀（讲义 Ch2 p.8，参考距离 d₀ = 1 m）：
10 log₁₀(Pr/Pt) = KdB − 35 log₁₀ d
This is a straight line in log₁₀ d with slope −35 dB per decade of distance. In the figure the line falls to the right of A, so the vertical axis is 10 log₁₀(Pr/Pt) (more loss = lower). A is at d = 1 m, where log₁₀ 1 = 0:这是关于 log₁₀ d 的一条直线，斜率 −35 dB/十倍距离（per decade）。图中的线从 A 往右下降，说明纵轴画的是 10 log₁₀(Pr/Pt)（损耗越大越往下）。A 在 d = 1 m，log₁₀ 1 = 0：
A = KdB − 35 × 0 = −30 dB
So at 1 m the signal is already attenuated by 30 dB.即 1 m 处信号已经衰减 30 dB。
2
(i) Find B: the vertical drop from A to the horizontal axis is 88 dB. The line falls 35 dB for every 1 unit of log₁₀ d, so horizontally it must go:(i) 求 B：从 A 竖直落到横轴是 88 dB。直线每走 1 个单位的 log₁₀ d 就下降 35 dB，所以横向要走：
35 × B = 88 → B = 88/35 = 2.51
d = 102.514 ≈ 327 m
Self-check: the vertical coordinate of point B = −30 − 35 × 2.514 = −118 dB, exactly 88 dB below A ✓.自检：B 点纵坐标 = −30 − 35 × 2.514 = −118 dB，正好比 A 低 88 dB ✓。
3
(ii) Symbol duration: the average fade duration (AFD) τ̄ = 6 × 10⁻⁶ s covers exactly 3 symbols:(ii) 符号时长：平均衰落时长（average fade duration, AFD）τ̄ = 6 × 10⁻⁶ s，正好盖住 3 个符号：
Ts = τ̄/3 = 6 µs / 3 = 2 µs
Rs = 1/Ts = 5 × 10⁵ symbol/s
4
(ii) Symbols in error per fade: one fade lasts 3Ts. If the start of the fade is aligned with a symbol boundary, all 3 symbols lie entirely inside the fade and are all in error. If it is not aligned, the fade covers 2 whole symbols plus two "fragments" at the ends; the two fragments add up to exactly 1 Ts, so one of them must be more than half a symbol (exactly half each is the boundary case). Either way there are 3 symbol errors per fade.(ii) 每次衰落错几个符号：一次衰落长 3Ts。如果衰落起点和符号边界对齐，3 个符号整个落在衰落里，全错；如果不对齐，就是 2 个完整符号加头尾两个"碎片"，两个碎片长度之和正好是 1 个 Ts，必有一个超过一半（恰好各一半是边界情况）。两种情况都是每次衰落 3 个错符号。
5
(ii) Symbol errors per second: the level crossing rate (LCR) LZ = 5 per second, i.e. on average 5 fades per second. Use the formula (τ̄Rs) × LZ from the worked example in notes Ch2 p.46–47:(ii) 每秒误符号数：电平通过率（level crossing rate, LCR）LZ = 5 次/秒，即每秒平均 5 次衰落。用讲义 Ch2 p.46–47 例题的公式 (τ̄Rs) × LZ：
Symbol errors = 3 × 5 = 15 per second误符号数 = 3 × 5 = 15 个/秒
Self-check: fraction of time the signal is in a fade = LZτ̄ = 5 × 6 × 10⁻⁶ = 3 × 10⁻⁵; symbol error rate = 15/(5 × 10⁵) = 3 × 10⁻⁵. The two agree ✓.自检：信号处在衰落中的时间比例 = LZτ̄ = 5 × 6 × 10⁻⁶ = 3 × 10⁻⁵；误符号率 = 15/(5 × 10⁵) = 3 × 10⁻⁵，两者一致 ✓。
6
(iii) dB to linear: γ = 10dB/10; also compute the reciprocals:(iii) dB 化线性：γ = 10dB/10，顺便算出倒数：
γ₁ = 101.8 = 63.10, 1/γ₁ = 0.0158
γ₂ = 101.0 = 10, 1/γ₂ = 0.1000
γ₃ = 100.3 = 1.995, 1/γ₃ = 0.5012
7
(iii) Find the threshold γ₀: this is water-filling (notes Ch2 p.54). First assume that all three sub-bands get power, and use the total-power constraint ΣPi = P = 1:(iii) 求门限 γ₀：这是注水法（water-filling，讲义 Ch2 p.54）。先假设三个子带都分到功率，用总功率约束 ΣPi = P = 1：
Σ(1/γ₀ − 1/γi) = 1
3/γ₀ = 1 + 0.0158 + 0.1 + 0.5012 = 1.6170
1/γ₀ = 0.5390 → γ₀ = 1.855 (2.7 dB)
Check the assumption: the worst sub-band has γ₃ = 1.995 ≥ γ₀ = 1.855 ✓, so all three sub-bands stay on and you do not need to drop a sub-band and recompute (in the worked example on notes p.56, γ₃ < γ₀, so channel 3 has to be removed and the calculation repeated).检查假设：最差的 γ₃ = 1.995 ≥ γ₀ = 1.855 ✓，三个子带都该开，不用去掉子带重算（讲义 p.56 例题就是因为 γ₃ < γ₀，要去掉第 3 个信道再算一遍）。
8
(iii) Allocate the power + self-check: Pi = P(1/γ₀ − 1/γi), P = 1 W:(iii) 分配功率 + 自检：Pi = P(1/γ₀ − 1/γi)，P = 1 W：
P₁ = 0.5390 − 0.0158 = 0.523 W
P₂ = 0.5390 − 0.1000 = 0.439 W
P₃ = 0.5390 − 0.5012 = 0.038 W
Self-check: 0.523 + 0.439 + 0.038 = 1.000 W ✓. The better a sub-band's SNR, the more power it gets; the worst sub-band (3 dB) is only just above the threshold, so it gets very little.自检：0.523 + 0.439 + 0.038 = 1.000 W ✓。SNR 越好的子带分到的功率越多；最差的 3 dB 子带只比门限高一点，分到的很少。
(i) A = −30 dB, B ≈ 2.51; (ii) Ts = 2 µs, 15 symbol errors/s; (iii) P ≈ 0.523 / 0.439 / 0.038 W
Note: if you read the vertical axis as positive path loss −KdB + 35 log d, then A = 30 dB; but that line would rise. With the falling line in the figure, A = KdB = −30 dB. B is the same under both readings.注：如果把纵轴理解为正的路径损耗 −KdB + 35 log d，则 A = 30 dB；但那条线应该上升。按图中下降的线，A = KdB = −30 dB。B 两种理解都一样。
◆ Key points
What it tests
Reading a path-loss plot, symbol errors from AFD/LCR, water-filling (Ch. 2 p.8–10, p.42–47, p.54–57).路径损耗图读数、由 AFD/LCR 求误符号数、注水分配（第 2 章 p.8–10、p.42–47、p.54–57）。
Knowledge used
10 log(Pr/Pt) = KdB − 10γ log d; the vertical value at d = 1 m is KdB; slope −10γ dB/decade; symbol errors per second = LCR × errors per fade; water-filling formula.10 log(Pr/Pt) = KdB − 10γ log d；d = 1 m 处纵坐标就是 KdB；斜率 −10γ dB/十倍距离；每秒误符号 = LCR × 每次连错个数；注水公式。
Method
(i) intercept → A; drop ÷ slope → B; (ii) Ts = AFD/3, symbol errors = 5 × 3; (iii) first assume every sub-band gets power and solve for γ₀, then check.(i) 截距 → A；下降量 ÷ 斜率 → B；(ii) Ts = AFD/3，误符号 = 5 × 3；(iii) 先假设全部分功率求 γ₀，再检查。
Common mistakes
The slope is 10γ = 35 dB/decade; B is the value of log₁₀d (2.51), d ≈ 327 m; convert the SNRs 18, 10, 3 dB to 63.1, 10, 2.0 first.斜率是 10γ = 35 dB/十倍距离；B 是 log₁₀d 的值（2.51），d ≈ 327 m；SNR 18、10、3 dB 先换成 63.1、10、2.0。
Self-check
The three powers sum to 1 W; the worst sub-band gets the least power, but it is still positive (2.0 > γ₀ = 1.855).三个功率之和 = 1 W；最差子带的功率最小但为正（2.0 > γ₀ = 1.855）。
Concept + Step by step: reading the path-loss plot, LCR/AFD and water-filling allocation

ConceptThree tools

  • Path-loss plot (Ch. 2 of the notes, p.8–10): in dB, 10 log₁₀(Pr/Pt) = KdB − 10γ log₁₀d. With log₁₀d on the x-axis this is a straight line: at d = 1 the y-value is KdB, and the slope is −10γ (10γ dB more loss per decade of distance). Here γ = 3.5, so the slope is 35 dB per decade.路径损耗图（讲义第 2 章 p.8–10）：dB 形式 10 log₁₀(Pr/Pt) = KdB − 10γ log₁₀d。以 log₁₀d 为横轴是一条直线：d = 1 处纵坐标是 KdB，斜率是 −10γ（每十倍距离多损耗 10γ dB）。本题 γ = 3.5，斜率 35 dB/十倍距离。
  • Level crossing rate (LCR): the average number of times per second the signal envelope crosses a threshold downwards, i.e. how many "deep fades" start per second (p.40). Average fade duration (AFD): how long, on average, each drop below the threshold lasts (p.42). Their product = the fraction of time spent in a deep fade. The lecturer said in class that the LCR and AFD formulas are given in the exam, but you must be able to explain them.电平通过率（LCR，level crossing rate）：每秒信号包络向下穿过某个门限的平均次数，即每秒"深衰落"开始几次（p.40）。平均衰落时长（AFD，average fade duration）：每次掉到门限以下平均持续多久（p.42）。两者相乘 = 处于深衰落的时间比例。老师课上说 LCR、AFD 公式考试会给，但要会解释。
  • Water-filling (p.52–57): a frequency-selective channel is split into several subbands; with total power P fixed, allocate Pi/P = 1/γ₀ − 1/γi, and give nothing to subbands with γi < γ₀. Where the name comes from: treat 1/γi as the "height of the pool floor" and pour in a total of 1 unit of water; the water level is 1/γ₀, and the power each subband gets is the water depth. Good subbands have a low floor and deep water, so they get more. The lecturer said in class that this formula is boxed and must be memorised; Quiz Q3 this year tested water-filling.注水（water-filling）（p.52–57）：频率选择性信道分成几个子带，总功率 P 固定，按 Pi/P = 1/γ₀ − 1/γi 分配，γi < γ₀ 的子带不分。名字的来历：把 1/γi 看成"池底高度"，倒进总量为 1 的水，水面高度是 1/γ₀，每个子带分到的功率就是水深。好子带池底低、水深，分得多。老师课上说这个式子是框起来要背的，今年 Quiz 第 3 题就考了注水。

Step by step(i) Read A and B

  1. The line in the plot slopes down to the right, so the y-axis is 10 log₁₀(Pr/Pt) (smaller at larger distance).图中直线向右下降，说明纵轴是 10 log₁₀(Pr/Pt)（距离越远越小）。
  2. A is at log₁₀d = 0 (d = 1 m), where the y-value = KdB:
    A = −30 dB
  3. From A down to the x-axis is 88 dB in total, falling 35 dB per decade of distance:从 A 降到横轴共 88 dB，每个十倍距离降 35 dB：
    35 × B = 88 → B = 88/35 = 2.51 (d = 102.51 ≈ 327 m)

Step by step(ii) Symbol duration and symbol errors per second

  1. One average fade covers exactly 3 symbols:一次平均衰落正好盖住 3 个符号：
    Ts = 6 µs / 3 = 2 µs
  2. How many symbols are wrong in each fade: the fade lasts 3Ts. If it is aligned with the symbol boundaries, all 3 symbols are inside it; if not, it covers 2 whole symbols plus a piece at each end, and the two pieces together are exactly one symbol long, so one of them must be more than half a symbol. So about 3 symbols are wrong per fade.每次衰落里有几个错符号：衰落长 3Ts。如果和符号边界对齐，3 个符号全在里面；不对齐时是 2 个完整符号加头尾两段，两段合起来正好一个符号长，其中必有一段超过一半。所以每次约 3 个错符号。
  3. LCR = 5 per second:
    Symbol errors = 5 × 3 = 15 per second误符号数 = 5 × 3 = 15 个/秒

Check: symbol rate 1/2 µs = 5×10⁵ per second, fraction of symbols in error 15/(5×10⁵) = 3×10⁻⁵, exactly equal to LCR × AFD = 5 × 6×10⁻⁶ = 3×10⁻⁵ (the fraction of time in a deep fade). The two approaches agree.检查：符号率 1/2 µs = 5×10⁵ 个/秒，误符号比例 15/(5×10⁵) = 3×10⁻⁵，正好等于 LCR × AFD = 5 × 6×10⁻⁶ = 3×10⁻⁵（处于深衰落的时间比例）。两条思路一致。

Step by step(iii) Water-filling allocation

  1. dB to linear: 18 dB → 63.1; 10 dB → 10; 3 dB → 2.0.
  2. First assume all three subbands get power, add the three equations, ΣPi = P:先假设三个子带都分到功率，把三个式子相加，ΣPi = P：
    3/γ₀ − (1/63.1 + 1/10 + 1/2.0) = 1
    1/γ₀ = (1 + 0.0158 + 0.100 + 0.501)/3 = 1.617/3 = 0.539
    γ₀ = 1/0.539 = 1.855 (2.7 dB).
  3. Check the assumption: all three γi (63.1, 10, 2.0) are ≥ 1.855, so it holds. If some γi < γ₀, remove it and recompute with the remaining subbands.检查假设：三个 γi（63.1、10、2.0）都 ≥ 1.855，成立。如果某个 γi < γ₀，就把它去掉、用剩下的子带重算。
  4. Allocation:
    P₁ = 0.539 − 0.016 = 0.523 W; P₂ = 0.539 − 0.100 = 0.439 W; P₃ = 0.539 − 0.501 = 0.038 W
    Sum is 1 W ✓.

PitfallsWatch out

  • B is the value of log₁₀d (2.51), not d itself.B 是 log₁₀d 的值（2.51），不是 d 本身。
  • The slope is 10γ = 35 dB per decade, not 3.5.斜率是 10γ = 35 dB/十倍距离，不是 3.5。
  • In the water-filling formula the SNRs must be converted to linear first; after finding γ₀, always go back and check that every γi ≥ γ₀.注水公式里 SNR 必须先换线性；求完 γ₀ 一定要回头检查每个 γi ≥ γ₀。
  • P = 1 W, so Pi = 1/γ₀ − 1/γi is directly in watts; when P is not 1, multiply by P.P = 1 W，所以 Pi = 1/γ₀ − 1/γi 直接就是瓦数；P 不是 1 时要乘 P。

ExamHow to write it in English

(i) In dB form, 10 log₁₀(Pr/Pt) = KdB − 35 log₁₀d, a straight line against log₁₀d with slope −35 dB per decade. At d = 1 m, log₁₀d = 0, so A = KdB = −30 dB. The line falls by 88 dB from A to the horizontal axis, so 35B = 88 and B = log₁₀d = 2.51 (d ≈ 327 m).

(ii) The average fade duration covers three symbols, so Ts = 6 µs/3 = 2 µs. In each fade, three symbols (or, if not aligned, two full symbols plus a part of another lying more than half in the fade) are in error, so about 3 symbol errors occur per fade. With a level crossing rate of 5 fades per second, the average number of symbol errors is 5 × 3 = 15 per second.

(iii) The SNRs in linear values are γ₁ = 63.1, γ₂ = 10 and γ₃ = 2.0. Assuming all three sub-bands are allocated power, ΣPi = P gives 3/γ₀ − (1/63.1 + 1/10 + 1/2.0) = 1, so 1/γ₀ = 0.539 and γ₀ = 1.855. All γi ≥ γ₀, so the assumption holds. P₁ = 0.539 − 0.016 = 0.523 W, P₂ = 0.539 − 0.100 = 0.439 W, P₃ = 0.539 − 0.501 = 0.038 W (total 1 W).

In one line: A = KdB = −30 dB, B = 88/35 = 2.51; Ts = 2 µs, 5 fades per second × 3 = 15 symbol errors; for water-filling first find 1/γ₀ = 0.539, then allocate 0.523 / 0.439 / 0.038 W.一句话：A = KdB = −30 dB，B = 88/35 = 2.51；Ts = 2 µs，每秒 5 次衰落 × 3 个 = 15 个误符号；注水先求 1/γ₀ = 0.539，再分 0.523 / 0.439 / 0.038 W。

Past final exam
2025-26 S2Q1(a)12 marksQuiz scope
Topics: classifying fading with Bc, BD, Bs · LCR and consecutive symbol errors · fade margin考点：用 Bc、BD、Bs 判衰落类型 · LCR 与连续误符号 · 衰落余量
Original question (verbatim)

1. (a) (i) Explain how coherence bandwidth, doppler spread, and signal bandwidth can be used to determine the type of fading the signal is experiencing.

(ii) A wireless system transmits a signal over a fading channel. The signal has a symbol duration of 5 ms and the average fade duration has been estimated to be 20 ms. For a period of 10 seconds, deep fades have been observed to have occurred 40 times. Assume that whenever a deep fade occurs, the affected symbol will be in error. Determine the Level Crossing Rate and the average number of consecutive symbol errors per second.

(iii) For an outage probability of ε, the channel capacity of a Rayleigh fading channel can be expressed as, Cε = B × log2[1 + γ̄R ln(1/(1 − ε))] where B is the signal bandwidth and γ̄R = 25dB is the average signal to noise ratio (SNR). If ε = 0.005, determine the minimum SNR and the Fade Margin compared to transmission over an Additive White Gaussian (AWGN) channel.

(12 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
(i) First comparison: Bs vs Bc → flat / frequency-selective: the coherence bandwidth Bc is the largest frequency separation over which the channel frequency response is still correlated. It is set by the multipath delay spread: the larger the delay spread, the smaller Bc (notes Ch2 p.31–33).
• Bs < Bc: all frequencies within the signal bandwidth fade in essentially the same way → flat fading, with little spectral distortion; in the time domain this is equivalent to rms delay spread ≪ symbol duration (rule of thumb στ/Ts < 0.1).
• Bs > Bc: different frequency components fade differently → frequency-selective fading; in the time domain the delay spread is a significant fraction of the symbol duration, so each symbol spills into the next one, causing ISI.(i) 第一组比较：Bs vs Bc → 平坦 / 频率选择性：相干带宽（coherence bandwidth）Bc 是信道频率响应仍然相关的最大频率间隔，由多径时延扩展决定：时延扩展越大，Bc 越小（讲义 Ch2 p.31–33）。
• Bs < Bc：信号带宽内所有频率的衰落基本相同 → 平坦衰落（flat fading），频谱失真小；时域上等价于 rms 时延扩展 ≪ 符号时长（经验值 στ/Ts < 0.1）。
• Bs > Bc：不同频率分量衰落不同 → 频率选择性衰落（frequency-selective fading）；时域上时延扩展占符号时长相当一部分，前一个符号拖进下一个，产生 ISI。
2
(i) Second comparison: Bs vs BD → slow / fast fading: the Doppler spread BD = fm = fcv/c is caused by motion; the coherence time Tc ≈ 1/BD is the time over which the channel stays essentially unchanged (p.35–37). Since Bs ≈ 1/Ts, comparing bandwidths is the same as comparing durations:
• Bs ≫ BD (⇔ Ts ≪ Tc): the channel amplitude and phase hardly change within one symbol → slow fading.
• Bs comparable to or smaller than BD (Ts ≳ Tc): the channel changes within a symbol → fast fading.
Combination: the two tests are independent (one depends on the multipath delay, the other on the speed of motion); the figure on p.39 combines them into four classes: flat slow, flat fast, frequency-selective slow, frequency-selective fast. Example: BD ≪ Bs < Bc → flat slow fading.(i) 第二组比较：Bs vs BD → 慢 / 快衰落：多普勒扩展（Doppler spread）BD = fm = fcv/c 由移动造成；相干时间 Tc ≈ 1/BD 是信道基本不变的时长（p.35–37）。因为 Bs ≈ 1/Ts，比带宽就等于比时长：
• Bs ≫ BD（⇔ Ts ≪ Tc）：一个符号内信道的幅度、相位几乎不变 → 慢衰落（slow fading）。
• Bs 与 BD 相当或更小（Ts ≳ Tc）：符号内信道就在变 → 快衰落（fast fading）。
组合：两个判断互相独立（一个看多径时延，一个看移动速度），p.39 的图把它们组合成四类：平坦慢、平坦快、频选慢、频选快。例：BD ≪ Bs < Bc → 平坦慢衰落。
3
(ii) Find the LCR: the level crossing rate LZ = the average number of times per second that the signal crosses the threshold Zmin downwards (p.40). Each deep fade corresponds to one downward crossing, so simply divide the number of fades by the observation time:(ii) 求 LCR：电平通过率（level crossing rate）LZ = 信号每秒向下穿过门限 Zmin 的平均次数（p.40）。每次深衰落对应一次向下穿越，所以直接用次数除以观测时间：
LZ = 40 crossings / 10 s = 4 crossings/s
4
(ii) Number of consecutive symbol errors: the average fade duration (AFD) τ̄ = 20 ms and the symbol duration Ts = 5 ms; the question assumes every symbol inside a fade is in error, so each fade gives a run of consecutive errors:(ii) 连续误符号数：平均衰落持续时间（AFD）τ̄ = 20 ms，符号时长 Ts = 5 ms，题设衰落里的符号全错，所以每次衰落连错：
τ̄ / Ts = 20 ms / 5 ms = 4 consecutive symbol errorsτ̄ / Ts = 20 ms / 5 ms = 4 个连续错符号

There are 4 fades per second:
每秒有 4 次衰落：
Symbol errors per second = LZ × τ̄/Ts
= 4 fades/s × 4 symbols/fade = 16 symbols/s每秒误符号数 = LZ × τ̄/Ts
= 4 次/s × 4 个/次 = 16 个/s

The errors come in bursts: 4 bursts per second, 4 errors per burst.
Self-check: there are 1/Ts = 1/0.005 = 200 symbols per second in total, and 16/200 = 8%; the fraction of time the signal spends in deep fades = LZ × τ̄ = 4 × 0.02 = 0.08 = 8% (the AFD definition on p.42 used in reverse). The two agree ✓
错误成串出现：每秒 4 串，每串 4 个。
自检：每秒共 1/Ts = 1/0.005 = 200 个符号，16/200 = 8%；信号处在深衰落里的时间比例 = LZ × τ̄ = 4 × 0.02 = 0.08 = 8%（p.42 的 AFD 定义反过来用）。两者一致 ✓
5
(iii) Convert to linear: the SNR in the formula must be a linear value:(iii) 换线性：公式里的 SNR 必须用线性值：
γ̄R = 25 dB → 1025/10 = 102.5 = 316.2

1/(1 − ε) = 1/0.995 = 1.005025
ln(1.005025) = 0.0050125

(For small ε, ln(1/(1−ε)) ≈ ε = 0.005, which you can use as an estimate.)
（ε 很小时 ln(1/(1−ε)) ≈ ε = 0.005，可以用来估算。）
6
(iii) Minimum SNR: under Rayleigh fading the CDF of the SNR is F(γ) = 1 − e−γ/γ̄. Setting P(γ < γmin) = ε and solving gives γmin = F−1(ε), which is the term inside the log in the formula given in the question (notes Ch2 p.50–51):(iii) 最小 SNR：Rayleigh 衰落下 SNR 的 CDF 是 F(γ) = 1 − e−γ/γ̄。令 P(γ < γmin) = ε，解出 γmin = F−1(ε)，就是题中公式 log 里的那一项（讲义 Ch2 p.50–51）：
γmin = γ̄R ln(1/(1−ε))
= 316.2 × 0.0050125 = 1.585
→ 10 log₁₀1.585 = 2.0 dB

Meaning: with probability 1 − ε = 99.5%, the instantaneous SNR is at least 1.585 (2.0 dB), so Cε = B log₂(1 + 1.585) = 1.37B bit/s.
意思：以 1 − ε = 99.5% 的概率，瞬时 SNR 不低于 1.585（2.0 dB），所以 Cε = B log₂(1 + 1.585) = 1.37B bit/s。
7
(iii) Fade margin: to reach the same capacity Cε, an AWGN channel only needs γAWGN = γmin = 2.0 dB, whereas the fading channel needs an average of 25 dB. The difference is the fade margin (p.51):(iii) 衰落余量：AWGN 信道要达到同样的容量 Cε，只需 γAWGN = γmin = 2.0 dB；衰落信道却要平均 25 dB。差值就是衰落余量（fade margin）（p.51）：
FM = γ̄R,dB − γAWGN,dB
= 25 − 2.0 = 23.0 dB

Self-check: directly from the formula on p.51, FM = 10 log₁₀[1/ln(1/(1−ε))] = 10 log₁₀(1/0.0050125) = 10 × 2.300 = 23.0 dB ✓ (independent of γ̄R). The example on p.51 has ε = 0.01 → 20 dB; halving ε adds 3 dB of margin, which matches ✓
自检：用 p.51 的公式直接算，FM = 10 log₁₀[1/ln(1/(1−ε))] = 10 log₁₀(1/0.0050125) = 10 × 2.300 = 23.0 dB ✓（与 γ̄R 无关）。p.51 的例子 ε = 0.01 → 20 dB；ε 减半，余量多 3 dB，吻合 ✓
(ii) LCR = 4 /s; about 16 symbol errors per second (4 consecutive errors per fade) (iii) γmin ≈ 2.0 dB, FM ≈ 23 dB(ii) LCR = 4 /s；每秒约 16 个错符号（每次衰落 4 个连续错误） (iii) γmin ≈ 2.0 dB，FM ≈ 23 dB
◆ Key points
What it tests
Classifying the four fading types, LCR and consecutive symbol errors, fade margin (Ch. 2 p.39, p.42–47, p.50–51).四种衰落类型判别、LCR 与连续误符号、衰落余量（第 2 章 p.39、p.42–47、p.50–51）。
Knowledge used
Bs vs Bc: flat / frequency-selective; symbol duration vs coherence time Tc ≈ 1/BD: slow / fast; γmin = γ̄ ln(1/(1 − ε)).Bs vs Bc：平坦 / 频率选择性；符号时长 vs 相干时间 Tc ≈ 1/BD：慢 / 快；γmin = γ̄ ln(1/(1 − ε))。
Method
(i) Judge each dimension separately and combine them into four types; (ii) LCR = number of crossings / time, consecutive errors per fade = AFD / Ts; (iii) convert to linear → γmin → FM = γ̄ − γmin (dB).(i) 两个维度分别判断，组合成四类；(ii) LCR = 次数 / 时间，每次连错 = AFD / Ts；(iii) 换线性 → γmin → FM = γ̄ − γmin（dB）。
Common mistakes
Flat / frequency-selective and slow / fast are two independent dimensions; do not mix them in one comparison. LCR is "per second": 40 crossings / 10 s = 4 per second.平坦 / 频选和慢 / 快是两个独立的维度，不要混在一起比较；LCR 是"每秒"，40 次 / 10 s = 4 次/秒。
Quick recall
ε = 0.005 → FM = 23 dB, independent of the average SNR.
Concept + Step by step: fading types, LCR and fade margin

ConceptTwo independent dimensions of fading type

A wireless channel causes two kinds of "dispersion", and you judge them separately (Ch. 2 p.30–39):无线信道对信号有两种"色散"，要分开判断（第 2 章 p.30–39）：

  • Time dispersion (caused by multipath delay spread) → described by the coherence bandwidth Bc (Bc ≈ 1/στ; within this bandwidth all frequencies fade roughly alike). Compare it with the signal bandwidth Bs: Bs < Bc → flat fading; Bs > Bc → frequency-selective fading, which shows up as ISI in the time domain.时间色散（多径时延扩展引起）→ 用相干带宽 Bc 描述（Bc ≈ 1/στ，在这个带宽内各频率的衰落基本相同）。比较信号带宽 Bs：Bs < Bc → 平坦衰落（flat）；Bs > Bc → 频率选择性衰落（frequency selective），时域上表现为 ISI。
  • Frequency dispersion (Doppler spread caused by motion) → described by the Doppler spread BD, with coherence time Tc ≈ 1/BD (the channel is roughly constant over this time). Compare it with Bs: Bs ≫ BD (equivalently, symbol duration Ts ≪ Tc) → slow fading: amplitude and phase stay constant within one symbol; Bs not much larger than BD (Ts close to or larger than Tc) → fast fading (p.37).频率色散（移动引起的多普勒扩展）→ 用多普勒扩展 BD 描述，对应相干时间 Tc ≈ 1/BD（信道在这段时间内基本不变）。比较 Bs：Bs ≫ BD（等价于符号时长 Ts ≪ Tc）→ 慢衰落（slow），一个符号内幅度相位不变；Bs 不比 BD 大多少（Ts 接近或大于 Tc）→ 快衰落（fast）（p.37）。
Bs ≫ BD (slow)Bs close to BD (fast)
Bs < BcFlat slow fadingFlat fast fading
Bs > BcFrequency-selective slow fading频率选择性慢衰落Frequency-selective fast fading频率选择性快衰落

Lecturer's emphasis: when asked for the fading type you must answer both dimensions; answering only one gets half marks. Simple rule: "bandwidth within the coherence bandwidth → flat; symbol within the coherence time → slow".老师课上强调：问衰落类型必须两个维度都答，只答一个维度只给一半分；简单记法是"带宽在相干带宽以内就平坦，符号在相干时间以内就慢"。

ConceptDefinitions of LCR and AFD

Level crossing rate (LCR): the average number of times per second the signal crosses the threshold Zmin downwards (p.40). Average fade duration (AFD): the average time the signal stays below the threshold in each fade (p.42). The lecturer said a common mistake in this year's Quiz was this: when the question does not say Rayleigh fading, compute from the definition; do not use the Rayleigh formulas with fm and ρ.电平通过率（LCR，Level Crossing Rate）：信号强度每秒向下穿过门限 Zmin 的平均次数（p.40）。平均衰落时长（AFD，Average Fade Duration）：每次衰落中信号低于门限的平均时长（p.42）。老师说今年 Quiz 的常见错误是：题目没说瑞利衰落时，要按定义算，不能套含 fm、ρ 的瑞利公式。

ConceptOutage capacity and fade margin

Under slow fading, a small outage probability ε is allowed: ε = P(γ < γmin). With Rayleigh fading the SNR is exponentially distributed with CDF = 1 − e−γ/γ̄; solving gives γmin = γ̄ ln(1/(1 − ε)), and putting this into Shannon's formula gives the Cε in the question (p.50–51). γmin is "the SNR an AWGN channel needs for the same capacity". Fade margin = average SNR needed on the fading channel − SNR needed on AWGN (subtract in dB) = 10 log₁₀[1/ln(1/(1 − ε))], which depends only on ε. The lecturer said this formula is "a bit hard to remember, but try to memorise it".慢衰落下，允许一个很小的中断概率 ε：ε = P(γ < γmin)。瑞利衰落时 SNR 服从指数分布，CDF = 1 − e−γ/γ̄，反解得 γmin = γ̄ ln(1/(1 − ε))，代入香农公式就是题目给的 Cε（p.50–51）。γmin 就是"AWGN 信道要达到同样容量所需的 SNR"。衰落余量（fade margin）= 衰落信道需要的平均 SNR − AWGN 需要的 SNR（dB 相减）= 10 log₁₀[1/ln(1/(1 − ε))]，只和 ε 有关。老师说这个公式"有点难记，但要尽量记"。

Step by step(ii) LCR and consecutive symbol errors per second

  1. LCR from the definition:
    LCR = 40 crossings / 10 s = 4 per second
  2. Each fade lasts 20 ms on average and a symbol lasts 5 ms, so the number of consecutive symbols in error per fade is:每次衰落平均 20 ms，符号 5 ms，每次衰落连续错几个符号：
    AFD / Ts = 20 ms / 5 ms = 4 symbols
  3. Symbol errors per second:每秒误符号数：
    4 fades/s × 4 symbols/fade = 16 symbols/s (4 bursts per second, each of 4 consecutive errors)4 次/秒 × 4 个/次 = 16 个/秒（每秒 4 串，每串 4 个连续错误）

Sanity check: time spent in fades per second = LCR × AFD = 4 × 0.02 = 0.08 s (8%); symbols sent per second = 1/5 ms = 200, and 200 × 8% = 16, which matches.合理性检查：每秒处于衰落的时间 = LCR × AFD = 4 × 0.02 = 0.08 s（8%）；每秒发 1/5 ms = 200 个符号，200 × 8% = 16 个，和上面一致。

Step by step(iii) Minimum SNR and fade margin

  1. dB to linear: 25 dB → 102.5 = 316.2.
  2. ln(1/(1 − ε)) = ln(1/0.995) = 0.005013 (for small ε it is ≈ ε, a useful check).ln(1/(1 − ε)) = ln(1/0.995) = 0.005013（ε 很小时 ≈ ε，可用来检查）。
  3. γmin = 316.2 × 0.005013 = 1.585 → 10 log₁₀1.585 = 2.0 dB
  4. FM = 25 − 2.0 = 23.0 dB (= 10 log₁₀[1/0.005013])

Meaning: under Rayleigh fading the average SNR is 25 dB, but to stay out of outage 99.5% of the time, the usable capacity is only that of an AWGN channel with SNR 2 dB, Cε/B = log₂(1 + 1.585) ≈ 1.37 bit/s/Hz; the "wasted" 23 dB is the margin reserved for fading.含义：瑞利衰落下平均 SNR 是 25 dB，但为了保证 99.5% 的时间不中断，能用的容量只相当于 SNR 为 2 dB 的 AWGN 信道，Cε/B = log₂(1 + 1.585) ≈ 1.37 bit/s/Hz；"浪费"的 23 dB 就是为衰落留的余量。

PitfallsCommon ways to lose marks

  • (i) Comparing Bc with BD: in both dimensions you compare with the signal bandwidth Bs.(i) 拿 Bc 和 BD 互相比较：两个维度都是和信号带宽 Bs 比。
  • (ii) Writing LCR as 40 (forgetting to divide by 10 s), or using the Rayleigh LCR formula.(ii) LCR 写成 40（忘了除以 10 s），或者套瑞利 LCR 公式。
  • (iii) Multiplying by 25 dB without converting to linear; subtracting γmin from 25 dB without converting it back to dB.(iii) 25 dB 不换线性直接乘；γmin 不换回 dB 就和 25 dB 相减。

ExamHow to write it in English

(i) Two comparisons are needed. (1) Signal bandwidth Bs versus coherence bandwidth Bc (caused by multipath delay spread): if Bs < Bc, all frequency components fade together and the signal experiences flat fading; if Bs > Bc, different frequencies fade differently, i.e. frequency-selective fading, which causes ISI. (2) Signal bandwidth Bs versus Doppler spread BD (caused by motion): if Bs ≫ BD (symbol duration much shorter than the coherence time Tc ≈ 1/BD), the channel is constant over a symbol and the fading is slow; otherwise the amplitude and phase change within a symbol and the fading is fast. Combining both gives flat slow, flat fast, frequency-selective slow or frequency-selective fast fading.

(ii) LCR = number of downward crossings per second = 40/10 = 4 crossings/s. Each fade lasts 20 ms on average, i.e. 20/5 = 4 consecutive symbols in error per fade. Number of symbol errors per second = 4 × 4 = 16 (4 bursts of 4 consecutive errors).

(iii) γ̄R = 25 dB = 316.2. Minimum SNR: γmin = γ̄R ln(1/(1 − ε)) = 316.2 × ln(1/0.995) = 316.2 × 0.005013 = 1.585 (2.0 dB). This is the SNR an AWGN channel needs to achieve the same capacity. Fade margin = 25 − 2.0 = 23.0 dB = 10 log₁₀[1/ln(1/(1 − ε))].

In one line: Bs vs Bc decides flat/frequency-selective, Bs vs BD decides slow/fast; LCR = 4/s, 4 consecutive errors per fade, 16 per second; γmin ≈ 2.0 dB, fade margin 23 dB.一句话：Bs 比 Bc 判平坦/频选，Bs 比 BD 判慢/快；LCR = 4/s，每次连错 4 个，每秒 16 个；γmin ≈ 2.0 dB，衰落余量 23 dB。

Ch. 3 · Signal detection: recognising symbols in a pile of noisy waveforms
