    (8−r)(4−r)8×47×36×25×14×0
    d32211250
    d ≥ 3？✓✓✓✓✗
    r 每加 1，d 就下降：多发一路数据流，就少一些抗衰落的能力。
  4. (a) 选最大的 r：r = 3 时 d = 5 ≥ 3 ✓；r = 4 时 d = 0 < 3 ✗。所以 r = 3。
  5. (a) 算速率：由复用增益（multiplexing gain）的定义 \(r=R/\log_2\mathrm{SNR}\)（讲义 p.32），\(R=r\log_2\gamma\)。\(\log_2 10=1/0.301=3.32\)（因为 \(\log_{10}10=1\)）： \[R=3\times3.32=9.96\ \text{bit/s/Hz}\] 精确值 3 × 3.3219 = 9.966，官方按 3.32 算得 9.96。自检：上限 \(r_{\max}\log_2\gamma=4\times3.32=13.3\) bit/s/Hz，9.96 在上限之下 ✓。
  6. (b) 误码率：r = 3 → \(d(3)=(8-3)(4-3)=5\) → \(P_e=\gamma^{-5}=10^{-5}\)。自检：\(10^{-5}\le10^{-3}\) ✓。比要求好两个数量级，因为 r 只能取整数，d 从 5 直接跳到 0，没有正好 d = 3 的点。
(a) ≈ 9.96 bit/s/Hz；(b) Pe = 10⁻⁵
官方答案：9.96 bits/s/Hz；10⁻⁵ ✓
知识讲解 + 详细解析：分集-复用折中求速率和 P_e

知识讲解分集增益 d 和复用增益 r

N 发 M 收的 MIMO 有两种用法（第 4 章 p.31–33）：

  • 分集（diversity）：同一份数据走很多条独立路径，求"稳"。用分集增益 d 衡量：高 SNR 时 Pe ≈ SNR−d，d 越大，SNR 每提高一点误码率降得越快。最大 d = N × M。
  • 复用（multiplexing）：同时发几路不同的数据，求"快"。用复用增益 r 衡量：速率 R = r·log₂SNR（bit/s/Hz），相当于同时有 r 路数据，每路 log₂SNR。最大 r = min(N, M)，因为高 SNR 时容量 C ≈ min(N, M)·log₂SNR（p.31）。

两者不能同时拉满：天线资源用来"多传"就不能全用来"传得稳"。题目给的折中曲线 d(r) = (N − r)(M − r)（p.33）：r = 0 时 d = N × M（全分集），r = min(N, M) 时 d = 0（全复用）。老师课上强调：这只是其中一种折中关系，r、d 都取整数，画出来是离散的点。

本题的解题思路就是"把题目给的符号连起来"（老师讲 p.34 例题时的说法）：Pe 的要求 → 最小 d → 最大 r → 速率 R。

详细解析(a) 由误码率要求定出 r

  1. dB 换线性。为什么：公式 Pe = γ−d 里的 γ 是线性值。γ = 1010/10 = 10。
  2. 求 d 的下限。10−d ≤ 10−3 ⇔ −d ≤ −3 ⇔ d ≥ 3。一般情况：d ≥ log(1/Pe,目标) / log γ = 3/1 = 3。
  3. 找满足 d ≥ 3 的最大 r。两种做法：
    r01234
    d = (8 − r)(4 − r)32211250
    逐个列表：r = 3 时 d = 5 ≥ 3，r = 4 时 d = 0，不行。老师的做法：解 (8 − r)(4 − r) = 3，即 r² − 12r + 29 = 0，r = 6 ± √7 ≈ 3.35 或 8.65。8.65 超过 min(N, M) = 4，舍去；在 0 ≤ r ≤ 4 内 d 随 r 增大而减小，所以要 r ≤ 3.35，取整数 r = 3。
  4. 算速率。由定义 r = R/log₂SNR：
    R = r·log₂γ = 3 × log₂10 = 3 × 3.32 = 9.97 bit/s/Hz
    log₂10 = 1/0.301 = 3.32。精确值 3 × 3.3219 = 9.966，官方答案写 9.96（截断），写 9.97 或 9.96 都对。

详细解析(b) 代回去求实际误码率

r = 3 → d = (8 − 3)(4 − 3) = 5 → Pe = γ−d = 10−5。比要求的 10−3 还好，因为 r 只能取整数，从 3.35 退到 3，多出来的分集就变成了更低的误码率。

自检合理吗

  • r = 3 ≤ min(8, 4) = 4 ✓；d = 5 ≤ N × M = 32 ✓。
  • 如果取 r = 4：R = 4 × 3.32 = 13.3 bit/s/Hz 更快，但 d = 0，误码率不随 SNR 下降，不满足要求。
  • 如果取 r = 2：d = 12，Pe = 10−12 很稳，但 R = 6.64 bit/s/Hz，浪费了速率。

易错常见丢分点

  • SNR 没换成线性值（10 dB → 10）。
  • d 必须是整数：d ≥ 3 时 r 要向下取整到 3，不能取 3.35。
  • 二次方程的另一个根 8.65 超出 min(N, M)，没有意义。
  • R 用 log₂，不是 log₁₀ 或 ln。
  • (b) 问的是用 r = 3 实际得到的 Pe（10−5），不是题目要求的 10−3。

考试英文写法

(a) γ = 10 dB = 10. \(P_e=\gamma^{-d}\le10^{-3}\Rightarrow10^{-d}\le10^{-3}\Rightarrow d\ge3\).

With N = 8, M = 4: d(r) = (8 − r)(4 − r) gives d = 32, 21, 12, 5, 0 for r = 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 (r ≤ min(N, M) = 4, integer). The largest r with d ≥ 3 is r = 3.

Since \(r=R/\log_2\mathrm{SNR}\), the maximum rate is \(R=r\log_2\gamma=3\log_210\approx9.97\) bit/s/Hz.

(b) With r = 3, d = (8 − 3)(4 − 3) = 5, so \(P_e=\gamma^{-5}=10^{-5}\).

一句话：10 dB → 10，Pe ≤ 10⁻³ 要求 d ≥ 3 → d(r) = (8 − r)(4 − r) ≥ 3 的最大整数 r = 3 → R = 3 log₂10 ≈ 9.97 bit/s/Hz，d(3) = 5 → Pe = 10⁻⁵。
◆ 本题知识点
考什么
分集-复用折中：d(r) = (N − r)(M − r)，速率 R = r log₂SNR（第 4 章 p.31–34）。
前置知识
分集增益 d：SNR 翻倍时误码率降多快，最大 N × M；复用增益 r：SNR 翻倍时速率多几 bit/s/Hz，最大 min(N, M)。
解题套路
① 由 Pe = γ−d ≤ 目标求 d 的下限；② 列 r = 0 … min(N, M) 对应的 d；③ 找满足条件的最大 r；④ R = r log₂γ，Pe = γ−d(r)。
关键数字
γ = 10 → d ≥ 3；d(3) = 5 ≥ 3，d(4) = 0 < 3 → r = 3；R = 3 × 3.32 = 9.97 bit/s/Hz，Pe = 10⁻⁵。
易错
SNR 用线性值（10 dB → 10，20 dB → 100）；d 必须是整数，向上取；r 不能超过 min(N, M) = 4。
举一反三
SNR = 20 dB（100）时：100−d ≤ 10⁻³ → d ≥ 1.5 → 取 2；r = 3 的 d = 5 仍满足，r = 4 不行 → R = 3 log₂100 = 19.9 bit/s/Hz。已知 Pe 和 d 求 SNR：SNR = Pe−1/d。
物理意义
r 是同时传输的独立数据流个数，d 是抗衰落能力；天线资源要么用来"多传"，要么用来"传得稳"。
▶ Lecturer's emphasis in class · Part 2 Week 12 recording
  • The lecturer's solution: from Pe ≤ 10⁻³ and SNR = 10, d = 3; solving (8 − r)(4 − r) = 3 gives r ≈ 3.35 or 8.65. r cannot exceed min(N, M) = 4 and must be an integer, so r = 3; then use the standard formula for the maximum rate. (b) Put r = 3 back into the trade-off formula to get d, then find the new error rate.老师的解法：由 Pe ≤ 10⁻³、SNR = 10 得 d = 3；解 (8 − r)(4 − r) = 3 得 r ≈ 3.35 或 8.65。r 不能超过 min(N, M) = 4，又要取整数，所以 r = 3，再用标准公式算最高速率。(b) 把 r = 3 代回折中公式求 d，再求新的误码率。
Past final exam
2023-24 S2Q1(b)(ii)–(iv)(b) 13 marks in total
Topics: spatial multiplexing · multiplexing gain min(N,M) · Alamouti orthogonality and diversity gain考点：空间复用 · 复用增益 min(N,M) · Alamouti 正交性与分集增益
Original question (verbatim)

(ii) Briefly describe the basic principle of the spatial multiplexing scheme and the mathematical relationship between the number of transmit antennas and the number of receive antennas for the scheme. For a MIMO system with 3 transmit antennas and 5 receive antennas, find the maximum possible multiplexing gain.

(iii) A Space-Time Block Coding system uses 2 transmit antennas and 2 time slots to transmit 2 complex symbols, s1 and s2. The code can be represented by the matrix X = ( s1 −s2* ; s2 s1* ) where s1 and s1 are the two transmitted symbols, and s1* and s2* are the complex conjugates of s1 and s1 respectively. Show that this is or is not an orthogonal space time block code.

(iv) Does the Alamouti code have diversity gain? Explain your answer.

(13 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
(ii) Principle of spatial multiplexing (notes Ch4 p.30): split the data into N streams; N different symbols are sent at the same time, in the same band, from the N transmit antennas, so the rate is N times that of a single antenna. Each symbol is sent only once, with no redundancy, so there is no diversity gain, and the error performance in a fading channel can be poor.(ii) 空间复用原理（spatial multiplexing，讲义 Ch4 p.30）：把数据拆成 N 路，N 个不同的符号在同一频带、同一时刻从 N 根发射天线同时发出，速率变成单天线的 N 倍。每个符号只发一次、没有冗余，所以没有分集增益，衰落信道里误码性能可能较差。
2
(ii) Relation between the numbers of transmit and receive antennas: each receive antenna gets a mixture of the N streams, y = Hx + v, i.e. M equations in N unknown symbols. To solve for N data streams you need at least as many equations as unknowns, so you need M ≥ N receive antennas (notes Ch4 p.30).(ii) 收发天线数的关系：每根接收天线收到的都是 N 路信号的混合，y = Hx + v，相当于 M 个方程、N 个未知符号。要解出 N 路数据流，方程数不能少于未知数，所以需要 M ≥ N 根接收天线（讲义 Ch4 p.30）。
3
(ii) Maximum multiplexing gain: at high SNR the MIMO capacity C → min(N, M) log₂ SNR (notes Ch4 p.31–32), so rmax = min(N, M):(ii) 最大复用增益：高 SNR 时 MIMO 容量 C → min(N, M) log₂ SNR（讲义 Ch4 p.31–32），所以 rmax = min(N, M)：
N = 3, M = 5
rmax = min(3, 5) = 3
The number of data streams is limited by the 3 transmit antennas (M = 5 ≥ 3, which meets the condition from the previous step ✓). The 2 extra receive antennas cannot add streams; they only make detection more reliable.数据流数被 3 根发射天线限制住（M = 5 ≥ 3，满足上一步的条件 ✓）；多出的 2 根接收天线不能再加流，只能让检测更可靠。
4
(iii) Compute X XH element by element: the definition of an orthogonal STBC (notes Ch5 p.22, p.27) is X XH = (|s₁|² + |s₂|²) I. The two rows of X are r₁ = (s₁, −s₂*) and r₂ = (s₂, s₁*); (X XH)ij = ri·rjH (conjugate row j, multiply element by element and sum):(iii) 逐个元素算 X XH：正交 STBC 的定义（讲义 Ch5 p.22、p.27）是 X XH = (|s₁|² + |s₂|²) I。X 的两行 r₁ = (s₁, −s₂*)，r₂ = (s₂, s₁*)；(X XH)ij = ri·rjH（第 j 行取共轭，对应相乘再求和）：
(1,1): s₁s₁* + (−s₂*)(−s₂*)* = |s₁|² + |s₂|²
(2,2): s₂s₂* + s₁*(s₁*)* = |s₂|² + |s₁|²
(1,2): s₁s₂* + (−s₂*)(s₁*)*
   = s₁s₂* − s₂*s₁ = 0
(2,1): conjugate of (1,2) = 0
5
(iii) Conclusion and numerical self-check:(iii) 结论和数字自检：
X XH = (|s₁|² + |s₂|²) I
Also, every element of X is a linear function of s₁, s₂ and their conjugates, so both conditions on notes p.27 hold: it is an orthogonal STBC. It is the transpose of the Alamouti matrix in the notes: in the notes, rows = time slots and columns = antennas; here, rows = antennas and columns = time slots (antenna 1 sends s₁ then −s₂*, antenna 2 sends s₂ then s₁*, exactly as on notes p.21). Self-check: with s₁ = 1 + j and s₂ = 2 − j, X XH = 7I, and |s₁|² + |s₂|² = 2 + 5 = 7 ✓.而且 X 的元素都是 s₁、s₂ 及其共轭的线性函数，满足讲义 p.27 的两个条件，是正交 STBC。它就是讲义 Alamouti 矩阵的转置：讲义行 = 时隙、列 = 天线；本题行 = 天线、列 = 时隙（天线 1 先发 s₁ 再发 −s₂*，天线 2 先发 s₂ 再发 s₁*，和讲义 p.21 完全一样）。自检：取 s₁ = 1 + j，s₂ = 2 − j，算得 X XH = 7I，而 |s₁|² + |s₂|² = 2 + 5 = 7 ✓。
6
(iv) Alamouti has diversity gain: after linear processing the receiver gets ỹ = Fs + ṽ, which puts the two symbols on two independent AWGN sub-channels, each with SNR = (|h₁|² + |h₂|²)E{|s|²}/σ² (notes Ch5 p.26). The SNR depends on the sum of two independent fading gains, so an error needs h₁ and h₂ to be in a deep fade at the same time. This is far less likely than one path fading deeply, hence diversity. Diversity order: 2 for 2 Tx / 1 Rx, 2M for 2 Tx / M Rx, i.e. full diversity N × M (p.27). Compare: if the transmitter does not know the channel and uses fixed weights, the SNR has the same distribution as a single |h₁|², so there is no diversity (p.18); Alamouti gets diversity without channel knowledge at the transmitter. The price: no array gain, and the SNR is 3 dB below receive MRC (p.30, because the transmit power is split between the two antennas).(iv) Alamouti 有分集增益：接收端线性处理后得到 ỹ = Fs + ṽ，两个符号分到两个独立的 AWGN 子信道，每个子信道 SNR = (|h₁|² + |h₂|²)E{|s|²}/σ²（讲义 Ch5 p.26）。SNR 由两条独立衰落增益之和决定，只有 h₁、h₂ 同时深衰落才会出错，概率远小于单条路径深衰落，所以有分集。分集阶数：2 发 1 收为 2，2 发 M 收为 2M，即满分集 N × M（p.27）。对比：发射端不知道信道、只用固定权重时，SNR 和单条 |h₁|² 同分布，没有分集（p.18）；Alamouti 不需要发射端知道信道就拿到了分集。代价：没有阵列增益（array gain），SNR 比接收端 MRC 低 3 dB（p.30，发射功率被两根天线平分）。
(ii) M ≥ N is needed; maximum multiplexing gain = 3 (iii) X XH = (|s₁|²+|s₂|²)I, so it is an orthogonal STBC (iv) yes, full diversity 2M(ii) 需 M ≥ N；最大复用增益 = 3 (iii) X XH = (|s₁|²+|s₂|²)I，是正交 STBC (iv) 有，满分集 2M
Note: in (iii) the original question prints "s₁ and s₂" as "s₁ and s₁"; read it as s₁ and s₂.注：原题 (iii) 把 "s₁ and s₂" 印成了 "s₁ and s₁"，按 s₁、s₂ 理解即可。
◆ Key points
What it tests
Spatial multiplexing and multiplexing gain; checking the orthogonality and diversity of the Alamouti code (Ch. 4 p.30–33; Ch. 5 p.21–30).空间复用与复用增益；Alamouti 码的正交性验证和分集（第 4 章 p.30–33；第 5 章 p.21–30）。
Knowledge used
rmax = min(N, M), and spatial multiplexing needs M ≥ N; OSTBC definition X XH = ‖s‖²I; conjugate transpose = transpose + conjugate of every element.rmax = min(N, M)，空间复用要 M ≥ N；OSTBC 的定义 X XH = ‖s‖²I；共轭转置 = 转置 + 每个元素取共轭。
Method
(iii) Take inner products row by row: the inner product of each row with itself = |s₁|² + |s₂|², and the inner product between the two rows must be 0; (iv) answer in three steps: "two independent paths → combined gain |h₁|² + |h₂|² → low probability of a simultaneous deep fade".(iii) 逐行做内积：每行和自己的内积 = |s₁|² + |s₂|²，两行之间的内积必须为 0；(iv) 按"两条独立路径 → 合并后增益 |h₁|² + |h₂|² → 同时深衰落的概率小"三步答。
Common mistakes
For the cross term, conjugate the second row; the matrix in the question is the transpose of the Alamouti matrix in the notes, and the conclusion is unchanged; with 2 transmit and M receive antennas the diversity order is 2M, not 2.算交叉项时第二行要取共轭；题目的矩阵是讲义 Alamouti 矩阵的转置，结论不变；2 发 M 收的分集阶数是 2M，不是 2。
Links
2025-26 S2 Q1(b)(iii) goes on to ask for the mean and variance of the decision statistic (unbiased, σ²/‖h‖²); Section 5.4 of the learning page has a derivation box that computes X XH term by term.2025-26 S2 Q1(b)(iii) 接着问检测量的均值和方差（无偏，σ²/‖h‖²）；讲解页 5.4 节有逐项算 X XH 的推导框。
Concept + Step by step: spatial multiplexing, Alamouti orthogonality and diversity

ConceptTwo ways to use multiple antennas: diversity vs multiplexing

With N transmit antennas and M receive antennas (MIMO), there are two ways to use them (Ch. 4 of the notes, p.29–33):有 N 根发射天线、M 根接收天线（MIMO）时，可以有两种用法（讲义第 4 章 p.29–33）：

  • Diversity: send the same information over several independent paths to gain reliability (the error rate falls faster with SNR). Maximum diversity gain dmax = N × M.分集（diversity）：把同一个信息经过多条独立路径送过去，换取可靠性（误码率随 SNR 下降得更快）。最大分集增益 dmax = N × M。
  • Spatial multiplexing: each transmit antenna sends different data symbols at the same time, so the rate becomes N times higher, but there is no diversity gain, and error performance in a fading channel can be poor. Multiplexing gain r = lim R/log₂SNR, maximum rmax = min(N, M).空间复用（spatial multiplexing）：每根发射天线同时发不同的数据符号，速率变成 N 倍，但没有分集增益，衰落信道里误码性能可能较差。复用增益 r = lim R/log₂SNR，最大值 rmax = min(N, M)。

Why does spatial multiplexing need M ≥ N? Each receive antenna gives one equation (a linear combination of the N symbols plus noise); to solve for N unknown symbols you need at least N equations, so the number of receive antennas cannot be less than the number of data streams. This also explains rmax = min(N, M): the side with fewer antennas decides how many "parallel pipes" can be open at once.为什么空间复用要 M ≥ N？接收端每根天线得到一个方程（N 个符号的线性组合加噪声），要解出 N 个未知符号，至少需要 N 个方程，所以接收天线数不能少于数据流数。这也解释了 rmax = min(N, M)：天线少的那一端决定能同时开几条"并行管道"。

ConceptOrthogonal space-time block codes (OSTBC) and the Alamouti code

A space-time block code arranges K symbols in a matrix X: one dimension is antennas, the other is time slots. The definition in Ch. 5 of the notes, p.27: X is orthogonal if and only if X XH = (|s₁|² + … + |sK|²) I. XH is the conjugate transpose (transpose first, then conjugate every element). The benefit of orthogonality: the receiver can fully separate s₁ and s₂ with simple linear combining, they do not interfere with each other, and each symbol collects the energy of all paths. The orthogonal code for 2 antennas is the Alamouti code (Ch. 5, p.21–26).空时分组码把 K 个符号排成矩阵 X：一个维度是天线，一个维度是时隙。讲义第 5 章 p.27 的定义：X 是正交的，当且仅当 X XH = (|s₁|² + … + |sK|²) I。XH 是共轭转置（先转置，再每个元素取共轭）。正交的好处：接收端只用简单的线性合并就能把 s₁、s₂ 完全分开，两者互不干扰，而且每个符号都拿到全部路径的能量。2 根天线的正交码就是 Alamouti 码（第 5 章 p.21–26）。

Step by step(ii) Spatial multiplexing

Principle: N different data streams are sent at the same time from N antennas, raising the rate N times; the receiver needs M ≥ N antennas to separate the N streams.原理：N 个不同数据流同时从 N 根天线发出，速率提高 N 倍；接收端需要 M ≥ N 根天线才能解出 N 个流。

N = 3, M = 5: rmax = min(3, 5) = 3

(The maximum diversity gain of the same system is 3 × 5 = 15; the two cannot both be at their maximum at the same time. This is the diversity-multiplexing trade-off.)（同一系统的最大分集增益是 3 × 5 = 15，两者不能同时取到最大，这就是分集-复用折中。）

Step by step(iii) Compute X XH element by element

  1. Write out X and XH: X = (s₁, −s₂* ; s₂, s₁*), XH = (s₁*, s₂* ; −s₂, s₁).
  2. (1,1) element: s₁s₁* + (−s₂*)(−s₂) = |s₁|² + |s₂|².
  3. (2,2) element: s₂s₂* + s₁*s₁ = |s₂|² + |s₁|².
  4. (1,2) element: s₁s₂* + (−s₂*)(s₁) = s₁s₂* − s₁s₂* = 0; the (2,1) element is its conjugate, also 0.(1,2) 元：s₁s₂* + (−s₂*)(s₁) = s₁s₂* − s₁s₂* = 0；(2,1) 元是它的共轭，也是 0。
X XH = (|s₁|² + |s₂|²) I → it is an orthogonal STBC

Numerical check: take s₁ = 1 + j, s₂ = 1 − j, |s₁|² + |s₂|² = 2 + 2 = 4; substituting gives X XH = 4I, and the off-diagonal elements are indeed 0. Reading the matrix: each row is one antenna and each column is one time slot. In slot 1 the two antennas send s₁, s₂; in slot 2 they send −s₂*, s₁*.数字检验：取 s₁ = 1 + j，s₂ = 1 − j，|s₁|² + |s₂|² = 2 + 2 = 4，代入得 X XH = 4I，非对角元确实为 0。读矩阵：每一行是一根天线，每一列是一个时隙——时隙 1 两根天线发 s₁、s₂，时隙 2 发 −s₂*、s₁*。

Step by step(iv) Does Alamouti have diversity gain?

Yes. Take 2 Tx and 1 Rx as an example, with independent channel gains h₁, h₂:有。以 2 发 1 收为例，信道增益 h₁、h₂ 独立：

y₁ = h₁s₁ + h₂s₂ + w₁; y₂ = −h₁s₂* + h₂s₁* + w₂
h₁*y₁ + h₂y₂* = (|h₁|² + |h₂|²) s₁ + noise

s₂ cancels completely (this is what orthogonality does), and the gain on s₁ is |h₁|² + |h₂|²: detection fails only when both paths are in a deep fade at the same time, so the diversity order is 2; with M receive antennas it is 2M, i.e. full diversity N × M. It does not need the transmitter to know the channel.s₂ 被完全抵消（这就是正交性的作用），s₁ 的增益是 |h₁|² + |h₂|²：只有两条路径同时深衰落时检测才会出错，所以分集阶数是 2；有 M 根接收天线时是 2M，即满分集 N × M。它不需要发射端知道信道。

Beyond the slides(the notes only say "MRC has array gain over OSTBC & Alamouti code", Ch. 5, p.30): for the same total transmit power, Alamouti has to split the power over two antennas, so it has the same diversity order as 1 Tx / 2 Rx MRC but about 3 dB less SNR.课外补充（讲义只说 "MRC has array gain over OSTBC & Alamouti code"，第 5 章 p.30）：总发射功率相同时，Alamouti 要把功率分给两根天线，所以和 1 发 2 收的 MRC 分集阶数相同，但 SNR 少约 3 dB。

PitfallsWatch out

  • When computing the (1,2) element, the second row must be conjugated: (−s₂*)·(s₁*)* = −s₂*s₁.算 (1,2) 元时第二行要取共轭：(−s₂*)·(s₁*)* = −s₂*s₁。
  • The matrix in the question is the transpose of the form in the notes (the notes put time slots in rows); the conclusion is the same, so do not worry about it.题目矩阵是讲义写法的转置（讲义按行排时隙），结论一样，不用纠结。
  • The original question misprints "s₁ and s₂" as "s₁ and s₁"; read it as s₁, s₂.原题把 "s₁ and s₂" 印成 "s₁ and s₁"，按 s₁、s₂ 理解。
  • The diversity order of 2 Tx and M Rx is 2M, not 2.2 发 M 收的分集阶数是 2M，不是 2。

ExamHow to write it in English

(ii) In spatial multiplexing, N different data symbols are transmitted simultaneously from the N transmit antennas, so the data rate is N times higher, but there is no diversity gain. To separate and decode the N data streams, the receiver needs M ≥ N receive antennas. The maximum multiplexing gain is rmax = min(N, M) = min(3, 5) = 3.

(iii) X XH = (s₁, −s₂* ; s₂, s₁*)(s₁*, s₂* ; −s₂, s₁). The diagonal elements are |s₁|² + |s₂|². The off-diagonal element is s₁s₂* − s₂*s₁ = 0 (and its conjugate is 0). Hence X XH = (|s₁|² + |s₂|²)I, so X is an orthogonal space-time block code (it is the Alamouti code).

(iv) Yes. Each symbol is transmitted from both antennas over two time slots and reaches the receiver through two independent fading paths. Because of the orthogonality, linear combining h₁*y₁ + h₂y₂* = (|h₁|² + |h₂|²)s₁ + noise removes s₂ completely. An error occurs only if both paths fade simultaneously, so the Alamouti code achieves full diversity of order 2 (2M with M receive antennas) without channel knowledge at the transmitter.

In one line: spatial multiplexing needs M ≥ N, maximum multiplexing gain min(3, 5) = 3; X XH has diagonal elements |s₁|² + |s₂|² and off-diagonal elements 0, so it is orthogonal; after Alamouti combining the gain is |h₁|² + |h₂|², giving full diversity 2M.一句话：空间复用要 M ≥ N，最大复用增益 min(3, 5) = 3；X XH 对角元 |s₁|² + |s₂|²、非对角元 0，所以正交；Alamouti 合并后增益 |h₁|² + |h₂|²，有满分集 2M。

Original question (verbatim)

(ii) For a MIMO system that uses 5 transmit antennas and 3 receive antennas, what is the maximum diversity gain of the system? If the system operates with a diversity gain of 3 and a multiplexing gain of 2, determine the maximum transmission rate per Hz of the system at a probability of error of 10−3.

(iii) The channel capacity of a MIMO system with N transmitter antennas and M receiver antennas can be expressed as, CMIMO = B × log2 det{I + (1/σ2) HPHH} where B is the receiver bandwidth, I is the Identity matrix, σ2 is the noise power, H and P are the channel matrix and transmit power matrix respectively, HH is the conjugate transpose of H, and det{X} is the determinant of the matrix X. Simplify the channel capacity expression if the MIMO system has an uninformed transmitter with a total transmit power of P. Hence determine the channel capacity per Hz of this system if N = M = 1, P = 1, σ2 = 0.25, and the channel gain is 2.

(12 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
(ii) Maximum diversity gain: with N = 5 transmit and M = 3 receive antennas, every Tx–Rx antenna pair is an independently fading path (notes Ch4 p.31–32):(ii) 最大分集增益：N = 5 根发射、M = 3 根接收天线，每一对收发天线都是一条独立衰落的路径（讲义 Ch4 p.31–32）：
dmax = N × M = 5 × 3 = 15
2
(ii) SNR from the error probability and the diversity gain: at high SNR, Pe ≈ SNR−d (notes Ch4 p.33). Substitute Pe = 10⁻³ and d = 3:(ii) 由误码率和分集增益求 SNR：高 SNR 时 Pe ≈ SNR−d（讲义 Ch4 p.33）。代入 Pe = 10⁻³、d = 3：
10⁻³ = SNR⁻³ → SNR = (10⁻³)−1/3 = 10 (10 dB)
3
(ii) Rate from the multiplexing gain: the multiplexing gain is defined as r = R / log₂ SNR (notes Ch4 p.32), so R = r log₂ SNR:(ii) 由复用增益求速率：复用增益（multiplexing gain）的定义是 r = R / log₂ SNR（讲义 Ch4 p.32），所以 R = r log₂ SNR：
log₂ 10 = log₁₀ 10 / 0.301 = 3.32
R = 2 × 3.32 ≈ 6.64 bit/s/Hz
4
(ii) Check whether (r, d) is achievable: the optimal trade-off curve joins the points (r, (N − r)(M − r)), r = 0 … min(N, M) = 3:(ii) 检查 (r, d) 能否做到：最优折中曲线连接点 (r, (N − r)(M − r))，r = 0 … min(N, M) = 3：
r = 0, 1, 2, 3 → d = 15, 8, 3, 0
At r = 2, d(2) = (5 − 2)(3 − 2) = 3, exactly the given d = 3 ✓. This operating point lies on the optimal curve, so 6.64 bit/s/Hz is the maximum rate.r = 2 时 d(2) = (5 − 2)(3 − 2) = 3，正好等于题给的 d = 3 ✓。这个工作点在最优曲线上，所以 6.64 bit/s/Hz 就是最大速率。
5
(iii) Simplification for an uninformed transmitter: an uninformed transmitter does not know H, so it can only split the total power P equally over the N antennas (notes Ch5 p.37):(iii) 无信息发射机的化简：无信息发射机（uninformed transmitter）不知道 H，只能把总功率 P 平均分给 N 根天线（讲义 Ch5 p.37）：
P = (P/N) I, tr P = P
Substitute into the original expression:
C = B log₂ det{I + (P/(Nσ²)) HHH}
6
(iii) Substitute N = M = 1: all matrices become scalars, and det is just the number itself. Read "channel gain is 2" as an amplitude gain h = 2 (the SISO example in notes Ch5 p.33 also uses h for the channel gain), so HHH = |h|² = 4:(iii) 代入 N = M = 1：所有矩阵都变成标量，det 就是这个数本身。"channel gain is 2" 按幅度增益 h = 2 理解（讲义 Ch5 p.33 的 SISO 例子也用 h 表示信道增益），HHH = |h|² = 4：
C/B = log₂(1 + P|h|²/σ²)
 = log₂(1 + 1 × 4/0.25)
 = log₂(1 + 16) = log₂ 17
This is the Shannon formula with SNR = 16 (12 dB).
7
(iii) Convert + self-check:
log₂ 17 = log₁₀ 17 / 0.301
 = 1.2304/0.301 ≈ 4.09 bit/s/Hz
Self-check: 2⁴ = 16 < 17 < 2⁵ = 32, so the result must lie between 4 and 5, just above 4 ✓.自检：2⁴ = 16 < 17 < 2⁵ = 32，结果应在 4 和 5 之间、略大于 4 ✓。
(ii) dmax = 15; R ≈ 6.64 bit/s/Hz; (iii) C/B = log₂17 ≈ 4.09 bit/s/Hz
Note: "channel gain is 2" is read as an amplitude gain h = 2 (|h|² = 4). If you read it as a power gain |h|² = 2, the result is log₂ 9 ≈ 3.17.注："channel gain is 2" 按幅度增益 h = 2 理解（|h|² = 4）。如果理解成功率增益 |h|² = 2，结果是 log₂ 9 ≈ 3.17。
◆ Key points
What it tests
Maximum diversity gain, rate from the diversity-multiplexing tradeoff, MIMO capacity when the transmitter does not know the channel (Ch. 4 p.28, p.32–33; Ch. 5 p.37).最大分集增益、分集-复用折中求速率、发射端不知道信道时的 MIMO 容量（第 4 章 p.28、p.32–33；第 5 章 p.37）。
Knowledge used
dmax = N × M; Pe = SNR−d; R = r log₂SNR; C = B log₂det(I + (P/(Nσ²))HHH).
Method
SNR = Pe−1/d = 10 → R = 2 log₂10; with N = M = 1 it reduces to log₂(1 + P|h|²/σ²).
Common mistakes
dmax is the product, 15, not the min; |h|² = 4; P/(Nσ²) = 1/0.25 = 4, and times |h|² = 4 this gives 16.dmax 是乘积 15，不是 min；|h|² = 4；P/(Nσ²) = 1/0.25 = 4，再乘 |h|² = 4 得 16。
Self-check
(r, d) = (2, 3) lies exactly on the optimal curve d(r) = (5 − r)(3 − r).(r, d) = (2, 3) 正好在最优曲线 d(r) = (5 − r)(3 − r) 上。
Concept + Step by step: diversity-multiplexing trade-off and MIMO capacity with an uninformed transmitter

ConceptDiversity gain d, multiplexing gain r and their trade-off

Ch. 4 of the notes, p.31–33, describes MIMO with two "slopes":讲义第 4 章 p.31–33 用两个"斜率"描述 MIMO：

  • Diversity gain d: at high SNR Pe ≈ SNR−d, i.e. each time the SNR grows 10 times, the error rate falls 10d times. Maximum dmax = N × M (N Tx, M Rx, when all paths are independent).分集增益 d：高 SNR 时 Pe ≈ SNR−d，即 SNR 每涨 10 倍，误码率降 10d 倍。最大 dmax = N × M（N 发 M 收，所有路径都独立时）。
  • Multiplexing gain r: at high SNR the rate R ≈ r log₂SNR, i.e. each time the SNR doubles, the rate gains r bit/s/Hz. Maximum rmax = min(N, M).复用增益 r：高 SNR 时速率 R ≈ r log₂SNR，即 SNR 每翻倍，速率多 r bit/s/Hz。最大 rmax = min(N, M)。
  • Trade-off: the two cannot both be at their maximum. The optimal trade-off curve joins the points (r, (N − r)(M − r)) (r = 0, 1, …, min(N, M)) with straight segments. The lecturer pointed out in class: the formulas for d and the array gain are simple, so remember them.折中（trade-off）：两者不能同时取最大。最优折中曲线把点 (r, (N − r)(M − r))（r = 0, 1, …, min(N, M)）连成折线。老师课上点名：d 和阵列增益的公式简单，要记住。

ConceptMIMO capacity with an uninformed transmitter

"Uninformed" means the transmitter does not know the channel H. It cannot focus power in the good directions, so it can only split the total power P equally over the N antennas: power matrix P = (P/N)I (Ch. 5 of the notes, p.37). Substituting into the general formula, HPHH = (P/N)HHH:"无信息"指发射端不知道信道 H。它没法把功率往好的方向集中，只能把总功率 P 平均分给 N 根天线：功率矩阵 P = (P/N)I（讲义第 5 章 p.37）。代入一般式，HPHH = (P/N)HHH：

C = B log₂ det{I + (P/(Nσ²)) HHH}

When N = M = 1, H is just a number h and det is that number itself, so it reduces to the familiar Shannon formula C = B log₂(1 + P|h|²/σ²).N = M = 1 时 H 就是一个数 h，det 就是这个数本身，退化成熟悉的香农公式 C = B log₂(1 + P|h|²/σ²)。

Step by step(ii) Maximum diversity gain and rate

  1. dmax = N × M = 5 × 3 = 15
  2. Find the SNR from the error rate and d (why: the rate formula needs the SNR):由误码率和 d 求 SNR（为什么：速率公式需要 SNR）：
    10⁻³ = SNR⁻³ → SNR = (10⁻³)−1/3 = 10 (10 dB)
  3. Find the rate:
    R = r log₂SNR = 2 × log₂10 = 2 × 3.32 ≈ 6.64 bit/s/Hz
    Calculator: log₂10 = 1/0.301 = 3.32.
  4. Self-check: is (r, d) = (2, 3) on the optimal curve? d(2) = (5 − 2)(3 − 2) = 3 ✓; r = 2 also does not exceed rmax = 3.自检：(r, d) = (2, 3) 在最优曲线上吗？d(2) = (5 − 2)(3 − 2) = 3 ✓；r = 2 也不超过 rmax = 3。

Physical meaning: r = 2 is like running 2 parallel data streams at once (the rate grows with log₂SNR at twice the slope); the remaining antenna degrees of freedom buy d = 3, so the error rate falls as SNR⁻³. Using the full diversity of 15 leaves only r = 0, and using the full multiplexing r = 3 leaves d = 0; this is the "trade-off". Why the order is "first d to get the SNR, then r to get R": both formulas share the same SNR; the error rate requirement fixes the SNR, and the rate follows from it.物理含义：r = 2 相当于同时开 2 条并行数据流（速率随 log₂SNR 以 2 倍增长）；剩下的天线自由度换来 d = 3，误码率按 SNR⁻³ 下降。用满 15 的分集就只能 r = 0，用满 r = 3 的复用就 d = 0，这就是"折中"。解题顺序为什么是"先 d 求 SNR，再 r 求 R"：两个公式共用同一个 SNR，误码率要求把 SNR 定下来，速率随之确定。

Step by step(iii) Simplify and substitute numbers

  1. Simplify: substituting P = (P/N)I gives C = B log₂ det{I + (P/(Nσ²)) HHH}.
  2. N = M = 1, P = 1, σ² = 0.25, h = 2 (amplitude gain), |h|² = 4:
    C/B = log₂(1 + 1 × 4/0.25) = log₂(1 + 16) = log₂17
    log₂17 = log₁₀17/0.301 = 1.230/0.301 ≈ 4.09 bit/s/Hz

If "channel gain is 2" is read as the power gain |h|² = 2, the result is log₂9 ≈ 3.17. It is a good idea to write "taking the channel gain as the amplitude gain h = 2, |h|² = 4" on your script to make the assumption clear.如果把 "channel gain is 2" 理解成功率增益 |h|² = 2，结果是 log₂9 ≈ 3.17。建议在答卷上写一句 "taking the channel gain as the amplitude gain h = 2, |h|² = 4"，把假设说清楚。

PitfallsWatch out

  • dmax is the product 15; rmax is min(N, M) = 3. Do not mix them up.dmax 是乘积 15，rmax 才是 min(N, M) = 3，别弄反。
  • The SNR in Pe = SNR−d is a linear value; take the d-th root.Pe = SNR−d 里的 SNR 是线性值；开 d 次方根。
  • The capacity formula needs |h|², not h.容量公式里要的是 |h|²，不是 h。
  • "per Hz" just means C/B, in bit/s/Hz.

ExamHow to write it in English

(ii) The maximum diversity gain is dmax = N × M = 5 × 3 = 15. With diversity gain d = 3, Pe ≈ SNR−d gives 10⁻³ = SNR⁻³, so SNR = 10. With multiplexing gain r = 2, the maximum rate is R = r log₂SNR = 2 log₂10 ≈ 6.64 bit/s/Hz. (Check: (r, d) = (2, 3) lies on the optimal trade-off curve, d(2) = (5 − 2)(3 − 2) = 3.)

(iii) For an uninformed transmitter the channel is unknown at the transmitter, so equal power is allocated to every transmit antenna: P = (P/N)I. The capacity becomes C = B log₂ det{I + (P/(Nσ²)) HHH}. For N = M = 1, H = h and C/B = log₂(1 + P|h|²/σ²). Taking the channel gain as the amplitude gain h = 2 (|h|² = 4): C/B = log₂(1 + 1 × 4/0.25) = log₂17 ≈ 4.09 bit/s/Hz.

In one line: dmax = 5 × 3 = 15; SNR = (10⁻³)−1/3 = 10, R = 2 log₂10 ≈ 6.64 bit/s/Hz; uninformed transmitter P = (P/N)I, with a single antenna C/B = log₂(1 + 16) ≈ 4.09 bit/s/Hz.一句话：dmax = 5 × 3 = 15；SNR = (10⁻³)−1/3 = 10，R = 2 log₂10 ≈ 6.64 bit/s/Hz；无信息发射机 P = (P/N)I，单天线时 C/B = log₂(1 + 16) ≈ 4.09 bit/s/Hz。

Past final exam
2025-26 S1Q1(b)(ii)(iii)(b) 13 marks in total
Topics: how SIMO achieves diversity · MIMO capacity = sum of parallel-channel capacities考点：SIMO 如何获得分集 · MIMO 容量 = 并行信道容量之和
Original question (verbatim)

(ii) The input-output relationship of a MIMO system is given below, y1 = (h1 × s) + v1; y2 = (h2 × s) + v2 where s is the transmitted symbol, h1, h2 are the channel gains, v1, v2 are the Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN), and y1, y2 are the received signals. Explain why this can be a Single-Input Multiple-Output (SIMO) system. Using the input-output relationship, explain conceptually how such systems can achieve diversity.

(iii) The channel capacity of a MIMO system can be simplified to, B log2 det{I + (1/σ2)Λ} where B is the bandwidth, det{•} is the Determinant of {•}, I is the Identity matrix, σ2 is the noise variance, and Λ is a diagonal matrix whose diagonal elements are some eigenvalues. Simplify this expression further and use it to explain that the channel capacity of a MIMO system is equal to the sum of the channel capacities of a set of parallel channels.

(13 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
(ii) Why it is SIMO: the two equations contain only one transmitted symbol s (one transmit antenna, N = 1) but two received signals y₁, y₂ (two receive antennas, M = 2), each passing through a different channel gain h₁, h₂ and with independent noise v₁, v₂ added. So it is Single-Input Multiple-Output (1 × 2). In vector form (Ch. 5 of the notes, p.12):(ii) 为什么是 SIMO：两个方程里只有一个发送符号 s（一根发射天线，N = 1），却有两个接收信号 y₁、y₂（两根接收天线，M = 2），各自经过不同的信道增益 h₁、h₂，再叠加独立噪声 v₁、v₂。所以是单输入多输出（Single-Input Multiple-Output，1 × 2）。写成向量（讲义第 5 章 p.12）：
y = [y₁, y₂]T = s · h + v
h = [h₁, h₂]T, v = [v₁, v₂]T
2
(ii) Linear combining: the receiver weights the two branches and adds them (Ch. 5 of the notes, p.13):(ii) 线性合并：接收端给两路加权再相加（讲义第 5 章 p.13）：
ŝ = w₁*y₁ + w₂*y₂
= s(w₁*h₁ + w₂*h₂) + (w₁*v₁ + w₂*v₂)
SNR = E|s|² · |wHh|² / (σ² ‖w‖²)
Choosing w ∝ h (each branch multiplied by the conjugate of its own channel gain, i.e. maximal ratio combining, MRC) maximises the SNR (p.14–15):取 w ∝ h（每路乘自己信道增益的共轭，即最大比合并 MRC）时 SNR 最大（p.14–15）：
SNRmax = (E|s|²/σ²)(|h₁|² + |h₂|²)
3
(ii) Why this gives diversity: SNRmax is proportional to |h₁|² + |h₂|², so it is small only when both branches are weak at the same time; if h₁ is in a deep fade but h₂ is strong, s can still be detected correctly from ŝ (p.15). If h₁ and h₂ are statistically independent (antennas far enough apart), the probability that both are in a deep fade at once is the product of the individual probabilities: e.g. if one branch is in a deep fade with probability 0.1, both are in a deep fade together with probability only 0.1 × 0.1 = 0.01 (Ch. 4 p.3: PoutM). So the error probability falls faster with SNR, with diversity order d = M = 2 (Ch. 4 p.28). This is receive diversity.(ii) 为什么得到分集：SNRmax 正比于 |h₁|² + |h₂|²，只有两路同时很弱时它才小；h₁ 深衰落而 h₂ 较大时，仍能从 ŝ 正确检测 s（p.15）。若 h₁、h₂ 统计独立（天线间距足够大），两路同时深衰落的概率是各自概率的乘积：例如单路深衰落概率为 0.1，两路同时只有 0.1 × 0.1 = 0.01（第 4 章 p.3：PoutM）。所以误码率随 SNR 下降得更快，分集阶数 d = M = 2（第 4 章 p.28）。这就是接收分集（receive diversity）。
4
(iii) Find the determinant: Λ = diag(λ₁, …, λr) is diagonal, so I + Λ/σ² is also diagonal, with diagonal entries 1 + λi/σ². The determinant of a diagonal matrix = the product of its diagonal entries:(iii) 求行列式：Λ = diag(λ₁, …, λr) 是对角阵，I + Λ/σ² 也是对角阵，对角元为 1 + λi/σ²。对角阵的行列式 = 对角元素的乘积：
det{I + Λ/σ²} = (1 + λ₁/σ²)(1 + λ₂/σ²)…(1 + λr/σ²)
= Πi=1r(1 + λi/σ²)
(Λ comes from the eigendecomposition HPHH = UΛUH; use det(I + AB) = det(I + BA) and UHU = I to eliminate U, Ch. 5 of the notes, p.34–35.)（Λ 来自 HPHH = UΛUH 的特征分解，用 det(I + AB) = det(I + BA) 和 UHU = I 把 U 消掉，讲义第 5 章 p.34–35。）
5
(iii) The log turns the product into a sum: use log₂(ab) = log₂a + log₂b:(iii) 对数把乘积变成求和：用 log₂(ab) = log₂a + log₂b：
C = B log₂ Πi(1 + λi/σ²)
= Σi=1r B log₂(1 + λi/σ²)
6
(iii) Interpretation: a sum of parallel channel capacities: each term B log₂(1 + λi/σ²) is exactly the Shannon capacity of a SISO channel with SNR λi/σ² (Ch. 5 p.33). So the MIMO channel is equivalent to r non-interfering parallel "data pipes" (eigen-sub-channels), and the total capacity is their sum (p.36). r = rank(HPHH) ≤ min(N, M), which is also why MIMO capacity grows linearly with min(N, M). Small example: r = 2, λ₁/σ² = 4, λ₂/σ² = 1; capacity per Hz log₂ det = log₂(5 × 2) = log₂10 = 3.32, equal to log₂5 + log₂2 = 2.32 + 1 = 3.32 ✓.(iii) 解释：并行信道容量之和：每一项 B log₂(1 + λi/σ²) 正是一个 SNR 为 λi/σ² 的 SISO 信道的香农容量（第 5 章 p.33）。所以 MIMO 信道等价于 r 个互不干扰的并行“数据管道”（eigen-sub-channels），总容量是它们之和（p.36）。r = rank(HPHH) ≤ min(N, M)，这也是 MIMO 容量随 min(N, M) 线性增长的原因。小例子：r = 2，λ₁/σ² = 4，λ₂/σ² = 1，每 Hz 容量 log₂ det = log₂(5 × 2) = log₂10 = 3.32，等于 log₂5 + log₂2 = 2.32 + 1 = 3.32 ✓。
(ii) 1 transmit, 2 receive antennas; combining two independently fading paths → diversity order 2; (iii) C = Σ B log₂(1 + λi/σ²)(ii) 1 发 2 收；两条独立衰落路径合并 → 分集阶数 2 (iii) C = Σ B log₂(1 + λi/σ²)
◆ Key points
What it tests
How SIMO achieves diversity; reducing MIMO capacity to a sum over parallel channels (Ch. 5 p.12–15, p.33–35).SIMO 怎么得到分集；MIMO 容量化成并行信道之和（第 5 章 p.12–15、p.33–35）。
Answer points (ii)
One transmitted symbol, two received signals → SIMO (1 × 2); antennas far enough apart → independent fading; after MRC the gain is |h₁|² + |h₂|², and the chance of both fading deeply at once is small → diversity order 2.一个发送符号、两个接收信号 → SIMO（1 × 2）；两根天线相距足够远 → 独立衰落；MRC 合并后增益 |h₁|² + |h₂|²，同时深衰落的概率很小 → 分集阶数 2。
Derivation points (iii)
Determinant of a diagonal matrix = product of the diagonal entries; the log turns the product into a sum; each term is the SISO Shannon capacity with SNR λi/σ².对角矩阵的行列式 = 对角元素之积；log 把积变成和；每一项是一个 SNR 为 λi/σ² 的 SISO 香农容量。
Common mistakes
State the "independent" condition (antennas far enough apart); the number of parallel sub-channels is K = rank(H) ≤ min(N, M).要写出"独立"的前提（天线间距足够）；并行子信道个数 K = rank(H) ≤ min(N, M)。
Links
Section 5.2 of the learning page has the Cauchy-Schwarz derivation of MRC; Section 5.5 has a derivation box for the capacity simplification.讲解页 5.2 节有 MRC 的柯西-施瓦茨推导，5.5 节有容量化简的推导框。
Concept + Step by step: SIMO diversity and MIMO parallel channels

ConceptThe MIMO input–output relation and SIMO

In flat fading, a MIMO channel with N transmit antennas and M receive antennas is written ym = Σn hm,nxn + vm, or in matrix form y = Hx + v (Ch. 5 p.5–6). "Input" means the number of transmitted signals and "output" the number of received signals. SIMO (Single-Input Multiple-Output) is N = 1, M ≥ 2: one transmitted symbol, several received signals (p.11–12).平坦衰落下，N 根发射天线、M 根接收天线的 MIMO 信道写成 ym = Σn hm,nxn + vm，矩阵形式 y = Hx + v（第 5 章 p.5–6）。"输入"指发送信号的个数，"输出"指接收信号的个数。SIMO（Single-Input Multiple-Output）就是 N = 1、M ≥ 2：一个发送符号，多个接收信号（p.11–12）。

How SIMO gives diversity (p.13–14): the receiver forms a linear combination x̂ = w₁*y₁ + w₂*y₂ and chooses w = αh to maximise the output SNR, giving SNRmax = E{|x|²}(|h₁|² + |h₂|²)/σ². It is proportional to |h₁|² + |h₂|²: even if h₁ is small, detection still works as long as h₂ is large. If h₁ and h₂ are statistically independent, the chance that both are small is much lower than the chance that one of them is small. This is receive diversity. This receiver is the MRC of Ch. 4; the lecturer suggests studying the two chapters together.SIMO 怎么得到分集（p.13–14）：接收端做线性合并 x̂ = w₁*y₁ + w₂*y₂，选 w = αh 使输出 SNR 最大，得到 SNRmax = E{|x|²}(|h₁|² + |h₂|²)/σ²。它和 |h₁|² + |h₂|² 成正比：即使 h₁ 很小，只要 h₂ 大，仍能正确检测。若 h₁、h₂ 统计独立，两者同时很小的概率远小于其中一个很小的概率，这就是接收分集。这个接收机就是第 4 章的 MRC，老师建议两章一起学。

ConceptWhy MIMO capacity is a sum of parallel channels

Capacity formula C = B log₂det(I + HPHH/σ²) (p.32–35). Eigen-decompose HPHH as UΛUH, then use det(I + AB) = det(I + BA) and UHU = I to reach the form given in the question, B log₂det{I + Λ/σ²} (the exam gives this first part and asks you to derive the rest). Λ is diagonal with the eigenvalues λi on its diagonal; the number of non-zero ones is r = rank(H) ≤ min(N, M). Lecturer's emphasis: the capacity is the sum over r subchannels; r is the rank, not N × M.容量公式 C = B log₂det(I + HPHH/σ²)（p.32–35）。对 HPHH 做特征分解 UΛUH，再用 det(I + AB) = det(I + BA) 和 UHU = I，就化成题目给的 B log₂det{I + Λ/σ²}（考试会给前面这部分，让你推剩下的）。Λ 是对角阵，对角元素是特征值 λi，非零的个数 r = rank(H) ≤ min(N, M)。老师强调：容量是 r 条子信道之和，r 是秩，不是 N × M。

Step by step(ii) Key points in detail

  1. Why it is SIMO: the equations contain only one transmitted symbol s (single input) but two received signals y₁, y₂ (multiple output), so it is a 1 × 2 SIMO, i.e. one transmit antenna and two receive antennas.为什么是 SIMO：方程里只有一个发送符号 s（单输入），却有两个接收信号 y₁、y₂（多输出），所以是 1 × 2 的 SIMO，即一根发射天线、两根接收天线。
  2. The two branches are independent: y₁ and y₂ carry the same s, but through different channel gains h₁, h₂, and the noises v₁, v₂ are uncorrelated. As long as the two receive antennas are far enough apart, h₁ and h₂ fade independently.两条支路各自独立：y₁、y₂ 带的是同一个 s，但经过不同的信道增益 h₁、h₂，噪声 v₁、v₂ 也互不相关。只要两根接收天线间距足够大，h₁ 和 h₂ 就是独立衰落的。
  3. Combining: use MRC, z = h₁*y₁ + h₂*y₂ = (|h₁|² + |h₂|²)s + h₁*v₁ + h₂*v₂; the output SNR is proportional to |h₁|² + |h₂|².合并：用 MRC，z = h₁*y₁ + h₂*y₂ = (|h₁|² + |h₂|²)s + h₁*v₁ + h₂*v₂，输出 SNR 与 |h₁|² + |h₂|² 成正比。
  4. Why it fights fading: if each branch is in a deep fade with probability p, both are in a deep fade at once with probability p². For example, p = 0.1 gives only 0.01, so link reliability improves greatly; the diversity order is 2.为什么能抗衰落：设每一路深衰落的概率是 p，两路同时深衰落的概率是 p²。例如 p = 0.1 时只有 0.01，链路可靠性大大提高，分集阶数为 2。

Step by step(iii) Simplification steps

  1. Λ = diag(λ₁, …, λr), so I + Λ/σ² is also diagonal, with diagonal elements 1 + λi/σ².Λ = diag(λ₁, …, λr)，所以 I + Λ/σ² 也是对角阵，对角元素是 1 + λi/σ²。
  2. The determinant of a diagonal matrix = the product of its diagonal elements: det{I + Λ/σ²} = Π(1 + λi/σ²).对角阵的行列式 = 对角元素之积：det{I + Λ/σ²} = Π(1 + λi/σ²)。
  3. The log turns the product into a sum: log₂Π(…) = Σlog₂(…).对数把乘积变成求和：log₂Π(…) = Σlog₂(…)。
  4. Each term B log₂(1 + λi/σ²) is exactly the Shannon capacity of a single-input single-output channel with SNR λi/σ².每一项 B log₂(1 + λi/σ²) 正是一条 SNR 为 λi/σ² 的单发单收信道的香农容量。
C = B log₂ Πi=1r(1 + λi/σ²) = Σi=1r B log₂(1 + λi/σ²)

Small numerical example: two eigen-subchannels with λ₁/σ² = 3, λ₂/σ² = 1. det = (1 + 3)(1 + 1) = 8, log₂8 = 3 bit/s/Hz; computed separately, log₂4 + log₂2 = 2 + 1 = 3 bit/s/Hz. The two are equal.数字小例子：两条特征子信道 λ₁/σ² = 3、λ₂/σ² = 1。det = (1 + 3)(1 + 1) = 8，log₂8 = 3 bit/s/Hz；分开算 log₂4 + log₂2 = 2 + 1 = 3 bit/s/Hz，两者相等。

PitfallsCommon ways to lose marks

  • In (ii), saying only "there are two antennas" without the chain of logic "same symbol, independent fading, small chance that both fade at once after combining".(ii) 只说"有两根天线"，没写"同一个符号、独立衰落、合并后同时深衰落概率小"这条逻辑链。
  • Forgetting the independent-fading condition (antennas far enough apart).忘了独立衰落的前提（天线间距足够大）。
  • In (iii), writing the number of subchannels as N × M; it should be r = rank(H) ≤ min(N, M).(iii) 子信道个数写成 N × M；应是 r = rank(H) ≤ min(N, M)。
  • Writing only the conclusion without the step "determinant of a diagonal matrix = product of its diagonal elements".只写结论，不写"对角阵行列式 = 对角元素之积"这一步。

ExamHow to write it in English

(ii) There is only one transmitted symbol s (single input) but two received signals y₁ and y₂ (multiple outputs), each through its own channel gain h₁, h₂ and independent noise v₁, v₂. Hence it is a 1 × 2 SIMO system with one transmit antenna and two receive antennas.

The same symbol s reaches the receiver through two different paths. If the receive antennas are sufficiently separated, h₁ and h₂ fade independently, so the probability that both are in a deep fade at the same time is much smaller than that of a single path. The receiver combines the two signals, e.g. by MRC: z = h₁*y₁ + h₂*y₂ = (|h₁|² + |h₂|²)s + h₁*v₁ + h₂*v₂. The output SNR is proportional to |h₁|² + |h₂|², so s can still be detected reliably when one gain is small as long as the other is large. This gives a diversity order of 2.

(iii) Since Λ = diag(λ₁, …, λr) is diagonal, I + Λ/σ² is diagonal and its determinant is the product of its diagonal elements:

C = B log₂ Πi=1r(1 + λi/σ²) = Σi=1r B log₂(1 + λi/σ²).

Each term is the Shannon capacity of a SISO channel with SNR λi/σ². Therefore the MIMO channel is equivalent to r = rank(H) ≤ min(N, M) independent parallel sub-channels, and its capacity is the sum of their capacities.

In one line: one transmit and two receive antennas, independent fading, and a small chance that both fade at once after combining: that is SIMO diversity. The determinant of a diagonal matrix is a product, and the log turns it into a sum: that is MIMO = r parallel channels.一句话：一发两收、独立衰落、合并后同时深衰落的概率很小，就是 SIMO 分集；对角阵行列式是乘积，取 log 变成求和，就是 MIMO = r 条并行信道。

Past final exam
2025-26 S2Q1(b)(ii)(iii)(b) 13 marks in total
Topics: y = Hx + v for flat-fading MIMO · mean and variance of the 2×1 Alamouti detection signal考点：平坦衰落 MIMO 的 y = Hx + v · 2×1 Alamouti 检测信号的均值与方差
Original question (verbatim)

(ii) A MIMO system uses 4 transmitter antennas and 6 receiver antennas and operates in a flat fading channel. Denote x, y, v and H as the transmitted signal vector, received signal vector, channel noise vector and the channel matrix, respectively. Explain why there is only channel gain for each channel. Express the input-output relationship of the MIMO system with an equation and the channel matrix as a function of the channel gains {hi,j}, where hij is the channel gain between the jth transmitter antenna and the ith receiver antenna.

(iii) In a 2 × 1 MIMO system, the detected signal vector can be expressed as, ŝ = s + (1/‖h‖2) Gw where s is the transmitted signal vector, h is the channel gain vector, G is a suitable matrix, and w is a Gaussian noise vector with zero mean. Given that, the variance of Gw is, σ2‖h‖2 (1 ; 1) Derive the expected value and variance of the detected signal.

(13 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
(ii) Why each channel has only one gain: flat fading ⇔ signal bandwidth < coherence bandwidth, i.e. the multipath delay spread is much smaller than the symbol duration (notes Ch2 p.31–33). So the multipath components from transmit antenna j to receive antenna i arrive at almost the same time and add up within one symbol into a single complex gain hij (magnitude = fading amplitude, argument = phase shift). There is no resolvable second tap and hence no ISI: the whole band is multiplied by the same number, so each antenna pair needs only one gain (notes Ch5 p.4–5).(ii) 为什么每条信道只有一个增益：平坦衰落 ⇔ 信号带宽 < 相干带宽，即多径时延扩展远小于符号时长（讲义 Ch2 p.31–33）。所以从第 j 根发射天线到第 i 根接收天线的各条多径几乎同时到达，在一个符号内叠加成一个复数增益 hij（模 = 衰落幅度，辐角 = 相移）。没有可分辨的第二个抽头，也就没有 ISI：整个带宽都乘同一个数，所以每对天线只需一个增益（讲义 Ch5 p.4–5）。
2
(ii) Write it per receive antenna (Ch5 p.5): receive antenna i receives a weighted sum of the signals from the 4 transmit antennas, plus its own noise:(ii) 逐根接收天线写（Ch5 p.5）：第 i 根接收天线收到 4 根发射天线信号的加权和，再加本天线的噪声：
yi = Σj=14 hijxj + vi, i = 1, 2, …, 6

vi is white Gaussian noise with zero mean and variance σ², independent across antennas.
vi 是零均值、方差 σ² 的高斯白噪声，各天线互相独立。
3
(ii) Matrix form (p.6): stack the 6 equations on top of each other:(ii) 写成矩阵（p.6）：把 6 个式子上下叠起来：
y = Hx + v
y, v: 6×1; x: 4×1; H: 6×4

H = ⎡h11 h12 h13 h14⎤
  ⎢h21 h22 h23 h24⎥
  ⎢ ⋮  ⋮  ⋮  ⋮ ⎥
  ⎣h61 h62 h63 h64⎦

Row index i = receive antenna, column index j = transmit antenna. Dimension check: (6×4)(4×1) = 6×1, consistent with y ✓
行号 i = 接收天线，列号 j = 发射天线。维数自检：(6×4)(4×1) = 6×1，与 y 一致 ✓
4
(iii) Mean: s is the transmitted deterministic signal; h and G are deterministic quantities known at the receiver; only w is random, with E[w] = 0. Expectation is linear:(iii) 均值：s 是发送的确定信号；h、G 是接收端已知的确定量；只有 w 随机，且 E[w] = 0。期望是线性的：
E[ŝ] = s + (1/‖h‖²)·G·E[w]
= s + 0 = s

So the detection statistic is unbiased.
所以检测量是无偏（unbiased）的。
5
(iii) Variance: the constant s contributes no variance; the random term is multiplied by the constant 1/‖h‖², so its variance is multiplied by the square of that constant (Var(aX) = a²Var(X)):(iii) 方差：常数 s 不贡献方差；随机项前乘了常数 1/‖h‖²，方差要乘它的平方（Var(aX) = a²Var(X)）：
Var[ŝ] = (1/‖h‖²)² · Var[Gw]
= (1/‖h‖⁴) · σ²‖h‖² (1, 1)T
= (σ²/‖h‖²) (1, 1)T

i.e. the noise variance of both detected symbols is σ²/‖h‖² = σ²/(|h₁|² + |h₂|²), and ŝ ~ N(s, (σ²/‖h‖²)·1) (notes Ch5 p.25).
即两个检测符号的噪声方差都是 σ²/‖h‖² = σ²/(|h₁|² + |h₂|²)，ŝ ~ N(s, (σ²/‖h‖²)·1)（讲义 Ch5 p.25）。
6
Self-check and meaning: the Var[Gw] given in the question comes from G = FH and FHF = ‖h‖²I: Cov(Gw) = FH(σ²I)F = σ²‖h‖²I, whose diagonal is exactly σ²‖h‖²(1, 1) ✓. The SNR of each subchannel = E|sn|²‖h‖²/σ² (p.26): the gains of the two paths, |h₁|² + |h₂|², add up and the noise is reduced. This is the second-order diversity of Alamouti.自检与意义：题给的 Var[Gw] 来自 G = FH 且 FHF = ‖h‖²I：Cov(Gw) = FH(σ²I)F = σ²‖h‖²I，对角线正是 σ²‖h‖²(1, 1) ✓。每个子信道 SNR = E|sn|²‖h‖²/σ²（p.26）：两条路径的增益 |h₁|² + |h₂|² 相加，噪声被压低，这就是 Alamouti 的二阶分集。
(ii) y = Hx + v, H is the 6×4 matrix [hij] (iii) E[ŝ] = s; Var = σ²/‖h‖² (each component)(ii) y = Hx + v，H 为 6×4 的 [hij] (iii) E[ŝ] = s；Var = σ²/‖h‖²（每个分量）
◆ Key points
What it tests
y = Hx + v for flat-fading MIMO; mean and variance of the Alamouti decision statistic (Ch. 5 p.5–6, p.23–25).平坦衰落 MIMO 的 y = Hx + v；Alamouti 检测量的均值和方差（第 5 章 p.5–6、p.23–25）。
Knowledge used
H is M×N (rows = receive antennas, columns = transmit antennas); E[constant + zero-mean noise] = constant; Var(cX) = c²Var(X).H 是 M×N（行 = 接收天线，列 = 发射天线）；E[常数 + 零均值噪声] = 常数；Var(cX) = c²Var(X)。
Method
(ii) First explain flat → one complex gain per antenna pair, then write the matrix and the element-wise form; (iii) for the mean, zero-mean noise → unbiased; for the variance, square the coefficient.(ii) 先说明平坦 → 每对天线一个复增益，再写矩阵和逐元素式；(iii) 均值看噪声零均值 → 无偏，方差看系数平方。
Common mistakes
With 4 transmit and 6 receive antennas, H is 6×4, not 4×6; the variance is multiplied by 1/‖h‖⁴ (the coefficient squared), and multiplying by the noise variance σ²‖h‖² gives σ²/‖h‖².4 发 6 收的 H 是 6×4，不是 4×6；方差要乘 1/‖h‖⁴（系数平方），乘上噪声方差 σ²‖h‖² 后得 σ²/‖h‖²。
Links

Concept + Step by step: MIMO model and Alamouti

ConceptWhy each channel has only one gain under flat fading

Ch. 5 p.4 lists several channel types: for flat, time-invariant fading y(t) = h × x(t), so the channel is just one complex coefficient; for frequency-selective fading y(t) = ∫h(t − τ)x(τ)dτ, a convolution. Flat fading means the signal bandwidth is smaller than the coherence bandwidth (delay spread much shorter than the symbol duration), so the differences in arrival time between multipath components are negligible and they add up within one symbol to one complex gain (amplitude + phase). There are no resolvable taps, and hence no ISI. So each "transmit antenna j → receive antenna i" pair needs only one number hij.第 5 章 p.4 列出了几种信道：平坦、时不变衰落时 y(t) = h × x(t)，信道只是一个复数系数；频率选择性衰落时 y(t) = ∫h(t − τ)x(τ)dτ，是卷积。平坦衰落意味着信号带宽小于相干带宽（时延扩展远小于符号时长），各条多径到达的时间差可以忽略，它们在一个符号内叠加成一个复数增益（幅度 + 相位），没有可以分辨的多个抽头，也就没有 ISI。所以每一对"发射天线 j → 接收天线 i"之间只需要一个数 hij。

ConceptMIMO input–output relation

Notes p.5–6: each receive antenna gets a weighted sum of all transmit-antenna signals plus its own noise: yi = Σj hijxj + vi. Stacking these into column vectors gives y = Hx + v. Rows of H correspond to receive antennas, columns to transmit antennas. The lecturer said you must be able to write this relation down directly, both element by element and in matrix form.讲义 p.5–6：每根接收天线收到的是所有发射天线信号的加权和，再加上自己的噪声：yi = Σj hijxj + vi。把它们排成列向量就是 y = Hx + v。H 的行对应接收天线、列对应发射天线。老师说这个关系要能直接写出来，单个元素的式子和矩阵形式都要会。

ConceptDistribution of the Alamouti decision statistic

The Alamouti code (2 Tx, 1 Rx; the coding matrix is in a blue box, so memorise it) is rearranged into ỹ = Fs + ṽ, where F satisfies FHF = ‖h‖²I (p.23). ML detection gives ŝ = (1/‖h‖²)FHỹ = s + (1/‖h‖²)FHṽ (p.25); the G in the question is FH. The notes conclude that ŝ ~ N(s, (σ²/‖h‖²)·1), and this question asks you to derive that result. You need two properties (Ch. 1b): E[a + cX] = a + cE[X]; Var[a + cX] = c²Var[X] (the constant a adds no variance; the coefficient is squared).Alamouti 码（2 发 1 收，编码矩阵是蓝框、要背）经过重新排列后得到 ỹ = Fs + ṽ，F 满足 FHF = ‖h‖²I（p.23）。ML 检测的结果是 ŝ = (1/‖h‖²)FHỹ = s + (1/‖h‖²)FHṽ（p.25），题目里的 G 就是 FH。讲义的结论是 ŝ ~ N(s, (σ²/‖h‖²)·1)，本题就是要你推出这个结论。要用的两条性质（第 1b 章）：E[a + cX] = a + cE[X]；Var[a + cX] = c²Var[X]（常数 a 不贡献方差，系数要平方）。

Step by step(ii) 4 Tx, 6 Rx

  1. Flat fading → one complex gain hij per antenna pair, 6 × 4 = 24 in total.平坦衰落 → 每对天线一个复数增益 hij，共 6 × 4 = 24 个。
  2. Sizes: x is 4×1 (4 transmit antennas), y and v are 6×1 (6 receive antennas), so H is 6×4.尺寸：x 是 4×1（4 根发射天线），y、v 是 6×1（6 根接收天线），所以 H 是 6×4。
  3. Write out the matrix:
    y = Hx + v
    H = [h11 h12 h13 h14; h21 h22 h23 h24; … ; h61 h62 h63 h64] (6 rows, 4 columns)
    yi = Σj=14 hijxj + vi, i = 1, …, 6

Check: the matrix product (6×4)(4×1) = 6×1 matches the size of y.检查方法：矩阵乘法 (6×4)(4×1) = 6×1，和 y 的尺寸一致。

Step by step(iii) Mean and variance

  1. Mean: s is the transmitted (deterministic) signal; h and G are known constants for detection; w has zero mean:均值：s 是发送的确定信号；h、G 对检测来说是已知常数；w 零均值：
    E[ŝ] = s + (1/‖h‖²)·G·E[w] = s + 0 = s
    The detector is unbiased: on average it gives exactly the transmitted symbol.检测是无偏的（unbiased），平均来说正好等于发送的符号。
  2. Variance: s is a constant and adds no variance; the random part is (1/‖h‖²)Gw, and the coefficient 1/‖h‖² squared is 1/‖h‖⁴:方差：s 是常数，不贡献方差；随机部分是 (1/‖h‖²)Gw，系数 1/‖h‖² 平方后是 1/‖h‖⁴：
    Var[ŝ] = (1/‖h‖⁴)·Var[Gw] = (1/‖h‖⁴)·σ²‖h‖²·(1, 1)T = (σ²/‖h‖²)·(1, 1)T
  3. Meaning: both symbols have noise variance σ²/‖h‖² = σ²/(|h₁|² + |h₂|²), so ŝ ~ N(s, σ²/‖h‖²). The power gains of the two paths add up and the noise is pushed down: as long as h₁ and h₂ are not both small, detection is reliable. This is Alamouti's transmit diversity (diversity order 2). The corresponding per-symbol SNR = E{|sn|²}‖h‖²/σ² (p.26).含义：两个符号的噪声方差都是 σ²/‖h‖² = σ²/(|h₁|² + |h₂|²)，所以 ŝ ~ N(s, σ²/‖h‖²)。两条路径的功率增益相加，噪声被压低：只要 h₁、h₂ 不同时很小，检测就可靠，这就是 Alamouti 的发射分集（分集阶数 2）。对应的每个符号的 SNR = E{|sn|²}‖h‖²/σ²（p.26）。

Small numerical example: |h₁|² = 0.5, |h₂|² = 1.5 → ‖h‖² = 2, so the noise variance becomes σ²/2, twice as good as a single path with gain 1.数字小例子：|h₁|² = 0.5、|h₂|² = 1.5 → ‖h‖² = 2，噪声方差变成 σ²/2，比只有一条增益为 1 的路径好一倍。

PitfallsCommon ways to lose marks

  • Writing H as 4×6: number of rows = number of receive antennas = 6.H 写成 4×6：行数 = 接收天线数 = 6。
  • (ii) Writing only y = Hx + v without explaining "why only one gain" (flat → no resolvable multipath → one complex coefficient).(ii) 只写 y = Hx + v，没解释"为什么只有一个增益"（平坦 → 无可分辨多径 → 一个复系数）。
  • (iii) Multiplying the variance by 1/‖h‖² only (not squared), which gives σ² and a wrong conclusion.(iii) 方差只乘 1/‖h‖²（没平方），得到 σ²，结论就错了。
  • Leaving out the reason "zero mean → unbiased" and giving only the result (the lecturer said a number without reasoning gets only half marks).漏写"零均值 → 无偏"的理由，只写一个结果（老师说只写数不写理由只给一半分）。

ExamHow to write it in English

(ii) In a flat fading channel the signal bandwidth is smaller than the coherence bandwidth (the delay spread is much smaller than the symbol duration), so the multipath components between each transmit–receive antenna pair cannot be resolved and add up to a single complex gain. There is no ISI, and each channel is described by one gain hij.

The input-output relationship is y = Hx + v, where x is the 4 × 1 transmitted vector, y and v are 6 × 1 received and noise vectors, and H is the 6 × 4 channel matrix H = [hij], i = 1, …, 6 (receive antennas, rows), j = 1, …, 4 (transmit antennas, columns). Element by element: yi = Σj=14 hijxj + vi.

(iii) Since s is deterministic and w has zero mean, E[ŝ] = s + (1/‖h‖²)G E[w] = s, i.e. the detection is unbiased.

The constant s does not contribute to the variance, and the scalar 1/‖h‖² is squared: Var[ŝ] = (1/‖h‖⁴)Var[Gw] = (1/‖h‖⁴)σ²‖h‖²(1, 1)T = (σ²/‖h‖²)(1, 1)T.

Hence each detected symbol is Gaussian with mean sn and variance σ²/‖h‖² = σ²/(|h₁|² + |h₂|²): the gains of the two paths add up and reduce the effective noise, which gives diversity.

In one line: under flat fading each antenna pair has one complex gain, y = Hx + v, H is 6×4; the Alamouti decision statistic has mean s (unbiased) and variance σ²/‖h‖² (square the coefficient, then multiply by the noise variance).一句话：平坦衰落每对天线一个复增益，y = Hx + v，H 是 6×4；Alamouti 检测量均值为 s（无偏），方差 σ²/‖h‖²（系数平方后乘噪声方差）。
