2024-25 S2Q2(a)13 marks
Topics: transversal filter · zero-forcing equaliser taps · BER with residual ISI考点：横向滤波器 · 迫零均衡抽头 · 残余 ISI 下的误码率
Original question (verbatim)

2. (a) The Z-transform of a channel is H(Z) = 1 + hZ−1, where h is the channel gain. The equalizer at the receiver is implemented as a transversal filter shown in Figure 2, where ri and yi are the received signal and equalizer output respectively, c0, c1 and c2 are the equalizer gain coefficients, and Z−1 represents a delay of 1 symbol duration.

Redrawn from the original Figure 2: a three-tap transversal (FIR) equaliser.按原卷 Figure 2 重画：三抽头横向（FIR）均衡器。

(i) What should the value of h be for an AWGN channel without fading? What would you observe on the value of h for fast-fading channels? Explain your answers.

(ii) If the equalizer implements the zero-forcing technique, determine the values of c1, c2, and c3 in Figure 2, if h = 0.2.

(iii) The equalizer is now implemented with another design such that the decision variable is yi = si + 0.6si−1 + w′i, where si is the transmitted symbol that is equally likely to be 1 or −1, and w′i is an additive white Gaussian noise with zero mean and a variance of 0.64. The decision rule is such that, si will be detected as 1 if yi ≥ 0, or −1 if yi < 0. Determine the probability of error for this equalizer.

(13 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
(i) h for AWGN without fading: in H(Z) = 1 + hZ⁻¹, the 1 is the direct path and hZ⁻¹ is a multipath echo arriving one symbol later. A pure AWGN channel has only the direct path plus noise and no echo, so h = 0, H(Z) = 1, there is no ISI, and the equaliser only needs c₀ = 1 with all other taps 0.(i) AWGN 无衰落时的 h：H(Z) = 1 + hZ⁻¹ 里，1 是直达路径，hZ⁻¹ 是晚一个符号到达的多径回波。纯 AWGN 信道只有一条直达路径加噪声，没有回波，所以 h = 0，H(Z) = 1，没有 ISI，均衡器只要 c₀ = 1、其余为 0。
2
(i) h under fast fading: with fast fading the coherence time is comparable to, or even shorter than, the symbol duration, so h is a time-varying complex random variable whose amplitude and phase change noticeably within a few symbols. So h is not a constant but varies rapidly with time: the equaliser coefficients must be re-estimated and tracked adaptively all the time (with training sequences sent more often), otherwise they soon become mismatched.(i) 快衰落时的 h：快衰落（fast fading）的相干时间（coherence time）和符号时长相当甚至更短，h 是随时间变化的复随机量，幅度和相位在几个符号内就明显改变。所以 h 不是常数，而是快速时变：均衡器系数必须不断重新估计、自适应跟踪（更频繁地发训练序列），否则很快失配。
3
(ii) Zero-forcing principle: zero-forcing (ZF) equalisation makes the cascaded response H(Z)C(Z) = 1, i.e. no ISI at all (notes Ch6 p.23):(ii) 迫零原理：迫零均衡（zero-forcing）要让级联响应 H(Z)C(Z) = 1，也就是完全没有 ISI（讲义 Ch6 p.23）：
C(Z) = 1/H(Z) = 1/(1 + 0.2Z⁻¹)
4
(ii) Expand by long division (same method as the worked example in notes Ch6 p.24), 1 ÷ (1 + 0.2Z⁻¹):(ii) 长除法展开（同讲义 Ch6 p.24 例题的做法），1 ÷ (1 + 0.2Z⁻¹)：
Quotient term 1: subtract 1 + 0.2Z⁻¹, remainder −0.2Z⁻¹
Quotient term −0.2Z⁻¹: subtract −0.2Z⁻¹ − 0.04Z⁻², remainder 0.04Z⁻²
Quotient term 0.04Z⁻²: subtract 0.04Z⁻² + 0.008Z⁻³, remainder −0.008Z⁻³商 1：减去 1 + 0.2Z⁻¹，余 −0.2Z⁻¹
商 −0.2Z⁻¹：减去 −0.2Z⁻¹ − 0.04Z⁻²，余 0.04Z⁻²
商 0.04Z⁻²：减去 0.04Z⁻² + 0.008Z⁻³，余 −0.008Z⁻³
C(Z) = 1 − 0.2Z⁻¹ + 0.04Z⁻² − 0.008Z⁻³ + …
Pattern: the coefficient of the k-th term is (−0.2)k.规律：第 k 项的系数是 (−0.2)k。
5
(ii) Keep 3 taps + self-check: Figure 2 has only 3 taps, so keep the first three terms. The question text says "c₁, c₂, c₃"; these correspond to c₀, c₁, c₂ in the figure:(ii) 取 3 个抽头 + 自检：Figure 2 只有 3 个抽头，取前三项。题目文字写 "c₁, c₂, c₃"，对应图里的 c₀、c₁、c₂：
c₀ = 1, c₁ = −0.2, c₂ = 0.04
Self-check: (1 + 0.2Z⁻¹)(1 − 0.2Z⁻¹ + 0.04Z⁻²) = 1 + 0·Z⁻¹ + 0·Z⁻² + 0.008Z⁻³; only the residual ISI of 0.008 caused by truncation is left ✓.自检：(1 + 0.2Z⁻¹)(1 − 0.2Z⁻¹ + 0.04Z⁻²) = 1 + 0·Z⁻¹ + 0·Z⁻² + 0.008Z⁻³，只剩截断造成的 0.008 残余 ISI ✓。
6
(iii) Split into two cases by the previous symbol: σ² = 0.64 → σ = 0.8. First take si = +1 sent; an error occurs if yi < 0. The previous symbol is si−1 = ±1, each with probability one half:(iii) 按前一个符号分两种情况：σ² = 0.64 → σ = 0.8。先看发 si = +1，出错条件是 yi < 0。前一个符号 si−1 = ±1 各占一半：
si−1 = +1: y = 1.6 + w′ → P = Q(1.6/0.8) = Q(2.0)
si−1 = −1: y = 0.4 + w′ → P = Q(0.4/0.8) = Q(0.5)
This is the method of notes Ch6 p.28: first find the conditional error probability for a given ISI, Q((q₀ + ISI)/σ) (here q₀ = 1, ISI = ±0.6), then average over the ISI.这就是讲义 Ch6 p.28 的做法：先在给定 ISI 下求条件误码率 Q((q₀ + ISI)/σ)（这里 q₀ = 1，ISI = ±0.6），再对 ISI 取平均。
7
(iii) Look up the Q table and average: Q(2.0) = 0.0228, Q(0.5) = 0.3085:
Pe = ½(0.0228 + 0.3085) = ½ × 0.3313 ≈ 0.166
When −1 is sent, y = −1 ± 0.6 + w′ and an error occurs if y ≥ 0; the distances to the decision threshold are again 1.6 and 0.4, so by symmetry the result is the same, and the overall Pe ≈ 0.166.发 −1 时 y = −1 ± 0.6 + w′，出错条件 y ≥ 0，到判决门限的距离还是 1.6 和 0.4，由对称性结果相同，所以总 Pe ≈ 0.166。
8
(iii) Compare + assess: without ISI, Pe = Q(1/0.8) = Q(1.25) = 0.106. The residual ISI of 0.6 raises the error probability to 0.166, mostly from the half of the cases in which the eye is open by only 0.4 (Q(0.5) = 0.31). The residual ISI is too large, so this design is poor.(iii) 对比 + 评价：如果没有 ISI，Pe = Q(1/0.8) = Q(1.25) = 0.106。0.6 的残余 ISI 把误码率提高到 0.166，主要来自眼图只张开 0.4 的那一半情况（Q(0.5) = 0.31）。残余 ISI 太大，说明这个设计不好。
(i) h = 0; under fast fading h varies rapidly; (ii) 1, −0.2, 0.04; (iii) Pe ≈ 0.166(i) h = 0；快衰落时 h 快速时变 (ii) 1，−0.2，0.04 (iii) Pe ≈ 0.166
Note: part (ii) of the original says "c₁, c₂, and c₃", but Figure 2 labels c₀, c₁, c₂; the answer follows the figure.注：原题 (ii) 写的是 "c₁, c₂, and c₃"，但 Figure 2 标的是 c₀、c₁、c₂，按图作答。
◆ Key points
What it tests
Transversal filter, zero-forcing taps, BER with residual ISI (Ch. 6 p.19–28).横向滤波器、迫零抽头、残余 ISI 误码率（第 6 章 p.19–28）。
Knowledge used
Pure AWGN, no multipath → H = 1; 1/(1 + hZ⁻¹) = 1 − hZ⁻¹ + h²Z⁻² − …; Pe = ½[Q((1 − a)/σ) + Q((1 + a)/σ)].
Method
Long division or term-by-term matching gives 1, −0.2, 0.04; σ = √0.64 = 0.8; split into two cases by the previous symbol, ±1.长除或逐项比较得 1、−0.2、0.04；σ = √0.64 = 0.8，按前一个符号 ±1 分两种情况。
Common mistakes
Variance 0.64 → σ = 0.8; the signs alternate; the residual ISI of 0.6 is large and the BER is 0.166, so this design is poor.方差 0.64 → σ = 0.8；符号正负交替；残余 ISI 0.6 很大，误码率 0.166，说明这个设计不好。
Variations
With the residual ISI reduced to 0.2 and the same σ: ½[Q(1) + Q(1.5)] ≈ 0.113, which is exactly the number in 2025-26 S2 Q2(a).残余 ISI 降到 0.2、σ 不变：½[Q(1) + Q(1.5)] ≈ 0.113，正是 2025-26 S2 Q2(a) 的数。
Concept + Step by step: transversal filter, zero-forcing taps and error rate with residual ISI

ConceptTransversal filter and zero-forcing equalisation

  • Transversal filter (Ch. 6 of the notes): simply an FIR filter. The input ri passes through a chain of Z⁻¹ elements (each a one-symbol delay), each tap is multiplied by a coefficient ck, and the results are added: yi = c₀ri + c₁ri−1 + c₂ri−2, i.e. C(Z) = c₀ + c₁Z⁻¹ + c₂Z⁻².横向滤波器（transversal filter，讲义第 6 章）：就是 FIR 滤波器。输入 ri 经过一串 Z⁻¹（每个延迟一个符号），每个抽头乘一个系数 ck，再相加：yi = c₀ri + c₁ri−1 + c₂ri−2，即 C(Z) = c₀ + c₁Z⁻¹ + c₂Z⁻²。
  • Zero-forcing equalisation (ZF): require "channel × equaliser = 1", i.e. C(Z) = 1/H(Z), which forces the ISI to zero (ignoring the noise). 1/H(Z) is generally infinitely long, so a finite number of taps can only take the first few terms of the long division (example in Ch. 6, p.24: the first two taps of 1/(1 + 0.3Z⁻¹) are 1, −0.3).迫零均衡（zero-forcing, ZF）：要求"信道 × 均衡器 = 1"，即 C(Z) = 1/H(Z)，把 ISI 强行压成零（不管噪声）。1/H(Z) 一般是无穷长，有限个抽头只能取长除法的前几项（第 6 章 p.24 的例子：1/(1 + 0.3Z⁻¹) 的前两个抽头是 1、−0.3）。
  • Meaning of h: H(Z) = 1 + hZ⁻¹ means there is a direct path plus an echo that arrives one symbol later with gain h. With h = 0 there is no ISI.h 的含义：H(Z) = 1 + hZ⁻¹ 说明有一条直达路径，外加一条晚一个符号、增益为 h 的回波。h = 0 就没有 ISI。
  • Fast fading: the coherence time is comparable to or even shorter than the symbol duration, so the channel changes within a few symbols (Ch. 2, p.37).快衰落（fast fading）：相干时间和符号时长相当甚至更短，信道在几个符号内就变（第 2 章 p.37）。

Step by step(i) Values of h

Pure AWGN, no fading: there is only one direct path and no multipath echo, H(Z) = 1, so h = 0; there is no ISI and no equalisation is needed. Fast fading channel: the amplitude and phase of h change randomly within a very short time, so h is not a constant; the equaliser coefficients must be re-estimated continuously and adaptively tracked, otherwise they quickly become mismatched.纯 AWGN、没有衰落：只有一条直达路径、没有多径回波，H(Z) = 1，所以 h = 0，无 ISI，不需要均衡。快衰落信道：h 的幅度和相位都会在很短时间内随机变化，所以 h 不是常数；均衡器系数必须不断重新估计、自适应跟踪，否则很快失配。

Step by step(ii) Zero-forcing taps (h = 0.2)

  1. C(Z) = 1/(1 + 0.2Z⁻¹), by long division (or using 1/(1 + x) = 1 − x + x² − …, x = 0.2Z⁻¹):
    1/(1 + 0.2Z⁻¹) = 1 − 0.2Z⁻¹ + 0.04Z⁻² − 0.008Z⁻³ + …
  2. There are only three taps, so take the first three terms:只有三个抽头，取前三项：
    c₀ = 1, c₁ = −0.2, c₂ = 0.04
  3. Check:
    C(Z)H(Z) = (1 − 0.2Z⁻¹ + 0.04Z⁻²)(1 + 0.2Z⁻¹) = 1 + 0.008Z⁻³
    The Z⁻¹ and Z⁻² terms cancel, leaving only a tiny residual ISI of 0.008; this is the error caused by truncation.Z⁻¹、Z⁻² 项抵消，只剩 0.008 的微小残余 ISI，这就是截断带来的误差。

Step by step(iii) Error rate of the other design

  1. Noise standard deviation:
    σ = √0.64 = 0.8
  2. Suppose si = +1 is sent. The previous symbol si−1 is ±1 with equal probability and adds ±0.6 of interference, giving two cases:
    • si−1 = +1: mean of y is 1.6; an error needs y < 0 → Q(1.6/0.8) = Q(2) = 0.0228
    • si−1 = −1: mean of y is 0.4 → Q(0.4/0.8) = Q(0.5) = 0.3085设发 si = +1。前一个符号 si−1 等概 ±1，带来 ±0.6 的干扰，分两种情况：
    • si−1 = +1：y 的均值 1.6，错判需 y < 0 → Q(1.6/0.8) = Q(2) = 0.0228
    • si−1 = −1：y 的均值 0.4 → Q(0.4/0.8) = Q(0.5) = 0.3085
  3. Average:
    Pe = ½(0.3085 + 0.0228) ≈ 0.166
  4. Sending −1 is symmetric and gives the same result.发 −1 时对称，结果相同。

Compare: without residual ISI, Pe = Q(1/0.8) = Q(1.25) ≈ 0.106. The residual ISI of 0.6 makes the error rate about 1.6 times larger, mainly because of the half of the cases where "the mean is only 0.4". This shows the design is poor.对比：如果没有残余 ISI，Pe = Q(1/0.8) = Q(1.25) ≈ 0.106。0.6 的残余 ISI 让误码率变成约 1.6 倍，主要来自"均值只剩 0.4"那一半情况，说明这个设计不好。

PitfallsWatch out

  • The question says "c₁, c₂, c₃", but the figure labels them c₀, c₁, c₂. Answer according to the figure and state how the labels correspond.原题写 "c₁, c₂, c₃"，但图里标的是 c₀、c₁、c₂，按图作答并写明对应关系。
  • The tap signs alternate: +1, −0.2, +0.04.抽头符号正负交替：+1、−0.2、+0.04。
  • Take the square root of the variance 0.64 to get σ = 0.8 before putting it into Q.方差 0.64 要开方成 σ = 0.8 再放进 Q。
  • You must be able to look up Q(0.5) = 0.3085 (near the first row of the table).Q(0.5) = 0.3085 要会查（表的第一行附近）。

ExamHow to write it in English

(i) For an AWGN channel without fading there is only the direct path and no multipath echo, so H(Z) = 1 and h = 0 (no ISI). In a fast-fading channel the coherence time is comparable to or shorter than the symbol duration, so the value of h (amplitude and phase) changes rapidly with time; the equalizer coefficients must therefore be re-estimated and adaptively tracked continuously.

(ii) For zero forcing, C(Z) = 1/H(Z) = 1/(1 + 0.2Z⁻¹) = 1 − 0.2Z⁻¹ + 0.04Z⁻² − 0.008Z⁻³ + … . With three taps, c₀ = 1, c₁ = −0.2 and c₂ = 0.04 (the coefficients labelled in Figure 2). Then C(Z)H(Z) = 1 + 0.008Z⁻³, so only a very small residual ISI remains.

(iii) σ = √0.64 = 0.8. Given si = 1: if si−1 = 1, the mean of yi is 1.6 and P(error) = Q(1.6/0.8) = Q(2) = 0.0228; if si−1 = −1, the mean is 0.4 and P(error) = Q(0.4/0.8) = Q(0.5) = 0.3085. Since si−1 = ±1 with equal probability, Pe = ½(0.3085 + 0.0228) ≈ 0.166, and by symmetry the same result holds for si = −1.

In one line: with no fading h = 0; with fast fading h changes quickly and must be tracked; ZF takes the first three terms of 1/(1 + 0.2Z⁻¹): 1, −0.2, 0.04; with residual ISI 0.6, average over the two cases ±0.6 to get Pe ≈ 0.166.一句话：无衰落时 h = 0，快衰落时 h 快速时变要跟踪；迫零取 1/(1 + 0.2Z⁻¹) 的前三项 1、−0.2、0.04；残余 ISI 0.6 时按 ±0.6 两种情况平均，Pe ≈ 0.166。

Past final exam
2025-26 S1Q2(a)13 marks
Topics: ISI channel length L · BER with direct decisions and no equalisation · noise enhancement by the equaliser考点：ISI 信道长度 L · 不均衡直接判决的误码率 · 均衡器放大噪声
Original question (verbatim)

2. (a) A mobile radio system transmits message symbols, {m[n]} over an AWGN Inter-Symbol Interference (ISI) channel. The received signal can be expressed as, r[n] = Σi=1L m[n − i + 1]h[i] + w(n) where m[n] is equally likely to be +1 or −1, {w(n)} is a Gaussian random variable with zero mean and a variance of 0.36, and the ISI channel, {h[i]}, has a Z-transform of H(Z) = 1 + 0.3Z−1.

(i) Determine the value of L in the expression for r[n] above.

(ii) r[n] can be used as a decision variable to detect m[n]. Determine the average probability of error if the decision rule is m̂[n] = sgn[r[n]].

(iii) The receiver uses an equalizer that has a Z-transform of C(Z) = 1 − c1Z−1 + c2Z−2, where c1 > 0 and c2 > 0. Show that there is an increase in the noise variance at the equalizer output.

(13 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
(i) Read off the channel coefficients: the coefficients of H(Z) are the channel impulse response: Z⁰ term → h[1] = 1, Z⁻¹ term → h[2] = 0.3. There are 2 taps, so L = 2. Substitute into the sum in the question (i = 1 → m[n]h[1], i = 2 → m[n−1]h[2]):(i) 读出信道系数：H(Z) 的各项系数就是信道冲激响应：Z⁰ 项 → h[1] = 1，Z⁻¹ 项 → h[2] = 0.3。共 2 个抽头，所以 L = 2。代回题中的求和式（i = 1 → m[n]h[1]，i = 2 → m[n−1]h[2]）：
r[n] = m[n] + 0.3m[n−1] + w(n)
That is, the current symbol + 30% interference (ISI) from the previous symbol + noise.即当前符号 + 前一个符号 30% 的干扰（ISI）+ 噪声。
2
(ii) Write down the error condition: σ = √0.36 = 0.6. Let m[n] = +1; m̂[n] = sgn(r[n]) is wrong if and only if r[n] ≤ 0:(ii) 写出出错条件：σ = √0.36 = 0.6。设 m[n] = +1，m̂[n] = sgn(r[n]) 出错当且仅当 r[n] ≤ 0：
1 + 0.3m[n−1] + w ≤ 0 → w ≤ −(1 + 0.3m[n−1])
The previous symbol m[n−1] = ±1 with equal probability, so there are two cases: first find the conditional error probability for a given ISI, then average over the ISI (Ch. 6 of the notes, p.27–28).前一符号 m[n−1] = ±1 等概，所以分两种情况：先求给定 ISI 的条件误码率，再对 ISI 取平均（讲义第 6 章 p.27–28）。
3
(ii) The two cases: P(w ≤ −a) = Q(a/σ):
m[n−1] = +1: a = 1.3, Q(1.3/0.6) = Q(2.17) ≈ 0.0150
m[n−1] = −1: a = 0.7, Q(0.7/0.6) = Q(1.17) ≈ 0.1210
(Q table to two decimal places; with the exact z = 2.167 and 1.167 you get 0.0151 and 0.1217.) When the ISI has the same sign as the current symbol, the signal is reinforced; with the opposite sign it is weakened, and most errors come from the latter case.（Q 表取两位小数；用精确的 z = 2.167、1.167 是 0.0151、0.1217。）ISI 与当前符号同号时信号被加强，异号时被削弱，误码主要来自后者。
4
(ii) Average:
Pe = ½(0.0150 + 0.1210) = 0.068 (exact value ½(0.0151 + 0.1217) = 0.0684)
For m[n] = −1 everything is symmetric and the result is the same, so the average error probability is Pe ≈ 0.068. Compare: without ISI, Pe = Q(1/0.6) = Q(1.67) ≈ 0.0475, so the ISI makes the error probability about 1.4 times larger.m[n] = −1 时完全对称，结果相同，所以平均误码率 Pe ≈ 0.068。对比：没有 ISI 时 Pe = Q(1/0.6) = Q(1.67) ≈ 0.0475，ISI 让误码率变为约 1.4 倍。
5
(iii) Noise through the equaliser: the equaliser is an FIR filter, so the output noise is the input noise convolved with the taps (Ch. 6 p.21: w′ = w ∗ c). The taps of C(Z) = 1 − c₁Z⁻¹ + c₂Z⁻² are (1, −c₁, c₂):(iii) 噪声经过均衡器：均衡器是 FIR 滤波器，输出噪声是输入噪声与抽头的卷积（第 6 章 p.21：w′ = w ∗ c）。C(Z) = 1 − c₁Z⁻¹ + c₂Z⁻² 的抽头是 (1, −c₁, c₂)：
w′(n) = w(n) − c₁w(n−1) + c₂w(n−2)
6
(iii) Output noise variance: w(n), w(n−1), w(n−2) are mutually independent (white noise), each with variance σ² = 0.36. The variance of a sum of independent variables = the sum of the variances, with each coefficient squared (Ch1b p.11: V(aX) = a²V(X)):(iii) 求输出噪声方差：w(n)、w(n−1)、w(n−2) 相互独立（白噪声）、方差都是 σ² = 0.36。独立变量和的方差 = 方差之和，系数要平方（Ch1b p.11：V(aX) = a²V(X)）：
Var[w′] = σ²(1² + (−c₁)² + c₂²) = 0.36(1 + c₁² + c₂²)
This is σ²‖c‖² from notes p.27. Since c₁ > 0 and c₂ > 0, c₁² + c₂² > 0, so Var[w′] > 0.36: the output noise variance is larger by 0.36(c₁² + c₂²). This is the "noise enhancement" of a linear equaliser (Ch. 6 p.29, p.41).这就是讲义 p.27 的 σ²‖c‖²。因为 c₁ > 0、c₂ > 0，c₁² + c₂² > 0，所以 Var[w′] > 0.36，输出噪声方差多出 0.36(c₁² + c₂²)。这就是线性均衡器的“噪声增强”（第 6 章 p.29、p.41）。
7
(iii) Numerical example: this C(Z) is exactly the first three taps of the zero-forcing equaliser (ZFE) for this channel. Long division gives 1/(1 + 0.3Z⁻¹) = 1 − 0.3Z⁻¹ + 0.09Z⁻² − … (same method as notes p.24), i.e. c₁ = 0.3, c₂ = 0.09:(iii) 数字例子：这个 C(Z) 正好是本信道迫零均衡器（ZFE）的前三个抽头：长除法 1/(1 + 0.3Z⁻¹) = 1 − 0.3Z⁻¹ + 0.09Z⁻² − …（同讲义 p.24 的做法），即 c₁ = 0.3、c₂ = 0.09：
Var[w′] = 0.36 × (1 + 0.09 + 0.0081) = 0.36 × 1.0981 = 0.395 > 0.36 ✓
The noise power increases by about 9.8% (0.41 dB).噪声功率增加约 9.8%（0.41 dB）。
(i) L = 2; (ii) Pe ≈ 0.068; (iii) σ′² = 0.36(1 + c₁² + c₂²) > 0.36
◆ Key points
What it tests
ISI channel length, BER without equalisation, noise enhancement by the equaliser (Ch. 6 p.22–28, p.41).ISI 信道长度、不均衡时的误码率、均衡器的噪声增强（第 6 章 p.22–28、p.41）。
Knowledge used
Number of terms in H(Z) = L; Pe = ½[Q((1 − a)/σ) + Q((1 + a)/σ)]; variance of a sum of independent variables = sum of (coefficient² × variance).H(Z) 的项数 = L；Pe = ½[Q((1 − a)/σ) + Q((1 + a)/σ)]；独立变量和的方差 = 系数平方 × 方差之和。
Method
(i) count the terms: L = 2; (ii) σ = 0.6, two cases for ISI ±0.3; (iii) write w′ = w − c₁w(n−1) + c₂w(n−2), variance σ²(1 + c₁² + c₂²).(i) 数项得 L = 2；(ii) σ = 0.6，ISI ±0.3 两种情况；(iii) 写出 w′ = w − c₁w(n−1) + c₂w(n−2)，方差 σ²(1 + c₁² + c₂²)。
Common mistakes
σ = √0.36 = 0.6; the coefficients are squared in the variance, so their signs do not matter.σ = √0.36 = 0.6；方差里系数要平方，正负号不影响结果。
Comparison
Without ISI Q(1/0.6) = Q(1.67) ≈ 0.048; with ISI 0.068.
Concept + Step by step: ISI error probability and noise enhancement

ConceptThe discrete ISI channel model

With multipath, a symbol's energy "smears" into the next few sampling instants, causing inter-symbol interference (ISI). Sampled at the symbol interval, the channel is a set of tap coefficients h[1], h[2], …, h[L], and the received signal is the convolution of the message sequence with the taps plus noise (Ch. 6 p.22): r[n] = Σh[i]m[n − i + 1] + w(n). The channel's Z-transform is H(Z) = h[1] + h[2]Z⁻¹ + …, where Z⁻¹ means a delay of one symbol, so L equals the number of terms in H(Z).信道有多径时，一个符号的能量会"拖尾"到后面几个采样时刻，造成符号间干扰（ISI，Inter-Symbol Interference）。按符号间隔采样后，信道就是一组抽头系数 h[1], h[2], …, h[L]，接收信号是消息序列和抽头的卷积加噪声（第 6 章 p.22）：r[n] = Σh[i]m[n − i + 1] + w(n)。信道的 Z 变换 H(Z) = h[1] + h[2]Z⁻¹ + …，Z⁻¹ 表示延迟一个符号，所以 H(Z) 有几项，L 就是几。

ConceptFinding the error probability with residual ISI

Notes p.27–28: decision variable = desired signal + ISI term + Gaussian noise. The ISI term depends on the previously sent symbols and is a discrete random variable. Method: first fix the ISI value and find the conditional error probability Q((q₀ + ISI)/σ); then average over all possible ISI values. It is the same idea as in Ch. 3, with one extra layer of averaging.讲义 p.27–28：判决变量 = 期望信号 + ISI 项 + 高斯噪声。ISI 项取决于前面发的符号，是离散随机变量。做法：先固定 ISI 的取值，求条件误码率 Q((q₀ + ISI)/σ)；再对 ISI 所有可能取值求平均。和第 3 章的思路一样，只多了一层平均。

ConceptWhy the equalizer amplifies noise

The equalizer C(Z) is an FIR filter; it acts on the noise as well as on the signal (p.21, p.25): w′(n) = Σcjw(n − j). The w samples are independent, each with variance σ²; the variance of a sum of independent variables is the sum of their variances, with the coefficients squared: σ′² = σ²Σcj². With a main tap of 1, Σcj² is greater than 1 as soon as any other tap is non-zero. This is "noise enhancement" (p.41). The lecturer said that for the equalization chapter you must be able to do three things: write the channel and the equalizer as Z-transforms, find the ZF coefficients (long division), and compute the noise power.均衡器 C(Z) 是一个 FIR 滤波器，它不仅作用在信号上，也作用在噪声上（p.21、p.25）：w′(n) = Σcjw(n − j)。各个 w 独立、方差都是 σ²，独立变量之和的方差 = 各项方差之和，系数要平方：σ′² = σ²Σcj²。主抽头为 1 时，只要还有别的非零抽头，Σcj² 就大于 1，这就是"噪声增强"（p.41）。老师说均衡这一章要会三件事：用 Z 变换写信道和均衡器、迫零系数（长除法）、算噪声功率。

Step by step(i) Channel length

H(Z) = 1 + 0.3Z⁻¹ → h[1] = 1, h[2] = 0.3 → L = 2
r[n] = m[n] + 0.3m[n−1] + w(n)

Step by step(ii) No equalizer, direct decision

σ = √0.36 = 0.6. By symmetry consider only m[n] = +1 (sending −1 gives the same result). The interference 0.3m[n−1] is +0.3 or −0.3 with equal probability:σ = √0.36 = 0.6。由对称性只看 m[n] = +1（发 −1 的结果相同）。干扰 0.3m[n−1] 等概为 +0.3 或 −0.3：

m[n−1]Mean of r[n]Error conditionConditional error probability
+1 (probability ½)1 + 0.3 = 1.3w < −1.3Q(1.3/0.6) = Q(2.17) = 0.0151
−1 (probability ½)1 − 0.3 = 0.7w < −0.7Q(0.7/0.6) = Q(1.17) = 0.1217
Pe = ½(0.0151 + 0.1217) = 0.0684 ≈ 0.068

Compare: without ISI, Pe = Q(1/0.6) = Q(1.67) ≈ 0.0478. ISI sometimes helps and sometimes hurts, but the "bad" half (0.1217) pulls the average up, so overall it is worse.对比：没有 ISI 时 Pe = Q(1/0.6) = Q(1.67) ≈ 0.0478。ISI 时好时坏，但"坏"的那一半（0.1217）拉高了平均，所以总体变差。

Step by step(iii) Noise at the equalizer output

  1. Noise passing through C(Z): w′(n) = w(n) − c₁w(n−1) + c₂w(n−2).
  2. The three terms are independent, so the variances add and the coefficients are squared (the minus sign disappears when squared):三项独立，方差相加，系数平方（负号平方后消失）：
    Var[w′] = σ²(1 + c₁² + c₂²) = 0.36(1 + c₁² + c₂²)
  3. c₁ > 0, c₂ > 0, so c₁² + c₂² > 0 and Var[w′] > 0.36: the noise variance increases.c₁ > 0、c₂ > 0，所以 c₁² + c₂² > 0，Var[w′] > 0.36，噪声方差增大。

A concrete example: the ZF equalizer for this channel, 1/(1 + 0.3Z⁻¹), taken to three terms by long division, is exactly 1 − 0.3Z⁻¹ + 0.09Z⁻² (c₁ = 0.3, c₂ = 0.09, matching the form in the question). The output noise variance is then 0.36 × (1 + 0.09 + 0.0081) = 0.36 × 1.0981 ≈ 0.395, about 10% more than 0.36; and the cascade H(Z)C(Z) = 1 + 0.027Z⁻³ leaves only 0.027 of ISI. Less ISI, more noise: that is the price of equalization.举个具体的例子：这个信道的迫零均衡器 1/(1 + 0.3Z⁻¹) 用长除法取前三项，正好是 1 − 0.3Z⁻¹ + 0.09Z⁻²（c₁ = 0.3，c₂ = 0.09，和题目的形式一致）。此时输出噪声方差 = 0.36 × (1 + 0.09 + 0.0081) = 0.36 × 1.0981 ≈ 0.395，比 0.36 大约 10%；而级联后 H(Z)C(Z) = 1 + 0.027Z⁻³，ISI 只剩 0.027。ISI 少了，噪声多了，这就是均衡的代价。

PitfallsCommon ways to lose marks

  • Writing σ as 0.36: in Q you divide by the standard deviation 0.6.σ 写成 0.36：Q 里除的是标准差 0.6。
  • Computing only one ISI case and forgetting to weight both cases by ½ and add them.只算一种 ISI 情况，忘了两种各乘 ½ 再相加。
  • In (iii), not squaring the coefficients and writing σ²(1 − c₁ + c₂); or forgetting the condition that the terms are independent.(iii) 系数不平方，写成 σ²(1 − c₁ + c₂)；或者忘了"各项独立"这个前提。
  • Answering L = 1 (counting only the delay): L is the number of taps.L 答成 1（只数延迟）：L 是抽头个数。

ExamHow to write it in English

(i) H(Z) = 1 + 0.3Z⁻¹ has two taps, h[1] = 1 and h[2] = 0.3, so L = 2 and r[n] = m[n] + 0.3m[n−1] + w(n).

(ii) σ = √0.36 = 0.6. By symmetry, consider m[n] = +1. The ISI term 0.3m[n−1] is +0.3 or −0.3 with equal probability.
If m[n−1] = +1: P(e) = P(w < −1.3) = Q(1.3/0.6) = Q(2.17) = 0.0151.
If m[n−1] = −1: P(e) = P(w < −0.7) = Q(0.7/0.6) = Q(1.17) = 0.1217.
Average Pe = ½(0.0151 + 0.1217) ≈ 0.068 (compared with Q(1.67) ≈ 0.048 without ISI).

(iii) The noise also passes through the equalizer: w′(n) = w(n) − c₁w(n−1) + c₂w(n−2). Since the noise samples are independent with variance σ², Var[w′] = σ²(1 + c₁² + c₂²) = 0.36(1 + c₁² + c₂²). Because c₁ > 0 and c₂ > 0, Var[w′] > 0.36, i.e. the equalizer increases the noise variance (noise enhancement).

In one line: L is the number of taps, 2; split the ISI ±0.3 into two cases, find Q for each and average to get 0.068; after the equalizer the noise variance is multiplied by (1 + c₁² + c₂²), so it always grows.一句话：L 是抽头数 2；ISI ±0.3 分两种情况求 Q 再平均得 0.068；噪声过均衡器后方差乘 (1 + c₁² + c₂²)，一定变大。

Past final exam
2025-26 S2Q2(a)12 marks
Topics: discrete ISI model · Nyquist criterion for zero ISI · equaliser output noise power · error probability with residual ISI考点：ISI 离散模型 · Nyquist 无 ISI 准则 · 均衡器输出噪声功率 · 残余 ISI 误码率
Original question (verbatim)

2. (a) A system transmits message symbols, {m[n]}, over an Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN) Inter-Symbol Interference (ISI) channel. The symbol m[n] is equally likely to be +1 or −1, the Gaussian noise, w(n), is a random variable with zero mean and a variance of 0.25, the channel impulse response is denoted as {h[i]}, i = 1, 2, …, L.

(i) Express the received signal, r[n], as a discrete time function of {m[n]}, {w[n]}, and {h[i]}. Explain the Nyquist ISI criterion.

(ii) The receiver uses a linear equalizer to reduce the ISI effect. The equalizer is designed with tap coefficients, {cj}, j = 1,2, …, M, where Σj=1M cj2 = 2.56. Determine the noise power at the equalizer output.

(iii) The equalizer output can be derived to be, y[n] = m(n) + 0.2m(n − 1) + w′(n) where w′(n) is the noise at the equalizer output. Using the decision rule of m̂(n) = sgn[y(n)], determine the average probability of error of this system.

(12 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
(i) Discrete model: the n-th received sample = the current symbol and the previous L − 1 symbols, each multiplied by a channel tap and summed, plus noise (notes Ch6 p.22; the notes index from 0, but this question indexes from 1, hence n − i + 1):(i) 离散模型：第 n 个接收采样 = 当前符号和前 L − 1 个符号分别乘信道抽头后相加，再加噪声（讲义 Ch6 p.22；讲义下标从 0 开始，这里题目从 1 开始，所以写成 n − i + 1）：
r[n] = Σi=1L h[i] m[n − i + 1] + w[n]
   = h[1]m[n] + Σi=2L h[i]m[n − i + 1] + w[n]

The first term is the wanted symbol; the sum in the middle is the ISI leaking in from earlier symbols; w[n] is Gaussian noise with zero mean and variance 0.25.
第一项是想要的符号；中间的和是前面的符号漏进来的 ISI；w[n] 是零均值、方差 0.25 的高斯噪声。
2
(i) Nyquist criterion (p.12): after sampling, y(nT) = m[n]ge(0) + Σi≠n m[i]ge(nT − iT) + w(nT), where ge = gT * gC * gR is the equivalent pulse of the transmit filter, channel and receive filter; the sum in the middle is the ISI. Condition for zero ISI:(i) Nyquist 准则（p.12）：采样后 y(nT) = m[n]ge(0) + Σi≠n m[i]ge(nT − iT) + w(nT)，其中 ge = gT * gC * gR 是发送滤波器、信道、接收滤波器的等效脉冲，中间的和就是 ISI。无 ISI 的条件：
ge(nT − iT) = 1, n = i
ge(nT − iT) = 0, n ≠ i

i.e. each pulse is exactly zero at the sampling instants of the other symbols (the pulse may have tails, as long as its zero crossings line up with the other symbols' sampling points). For the discrete model above this means h[1] = 1, h[2] = … = h[L] = 0.
即每个脉冲在其他符号的采样时刻恰好为零（脉冲可以拖尾，只要过零点对准别人的采样点）。对上面的离散模型就是 h[1] = 1、h[2] = … = h[L] = 0。
3
(ii) Output noise power: the equaliser is an M-tap FIR filter, and the noise is filtered by it too:(ii) 输出噪声功率：均衡器是 M 抽头的 FIR 滤波器，噪声也被它滤波：
w′(n) = Σj=1M cj w[n − j + 1]

w is white noise: independent at different times and zero-mean, so the cross terms E[w(a)w(b)] = 0 (a ≠ b); after expanding the square, only the squared terms remain:
w 是白噪声：不同时刻独立、零均值，交叉项 E[w(a)w(b)] = 0（a ≠ b），平方展开后只剩平方项：
σ′² = E[w′²] = Σj cj² E[w²] = σ² Σ cj²
= 0.25 × 2.56 = 0.64

This is the result on p.27, "variance of w′ = σ²‖c‖²". The price of removing ISI with a linear equaliser: the noise is amplified by a factor of 2.56 (about 4.1 dB).
这就是 p.27 的结论"w′ 的方差 = σ²‖c‖²"。线性均衡消 ISI 的代价：噪声被放大 2.56 倍（约 4.1 dB）。
4
(iii) Reduce to a conditional probability: σ′ = √0.64 = 0.8. m(n) = ±1 are equally likely and the problem is symmetric, so Pe = P(error | m(n) = +1). Then y(n) = 1 + 0.2m(n − 1) + w′(n), and the sgn decision is wrong ⇔ y(n) < 0. The residual ISI 0.2m(n−1) takes ±0.2 with equal probability, so there are two cases (p.28).(iii) 化成条件概率：σ′ = √0.64 = 0.8。m(n) = ±1 等概且对称，所以 Pe = P(错 | m(n) = +1)。此时 y(n) = 1 + 0.2m(n − 1) + w′(n)，sgn 判决出错 ⇔ y(n) < 0。残余 ISI 0.2m(n−1) 等概取 ±0.2，分两种情况（p.28）。
5
(iii) The two cases:
• m(n−1) = +1: mean 1 + 0.2 = 1.2, error ⇔ w′ < −1.2:(iii) 两种情况：
• m(n−1) = +1：均值 1 + 0.2 = 1.2，出错 ⇔ w′ < −1.2：
P = Q(1.2/0.8) = Q(1.5) = 0.0668

• m(n−1) = −1: mean 1 − 0.2 = 0.8, error ⇔ w′ < −0.8:
P = Q(0.8/0.8) = Q(1.0) = 0.1587

From the Q table: row 1.5, column 0.00 → 6.681E−02; row 1.0, column 0.00 → 1.587E−01. Note that inside Q you divide by the standard deviation 0.8, not by the variance 0.64.
查 Q 表：行 1.5、列 0.00 → 6.681E−02；行 1.0、列 0.00 → 1.587E−01。注意 Q 里除的是标准差 0.8，不是方差 0.64。
6
(iii) Average: each case has probability ½:(iii) 平均：两种情况各占 ½：
Pe = ½(0.1587 + 0.0668)
= ½ × 0.2255 = 0.11275 ≈ 0.113

Self-check: without residual ISI, Pe = Q(1/0.8) = Q(1.25) = 0.1056; with ISI it is larger (0.113 > 0.106) ✓. Reason: Q is convex on the positive axis, so the extra errors in the half of the cases where the ISI hurts outweigh the errors saved in the half where it helps.
自检：如果没有残余 ISI，Pe = Q(1/0.8) = Q(1.25) = 0.1056；有 ISI 时更大（0.113 > 0.106）✓。原因：Q 在正半轴是凸函数，ISI 帮倒忙那一半多出的误码比帮忙那一半省下的多。
(ii) 0.64 (iii) Pe ≈ 0.113
◆ Key points
What it tests
Discrete ISI model, Nyquist criterion for zero ISI, equaliser output noise, error probability with residual ISI (Ch. 6 p.12, p.22–28).ISI 离散模型、Nyquist 无 ISI 准则、均衡器输出噪声、残余 ISI 误码率（第 6 章 p.12、p.22–28）。
Knowledge used
r[n] = Σh[i]m[n − i + 1] + w[n]; Nyquist: the equivalent pulse is 0 at the other sampling points; σ′² = σ²Σcj².r[n] = Σh[i]m[n − i + 1] + w[n]；Nyquist：等效脉冲在其他采样点为 0；σ′² = σ²Σcj²。
Method
(i) Write the model + explain the criterion (h[1] = 1, all others 0); (ii) 0.25 × 2.56 = 0.64; (iii) σ′ = 0.8, two cases for the ISI ±0.2.(i) 写模型 + 解释准则（h[1] = 1、其余为 0）；(ii) 0.25 × 2.56 = 0.64；(iii) σ′ = 0.8，ISI ±0.2 两种情况。
Common mistakes
Inside Q you divide by σ′ = 0.8, not by the variance 0.64; weight each case by ½.Q 里除的是 σ′ = 0.8，不是方差 0.64；两种情况各乘 ½。
Links
Q2(a) follows this method in all four years of finals; learning page Section 6.3 has a table comparing the numbers from the four years.四年期末 Q2(a) 都是这个套路，讲解页 6.3 节有四年的数字对照表。
Concept + Step by step: Nyquist criterion and residual ISI

ConceptWhere ISI comes from and what the Nyquist criterion says

The transmitter sends one pulse every T seconds; after the transmit filter and the channel, each pulse spreads out. When the receiver samples at t = nT, it gets (Ch. 6 p.10–12):发送端每隔 T 秒发一个脉冲，脉冲经过发送滤波器和信道后会展宽。接收端在 t = nT 采样时，采到的是（第 6 章 p.10–12）：

y(nT) = m[n]ge(0) + Σi≠n m[i]ge(nT − iT) + w(nT)

The first term is the wanted symbol; the second term is the "tails" of the other symbols' pulses at this sampling instant, i.e. ISI. Nyquist criterion for zero ISI: if the equivalent pulse ge equals 1 at its own sampling instant and 0 at the sampling instants of all other symbols, i.e. ge(nT − iT) = 1 (n = i), 0 (n ≠ i), then the second term vanishes and transmission is ISI-free. The pulse may be non-zero between sampling points, as long as it crosses zero exactly at the other symbols' sampling points. The lecturer said this criterion is "worth remembering": one sentence (transmission without ISI) plus one equation.第一项是想要的符号，第二项是其他符号的脉冲"拖尾"到这个采样时刻的部分，就是 ISI。Nyquist 无 ISI 准则：如果等效脉冲 ge 在本符号的采样时刻为 1、在其他所有符号的采样时刻都为 0，即 ge(nT − iT) = 1（n = i）、0（n ≠ i），那么第二项消失，传输没有 ISI。脉冲可以在采样点之间不为零，只要在别人的采样点上恰好过零就行。老师说这个准则"值得记住"：一句话（传输没有 ISI）加一个式子。

Discrete model (p.22): after sampling at the symbol interval, the channel is the taps h[1], …, h[L], r[n] = Σh[i]m[n − i + 1] + w[n]. In this model, the Nyquist criterion is h[1] = 1 and all other h[i] = 0.离散模型（p.22）：按符号间隔采样后，信道就是抽头 h[1], …, h[L]，r[n] = Σh[i]m[n − i + 1] + w[n]。用这个模型说，Nyquist 准则就是 h[1] = 1、其余 h[i] = 0。

ConceptOutput noise and residual ISI of a linear equaliser

The equaliser is an M-tap FIR filter, and the noise passes through it too: w′(n) = Σcjw(n − j + 1). The noise samples are independent with the same variance σ², so the output noise power is σ′² = σ²Σcj² (the "variance σ²‖c‖²" on p.27). If some ISI remains after equalisation, compute the error rate by first fixing the ISI to get the conditional error rate, then averaging over the ISI (p.27–28).均衡器是 M 个抽头的 FIR 滤波器，噪声也要经过它：w′(n) = Σcjw(n − j + 1)。各个噪声样本独立、方差都是 σ²，所以输出噪声功率 σ′² = σ²Σcj²（p.27 的"variance σ²‖c‖²"）。均衡后如果还留有一点 ISI，误码率按"先固定 ISI 求条件误码率、再对 ISI 取平均"来算（p.27–28）。

Step by step(i) Model and criterion

r[n] = Σi=1L h[i]m[n − i + 1] + w[n] = h[1]m[n] + h[2]m[n−1] + … + h[L]m[n−L+1] + w[n]

The first term h[1]m[n] is wanted; the rest, h[i]m[n − i + 1] (i ≥ 2), is ISI from earlier symbols. Then state the Nyquist criterion (the sentence above + the equation).第一项 h[1]m[n] 是想要的，其余 h[i]m[n − i + 1]（i ≥ 2）是前面符号造成的 ISI。再写 Nyquist 准则（上面那句话 + 式子）。

Step by step(ii) Output noise power

σ′² = σ²Σcj² = 0.25 × 2.56 = 0.64

This is 2.56 times the input value 0.25: that is the equaliser's noise enhancement.比输入的 0.25 大了 2.56 倍：这就是均衡器的噪声增强。

Step by step(iii) Error rate with residual ISI

σ′ = √0.64 = 0.8. By symmetry, consider only m(n) = +1; 0.2m(n−1) is ±0.2 with equal probability:σ′ = √0.64 = 0.8。由对称性只看 m(n) = +1，0.2m(n−1) 等概为 ±0.2：

m(n−1)Mean of y(n)Conditional error probability
+1 (probability ½)1.2Q(1.2/0.8) = Q(1.5) = 0.0668
−1 (probability ½)0.8Q(0.8/0.8) = Q(1) = 0.1587
Pe = ½(0.0668 + 0.1587) = 0.1127 ≈ 0.113

Comparison: even if the equaliser removed all ISI, the noise has already been amplified to 0.64, so Pe = Q(1/0.8) = Q(1.25) ≈ 0.106; if the original channel had no ISI and no equaliser were needed, Pe = Q(1/0.5) = Q(2) ≈ 0.023. Noise enhancement is clearly costly.对比：即使均衡器把 ISI 全部去掉，噪声已被放大到 0.64，Pe = Q(1/0.8) = Q(1.25) ≈ 0.106；如果原信道本来就没有 ISI、也不用均衡，Pe = Q(1/0.5) = Q(2) ≈ 0.023。可见噪声增强的代价很大。

PitfallsCommon ways to lose marks

  • (ii) Taking 0.25 × 2.56 and then a square root, or squaring Σcj² again.(ii) 答成 0.25 × 2.56 后又开根号，或者把 Σcj² 再平方。
  • (iii) Dividing by the variance 0.64 inside Q: divide by the standard deviation 0.8.(iii) Q 里除以方差 0.64：要除以标准差 0.8。
  • (iii) Computing only one case, or forgetting to weight each case by ½.(iii) 只算一种情况，或者忘了各乘 ½。
  • (i) Stating the criterion only as "no ISI", without the condition "1 at its own sampling instant, 0 at all others".(i) 准则只写"没有 ISI"，没写采样时刻为 1、其他时刻为 0 的条件。

ExamHow to write it in English

(i) r[n] = Σi=1L h[i] m[n − i + 1] + w[n]. The term h[1]m[n] is the desired symbol and the terms with i ≥ 2 are ISI from previous symbols.

Nyquist ISI criterion: after sampling, y(nT) = m[n]ge(0) + Σi≠n m[i]ge(nT − iT) + w(nT). If the equivalent pulse satisfies ge(nT − iT) = 1 for n = i and 0 for n ≠ i, i.e. each pulse is zero at the sampling instants of all other symbols, the ISI term vanishes and the transmission is ISI-free. For the discrete model this means h[1] = 1 and h[i] = 0 for i ≥ 2.

(ii) The equalizer output noise is w′(n) = Σcjw(n − j + 1). Since the noise samples are independent with variance σ², the output noise power is σ′² = σ²Σcj² = 0.25 × 2.56 = 0.64.

(iii) σ′ = 0.8. By symmetry, take m(n) = +1. If m(n − 1) = +1, P(e) = P(w′ < −1.2) = Q(1.2/0.8) = Q(1.5) = 0.0668. If m(n − 1) = −1, P(e) = P(w′ < −0.8) = Q(1) = 0.1587. Average Pe = ½(0.0668 + 0.1587) ≈ 0.113.

In one line: the Nyquist criterion means the pulse is zero at the other symbols' sampling points; noise power 0.25 × 2.56 = 0.64; σ′ = 0.8, and averaging the two ISI cases ±0.2 gives Pe ≈ 0.113.一句话：Nyquist 准则是脉冲在别人的采样点上为零；噪声功率 0.25 × 2.56 = 0.64；σ′ = 0.8，ISI ±0.2 两种情况平均得 Pe ≈ 0.113。
