Ch. 7 · OFDM: turn one wide, bumpy road into many smooth, narrow lanes

3 practice · 4 past-examNotes →
Part 2 practice
P7 · Q1

OFDM over a two-path channel: choose N, compute H_k, allocate power

Original question · bilingualPractice 7

An OFDM signal x(t) is transmitted through a multi-path channel. The received signals can be expressed as, \(y(t)=h_0x(t)+h_1x(t-\tau)+w(t)\), where \(h_0,h_1\) are independent channel gains, τ is the time delay, and w(t) is the AWGN with zero-mean and variance \(\sigma^2=1\). The Doppler spread and Coherence bandwidth have been measured to be \(B_d\) and \(B_C\) respectively.

OFDM 信号 x(t) 经过多径信道传输，接收信号为 \(y(t)=h_0x(t)+h_1x(t-\tau)+w(t)\)，其中 \(h_0,h_1\) 是相互独立的信道增益，τ 是时延，w(t) 是零均值、方差 \(\sigma^2=1\) 的 AWGN。测得多普勒扩展为 \(B_d\)，相干带宽为 \(B_C\)。

(a) Given a fixed total bandwidth B Hz, the number of sub-carriers N needs to be carefully selected so that each sub-channel could be regarded as experiencing slow flat fading. Explain the principle of how the value of N is selected.

(a) 在总带宽 B Hz 固定的情况下，需要合理选择子载波数 N，使每个子信道都可以看作慢、平坦衰落。说明 N 的选取原则。

(b) For N = 4, \(h_0\) = 0.8, and \(h_1\) = 0.6, find the values of the channel gain coefficients \(H_k\) for each sub-channel.

(b) 当 N = 4、\(h_0\) = 0.8、\(h_1\) = 0.6 时，求各子信道的信道增益系数 \(H_k\)。

(c) Given the value of \(H_k\) from (b), the transmitter allocates power \(P_k\) to the kth sub-channel such that each sub-channel has the same capacity. Under the sum-power constraint, \(\sum_{k=1}^{N}P_k=10\), find the value of \(P_k\) for each sub-channel.

(c) 已知 (b) 中的 \(H_k\)，发射端给第 k 个子信道分配功率 \(P_k\)，使所有子信道的容量相同。在总功率约束 \(\sum_{k=1}^{N}P_k=10\) 下，求每个子信道的 \(P_k\)。

(d) Given the same value of \(H_k\) and the sum-power constraint from (c), find the maximum sum capacity in bits per second per Hertz.

(d) 在相同的 \(H_k\) 和 (c) 的总功率约束下，求最大和容量（bit/s/Hz）。

Slow flat-fading conditionH_k = DFT{h}Equal-capacity allocationWater-fillingCh. 7 of the notes p.5, p.15, p.24
What the question is asking: what does this question actually want?

ScenarioWhat the question is about

An OFDM signal passes through a two-path channel: \(y(t)=h_0x(t)+h_1x(t-\tau)+w(t)\), one direct path plus one echo delayed by τ.OFDM 信号经过两径信道：\(y(t)=h_0x(t)+h_1x(t-\tau)+w(t)\)，直射一条加延迟 τ 的回波一条。

OFDM splits the total bandwidth B into N subcarriers. The question first asks how to choose N, then the gain of each subcarrier, and finally the power allocation to the subcarriers under two different principles.OFDM 把总带宽 B 切成 N 个子载波。题目先问 N 怎么选，再算每个子载波的增益，最后在两种原则下给子载波分功率。

SymbolsWhat each quantity in the question means

\(B_d\)Doppler spread: how fast the channel changes in time (coherence time about 1/B_d)多普勒扩展：信道随时间变化有多快（相干时间约 1/B_d）
\(B_C\)Coherence bandwidth: how far apart in frequency the channel becomes different相干带宽：频率相差多远，信道就不一样了
\(H_k\)Channel gain (complex) of the k-th subcarrier, equal to the DFT of [h₀, h₁]第 k 个子载波的信道增益（复数），等于 [h₀, h₁] 的 DFT
\(P_k\)Power allocated to the k-th subcarrier; the total is 10分给第 k 个子载波的功率，总和 10
σ² = 1Noise variance, so the SNR of subcarrier k = |H_k|²P_k噪声方差，所以子载波 k 的 SNR = |H_k|²P_k

What each part asksWhat each part is asking for

  • (a) Explain how to choose N: each subcarrier must be narrow enough to see flat fading (B/N much smaller than B_C), and an OFDM symbol must be short enough that the channel hardly changes during it (slow fading).(a) 解释 N 怎么选：每个子载波要窄到感受到的是平坦衰落（B/N 远小于 B_C），同时一个 OFDM 符号要短到信道在这期间几乎不变（慢衰落）。
  • (b) N = 4, h₀ = 0.8, h₁ = 0.6: compute H_k for each of the 4 subcarriers.(b) N = 4、h₀ = 0.8、h₁ = 0.6：算出 4 个子载波各自的 H_k。
  • (c) Allocate the total power 10 so that "every subcarrier has the same capacity".(c) 按"每个子载波容量一样"的原则分配总功率 10。
  • (d) Allocate so as to "maximise the total capacity" (water-filling), and find the maximum total capacity per second per hertz.(d) 按"总容量最大"的原则（注水）分配，求每秒每赫兹的最大总容量。

Watch outEasy ways to misread the question

  • The question numbers the subcarriers k = 1…4; watch how they map to 0…3 (H₄ = H₀).题目把子载波编号成 k = 1…4，注意和 0…3 的对应关系（H₄ = H₀）。
  • (d) asks "per hertz": each of the 4 subcarriers takes B/4, so divide the total bits by 4.(d) 要"每赫兹"：4 个子载波各占 B/4，总比特数要除以 4。
  • In water-filling, first check whether the worst subcarrier should be dropped.注水时先检查最差的子载波要不要放弃。

PurposeWhat the question wants you to understand

OFDM turns one frequency-selective channel into N subchannels, each flat but with different gains; sharing power "equally for everyone" is wasteful, while water-filling drops the worst subcarrier and gives a much higher total capacity.OFDM 把一个频率选择性信道变成 N 个各自平坦、但增益不同的子信道；"人人平等"地分功率很浪费，注水会放弃最差的子载波，总容量高得多。

In one line: OFDM over a two-path channel: explain how to choose N, compute the gains of the 4 subcarriers, then allocate power by "equal capacity" and by "water-filling".一句话：两径信道上的 OFDM：说明 N 怎么选，算出 4 个子载波的增益，再分别按"容量相等"和"注水"分功率。
  1. (a) Flat condition: the bandwidth of each sub-carrier, \(\Delta f=B/N\), must be much smaller than the coherence bandwidth \(B_C\), so the frequency response is almost constant inside one sub-band and each sub-carrier sees a single complex gain \(H_k\): \[\frac BN\ll B_C\;\Rightarrow\;N\gg\frac{B}{B_C}\] The condition \(T=NT_S\gg T_D\approx1/B_C\) on Ch 7 p.5 and p.14 is the same thing.
  2. (a) Slow condition: the OFDM symbol duration \(T=N/B\) (\(=NT_S\), \(T_S=1/B\)) must be much shorter than the coherence time \(T_C\approx1/B_d\), so the channel does not change during one OFDM symbol and the sub-carriers stay orthogonal (no ICI): \[\frac NB\ll\frac1{B_d}\;\Rightarrow\;N\ll\frac{B}{B_d}\] Together: \(\dfrac{B}{B_C}\ll N\ll\dfrac{B}{B_d}\), which has a solution only if \(B_d\ll B_C\). Example: B = 1 MHz, \(B_C\) = 50 kHz, \(B_d\) = 100 Hz → 20 ≪ N ≪ 10⁴, e.g. N = 256 (a power of 2 for the FFT).
  3. (b) Write Hk: the impulse response of the two-path channel is \(h=[h_0,h_1]=[0.8,0.6]\) (τ is one sampling interval). The sub-channel gains are its DFT (Ch 7 p.15): \[H_k=\sum_{i=0}^{L-1}h_ie^{-j2\pi ik/N}=0.8+0.6\,e^{-j\pi k/2}\] For k = 1, 2, 3, 4, \(e^{-j\pi k/2}=-j,\ -1,\ j,\ 1\): \[\begin{aligned}H_1&=0.8-0.6j\\ H_2&=0.8-0.6=0.2\\ H_3&=0.8+0.6j\\ H_4&=H_0=0.8+0.6=1.4\end{aligned}\]
  4. (b) Power gains and check: the power allocation needs \(|H_k|^2\): \[\begin{aligned}|H_1|^2&=|H_3|^2=0.8^2+0.6^2=1\\ |H_2|^2&=0.2^2=0.04,\quad|H_4|^2=1.4^2=1.96\end{aligned}\] Check (Parseval): the four \(|H_k|^2\) add up to 1 + 0.04 + 1 + 1.96 = 4, equal to \(N(h_0^2+h_1^2)=4\times1=4\) ✓.
  5. (c) Equal-capacity allocation: noise \(\sigma^2=1\), capacity of sub-channel k is \(\log_2(1+|H_k|^2P_k)\). Equal capacities ⇔ equal received SNR \(|H_k|^2P_k=c\), so \(P_k=c/|H_k|^2\). Insert into the total power: \[\begin{aligned}10&=c\Big(\tfrac11+\tfrac1{0.04}+\tfrac11+\tfrac1{1.96}\Big)\\&=c(1+25+1+0.510)=27.51\,c\\ c&=10/27.51=0.3635\end{aligned}\] \[\begin{aligned}P_1&=P_3=0.3635/1=0.36\\ P_2&=0.3635/0.04=9.09\\ P_4&=0.3635/1.96=0.19\end{aligned}\] Check: 0.36 + 9.09 + 0.36 + 0.19 = 10.0 ✓. Every sub-channel has capacity \(\log_2 1.3635=0.447\) bit, and the worst sub-channel 2 takes 91% of the power.
  6. (d) Water-filling: first try all four: the water-filling solution is \(P_k=(\mu-1/|H_k|^2)^+\), with floors \(1/|H_k|^2\) = 1, 25, 1, 0.51. Filling all four: \[\begin{aligned}\mu&=\frac{10+(1+25+1+0.51)}{4}\\&=\frac{37.51}{4}=9.38\end{aligned}\] But \(9.38\lt25\): sub-channel 2 would get negative power (\(9.38-25\lt0\)), so drop it and recompute.
  7. (d) Three sub-channels left: \[\begin{aligned}\mu&=\frac{10+1+1+0.51}{3}=\frac{12.51}{3}=4.17\\ P_1&=P_3=4.17-1=3.17\\ P_4&=4.17-0.51=3.66\end{aligned}\] All positive ✓; 3.17 + 3.17 + 3.66 = 10.0 ✓; the floor of sub-channel 2 (25) is above the water level 4.17, so it stays out ✓.
  8. (d) Sum capacity: each sub-channel gives \(\log_2(1+|H_k|^2P_k)=\log_2(\mu|H_k|^2)\); with \(\log_2x=\log_{10}x/0.301\): \[\begin{aligned}C_1=C_3&=\log_2 4.17=\tfrac{0.620}{0.301}=2.06\\ C_4&=\log_2(4.17\times1.96)\\&=\log_2 8.17=\tfrac{0.912}{0.301}=3.03\\ \textstyle\sum_k C_k&=2.06+2.06+3.03=7.15\text{ bit}\end{aligned}\] Each sub-carrier occupies only B/4, \(C=\sum_k\frac B4\log_2(\cdot)\), so per hertz \(C/B=7.15/4=1.79\approx1.8\) bit/s/Hz (matches the official answer). Compare (c): only 0.447 bit/s/Hz, so water-filling is about 4 times higher.
(a) B/BC ≪ N ≪ B/Bd; (b) 1.4, 0.8−0.6j, 0.2, 0.8+0.6j; (c) 0.36, 9.09, 0.36, 0.19; (d) ≈ 1.8 bit/s/Hz
Official answer: identical ✓ (the official solution labels k = 1…4 as H₁…H₄, with H₄ = H₀ = 1.4)
Compare (c) and (d): to make every sub-channel "equal", (c) spends 91% of the power on the worst sub-channel; water-filling (d) simply abandons it and gets a much higher total capacity.
Concept + walkthrough: OFDM N, H_k, power allocation知识讲解 + 详细解析：OFDM 选 N、算 H_k、分功率

ConceptOFDM cuts a frequency-selective channel into N flat sub-channels

The multipath channel y(t) = h₀x(t) + h₁x(t − τ) + w(t) has a frequency response that varies with frequency (frequency-selective fading), and single-carrier transmission suffers ISI. OFDM cuts the total bandwidth B into N sub-carriers, each Δf = B/N wide (Ch 7 p.8); one OFDM symbol lasts T = N/B (p.7). As long as each sub-carrier is narrow enough, the gain it sees over its small band is nearly constant, i.e. flat fading; after the DFT the receiver gets rk = Hksk + wk (p.6, p.17).多径信道 y(t) = h₀x(t) + h₁x(t − τ) + w(t) 的频率响应随频率起伏（频率选择性衰落），单载波传输会有 ISI。OFDM 把总带宽 B 切成 N 个子载波，每个宽 Δf = B/N（第 7 章 p.8），一个 OFDM 符号长 T = N/B（p.7）。只要每个子载波足够窄，它在自己那一小段频率里看到的增益就近似是常数，即平坦衰落；接收端 DFT 以后得到 rk = Hksk + wk（p.6、p.17）。

Two conditions (Ch 2 p.31–37):两个条件（第 2 章 p.31–37）：

  • Flat: signal bandwidth < coherence bandwidth BC. Here the "signal" is one sub-carrier, so B/N ≪ BC.平坦（flat）：信号带宽 < 相干带宽 BC。这里"信号"是一个子载波，所以 B/N ≪ BC。
  • Slow: symbol duration < coherence time TC ≈ 1/Bd (p.36: coherence time is the dual of the Doppler spread). Here the "symbol" is one OFDM symbol, so N/B ≪ 1/Bd.慢衰落（slow）：符号时长 < 相干时间 TC ≈ 1/Bd（p.36：相干时间是多普勒扩展的对偶）。这里"符号"是一个 OFDM 符号，所以 N/B ≪ 1/Bd。

Sub-channel gains (Ch 7 p.15): Hk = Σi hi e−j2πik/N, the N-point DFT of the impulse response [h₀, h₁, …]. This assumes the echo delay τ is exactly one sampling interval (i = 0, 1). The slide notes HN = H₀, so k = 1…N and k = 0…N − 1 give the same set of values.子信道增益（第 7 章 p.15）：Hk = Σi hi e−j2πik/N，就是冲激响应 [h₀, h₁, …] 的 N 点 DFT。这里假设回波延迟 τ 正好是一个采样间隔（i = 0, 1）。讲义注明 HN = H₀，所以 k = 1…N 和 k = 0…N − 1 是同一组值。

Capacity (Ch 7 p.24): N independent parallel Gaussian sub-channels, C = Σk log₂(1 + |Hk|²Pk/Nk); here the noise Nk = σ² = 1. (c) and (d) give two rules for splitting the power.容量（第 7 章 p.24）：N 条独立的并行高斯子信道，C = Σk log₂(1 + |Hk|²Pk/Nk)，本题噪声 Nk = σ² = 1。功率怎么分，(c)(d) 给了两种原则。

Step by step(a) How to choose N

  1. Flat: B/N ≪ BC → N ≫ B/BC (if N is too small the sub-carriers are too wide and become frequency-selective again).平坦：B/N ≪ BC → N ≫ B/BC（N 太小，子载波太宽，又变回频率选择性）。
  2. Slow: T = N/B ≪ 1/Bd → N ≪ B/Bd (if N is too large the OFDM symbol is too long, the channel changes within one symbol, the sub-carriers lose orthogonality and inter-carrier interference, ICI, appears).慢衰落：T = N/B ≪ 1/Bd → N ≪ B/Bd（N 太大，OFDM 符号太长，信道在一个符号内就变了，子载波失去正交，产生载波间干扰 ICI）。
  3. Together: B/BC ≪ N ≪ B/Bd. Such an N exists only if Bd ≪ BC, which practical systems normally satisfy.合起来：B/BC ≪ N ≪ B/Bd。能找到这样的 N 的前提是 Bd ≪ BC，实际系统一般满足。

Step by step(b) Compute Hk

N = 4: e−j2πk/4 = e−jπk/2 is 1, −j, −1, j for k = 0, 1, 2, 3 (a 90° clockwise step around the unit circle each time).N = 4：e−j2πk/4 = e−jπk/2，k = 0, 1, 2, 3 依次是 1、−j、−1、j（在单位圆上每次顺时针转 90°）。

H₀ = H₄ = 0.8 + 0.6 = 1.4, |H|² = 1.96
H₁ = 0.8 + 0.6(−j) = 0.8 − 0.6j, |H|² = 0.64 + 0.36 = 1
H₂ = 0.8 − 0.6 = 0.2, |H|² = 0.04
H₃ = 0.8 + 0.6j, |H|² = 1

Check: Σ|Hk|² = 1.96 + 1 + 0.04 + 1 = 4 = N(h₀² + h₁²) = 4 × 1 ✓ (Parseval's theorem, not in the slides). Sub-channel 2 has gain only 0.2: the two paths cancel each other, a "deep fade" of frequency-selective fading. With the question's numbering k = 1, 2, 3, 4 the power gains are 1, 0.04, 1, 1.96.自检：Σ|Hk|² = 1.96 + 1 + 0.04 + 1 = 4 = N(h₀² + h₁²) = 4 × 1 ✓（帕塞瓦尔定理，课外补充）。子信道 2 的增益只有 0.2：两条路径反相抵消，这就是频率选择性衰落里的"深衰落"。按题目编号 k = 1, 2, 3, 4，功率增益为 1、0.04、1、1.96。

Step by step(c) Equal-capacity allocation

  1. All capacities log₂(1 + |Hk|²Pk) equal ⇔ every SNR |Hk|²Pk equals the same constant c → Pk = c/|Hk|². The weaker the gain, the more power ("rob the rich to pay the poor").容量 log₂(1 + |Hk|²Pk) 都相等 ⇔ 每条的 SNR |Hk|²Pk 都等于同一个常数 c → Pk = c/|Hk|²。增益越差，分的功率越多（"劫富济贫"）。
  2. Find c from the total power:由总功率求 c：
    c(1/1 + 1/0.04 + 1/1 + 1/1.96) = c(1 + 25 + 1 + 0.51) = 27.51c = 10 → c = 0.3635
  3. Each sub-channel:各子信道：加起来 0.36 + 9.09 + 0.36 + 0.19 = 10 ✓。
    P₁ = 0.3635/1 = 0.36, P₂ = 0.3635/0.04 = 9.09, P₃ = 0.36, P₄ = 0.3635/1.96 = 0.19
    Sum 0.36 + 9.09 + 0.36 + 0.19 = 10 ✓.

Step by step(d) Water-filling for the maximum sum capacity

  1. Floors = noise/gain = 1/|Hk|²: 1, 25, 1, 0.51. Power Pk = μ − 1/|Hk|² (μ is the water level); only sub-channels below the water level get power.池底 = 噪声/增益 = 1/|Hk|²：1、25、1、0.51。功率 Pk = μ − 1/|Hk|²（μ 是水面），水面以下的子信道才分功率。
  2. Fill all four first: 4μ − 27.51 = 10 → μ = 37.51/4 = 9.38. But sub-channel 2 has floor 25 > 9.38 and would get negative power, which is impossible, so drop it.先全放水：4μ − 27.51 = 10 → μ = 37.51/4 = 9.38。但子信道 2 的池底 25 > 9.38，它会分到负功率，不行，去掉。
  3. Three left: 3μ − (1 + 1 + 0.51) = 10 → μ = 12.51/3 = 4.17. Powers 4.17 − 1 = 3.17, 3.17, 4.17 − 0.51 = 3.66, all positive ✓, sum 10 ✓.剩三条：3μ − (1 + 1 + 0.51) = 10 → μ = 12.51/3 = 4.17。功率 4.17 − 1 = 3.17、3.17、4.17 − 0.51 = 3.66，都为正 ✓，加起来 10 ✓。
  4. Capacity: after allocation each SNR is |Hk|²Pk, so 1 + SNR = |Hk|²μ:容量：分到功率后每条的 SNR = |Hk|²Pk，1 + SNR = |Hk|²μ：
    C = log₂(4.17) + log₂(4.17) + log₂(4.17 × 1.96) = 2.06 + 2.06 + 3.03 = 7.15 bit
  5. Per hertz: these 7.15 bit are carried by 4 sub-carriers together, each occupying B/4, so per hertz of total bandwidth: 7.15/4 = 1.79 ≈ 1.8 bit/s/Hz (official answer 1.8).换成每赫兹：这 7.15 bit 是 4 个子载波一起传的，每个子载波只占 B/4，所以每赫兹总带宽：7.15/4 = 1.79 ≈ 1.8 bit/s/Hz（官方答案 1.8）。

Matching the Ch 2 notation: each full-power SNR γk = |Hk|² × 10 = 10, 0.4, 10, 19.6; solving Σ(1/γ₀ − 1/γk) = 1 gives γ₀ = 2.40, γ₂ = 0.4 < γ₀ is dropped, and C = Σ log₂(γk/γ₀) = 7.15 bit, the same result (μ = P/γ₀).和第 2 章的写法对上：每条的满功率 SNR γk = |Hk|² × 10 = 10、0.4、10、19.6，用 Σ(1/γ₀ − 1/γk) = 1 解出 γ₀ = 2.40，γ₂ = 0.4 < γ₀ 被去掉，C = Σ log₂(γk/γ₀) = 7.15 bit，结果一样（μ = P/γ₀）。

CheckThree allocations side by side

AllocationPowersTotal bitsbit/s/Hz
(c) Equal capacity0.36, 9.09, 0.36, 0.194 × 0.447 = 1.790.447
Equal power (not in the slides)平分（课外补充）2.5, 2.5, 2.5, 2.56.311.58
(d) Water-filling3.17, 0, 3.17, 3.667.151.79

(c) pours 91% of the power into the worst sub-channel and has the lowest total; water-filling gives that sub-channel up and has the highest. Note that the "1.79 total bits" of (c) and the "1.79 bit/s/Hz" of (d) are a numerical coincidence with different units; do not mix them up.(c) 把 91% 的功率砸在最差的子信道上，总容量最低；注水干脆放弃它，总容量最高。注意 (c) 的"总比特 1.79"和 (d) 的"bit/s/Hz 1.79"只是数字巧合，单位不同，别混。

PitfallsWhere marks are lost

  • The power gain is |Hk|², not |Hk|; the squared modulus of a complex number = real² + imaginary².功率增益要用 |Hk|²，不是 |Hk|；复数的模平方 = 实部² + 虚部²。
  • Numbering: the question uses k = 1…4, H₄ = H₀ = 1.4; P₄ goes with 1.96.编号：题目 k = 1…4，H₄ = H₀ = 1.4；P₄ 对应 1.96。
  • Water-filling without checking the floors: using μ = 9.38 directly gives sub-channel 2 negative power.注水不检查池底，直接用 μ = 9.38 会给子信道 2 分到负功率。
  • (d) asks for bit/s/Hz: divide by N = 4 at the end. Slide p.24 calls the sum "capacity per Hertz", counted per sub-carrier bandwidth; the official 1.8 is the value after dividing by N.(d) 要的是 bit/s/Hz：最后除以 N = 4。讲义 p.24 把求和式叫"capacity per Hertz"，那是按每个子载波的带宽算的；官方答案 1.8 是除以 N 以后的值。
  • In (a) one condition is not enough: write both "flat" and "slow" with the reason for each.(a) 只写一个条件不够，"平坦"和"慢衰落"两边都要写，并说明理由。

ExamHow to write it

(a) Each sub-carrier has bandwidth B/N and the OFDM symbol lasts about N/B. Flat fading requires B/N ≪ BC, i.e. N ≫ B/BC; slow fading requires N/B ≪ TC ≈ 1/Bd, i.e. N ≪ B/Bd. Hence choose \(B/B_C\ll N\ll B/B_d\).

(b) \(H_k=h_0+h_1e^{-j2\pi k/N}=0.8+0.6e^{-j\pi k/2}\): H₀ = H₄ = 1.4, H₁ = 0.8 − j0.6, H₂ = 0.2, H₃ = 0.8 + j0.6; \(|H_k|^2\) = 1, 0.04, 1, 1.96 for k = 1, 2, 3, 4.

(c) Equal capacity ⇔ \(|H_k|^2P_k=c\). \(\sum P_k=c\sum1/|H_k|^2=27.51c=10\Rightarrow c=0.3635\); P₁ = 0.36, P₂ = 9.09, P₃ = 0.36, P₄ = 0.19.

(d) Water-filling with floors \(1/|H_k|^2\) = 1, 25, 1, 0.51. Using all four gives μ = 9.38 \(\lt\) 25, so sub-channel 2 is dropped. With three: μ = (10 + 2.51)/3 = 4.17, P = 3.17, 3.17, 3.66. \(C=2\log_2(4.17)+\log_2(4.17\times1.96)=7.15\) bit over 4 sub-carriers, i.e. 7.15/4 ≈ 1.8 bit/s/Hz.

In one line: (a) B/BC ≪ N ≪ B/Bd (sub-carriers narrower than the coherence bandwidth, OFDM symbol shorter than the coherence time); (b) Hk = DFT{0.8, 0.6} = 1.4, 0.8 − 0.6j, 0.2, 0.8 + 0.6j; (c) Pk ∝ 1/|Hk|²: 0.36, 9.09, 0.36, 0.19; (d) water-filling drops the gain-0.2 sub-channel, 7.15 bit / 4 ≈ 1.8 bit/s/Hz.一句话：(a) B/BC ≪ N ≪ B/Bd（子载波要窄于相干带宽，OFDM 符号要短于相干时间）；(b) Hk = DFT{0.8, 0.6} = 1.4、0.8 − 0.6j、0.2、0.8 + 0.6j；(c) Pk ∝ 1/|Hk|²：0.36、9.09、0.36、0.19；(d) 注水去掉增益 0.2 的子信道，7.15 bit / 4 ≈ 1.8 bit/s/Hz。
◆ Key points
What it tests
The four core OFDM calculations: choosing N, Hk, equal-capacity power allocation, water-filling capacity (Ch 7 p.5, p.15, p.24; water-filling from Ch 2).
Background
Coherence bandwidth and coherence time; Euler: e−jπk/2 is 1, −j, −1, j in turn; water-filling; log₂.
Method
(a) Flat N ≫ B/BC, slow N ≪ B/Bd; (b) Hk = h₀ + h₁e−j2πk/N; (c) |Hk|²Pk = c, find c from ΣPk = 10; (d) floors 1/|Hk|², water level μ, drop sub-channels whose floor is above the water.
Key numbers
|Hk|² = 1, 0.04, 1, 1.96; c = 10/27.51 = 0.3635; water level 4.17, powers 3.17, 0, 3.17, 3.66; 7.15 bit / 4 = 1.79 bit/s/Hz.
Check
Σ|Hk|² = N Σhi² = 4 × (0.64 + 0.36) = 4; the powers in (c) and (d) both sum to 10; the dropped sub-channel 2 has floor 25, above the water level.
Common mistakes
Index k = 1…4 (H₄ = H₀); use |Hk|², not |Hk|; noise σ² = 1; divide by N at the end to get bit/s/Hz.
Conclusion
Equal capacity pours 91% of the power into the worst sub-channel; water-filling gives up on it. Use (c) for fairness, (d) for maximum total capacity.
  1. (a) 平坦条件：每个子载波的带宽 \(\Delta f=B/N\) 要远小于相干带宽（coherence bandwidth）\(B_C\)，这样一个子带内信道频率响应几乎不变，每个子载波只看到一个复增益 \(H_k\)： \[\frac BN\ll B_C\;\Rightarrow\;N\gg\frac{B}{B_C}\] 讲义第 7 章 p.5、p.14 的 \(T=NT_S\gg T_D\approx1/B_C\) 是同一个条件。
  2. (a) 慢衰落条件：OFDM 符号时长 \(T=N/B\)（\(=NT_S\)，\(T_S=1/B\)）要远小于相干时间（coherence time）\(T_C\approx1/B_d\)，这样一个 OFDM 符号内信道不变，子载波保持正交、没有 ICI： \[\frac NB\ll\frac1{B_d}\;\Rightarrow\;N\ll\frac{B}{B_d}\] 合起来 \(\dfrac{B}{B_C}\ll N\ll\dfrac{B}{B_d}\)，需要 \(B_d\ll B_C\) 才有解。例：B = 1 MHz、\(B_C\) = 50 kHz、\(B_d\) = 100 Hz → 20 ≪ N ≪ 10⁴，可取 N = 256（FFT 用 2 的幂）。
  3. (b) 写出 Hk：两径信道的冲激响应 \(h=[h_0,h_1]=[0.8,0.6]\)（τ 等于 1 个采样间隔）。子信道增益是它的 DFT（讲义 p.15）： \[H_k=\sum_{i=0}^{L-1}h_ie^{-j2\pi ik/N}=0.8+0.6\,e^{-j\pi k/2}\] k = 1, 2, 3, 4 时 \(e^{-j\pi k/2}=-j,\ -1,\ j,\ 1\)： \[\begin{aligned}H_1&=0.8-0.6j\\ H_2&=0.8-0.6=0.2\\ H_3&=0.8+0.6j\\ H_4&=H_0=0.8+0.6=1.4\end{aligned}\]
  4. (b) 功率增益与自检：后面分功率要用 \(|H_k|^2\)： \[\begin{aligned}|H_1|^2&=|H_3|^2=0.8^2+0.6^2=1\\ |H_2|^2&=0.2^2=0.04,\quad|H_4|^2=1.4^2=1.96\end{aligned}\] 自检（Parseval）：四个 \(|H_k|^2\) 之和 1 + 0.04 + 1 + 1.96 = 4，等于 \(N(h_0^2+h_1^2)=4\times1=4\) ✓。
  5. (c) 等容量分配：噪声 \(\sigma^2=1\)，第 k 个子信道容量 \(\log_2(1+|H_k|^2P_k)\)。容量相等 ⇔ 接收 SNR \(|H_k|^2P_k=c\) 相等，所以 \(P_k=c/|H_k|^2\)。代入总功率： \[\begin{aligned}10&=c\Big(\tfrac11+\tfrac1{0.04}+\tfrac11+\tfrac1{1.96}\Big)\\&=c(1+25+1+0.510)=27.51\,c\\ c&=10/27.51=0.3635\end{aligned}\] \[\begin{aligned}P_1&=P_3=0.3635/1=0.36\\ P_2&=0.3635/0.04=9.09\\ P_4&=0.3635/1.96=0.19\end{aligned}\] 验算：0.36 + 9.09 + 0.36 + 0.19 = 10.0 ✓。每个子信道容量都是 \(\log_2 1.3635=0.447\) bit，最差的子信道 2 拿走了 91% 的功率。
  6. (d) 注水：先试四个都放水：注水解 \(P_k=(\mu-1/|H_k|^2)^+\)，池底（floor）\(1/|H_k|^2\) = 1、25、1、0.51。四个都放水： \[\begin{aligned}\mu&=\frac{10+(1+25+1+0.51)}{4}\\&=\frac{37.51}{4}=9.38\end{aligned}\] 但 \(9.38\lt25\)，子信道 2 的功率会是负的（\(9.38-25\lt0\)），去掉它重算。
  7. (d) 剩三个子信道： \[\begin{aligned}\mu&=\frac{10+1+1+0.51}{3}=\frac{12.51}{3}=4.17\\ P_1&=P_3=4.17-1=3.17\\ P_4&=4.17-0.51=3.66\end{aligned}\] 都为正 ✓；3.17 + 3.17 + 3.66 = 10.0 ✓；子信道 2 的池底 25 > 4.17，留在水面以上 ✓。
  8. (d) 和容量：每个子信道 \(\log_2(1+|H_k|^2P_k)=\log_2(\mu|H_k|^2)\)，用 \(\log_2x=\log_{10}x/0.301\)： \[\begin{aligned}C_1=C_3&=\log_2 4.17=\tfrac{0.620}{0.301}=2.06\\ C_4&=\log_2(4.17\times1.96)\\&=\log_2 8.17=\tfrac{0.912}{0.301}=3.03\\ \textstyle\sum_k C_k&=2.06+2.06+3.03=7.15\text{ bit}\end{aligned}\] 每个子载波只占 B/4 带宽，\(C=\sum_k\frac B4\log_2(\cdot)\)，所以每赫兹 \(C/B=7.15/4=1.79\approx1.8\) bit/s/Hz（与官方一致）。对比 (c)：每赫兹只有 0.447 bit/s/Hz，注水高约 4 倍。
(a) B/B_C ≪ N ≪ B/B_d；(b) 1.4, 0.8−0.6j, 0.2, 0.8+0.6j；(c) 0.36, 9.09, 0.36, 0.19；(d) ≈ 1.8 bit/s/Hz
官方答案：完全一致 ✓（官方把 k = 1…4 记为 H₁…H₄，H₄ = H₀ = 1.4）
对比 (c) 和 (d)：为了"人人平等"，(c) 把 91% 的功率砸在最差的子信道上；注水 (d) 干脆放弃最差的那个，总容量高得多。
知识讲解 + 详细解析：OFDM 选 N、算 H_k、分功率

知识讲解OFDM 把频率选择性信道切成 N 条平坦子信道

多径信道 y(t) = h₀x(t) + h₁x(t − τ) + w(t) 的频率响应随频率起伏（频率选择性衰落），单载波传输会有 ISI。OFDM 把总带宽 B 切成 N 个子载波，每个宽 Δf = B/N（第 7 章 p.8），一个 OFDM 符号长 T = N/B（p.7）。只要每个子载波足够窄，它在自己那一小段频率里看到的增益就近似是常数，即平坦衰落；接收端 DFT 以后得到 rk = Hksk + wk（p.6、p.17）。

两个条件（第 2 章 p.31–37）：

  • 平坦（flat）：信号带宽 < 相干带宽 BC。这里"信号"是一个子载波，所以 B/N ≪ BC。
  • 慢衰落（slow）：符号时长 < 相干时间 TC ≈ 1/Bd（p.36：相干时间是多普勒扩展的对偶）。这里"符号"是一个 OFDM 符号，所以 N/B ≪ 1/Bd。

子信道增益（第 7 章 p.15）：Hk = Σi hi e−j2πik/N，就是冲激响应 [h₀, h₁, …] 的 N 点 DFT。这里假设回波延迟 τ 正好是一个采样间隔（i = 0, 1）。讲义注明 HN = H₀，所以 k = 1…N 和 k = 0…N − 1 是同一组值。

容量（第 7 章 p.24）：N 条独立的并行高斯子信道，C = Σk log₂(1 + |Hk|²Pk/Nk)，本题噪声 Nk = σ² = 1。功率怎么分，(c)(d) 给了两种原则。

详细解析(a) N 的选取原则

  1. 平坦：B/N ≪ BC → N ≫ B/BC（N 太小，子载波太宽，又变回频率选择性）。
  2. 慢衰落：T = N/B ≪ 1/Bd → N ≪ B/Bd（N 太大，OFDM 符号太长，信道在一个符号内就变了，子载波失去正交，产生载波间干扰 ICI）。
  3. 合起来：B/BC ≪ N ≪ B/Bd。能找到这样的 N 的前提是 Bd ≪ BC，实际系统一般满足。

详细解析(b) 算 Hk

N = 4：e−j2πk/4 = e−jπk/2，k = 0, 1, 2, 3 依次是 1、−j、−1、j（在单位圆上每次顺时针转 90°）。

H₀ = H₄ = 0.8 + 0.6 = 1.4，|H|² = 1.96
H₁ = 0.8 + 0.6(−j) = 0.8 − 0.6j，|H|² = 0.64 + 0.36 = 1
H₂ = 0.8 − 0.6 = 0.2，|H|² = 0.04
H₃ = 0.8 + 0.6j，|H|² = 1

自检：Σ|Hk|² = 1.96 + 1 + 0.04 + 1 = 4 = N(h₀² + h₁²) = 4 × 1 ✓（帕塞瓦尔定理，课外补充）。子信道 2 的增益只有 0.2：两条路径反相抵消，这就是频率选择性衰落里的"深衰落"。按题目编号 k = 1, 2, 3, 4，功率增益为 1、0.04、1、1.96。

详细解析(c) 等容量分配

  1. 容量 log₂(1 + |Hk|²Pk) 都相等 ⇔ 每条的 SNR |Hk|²Pk 都等于同一个常数 c → Pk = c/|Hk|²。增益越差，分的功率越多（"劫富济贫"）。
  2. 由总功率求 c：
    c(1/1 + 1/0.04 + 1/1 + 1/1.96) = c(1 + 25 + 1 + 0.51) = 27.51c = 10 → c = 0.3635
  3. 各子信道：
    P₁ = 0.3635/1 = 0.36，P₂ = 0.3635/0.04 = 9.09，P₃ = 0.36，P₄ = 0.3635/1.96 = 0.19
    加起来 0.36 + 9.09 + 0.36 + 0.19 = 10 ✓。

详细解析(d) 注水求最大和容量

  1. 池底 = 噪声/增益 = 1/|Hk|²：1、25、1、0.51。功率 Pk = μ − 1/|Hk|²（μ 是水面），水面以下的子信道才分功率。
  2. 先全放水：4μ − 27.51 = 10 → μ = 37.51/4 = 9.38。但子信道 2 的池底 25 > 9.38，它会分到负功率，不行，去掉。
  3. 剩三条：3μ − (1 + 1 + 0.51) = 10 → μ = 12.51/3 = 4.17。功率 4.17 − 1 = 3.17、3.17、4.17 − 0.51 = 3.66，都为正 ✓，加起来 10 ✓。
  4. 容量：分到功率后每条的 SNR = |Hk|²Pk，1 + SNR = |Hk|²μ：
    C = log₂(4.17) + log₂(4.17) + log₂(4.17 × 1.96) = 2.06 + 2.06 + 3.03 = 7.15 bit
  5. 换成每赫兹：这 7.15 bit 是 4 个子载波一起传的，每个子载波只占 B/4，所以每赫兹总带宽：7.15/4 = 1.79 ≈ 1.8 bit/s/Hz（官方答案 1.8）。

和第 2 章的写法对上：每条的满功率 SNR γk = |Hk|² × 10 = 10、0.4、10、19.6，用 Σ(1/γ₀ − 1/γk) = 1 解出 γ₀ = 2.40，γ₂ = 0.4 < γ₀ 被去掉，C = Σ log₂(γk/γ₀) = 7.15 bit，结果一样（μ = P/γ₀）。

自检三种分法比一比

分法功率总比特bit/s/Hz
(c) 等容量0.36、9.09、0.36、0.194 × 0.447 = 1.790.447
平分（课外补充）2.5、2.5、2.5、2.56.311.58
(d) 注水3.17、0、3.17、3.667.151.79

(c) 把 91% 的功率砸在最差的子信道上，总容量最低；注水干脆放弃它，总容量最高。注意 (c) 的"总比特 1.79"和 (d) 的"bit/s/Hz 1.79"只是数字巧合，单位不同，别混。

易错常见丢分点

  • 功率增益要用 |Hk|²，不是 |Hk|；复数的模平方 = 实部² + 虚部²。
  • 编号：题目 k = 1…4，H₄ = H₀ = 1.4；P₄ 对应 1.96。
  • 注水不检查池底，直接用 μ = 9.38 会给子信道 2 分到负功率。
  • (d) 要的是 bit/s/Hz：最后除以 N = 4。讲义 p.24 把求和式叫"capacity per Hertz"，那是按每个子载波的带宽算的；官方答案 1.8 是除以 N 以后的值。
  • (a) 只写一个条件不够，"平坦"和"慢衰落"两边都要写，并说明理由。

考试英文写法

(a) Each sub-carrier has bandwidth B/N and the OFDM symbol lasts about N/B. Flat fading requires B/N ≪ BC, i.e. N ≫ B/BC; slow fading requires N/B ≪ TC ≈ 1/Bd, i.e. N ≪ B/Bd. Hence choose \(B/B_C\ll N\ll B/B_d\).

(b) \(H_k=h_0+h_1e^{-j2\pi k/N}=0.8+0.6e^{-j\pi k/2}\): H₀ = H₄ = 1.4, H₁ = 0.8 − j0.6, H₂ = 0.2, H₃ = 0.8 + j0.6; \(|H_k|^2\) = 1, 0.04, 1, 1.96 for k = 1, 2, 3, 4.

(c) Equal capacity ⇔ \(|H_k|^2P_k=c\). \(\sum P_k=c\sum1/|H_k|^2=27.51c=10\Rightarrow c=0.3635\); P₁ = 0.36, P₂ = 9.09, P₃ = 0.36, P₄ = 0.19.

(d) Water-filling with floors \(1/|H_k|^2\) = 1, 25, 1, 0.51. Using all four gives μ = 9.38 \(\lt\) 25, so sub-channel 2 is dropped. With three: μ = (10 + 2.51)/3 = 4.17, P = 3.17, 3.17, 3.66. \(C=2\log_2(4.17)+\log_2(4.17\times1.96)=7.15\) bit over 4 sub-carriers, i.e. 7.15/4 ≈ 1.8 bit/s/Hz.

一句话：(a) B/BC ≪ N ≪ B/Bd（子载波要窄于相干带宽，OFDM 符号要短于相干时间）；(b) Hk = DFT{0.8, 0.6} = 1.4、0.8 − 0.6j、0.2、0.8 + 0.6j；(c) Pk ∝ 1/|Hk|²：0.36、9.09、0.36、0.19；(d) 注水去掉增益 0.2 的子信道，7.15 bit / 4 ≈ 1.8 bit/s/Hz。
◆ 本题知识点
考什么
OFDM 的四个核心计算：N 的选择、Hk、等容量功率分配、注水容量（第 7 章 p.5、p.15、p.24；第 2 章注水）。
前置知识
相干带宽 / 相干时间；欧拉公式 e−jπk/2 依次为 1、−j、−1、j；注水公式；log₂。
解题套路
(a) 平坦 N ≫ B/BC，慢衰落 N ≪ B/Bd；(b) Hk = h₀ + h₁e−j2πk/N；(c) |Hk|²Pk = c，由 ΣPk = 10 求 c；(d) 池底 1/|Hk|²，水面 μ，去掉池底高过水面的子信道。
关键数字
|Hk|² = 1、0.04、1、1.96；c = 10/27.51 = 0.3635；注水水面 4.17，功率 3.17、0、3.17、3.66；7.15 bit / 4 = 1.79 bit/s/Hz。
自检
Σ|Hk|² = N Σhi² = 4 × (0.64 + 0.36) = 4；(c)(d) 的功率加起来都是 10；被去掉的子信道 2 的池底 25 高于水面。
易错
编号 k = 1…4（H₄ = H₀）；用 |Hk|² 不是 |Hk|；噪声 σ² = 1；最后除以 N 换成 bit/s/Hz。
对比结论
等容量把 91% 的功率砸在最差的子信道上；注水干脆放弃它。要公平用 (c)，要总容量最大用 (d)。
Part 2 practice
P7 · Q2

Designing a 2 Mbps OFDM system

Original question · bilingualPractice 7

Consider the design of an OFDM system. The goal is to transmit data at a rate of 2 Mbps using 16-QAM with an available bandwidth of 600 kHz. It is known that the delay spread of the channel is up to a maximum of 20 μs. You can assume the cyclic prefix to be equal to the maximum delay spread. Find the total number of sub-carriers and the OFDM symbol duration.

考虑一个 OFDM 系统的设计：目标是在 600 kHz 的可用带宽内，用 16-QAM 以 2 Mbps 的速率传输数据。已知信道时延扩展最大为 20 μs，可设循环前缀等于最大时延扩展。求子载波总数和 OFDM 符号周期。

Δf = B/NCyclic-prefix overheadCh. 7 of the notes p.8, p.17–18
What the question is asking: what does this question actually want?

ScenarioWhat the question is about

A design question: use OFDM to carry 2 Mbps in 600 kHz of bandwidth with 16-QAM. The channel delay spread is at most 20 µs, and the cyclic prefix (CP) is set to 20 µs.设计题：要用 OFDM 在 600 kHz 带宽里传 2 Mbps，调制用 16-QAM。信道时延扩展最多 20 µs，循环前缀（CP）就取 20 µs。

Find the number of subcarriers N and the OFDM symbol duration.求子载波数 N 和 OFDM 符号时长。

SymbolsWhat each quantity in the question means

16-QAM4 bits per symbol
NNumber of subcarriers: one OFDM symbol carries N QAM symbols in parallel子载波数：一个 OFDM 符号里同时发 N 个 QAM 符号
Δf = B/NSubcarrier spacing; useful symbol duration T = 1/Δf = N/B子载波间隔；有用符号时长 T = 1/Δf = N/B
CPCyclic prefix of 20 µs, added in front of every OFDM symbol; it takes time but carries no new data循环前缀 20 µs，每个 OFDM 符号前面都要加，占时间但不带新数据

What each part asksWhat each part is asking for

  • Only part Write "rate = bits per OFDM symbol ÷ total OFDM symbol duration": 4N /(N/B + 20 µs) = 2 Mbps, solve for N, then compute the OFDM symbol duration (including the CP).唯一一问 列出"速率 = 每个 OFDM 符号的比特数 ÷ OFDM 符号总时长"：4N /(N/B + 20 µs) = 2 Mbps，解出 N，再算 OFDM 符号时长（含 CP）。

Watch outEasy ways to misread the question

  • Total OFDM symbol duration = useful part N/B + CP; do not forget the CP.OFDM 符号总时长 = 有用部分 N/B + CP，别漏 CP。

PurposeWhat the question wants you to understand

Without a CP, 600 kHz would already be enough and any N would do; it is the CP overhead that fixes N: the larger N, the smaller the fraction taken by the CP.没有 CP 的话，600 kHz 本来就够用，N 取多少都行；正是 CP 的开销决定了 N：N 越大，CP 占的比例越小。

In one line: solve "4 bits × N subcarriers ÷ (N/B + 20 µs) = 2 Mbps" for the number of subcarriers N, then compute the OFDM symbol duration including the CP.一句话：由"4 bit × N 个子载波 ÷（N/B + 20 µs）= 2 Mbps"解出子载波数 N，再算含 CP 的 OFDM 符号时长。
  1. Bit rate → symbol rate: 16-QAM carries \(\log_2 16=4\) bits per symbol: \[R_s=\frac{2\times10^6\text{ bit/s}}{4\text{ bit/symbol}}=5\times10^5\text{ symbols/s}\]
  2. OFDM timing: with N sub-carriers the spacing is \(\Delta f=B/N\) and the useful symbol duration is \(T=1/\Delta f=N/B\) (Ch 7 p.8). With the cyclic prefix \(T_G=T_D=20\) µs one OFDM block lasts \(T+T_G\) (p.18), during which each of the N sub-carriers sends one symbol: \[\text{symbol rate}=\frac{N}{T+T_G}=\frac{N}{N/B+T_G}\]
  3. Solve for N: set it equal to \(R_s\): \[\begin{aligned}N&=R_s\Big(\frac NB+T_G\Big)\\&=\tfrac{500\text{k}}{600\text{k}}N+500\text{k}\times20\ \mu\text{s}\\&=0.8333N+10\\ N&=\frac{10}{1-0.8333}=\frac{10}{0.1667}=60\end{aligned}\]
  4. Symbol durations: \[\begin{aligned}T&=\frac NB=\frac{60}{600\text{ kHz}}=100\ \mu\text{s}\\ T+T_G&=100+20=120\ \mu\text{s}=0.12\text{ ms}\end{aligned}\] Sub-carrier spacing Δf = 600 kHz / 60 = 10 kHz = 1/T ✓.
  5. Check: each OFDM block carries 60 × 4 = 240 bits, and 240 bits / 120 µs = 2 × 10⁶ bit/s = 2 Mbps ✓. The CP takes 20/120 = 1/6 of the time; the power loss is \(10\log_{10}(120/100)=0.79\) dB (Ch 7 p.18).
N = 60, OFDM symbol duration 0.12 ms
Official answer: 60; 0.12 ms ✓
Without the CP, 600 kHz would carry 500 k symbols/s for any N and the problem would have no unique answer. The CP overhead is what fixes N: the larger N, the smaller the CP fraction. Here the CP takes 20/120 = 1/6 of the time, so the bandwidth must exceed 500 k by 1/5, exactly 600 kHz.
Concept + walkthrough: N from rate and CP知识讲解 + 详细解析：由速率和 CP 解出子载波数

ConceptOFDM time budget: useful part + cyclic prefix

OFDM divides the bandwidth B into N sub-carriers with spacing Δf = B/N (Ch 7 p.8). For the sub-carriers to be orthogonal, the useful symbol duration must be T = 1/Δf = N/B (p.7). During this time each of the N sub-carriers sends one modulated symbol.OFDM 把带宽 B 分成 N 个子载波，子载波间隔 Δf = B/N（第 7 章 p.8）。为了让子载波相互正交，有用符号时长必须是 T = 1/Δf = N/B（p.7）。在这段时间里，N 个子载波各发一个调制符号。

Each OFDM block is also preceded by a guard interval TG (implemented as a cyclic prefix, CP), with TG ≥ the maximum delay spread TD, to block the echo of the previous block (p.5, p.17). So one OFDM block lasts T + TG in total (p.18), but the CP carries no new data.每个 OFDM 块前面还要加一段保护间隔 TG（实现上就是循环前缀 CP），TG ≥ 最大时延扩展 TD，用来挡住上一个块的回波（p.5、p.17）。所以一个 OFDM 块总长 T + TG（p.18），但 CP 不带新数据。

Data rate = N × log₂M bit ÷ (N/B + TG)

Symbols: M is the modulation order, log₂16 = 4 bits/symbol for 16-QAM; B = 600 kHz; TG = 20 µs. The time spent on the CP also costs power: 10 log₁₀((T + TG)/T) dB (p.18).符号：M 是调制阶数，16-QAM 的 log₂16 = 4 bit/符号；B = 600 kHz；TG = 20 µs。CP 占用时间还带来功率损失 10 log₁₀((T + TG)/T) dB（p.18）。

Step by stepFour steps to N and the symbol duration

  1. Bit rate to symbol rate. Why: each sub-carrier sends one QAM symbol at a time, so it is easier to count symbols. 2 Mbps ÷ 4 bits = 500 k symbols/s.比特速率换成符号速率。为什么：一个子载波一次发一个 QAM 符号，按符号数列方程更方便。2 Mbps ÷ 4 bit = 500 k 符号/秒。
  2. Set up the equation. Each OFDM block carries N symbols and takes N/B + TG:列方程。每个 OFDM 块发 N 个符号，耗时 N/B + TG：
    N / (N/600 kHz + 20 µs) = 500 k symbols/s
  3. Solve. Multiply both sides by the denominator: N = 500k × N/600k + 500k × 20 × 10⁻⁶ = 0.8333N + 10 → 0.1667N = 10 → N = 60.解方程。两边乘以分母：N = 500k × N/600k + 500k × 20 × 10⁻⁶ = 0.8333N + 10 → 0.1667N = 10 → N = 60。
  4. Durations. T = N/B = 60/600 kHz = 100 µs (Δf = 10 kHz); total OFDM symbol T + TG = 100 + 20 = 120 µs = 0.12 ms.算时长。T = N/B = 60/600 kHz = 100 µs（Δf = 10 kHz）；OFDM 符号总长 T + TG = 100 + 20 = 120 µs = 0.12 ms。

A quicker way: without a CP, 600 kHz could carry 600 k symbols/s, but only 500 k are needed, so the useful time can take only 500/600 = 5/6 of each block and the CP takes 1/6: TG = T/5 → T = 5 × 20 = 100 µs → N = B·T = 600 k × 100 µs = 60.更快的想法：不加 CP 时 600 kHz 能发 600 k 符号/秒，只需要 500 k，所以有用时间只能占 500/600 = 5/6，CP 占 1/6：TG = T/5 → T = 5 × 20 = 100 µs → N = B·T = 600 k × 100 µs = 60。

CheckSubstitute back

  • Rate: 60 × 4 bits / 120 µs = 2 × 10⁶ bit/s = 2 Mbps ✓.速率：60 × 4 bit / 120 µs = 2 × 10⁶ bit/s = 2 Mbps ✓。
  • Per sub-carrier: one symbol every 120 µs, 8.33 k symbols/s, × 60 = 500 k symbols/s ✓.每个子载波：每 120 µs 发一个符号，8.33 k 符号/秒，× 60 = 500 k 符号/秒 ✓。
  • Flat? The coherence bandwidth is about BC ≈ 1/TD = 1/20 µs = 50 kHz (Ch 7 p.14 uses TD = 1/Bc); the sub-carrier width 10 kHz < 50 kHz ✓.平坦吗：相干带宽约 BC ≈ 1/TD = 1/20 µs = 50 kHz（第 7 章 p.14 用 TD = 1/Bc），子载波宽 10 kHz < 50 kHz ✓。
  • CP power loss: 10 log₁₀(120/100) = 0.79 dB.CP 功率损失：10 log₁₀(120/100) = 0.79 dB。

PitfallsWhere marks are lost

  • Forgetting the CP: without it, 600 kHz is already enough for 500 k symbols/s, any N works and there is no unique answer. It is the CP overhead that fixes N.忘了 CP：没有 CP 时 600 kHz 本来就够发 500 k 符号/秒，N 取多少都行，题目就没有唯一解。正是 CP 的开销决定了 N。
  • Using 2 Mbps directly in the equation without first dividing by 4 bits/symbol.直接拿 2 Mbps 列方程，忘了先除以 4 bit/符号。
  • Units: N/600 kHz is in seconds, 60/600 000 = 10⁻⁴ s = 100 µs; 20 µs = 2 × 10⁻⁵ s.单位：N/600 kHz 的单位是秒，60/600 000 = 10⁻⁴ s = 100 µs；20 µs = 2 × 10⁻⁵ s。
  • The official "OFDM symbol duration" of 0.12 ms is the total including the CP; if a question asks for the useful symbol duration, answer 100 µs. Writing both is safest."OFDM symbol duration"官方答案 0.12 ms 是含 CP 的总长；如果题目问有用符号时长，答 100 µs。两个都写出来最稳。

ExamHow to write it

16-QAM carries log₂16 = 4 bits/symbol, so the required symbol rate is 2 Mbps / 4 = 500 k symbols/s.

With N sub-carriers, the useful OFDM symbol duration is T = N/B and each OFDM block lasts T + TG with TG = 20 µs, carrying N symbols: \(\dfrac{N}{N/(600\text{ kHz})+20\,\mu\text{s}}=500\text{ k}\Rightarrow N=0.8333N+10\Rightarrow N=60\).

Useful duration T = 60/600 kHz = 100 µs (Δf = 10 kHz); OFDM symbol duration including the CP = 100 + 20 = 120 µs = 0.12 ms. Check: 60 × 4 bits / 120 µs = 2 Mbps.

In one line: 2 Mbps ÷ 4 = 500 k symbols/s; N/(N/600 kHz + 20 µs) = 500 k → N = 60; T = 100 µs, and with the CP the OFDM symbol lasts 120 µs = 0.12 ms.一句话：2 Mbps ÷ 4 = 500 k 符号/秒；N/(N/600 kHz + 20 µs) = 500 k → N = 60；T = 100 µs，加 CP 后 OFDM 符号长 120 µs = 0.12 ms。
◆ Key points
What it tests
OFDM system design: number of sub-carriers, OFDM symbol duration, CP overhead (Ch 7 p.8, p.17–18).
Background
Useful symbol duration T = N/B = 1/Δf; one OFDM block lasts T + TG, during which each sub-carrier sends one symbol.
Method
① Bit rate ÷ log₂M = required symbol rate; ② write N / (N/B + TG) = symbol rate; ③ solve for N; ④ T = N/B, total T + TG.
Key numbers
2 Mbps / 4 = 500 k symbols/s; N = 0.8333N + 10 → N = 60; T = 100 µs, total 120 µs.
Check
60 × 4 bit / 120 µs = 2 Mbps; the CP takes 1/6 of the time, power loss 10 log(120/100) = 0.79 dB.
Variations
With a 40 µs delay spread: N = 0.8333N + 20 → N = 120, T = 200 µs, total 240 µs. A larger delay spread needs a larger N to keep the CP fraction small.
Common mistakes
Without a CP any N would do and there would be no unique answer, so the CP must be included in the duration; the given rate is a bit rate, divide by 4 first.
  1. 比特率 → 符号率：16-QAM 每个符号 \(\log_2 16=4\) bit： \[R_s=\frac{2\times10^6\text{ bit/s}}{4\text{ bit/符号}}=5\times10^5\text{ 符号/s}\]
  2. OFDM 时间结构：N 个子载波，子载波间隔 \(\Delta f=B/N\)，有用符号时长 \(T=1/\Delta f=N/B\)（讲义第 7 章 p.8）。加循环前缀（cyclic prefix）\(T_G=T_D=20\) µs 后，一个 OFDM 块长 \(T+T_G\)（p.18），期间 N 个子载波各发 1 个符号： \[\text{符号率}=\frac{N}{T+T_G}=\frac{N}{N/B+T_G}\]
  3. 解出 N：令它等于 \(R_s\)： \[\begin{aligned}N&=R_s\Big(\frac NB+T_G\Big)\\&=\tfrac{500\text{k}}{600\text{k}}N+500\text{k}\times20\ \mu\text{s}\\&=0.8333N+10\\ N&=\frac{10}{1-0.8333}=\frac{10}{0.1667}=60\end{aligned}\]
  4. 符号时长： \[\begin{aligned}T&=\frac NB=\frac{60}{600\text{ kHz}}=100\ \mu\text{s}\\ T+T_G&=100+20=120\ \mu\text{s}=0.12\text{ ms}\end{aligned}\] 子载波间隔 Δf = 600 kHz / 60 = 10 kHz = 1/T ✓。
  5. 自检：每个 OFDM 块 60 × 4 = 240 bit，240 bit / 120 µs = 2 × 10⁶ bit/s = 2 Mbps ✓。CP 占 20/120 = 1/6 的时间，功率损失 \(10\log_{10}(120/100)=0.79\) dB（讲义 p.18）。
N = 60，OFDM 符号时长 0.12 ms
官方答案：60；0.12 ms ✓
如果不加 CP，600 kHz 本来就够发 500 k 符号/秒，N 取多少都行，题目就没有唯一解。正是 CP 的开销决定了 N：N 越大，CP 占的比例越小。CP 占 20/120 = 1/6 的时间，所以带宽必须比 500 k 多出 1/5，正好是 600 kHz。
知识讲解 + 详细解析：由速率和 CP 解出子载波数

知识讲解OFDM 的时间账：有用部分 + 循环前缀

OFDM 把带宽 B 分成 N 个子载波，子载波间隔 Δf = B/N（第 7 章 p.8）。为了让子载波相互正交，有用符号时长必须是 T = 1/Δf = N/B（p.7）。在这段时间里，N 个子载波各发一个调制符号。

每个 OFDM 块前面还要加一段保护间隔 TG（实现上就是循环前缀 CP），TG ≥ 最大时延扩展 TD，用来挡住上一个块的回波（p.5、p.17）。所以一个 OFDM 块总长 T + TG（p.18），但 CP 不带新数据。

数据速率 = N × log₂M bit ÷ (N/B + TG)

符号：M 是调制阶数，16-QAM 的 log₂16 = 4 bit/符号；B = 600 kHz；TG = 20 µs。CP 占用时间还带来功率损失 10 log₁₀((T + TG)/T) dB（p.18）。

详细解析四步解出 N 和符号时长

  1. 比特速率换成符号速率。为什么：一个子载波一次发一个 QAM 符号，按符号数列方程更方便。2 Mbps ÷ 4 bit = 500 k 符号/秒。
  2. 列方程。每个 OFDM 块发 N 个符号，耗时 N/B + TG：
    N / (N/600 kHz + 20 µs) = 500 k 符号/秒
  3. 解方程。两边乘以分母：N = 500k × N/600k + 500k × 20 × 10⁻⁶ = 0.8333N + 10 → 0.1667N = 10 → N = 60。
  4. 算时长。T = N/B = 60/600 kHz = 100 µs（Δf = 10 kHz）；OFDM 符号总长 T + TG = 100 + 20 = 120 µs = 0.12 ms。

更快的想法：不加 CP 时 600 kHz 能发 600 k 符号/秒，只需要 500 k，所以有用时间只能占 500/600 = 5/6，CP 占 1/6：TG = T/5 → T = 5 × 20 = 100 µs → N = B·T = 600 k × 100 µs = 60。

自检回代检查

  • 速率：60 × 4 bit / 120 µs = 2 × 10⁶ bit/s = 2 Mbps ✓。
  • 每个子载波：每 120 µs 发一个符号，8.33 k 符号/秒，× 60 = 500 k 符号/秒 ✓。
  • 平坦吗：相干带宽约 BC ≈ 1/TD = 1/20 µs = 50 kHz（第 7 章 p.14 用 TD = 1/Bc），子载波宽 10 kHz < 50 kHz ✓。
  • CP 功率损失：10 log₁₀(120/100) = 0.79 dB。

易错常见丢分点

  • 忘了 CP：没有 CP 时 600 kHz 本来就够发 500 k 符号/秒，N 取多少都行，题目就没有唯一解。正是 CP 的开销决定了 N。
  • 直接拿 2 Mbps 列方程，忘了先除以 4 bit/符号。
  • 单位：N/600 kHz 的单位是秒，60/600 000 = 10⁻⁴ s = 100 µs；20 µs = 2 × 10⁻⁵ s。
  • "OFDM symbol duration"官方答案 0.12 ms 是含 CP 的总长；如果题目问有用符号时长，答 100 µs。两个都写出来最稳。

考试英文写法

16-QAM carries log₂16 = 4 bits/symbol, so the required symbol rate is 2 Mbps / 4 = 500 k symbols/s.

With N sub-carriers, the useful OFDM symbol duration is T = N/B and each OFDM block lasts T + TG with TG = 20 µs, carrying N symbols: \(\dfrac{N}{N/(600\text{ kHz})+20\,\mu\text{s}}=500\text{ k}\Rightarrow N=0.8333N+10\Rightarrow N=60\).

Useful duration T = 60/600 kHz = 100 µs (Δf = 10 kHz); OFDM symbol duration including the CP = 100 + 20 = 120 µs = 0.12 ms. Check: 60 × 4 bits / 120 µs = 2 Mbps.

一句话：2 Mbps ÷ 4 = 500 k 符号/秒；N/(N/600 kHz + 20 µs) = 500 k → N = 60；T = 100 µs，加 CP 后 OFDM 符号长 120 µs = 0.12 ms。
◆ 本题知识点
考什么
OFDM 系统设计：子载波数、OFDM 符号时长、CP 开销（第 7 章 p.8、p.17–18）。
前置知识
有用符号时长 T = N/B = 1/Δf；一个 OFDM 块 = T + TG，期间每个子载波发一个符号。
解题套路
① 比特速率 ÷ log₂M = 需要的符号速率；② 列方程 N / (N/B + TG) = 符号速率；③ 解 N；④ T = N/B，总时长 T + TG。
关键数字
2 Mbps / 4 = 500 k 符号/秒；N = 0.8333N + 10 → N = 60；T = 100 µs，总长 120 µs。
检验
60 × 4 bit / 120 µs = 2 Mbps；CP 占 1/6 的时间，功率损失 10 log(120/100) = 0.79 dB。
举一反三
时延扩展变成 40 µs：N = 0.8333N + 20 → N = 120，T = 200 µs，总长 240 µs。时延扩展越大，需要的 N 越大，CP 的占比才不至于太高。
易错
没有 CP 时 N 取多少都行，题目就没有唯一解，所以一定要把 CP 算进时长；速率是比特速率，要先除以 4。
Part 2 practice
P7 · Q3

Shortest cyclic prefix

Original question · bilingualPractice 7

The Z–transform of a mobile channel is \(H(Z)=1+0.9Z^{-1}\). In order to mitigate the ISI of this channel, the system is now designed with OFDM. What is the minimum cyclic-prefix required. Explain your answer.

某移动信道的 Z 变换为 \(H(Z)=1+0.9Z^{-1}\)。为抑制该信道的 ISI，系统改用 OFDM 设计。所需的最小循环前缀是多少？说明理由。

Channel lengthCP ≥ L − 1Ch. 7 of the notes p.17–22
What the question is asking: what does this question actually want?

ScenarioWhat the question is about

Channel H(z) = 1 + 0.9z⁻¹: one direct path plus an echo of strength 0.9 arriving one sample later.信道 H(z) = 1 + 0.9z⁻¹：一条直射，加一条晚一个采样到达、强度 0.9 的回波。

The system uses OFDM to deal with the ISI caused by this echo; the question asks how long the cyclic prefix (CP) must be at least.系统用 OFDM 来对付这个回波造成的 ISI，问循环前缀（CP）至少要多长。

SymbolsWhat each quantity in the question means

\(z^{-1}\)Delay of one sample延迟一个采样
LChannel length: the impulse response [1, 0.9] has 2 taps, L = 2信道长度：冲激响应 [1, 0.9] 有 2 个抽头，L = 2
CPCyclic prefix: copy the last few samples of each OFDM block to the front of the block循环前缀：把每个 OFDM 块尾部的几个采样复制到块前面

What each part asksWhat each part is asking for

  • Only part Find the shortest CP and explain: how many samples of the previous block leak into the next? The CP must cover them; the receiver discards the CP, and the ISI is discarded with it. Using a copy of the block's tail also keeps the subcarriers orthogonal.唯一一问 求最短 CP 并解释：上一个块会漏进下一个块几个采样？CP 要盖住它们，接收端把 CP 丢掉，ISI 就跟着丢掉了；用块尾的复制品还能让子载波保持正交。

Watch outEasy ways to misread the question

  • It is L − 1 = 1 sample, not L = 2; the size of the coefficient 0.9 does not affect the CP length, only how many samples the delay is.是 L − 1 = 1 个采样，不是 L = 2 个；系数 0.9 的大小不影响 CP 长度，只看延迟几个采样。

PurposeWhat the question wants you to understand

The CP length depends only on how long the channel's "memory" is (the maximum delay); it must be at least L − 1 samples.CP 的长度只取决于信道"记忆"有多长（最大时延），至少等于 L − 1 个采样。

In one line: the channel has an echo 1 sample late; the question asks how long the OFDM cyclic prefix must be at least to block the ISI, and why.一句话：信道有一个晚 1 个采样的回波，问 OFDM 的循环前缀至少多长才能挡住 ISI，并解释原因。
  1. Read the impulse response: \(H(Z)=\sum_ih_iZ^{-i}\), and \(Z^{-1}\) means one sample later. So \(h_0=1\) (direct path) and \(h_1=0.9\) (an echo one sample late): channel length L = 2, longest echo L − 1 = 1 sample late.
  2. Where the ISI comes from: a received sample is \(r_i=x_i+0.9x_{i-1}+w_i\). The first sample of a block, i = 0, uses \(x_{-1}\); without a CP that is the last sample of the previous block, which causes inter-block interference (ISI). For i ≥ 1 only the current block is used, so just 1 sample per block is corrupted.
  3. Add a 1-sample CP: copy the last sample of the block to its front: \(x_{-1}=x_{N-1}\). The receiver discards the CP sample \(r_{-1}\) (it contains the echo of the previous block); the first sample kept is \[r_0=x_0+0.9\,x_{N-1}+w_0\] which contains only current-block data: the ISI is caught inside the CP.
  4. Why copy the tail: the N kept samples satisfy \(r_i=\sum_lh_lx_{(i-l)\bmod N}+w_i\), a circular convolution. After the DFT this gives exactly \(R_k=H_kS_k+W_k\) (Ch 7 p.22) with \(H_k=1+0.9e^{-j2\pi k/N}\): the sub-carriers stay orthogonal, there is no ICI, and one complex division \(\hat s_k=R_k/H_k\) equalises each sub-carrier. A guard interval filled with zeros would also block the ISI, but it breaks the circular structure and ICI appears.
  5. Conclusion and check: minimum CP = L − 1 = 1 sample (one symbol duration \(T_S\)). G = 0 fails (ISI and ICI); G = 2 also works but wastes a sample and lowers the efficiency N/(N + G). Check with N = 4: the kept samples are \(r_0=x_0+0.9x_3\), \(r_1=x_1+0.9x_0\), \(r_2=x_2+0.9x_1\), \(r_3=x_3+0.9x_2\), exactly the 4-point circular convolution of [1, 0.9] with x ✓. The size of the coefficient 0.9 does not affect the CP length; only how many samples the echo is delayed matters.
Minimum CP = 1 sample (symbol) = L − 1
Official answer: 1 symbol length ✓
Concept + walkthrough: minimum CP = L − 1知识讲解 + 详细解析：最短循环前缀 = L − 1

ConceptChannel "memory" and the cyclic prefix

Read the impulse response from H(z): z⁻¹ means one sample later, so H(z) = 1 + 0.9z⁻¹ → h = [1, 0.9]: a direct path plus an echo 1 sample later with strength 0.9. The number of taps is L = 2 and the channel "memory" (maximum delay) is L − 1 = 1 sample: each output sample ri = xi + 0.9xi−1 uses the previous input sample.从 H(z) 读冲激响应：z⁻¹ 表示晚一个采样，H(z) = 1 + 0.9z⁻¹ → h = [1, 0.9]，一条直射 + 一条晚 1 个采样、强度 0.9 的回波。抽头数 L = 2，信道的"记忆"（最大时延）是 L − 1 = 1 个采样：每个输出样本 ri = xi + 0.9xi−1，会用到前一个输入样本。

The problem is at block boundaries: OFDM is sent block by block (each block is the N samples obtained by an IDFT of N sub-carrier symbols, Ch 7 p.19). The first sample of a block is r₀ = x₀ + 0.9 × (last sample of the previous block), which mixes in data from the previous block: inter-block ISI.问题在块边界：OFDM 一块一块地发（每块是 N 个子载波符号做 IDFT 得到的 N 个采样，第 7 章 p.19）。一个块的第一个采样 r₀ = x₀ + 0.9 × (上一块的最后一个采样)，混进了上一块的数据，这就是块间的 ISI。

Cyclic prefix (CP) (p.21–22): copy the last G samples of each block to its front; the receiver discards these G samples and keeps only the last N. With G ≥ L − 1, the echo of the previous block lands only inside the discarded CP.循环前缀 CP（p.21–22）：把每块最后 G 个采样复制一份放到块前面，接收端把这 G 个采样丢掉，只留后 N 个。G ≥ L − 1 时，上一块的回波只会落在被丢掉的 CP 里。

Why "copy the tail" instead of leaving a gap: with the CP, the sample "seen" before the first sample of the block is the last sample of the same block, so inside the receive window the linear convolution becomes a circular convolution. The DFT turns circular convolution exactly into multiplication: Rk = HkSk + Wk (p.17, p.22); each sub-carrier is multiplied by one complex number and the sub-carriers stay orthogonal. An empty gap (zero padding) also blocks the ISI, but the window no longer has a circular structure, so the sub-carriers lose orthogonality and inter-carrier interference (ICI) appears.为什么要"复制块尾"而不是放空白：放 CP 后，块的第一个采样前面"看到"的是本块的最后一个采样，线性卷积在接收窗口里就变成循环卷积。循环卷积做 DFT 正好变成乘法：Rk = HkSk + Wk（p.17、p.22），每个子载波只乘一个复数，子载波之间保持正交。如果只放空白（补零），能挡住 ISI，但接收窗口里不再是循环结构，子载波失去正交，产生载波间干扰（ICI）。

Step by stepA small N = 4 example makes it clear

  1. Transmit: a block has samples x₀ x₁ x₂ x₃; with a 1-sample CP we send [x₃ | x₀ x₁ x₂ x₃].发送：一块的采样是 x₀ x₁ x₂ x₃，加 1 个采样的 CP 后发 [x₃ | x₀ x₁ x₂ x₃]。
  2. Receive (ri = xi + 0.9xi−1):接收（ri = xi + 0.9xi−1）：
    CP slot: x₃ + 0.9 × (last sample of the previous block) ← contains ISI, but is discarded
    r₀ = x₀ + 0.9x₃ (the previous sample is exactly the x₃ in the CP)
    r₁ = x₁ + 0.9x₀, r₂ = x₂ + 0.9x₁, r₃ = x₃ + 0.9x₂
  3. Look at the structure: in the kept r₀…r₃ each x is added only to its "cyclic predecessor" (the predecessor of x₀ is x₃). This is the 4-point circular convolution of h and x, with no data from the previous block at all.看结构：留下的 r₀…r₃ 里每个 x 都只和它"循环意义下的前一个"相加（x₀ 的前一个是 x₃），这就是 h 和 x 的 4 点循环卷积，完全没有上一块的数据。
  4. After the DFT: Rk = HkSk with Hk = 1 + 0.9e−j2πk/4 = 1.9, 1 − 0.9j, 0.1, 1 + 0.9j. The receiver equalises by dividing each sub-carrier by Hk (p.25–26).DFT 后：Rk = HkSk，Hk = 1 + 0.9e−j2πk/4 = 1.9、1 − 0.9j、0.1、1 + 0.9j。接收端每个子载波除以 Hk 就完成均衡（p.25–26）。
  5. Conclusion: minimum CP = L − 1 = 1 sample (1 symbol length). Shorter (0) cannot block the ISI; longer also works but wastes time, efficiency N/(N + G).结论：最短 CP = L − 1 = 1 个采样（1 个符号长度）。再短（0 个）就挡不住 ISI；更长也可以，但浪费时间，效率 N/(N + G)。

A side note: H₂ = 0.1, so sub-carrier 2 is almost cancelled by the two paths. OFDM does not remove fading; it turns frequency-selective fading into flat fading on each sub-carrier, which then needs coding or power allocation as in P7 Q1.附带一点：H₂ = 0.1，第 2 个子载波几乎被两条路径抵消。OFDM 不能消除衰落，只是把频率选择性衰落变成每个子载波上的平坦衰落，这时就需要编码或 P7 Q1 那样的功率分配。

PitfallsWhere marks are lost

  • Answering L = 2 samples. The CP must cover the part of the echo that arrives late, which is L − 1, not L.答成 L = 2 个采样。CP 要盖住的是"回波晚到的那部分"，是 L − 1，不是 L。
  • Thinking a larger coefficient 0.9 needs a longer CP. The CP length depends only on how many samples the echo is delayed, not on its strength.以为系数 0.9 越大 CP 要越长。CP 长度只看延迟几个采样，和回波强弱无关。
  • Saying only "it blocks ISI" without saying why the copy of the tail is used (keeps the circular convolution / sub-carrier orthogonality, avoids ICI). The question says "Explain"; this point earns marks.只说"挡住 ISI"，不说为什么要用块尾的复制品（保持循环卷积 / 子载波正交，避免 ICI）。题目要求 Explain，这一点是得分点。
  • In time units: CP ≥ 1 sampling interval Ts, i.e. TG ≥ the maximum delay spread TD.换成时间单位：CP ≥ 1 个采样间隔 Ts，即 TG ≥ 最大时延扩展 TD。

ExamHow to write it

From \(H(z)=1+0.9z^{-1}\), the channel impulse response is h = [1, 0.9]: L = 2 taps, so the channel memory (maximum delay spread) is L − 1 = 1 sample.

The last sample of each OFDM block therefore leaks into the first sample of the next block (ISI). A cyclic prefix of G ≥ L − 1 samples, i.e. a copy of the last sample of the block placed in front of it, absorbs this leakage, and the receiver discards the CP.

Because the prefix is cyclic, the linear convolution with h becomes a circular convolution over the N retained samples, so after the DFT \(r_k=H_ks_k+w_k\): no ISI and no ICI, and each sub-carrier is equalised by one complex gain.

Minimum cyclic prefix = 1 symbol (sample) length.

In one line: h = [1, 0.9], the echo is 1 sample late → minimum CP = L − 1 = 1 symbol length; a prefix copied from the block tail keeps the ISI inside the discarded CP and turns the linear convolution into a circular one, so after the DFT rk = Hksk + wk.一句话：h = [1, 0.9]，回波晚 1 个采样 → 最短 CP = L − 1 = 1 个符号长度；用块尾复制品做前缀，既把 ISI 留在被丢掉的 CP 里，又让线性卷积变成循环卷积，DFT 后 rk = Hksk + wk。
◆ Key points
What it tests
The minimum cyclic-prefix length (Ch 7 p.17–22).
Background
Z-transform: Z⁻¹ means one sample later; a channel with L taps has its longest echo L − 1 samples late.
Method
Read the impulse response h = [1, 0.9] from H(Z) → L = 2 → CP ≥ L − 1 = 1 sample.
Why it is enough
With CP ≥ L − 1 the N samples kept by the receiver contain only data from the current block, the linear convolution becomes circular, and after the DFT rk = Hksk + wk (derivation box in Section 7.4 of the learning page).
Why copy the tail
An empty guard interval would also block the previous block's echo, but the receive window would no longer see a complete periodic signal, the sub-carriers would lose orthogonality and ICI would appear. Only copying the tail keeps the circular structure.
Common mistakes
It is L − 1 = 1 sample, not L = 2; the size of the coefficient 0.9 does not matter, only how many samples the echo is delayed.
Variations
H(Z) = 1 + 0.5Z⁻³ → delay 3 samples → CP ≥ 3; in time, TG ≥ the maximum delay spread TD. Each extra CP sample lowers the efficiency to N/(N + G).
  1. 读出冲激响应：\(H(Z)=\sum_ih_iZ^{-i}\)，\(Z^{-1}\) 表示晚 1 个采样。所以 \(h_0=1\)（直射径），\(h_1=0.9\)（晚 1 个采样的回波），信道长度 L = 2，最长回波晚 L − 1 = 1 个采样。
  2. ISI 从哪来：接收样本 \(r_i=x_i+0.9x_{i-1}+w_i\)。块内第一个样本 i = 0 要用到 \(x_{-1}\)；没有 CP 时它是上一个块的最后一个样本，形成块间干扰（ISI）。i ≥ 1 只用到本块数据，所以每块只有 1 个样本被污染。
  3. 加 1 个样本的 CP：把本块最后一个样本复制到块前：\(x_{-1}=x_{N-1}\)。接收端丢掉 CP 位置的样本 \(r_{-1}\)（它含上一块的回波），保留的第一个样本 \[r_0=x_0+0.9\,x_{N-1}+w_0\] 只含本块数据，ISI 被挡在 CP 里。
  4. 为什么要复制块尾：保留的 N 个样本满足 \(r_i=\sum_lh_lx_{(i-l)\bmod N}+w_i\)，即循环卷积（circular convolution）。DFT 后正好 \(R_k=H_kS_k+W_k\)（讲义 p.22），\(H_k=1+0.9e^{-j2\pi k/N}\)：子载波保持正交、没有 ICI，一次复数除法 \(\hat s_k=R_k/H_k\) 就完成均衡。如果 CP 位置只放 0，ISI 也能挡住，但循环结构被破坏，会出现 ICI。
  5. 结论与自检：最短 CP = L − 1 = 1 个采样（1 个符号时长 \(T_S\)）。G = 0 不行（有 ISI 和 ICI）；G = 2 也行，但多浪费一个样本，效率 N/(N + G) 更低。自检 N = 4：保留的样本是 \(r_0=x_0+0.9x_3\)、\(r_1=x_1+0.9x_0\)、\(r_2=x_2+0.9x_1\)、\(r_3=x_3+0.9x_2\)，正好是 [1, 0.9] 与 x 的 4 点循环卷积 ✓。系数 0.9 的大小不影响 CP 长度，只看回波晚几个采样。
最短 CP = 1 个采样（符号）长度 = L − 1
官方答案：1 symbol length ✓
知识讲解 + 详细解析：最短循环前缀 = L − 1

知识讲解信道"记忆"和循环前缀

从 H(z) 读冲激响应：z⁻¹ 表示晚一个采样，H(z) = 1 + 0.9z⁻¹ → h = [1, 0.9]，一条直射 + 一条晚 1 个采样、强度 0.9 的回波。抽头数 L = 2，信道的"记忆"（最大时延）是 L − 1 = 1 个采样：每个输出样本 ri = xi + 0.9xi−1，会用到前一个输入样本。

问题在块边界：OFDM 一块一块地发（每块是 N 个子载波符号做 IDFT 得到的 N 个采样，第 7 章 p.19）。一个块的第一个采样 r₀ = x₀ + 0.9 × (上一块的最后一个采样)，混进了上一块的数据，这就是块间的 ISI。

循环前缀 CP（p.21–22）：把每块最后 G 个采样复制一份放到块前面，接收端把这 G 个采样丢掉，只留后 N 个。G ≥ L − 1 时，上一块的回波只会落在被丢掉的 CP 里。

为什么要"复制块尾"而不是放空白：放 CP 后，块的第一个采样前面"看到"的是本块的最后一个采样，线性卷积在接收窗口里就变成循环卷积。循环卷积做 DFT 正好变成乘法：Rk = HkSk + Wk（p.17、p.22），每个子载波只乘一个复数，子载波之间保持正交。如果只放空白（补零），能挡住 ISI，但接收窗口里不再是循环结构，子载波失去正交，产生载波间干扰（ICI）。

详细解析用 N = 4 的小例子看清楚

  1. 发送：一块的采样是 x₀ x₁ x₂ x₃，加 1 个采样的 CP 后发 [x₃ | x₀ x₁ x₂ x₃]。
  2. 接收（ri = xi + 0.9xi−1）：
    CP 位置：x₃ + 0.9 × (上一块最后一个采样) ← 有 ISI，但会被丢掉
    r₀ = x₀ + 0.9x₃（前一个采样正好是 CP 里的 x₃）
    r₁ = x₁ + 0.9x₀，r₂ = x₂ + 0.9x₁，r₃ = x₃ + 0.9x₂
  3. 看结构：留下的 r₀…r₃ 里每个 x 都只和它"循环意义下的前一个"相加（x₀ 的前一个是 x₃），这就是 h 和 x 的 4 点循环卷积，完全没有上一块的数据。
  4. DFT 后：Rk = HkSk，Hk = 1 + 0.9e−j2πk/4 = 1.9、1 − 0.9j、0.1、1 + 0.9j。接收端每个子载波除以 Hk 就完成均衡（p.25–26）。
  5. 结论：最短 CP = L − 1 = 1 个采样（1 个符号长度）。再短（0 个）就挡不住 ISI；更长也可以，但浪费时间，效率 N/(N + G)。

附带一点：H₂ = 0.1，第 2 个子载波几乎被两条路径抵消。OFDM 不能消除衰落，只是把频率选择性衰落变成每个子载波上的平坦衰落，这时就需要编码或 P7 Q1 那样的功率分配。

易错常见丢分点

  • 答成 L = 2 个采样。CP 要盖住的是"回波晚到的那部分"，是 L − 1，不是 L。
  • 以为系数 0.9 越大 CP 要越长。CP 长度只看延迟几个采样，和回波强弱无关。
  • 只说"挡住 ISI"，不说为什么要用块尾的复制品（保持循环卷积 / 子载波正交，避免 ICI）。题目要求 Explain，这一点是得分点。
  • 换成时间单位：CP ≥ 1 个采样间隔 Ts，即 TG ≥ 最大时延扩展 TD。

考试英文写法

From \(H(z)=1+0.9z^{-1}\), the channel impulse response is h = [1, 0.9]: L = 2 taps, so the channel memory (maximum delay spread) is L − 1 = 1 sample.

The last sample of each OFDM block therefore leaks into the first sample of the next block (ISI). A cyclic prefix of G ≥ L − 1 samples, i.e. a copy of the last sample of the block placed in front of it, absorbs this leakage, and the receiver discards the CP.

Because the prefix is cyclic, the linear convolution with h becomes a circular convolution over the N retained samples, so after the DFT \(r_k=H_ks_k+w_k\): no ISI and no ICI, and each sub-carrier is equalised by one complex gain.

Minimum cyclic prefix = 1 symbol (sample) length.

一句话：h = [1, 0.9]，回波晚 1 个采样 → 最短 CP = L − 1 = 1 个符号长度；用块尾复制品做前缀，既把 ISI 留在被丢掉的 CP 里，又让线性卷积变成循环卷积，DFT 后 rk = Hksk + wk。
◆ 本题知识点
考什么
循环前缀的最短长度（第 7 章 p.17–22）。
前置知识
Z 变换：Z⁻¹ 表示晚一个采样；L 个抽头的信道，最长回波晚 L − 1 个采样。
解题套路
由 H(Z) 读出冲激响应 h = [1, 0.9] → L = 2 → CP ≥ L − 1 = 1 个采样。
为什么够
CP ≥ L − 1 时，接收端保留的 N 个采样只含本块的数据，线性卷积变成循环卷积，DFT 后 rk = Hksk + wk（讲解页 7.4 节推导框）。
为什么复制块尾
只放一段空白也能挡住上一块的回声，但接收窗口里看到的不再是完整的周期信号，子载波失去正交，会有 ICI；复制块尾才能保持循环结构。
易错
是 L − 1 = 1 个，不是 L = 2 个；系数 0.9 的大小不影响 CP 长度，只看延迟几个采样。
举一反三
H(Z) = 1 + 0.5Z⁻³ → 延迟 3 个采样 → CP ≥ 3；换成时间就是 TG ≥ 最大时延扩展 TD。CP 每多 1 个采样，效率降为 N/(N + G)。
Past final exam
2023-24 S2Q2(b)12 marks
Topics: number of OFDM subcarriers · subchannel gain Hk · guard interval and power loss考点：OFDM 子载波数 · 子信道增益 Hk · 保护间隔与功率损失
Original question (verbatim)

(b) A wireless system operates with a bandwidth of 1 MHz and implements an OFDM scheme with N sub-carriers. The fading channel has a coherence bandwidth of 500 kHz and a sampled channel impulse response of {1, −0.6, 0.2}.

(i) Determine the value of N if the bandwidth of each OFDM sub-carrier is to be half of the coherence bandwidth.

(ii) Determine the channel gain coefficient values for the N sub-channels.

(iii) Using the simplified formula, T = 1/B, where T is the signal symbol duration and B is the signal bandwidth, determine the total OFDM block duration if a Guard interval of 1 microsecond is added.

(iv) For the question in 2(b) part (iii) above, determine the power loss due to the addition of the guard interval.

(12 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
(i) Subcarrier bandwidth → N: make each subcarrier bandwidth half the coherence bandwidth, so that every subcarrier is narrower than Bc and sees flat fading:(i) 子载波带宽 → N：每个子载波带宽取相干带宽的一半，这样每个子载波都比 Bc 窄，经历平坦衰落：
Δf = Bc/2 = 500 kHz / 2 = 250 kHz
N = B/Δf = 1000 kHz / 250 kHz = 4
2
(ii) Write the sub-channel gain formula: notes Ch7 p.15: Hk = Σi=0L−1 hi e−j2πik/N, k = 1, …, N. Here h₀ = 1, h₁ = −0.6, h₂ = 0.2, L = 3, N = 4. Let W = e−j2πk/4 = e−jπk/2; then Hk = 1 − 0.6W + 0.2W². First list W and W²:(ii) 写出子信道增益公式：讲义 Ch7 p.15：Hk = Σi=0L−1 hi e−j2πik/N，k = 1, …, N。这里 h₀ = 1，h₁ = −0.6，h₂ = 0.2，L = 3，N = 4。记 W = e−j2πk/4 = e−jπk/2，则 Hk = 1 − 0.6W + 0.2W²，先列出 W 和 W²：
k = 1: W = −j, W² = −1
k = 2: W = −1, W² = 1
k = 3: W = j, W² = −1
k = 4: W = 1, W² = 1
3
(ii) Substitute one by one:
H₁ = 1 − 0.6(−j) + 0.2(−1) = 0.8 + 0.6j
H₂ = 1 − 0.6(−1) + 0.2(1) = 1.8
H₃ = 1 − 0.6(j) + 0.2(−1) = 0.8 − 0.6j
H₄ = 1 − 0.6(1) + 0.2(1) = 0.6
Magnitudes: |H₁| = |H₃| = √(0.8² + 0.6²) = 1, |H₂| = 1.8, |H₄| = 0.6 (for k = 4, W = 1, the same as for k = 0, so H₄ = H₀: Hk is periodic with period N). Each sub-channel is left with a single complex gain, rk = Hksk + wk (p.17). This is what is meant by OFDM turning a frequency-selective channel into N flat sub-channels.模值：|H₁| = |H₃| = √(0.8² + 0.6²) = 1，|H₂| = 1.8，|H₄| = 0.6（k = 4 时 W = 1，和 k = 0 一样，所以 H₄ = H₀：Hk 以 N 为周期）。每个子信道只剩一个复数增益 rk = Hksk + wk（p.17），这就是 OFDM 把频率选择性信道变成 N 个平坦子信道的意思。
4
(ii) Self-check: ① h is real, so H₃ = H₁* (conjugate symmetry) ✓; ② Parseval's theorem:(ii) 自检：① h 是实数，所以 H₃ = H₁*（共轭对称）✓；② 帕塞瓦尔定理（Parseval）：
(1/N)Σ|Hk|² = (1 + 3.24 + 1 + 0.36)/4 = 1.4
Σhi² = 1 + 0.36 + 0.04 = 1.4 ✓
5
(iii) OFDM block length: with T = 1/B, the original symbol duration is Ts = 1/(1 MHz) = 1 µs. One OFDM block carries N symbols, plus the guard interval (notes Ch7 p.18: block length = NTs + TG):(iii) OFDM 块长：按 T = 1/B，原始符号时长 Ts = 1/(1 MHz) = 1 µs。一个 OFDM 块装 N 个符号，再加保护间隔（讲义 Ch7 p.18：块长 = NTs + TG）：
NTs = 4 × 1 µs = 4 µs
Tblock = NTs + TG = 4 + 1 = 5 µs
Check: 4 µs also equals the reciprocal of the subcarrier bandwidth, 1/(250 kHz) ✓.检查：4 µs 也等于子载波带宽的倒数 1/(250 kHz) ✓。
6
(iv) Power loss due to the guard interval: the guard interval carries no new information, so the energy spent on it is wasted (notes Ch7 p.18):(iv) 保护间隔的功率损失：保护间隔不携带新信息，花在它上面的能量白白浪费（讲义 Ch7 p.18）：
Loss = 10 log₁₀[(NTs + TG)/(NTs)]
 = 10 log₁₀(5/4) = 10 × 0.0969
 ≈ 0.97 dB
Another way to see it: the useful energy is only 4/5 = 80%, and 10 log₁₀ 0.8 = −0.97 dB ✓.换个角度：有用能量只占 4/5 = 80%，10 log₁₀ 0.8 = −0.97 dB ✓。
N = 4; H = {0.8+0.6j, 1.8, 0.8−0.6j, 0.6}; block length 5 µs; power loss ≈ 0.97 dBN = 4；H = {0.8+0.6j, 1.8, 0.8−0.6j, 0.6}；块长 5 µs；功率损失 ≈ 0.97 dB
◆ Key points
What it tests
Number of OFDM subcarriers, subchannel gain Hk, block length and guard-interval power loss (Ch. 7 p.5, p.15, p.17–18).OFDM 子载波数、子信道增益 Hk、块长和保护间隔的功率损失（第 7 章 p.5、p.15、p.17–18）。
Knowledge used
Subcarrier bandwidth ≤ coherence bandwidth (BC/2 is used here); Hk = Σhie−j2πik/N; T = NTs; loss 10 log₁₀((NTs + TG)/NTs).子载波带宽 ≤ 相干带宽（本题取 BC/2）；Hk = Σhie−j2πik/N；T = NTs；损失 10 log₁₀((NTs + TG)/NTs)。
Method
N = total bandwidth / subcarrier bandwidth; for N = 4, e−j2πk/4 is −j, −1, j, 1 in turn, and the third tap is multiplied by its square (−1, 1, −1, 1); block length = 4 µs + 1 µs.N = 总带宽 / 子载波带宽；N = 4 时 e−j2πk/4 依次是 −j、−1、j、1，第三个抽头乘的是它的平方（−1、1、−1、1）；块长 = 4 µs + 1 µs。
Self-check
H₄ = sum of all taps = 0.6; H₁ and H₃ are complex conjugates; Σ|Hk|² = 1 + 3.24 + 1 + 0.36 = 5.6 = 4 × (1 + 0.36 + 0.04).H₄ = 所有抽头之和 = 0.6；H₁ 和 H₃ 共轭；Σ|Hk|² = 1 + 3.24 + 1 + 0.36 = 5.6 = 4 × (1 + 0.36 + 0.04)。
Common mistakes
At k = 1 the third tap is multiplied by −1, not −j; in the power loss, the numerator is the total block length 5 µs and the denominator is the useful part 4 µs.第三个抽头在 k = 1 时乘 −1，不是 −j；功率损失的分子是总块长 5 µs，分母是有用部分 4 µs。
Concept + Step by step: OFDM number of subcarriers, subchannel gains and guard interval

ConceptWhy OFDM can handle frequency-selective fading

When the bandwidth of a wideband signal is larger than the coherence bandwidth BC, different frequencies fade differently (frequency-selective fading), which shows up as ISI in the time domain. OFDM (orthogonal frequency division multiplexing) splits the total bandwidth B into N narrow subcarriers, each with bandwidth B/N smaller than BC, so each subcarrier sees only flat fading (Ch. 7 of the notes, p.5–8).宽带信号的带宽大于相干带宽 BC 时，不同频率衰落不一样（频率选择性衰落），时域上表现为 ISI。OFDM（正交频分复用）的办法是把总带宽 B 切成 N 个窄的子载波（sub-carrier），每个子载波带宽 B/N 小于 BC，于是每个子载波只经历平坦衰落（讲义第 7 章 p.5–8）。

  • Subchannel gain (Ch. 7, p.15): Hk = Σi hi e−j2πik/N, i.e. the N-point DFT of the channel impulse response. Each subcarrier is only multiplied by one complex number Hk, and the receiver equalises by dividing by Hk.子信道增益（第 7 章 p.15）：Hk = Σi hi e−j2πik/N，就是信道冲激响应的 N 点 DFT。每个子载波只被乘上一个复数 Hk，接收端除以 Hk 就完成均衡。
  • Symbol duration: the original symbol duration is Ts = 1/B; one OFDM block holds N symbols and lasts NTs, so the symbol on each subcarrier is N times longer and the relative effect of ISI is smaller.符号时长：原来的符号时长 Ts = 1/B；一个 OFDM 块含 N 个符号，长 NTs，所以每个子载波上的符号变长 N 倍，ISI 的相对影响变小。
  • Guard interval (Ch. 7, p.17–18): add a segment of length TG in front of each block, with TG larger than the maximum delay spread, so the tail of the previous block falls inside it and the receiver simply discards it. The cost is that power is also transmitted during this segment: power loss = 10 log₁₀[(NTs + TG)/(NTs)].保护间隔（guard interval，第 7 章 p.17–18）：每个块前面加长度 TG 的一段，要求 TG 大于最大时延扩展，让上一个块的拖尾落在这段里，接收端直接丢掉。代价是这段时间也要发功率，功率损失 = 10 log₁₀[(NTs + TG)/(NTs)]。

Step by step(i) Number of subcarriers

Bandwidth per subcarrier = BC/2 = 500/2 = 250 kHz每个子载波带宽 = BC/2 = 500/2 = 250 kHz
N = 1 MHz / 250 kHz = 4

Half of BC is taken to leave a margin, so that each subcarrier really is flat fading.取 BC 的一半是为了留余量，保证每个子载波确实是平坦衰落。

Step by step(ii) The four subchannel gains

For N = 4, e−j2πk/4 is easy to compute; the third tap is multiplied by its square:N = 4 时 e−j2πk/4 很好算，第三个抽头乘的是它的平方：

ke−j2πk/4e−j2π·2k/4Hk = 1 − 0.6(·) + 0.2(·)|Hk|
1−j−11 + 0.6j − 0.2 = 0.8 + 0.6j1
2−111 + 0.6 + 0.2 = 1.81.8
3j−11 − 0.6j − 0.2 = 0.8 − 0.6j1
4 (= 0)111 − 0.6 + 0.2 = 0.60.6

Self-check: H₁ and H₃ are complex conjugates (because h is real); H₄ = H₀ = sum of the taps. |H| ranges from 0.6 to 1.8, so this channel is indeed frequency-selective, but within each subcarrier it is just a constant gain.自检：H₁ 和 H₃ 互为共轭（因为 h 是实数）；H₄ = H₀ = 抽头之和。|H| 从 0.6 到 1.8，说明这个信道确实是频率选择性的，但每个子载波内部只是一个常数增益。

Step by step(iii)(iv) Block length and power loss

Ts = 1/B = 1/(1 MHz) = 1 µs; NTs = 4 µs (= 1/250 kHz)
Tblock = NTs + TG = 4 + 1 = 5 µs
Power loss = 10 log₁₀(5/4) = 10 × 0.0969 ≈ 0.97 dB

Intuition: only 4 µs of every 5 µs is useful; 20% of the time and energy is spent on the guard interval, and the rate drops to 4/5 of the original.直觉：5 µs 里只有 4 µs 有用，20% 的时间和能量花在保护间隔上，速率也只剩原来的 4/5。

PitfallsWatch out

  • At k = 1 the third tap is multiplied by (−j)² = −1, not −j.第三个抽头在 k = 1 时乘 (−j)² = −1，不是 −j。
  • In the power loss, the numerator is the total block length 5 µs and the denominator is the useful part 4 µs; the ratio is > 1, so the dB value is positive.功率损失的分子是总块长 5 µs，分母是有用部分 4 µs，比值 > 1，dB 为正。
  • N must be an integer; the subcarrier bandwidth is half the coherence bandwidth, not equal to it.N 必须是整数；子载波带宽是相干带宽的一半，不是等于相干带宽。
  • One extra point (does not affect the answer): the taps are 1 µs apart and there are 3 of them, so the channel tail is about 2 µs; by the rule on notes p.5, "the guard interval must be longer than the maximum delay spread", a 1 µs guard interval is strictly speaking too short. In the exam, just use the 1 µs given in the question.补充一点（不影响本题作答）：抽头间隔 1 µs、共 3 个抽头，信道拖尾约 2 µs；按讲义 p.5"保护间隔要长于最大时延扩展"，严格说 1 µs 的保护间隔偏短。考试按题目给的 1 µs 计算即可。

ExamHow to write it in English

(i) Bandwidth of each sub-carrier = BC/2 = 250 kHz, so N = 1 MHz / 250 kHz = 4.

(ii) The sub-channel gains are the N-point DFT of the channel impulse response, Hk = Σi hie−j2πik/N with h = {1, −0.6, 0.2} and N = 4: H₁ = 1 − 0.6(−j) + 0.2(−1) = 0.8 + 0.6j; H₂ = 1 + 0.6 + 0.2 = 1.8; H₃ = 0.8 − 0.6j; H₄ (= H₀) = 1 − 0.6 + 0.2 = 0.6. Each sub-carrier therefore sees a flat channel with a single complex gain.

(iii) Original symbol duration Ts = 1/B = 1 µs. The OFDM block duration is NTs = 4 µs, and with the 1 µs guard interval the total block duration is 4 + 1 = 5 µs.

(iv) Power loss = 10 log₁₀[(NTs + TG)/(NTs)] = 10 log₁₀(5/4) ≈ 0.97 dB.

In one line: subcarrier bandwidth 250 kHz → N = 4; Hk is the 4-point DFT of h = {0.8+0.6j, 1.8, 0.8−0.6j, 0.6}; block length 4 + 1 = 5 µs; power loss 10 log₁₀(5/4) ≈ 0.97 dB.一句话：子载波带宽 250 kHz → N = 4；Hk 是 h 的 4 点 DFT = {0.8+0.6j, 1.8, 0.8−0.6j, 0.6}；块长 4 + 1 = 5 µs；功率损失 10 log₁₀(5/4) ≈ 0.97 dB。

Past final exam
2024-25 S2Q2(b)12 marks
Topics: OFDM rate split · expression with a cyclic prefix · power allocation for equal capacity考点：OFDM 速率划分 · 加循环前缀的表达式 · 等容量功率分配
Original question (verbatim)

(b) A 4-level communication system has a transmitted symbol rate of 5 million symbols per second. The system experiences severe fading effects and will be modified to use the OFDM technique with N = 4, where N is the number of sub-carriers of the OFDM system.

(i) Determine the transmission bit rates for the system and for each of the OFDM sub-carriers.

(ii) The transmitted signal of an OFDM signal can be expressed as, x(t) = (1/√T) Σk=0N−1 sk(t)ej2π(k/T)t, nT ≤ t ≤ (n + 1)T where sk(t) is the signals in the kth OFDM sub-carrier and T is the OFDM symbol duration. Modify this expression to incorporate the inclusion of a cyclic prefix of Tg.

(iii) The channel capacity per Hz for the kth sub-carrier of an OFDM system has been derived to be, Ck = ¼ log2(1 + Pk|Hk|2), k = 1, 2, 3, 4 where Pk is the power allocated to the kth OFDM sub-carrier and Hk is the channel gain experienced by the kth OFDM sub-carrier signal. Powers are allocated to the sub-carriers to have the same channel capacity per Hz of Ck = 0.9 bit per second per Hz. Determine the total power needed for this system if the channel gains have the following values. |H1| = 1, |H2| = 0.2, |H3| = 1, |H4| = 1.4

(12 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
(i) System rate: 4-level → log₂ 4 = 2 bit per symbol:(i) 系统速率：4 电平（4-level）→ 每个符号 log₂ 4 = 2 bit：
Rb = Rs × 2 = 5 × 10⁶ × 2 = 10 Mbit/s
Switching to OFDM does not change the total rate; it only splits this high-rate stream into N low-rate streams sent in parallel.改用 OFDM 不改变总速率，只是把这条高速流拆成 N 路低速流并行传。
2
(i) Rate per subcarrier: from notes Ch7 p.8, the symbol rate of each subcarrier is R = 1/T = 1/(NTs) = Rs/N:(i) 每个子载波的速率：讲义 Ch7 p.8，每个子载波的符号率 R = 1/T = 1/(NTs) = Rs/N：
R = 5 M/4 = 1.25 Msymbol/s
Per subcarrier = 1.25 M × 2 = 2.5 Mbit/s
Self-check: 4 × 2.5 = 10 Mbit/s ✓. The OFDM symbol duration is T = 4Ts = 4 × 0.2 µs = 0.8 µs; the symbol is 4 times longer, which is exactly why OFDM resists multipath.自检：4 × 2.5 = 10 Mbit/s ✓。OFDM 符号时长 T = 4Ts = 4 × 0.2 µs = 0.8 µs，符号变长 4 倍，这正是 OFDM 抗多径的原因。
3
(ii) Add the cyclic prefix: as written in notes Ch7 p.17 and p.21, the expression stays the same; only the time range of each block is extended earlier by Tg:(ii) 加循环前缀：讲义 Ch7 p.17、p.21 的写法：表达式不变，只把每个块的时间范围往前延伸 Tg：
x(t) = (1/√T) Σk=0N−1 sk(t) ej2πkt/T,
nT − Tg ≤ t < (n+1)T
4
(ii) Why it is called "cyclic": ej2πkt/T is periodic with period T, so the extra Tg segment at the front is an exact copy of the last Tg of the block; this is the cyclic prefix. As long as Tg is not smaller than the maximum delay spread, echoes of the previous block fall only inside the prefix; the receiver discards this segment and keeps only nT ≤ t < (n+1)T. (If you count time with the block period T + Tg, you can also write the interval as n(T+Tg) ≤ t < (n+1)(T+Tg) and use t − n(T+Tg) − Tg in the exponent.)(ii) 为什么叫"循环"：ej2πkt/T 以 T 为周期，所以前面多出的 Tg 段正好是块尾 Tg 段的复制，这就是循环前缀（cyclic prefix）。只要 Tg 不小于最大时延扩展，上一块的回波只落在前缀里；接收端丢掉这一段，只取 nT ≤ t < (n+1)T。（若按块周期 T + Tg 计时，也可写成区间 n(T+Tg) ≤ t < (n+1)(T+Tg)、指数里用 t − n(T+Tg) − Tg。）
5
(iii) Condition for each subcarrier: each Ck must equal 0.9:(iii) 每个子载波的条件：要求每个 Ck = 0.9：
¼ log₂(1 + Pk|Hk|²) = 0.9
log₂(1 + Pk|Hk|²) = 3.6
1 + Pk|Hk|² = 23.6
6
(iii) Compute 23.6:
23.6 = 2³ × 20.6 = 8 × 1.5157 = 12.126
Pk|Hk|² = 12.126 − 1 = 11.126 (≈ 11.13)
The received SNR on all four subcarriers must equal 11.126, so Pk = 11.126/|Hk|²: the worse the channel, the more power it needs.四个子载波的接收 SNR 都要等于 11.126，所以 Pk = 11.126/|Hk|²：信道越差，要的功率越多。
7
(iii) Find each Pk: |Hk|² = 1, 0.04, 1, 1.96:
P₁ = 11.126/1 = 11.13
P₂ = 11.126/0.04 = 278.1
P₃ = 11.126/1 = 11.13
P₄ = 11.126/1.96 = 5.68
(P₂ uses the unrounded 11.126; rounding to 11.13 first and then dividing gives 278.25 — only a rounding difference, both are accepted.)（P₂ 用没四舍五入的 11.126 算；如果先写成 11.13 再除，得 278.25，只是舍入差别，两个都算对。）
8
(iii) Sum + self-check:
Ptotal = 11.126 + 278.14 + 11.126 + 5.676
 ≈ 306.1 (power units)
Self-check: substitute P₄ back: ¼ log₂(1 + 5.68 × 1.96) = ¼ log₂ 12.13 = ¼ × 3.6 = 0.9 ✓. The one poor subcarrier (|H₂| = 0.2) alone takes 278.1/306.1 ≈ 91% of the power. This shows exactly why you use water-filling instead of forcing every subcarrier to have the same capacity.自检：P₄ 代回，¼ log₂(1 + 5.68 × 1.96) = ¼ log₂ 12.13 = ¼ × 3.6 = 0.9 ✓。差的子载波（|H₂| = 0.2）一个就吃掉 278.1/306.1 ≈ 91% 的功率。这正好说明为什么要用注水法，而不是强求每个子载波容量相同。
(i) 10 Mbit/s; 2.5 Mbit/s per subcarrier; (iii) total power ≈ 306(i) 10 Mbit/s；每子载波 2.5 Mbit/s (iii) 总功率 ≈ 306
◆ Key points
What it tests
OFDM rate split, cyclic-prefix expression, power allocation for equal capacity (Ch. 7 p.8, p.17, p.21, p.24).OFDM 速率划分、循环前缀的表达式、等容量功率分配（第 7 章 p.8、p.17、p.21、p.24）。
Knowledge used
log₂M bits per symbol; with a CP the expression is unchanged and the interval becomes nT − Tg ≤ t < (n+1)T; per subcarrier Ck = (1/N)log₂(1 + Pk|Hk|²).每符号 log₂M bit；CP 表达式不变、区间改为 nT − Tg ≤ t < (n+1)T；每个子载波 Ck = (1/N)log₂(1 + Pk|Hk|²)。
Method
Total rate = symbol rate × bits/symbol, then divide by the number of subcarriers; Pk = (2NCk − 1)/|Hk|².总速率 = 符号率 × bit/符号，再除以子载波数；Pk = (2NCk − 1)/|Hk|²。
Common mistakes
Multiply back by N = 4 before taking the power of 2 (23.6); |H₂| = 0.2 must be squared to 0.04; the CP changes only the time interval, not the formula.先乘回 N = 4 再取 2 的幂（23.6）；|H₂| = 0.2 要平方成 0.04；CP 只改时间区间，不改式子。
Conclusion
The worst subcarrier alone takes 90% of the power, which is why water-filling is used in practice (Practice 7 Q1(d)).最差的子载波一个就吃掉 90% 的功率，所以实际用注水（Practice 7 第 1(d) 题）。
Concept + Step by step: OFDM rate split, cyclic prefix and equal-capacity power

ConceptHow the OFDM rate is split and how to write the cyclic prefix

  • Bits per symbol: M-level modulation carries log₂M bit per symbol. System bit rate = symbol rate × log₂M.每符号比特数：M 电平调制每个符号带 log₂M bit。系统比特率 = 符号率 × log₂M。
  • Splitting over N subcarriers (Ch. 7 of the notes, p.8): one high-rate serial stream is split into N parallel low-rate streams. Each subcarrier's symbol rate is Rs/N, and the symbol duration becomes N times longer. The total rate is unchanged, but each symbol is longer, so the relative effect of ISI is smaller.分到 N 个子载波（讲义第 7 章 p.8）：原来一个高速串行流拆成 N 路并行的低速流，每个子载波的符号率是 Rs/N，符号时长变成 N 倍。总速率不变，但每个符号变长了，ISI 的相对影响变小。
  • Cyclic prefix (CP, p.17–21): a guard interval of length Tg is added in front of each OFDM block, and it holds a copy of the block's tail. Because ej2πkt/T is periodic with period T, you just extend the time range of the original expression back by Tg; the extra piece at the front is then automatically a copy of the tail. The receiver discards this piece.循环前缀（cyclic prefix, CP，p.17–21）：每个 OFDM 块前面加长度 Tg 的保护间隔，里面放的是块尾部的复制。因为 ej2πkt/T 以 T 为周期，只要把原表达式的时间范围往前延伸 Tg，前面多出来的那段自然就是尾巴的复制。接收端丢掉这一段。
  • OFDM subcarrier capacity (p.24): the N subcarriers are N parallel Gaussian channels, each using 1/N of the bandwidth, so the capacity per hertz is Ck = (1/N) log₂(1 + Pk|Hk|²) (here N = 4, so the factor is ¼).OFDM 子载波容量（p.24）：N 个子载波是 N 条并行的高斯信道，每条占 1/N 的带宽，所以每赫兹容量 Ck = (1/N) log₂(1 + Pk|Hk|²)（本题 N = 4，所以是 ¼）。

Step by step(i) Rates

log₂4 = 2 bit per symbol; system bit rate = 5×10⁶ × 2 = 10 Mbit/s每符号 log₂4 = 2 bit；系统比特率 = 5×10⁶ × 2 = 10 Mbit/s
Per subcarrier: symbol rate 5/4 = 1.25 Msymbol/s, bit rate 10/4 = 2.5 Mbit/s每个子载波：符号率 5/4 = 1.25 Msymbol/s，比特率 10/4 = 2.5 Mbit/s

Corresponding durations: original symbol Ts = 1/(5×10⁶) = 0.2 µs; OFDM symbol T = 4Ts = 0.8 µs.对应的时长：原符号 Ts = 1/(5×10⁶) = 0.2 µs，OFDM 符号 T = 4Ts = 0.8 µs。

Step by step(ii) Adding the cyclic prefix

x(t) = (1/√T) Σk=0N−1 sk(t) ej2π(k/T)t, nT − Tg ≤ t < (n + 1)T

Why only the interval changes: the expression itself stays the same; only the start of each block is moved Tg earlier. By periodicity, x(t) on [nT − Tg, nT) equals x(t) on [(n+1)T − Tg, (n+1)T), i.e. a copy of the tail. The receiver keeps only nT ≤ t < (n + 1)T. (You can also write it with a block period of T + Tg; the meaning is the same.)为什么只改区间：表达式本身不变，只把每个块的开始时间提前 Tg。由于周期性，x(t) 在 [nT − Tg, nT) 这段等于 [(n+1)T − Tg, (n+1)T) 那段，也就是尾巴的复制。接收端只取 nT ≤ t < (n + 1)T。（也可以按块周期 T + Tg 计时来写，意思相同。）

Step by step(iii) Power needed for equal capacity

  1. Each subcarrier needs ¼ log₂(1 + Pk|Hk|²) = 0.9. First multiply by 4:每个子载波都要 ¼ log₂(1 + Pk|Hk|²) = 0.9，先乘 4：
    log₂(1 + Pk|Hk|²) = 3.6 → 1 + Pk|Hk|² = 23.6 = 12.126
    Calculator: 23.6 = 103.6 × 0.301 = 101.084 ≈ 12.13.
  2. Pk|Hk|² = 11.126 (≈ 11.13)
  3. |Hk|² is 1, 0.04, 1, 1.96 respectively:
    P₁ = 11.13; P₂ = 11.126/0.04 = 278.1; P₃ = 11.13; P₄ = 11.126/1.96 = 5.68
  4. Ptotal = 11.13 + 278.1 + 11.13 + 5.68 ≈ 306.1 (power units)

Observation: the worst subcarrier (|H₂| = 0.2) alone uses 278.1/306.1 ≈ 91% of the power. "Equal capacity on every subcarrier" means using power to compensate for the channel (channel inversion), which is very wasteful on deeply faded subcarriers. Water-filling does the opposite: it gives more power to the good subcarriers.观察：最差的子载波（|H₂| = 0.2）一个就用掉 278.1/306.1 ≈ 91% 的功率。"每个子载波容量一样"等于用功率去补偿信道（信道反转），在深衰落的子载波上非常浪费；注水法正好相反，把功率多给好的子载波。

PitfallsWatch out

  • Multiply back by 4 first, then raise 2 to that power: 23.6, not 20.9.先乘回 4 再取 2 的幂：23.6，不是 20.9。
  • Square |H₂| = 0.2 to get 0.04, and |H₄| = 1.4 to get 1.96.|H₂| = 0.2 要平方成 0.04，|H₄| = 1.4 平方成 1.96。
  • Using 11.126 gives P₂ = 278.1; rounding to 11.13 first and then dividing gives 278.25. This is only a rounding difference.P₂ 用 11.126 算得 278.1；先四舍五入成 11.13 再除得 278.25，只是舍入差别。
  • The CP changes only the time interval, not the expression; the interval starts at nT − Tg, not nT + Tg.CP 只改时间区间，不改表达式；区间写 nT − Tg，不是 nT + Tg。

ExamHow to write it in English

(i) A 4-level system carries log₂4 = 2 bits per symbol, so the system bit rate is 5 × 10⁶ × 2 = 10 Mbit/s. With N = 4 sub-carriers, each sub-carrier carries 5/4 = 1.25 Msymbol/s, i.e. 10/4 = 2.5 Mbit/s.

(ii) With a cyclic prefix of duration Tg, each block is extended by Tg at its start: x(t) = (1/√T) Σk=0N−1 sk(t)ej2π(k/T)t, nT − Tg ≤ t < (n + 1)T. Because ej2πkt/T is periodic with period T, the extra segment is a copy of the last Tg of the block (a cyclic prefix); the receiver discards it and processes only nT ≤ t < (n + 1)T.

(iii) For each sub-carrier, ¼ log₂(1 + Pk|Hk|²) = 0.9, so 1 + Pk|Hk|² = 23.6 = 12.126 and Pk|Hk|² = 11.126. Hence P₁ = 11.126/1 = 11.13, P₂ = 11.126/0.04 = 278.1, P₃ = 11.13 and P₄ = 11.126/1.96 = 5.68. The total power needed is about 306.1 (power units). The weak sub-carrier |H₂| = 0.2 alone needs about 91% of the total power, showing that equal-capacity allocation is inefficient compared with water-filling.

In one line: 10 Mbit/s split 4 ways gives 2.5 Mbit/s each; the CP only changes the interval to nT − Tg ≤ t < (n+1)T; equal capacity needs Pk|Hk|² = 23.6 − 1 = 11.126, total power ≈ 306.1, and the bad subcarrier takes 91%.一句话：10 Mbit/s 分 4 份每份 2.5 Mbit/s；CP 只把区间改成 nT − Tg ≤ t < (n+1)T；等容量要 Pk|Hk|² = 23.6 − 1 = 11.126，总功率 ≈ 306.1，差子载波吃掉 91%。
