Past final exam
2025-26 S1Q2(b)12 marks
Topics: minimum number of subcarriers for flat fading · effective rate · correlator output = sn考点：平坦衰落所需最少子载波 · 有效速率 · 相关器输出 = sn
Original question (verbatim)

(b) An 4-QAM OFDM system transmits data with an available bandwidth of 500 kHz. The coherence bandwidth and maximum delay spread of the channel have been measured to be 30 kHz and 10 microseconds (μs) respectively. Note: For this question, you may assume T = 1/B, where T is signal duration and B is the corresponding bandwidth.

(i) Determine the minimum number of carriers the OFDM system should use for its signal to experience flat fading.

(ii) If the OFDM system uses N = 50 carriers, determine the effective transmission bit rate of this system.

(iii) The received OFDM signal can be expressed as, r(t) = x(t) + w(t) = (1/√TOFDM) Σk=0N−1 sk(t)ej2π(k/TOFDM)t + w(t) where sk(t) is the transmitted signal with the kth carrier and w(t) is an Additive White Gaussian Noise. At the receiver, r(t) is passed through a set of correlators. Show that at the output of the nth correlator, the signal x(t) is simplified to sn(t).

(12 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
(i) Flat-fading condition: a subchannel is flat-fading only if the subcarrier bandwidth is smaller than the coherence bandwidth (Ch. 7 of the notes, p.5: 1/T < BC). The subcarrier bandwidth is Δf = B/N (p.8):(i) 平坦衰落条件：每个子载波的带宽要小于相干带宽，子信道才是平坦衰落（讲义第 7 章 p.5：1/T < BC）。子载波带宽 Δf = B/N（p.8）：
Δf = B/N < BC → N > B/BC = 500 kHz / 30 kHz = 16.67
N must be an integer, so round up: Nmin = 17. Check: 500/17 = 29.4 kHz < 30 kHz ✓; with N = 16, 500/16 = 31.25 kHz > 30 kHz ✗.N 是整数，向上取 Nmin = 17。验算：500/17 = 29.4 kHz < 30 kHz ✓；N = 16 时 500/16 = 31.25 kHz > 30 kHz ✗。
2
(ii) Subcarrier bandwidth and symbol duration: N = 50 (50 > 17, so the flat-fading condition holds):(ii) 子载波带宽与符号时长：N = 50（50 > 17，满足平坦衰落）：
Δf = 500 kHz / 50 = 10 kHz
T = 1/Δf = 1/(10 × 10³ Hz) = 100 µs
Another way: TS = 1/B = 1/500 kHz = 2 µs, T = NTS = 50 × 2 µs = 100 µs ✓.
3
(ii) Adding the guard interval: to remove the inter-block interference caused by the delay spread, the guard interval must satisfy TG ≥ TD = 10 µs (Ch. 7 p.5, p.17); take TG = 10 µs. Total duration of one OFDM block (p.18):(ii) 加保护间隔：为消除时延扩展造成的块间干扰，保护间隔要满足 TG ≥ TD = 10 µs（第 7 章 p.5、p.17），取 TG = 10 µs。一个 OFDM 块的总时长（p.18）：
NTS + TG = 100 µs + 10 µs = 110 µs
4
(ii) Bits per block and effective rate: 4-QAM carries log₂4 = 2 bit per symbol, and in each block each of the 50 subcarriers sends one symbol:(ii) 每块比特数与有效速率：4-QAM 每个符号 log₂4 = 2 bit，每块 50 个子载波各送一个符号：
Per block: 50 × 2 = 100 bit
Reff = 100 bit / 110 µs = 9.09 × 10⁵ bit/s ≈ 909 kbit/s
Without the guard interval the rate is 100 bit / 100 µs = 1 Mbit/s; the guard interval takes 10/110 = 9.1% of the time, so the effective rate = 1 Mbit/s × 100/110 ≈ 909 kbit/s ✓.不计保护间隔时是 100 bit / 100 µs = 1 Mbit/s；保护间隔占掉 10/110 = 9.1% 的时间，所以有效速率 = 1 Mbit/s × 100/110 ≈ 909 kbit/s ✓。
5
(iii) What the correlator does: the n-th correlator multiplies r(t) by (1/√T)e−j2πnt/T and integrates over one OFDM symbol period [0, T] (T = TOFDM, Ch. 7 p.12–13). Look at the signal part x(t) only; sk is constant within one symbol period, so it can be taken outside the integral:(iii) 相关器做什么：第 n 个相关器把 r(t) 乘以 (1/√T)e−j2πnt/T，在一个 OFDM 符号期 [0, T] 内积分（T = TOFDM，第 7 章 p.12–13）。只看信号部分 x(t)；sk 在一个符号期内是常数，可以提到积分号外：
(1/√T)∫₀T x(t)e−j2πnt/Tdt
= (1/√T)(1/√T) Σk sk ∫₀T ej2πkt/Te−j2πnt/Tdt
= (1/T) Σk sk ∫₀T ej2π(k−n)t/Tdt
6
(iii) Evaluate the integral using orthogonality: for k = n the integrand is e⁰ = 1, so the integral = T. For k ≠ n:(iii) 用正交性算积分：k = n 时被积函数是 e⁰ = 1，积分 = T。k ≠ n 时：
∫₀T ej2π(k−n)t/Tdt = [T/(j2π(k−n))] (ej2π(k−n) − 1) = 0
Because k − n is a non-zero integer, ej2π(k−n) = 1 (a whole number of cycles within T). Together: ∫₀T ej2π(k−n)t/Tdt = T·δ[k − n], i.e. the subcarriers are orthogonal (Ch. 7 p.7).因为 k − n 是非零整数，ej2π(k−n) = 1（在 T 内走完整数个周期）。合起来就是 ∫₀T ej2π(k−n)t/Tdt = T·δ[k − n]，即子载波正交（第 7 章 p.7）。
7
(iii) Result: only the k = n term survives in the sum:(iii) 结果：求和里只剩 k = n 一项：
Output = (1/T) · sn · T = sn(t)
The contributions of the other N − 1 subcarriers are all 0, so there is no inter-carrier interference (ICI); the noise term integrates separately to wn, so rn = sn + wn (p.13).其他 N − 1 个子载波的贡献全部为 0，没有子载波间干扰（ICI）；噪声项单独积分成 wn，所以 rn = sn + wn（p.13）。
(i) N ≥ 17 (ii) ≈ 909 kbit/s (1 Mbit/s ignoring the guard interval) (iii) subcarriers orthogonal → output sn(i) N ≥ 17 (ii) ≈ 909 kbit/s（不计保护间隔 1 Mbit/s） (iii) 子载波正交 → 输出 sn
◆ Key points
What it tests
Minimum number of subcarriers for flat fading, effective rate, proof that the correlator output = sn (Ch. 7 p.5–13).平坦衰落所需最少子载波、有效速率、相关器输出 = sn 的证明（第 7 章 p.5–13）。
Knowledge used
N > B/BC; T = 1/Δf; effective rate = N log₂M / (T + TG); orthogonality integral of the subcarriers.N > B/BC；T = 1/Δf；有效速率 = N log₂M / (T + TG)；子载波正交积分。
Method
(i) 500/30 = 16.7 → 17; (ii) Δf = 10 kHz → T = 100 µs, add TG = 10 µs; (iii) multiply by e−j2πnt/T and integrate, treating k = n and k ≠ n separately.(i) 500/30 = 16.7 → 17；(ii) Δf = 10 kHz → T = 100 µs，加 TG = 10 µs；(iii) 乘 e−j2πnt/T 积分，分 k = n、k ≠ n 两种情况。
Common mistakes
Round N up; "effective" means you must subtract the guard interval; the proof must cover both cases.N 向上取整；"effective"要扣掉保护间隔；证明要把两种情况都写出来。
Links
Learning page Section 7.2, derivation box "Why the subcarriers are orthogonal".讲解页 7.2 节"子载波为什么正交"推导框。
Concept + Step by step: OFDM number of subcarriers, rate and orthogonality

ConceptThe idea behind OFDM

In single-carrier high-rate transmission, the signal bandwidth B exceeds the coherence bandwidth Bc; this is frequency-selective fading and causes ISI. OFDM (orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing) cuts the available bandwidth B into N narrow subcarriers, each of bandwidth Δf = B/N (Ch. 7 p.5–8). As long as Δf < Bc, every subcarrier sees flat fading.单载波高速传输时，信号带宽 B 大于相干带宽 Bc，就是频率选择性衰落，会产生 ISI。OFDM（正交频分复用）的办法是：把可用带宽 B 切成 N 个窄的子载波，每个子载波带宽 Δf = B/N（第 7 章 p.5–8）。只要 Δf < Bc，每个子载波看到的都是平坦衰落。

The price is a slower symbol on each subcarrier: subcarrier symbol duration T = 1/Δf = NTS (TS = 1/B is the symbol duration without OFDM). With longer symbols, the delay spread TD is only a small fraction of a symbol; adding a guard interval TG ≥ TD in front of each OFDM block (p.17–18) removes the ISI between blocks completely. The guard interval carries no new data, so the effective rate must be computed with the block length T + TG.代价是每个子载波上的符号变慢：子载波符号时长 T = 1/Δf = NTS（TS = 1/B 是不用 OFDM 时的符号时长）。符号变长后，时延扩展 TD 只占它的一小部分；再在每个 OFDM 块前面加保护间隔 TG ≥ TD（p.17–18），块与块之间的 ISI 就完全消掉。保护间隔不传新数据，所以有效速率要用块长 T + TG 来算。

Why the subcarriers do not interfere: the subcarrier spacing is exactly 1/T, so over one symbol period T the integral of the product of any two different subcarriers is 0 (orthogonality, p.7, p.13). So the n-th correlator at the receiver "sees" only the n-th subcarrier. The lecturer said the maths of OFDM is relatively simple.子载波为什么不互相干扰：子载波频率间隔正好是 1/T，在一个符号期 T 内，任意两个不同子载波的乘积积分为 0（正交，p.7、p.13）。所以接收端用第 n 个相关器只能"看到"第 n 个子载波。老师说 OFDM 的数学相对简单。

Step by step(i) Minimum number of subcarriers

Need 500/N < 30 kHz → N > 500/30 = 16.7 → Nmin = 17

Check: N = 17 gives Δf = 500/17 = 29.4 kHz < 30 kHz, which meets the requirement; N = 16 gives 31.25 kHz > 30 kHz, which does not.检查：N = 17 时 Δf = 500/17 = 29.4 kHz < 30 kHz，满足；N = 16 时 31.25 kHz > 30 kHz，不满足。

Step by step(ii) Effective rate for N = 50

  1. Subcarrier bandwidth: Δf = 500/50 = 10 kHz (< 30 kHz, flat).子载波带宽：Δf = 500/50 = 10 kHz（< 30 kHz，平坦）。
  2. Subcarrier symbol duration (the question says T = 1/B): T = 1/10 kHz = 100 µs, much larger than TD = 10 µs.子载波符号时长（题目说 T = 1/B）：T = 1/10 kHz = 100 µs，远大于 TD = 10 µs。
  3. To remove the ISI caused by the delay spread, add a guard interval TG = TD = 10 µs; block length = 110 µs.为消除时延扩展的 ISI，加保护间隔 TG = TD = 10 µs，块长 = 110 µs。
  4. Each block carries 50 4-QAM symbols of log₂4 = 2 bit each, 100 bit in total:每个块传 50 个 4-QAM 符号，每个符号 log₂4 = 2 bit，共 100 bit：
    Reff = 100 bit / 110 µs ≈ 909 kbit/s

Compare: ignoring the guard interval gives 100 bit / 100 µs = 1 Mbit/s; the effective rate is 100/110 = 90.9% of that. (Beyond the slides: there is also a power loss of 10 log₁₀(110/100) ≈ 0.41 dB, formula on p.18; not asked here.)对比：不计保护间隔是 100 bit / 100 µs = 1 Mbit/s；有效速率是它的 100/110 = 90.9%。（课外补充：同时还有 10 log₁₀(110/100) ≈ 0.41 dB 的功率损失，公式在 p.18，本题没问。）

Step by step(iii) Correlator output = sn

  1. n-th correlator: multiply r(t) by (1/√T)e−j2πnt/T and integrate over one symbol period [0, T] (T = TOFDM).第 n 个相关器：把 r(t) 乘以 (1/√T)e−j2πnt/T，在一个符号期 [0, T] 内积分（T = TOFDM）。
  2. Substitute x(t), take the constant (1/√T)·(1/√T) = 1/T outside, and swap the sum and the integral; sk is constant over one symbol period, so take it outside too:代入 x(t)，常数 (1/√T)·(1/√T) = 1/T 提出来，求和与积分交换顺序，sk 在一个符号期内是常数，也提出来：
    (1/T) Σk=0N−1 sk ∫₀T ej2π(k−n)t/T dt
  3. k = n: integrand = e⁰ = 1, integral = T.k = n：被积函数 = e⁰ = 1，积分 = T。
  4. k ≠ n: over [0, T] it turns exactly (k − n) full cycles, integral = T(ej2π(k−n) − 1)/(j2π(k − n)) = 0.k ≠ n：在 [0, T] 内正好转了 (k − n) 整圈，积分 = T(ej2π(k−n) − 1)/(j2π(k − n)) = 0。
  5. So only the k = n term remains in the sum: (1/T)·sn·T = sn(t). The noise term is handled separately (after correlation it is still zero-mean Gaussian).所以求和里只剩 k = n 一项：(1/T)·sn·T = sn(t)。噪声项另算（相关后仍是零均值高斯）。

PitfallsCommon ways to lose marks

  • In (i), not rounding N to an integer, or rounding down to 16.(i) N 不取整或向下取整成 16。
  • In (ii), forgetting the guard interval and answering 1 Mbit/s; "effective" means the guard interval must be taken out.(ii) 忘了保护间隔，答 1 Mbit/s；"effective"就是要扣掉保护间隔。
  • In (ii), a 4-QAM symbol is 2 bit, not 4 bit.(ii) 4-QAM 每个符号是 2 bit，不是 4 bit。
  • In (iii), writing only the k = n case without showing that the integral is 0 for k ≠ n (orthogonality): the proof is incomplete.(iii) 只写 k = n 的情况，没写 k ≠ n 积分为 0（正交性），证明不完整。

ExamHow to write it in English

(i) For flat fading, each sub-carrier bandwidth must be smaller than the coherence bandwidth: 500/N < 30 kHz, so N > 16.7. The minimum number of carriers is N = 17.

(ii) With N = 50, the sub-carrier bandwidth is Δf = 500/50 = 10 kHz, so the symbol duration on each sub-carrier is T = 1/Δf = 100 µs. A guard interval TG ≥ TD = 10 µs is added to remove ISI, so each OFDM block lasts 110 µs. Each block carries 50 × log₂4 = 100 bits. The effective bit rate is 100/(110 µs) ≈ 909 kbit/s (1 Mbit/s if the guard interval is ignored).

(iii) The output of the n-th correlator is (1/√T)∫₀T x(t)e−j2πnt/Tdt = (1/T)Σk sk∫₀T ej2π(k−n)t/Tdt. For k = n the integral equals T; for k ≠ n it is the integral of a complex exponential over an integer number of periods, which is zero (orthogonal sub-carriers). Hence the output is (1/T)·sn·T = sn(t): only the n-th symbol remains and the other sub-carriers cause no interference.

In one line: subcarrier bandwidth below the coherence bandwidth → N ≥ 17; with N = 50 the block is 100 + 10 µs and carries 100 bit, effective rate about 909 kbit/s; the subcarriers are orthogonal, so the correlator keeps only sn.一句话：子载波带宽小于相干带宽 → N ≥ 17；N = 50 时块长 100 + 10 µs，传 100 bit，有效速率约 909 kbit/s；子载波正交，相关器只留下 sn。

Past final exam
2025-26 S2Q2(b)13 marks
Topics: channel gains of the 4 subcarriers · OFDM as an IDFT · cyclic prefix and power loss考点：4 子载波的信道增益 · OFDM 即 IDFT · 循环前缀与功率损失
Original question (verbatim)

(b) An OFDM system uses 4 sub-carriers to transmit a baseband signal that has a symbol duration of 2 μs. The fading channel has a Z-transform of 1 + 0.3Z−1. The baseband signal can be organized into N signals {sk(t)} to form the transmitted OFDM signal, x(t) = (1/√T) Σk=0N−1 sk(t)ej2π(k/T)t, nT ≤ t ≤ (n + 1)T

(i) Determine the channel gain coefficients of the OFDM system.

(ii) Explain why the transformation of the signal, {sk(t)}, into the OFDM signal, x(t), can be viewed as an inverse Discrete Fourier transform process.

(iii) If the OFDM system uses a cyclic prefix of 20 μs, determine the OFDM symbol duration and the power loss due to the addition of the cyclic prefix.

(13 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
(i) Write down the formula: the channel Z-transform 1 + 0.3Z−1 → impulse response h₀ = 1, h₁ = 0.3 (L = 2). The gain of the k-th subcarrier is the N-point DFT of the channel impulse response (notes Ch7 p.15, k = 1…N, HN = H₀):(i) 写出公式：信道 Z 变换 1 + 0.3Z−1 → 冲激响应 h₀ = 1、h₁ = 0.3（L = 2）。第 k 个子载波的增益就是信道冲激响应的 N 点 DFT（讲义 Ch7 p.15，k = 1…N，HN = H₀）：
Hk = Σi=0L−1 hie−j2πik/N
= 1 + 0.3e−j2πk/4

For N = 4, e−j2πk/4 = e−jπk/2 takes only 4 values: k = 1, 2, 3, 4 → −j, −1, +j, 1.
2
(i) Substitute:
H₁ = 1 + 0.3(−j) = 1 − 0.3j, |H₁| = 1.044
H₂ = 1 + 0.3(−1) = 0.7
H₃ = 1 + 0.3(+j) = 1 + 0.3j, |H₃| = 1.044
H₄ = 1 + 0.3(1) = 1.3 (= H₀)

Each subcarrier sees only a single complex gain: the frequency-selective channel is split into 4 flat subchannels, and H₂ is the weakest.
Self-check (Parseval): (1/N)Σ|Hk|² = (1.09 + 0.49 + 1.09 + 1.69)/4 = 4.36/4 = 1.09 = h₀² + h₁² = 1 + 0.09 ✓
每个子载波只看到一个复数增益：频率选择性信道被拆成 4 个平坦子信道，H₂ 最弱。
自检（Parseval）：(1/N)Σ|Hk|² = (1.09 + 0.49 + 1.09 + 1.69)/4 = 4.36/4 = 1.09 = h₀² + h₁² = 1 + 0.09 ✓
3
(ii) Sample within one block: block n occupies nT ≤ t < (n+1)T; take N equally spaced samples t = nT + iT/N, i = 0, 1, …, N−1 (notes Ch7 p.19). Substitute into the k-th subcarrier:(ii) 在一个块内采样：块 n 占 nT ≤ t < (n+1)T，取 N 个等间隔采样 t = nT + iT/N，i = 0, 1, …, N−1（讲义 Ch7 p.19）。代入第 k 个子载波：
ej2π(k/T)(nT + iT/N) = ej2πkn · ej2πki/N
= ej2πki/N

(k and n are both integers, so ej2πkn = 1.)
4
(ii) Compare with the IDFT: the samples are(ii) 和 IDFT 对比：采样值为
xi = (1/√T) Σk=0N−1 sk ej2πki/N, i = 0…N−1

The N-point IDFT is defined as xi = (1/N)Σk Xkej2πki/N: the kernel ej2πki/N is identical, and only a constant scale factor differs. So the N samples of x(t) are the IDFT of {sk}: sk is the symbol on the k-th subcarrier (frequency domain), and the IDFT turns N frequency-domain symbols into N time-domain samples. Benefit: the transmitter generates the OFDM signal with one IFFT and the receiver demodulates with an FFT, so N separate oscillators and filters are not needed.
N 点 IDFT 的定义是 xi = (1/N)Σk Xkej2πki/N：核 ej2πki/N 完全相同，只差一个常数比例。所以 x(t) 的 N 个采样就是 {sk} 的 IDFT：sk 是第 k 个子载波（频域）上的符号，IDFT 把 N 个频域符号变成 N 个时域采样。好处：发射端用一次 IFFT 生成 OFDM 信号，接收端用 FFT 解调，不需要 N 个独立的振荡器和滤波器。
5
(iii) OFDM symbol duration: the N = 4 baseband symbols (each Ts = 2 µs) go through serial-to-parallel conversion and are sent in parallel on the 4 subcarriers, so the useful part (the data block) lasts NTs; a cyclic prefix TG is added in front of it (notes Ch7 p.18):(iii) OFDM 符号时长：N = 4 个基带符号（各 Ts = 2 µs）串并转换后在 4 个子载波上并行传，所以有用部分（数据块）长 NTs；前面再加循环前缀（cyclic prefix）TG（讲义 Ch7 p.18）：
NTs = 4 × 2 µs = 8 µs
TOFDM = NTs + TG = 8 + 20 = 28 µs
6
(iii) Power loss: the CP is copied data that the receiver simply discards, but it still costs energy to transmit (p.18):(iii) 功率损失：CP 是复制的数据，接收端直接丢掉，但发射时照样消耗能量（p.18）：
Loss = 10 log₁₀[(NTs + TG)/NTs]
= 10 log₁₀(28/8) = 10 log₁₀3.5
= 10 × 0.544 = 5.44 dB

Self-check: the useful energy is 8/28 = 28.6% of the total, and 10 log₁₀0.286 = −5.44 dB ✓. The CP is even longer than the data part, so the loss is large; a practical design increases N so that NTs ≫ TG.
自检：有用能量占 8/28 = 28.6%，10 log₁₀0.286 = −5.44 dB ✓。CP 比数据部分还长，所以损失很大；实际设计会增大 N，让 NTs ≫ TG。
(i) {1−0.3j, 0.7, 1+0.3j, 1.3} (iii) 28 µs, ≈ 5.44 dB
◆ Key points
What it tests
Channel gains of the 4 subcarriers, OFDM as an IDFT, cyclic prefix and power loss (Ch. 7 p.15, p.17–21).4 个子载波的信道增益、OFDM 即 IDFT、循环前缀与功率损失（第 7 章 p.15、p.17–21）。
Knowledge used
Hk = Σhie−j2πik/N; sampling at t = iT/N → IDFT; loss = 10 log₁₀((NTs + TG)/NTs).
Method
(i) For N = 4 the exponentials are simply −j, −1, j, 1; (ii) substitute the sampling instants and compare with the IDFT definition; (iii) block length 4 × 2 = 8 µs, plus 20 µs.(i) N = 4 速算 −j、−1、j、1；(ii) 代入采样时刻，和 IDFT 定义对比；(iii) 块长 4 × 2 = 8 µs，加 20 µs。
Common mistakes
The useful part is NTs = 8 µs, not 2 µs; the CP is longer than the data, so the loss is as high as 5.44 dB.有用部分是 NTs = 8 µs，不是 2 µs；CP 比数据还长，所以损失高达 5.44 dB。
Variations
Increase N to 64: the useful part is 128 µs and the loss is only 10 log(148/128) = 0.63 dB. The larger N, the smaller the CP overhead.N 增大到 64：有用部分 128 µs，损失只有 10 log(148/128) = 0.63 dB。N 越大，CP 开销越小。
Concept + Step by step: subcarrier gains, IDFT and cyclic prefix

ConceptSubcarrier channel gains

OFDM splits a frequency-selective channel into N flat subchannels; subcarrier k sees one complex gain Hk (Ch. 7 p.15):OFDM 把频率选择性信道切成 N 个平坦的子信道，第 k 个子载波看到的是一个复数增益 Hk（第 7 章 p.15）：

Hk = Σi=0L−1 hi e−j2πik/N, k = 1, …, N (note HN = H0)

It is just the N-point DFT of the channel taps, which is also H(Z) evaluated at Z = ej2πk/N. With a cyclic prefix, the received signal on each subcarrier is rk = Hksk + wk (p.17, p.22), so the receiver equalises by simply dividing each subcarrier by one Hk.它就是信道抽头的 N 点 DFT，也等于把 Z = ej2πk/N 代进 H(Z)。加了循环前缀后，每个子载波的接收信号就是 rk = Hksk + wk（p.17、p.22），接收端只要每个子载波除以一个 Hk 就完成了均衡。

ConceptWhy OFDM modulation is an IDFT

p.19: sampling x(t) of one OFDM block at N equally spaced instants gives N samples that are exactly the IDFT of {sk}; p.20: the outputs of the receiver's correlators are exactly the DFT. So real systems can use IFFT/FFT chips instead of N oscillators.p.19：把一个 OFDM 块的 x(t) 在 N 个等间隔时刻采样，得到的 N 个样本正好是 {sk} 的 IDFT；p.20：接收端相关器的输出正好是 DFT。所以实际系统用 IFFT/FFT 芯片就能实现，不需要 N 个振荡器。

ConceptCyclic prefix (CP) and power loss

With a guard interval TG ≥ the maximum delay spread TD, the tail of the previous block falls inside the guard interval and is discarded by the receiver, so there is no ISI between blocks (p.17–18). The guard interval carries a copy of the last G samples of the block, called the cyclic prefix (p.21–22); this turns the channel's linear convolution into a circular convolution, so that each subcarrier is simply Hksk. The cost: the CP uses transmit power but carries no new information, giving a power loss (p.18) = 10 log₁₀[(NTS + TG)/(NTS)].保护间隔 TG ≥ 最大时延扩展 TD，前一个块的拖尾落在保护间隔里，被接收端丢掉，所以块间没有 ISI（p.17–18）。保护间隔里放的是块末尾 G 个样本的复制，叫循环前缀（p.21–22），这样信道的线性卷积变成循环卷积，每个子载波才是简单的 Hksk。代价是 CP 也要花发射功率，却不带新信息，功率损失（p.18）= 10 log₁₀[(NTS + TG)/(NTS)]。

Step by step(i) Gains of the 4 subcarriers

h0 = 1, h1 = 0.3, N = 4, Hk = 1 + 0.3e−j2πk/4. First compute e−jπk/2: k = 1 → −j, k = 2 → −1, k = 3 → j, k = 4 → 1.

H₁ = 1 + 0.3(−j) = 1 − 0.3j (|H₁| = 1.044)
H₂ = 1 + 0.3(−1) = 0.7
H₃ = 1 + 0.3(j) = 1 + 0.3j
H₄ = 1 + 0.3(1) = 1.3 (= H₀)

Check: h is real, so H₃ is the conjugate of H₁, which holds. The gains range from 0.7 to 1.3, showing that the original channel is frequency-selective, yet within each subcarrier the gain is just a constant.检查：h 是实数，所以 H₃ = H₁ 的共轭，成立。增益从 0.7 到 1.3 不等，说明原信道是频率选择性的，但每个子载波内部只是一个常数。

Step by step(ii) Why it is an IDFT

  1. Sample within one block at t = iT/N (i = 0, …, N−1) and substitute into x(t):在一个块内按 t = iT/N（i = 0, …, N−1）采样，代入 x(t)：
    xi = x(iT/N) = (1/√T) Σk=0N−1 sk ej2πki/N
  2. The N-point IDFT is defined as xi = (1/N)Σk Xk ej2πki/N. The two expressions differ only by a constant scale factor and have exactly the same form.N 点 IDFT 的定义是 xi = (1/N)Σk Xk ej2πki/N。两式只差一个常数比例，形式完全相同。
  3. So turning the N frequency-domain symbols {sk} into N time-domain samples is one IDFT; the transmitter implements it with an IFFT, and the receiver demodulates with an FFT.所以把频域的 N 个符号 {sk} 变成时域的 N 个样本，就是做一次 IDFT；发射端用 IFFT 实现，接收端用 FFT 解调。

Step by step(iii) Symbol duration and power loss

  1. 4 baseband symbols are sent in parallel, so the symbol duration (useful part) on each subcarrier is T = NTS = 4 × 2 = 8 µs.4 个基带符号并行，每个子载波上的符号时长（有用部分）T = NTS = 4 × 2 = 8 µs。
  2. Add the CP:
    TOFDM = 8 + 20 = 28 µs
  3. Power loss (calculator: 28/8 = 3.5, log₁₀3.5 = 0.544):功率损失（计算器：28/8 = 3.5，log₁₀3.5 = 0.544）：
    10 log₁₀(28/8) = 10 log₁₀3.5 ≈ 5.44 dB

20/28 ≈ 71% of the transmit energy goes into the CP, which is very wasteful. Real designs increase N so that NTS is much larger than the CP. (Further thought: the channel 1 + 0.3Z⁻¹ delays by only one baseband symbol, i.e. 2 µs, so a 2 µs CP would be enough; the question gives 20 µs to practise the formula, so just compute with the given value.)20/28 ≈ 71% 的发射能量花在 CP 上，非常浪费。实际设计会增大 N，让 NTS 远大于 CP。（补充思考：信道 1 + 0.3Z⁻¹ 只延迟一个基带符号，即 2 µs，CP 有 2 µs 就够；题目给 20 µs 是为了练公式，答题照题目算即可。）

PitfallsCommon ways to lose marks

  • (i) Getting the sign of e−j2πk/4 wrong, which swaps H₁ and H₃.(i) e−j2πk/4 的符号搞反，H₁ 和 H₃ 写反。
  • (iii) Using 2 µs (one baseband symbol) as the useful part instead of NTS = 8 µs, which gives the wrong answer 10 log₁₀11.(iii) 有用部分用 2 µs（一个基带符号）而不是 NTS = 8 µs，得出 10 log₁₀11 的错误答案。
  • (iii) Giving the power loss as 20/28 or 28/8 without converting to dB.(iii) 功率损失写成 20/28 或 28/8 而不换成 dB。

ExamHow to write it in English

(i) h0 = 1, h1 = 0.3, N = 4. The sub-channel gains are Hk = Σi hie−j2πik/N = 1 + 0.3e−jπk/2: H₁ = 1 − 0.3j, H₂ = 0.7, H₃ = 1 + 0.3j, H₄ = H₀ = 1.3.

(ii) Sampling the OFDM block at t = iT/N, i = 0, 1, …, N − 1, gives xi = (1/√T)Σk=0N−1 skej2πki/N. Apart from a constant scaling factor, this is exactly the N-point inverse DFT of {sk}: the N frequency-domain symbols are transformed into N time-domain samples. Hence the OFDM modulator can be implemented with an IFFT, and the receiver demodulates with an FFT.

(iii) The useful OFDM symbol duration is NTS = 4 × 2 µs = 8 µs. With a cyclic prefix of 20 µs, the OFDM symbol duration is 8 + 20 = 28 µs. Power loss due to the cyclic prefix = 10 log₁₀[(NTS + TG)/NTS] = 10 log₁₀(28/8) ≈ 5.44 dB.

In one line: Hk = 1 + 0.3e−jπk/2 gives {1−0.3j, 0.7, 1+0.3j, 1.3}; sampling at t = iT/N is an IDFT; block length 8 + 20 = 28 µs, power loss 10 log₁₀3.5 ≈ 5.44 dB.一句话：Hk = 1 + 0.3e−jπk/2 得 {1−0.3j, 0.7, 1+0.3j, 1.3}；按 t = iT/N 采样就是 IDFT；块长 8 + 20 = 28 µs，功率损失 10 log₁₀3.5 ≈ 5.44 dB。

About 2% error is allowed (deviations from Q-table lookup or rounding count as correct). Probabilities can be written as 0.0036 or 3.6e-3.允许约 2% 的误差（查 Q 表、取整造成的偏差都算对）。概率可以写成 0.0036 或 3.6e-3。

Part 2 homework (SW): questions, English answers, Chinese notes

Part A · Cellular networks (final Q3–Q4)

Ch. 1 · Three ways to "share the resource": FDMA / TDMA / CDMA

0 practice · 1 past-examNotes →
Past final exam
2023-24 S2Q3(b)5 marks
Topics: FDMA / TDMA / CDMA and example systems考点：FDMA / TDMA / CDMA 及系统举例
Original question (verbatim)

(b) Multiple access schemes are important features in mobile cellular systems as they allow many users to share the limited spectrum simultaneously. There are three basic multiple access schemes used in the 1G-3G mobile cellular systems. Briefly describe each of the multiple access schemes and give an example of an existing mobile cellular system for each scheme.

(5 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
FDMA (frequency division multiple access): the spectrum is cut into many narrowband channels of equal width, and each user has one frequency channel to itself for the whole call (notes Part A p.7). Users are separated by frequency with no overlap, so no time synchronisation is needed; but the channel is held for the whole call and cannot be given to anyone else even when idle. Example: 1G AMPS (30 kHz channels, p.15–16).FDMA（频分多址，frequency division multiple access）：把频谱切成许多等宽的窄带信道，每个用户在通话期间独占一个频率信道（讲义 Part A p.7）。用户靠频率区分、互不重叠，所以不需要时间同步；但信道整个通话期间都被占着，空闲时也不能给别人。例：1G 的 AMPS（30 kHz 信道，p.15–16）。
2
TDMA (time division multiple access): one carrier is divided in time into equal slots, assigned in turn to several users; each user transmits in bursts only in its own slot (p.7). Users are separated by time; transmission is not continuous, so frame synchronisation and guard times are needed. Examples: 2G GSM (200 kHz carrier, 8 slots per frame; in fact a combination of FDMA + TDMA, p.22–23) and IS-136.TDMA（时分多址）：一个载波按时间切成等长时隙，循环分给几个用户，每人只在自己的时隙里突发发送（p.7）。用户靠时间区分；发送不连续，所以需要帧同步和保护时间。例：2G 的 GSM（200 kHz 载波、每帧 8 个时隙，实际是 FDMA + TDMA 组合，p.22–23）、IS-136。
3
CDMA (code division multiple access): all users occupy the same wideband spectrum at the same time, each with a different spreading code (orthogonal or with low correlation). The receiver correlates with its own code to recover its own signal; the other users' signals look like noise (p.7). Users are separated by code; frequency and time are both shared. Examples: 2G IS-95; 3G WCDMA and cdma2000 (p.26, p.155).CDMA（码分多址）：所有用户同时占用同一段宽带频谱，每人分配一个不同的扩频码（正交或低相关），接收端用自己的码做相关运算解出自己的信号，其他用户的信号看起来像噪声（p.7）。用户靠码区分，频率和时间都共享。例：2G 的 IS-95，3G 的 WCDMA、cdma2000（p.26、p.155）。
4
In one line: FDMA divides frequency, TDMA divides time, CDMA divides code. 1G analogue systems use FDMA; 2G digital systems use TDMA (GSM) or CDMA (IS-95) (p.18); 3G is based on wideband CDMA.一句话对比：FDMA 切频率、TDMA 切时间、CDMA 切码。1G 模拟系统用 FDMA；2G 数字系统用 TDMA（GSM）或 CDMA（IS-95）（p.18）；3G 基于宽带 CDMA。
FDMA–AMPS; TDMA–GSM; CDMA–IS-95/WCDMA
◆ Key points
What it tests
The three multiple-access schemes and representative systems (Part A Ch. 1).三种多址方式及代表系统（Part A 第 1 章）。
Answer points
FDMA: divide by frequency, each user has its own narrowband channel, e.g. AMPS; TDMA: shared carrier, users take turns in time slots, e.g. GSM (200 kHz, 8 slots), IS-136; CDMA: same time, same frequency, users separated by spreading codes, e.g. IS-95, WCDMA, cdma2000.FDMA：按频率分，每人独占窄带信道，例 AMPS；TDMA：共用载波、按时隙轮流，例 GSM（200 kHz、8 时隙）、IS-136；CDMA：同时同频、靠扩频码区分，例 IS-95、WCDMA、cdma2000。
Memory aid
Three dimensions, "frequency, time, code", with one system for each."频、时、码"三个维度，各举一个系统。
Common mistakes
Strictly, GSM is a hybrid FDMA/TDMA system (several 200 kHz carriers, each split into 8 time slots); if you write TDMA, add a sentence on this.GSM 严格说是 FDMA/TDMA 混合（多个 200 kHz 载波，每个再分 8 个时隙），写 TDMA 时最好补一句。
Extension (beyond the notes)
4G/5G use OFDMA, the multiple-access version of the OFDM in Ch. 7: users are allocated resources in both time and subcarriers.4G/5G 用的是 OFDMA，即第 7 章 OFDM 的多址版本：在时间和子载波两个维度上给用户分配资源。
Concept + Step by step: FDMA / TDMA / CDMA and example systems

ConceptWhat multiple access is

Spectrum is limited and users are many. A multiple access technique defines "how many users share one band of spectrum at the same time without interfering with each other". The method is to divide some resource among the users: divide frequency, divide time, or let everyone use the same frequency at the same time and separate them by code (definition on notes Part A p.7; p.15–26 introduce the 1G–3G systems).频谱有限，用户很多。多址技术就是规定"许多用户怎样同时共用一段频谱而不互相干扰"。办法是把某种资源切开分给用户：切频率、切时间，或者大家同时同频、靠码来区分（讲义 Part A p.7 的定义，p.15–26 介绍 1G–3G 系统）。

SchemeWhat is dividedWhat each user getsExample systems
FDMAFrequencyExclusive use of a narrowband frequency channel for the whole call通话期间独占一个窄带频率信道1G: AMPS (30 kHz channels)
TDMATimeShares one carrier, transmits only in its own time slot共用一个载波，只在自己的时隙发送2G: GSM (200 kHz carriers, 8 time slots per frame), IS-54/IS-1362G：GSM（200 kHz 载波、每帧 8 时隙）、IS-54/IS-136
CDMACodeUses the whole wideband spectrum at the same time, with its own spreading code同时占用整段宽带频谱，有自己的扩频码2G: IS-95; 3G: WCDMA, cdma2000

Step by stepAnswer points (for each scheme write "how it divides + an example")

  1. FDMA (frequency division multiple access): the band is split into equal-width channels and each call uses one frequency. Why it matters: the earliest and simplest scheme, the only option for analogue systems; drawbacks are the need for guard bands and a separate transceiver for each channel.FDMA（频分多址）：把频带分成等宽的信道，每个通话占一个频率。为什么重要：最早、最简单，模拟系统只能这样做；缺点是需要保护频带、每个信道要一套收发设备。
  2. TDMA (time division multiple access): one carrier is divided in time into periodic time slots, and several users take turns to transmit. Why it matters: only possible after digitisation; one carrier can serve several users, which improves efficiency; it needs strict synchronisation. GSM is actually a hybrid FDMA/TDMA (first several 200 kHz carriers, then 8 time slots on each); adding this sentence makes the answer more complete.TDMA（时分多址）：一个载波按时间切成周期性的时隙，几个用户轮流发送。为什么重要：数字化以后才能做，一个载波可以给多个用户，提高效率；需要严格同步。GSM 实际是 FDMA/TDMA 混合（先分多个 200 kHz 载波，每个再分 8 个时隙），写上这一句更完整。
  3. CDMA (code division multiple access): each user is assigned an (approximately) orthogonal code, all users transmit at the same time on the same frequency, and the receiver despreads with the matching code, so other users' signals look like low-level noise. Why it matters: the frequency reuse factor can be 1 and it is robust to multipath (notes p.28 say CDMA needs fewer base stations and handles multipath better).CDMA（码分多址）：给每个用户分配一个（近似）正交的码，所有用户同时、同频发送，接收端用对应的码解扩，别人的信号表现为低电平噪声。为什么重要：频率复用系数可以为 1，抗多径能力强（讲义 p.28 说 CDMA 需要的基站更少、抗多径更好）。

Beyond the slides4G/5G use OFDMA (the multiple access version of OFDM from Ch. 7); this question only asks about 1G–3G, so you can leave it out.课外补充4G/5G 用的是 OFDMA（第 7 章 OFDM 的多址版本），本题只问 1G–3G，可以不写。

PitfallsWatch out

  • For each scheme give one real system; describing without an example loses marks.每种方式都要举一个真实系统，只描述不举例会丢分。
  • Do not write GSM as CDMA, or IS-95 as TDMA.别把 GSM 写成 CDMA，也别把 IS-95 写成 TDMA。
  • For a 5-mark question, "how it divides + an example" is enough; no need to write two pages.5 分题写清"怎么分 + 例子"即可，不用写两页。

ExamHow to write it in English

FDMA (Frequency Division Multiple Access): the available spectrum is divided into frequency channels of equal bandwidth, and each user is assigned its own channel for the whole duration of the call, so different users transmit on different frequencies. Example: the 1G analogue system AMPS (30 kHz channels).

TDMA (Time Division Multiple Access): one carrier frequency is divided cyclically into time slots of equal duration, and several users share the carrier by transmitting only in their own time slot. Example: the 2G system GSM (200 kHz carriers with 8 time slots per frame, i.e. combined FDMA/TDMA); IS-54/IS-136 in North America.

CDMA (Code Division Multiple Access): all users transmit at the same time over the same wideband spectrum; each user is assigned a different (nearly orthogonal) spreading code, and the receiver separates its own signal by correlating with that code, while other users appear as low-level noise. Examples: the 2G system IS-95 and the 3G systems WCDMA and cdma2000.

In one line: FDMA divides frequency (AMPS), TDMA divides time slots (GSM, IS-136), CDMA uses the same time and frequency and separates users by code (IS-95, WCDMA).一句话：FDMA 分频率（AMPS），TDMA 分时隙（GSM、IS-136），CDMA 同时同频靠码区分（IS-95、WCDMA）。
→ Back to the learning page: Part A Ch. 1 Three ways to "share resources": FDMA / TDMA / CDMA→ 回到讲解：Part A 第一章 三种"分资源"的方式：FDMA / TDMA / CDMA

Ch. 2 · The cellular concept: split one big tower into many small ones

0 practice · 1 past-examNotes →
Past final exam
2024-25 S2Q4(a)8 marks≡ HW1 Q1(a)
Topics: the databases among the six components of a cellular system: HLR and VLR考点：蜂窝系统六大组成之数据库：HLR 与 VLR
Original question (verbatim)

4. (a) For every cellular network, a database unit is one of the six basic components. What are the basic functions of the database unit? Describe the differences between the home location register (HLR) and the visitor location register (VLR) in the database units.

(8 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
Where the databases sit: notes Part A p.11 lists the six basic components of a cellular network: ① gateways to the wired network, ② base stations (BS), ③ databases, ④ security mechanisms, ⑤ air-interface standards, ⑥ mobile stations (MS). The databases are attached to the mobile switching centre (MTSO/MSC), which queries them to handle every call.数据库在哪里：讲义 Part A p.11 列出蜂窝网的六个基本组成：① 到有线网的网关、② 基站（BS）、③ 数据库（Databases）、④ 安全机制、⑤ 空中接口标准、⑥ 移动台（MS）。数据库挂在移动交换中心（MTSO/MSC）上，交换中心处理每个呼叫都要查它。
2
Basic functions of the databases:
• Store subscriber information: number, subscribed services, billing information; the switching centre uses this to decide whether the user may make calls and which services they can use.
• Location management: record which location area the user is in now; users move, and an incoming call can be paged at the right base station only if the location is known.
• Authentication and security parameters: work with the security mechanisms to confirm that the user is who they claim to be, and prevent fraudulent use.
• Support roaming and handoff: when the user moves to another network or area, the databases exchange information so that service continues.数据库的基本功能：
• 存用户签约信息：号码、开通的业务、计费信息——交换中心据此决定这个用户能不能打、能用哪些业务。
• 位置管理：记录用户当前在哪个位置区——用户在移动，来电时只有知道位置，才能在正确的基站寻呼（paging）。
• 鉴权和安全参数：配合安全机制确认"是不是本人"，防止盗用。
• 支持漫游和切换：用户到了别的网络或区域，靠数据库之间交换信息继续提供服务。
3
HLR (home location register): every subscriber has a permanent record in the HLR of their home network, holding all subscription data, the authentication parameters, and a pointer to "which VLR/MSC area the user is in now". An operator usually has only one (logical) HLR; it is the single "master copy" of the subscriber data.HLR（归属位置寄存器，home location register）：每个用户在其归属网络的 HLR 里有一条永久记录，存全部签约资料、鉴权参数，以及"当前在哪个 VLR/MSC 区域"的指针。一个运营商通常只有一个（逻辑上的）HLR，它是用户资料的唯一"正本"。
4
VLR (visitor location register): associated with each MSC/MTSO service area, it holds temporary copies of the records of users who are currently in this area (including roaming users from other networks): a copy is downloaded from the HLR when the user enters and deleted when the user leaves. Local call setup and paging only need to query the VLR instead of asking the distant HLR every time, which reduces signalling and delay.VLR（拜访位置寄存器，visitor location register）：和每个 MSC/MTSO 服务区关联，保存当前在本区域内的用户（包括外地来的漫游用户）的临时副本：用户进入时从 HLR 下载，离开后删除。本地的呼叫建立和寻呼查 VLR 就够，不必每次都去问远处的 HLR，减少信令和时延。
5
The difference in one line: the HLR is the "home registry": permanent, centralised, and holds all subscription information; the VLR is the "temporary visitor registration": temporary, distributed over the service areas, and holds only copies for the users currently present.
How they work together: when a user moves into a new area, the new VLR registers the user with the HLR; the HLR updates the location and tells the old VLR to delete its record. When someone calls the user, the network first asks the HLR which VLR the user is under, and then the MSC of that VLR pages the user.区别一句话：HLR 是"户口所在地"，永久、集中、存全部签约信息；VLR 是"暂住登记"，临时、分布在各个服务区、只存当前在场用户的副本。
两者怎么配合：用户移动到新区域时，新 VLR 向 HLR 登记，HLR 更新位置并通知旧 VLR 删除记录；有人打给他时，网络先问 HLR 他在哪个 VLR，再由那个 VLR 所在的 MSC 去寻呼。
Databases store user and location information; HLR = permanent home record, VLR = temporary visitor record数据库存用户与位置信息；HLR 永久归属记录，VLR 临时拜访记录
Note: the notes only list "Databases" in the block diagram on p.11; the HLR/VLR details are beyond the notes (standard GSM architecture) and match the answer to HW1 Q1(a).注：讲义只在 p.11 的框图里列出 "Databases"，HLR/VLR 的细节属于课外补充（GSM 的标准结构），和 HW1 Q1(a) 的答法一致。
◆ Key points
What it tests
Databases in a cellular system: HLR and VLR (Part A p.11).蜂窝系统的数据库：HLR 与 VLR（Part A p.11）。
Answer points
Function: store subscription and location information for queries during call setup, paging, authentication, roaming and handoff. HLR: permanent, centralised, holds subscription data and "which VLR the user is in now". VLR: one per MSC area, temporarily holds copies for the users in its area, downloaded from the HLR on entry and deleted on exit.功能：保存签约信息和位置信息，供呼叫建立、寻呼、鉴权、漫游、切换查询。HLR：永久、集中，存签约资料和"当前在哪个 VLR"；VLR：每个 MSC 区域一个，临时存本区用户的副本，进来时从 HLR 下载、离开后删除。
Memory aid
HLR = registered home address, VLR = temporary residence registration.HLR = 户口所在地，VLR = 暂住登记。
Common mistakes
The VLR does not only hold roaming users; local users in the area are registered in the VLR too. The HLR stores "which VLR/MSC area", not the exact location.VLR 不只存漫游用户，本地用户在本区也登记在 VLR；HLR 存的是"在哪个 VLR/MSC 区域"，不是精确位置。
Bonus points
Write out the procedure when the user moves: the new VLR registers with the HLR → the HLR updates the location → the old VLR is told to delete the record.写出用户移动时的流程：新 VLR 向 HLR 登记 → HLR 更新位置 → 通知旧 VLR 删除记录。
Concept + Step by step: cellular databases and HLR / VLR

ConceptThe six basic components of a cellular system

The block diagram in notes Part A p.11: ① mobile station (MS), ② base station (BS), ③ databases, ④ security mechanisms, ⑤ air-interface standards, ⑥ mobile switching centre (MTSO / MSC) connected to the PSTN. The lecturer said in class that the MTSO is the "brain" of the cellular system, and the brain makes its decisions (may this user make a call, where is the user now, how to connect the call) using the databases.讲义 Part A p.11 的框图：① 移动台（MS）、② 基站（BS）、③ 数据库（Databases）、④ 安全机制、⑤ 空中接口标准、⑥ 移动交换中心（MTSO / MSC）连到 PSTN。老师课上说 MTSO 是整个蜂窝系统的"大脑"；而大脑做决定（这个用户能不能打、现在在哪、怎么接通）靠的就是数据库。

Beyond the slidesThe notes only write "Databases" in the block diagram. The HLR / VLR details come from the GSM architecture (also the answer to HW1 Q1(a)). The content below is beyond the slides, but it is where the marks are in this question.课外补充讲义只在框图里写了 "Databases"，HLR / VLR 的细节来自 GSM 标准结构（也是 HW1 Q1(a) 的答法），下面的内容属于课外补充，但是本题的得分点。

HLR (Home Location Register)VLR (Visitor Location Register)
LocationIn the user's home network; usually one per operator (logically)用户的归属网络，一个运营商通常一个（逻辑上）One per MSC service area, distributed每个 MSC 服务区一个，分布式
Nature of the recordPermanent master record永久的主记录Temporary copy
What it storesSubscription data, service permissions, authentication parameters, "which VLR/MSC area the user is in now"签约资料、业务权限、鉴权参数、"当前在哪个 VLR/MSC 区域"Data and a more precise location area for all users now in the area (local and roaming)当前在本区的所有用户（本地和漫游）的资料和较精确的位置区
When it is updatedWhen the user moves to another MSC area用户换到另一个 MSC 区域时Downloaded from the HLR when the user enters the area; deleted after the user leaves用户进入本区时从 HLR 下载，离开后删除
AnalogyPermanent home registrationTemporary residence registration

Step by stepAnswer points in detail

  1. Basic function of the databases: store user information (number, subscribed services, billing) and location information, which the MSC queries for call set-up, paging the called user, authentication, roaming and handoff. Why it matters: without them the network does not know "who this user is, whether the user is allowed, and where the user is now", so it cannot connect the call.数据库的基本功能：保存用户信息（号码、签约业务、计费）和位置信息，供 MSC 在呼叫建立、寻呼被叫、鉴权、漫游和切换时查询。为什么重要：没有它，网络不知道"这个用户是谁、有没有权限、现在在哪"，就无法接通。
  2. HLR: the permanent master record of each user in the home network, stored centrally; it records the VLR/MSC the user is in now. For an incoming call the network first asks the HLR "which area is the user in?"HLR：每个用户在归属网络里的永久主记录，集中存储；记录用户当前所在的 VLR/MSC，来电时网络先问 HLR "他在哪个区"。
  3. VLR: a temporary database linked to an MSC that stores only the users now in its area. Benefit: calls and paging in the area query the VLR directly instead of asking a possibly distant HLR every time, which reduces signalling and delay.VLR：和 MSC 关联的临时数据库，只存当前在本区的用户。好处：本区的呼叫、寻呼直接查 VLR，不必每次都去问可能很远的 HLR，减少信令和时延。
  4. Bonus point (procedure): the user moves to a new area → the new VLR registers with the HLR → the HLR updates the location and tells the old VLR to delete its record.加分点（流程）：用户移动到新区域 → 新 VLR 向 HLR 登记 → HLR 更新位置并通知旧 VLR 删除记录。

PitfallsWatch out

  • The VLR does not store only roaming users; local users in the area are also registered in the VLR.VLR 不只存漫游用户，本地用户在本区也登记在 VLR。
  • The HLR stores "which VLR/MSC area", not the location down to the cell.HLR 存的是"在哪个 VLR/MSC 区域"，不是精确到小区的位置。
  • 8-mark question: write both the functions and the differences, ideally as contrasts (permanent vs temporary, central vs distributed, all subscription data vs users present now).8 分题：功能 + 区别都要写，最好用对比的句式（永久 vs 临时、集中 vs 分布、全部签约信息 vs 当前在场用户）。

ExamHow to write it in English

Basic functions of the database unit: the databases store subscriber information (identity, subscribed services, authentication and billing data) and location information of the mobile users. The MSC/MTSO queries them during call set-up, paging of the called user, authentication, roaming and handoff. Without the databases, the network would not know who the user is, what services the user may use and where the user is located.

Home Location Register (HLR): a permanent, centralised database in the subscriber's home network. It holds the master record of every subscriber registered with the operator, including the subscription profile, authentication parameters and the identity of the VLR/MSC area where the subscriber is currently located. An operator normally has one (logical) HLR.

Visitor Location Register (VLR): a temporary, distributed database associated with each MSC service area. It stores a copy of the relevant data of all subscribers currently in that area, both local users and visiting (roaming) users, together with their current location area. When a user enters the area the record is downloaded from the HLR, and it is deleted when the user leaves. Local calls and paging are handled by the VLR without querying the HLR each time, which reduces signalling.

Differences: the HLR is permanent, centralised and holds complete subscription data for its own subscribers; the VLR is temporary, located in each service area and holds only the users currently present. When a user moves to a new area, the new VLR registers the user with the HLR, the HLR updates the location and instructs the old VLR to delete its record.

In one line: the databases store user subscription data and location for the MSC to connect calls, page, authenticate and handle roaming; the HLR is the permanent, central "home registration", the VLR is each service area's temporary "visitor registration".一句话：数据库存用户签约信息和位置，供 MSC 接续、寻呼、鉴权和漫游查询；HLR 是永久集中的"户口"，VLR 是各服务区临时的"暂住登记"。

Ch. 4 · Duplexing and spectral efficiency: how to measure "is it enough"

2 practice · 1 past-examNotes →
Lecture example
p.43–44

Ex. 1 · Spectral efficiency of an AMPS system

Original questionSlide 43

Consider an AMPS system with two operators sharing the 25 MHz bandwidth. Assume each cell uses 3 control channels. Calculate the spectral efficiency based on the following parameters.

  • Area of cell = 4 km2
  • Total coverage area = 2000 km2
  • Average number of calls per user per hour = 1.2
  • Average holding time of a call = 100 sec
  • Call blocking probability: GOS = 2%
  • Frequency reuse factor = 7
Two operators share a 25MHz AMPS system, and each cell uses 3 control channels. Find the spectral efficiency, the calls per hour and the number of users.两家运营商共享 25MHz 的 AMPS 系统，每个小区用 3 条控制信道。求频谱效率、每小时呼叫数与用户数。
Channel width 30kHzCell area 4km²Total coverage 2000km²1.2 calls/user/hourMean call 100sGoS 2%N = 7信道宽 30kHz小区面积 4km²总覆盖 2000km²1.2 次/用户/小时平均通话 100sGoS 2%N = 7
  1. Split the bandwidth, count the total channels: two operators share 25 MHz equally, so each has Bw = 25 ÷ 2 = 12.5 MHz. Number of channels = bandwidth ÷ channel spacing; for AMPS the channel spacing is Bc = 30 kHz. First convert both to Hz:分带宽、算总信道数：两家运营商平分 25 MHz，每家 Bw = 25 ÷ 2 = 12.5 MHz。信道数 = 带宽 ÷ 信道间隔（channel spacing），AMPS 的信道间隔 Bc = 30 kHz，先统一成 Hz：
    Bw/Bc = 12.5×10⁶ Hz ÷ 30×10³ Hz = 416.67 → 416 channels
    A channel count cannot be a fraction, so round down (notes p.44).信道不能是小数，向下取整（讲义 p.44）。
  2. Subtract the control channels: these 416 channels are shared by a cluster of 7 cells, and each cell reserves 3 control channels (for call setup and paging), so the whole cluster loses扣控制信道：这 416 条要分给一簇 7 个小区，每个小区各留 3 条控制信道（control channel，用于呼叫建立和寻呼），所以整簇扣掉
    3 × 7 = 21 channels; 416 − 21 = 395 voice channels3 × 7 = 21 条；416 − 21 = 395 条业务信道（voice channels）
  3. Per cell: the 7 cells share them equally, M = 395 ÷ 7 = 56.43 → 56 channels/cell, again rounded down.分到每个小区：7 个小区平分，M = 395 ÷ 7 = 56.43 → 56 条/小区，同样向下取整。
  4. Read the Erlang B table: at row M = 56, column GoS = 0.02, read A = 45.9 Erlang/cell (exact formula value 45.88, consistent with the table). This is the maximum traffic one cell can carry at 2% blocking. Per unit area: 45.9 Er ÷ 4 km² = 11.5 Er/km².查 Erlang B 表：在 M = 56 行、GoS = 0.02 列读出 A = 45.9 Erlang/小区（公式精确值 45.88，与表一致）。这是一个小区在 2% 阻塞率下最多能承载的话务量（traffic）。按面积折算 45.9 Er ÷ 4 km² = 11.5 Er/km²。
  5. Spectral efficiency ηm: by the traffic-based definition (spectral efficiency, p.41), ηm = traffic per cell ÷ (bandwidth × cell area):频谱效率 ηm：按话务量的定义（spectral efficiency，p.41），ηm = 每小区话务量 ÷ (带宽 × 小区面积)：
    ηm = A / (Bw × Ac) = 45.9 ÷ (12.5 MHz × 4 km²) = 45.9 ÷ 50 = 0.918 ≈ 0.92 Er/MHz/km²
    The denominator uses the area of only one cell, because total traffic and total area are both multiplied by the same number of cells, which cancels. Check: 2000 km² holds 500 cells, 500 × 45.9 = 22,950 Er, 22,950 ÷ (12.5 × 2000) = 0.918 ✓.分母只用一个小区的面积，因为总话务量和总面积都要乘同一个小区数，上下约掉。验算：2000 km² 共 500 个小区，500 × 45.9 = 22,950 Er，22,950 ÷ (12.5 × 2000) = 0.918 ✓。
  6. Calls per hour: traffic A = calls per hour × mean call duration h, with h in hours (100 s = 100/3600 h), so每小时呼叫数：话务量 A = 每小时呼叫数 × 平均通话时长 h，h 要换成小时（100 s = 100/3600 h），所以
    Calls = A ÷ h = 45.9 × 3600/100 = 1652.4 calls/hour/cell
    1652.4 ÷ 4 km² = 413.1 calls/hour/km²呼叫数 = A ÷ h = 45.9 × 3600/100 = 1652.4 次/小时/小区
    1652.4 ÷ 4 km² = 413.1 次/小时/km²
  7. Number of users: each user makes 1.2 calls per hour:用户数：每个用户每小时打 1.2 次：
    Users = 1652.4 ÷ 1.2 = 1377 users/cell用户数 = 1652.4 ÷ 1.2 = 1377 用户/小区
    Check another way: traffic per user Au = 1.2 × 100/3600 = 0.0333 Er, 45.9 ÷ 0.0333 = 45.9 × 30 = 1377 ✓.换一条路验算：每用户话务量 Au = 1.2 × 100/3600 = 0.0333 Er，45.9 ÷ 0.0333 = 45.9 × 30 = 1377 ✓。
  8. (Also on p.45) Multiple access efficiency ηa: the multiple access spectral efficiency of FDMA = bandwidth used by the voice channels ÷ total bandwidth, with both in kHz:（p.45 顺带）多址效率 ηa：FDMA 的多址频谱效率（multiple access spectral efficiency）= 业务信道占的带宽 ÷ 总带宽，单位统一成 kHz：
    ηa = BcNt/Bw = 395 × 30 kHz ÷ 12,500 kHz = 11,850 ÷ 12,500 = 0.948
    The remaining ~5% of the bandwidth goes to the 21 control channels and the remainder lost in rounding down.剩下约 5% 的带宽给了 21 条控制信道和取整丢掉的零头。
ηm = 0.92 Er/MHz/km² · 1652 calls/hour/cell · 1377 users/cell · ηa = 0.948ηm = 0.92 Er/MHz/km² · 1652 次/小时/小区 · 1377 用户/小区 · ηa = 0.948
Memorise the number chain: 25 → 12.5 → 416 → 395 → 56 → 45.9. With 100 s calls, calls per hour = A × 36.背数字链：25 → 12.5 → 416 → 395 → 56 → 45.9。通话 100 秒时，每小时呼叫数 = A × 36。
Subtract 3 × 7 = 21 control channels, not 3. The denominator of ηm uses the area of a single cell, 4km², because A is the traffic per cell; the total coverage of 2000km² given in the question is not used.控制信道要减 3 × 7 = 21 条，不是 3 条。ηm 的分母用的是单个小区的面积 4km²，因为 A 是每个小区的话务量；题目给的总覆盖 2000km² 在计算中用不到。
Concept + Step by step: spectral efficiency ηm and traffic conversion

ConceptWhat spectral efficiency actually measures

Operators pay a lot of money for spectrum. Spectral efficiency answers one question: per 1 MHz of spectrum and per 1 km² of area, how many calls can be supported? Part A p.38–39 of the notes splits it into two parts: modulation spectral efficiency ηm and multiple access spectral efficiency ηa; overall efficiency η = ηm × ηa (p.46).频谱是运营商花大钱买来的。频谱效率回答一个问题：每 1 MHz 频谱、每 1 km² 面积，能撑起多少通话？讲义 Part A p.38–39 把它拆成两部分：调制频谱效率 ηm（modulation spectral efficiency）和多址频谱效率 ηa（multiple access spectral efficiency），总效率 η = ηm × ηa（p.46）。

ηm can be written in two ways:

  • By number of channels (p.40): ηm = (Bw/Bc) / (Bw · Ac · N), in channels/MHz/km². Bw is the system bandwidth, Bc the channel spacing, Ac the area of one cell, and N the cluster size (reuse factor).按信道数（p.40）：ηm = (Bw/Bc) / (Bw · Ac · N)，单位 channels/MHz/km²。Bw 是系统带宽，Bc 是信道间隔，Ac 是一个小区的面积，N 是簇尺寸（复用因子）。
  • By traffic (p.41): ηm = total traffic carried by the system / (bandwidth × total coverage area), in Erlang/MHz/km². This question uses this definition.按话务量（p.41）：ηm = 系统承载的总话务量 / (带宽 × 总覆盖面积)，单位 Erlang/MHz/km²。本题用的是这一种。

Why does the denominator use only one cell's area, 4 km²? Because "total traffic = traffic per cell × number of cells" and "total area = area per cell × number of cells", the number of cells cancels, leaving ηm = Acell / (Bw × Ac). So the total coverage of 2000 km² does not affect the result.为什么分母只用一个小区的面积 4 km²？因为"总话务量 = 每小区话务量 × 小区数"，"总面积 = 每小区面积 × 小区数"，小区数上下约掉，剩下 ηm = A小区 / (Bw × Ac)。所以总覆盖 2000 km² 不影响结果。

Two other tools: traffic A (Erlang) = number of calls × duration of each call (convert to hours), notes p.118; Erlang B table: given the number of channels M and the blocking probability GoS, read off the maximum traffic A one cell can carry (p.119–121). Lecturer's emphasis: "try to memorise" the spectral efficiency formula (tested in 2025-26 S1 Q3(a)(iv)); for Erlang B the exam only uses the table, which is given in the appendix.另外两个工具：话务量 A（Erlang）= 呼叫次数 × 每次通话时长（单位要统一成小时），讲义 p.118；Erlang B 表：给定信道数 M 和阻塞率 GoS，查出一个小区最多能承载的话务量 A（p.119–121）。老师课上强调：频谱效率公式"要试着记住"（2025-26 S1 Q3(a)(iv) 考过）；Erlang B 考试只查表，附录会给表。

SymbolMeaningValues in this question
BwBandwidth per operator每家运营商的带宽25 ÷ 2 = 12.5 MHz
BcChannel spacing (AMPS)30 kHz
NCluster size7
AcCell area4 km²
λ, hCall rate per user, mean call duration每用户呼叫率、平均通话时长1.2 calls/hour, 100 s

Step by stepWork it out step by step

  1. Split the bandwidth: the two operators share 25 MHz equally, 12.5 MHz each.分带宽：两家运营商平分 25 MHz，每家 12.5 MHz。
  2. Total number of channels: bandwidth ÷ channel width. 12.5×10⁶ ÷ 30×10³ = 416.67. A channel cannot be fractional, so round down to 416.算总信道数：带宽 ÷ 信道宽。12.5×10⁶ ÷ 30×10³ = 416.67，信道不能是小数，向下取整为 416。
  3. Remove the control channels: these 416 channels are shared by a cluster of 7 cells, and each cell keeps 3 control channels (for call set-up and paging), so the cluster loses 3 × 7 = 21, leaving 395 traffic channels (voice channels).扣控制信道：这 416 条要分给一簇 7 个小区，每个小区自己要留 3 条控制信道（建立呼叫、寻呼用），所以整簇扣 3 × 7 = 21 条，剩 395 条业务信道（voice channels）。
  4. Share among the cells: 395 ÷ 7 = 56.43, round down to 56.分到每个小区：395 ÷ 7 = 56.43，向下取整 56 条。
  5. Read the Erlang B table: in row M = 56, column GoS = 0.02, read A = 45.9 Erlang/cell (the exact formula gives 45.88, matching the table). This is the maximum traffic one cell can carry at 2% blocking.查 Erlang B 表：在 M = 56 那一行、GoS = 0.02 那一列读出 A = 45.9 Erlang/小区（用公式精确算是 45.88，与表一致）。这就是一个小区在 2% 阻塞率下能承载的最大话务量。
  6. Find ηm: 45.9 ÷ (12.5 MHz × 4 km²).
  7. Traffic → calls: A = (calls per hour) × h, so calls per hour = A ÷ h, with h = 100 s = 100/3600 hours.话务量 → 呼叫数：A = (每小时呼叫数) × h，所以每小时呼叫数 = A ÷ h。h = 100 s = 100/3600 小时。
  8. Calls → users: each user makes 1.2 calls per hour, so number of users = calls ÷ 1.2.呼叫数 → 用户数：每个用户每小时打 1.2 次，所以用户数 = 呼叫数 ÷ 1.2。
12.5×10⁶ ÷ 30×10³ = 416.67 → 416 channels
416 − 3 × 7 = 395 channels
395 ÷ 7 = 56.43 → 56 channels/cell
Erlang B (M = 56, 2%) → A = 45.9 Er/cell; 45.9 ÷ 4 = 11.5 Er/km²
ηm = 45.9 ÷ (12.5 × 4) = 0.918 ≈ 0.92 Er/MHz/km²
Calls = 45.9 × 3600 ÷ 100 = 1652.4 calls/hour/cell; 1652.4 ÷ 4 = 413.1 calls/hour/km²
Users = 1652.4 ÷ 1.2 = 1377 users/cell12.5×10⁶ ÷ 30×10³ = 416.67 → 416 条
416 − 3 × 7 = 395 条
395 ÷ 7 = 56.43 → 56 条/小区
Erlang B（M = 56，2%）→ A = 45.9 Er/小区；45.9 ÷ 4 = 11.5 Er/km²
ηm = 45.9 ÷ (12.5 × 4) = 0.918 ≈ 0.92 Er/MHz/km²
呼叫数 = 45.9 × 3600 ÷ 100 = 1652.4 次/小时/小区；1652.4 ÷ 4 = 413.1 次/小时/km²
用户数 = 1652.4 ÷ 1.2 = 1377 用户/小区

Check (another route): traffic per user Au = 1.2 × 100/3600 = 0.0333 Er, users = 45.9 ÷ 0.0333 = 45.9 × 30 = 1377, the same as step 8.验算（换一条路）：每用户话务量 Au = 1.2 × 100/3600 = 0.0333 Er，用户数 = 45.9 ÷ 0.0333 = 45.9 × 30 = 1377，和第 8 步一致。

Two extra quantities: ① ηm by number of channels (p.40) = 1/(Bc · Ac · N) = 1/(0.03 × 4 × 7) = 1.19 channels/MHz/km². Bw cancels out, which is exactly why p.41 says "ηm is independent of the system bandwidth". ② If asked for the number of users in the whole area: 2000 ÷ 4 = 500 cells, 500 × 1377 = 688,500 users (a variation; the notes do not compute it).顺带两个量：① 按信道数的 ηm（p.40）= 1/(Bc · Ac · N) = 1/(0.03 × 4 × 7) = 1.19 channels/MHz/km²，可以看到 Bw 约掉了，这正是 p.41 说"ηm 与系统带宽无关"的原因。② 如果追问全区用户数：2000 ÷ 4 = 500 个小区，500 × 1377 = 688,500 用户（这是变式，讲义没算）。

Pitfalls

  • Subtract 21 control channels, not 3; round both 416.67 and 56.43 down.控制信道扣 21 条，不是 3 条；416.67 和 56.43 都要向下取整。
  • Convert h to hours (100/3600), otherwise the number of calls is off by a factor of 3600.h 要换成小时（100/3600），否则呼叫数差 3600 倍。
  • Keep the units: Er/MHz/km², calls/hour/cell, users/cell. The lecturer says answers must include units.单位别丢：Er/MHz/km²、次/小时/小区、用户/小区。老师说答案要写单位。

ExamHow to write it in English

Bandwidth per operator = 25/2 = 12.5 MHz. Number of 30 kHz channels = 12.5×10⁶ / 30×10³ = 416. Voice channels = 416 − 3×7 = 395; per cell = 395/7 ≈ 56. From the Erlang B table (M = 56, GoS = 2%), A = 45.9 Erlangs/cell = 11.5 Erlangs/km². Spectral efficiency ηm = 45.9 / (12.5 MHz × 4 km²) = 0.92 Erlangs/MHz/km². Calls per hour per cell = 45.9 × 3600/100 = 1652.4 calls/hr/cell (413.1 calls/hr/km²). Users per cell = 1652.4/1.2 = 1377 users/cell.

In one line: bandwidth → channels → remove control → share among cells → table gives A → A ÷ (Bw × Ac) is ηm, A ÷ h is the number of calls, and ÷ 1.2 gives the number of users.一句话：带宽 → 信道 → 扣控制 → 分小区 → 查表得 A → A ÷ (Bw × Ac) 就是 ηm，A ÷ h 是呼叫数，再 ÷ 1.2 是用户数。
Lecture example
p.47

Multiple-access spectral efficiency of the North American TDMA system

Original questionSlide 47

In the North American TDMA system, the parameters are as follows. Calculate the multiple access spectral efficiency.

  • Single operator bandwidth = 12.5 MHz with channel spacing = 30 kHz
  • Total data channels = 395
  • Frame duration = 40 ms with time slots per frame = 6
  • Speech rate = 13 kbps and gross data rate = 16.2 kbps
Find the multiple-access spectral efficiency ηa of the North American TDMA system.求北美 TDMA 系统的多址频谱效率 ηa。
12.5MHz per operatorChannel spacing 30kHz395 data channelsFrame 40ms6 slots per frameVoice 13kbpsTotal rate 16.2kbps单运营商 12.5MHz信道间隔 30kHz数据信道 395帧长 40ms每帧 6 时隙语音 13kbps总速率 16.2kbps
  1. Length of each time slot: a frame of Tf = 40 ms is divided into Mt = 6 time slots: Tf/Mt = 40 ÷ 6 = 6.667 ms每个时隙多长：一帧 Tf = 40 ms 分成 Mt = 6 个时隙（time slot）：Tf/Mt = 40 ÷ 6 = 6.667 ms
  2. Remove the overhead to get Ts: Ts counts only the time that carries pure information (p.45). Of the 16.2 kbps total rate in each slot, only 13 kbps is voice; the other 3.2 kbps is overhead (synchronisation, guard, control, etc.). At the same rate, time is proportional to the number of bits, so扣开销得 Ts：Ts 只算装纯信息的时间（p.45）。每个时隙的总速率 16.2 kbps 里只有 13 kbps 是语音，其余 3.2 kbps 是同步、保护、控制等开销；速率相同，时间和比特数成正比，所以
    Voice fraction = 13/16.2 = 0.8025
    Ts = 0.8025 × 6.667 ms = 5.35 ms
  3. Time factor:
    TsMt/Tf = 5.35 × 6 ÷ 40 = 32.1 ÷ 40 = 0.8025
    40/6 and 6/40 cancel, so the time factor is really just 13/16.2; that is why notes p.47 writes 13/16.2 directly.40/6 和 6/40 约掉，时间因子其实就是 13/16.2，所以讲义 p.47 直接写 13/16.2。
  4. Frequency factor: North American TDMA is narrowband TDMA (p.46): the 12.5 MHz is first cut into 30 kHz sub-bands, and each sub-band is then divided into time slots, so you also multiply by the frequency utilisation. Use kHz throughout (12.5 MHz = 12,500 kHz):频率因子：北美 TDMA 是窄带 TDMA（narrowband TDMA，p.46）：12.5 MHz 先切成 30 kHz 子带，每个子带内再分时隙，所以还要乘频率利用率。单位统一成 kHz（12.5 MHz = 12,500 kHz）：
    BuNu/Bw = 30 × 395 ÷ 12,500 = 11,850 ÷ 12,500 = 0.948
    This is the FDMA efficiency from Example 1 (p.45).这就是例 1（p.45）的 FDMA 效率。
  5. Multiply and self-check:
    ηa = (TsMt/Tf)(BuNu/Bw) = 0.8025 × 0.948 = 0.761 ≈ 0.76
    Check: 0.76 lies between 0 and 1 and is smaller than both factors (two discounts applied) ✓; about 24% of the time-frequency resource goes to overhead and control.检查：0.76 在 0 和 1 之间，而且比两个因子都小（打了两次折）✓；约 24% 的时频资源花在开销和控制上。
ηa ≈ 0.76
ηa = time utilisation × frequency utilisation = 0.80 × 0.95 ≈ 0.76. The 0.948 is the FDMA efficiency from Ex. 1, so you can memorise the two examples together.ηa = 时间利用率 × 频率利用率 = 0.80 × 0.95 ≈ 0.76。其中 0.948 就是例 1 里的 FDMA 效率，两题可以一起记。
Ts is not 40/6 = 6.67ms; multiply by 13/16.2 to remove the overhead. Narrowband TDMA needs the frequency factor; TsMt/Tf alone is the formula for wideband TDMA.Ts 不是 40/6 = 6.67ms，要乘 13/16.2 扣掉开销。窄带 TDMA 要乘频率因子，只算 TsMt/Tf 是宽带 TDMA 的公式。
Concept + Step by step: multiple access efficiency ηa of narrowband TDMA

ConceptMultiple access spectral efficiency ηa: how much of the time-frequency grid carries "real talk"

Draw the system resources as a time × frequency grid. The multiple access spectral efficiency ηa (notes Part A p.45) = time-frequency area actually used for voice (data) ÷ total time-frequency area of the system, so it is always ≤ 1. The rest is spent on overhead: control channels, guard slots, synchronisation and training sequences, etc.把系统资源画成一张时间 × 频率的格子图。多址频谱效率 ηa（讲义 Part A p.45）= 真正用来传语音（数据）的时频面积 ÷ 系统全部时频面积，所以一定 ≤ 1。剩下的部分花在了开销上：控制信道、保护时隙、同步和训练序列等。

SystemFormulaMeaning
FDMA (p.45)ηa = BeNt/BwUtilisation in frequency频率方向的利用率
Wideband TDMA (p.45)ηa = TsMt/TfUtilisation in time时间方向的利用率
Narrowband TDMA (p.46)ηa = (TsMt/Tf)(BuNu/Bw)Time utilisation × frequency utilisation时间利用率 × 频率利用率

Symbols: Ts = time in one slot occupied by pure information; Tf = frame length; Mt = number of slots per frame; Bu = bandwidth of one sub-band; Nu = number of sub-bands (users in the same slot on different frequencies); Bw = total bandwidth.符号：Ts = 一个时隙中纯信息占的时间；Tf = 帧长；Mt = 每帧时隙数；Bu = 一个子带的带宽；Nu = 子带数（同一时隙、不同频率的用户数）；Bw = 总带宽。

Narrowband TDMA first cuts the total bandwidth into many 30 kHz sub-bands (like FDMA), and within each sub-band users take turns in time (TDMA). So the waste in both directions counts, and the two factors are multiplied. North American TDMA (IS-54/IS-136, also called D-AMPS) has this structure.窄带 TDMA（narrowband TDMA）是先把总带宽切成很多 30 kHz 子带（像 FDMA），每个子带里再按时间轮流用（TDMA）。所以两个方向的浪费都要算，两个因子相乘。北美 TDMA（IS-54/IS-136，也叫 D-AMPS）就是这种结构。

Step by stepFirst the time factor, then the frequency factor

  1. Length of each slot: a 40 ms frame is split into 6 slots, each 40/6 = 6.67 ms.每个时隙多长：一帧 40 ms 分成 6 个时隙，每个 40/6 = 6.67 ms。
  2. How much of it is voice: the total rate of each slot is 16.2 kbps, of which voice is only 13 kbps, a ratio of 13/16.2 = 0.8025. The remaining 3.2 kbps is overhead for synchronisation, guard, control, etc. So Ts = 0.8025 × 6.67 ms.其中多少是语音：每个时隙的总速率是 16.2 kbps，其中语音只占 13 kbps，比例 13/16.2 = 0.8025。剩下的 3.2 kbps 是同步、保护、控制等开销。所以 Ts = 0.8025 × 6.67 ms。
  3. Time factor: TsMt/Tf. Note that 40/6 × 6/40 = 1 cancels, so the time factor is simply 13/16.2.时间因子：TsMt/Tf。注意 40/6 × 6/40 = 1 会约掉，时间因子其实就等于 13/16.2。
  4. Frequency factor: 395 data channels of 30 kHz each occupy 395 × 30 = 11,850 kHz out of a total bandwidth of 12,500 kHz, a ratio of 0.948. This is the same number as the FDMA efficiency in Example 1 (p.45).频率因子：395 条数据信道，每条 30 kHz，共占 395 × 30 = 11,850 kHz，总带宽 12,500 kHz，比例 0.948。这和例 1（p.45）的 FDMA 效率是同一个数。
  5. Multiply to get ηa.
Ts = (13/16.2) × (40/6) = 0.8025 × 6.667 = 5.35 ms
Time factor = 5.35 × 6 ÷ 40 = 0.8025
Frequency factor = 30 × 395 ÷ 12500 = 0.948
ηa = 0.8025 × 0.948 = 0.7607 ≈ 0.76Ts = (13/16.2) × (40/6) = 0.8025 × 6.667 = 5.35 ms
时间因子 = 5.35 × 6 ÷ 40 = 0.8025
频率因子 = 30 × 395 ÷ 12500 = 0.948
ηa = 0.8025 × 0.948 = 0.7607 ≈ 0.76

Sanity check: ηa is between 0 and 1 and smaller than both factors (discounted twice). 0.76 means about 24% of the time-frequency resource goes to overhead and control. The form on notes p.47, ηa = (13/16.2) × (30 × 395/12500), simply drops the part that cancels.合理性检查：ηa 在 0 和 1 之间，且比两个因子都小（两次打折）。0.76 表示约 24% 的时频资源用在开销和控制上。讲义 p.47 的写法 ηa = (13/16.2) × (30 × 395/12500) 就是把约掉的部分直接省了。

Beyond the slidesWhere 16.2 kbps comes from (not in the notes)

In IS-54 each 30 kHz carrier has a total rate of 48.6 kbps. A full-rate user uses 2 of the 6 slots per frame, i.e. 1/3 of the carrier: 48.6 ÷ 3 = 16.2 kbps. You do not need to write this in the exam; it only helps you understand the data in the question.IS-54 每个 30 kHz 载波总速率 48.6 kbps，一个全速率用户用每帧 6 个时隙中的 2 个，即 1/3 的载波，48.6 ÷ 3 = 16.2 kbps。考试不用写这一点，只是帮你理解题目数据。

Pitfalls

  • Ts is not 40/6 = 6.67 ms; multiply by 13/16.2 to remove the overhead ("carrying pure information").Ts 不是 40/6 = 6.67 ms，要乘 13/16.2 扣掉开销（"carrying pure information"）。
  • Narrowband TDMA must include the frequency factor; computing only TsMt/Tf = 0.80 is the wideband TDMA answer.窄带 TDMA 必须乘频率因子；只算 TsMt/Tf = 0.80 是宽带 TDMA 的答案。
  • Use the same units in the frequency factor: 30 kHz and 12.5 MHz = 12,500 kHz.频率因子单位统一：30 kHz 和 12.5 MHz = 12,500 kHz。

ExamHow to write it in English

This is a narrowband TDMA system, so ηa = (Ts·Mt/Tf)(Bu·Nu/Bw). The useful slot duration is Ts = (13/16.2) × (40/6) = 5.35 ms, with Tf = 40 ms, Mt = 6, Bu = 30 kHz, Nu = 395 and Bw = 12.5 MHz. Hence ηa = (5.35 × 6/40) × (30 × 395/12500) = 0.8025 × 0.948 ≈ 0.76.

In one line: for narrowband TDMA, ηa = time factor (13/16.2 = 0.80) × frequency factor (395 × 30/12500 = 0.948) ≈ 0.76.一句话：窄带 TDMA 的 ηa = 时间因子（13/16.2 = 0.80）× 频率因子（395 × 30/12500 = 0.948）≈ 0.76。
Past final exam
2025-26 S1Q3(a)12 marks
Topics: number of cells · total number of channels (minus guard bands) · cell capacity · spectral efficiency in channels/MHz/km²考点：小区数 · 总信道数（扣保护带）· 小区容量 · 频谱效率 channels/MHz/km²
Original question (verbatim)

3. (a) A metropolis city with a total area of 1500 km2 is covered by a hexagonal cellular system with a cluster size of 9. Suppose that each cell has a radius R of 2 km and the cellular system is allocated 25 MHz of spectrum, with a full-duplex channel bandwidth of 30 kHz and a total 40 kHz guard bands. The system uses frequency division multiple access (FDMA) with 18 control channels. Determine:

(i) the number of cells in the service area;

(ii) the number of channels without frequency reuse;

(iii) The cell capacity; and

(iv) The system spectral efficiency in the units of channels/ MHz / km2.

(12 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
(i) Cell area: a regular hexagon is made of 6 equilateral triangles of side R, so its area = (3√3/2)R²:(i) 小区面积：正六边形由 6 个边长为 R 的等边三角形组成，面积 = (3√3/2)R²：
Ac = (3√3/2) × 2² = 2.598 × 4 = 10.39 km²
2
(i) Number of cells:
Ncells = 1500 / 10.39 = 144.3 → 145 cells
The number of cells must be an integer; round up to cover the full 1500 km² (writing ≈ 144 and stating that it is approximate is also acceptable).小区数必须是整数，向上取整才能完全覆盖 1500 km²（写 ≈ 144 并说明是近似也可以）。
3
(ii) Number of channels without reuse: first subtract the guard band, then divide by the bandwidth of one full-duplex channel (the 30 kHz in the question is already the bandwidth of one full-duplex channel; same method as the worked example on notes Part A p.44):(ii) 不复用时的信道数：先扣掉保护带，再除以每条全双工信道的带宽（题目的 30 kHz 已经是一条全双工信道占用的带宽，算法同讲义 Part A p.44 例题）：
Usable bandwidth = 25 MHz − 40 kHz = 25 000 − 40 = 24 960 kHz
Number of channels = 24 960 / 30 = 832可用带宽 = 25 MHz − 40 kHz = 25 000 − 40 = 24 960 kHz
信道数 = 24 960 / 30 = 832 条
4
(iii) Cell capacity: of the 832 channels, 18 are control channels (18/9 = 2 per cell in the cluster), leaving 832 − 18 = 814 traffic channels. The 9 cells of each cluster share all the channels equally (uniform fixed channel assignment, UFCA, notes p.92–93):(iii) 小区容量：832 条中有 18 条控制信道（簇内每小区 18/9 = 2 条），话务信道 832 − 18 = 814 条。每簇 9 个小区平分全部信道（均匀固定分配 UFCA，讲义 p.92–93）：
814 / 9 = 90.4 → 90 traffic channels per cell814 / 9 = 90.4 → 每小区 90 条话务信道
A cell cannot have a fraction of a channel, so round down. (If the control channels are included as well: 832/9 = 92.4 → 92 channels.)信道不能取分数，向下取整。（若把控制信道也算进来：832/9 = 92.4 → 92 条。）
5
(iv) Spectral efficiency (notes Part A p.40): ηm = (Bw/Bc)/(Bw·Ac·N). The numerator is the number of system channels; the denominator is bandwidth × the area of one cluster. Bw cancels, and Bc is converted to MHz (30 kHz = 0.03 MHz):(iv) 频谱效率（讲义 Part A p.40）：ηm = (Bw/Bc)/(Bw·Ac·N)，分子是系统信道数，分母是带宽 × 一个簇的面积。Bw 约掉，Bc 换成 MHz（30 kHz = 0.03 MHz）：
η = 1/(Bc·Ac·N) = 1/(0.03 × 10.39 × 9)
= 1/2.806 = 0.356 channels/MHz/km²
6
(iv) Self-check: compute directly from the definition with the actual 832 channels (each cluster uses 832 channels to cover 9 cells):(iv) 自检：用实际的 832 条信道按定义直接算（每簇 832 条信道覆盖 9 个小区）：
η = 832 / (25 MHz × 9 × 10.39 km²) = 832 / 2338 = 0.356 ✓
The whole-system calculation gives the same: 832/9 = 92.4 channels per cell × 144.3 cells ≈ 13 340 channels, ÷ (25 × 1500) ≈ 0.356 ✓.全系统算也一样：每小区 832/9 = 92.4 条 × 144.3 个小区 ≈ 13 340 条，÷ (25 × 1500) ≈ 0.356 ✓。
(i) ≈ 145 cells (ii) 832 channels (iii) 90 traffic channels/cell (iv) ≈ 0.36 channels/MHz/km²(i) ≈ 145 个小区 (ii) 832 条 (iii) 90 条话务信道/小区 (iv) ≈ 0.36 channels/MHz/km²
◆ Key points
What it tests
Number of cells, number of channels after removing guard bands, capacity per cell, spectral efficiency (Part A p.40).小区数、扣保护带后的信道数、每小区容量、频谱效率（Part A p.40）。
Knowledge used
Hexagon area (3√3/2)R²; number of channels = (total bandwidth − guard bands)/channel bandwidth; η = 1/(Bc·Ac·N).六边形面积 (3√3/2)R²；信道数 = (总带宽 − 保护带)/信道带宽；η = 1/(Bc·Ac·N)。
Method
Area → number of cells; remove guard bands → number of channels; remove control channels → ÷N; substitute into the spectral-efficiency formula.面积 → 小区数；扣保护带 → 信道数；扣控制信道 → ÷N；代频谱效率公式。
Common mistakes
Round the number of cells up; traffic channels per cell exclude the control channels; the unit is channels/MHz/km², so Bc is in MHz (0.03).小区数向上取整；每小区话务信道要扣掉控制信道；单位 channels/MHz/km²，Bc 用 MHz（0.03）。
Self-check
Compute it directly as "total channels ÷ (bandwidth × area)"; the result is again about 0.356.用"总信道 ÷ (带宽 × 面积)"直接算，结果同样约 0.356。
Concept + Step by step: number of cells, number of channels and spectral efficiency

ConceptBasic quantities in cellular planning

  • Hexagonal cell area: a regular hexagon of radius R (centre to vertex, also equal to the side length) has area (3√3/2)R² ≈ 2.598R².六边形小区面积：半径 R（中心到顶点，也等于边长）的正六边形面积 = (3√3/2)R² ≈ 2.598R²。
  • Number of channels: take the available spectrum, subtract the guard bands (they prevent interference with adjacent systems and cannot carry signals), then divide by the bandwidth per channel. The question gives "full-duplex channel bandwidth 30 kHz" directly: one full-duplex channel takes 30 kHz, so do not divide by 2 again.信道数：可用频谱扣掉保护带（guard band，防止相邻系统干扰、不能用来传信号），再除以每条信道的带宽。题目直接给了"全双工信道带宽 30 kHz"，一条全双工信道就占 30 kHz，不用再除以 2。
  • Control channels set up calls and carry signalling, not voice; cell capacity usually means the number of traffic channels.控制信道（control channel）用来建立呼叫、传信令，不承载话音；小区容量通常指话务信道（traffic channel）数。
  • Cluster: N adjacent cells share out all the channels, and the pattern repeats from cluster to cluster (frequency reuse, Part A p.78–81). With uniform fixed assignment, each cell gets 1/N.簇（cluster）：N 个相邻小区分完全部信道，簇与簇之间重复使用（频率复用，Part A p.78–81）。均匀固定分配时，每小区分到 1/N。
  • Spectral efficiency (Part A p.38–40): how many channels can be provided per MHz of spectrum per km² of area. Formula η = (Bw/Bc)/(Bw·Ac·N) = 1/(Bc·Ac·N), where Bc is the channel spacing (MHz), Ac the cell area (km²) and N the cluster size. The lecturer said you should "try to memorise" this formula; part (iv) of this question tests it.频谱效率（spectral efficiency，Part A p.38–40）：每 MHz 频谱、每 km² 面积上能提供几条信道。公式 η = (Bw/Bc)/(Bw·Ac·N) = 1/(Bc·Ac·N)，Bc 是信道间隔（MHz），Ac 是小区面积（km²），N 是簇大小。老师说这个公式"要试着记住"，本题 (iv) 就考了。

Step by step(i) Number of cells

Acell = 2.598 × 2² = 10.39 km²
Number of cells = 1500 / 10.39 = 144.3 → 145

Why round up: 144 cells cannot cover 1500 km², so one more is needed.为什么向上取整：144 个小区盖不满 1500 km²，必须再加一个。

Step by step(ii) Number of channels without reuse

Available bandwidth = 25 000 kHz − 40 kHz = 24 960 kHz
Number of channels = 24 960 / 30 = 832可用带宽 = 25 000 kHz − 40 kHz = 24 960 kHz
信道数 = 24 960 / 30 = 832 条

"without frequency reuse" means the total number of distinct channels in the whole system."without frequency reuse"就是整个系统一共有多少条不同的信道。

Step by step(iii) Cell capacity

Traffic channels = 832 − 18 = 814
Per cell = 814 / 9 = 90.4 → 90 traffic channels话务信道 = 832 − 18 = 814 条
每小区 = 814 / 9 = 90.4 → 90 条话务信道

Round down: half a channel cannot be used. If you include the control channels it is 832/9 ≈ 92; just state clearly which basis you use.向下取整：半条信道不能用。如果把控制信道也算进去，是 832/9 ≈ 92 条；写清楚自己的口径即可。

Step by step(iv) Spectral efficiency

Bc = 30 kHz = 0.03 MHz
η = 1/(0.03 × 10.39 × 9) = 1/2.806 ≈ 0.356 channels/MHz/km²

Self-check from the definition: total channels in the system = 832/9 = 92.44 per cell × 144.3 cells ≈ 13 344, divided by (25 MHz × 1500 km²) = 37 500, gives 0.356, which agrees. In the formula from the notes Bw cancels, so the result is 0.356 whether you use 25 MHz or the bandwidth after removing the guard band.用定义自检：系统总信道数 = 每小区 832/9 = 92.44 条 × 144.3 个小区 ≈ 13 344 条，除以 (25 MHz × 1500 km²) = 37 500，得 0.356，一致。讲义公式里 Bw 上下约掉，所以用 25 MHz 还是扣掉保护带后的带宽，结果都是 0.356。

PitfallsCommon ways to lose marks

  • Forgetting to subtract the 40 kHz guard band (giving 833 channels).忘了扣 40 kHz 保护带（得 833 条）。
  • Treating 30 kHz as a one-way channel and dividing by 2 again.把 30 kHz 当成单向信道，又除以 2。
  • Not subtracting the control channels from the cell capacity, or not rounding.小区容量不扣控制信道，或者不取整。
  • Units of η: Bc must be in MHz (0.03) and the area in km²; give the unit channels/MHz/km² in the answer (the lecturer said answers must have units).η 的单位：Bc 要用 MHz（0.03），面积用 km²；答案要写单位 channels/MHz/km²（老师说答案要写单位）。

ExamHow to write it in English

(i) Area of one hexagonal cell = (3√3/2)R² = 2.598 × 2² = 10.39 km². Number of cells = 1500/10.39 = 144.3, so about 145 cells are needed to cover the area.

(ii) Usable spectrum = 25 MHz − 40 kHz = 24 960 kHz. Number of full-duplex channels without frequency reuse = 24 960/30 = 832 channels.

(iii) Traffic channels = 832 − 18 control channels = 814. Cell capacity = 814/9 = 90.4, i.e. 90 traffic channels per cell.

(iv) Spectral efficiency η = (Bw/Bc)/(BwAcN) = 1/(BcAcN) = 1/(0.03 MHz × 10.39 km² × 9) ≈ 0.356 channels/MHz/km².

In one line: area 10.39 km² → 145 cells; (25 000 − 40)/30 = 832 channels; subtract 18 control channels and divide by 9 to get 90 per cell; η = 1/(BcAcN) ≈ 0.356 channels/MHz/km².一句话：面积 10.39 km² → 145 个小区；(25 000 − 40)/30 = 832 条；扣 18 条控制信道再 ÷9 得 90 条/小区；η = 1/(BcAcN) ≈ 0.356 channels/MHz/km²。
