Ch. 5 · How radio waves weaken: propagation models

1 practice · 0 past-examNotes →
Lecture example
p.65 (background p.58–64)

Received power from the CCIR model

Original questionSlide 65

Find the received power using CCIR model for

  • PT = 5W, d = 2km
  • GT = 10dBd, GR = 0 dBd
  • hT = 25m, hR = 2m
Use the CCIR urban model to find the received power PR (f = 900MHz).用 CCIR 城区模型求接收功率 PR（f = 900MHz）。
PT = 5Wd = 2kmGT = 10dBdGR = 0dBdhT = 25mhR = 2m

Approach: first compute a reference line PR = P0 + γ log d under standard conditions (PT = 10W, GT = 6dBd, GR = 0dBd, hT = 30m, hR = 3m), then correct it term by term with the correction table on p.63. CCIR urban: P0 = −71.04dBm, γ = −35.4.思路：先按标准条件（PT = 10W、GT = 6dBd、GR = 0dBd、hT = 30m、hR = 3m）算出一条基准直线 PR = P0 + γ log d，再用 p.63 的修正表逐项修正。CCIR 城区：P0 = −71.04dBm，γ = −35.4。

  1. Standard line: under standard conditions PR = P0 + γ log d (d in km, p.59–60). d = 2 km, log 2 = 0.301:标准线：标准条件下 PR = P0 + γ log d（d 用 km，p.59–60）。d = 2 km，log 2 = 0.301：
    −71.04 + (−35.4) × 0.301 = −71.04 − 10.66 = −81.70 dBm
    This is the power received by "standard equipment at 2 km"; the five corrections below (correction table, p.62–64) are all added to or subtracted from it.这是"标准设备放在 2 km 处"收到的功率，下面五项修正（p.62–64 修正表）都在它上面加减。
  2. Transmit power correction: in dB, multiplication and division become addition and subtraction, so the correction depends on the ratio to the standard 10 W:发射功率修正：dB 里乘除变加减，修正量看和标准 10 W 的比值：
    10 log(PT′/10) = 10 log(5/10) = 10 × (−0.301) = −3.01 dB
    Halving the power = −3 dB.
  3. Base-station height correction (intercept): L in the CCIR formula (p.55) contains −14 log hT, and PR contains −L, so the PR correction is +14 log(hT′/30):基站高度修正（截距）：CCIR 公式（p.55）的 L 里有 −14 log hT，而 PR 里是 −L，所以 PR 修正 +14 log(hT′/30)：
    log(25/30) = log 0.8333 = −0.0792
    14 × (−0.0792) = −1.11 dB
  4. Base-station height correction (slope): L also contains (45 − 6.5 log hT) log d, so hT also changes the slope of the line; this term must therefore also be multiplied by log d:基站高度修正（斜率）：L 里还有 (45 − 6.5 log hT) log d，hT 也改变了直线的斜率，所以这一项要再乘 log d：
    6.5 log(hT′/30) × log d = 6.5 × (−0.0792) × 0.301 = −0.15 dB
  5. Mobile height correction: A(hR) = (log f − 0.7)hR − (1.6 log f − 0.8); the second term does not depend on hR and cancels in the subtraction; the first term is linear in hR, and at f = 900 MHz its coefficient is log 900 − 0.7 = 2.954 − 0.7 = 2.25:终端高度修正：A(hR) = (log f − 0.7)hR − (1.6 log f − 0.8)，后一项和 hR 无关，相减时消掉；前一项对 hR 是线性的，f = 900 MHz 时系数 log 900 − 0.7 = 2.954 − 0.7 = 2.25：
    2.25 × (hR′ − 3) = 2.25 × (2 − 3) = −2.25 dB
    This term takes no logarithm; just multiply by the height difference.这一项不取对数，直接乘高度差。
  6. Antenna gain correction: the question and the standard both use dBd, so subtract directly; there is no need to convert to dBi (do not add 2.14):天线增益修正：题目和标准都用 dBd，直接相减，不用换成 dBi（不加 2.14）：
    GT: 10 − 6 = +4 dB; GR: 0 − 0 = 0 dB
  7. Add everything up and self-check:全部相加并自检：
    PR = −81.70 − 3.01 − 1.11 − 0.15 − 2.25 + 4 = −84.22 dBm
    Check: net correction −2.52 dB. Half the power and both antennas lower, so the result should be weaker than the standard line; the extra 4 dB of transmit antenna gain only offsets part of this, so the direction is right ✓. In linear terms: 10−84.22/10 mW ≈ 3.8 × 10⁻⁹ mW (3.8 pW), a normal level for the power received by a mobile.检查：净修正 −2.52 dB。功率减半、两根天线都更低，应该比标准线弱，发射天线多 4 dB 只抵掉一部分，方向对 ✓。换成线性：10−84.22/10 mW ≈ 3.8 × 10⁻⁹ mW（3.8 pW），是手机接收功率的正常量级。
PR = −84.22 dBm
ParameterStandard valueIntercept correctionSlope correction
PT10W10 log(PT′/10)0
hT30m14 log(hT′/30)6.5 log(hT′/30)
GT6dBdGT′ − 60
hR3m2.25(hR′ − 3)0
GR0dBdGR′ − 00
Draw the standard line first, then correct term by term. The coefficients in the correction table all come from the CCIR formula itself: −14 log hT → 14; (45 − 6.5 log hT) log d → 6.5; the term (log f − 0.7)hR in A(hR) equals 2.25 × hR at f = 900.先画标准线，再逐项修正。修正表里的系数都来自 CCIR 公式本身：−14 log hT → 14；(45 − 6.5 log hT) log d → 6.5；A(hR) 中的 (log f − 0.7)hR 在 f = 900 时等于 2.25 × hR。
① The power correction uses the ratio PT′/10W; ② the base station height needs two corrections (intercept and slope), and the slope term is also multiplied by log d; ③ antenna gains are in dBd, so subtract the standard value 6 directly.① 功率修正用比值 PT′/10W；② 基站高度要修正两项（截距和斜率），斜率那项还要乘 log d；③ 天线增益以 dBd 为单位，直接减去标准值 6。
Concept + Step by step: the CCIR model's standard line and corrections

ConceptEmpirical path loss model: draw a standard line first, then correct term by term

In a real city the signal is reflected and blocked by buildings, so theoretical formulas are inaccurate. Instead, an empirical path loss model is fitted to measured data, notes Part A p.55–64. The core relation (p.59, all in dB):真实城市里信号被楼房反射、遮挡，理论公式算不准，只能用实测数据拟合出经验模型（empirical path loss model），讲义 Part A p.55–64。核心关系（p.59，全部用 dB）：

PR = PT + GT + GR − L, where L is the path loss.

The notes first define a set of standard conditions (p.58–59): f = 900 MHz, PT = 10 W (= 40 dBm), GT = 6 dBd, GR = 0 dBd, hT = 30 m, hR = 3 m. Under the standard conditions, received power versus log d is a straight line:讲义先规定一组标准条件（p.58–59）：f = 900 MHz，PT = 10 W（= 40 dBm），GT = 6 dBd，GR = 0 dBd，hT = 30 m，hR = 3 m。在标准条件下，接收功率对 log d 是一条直线：

PR = P0 + γ log10d (d in km), where P0 is the intercept at d = 1 km and γ is the slope (= −10n). The table on p.60 gives CCIR urban: P0 = −71.04 dBm, γ = −35.4.PR = P0 + γ log10d（d 用 km），P0 是 d = 1 km 处的截距，γ 是斜率（= −10n）。p.60 的表给出 CCIR 城区：P0 = −71.04 dBm，γ = −35.4。

When the conditions differ from the standard, add or subtract the corrections from the table on p.62–64. Each correction comes from the CCIR formula on p.55, L = 69 + 26 log f − 14 log hT + (45 − 6.5 log hT) log d − A(hR). Because PR contains "−L", the signs are reversed:条件和标准不同时，按 p.62–64 的修正表加减。每一项修正都来自 p.55 的 CCIR 公式 L = 69 + 26 log f − 14 log hT + (45 − 6.5 log hT) log d − A(hR)，因为 PR 里是 "−L"，所以符号要反过来：

ParameterTerm in LCorrection to PR
PT—10 log(PT′/10 W)
hT (intercept)−14 log hT+14 log(hT′/30)
hT (slope)−6.5 log hT × log d+6.5 log(hT′/30) × log d
hR−(log f − 0.7)hR+(log 900 − 0.7)(hR′ − 3) = 2.25(hR′ − 3)
GT, GR—(GT′ − 6) + (GR′ − 0), in dBd

Note that the hR correction is linear (multiply the height difference directly), while the hT correction is logarithmic (log of the height ratio). Antenna gains are in dBd (relative to a half-wave dipole), 0 dBd = 2.14 dBi; both the question and the standard use dBd, so just subtract.注意 hR 的修正是线性的（直接乘高度差），hT 的修正是对数的（log 高度比）。天线增益用 dBd（相对半波偶极子），0 dBd = 2.14 dBi；题目和标准都用 dBd，直接相减即可。

Step by stepCompute the five corrections one by one

  1. Standard line: d = 2 km, log102 = 0.301. −71.04 − 35.4 × 0.301.
  2. Transmit power: 5 W is half of 10 W, 10 log 0.5 = −3.01 dB.发射功率：5 W 比 10 W 少一半，10 log 0.5 = −3.01 dB。
  3. BS height (intercept): 25 m is lower than 30 m, log(25/30) = log 0.8333 = −0.0792, times 14.基站高度（截距）：25 m 比 30 m 低，log(25/30) = log 0.8333 = −0.0792，乘 14。
  4. BS height (slope): the same −0.0792, times 6.5, and times log d = 0.301, because it changes the slope of the line.基站高度（斜率）：同一个 −0.0792，乘 6.5，还要乘 log d = 0.301，因为它改的是直线的斜率。
  5. MS height: 2 m is 1 m lower than 3 m, times 2.25.终端高度：2 m 比 3 m 低 1 m，乘 2.25。
  6. Antenna gain: GT of 10 dBd is 4 dB above the standard 6 dBd; GR is unchanged.天线增益：GT 10 dBd 比标准 6 dBd 多 4 dB；GR 不变。
  7. Add everything.
Standard line: −71.04 − 35.4 × 0.301 = −71.04 − 10.66 = −81.70 dBm
PT: 10 log(5/10) = −3.01 dB
hT intercept: 14 × log(25/30) = 14 × (−0.0792) = −1.11 dB
hT slope: 6.5 × (−0.0792) × 0.301 = −0.15 dB
hR: 2.25 × (2 − 3) = −2.25 dB
Gain: (10 − 6) + (0 − 0) = +4 dB
PR = −81.70 − 3.01 − 1.11 − 0.15 − 2.25 + 4 = −84.22 dBm标准线：−71.04 − 35.4 × 0.301 = −71.04 − 10.66 = −81.70 dBm
PT：10 log(5/10) = −3.01 dB
hT 截距：14 × log(25/30) = 14 × (−0.0792) = −1.11 dB
hT 斜率：6.5 × (−0.0792) × 0.301 = −0.15 dB
hR：2.25 × (2 − 3) = −2.25 dB
增益：(10 − 6) + (0 − 0) = +4 dB
PR = −81.70 − 3.01 − 1.11 − 0.15 − 2.25 + 4 = −84.22 dBm

Sanity check: half the power and both antennas lower, so weaker than the standard line (−81.70 dBm); the extra 4 dB of transmit antenna gain offsets part of it. Net change −2.52 dB, the right direction. In watts: 10−84.22/10 mW ≈ 3.8 × 10⁻⁹ mW = 3.8 pW, a normal level for a mobile's received power.合理性检查：功率减半、两根天线都更低，所以比标准线（−81.70 dBm）弱；发射天线增益多 4 dB 抵掉一部分。净变化 −2.52 dB，方向对。换成瓦：10−84.22/10 mW ≈ 3.8 × 10⁻⁹ mW = 3.8 pW，手机接收功率在这个量级是正常的。

Calculator tip: key in log 0.8333 directly; for 10 log(5/10) remember "half = −3 dB".计算器提示：log 0.8333 直接按；10 log(5/10) 记住"减半 = −3 dB"。

Pitfalls

  • The power correction uses the ratio PT′/10 W; do not write 10 log 5 = 7 dB.功率修正用比值 PT′/10 W，不要写 10 log 5 = 7 dB。
  • BS height has two corrections; the slope term must be multiplied by log d. Missing it costs 0.15 dB.基站高度有两项修正，斜率那项要乘 log d，漏掉就差 0.15 dB。
  • The hR correction takes no log; subtract the gains directly in dBd, do not add 2.14 again.hR 修正不取对数；增益差直接用 dBd 相减，不要再加 2.14。
  • d must be in km, and log is base 10.d 必须用 km，log 是以 10 为底。

ExamHow to write it in English

Under the standard conditions (PT = 10 W, GT = 6 dBd, GR = 0 dBd, hT = 30 m, hR = 3 m, f = 900 MHz), the CCIR urban model gives PR = P0 + γ log d with P0 = −71.04 dBm and γ = −35.4. At d = 2 km: PR = −71.04 − 35.4 log 2 = −81.70 dBm. Corrections: transmit power 10 log(5/10) = −3.01 dB; BS height (intercept) 14 log(25/30) = −1.11 dB; BS height (slope) 6.5 log(25/30) log 2 = −0.15 dB; MS height 2.25(2 − 3) = −2.25 dB; antenna gain (10 − 6) + (0 − 0) = +4 dB. Therefore PR = −81.70 − 3.01 − 1.11 − 0.15 − 2.25 + 4 = −84.22 dBm.

In one line: read −81.70 dBm off the standard line, then add five corrections (power ratio, two BS-height terms, MS height, gain difference) to get −84.22 dBm.一句话：先在标准线上读出 −81.70 dBm，再加五项修正（功率比、基站高度两项、终端高度、增益差），得 −84.22 dBm。

Ch. 6 · Frequency reuse: putting the hexagon's secret to work

2 practice · 1 past-examNotes →
Lecture example
p.82

Channels in a 7-cell FDD system

Original questionSlide 82

A 7-cell reuse FDD cellular system has a total of 30 MHz of bandwidth. Each simplex voice channel occupies 25 kHz bandwidth. A total of 2 MHz bandwidth is allocated to control channels. Determine the number of duplex voice channels in the system and per cell. Assume that uniform fixed channel assignment (UFCA) is used.

An FDD cellular system with 7-cell reuse uses uniform fixed channel assignment. Find the number of duplex voice channels in the system and per cell.7 小区复用的 FDD 蜂窝系统，采用均匀固定信道分配，求系统和每个小区的双工语音信道数。
Total bandwidth 30MHzSimplex channel 25kHzControl channels take 2MHz总带宽 30MHz单工信道 25kHz控制信道占 2MHz
  1. Subtract control: 2 MHz goes to control channels and cannot carry calls, so remove it first: 30 − 2 = 28 MHz for voice.减控制：2 MHz 给控制信道，不能用来通话，先扣掉：30 − 2 = 28 MHz 给语音。
  2. Split in half for FDD: FDD (frequency division duplex) uses two separate bands for uplink and downlink, each taking half: 28 ÷ 2 = 14 MHz/link (notes p.82: "assume each link has 14 MHz").FDD 对半分：FDD（frequency division duplex）上行和下行用两段分开的频带，各占一半：28 ÷ 2 = 14 MHz/链路（讲义 p.82："assume each link has 14 MHz"）。
  3. Divide by the simplex channel width: in kHz, each link holds除单工信道宽：单位统一成 kHz，每条链路能放
    14 MHz ÷ 25 kHz = 14,000 ÷ 25 = 560 simplex channels
  4. Pair them into duplex channels: a call needs one uplink + one downlink channel, so two simplex channels form one duplex channel, and the system has 560 duplex channels in total. Check: one duplex channel occupies 2 × 25 = 50 kHz, 28,000 ÷ 50 = 560 ✓.配成双工：一次通话要上行一条 + 下行一条，两条单工配成一个双工信道（duplex channel），所以系统共 560 个双工信道。验算：一个双工信道共占 2 × 25 = 50 kHz，28,000 ÷ 50 = 560 ✓。
  5. Per cell: with UFCA the 7 cells of a cluster share them equally (S/N per cell, p.81):分到每个小区：UFCA 下一簇 7 个小区平分（每小区 S/N，p.81）：
    560 ÷ 7 = 80 duplex channels/cell560 ÷ 7 = 80 个双工信道/小区
    Check: 80 × 7 = 560, divides exactly ✓.检查：80 × 7 = 560，正好分完 ✓。
System: 560 duplex channels · per cell: 80系统 560 个双工信道 · 每小区 80 个
Four steps in order: subtract control → halve → divide by channel width → divide by N.四步顺序：减控制 → 对半分 → 除信道宽 → 除 N。
Do not write 28000 ÷ 25 = 1120 duplex channels. 1120 is the total number of simplex channels; it takes two simplex channels to make one duplex channel.不要写成 28000 ÷ 25 = 1120 个双工信道。1120 是单工信道总数，两个单工才组成一个双工。
Concept + Step by step: number of FDD duplex channels

ConceptSimplex, duplex and FDD

A phone call is two-way: when you talk, the signal goes on the uplink (phone → base station); when you listen, it comes on the downlink (base station → phone).打电话是双向的：你说话走上行（uplink，手机 → 基站），听对方走下行（downlink，基站 → 手机）。

  • Simplex channel: one direction only; in this question each takes 25 kHz.单工信道（simplex channel）：只管一个方向，本题每条占 25 kHz。
  • Duplex channel: one uplink + one downlink paired together, needed to complete a call.双工信道（duplex channel）：一条上行 + 一条下行配成一对，才能完成一次通话。
  • FDD (Frequency Division Duplex, notes Part A p.37): uplink and downlink use two separate frequency bands, each taking half the bandwidth. TDD instead alternates uplink and downlink in time on the same band.FDD（Frequency Division Duplex，讲义 Part A p.37）：上行和下行用两段分开的频带，各占一半带宽。TDD 则是同一频带按时间轮流上下行。

Uniform fixed channel assignment (UFCA, p.81, p.92): the N cells of a cluster share all channels equally, S/N per cell. Control channels handle call set-up and paging and cannot carry calls, so subtract their bandwidth first.均匀固定信道分配（UFCA，uniform fixed channel assignment，p.81、p.92）：一簇 N 个小区平分全部信道，每个小区 S/N 条。控制信道负责呼叫建立和寻呼，不能拿来通话，所以要先把它们的带宽扣掉。

Step by stepFour steps: remove control → halve → divide by channel width → divide by N

  1. Remove control: of the 30 MHz, 2 MHz goes to control channels, leaving 28 MHz for voice.减控制：30 MHz 中有 2 MHz 给控制信道，剩 28 MHz 给语音。
  2. Halve: FDD gives half to each direction, 14 MHz per direction.对半分：FDD 上下行各一半，每个方向 14 MHz。
  3. Divide by channel width: how many 25 kHz simplex channels fit in each direction.除信道宽：每个方向能放多少条 25 kHz 的单工信道。
  4. Pair up: uplink channel k and downlink channel k form duplex channel k, so the number of duplex channels = the number of simplex channels in one direction.配对：上行第 k 条和下行第 k 条组成第 k 个双工信道，所以双工信道数 = 一个方向的单工信道数。
  5. Divide by N: under UFCA the 7 cells share them equally.除 N：UFCA 下 7 个小区平分。
Voice bandwidth = 30 − 2 = 28 MHz
Per direction = 28 ÷ 2 = 14 MHz
Simplex channels/direction = 14000 kHz ÷ 25 kHz = 560
Duplex channels (system) = 560
Per cell = 560 ÷ 7 = 80语音带宽 = 30 − 2 = 28 MHz
每个方向 = 28 ÷ 2 = 14 MHz
单工信道/方向 = 14000 kHz ÷ 25 kHz = 560
双工信道（系统）= 560
每小区 = 560 ÷ 7 = 80

Why halve: every call needs one uplink and one downlink at the same time, so the numbers of uplink and downlink channels must be equal; FDD splits the voice bandwidth evenly into an uplink band and a downlink band (notes p.82: "assume each link has 14 MHz"). With TDD there is no band split; the same band alternates uplink and downlink by time slot (p.37).为什么要对半分：每一通电话同时需要一条上行和一条下行，所以上下行的信道数必须一样多；FDD 把语音带宽平均切成上行频带和下行频带（讲义 p.82 原文 "assume each link has 14 MHz"）。如果是 TDD，就不分频带，而是同一频带按时隙轮流上下行（p.37）。

Check (another way): one duplex channel takes 2 × 25 = 50 kHz in total, 28000 ÷ 50 = 560, the same result.验算（另一种算法）：一个双工信道总共占 2 × 25 = 50 kHz，28000 ÷ 50 = 560，结果相同。

Variation (not asked in the notes): for the number of control channels, the same method gives 2000 kHz ÷ 50 kHz = 40 duplex control channels, on average 40 ÷ 7 ≈ 5.7 per cell (in practice some cells get 6 and some 5).变式（讲义没问）：如果问控制信道数，同样做法 2000 kHz ÷ 50 kHz = 40 个双工控制信道，平均每小区 40 ÷ 7 ≈ 5.7 个（实际分配时有的小区 6 个、有的 5 个）。

Pitfalls

  • Writing 28000 ÷ 25 = 1120 duplex channels is wrong: 1120 is the total number of uplink plus downlink simplex channels, and two of them make one duplex channel.写成 28000 ÷ 25 = 1120 个双工信道是错的：1120 是上下行加起来的单工信道总数，两条才配一个双工。
  • Remove control first, then halve; doing it the other way (30 ÷ 2 − 2) gives 13 MHz/direction, which is wrong.先减控制再对半分；顺序反过来（30 ÷ 2 − 2）会得到 13 MHz/方向，错。
  • Convert everything to kHz before dividing.单位统一成 kHz 再除。

ExamHow to write it in English

Bandwidth for voice = 30 − 2 = 28 MHz. In FDD, each link (uplink and downlink) has 28/2 = 14 MHz. Number of simplex voice channels per link = 14 000 kHz / 25 kHz = 560. Since each duplex voice channel needs one simplex channel in each link, the system has 560 duplex voice channels. With UFCA and N = 7, each cell has 560/7 = 80 duplex voice channels.

In one line: remove control → halve → divide by 25 kHz → one pair of simplex = one duplex → divide by 7, giving 560 for the system and 80 per cell.一句话：减控制 → 对半分 → 除 25 kHz → 一对单工 = 一个双工 → 除 7，得系统 560、每小区 80。
Lecture example
p.89

Choosing the cluster size for SIR ≥ 10dB

Original questionSlide 89

If a SIR of 10 dB is required for a cellular system, find the optimum cluster size with the path loss exponent to be 4. Using simple analysis assumptions.

The system requires SIR = 10dB with path loss exponent n = 4. Use the simplified analysis to find the required and the optimum cluster size.系统要求 SIR = 10dB，路径损耗指数 n = 4，用简化分析求所需簇尺寸与最优簇尺寸。
  1. Write the SIR formula: simplified assumptions (p.88): count only the 6 first-tier co-channel interferers; the mobile is at the cell edge, at distance R from its own base station, and all 6 interfering base stations are at distance D from it:写 SIR 公式：简化假设（p.88）：只算第一层 6 个同频干扰源（co-channel interferer），手机在小区边缘、离自己基站 R，6 个干扰基站都离它 D：
    S/I = R−n / (6D−n) = Qn/6, Q = D/R = √(3N)
    Q is called the co-channel reuse ratio.
  2. Substitute n = 4: Q⁴ = (√(3N))⁴ = (3N)², so the square root disappears: S/I = (3N)²/6代 n = 4：Q⁴ = (√(3N))⁴ = (3N)²，根号正好消掉：S/I = (3N)²/6
  3. Convert the thresholds to linear values: 10 dB → 1010/10 = 10; 18 dB → 101.8 = 63.1. Do not mix dB and linear values when comparing.门槛换成线性值：10 dB → 1010/10 = 10；18 dB → 101.8 = 63.1。比较时 dB 和线性值不能混用。
  4. Try each valid N in turn: N can only be i² + ij + j², i.e. 1, 3, 4, 7, 9, 12, 13 … (the hexagons must tile into a cluster). Take N = 7 as an example: 3 × 7 = 21, 21² = 441, 441 ÷ 6 = 73.5, 10 log 73.5 = 18.66 dB.逐个代入合法 N：N 只能取 i² + ij + j²，即 1, 3, 4, 7, 9, 12, 13 …（六边形要能拼成簇）。以 N = 7 为例：3 × 7 = 21，21² = 441，441 ÷ 6 = 73.5，10 log 73.5 = 18.66 dB。
    N(3N)²/6SIR
    11.51.76 dB
    313.511.30 dB ← first ≥ 10dB
    42413.80 dB
    773.518.66 dB ← first > 18dB
    9121.520.85 dB
    1221623.34 dB
    13253.524.04 dB
  5. (a) Required cluster size: you need SIR ≥ 10 dB. N = 1 gives only 1.76 dB ✗, N = 3 gives 11.30 dB ✓, so N = 3. Check by solving backwards: (3N)²/6 ≥ 10 → 3N ≥ √60 = 7.746 → N ≥ 2.58 → the next valid value is 3 ✓.(a) 所需簇尺寸（required cluster size）：要 SIR ≥ 10 dB。N = 1 只有 1.76 dB ✗，N = 3 有 11.30 dB ✓，所以 N = 3。反解验算：(3N)²/6 ≥ 10 → 3N ≥ √60 = 7.746 → N ≥ 2.58 → 下一个合法值是 3 ✓。
  6. (b) Optimum cluster size: notes p.89 say that voice quality needs SIR > 18 dB. N = 4 gives only 13.80 dB ✗, N = 7 gives 18.66 dB ✓, so N = 7. Solving backwards: 3N ≥ √(6 × 63.1) = 19.46 → N ≥ 6.49 → take 7 (5 and 6 are not valid N) ✓. Check: with n = 4, S/I ∝ N², so making N 4 times larger adds 10 log 16 = 12.04 dB to the SIR; in the table, N = 3 → 12 goes from 11.30 to 23.34 dB, exactly this ✓.(b) 最优簇尺寸（optimum cluster size）：讲义 p.89 说语音质量要 SIR > 18 dB。N = 4 只有 13.80 dB ✗，N = 7 有 18.66 dB ✓，所以 N = 7。反解：3N ≥ √(6 × 63.1) = 19.46 → N ≥ 6.49 → 取 7（5、6 不是合法 N）✓。 检查：n = 4 时 S/I ∝ N²，N 变 4 倍 SIR 加 10 log 16 = 12.04 dB；表中 N = 3 → 12 正好从 11.30 到 23.34 dB ✓。
Required cluster size N = 3 (SIR ≥ 10dB) · optimum cluster size N = 7 (voice quality needs SIR > 18dB)所需簇尺寸 N = 3（SIR ≥ 10dB） · 最优簇尺寸 N = 7（语音质量要求 SIR > 18dB）
For n = 4, S/I = (3N)²/6, with no square root. N = 7 → 21² = 441 → ÷6 = 73.5 → 10 log 73.5 = 20 − 1.34 ≈ 18.66dB.n = 4 时 S/I = (3N)²/6，不用开根号。N = 7 → 21² = 441 → ÷6 = 73.5 → 10 log 73.5 = 20 − 1.34 ≈ 18.66dB。
The question asks for two different answers: "required" is the smallest N that meets the threshold, and "optimum" is the N that meets the 18dB voice-quality target. Answering only one loses marks.题目问了两个不同的答案：「required」对应满足门槛的最小 N，「optimum」对应满足 18dB 语音质量的 N。只答一个会丢分。
Concept + Step by step: choosing cluster size N from SIR

ConceptCo-channel interference, reuse ratio Q and cluster size N

Frequency reuse: the same set of frequencies is reused in every cluster. Two cells using the same frequency are a distance D apart (reuse distance), notes Part A p.78: D = R√(3N), and Q = D/R = √(3N) is called the reuse ratio.频率复用：同一组频率每隔一个簇就重复使用一次。两个使用同一频率的小区中心相距 D（复用距离，reuse distance），讲义 Part A p.78：D = R√(3N)，Q = D/R = √(3N) 叫复用比。

N can only take values i² + ij + j² (i, j non-negative integers, p.75): 1, 3, 4, 7, 9, 12, 13 …, because the hexagons must tile into a cluster without gaps.N 只能取 i² + ij + j²（i、j 为非负整数，p.75）这样的值：1, 3, 4, 7, 9, 12, 13 …，因为六边形必须能无缝拼成簇。

SIR (signal-to-interference ratio, p.83–84): S/I = S / ΣIi. Considering only path loss, received power ∝ distance−n, where n is the path loss exponent.SIR（signal-to-interference ratio，p.83–84）：S/I = S / ΣIi。只考虑路径损耗时，接收功率 ∝ 距离−n，n 是路径损耗指数。

Simplifying assumptions (p.88): count only the 6 first-tier co-channel interfering cells; the mobile is at the cell edge, a distance R from its own base station; all 6 interfering base stations are taken at distance D. Then简化假设（p.88）：只算第一层 6 个同频干扰小区；手机在小区边缘，到自己基站距离 R；6 个干扰基站都按距离 D 算。于是

S/I = R−n / (6 D−n) = Qn/6 = (√(3N))n/6

For n = 4 the square root cancels exactly: S/I = (3N)²/6. Trade-off (p.78): larger N → larger D → better SIR, but fewer channels per cell (S/N) and lower capacity; smaller N is the opposite. So look for the N that is "just enough".n = 4 时根号正好消掉：S/I = (3N)²/6。取舍（p.78）：N 大 → D 远 → SIR 好，但每个小区分到的信道少（S/N），容量低；N 小则相反。所以要找"刚好够用"的 N。

Step by stepTwo methods: try N from a list, or solve backwards

Method 1: substitute one by one (the method on notes p.89).做法一：逐个代入（讲义 p.89 的做法）。

NQ = √(3N)(3N)²/6SIR (dB)
11.7321.51.76
33.00013.511.30
43.4642413.80
74.58373.518.66
95.196121.520.85
126.00021623.34
136.245253.524.04

For example N = 7: 3 × 7 = 21, 21² = 441, 441 ÷ 6 = 73.5, 10 log1073.5 = 18.66 dB.

Method 2: solve backwards (faster, recommended in the exam). Convert dB to linear first, solve for N, then round up to the nearest valid N.做法二：反解（更快，考场推荐）。先把 dB 换成线性值，再解 N，最后往上取到最近的合法 N。

10 dB → 1010/10 = 10
(3N)²/6 ≥ 10 → 3N ≥ √60 = 7.746 → N ≥ 2.58 → valid N = 3
18 dB → 101.8 = 63.1
(3N)²/6 ≥ 63.1 → 3N ≥ 19.46 → N ≥ 6.49 → valid N = 7

Sanity check: for n = 4, S/I ∝ N², so making N 4 times larger raises SIR by 10 log 16 = 12.04 dB. In the table, N = 3 → 12: 11.30 → 23.34 dB, exactly 12.04 dB apart; larger N gives higher SIR, also the right direction.合理性检查：n = 4 时 S/I ∝ N²，所以 N 变成 4 倍，SIR 增加 10 log 16 = 12.04 dB。表里 N = 3 → 12：11.30 → 23.34 dB，正好差 12.04 dB；N 越大 SIR 越高，方向也对。

Why there are two answers: the question requires SIR of 10 dB, and the smallest N meeting it is 3, which the notes call the required cluster size. But the notes then say voice quality needs SIR above 18 dB (the empirical AMPS requirement), so the optimum cluster size is 7. In the exam, write both and give the reasons.为什么有两个答案：题目说 SIR 要求 10 dB，满足它的最小 N 是 3，讲义称为 required cluster size。但讲义接着说语音质量要 SIR 大于 18 dB（AMPS 的经验要求），所以 optimum cluster size 取 7。考试把两个都写出来并说明理由。

Pitfalls

  • N = 5, 6, 8 are not valid cluster sizes; solving backwards gives 6.49, which must become 7, not 6.5 or 6.N = 5、6、8 不是合法簇尺寸，反解出 6.49 要取 7，不是 6.5 或 6。
  • Use the same units before comparing: either all dB or all linear.比较前先统一单位：要么都用 dB，要么都用线性值。
  • For n = 4, Q⁴ = (3N)², so no further square root is needed.n = 4 时 Q⁴ = (3N)²，不用再开根号。

ExamHow to write it in English

With the simple assumptions (six first-tier co-channel interferers, all at distance D, mobile at the cell edge), S/I = Qn/6 with Q = √(3N). For n = 4, S/I = (3N)²/6. For N = 1, 3, 4, 7, 9, 12, 13 this gives 1.76, 11.30, 13.80, 18.66, 20.85, 23.34 and 24.04 dB. N ≥ 3 gives SIR above 10 dB, so the required cluster size is N = 3. For sufficient voice quality the SIR should exceed 18 dB, so the optimum cluster size is N = 7 (S/I = 73.5 = 18.66 dB).

In one line: for n = 4, S/I = (3N)²/6; the smallest N for the 10 dB requirement is 3, and the optimum N for 18 dB voice quality is 7.一句话：n = 4 时 S/I = (3N)²/6；10 dB 要求的最小 N = 3，满足 18 dB 语音质量的最优 N = 7。
Past final exam
2025-26 S2Q3(a)6 marks
Topics: channels per cell · cluster area · number of times the cluster is replicated · system capacity考点：每小区信道 · 簇面积 · 簇复制次数 · 系统容量
Original question (verbatim)

3. (a) A new operator B is designing the cellular network for a city in South China which has a total of 1071 radio channels available for handling the traffic. Suppose the area of each cell is 6 km2 and the total area of the entire system is 2100 km2. Let the cluster size of the design be 7. Determine the following results.

(i) Number of channels per cell and the total coverage area of each cluster.

(ii) Number of times to replicate this cluster to cover the entire system.

(iii) System capacity for this network.

(6 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
(i) Channels per cell: cluster size N = 7, and one cluster uses all S = 1071 channels; with uniform fixed channel assignment (UFCA), each cell gets S/N channels (notes Part A p.81):(i) 每小区信道：簇大小 N = 7，一个簇用全部 S = 1071 条信道；均匀固定分配（UFCA）时每个小区分到 S/N 条（讲义 Part A p.81）：
k = S/N = 1071/7 = 153 channels/cell
2
(i) Cluster area: one cluster consists of 7 cells:(i) 簇面积：一个簇由 7 个小区组成：
Acluster = N × Acell = 7 × 6 km² = 42 km²
3
(ii) Number of cluster replications: the whole service area must be tiled with clusters:(ii) 复制次数：整个服务区要被簇铺满：
M = Asys/Acluster = 2100/42 = 50 times

In total 7 × 50 = 350 cells; directly, 2100/6 = 350 ✓
共 7 × 50 = 350 个小区；直接算 2100/6 = 350 ✓
4
(iii) System capacity: every cluster uses all 1071 channels once, and the cluster is replicated M times (p.81: T = C × N × S/N = CS, where C in the notes is the number of clusters, i.e. M here):(iii) 系统容量：每个簇都把全部 1071 条信道用一遍，簇复制了 M 次（p.81：T = C × N × S/N = CS，讲义的 C 是簇数，这里就是 M）：
T = M × S = 50 × 1071 = 53 550 channels

Self-check: per cell, 153 channels × 350 cells = 53 550 ✓. The same set of 1071 channels is reused 50 times; this is the capacity gained from frequency reuse.
自检：按小区算 153 条 × 350 个小区 = 53 550 ✓。同一组 1071 条信道被重复用了 50 次，这就是频率复用带来的容量。
153 channels/cell, 42 km²/cluster; replicated 50 times; system capacity 53 550 channels153 条/小区，42 km²/簇；复制 50 次；系统容量 53 550 条信道
◆ Key points
What it tests
Channels per cell, cluster area, number of cluster replications, system capacity (Part A frequency reuse).每小区信道、簇面积、簇复制次数、系统容量（Part A 频率复用）。
Knowledge used
Channels per cell = total channels / N; cluster area = N × cell area; number of replications = service area / cluster area; system capacity = channels per cluster × number of replications.每小区信道 = 总信道 / N；簇面积 = N × 小区面积；复制次数 = 服务区面积 / 簇面积；系统容量 = 每簇信道 × 复制次数。
Common mistakes
System capacity is the sum of the channels in all cells (53 550), not the 1071 of one cluster.系统容量是所有小区信道之和（53 550），不是一个簇的 1071。
Conclusion
Frequency reuse is where cellular capacity comes from: the same set of channels is used 50 times. The smaller the cluster, the more replications and the higher the capacity, but the stronger the co-channel interference.频率复用是蜂窝容量的来源：同一组信道用了 50 次。簇越小，复制次数越多，容量越大，但同频干扰越强。
Concept + Step by step: number of cluster replications and system capacity

ConceptFrequency reuse and system capacity

An operator has only a limited set of channels (1071 in this question). The cellular approach is (Part A p.78–81):运营商只有一组有限的信道（本题 1071 条）。蜂窝系统的办法是（Part A p.78–81）：

  • Group N neighbouring cells into a cluster; the N cells in a cluster share all S channels, with different frequencies in neighbouring cells to avoid interference; with uniform fixed allocation each cell gets S/N channels.把 N 个相邻小区组成一个簇（cluster），簇内 N 个小区分完全部 S 条信道，相邻小区频率不同，避免干扰；均匀固定分配时每小区 S/N 条。
  • The whole service area is tiled by C clusters, and every cluster reuses the same set of S channels (frequency reuse); co-channel cells are separated by the reuse distance D = R√(3N).整个服务区由 C 个簇拼成，每个簇都重复使用同一组 S 条信道（频率复用，frequency reuse），相同频率之间隔开复用距离 D = R√(3N)。
  • System capacity (the total number of channels the whole system can offer at the same time) T = C × N × S/N = C × S (p.81).系统容量（全系统能同时提供的信道总数）T = C × N × S/N = C × S（p.81）。

So capacity comes from "how many times the cluster is replicated": the smaller the cluster (smaller N), the smaller the cluster area, the more replications and the higher the capacity, but co-channel cells are closer together and interference is stronger (p.78: the choice of N is a trade-off between capacity and quality of service).所以容量的来源就是"复制了几次簇"：簇越小（N 越小），簇面积越小，复制次数越多，容量越大，但同频小区靠得更近，干扰更强（p.78：N 的选择是容量和服务质量之间的折中）。

Step by stepCalculation step by step

  1. Channels per cell:
    S/N = 1071 / 7 = 153 channels/cell
  2. Area per cluster: a cluster has 7 cells of 6 km² each:每簇面积：一个簇有 7 个小区，每个 6 km²：
    7 × 6 = 42 km²
  3. Number of replications:
    C = 2100 / 42 = 50 times (50 × 7 = 350 cells in total)
  4. System capacity:
    T = C × S = 50 × 1071 = 53 550 channels (= 153 × 350)

Check: both methods (channels per cluster × number of clusters, channels per cell × number of cells) give the same result. The 1071 channels are reused 50 times, so capacity is multiplied by 50.检查：两种算法（每簇信道 × 簇数，每小区信道 × 小区数）结果相同。1071 条信道被重复用了 50 次，容量放大了 50 倍。

PitfallsCommon ways to lose marks

  • Giving the system capacity as 1071: that is only the channel count of one cluster.系统容量答成 1071：那只是一个簇的信道数。
  • Dividing by the cell area to get the replications: 2100/6 = 350 is the number of cells, not clusters.复制次数用小区面积去除：2100/6 = 350 是小区数，不是簇数。
  • Leaving out units (channels, km², times).答案不写单位（条信道、km²、次）。

ExamHow to write it in English

(i) Number of channels per cell = 1071/7 = 153 channels. Coverage area of each cluster = 7 × 6 km² = 42 km².

(ii) Number of times the cluster is replicated = 2100/42 = 50 (i.e. 350 cells in total).

(iii) System capacity = (channels per cluster) × (number of clusters) = 1071 × 50 = 53 550 channels (= 153 × 350). The same set of 1071 channels is reused 50 times through frequency reuse.

In one line: 1071/7 = 153 channels per cell, cluster area 42 km², 2100/42 = 50 replications, system capacity 1071 × 50 = 53 550 channels.一句话：每小区 1071/7 = 153 条，簇面积 42 km²，复制 2100/42 = 50 次，系统容量 1071 × 50 = 53 550 条信道。
→ Back to the learning page: Part A Ch. 6 Frequency reuse: putting the hexagon's secret to work→ 回到讲解：Part A 第六章 频率复用：把六边形的秘密用起来

Ch. 7 · Co-channel interference and how to assign channels

2 practice · 2 past-examNotes →
Lecture example
p.91

Worst-case SIR (N = 7, n = 4)

Original questionSlide 91 · “The Worse Case”

Case 1: Then SIR,

S/I = R−n / [2(D − R)−n + 2D−n + 2(D + R)−n] = 1 / [2(Q − 1)−n + 2Q−n + 2(Q + 1)−n]

N = 7, n = 4, S/I = ? dB

Case 2: To be conservative, shortest distance D − R for all 6 interferers, then

S/I = R−n / 6(D − R)−n = 1 / 6(Q − 1)−n

N = 7, n = 4, S/I = ? dB

This page is a derivation with no separate question. The original text is below, with the results replaced by ?.这页是推导页，没有单独的题干。下面是原文，结果用 ? 代替。
The mobile is at the cell edge, so the 6 first-tier interferers are no longer at equal distances from it. Find S/I for two cases.移动台位于小区边缘，第一层 6 个干扰源到它的距离不再相等。分两种情况求 S/I。
  1. Find Q: N = 7, Q = √(3N) = √21 = 4.5826. The fourth power comes next and amplifies errors, so keep extra decimal places in the intermediate steps.求 Q：N = 7，Q = √(3N) = √21 = 4.5826。后面要算四次方，误差会放大，中间多留几位小数。
  2. Fourth powers of the three distances: divide all distances by R (D/R = Q); on the calculator use x⁴ = (x²)²:三个距离的四次方：距离都除以 R（D/R = Q），计算器用 x⁴ = (x²)²：
    (Q − 1)⁴ = 3.5826⁴: 3.5826² = 12.835, 12.835² = 164.7
    Q⁴ = (3N)² = 21² = 441
    (Q + 1)⁴ = 5.5826⁴: 5.5826² = 31.165, 31.165² = 971.3
  3. Case 1: the mobile is at the cell edge, and the 6 interferers fall into three groups: 2 near (D − R), 2 at D, 2 far (D + R) (p.91). Divide numerator and denominator by R−n:情况 1：手机在小区边缘，6 个干扰源分三组：2 个近（D − R）、2 个在 D、2 个远（D + R）（p.91）。分子分母同除 R−n：
    S/I = 1 / [2(Q−1)⁻⁴ + 2Q⁻⁴ + 2(Q+1)⁻⁴]
    = 1 / (2/164.7 + 2/441 + 2/971.3)
    = 1 / (0.01214 + 0.00454 + 0.00206)
    = 1/0.01874 = 53.4 → 10 log 53.4 = 17.27 dB
    Add the interference powers first, then take the reciprocal; do not add dB values.要先把干扰功率加起来再取倒数，不能把 dB 相加。
  4. Case 2 (conservative): take all 6 interferers at the shortest distance D − R:情况 2（保守）：6 个干扰源全按最近距离 D − R 算（conservative）：
    S/I = 1 / [6(Q−1)⁻⁴] = (Q−1)⁴/6 = 164.7 ÷ 6 = 27.5 → 10 log 27.5 = 14.39 dB
  5. Compare and self-check: the more pessimistic the assumption, the lower the SIR: 18.66 dB (all 6 at D, p.89) > 17.27 dB > 14.39 dB ✓. In case 1 the 2 nearest interferers make up 0.01214 ÷ 0.01874 = 65% of the total interference: with n = 4, being slightly closer makes the interference much larger. Both worst cases fall below 18 dB, which is why sectoring (p.145) is used later.对比自检：越悲观 SIR 越低：18.66 dB（6 个都在 D，p.89）> 17.27 dB > 14.39 dB ✓。情况 1 里最近的 2 个干扰源占总干扰的 0.01214 ÷ 0.01874 = 65%：n = 4 时距离近一点，干扰就大很多。两种最坏情况都低于 18 dB，这就是后面要用扇区化（p.145）的原因。
Case 1: 17.27 dB · Case 2: 14.39 dB
The more pessimistic the assumption, the lower the value: 18.66 (all at D) > 17.27 (two each at D−R, D, D+R) > 14.39 (all at D−R).三种口径越悲观越低：18.66（全在 D）> 17.27（D−R、D、D+R 各两个）> 14.39（全在 D−R）。
In case 2 the denominator is still 6. Case 1 groups the interferers 2+2+2, so each group has a coefficient of 2.情况 2 的分母仍然是 6。情况 1 是 2+2+2 的分组，每组系数是 2。
Concept + Step by step: two ways to compute worst-case SIR

ConceptWhy compute the "worst case"

The simplified method on p.88 assumes all 6 interfering base stations are a distance D from the mobile. But when the mobile is at the cell edge, it is closer to some interfering cells and farther from others. Notes Part A p.90–91 use two more pessimistic approximations:p.88 的简化算法假设 6 个干扰基站都离手机 D。可手机站在小区边缘时，它离某些干扰小区更近、离另一些更远。讲义 Part A p.90–91 用两种更悲观的近似：

  • Case 1: the 6 interferers form three groups: 2 at D − R, 2 at D, 2 at D + R.
    S/I = R−n / [2(D−R)−n + 2D−n + 2(D+R)−n] = 1 / [2(Q−1)−n + 2Q−n + 2(Q+1)−n]情况 1：6 个干扰源分成三组，2 个在 D − R，2 个在 D，2 个在 D + R。
    S/I = R−n / [2(D−R)−n + 2D−n + 2(D+R)−n] = 1 / [2(Q−1)−n + 2Q−n + 2(Q+1)−n]
  • Case 2 (conservative): all 6 are taken at the nearest distance D − R.
    S/I = 1 / [6(Q−1)−n] = (Q−1)n/6情况 2（保守，conservative）：6 个全按最近距离 D − R 算。
    S/I = 1 / [6(Q−1)−n] = (Q−1)n/6

Where the second equals sign comes from: divide numerator and denominator by R−n, and D/R becomes Q. So you only need Q = √(3N) and n.第二个等号的来历：分子分母同除以 R−n，D/R 就变成 Q。所以只要知道 Q = √(3N) 和 n 就能算。

Key point: interference power ∝ distance−n; for n = 4, a slightly shorter distance gives much more interference (distance × 0.78, interference × 2.7). So the two nearest interferers contribute most of the interference.要点：干扰功率 ∝ 距离−n，n = 4 时距离近一点，干扰就大很多（距离 × 0.78，干扰 × 2.7）。所以最近的那两个干扰源贡献了大部分干扰。

Step by stepCompute the fourth powers first, then substitute

  1. Find Q: N = 7, Q = √21 = 4.5826 (fourth powers amplify errors, so keep more decimals in between).求 Q：N = 7，Q = √21 = 4.5826（四次方会放大误差，中间多留几位小数）。
  2. Fourth powers of the three distances (calculator tip: x⁴ = (x²)²).三个距离的四次方（计算器提示：x⁴ = (x²)²）。
  3. Case 1: add the three groups of interference (coefficient 2 each), then take the reciprocal.情况 1：把三组干扰相加（每组系数 2），再取倒数。
  4. Case 2: simply (Q−1)⁴ ÷ 6.
  5. Convert to dB: 10 log10.
Q − 1 = 3.5826: 3.5826² = 12.835, 12.835² = 164.7
Q⁴ = 21² = 441
Q + 1 = 5.5826: 5.5826² = 31.165, 31.165² = 971.3
Case 1: 2/164.7 + 2/441 + 2/971.3 = 0.01214 + 0.00454 + 0.00206 = 0.01874
S/I = 1 ÷ 0.01874 = 53.4 → 10 log 53.4 = 17.27 dB
Case 2: S/I = 164.7 ÷ 6 = 27.5 → 10 log 27.5 = 14.39 dB

Comparing the three assumptions: the more pessimistic, the lower the SIR.三种口径对比：越悲观 SIR 越低。

AssumptionS/IdB
All 6 at D (p.88–89)73.518.66
2 + 2 + 2 (Case 1)53.417.27
All 6 at D − R (Case 2)27.514.39

What it means: in the worst case, the SIR for N = 7 is below the 18 dB voice requirement. The fix is either a larger N or sectoring (p.143–145) to reduce the number of interferers, which motivates the later example on p.145.意义：按最坏情况算，N = 7 的 SIR 低于 18 dB 的语音要求。解决办法要么加大 N，要么用扇区化（p.143–145）减少干扰源，这就是后面 p.145 例题的动机。

Pitfalls

  • Case 2 still has 6 in the denominator (6 interferers); only the distances all become D − R.情况 2 分母仍然有 6（6 个干扰源），只是距离都换成 D − R。
  • Case 1 is not three interferers but three groups of 2, so each term has a coefficient of 2.情况 1 不是三个干扰源，是三组、每组 2 个，每项前面系数 2。
  • Add first, then take the reciprocal; you cannot add the dB values of the three terms.先相加再取倒数，不能把三项的 dB 值相加。

ExamHow to write it in English

For N = 7, Q = √(3N) = √21 = 4.583. Case 1: S/I = 1/[2(Q−1)⁻⁴ + 2Q⁻⁴ + 2(Q+1)⁻⁴] = 1/[2/164.7 + 2/441 + 2/971.3] = 1/0.01874 = 53.4, i.e. 17.27 dB. Case 2 (all six interferers at D − R): S/I = (Q−1)⁴/6 = 164.7/6 = 27.5, i.e. 14.39 dB. Both are lower than the 18.66 dB obtained with the simple equidistant assumption.

In one line: for N = 7, n = 4, the 2+2+2 grouping gives 17.27 dB and all-at-D − R gives 14.39 dB, both lower than the 18.66 dB of the simplified method.一句话：N = 7、n = 4 时，2+2+2 分组得 17.27 dB，全按 D − R 得 14.39 dB，都比简化算法的 18.66 dB 低。
Lecture example
p.93

Fixed channel assignment: 210 channels

Original questionSlide 93

If the total number of system channel is 210. Compute the number of channels per cell if the fixed channel assignment is used.

The system has 210 channels in total with fixed channel assignment (N = 7). Find the number of channels per cell.系统共有 210 条信道，采用固定信道分配（N = 7），求每个小区的信道数。
  1. Fix N: the question does not give the cluster size; the notes solve it with 7-cell reuse (p.93 "1/7"). In the exam, first write "Assume N = 7".确定 N：题目没给簇尺寸，讲义按 7 小区复用来解（p.93 "1/7"）。考试时先写一句 "Assume N = 7"。
  2. Equal split under UFCA: uniform fixed channel assignment (p.92) gives every cell in a cluster the same number of channels, S/N (p.81):UFCA 平分：均匀固定信道分配（uniform fixed channel assignment，p.92）让一簇里每个小区分到一样多的信道 S/N（p.81）：
    210 ÷ 7 = 30 channels/cell
  3. Subtract the control channel: each cell usually reserves 1 channel as the control channel (call setup, paging); without it, mobiles cannot access the system:扣控制信道：每个小区通常留 1 条做控制信道（呼叫建立、寻呼），没有它手机无法接入：
    30 − 1 = 29 channels available for calls30 − 1 = 29 条可用于通话
  4. Self-check: 30 × 7 = 210, divides exactly with no remainder ✓.自检：30 × 7 = 210，正好分完、没有余数 ✓。
30 per cell, of which 29 can carry calls每小区 30 条，可用于通话的 29 条
UFCA = total ÷ N, then subtract control.UFCA = 总数 ÷ N，再减控制。
Remember to subtract 1 control channel at the end, or you get only half the marks.最后要减 1 条控制信道，否则只拿一半分。
Concept + Step by step: fixed channel assignment (FCA)

ConceptHow channels are given to each cell: fixed vs dynamic assignment

Spectrum is limited and users are many, so a channel assignment method is needed, notes Part A p.92–95.频谱有限，用户很多，所以要设计信道分配（channel assignment）方法，讲义 Part A p.92–95。

  • Fixed channel assignment (FCA): each cell (base station) is given a fixed set of channels in advance. Calls in a cell can only use that cell's idle channels; when all are busy, the call is blocked.固定信道分配 FCA（fixed channel assignment）：事先给每个小区（基站）一组固定的信道。小区里的呼叫只能用本小区的空闲信道；全部占满就阻塞（blocked）。
  • Uniform FCA (UFCA): every cell in a cluster gets the same number of channels, per cell = total channels S ÷ N (p.81).均匀 FCA（UFCA）：一簇里每个小区分到一样多的信道，每小区 = 总信道数 S ÷ N（p.81）。
  • Non-uniform FCA: channels are shared according to each cell's traffic; busier cells get more.非均匀 FCA：按各小区的话务量多少分，忙的多分。
  • Dynamic channel assignment (DCA) (p.95): channels do not belong permanently to any cell; each new call picks an available channel by a rule, as long as the co-channel interference constraint is not violated. Channel borrowing is one form of DCA: a busy cell borrows from a neighbour and returns the channel when the call ends.动态分配 DCA（dynamic，p.95）：信道不永久归某个小区，来一个呼叫就按规则挑一条可用信道，只要不违反同频干扰约束。信道借用（channel borrowing）是 DCA 的一种：忙的小区向邻区借，通话结束要还回去。

The problem with FCA (p.94): when a cell's channels are used up, a new call must be rejected even if the neighbouring cell has idle channels. Lecturer's emphasis: fixed assignment is simple but inflexible; borrowed channels must be returned after use, and borrowing must still respect the reuse distance so it causes no co-channel interference.FCA 的问题（p.94）：本小区信道用完了，即使隔壁小区有空闲信道，新呼叫也只能被拒绝。老师课上强调：固定分配简单但不灵活；借来的信道用完要还，借用时仍要满足复用距离，不能造成同频干扰。

p.81 also gives the total number of channels in the whole area, T = C × N × (S/N) = C × S, where C is the number of clusters: every cluster uses all S channels once.p.81 还给出全区信道总数 T = C × N × (S/N) = C × S，C 是簇的个数：每个簇都把 S 条信道全部用一遍。

Step by stepTwo steps: share equally, then keep a control channel

  1. Fix N: the question does not state the cluster size; the notes' solution assumes 7-cell reuse. In the exam, first write "Assume N = 7" to state the assumption clearly.确认 N：题目没写簇尺寸，讲义解法默认 7 小区复用。考试时先写一句"Assume N = 7"，把假设说清楚。
  2. Share equally: under UFCA each cell gets 1/7.平分：UFCA 下每个小区分到 1/7。
  3. Remove the control channel: each cell usually keeps 1 channel as a control channel (call set-up, paging); only the rest can carry calls.扣控制信道：每个小区通常留 1 条做控制信道（呼叫建立、寻呼），剩下的才能通话。
Channels per cell = 210 ÷ 7 = 30
Available for calls = 30 − 1 = 29每小区信道数 = 210 ÷ 7 = 30 条
可用于通话 = 30 − 1 = 29 条

Why keep a control channel: after switching on, a phone must first register, receive paging and send call requests on the control channel, and the base station then assigns it a voice channel. Without a control channel, no call can be connected however many voice channels there are. So each cell keeps at least 1.为什么要留控制信道：手机开机后要先在控制信道上登记、收寻呼、发起呼叫请求，基站再给它分一条语音信道。没有控制信道，语音信道再多也没法接通电话。所以每个小区至少留 1 条。

Check: 30 × 7 = 210, shared out exactly with no remainder. With N = 4 or N = 12 you would get 210 ÷ 4 = 52.5 and 210 ÷ 12 = 17.5, which do not divide evenly, and you would have to explain the rounding (this also shows the notes chose 7 to fit).检查：30 × 7 = 210，刚好分完，没有余数。如果是 N = 4 或 N = 12，就会是 210 ÷ 4 = 52.5、210 ÷ 12 = 17.5，不整除，要说明怎么取整（这也说明讲义选 7 是配好的）。

Pitfalls

  • Writing only 30 and not 29 loses the "control channel" mark.只写 30 不写 29，会漏掉"控制信道"这一分。
  • Do not take 210 as channels per cell; 210 is the total for a cluster (the system).不要把 210 当成每小区信道数，210 是一簇（系统）总数。
  • When the question does not give N, write down your assumption.题目没给 N 时要写出假设。

ExamHow to write it in English

Assume a 7-cell reuse pattern (N = 7). With uniform fixed channel assignment, each cell in a cluster is allocated 1/7 of the total system channels: 210/7 = 30 channels per cell. Usually one channel in each cell is used as a control channel, leaving 30 − 1 = 29 channels for voice traffic.

In one line: under UFCA, per cell = total ÷ N = 210 ÷ 7 = 30 channels; keep 1 for control, leaving 29 for calls.一句话：UFCA 每小区 = 总数 ÷ N = 210 ÷ 7 = 30 条，留 1 条控制，29 条通话。
Past final exam
2023-24 S2Q4(c)12 marks≡ HW1 Q2(b)
Topics: derive SIR = 1.76 + 20 log N · solve for n · worst case and 120° sectors考点：推导 SIR = 1.76 + 20 log N · 反求 n · 最坏情况与 120° 扇区
Original question (verbatim)

(c) Derive and establish the following relationship between Signal-to-Interference Ratio SIRdB and cluster size Nc. SIRdB = 1.76 + 20 log10(Nc)

(i) Consider the Simplified SIR analysis where SIR = (1/6)Qn and Q is the co-channel reuse factor and there are six co-channel interferers in the first tier. You may assume a path loss exponent of n = 4 in your initial evaluation. Determine the SIRdB for Nc=7 and comment on your results.

(ii) If the required minimum SNRdB is to be least 20 dB, derive the corresponding value of the path loss exponent n for this case.

(iii) Using the new value of n from part (ii), determine Co-Channel interference SIR for the worst case omnidirectional as shown below. SIR = 1 / [2(Q − 1)−n + 2Q−n + 2(Q + 1)−n]

(iv) Using the new value of n from part (ii), determine the SIR when using co-channel interference SIR with 120° sectoring. State and comment on your results when compared to part (iii).

(12 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
Derivation: state the assumptions, write S/I (notes Part A p.88): count only the 6 first-tier co-channel interferers (the second tier is too far away and is ignored); the mobile is at the cell edge, at distance R from its own base station; all 6 interfering base stations are approximately at distance D; received power ∝ d−n:推导：列假设，写 S/I（讲义 Part A p.88）：只算第一层 6 个同频干扰（第二层太远，忽略）；手机在小区边缘，离本基站 R；6 个干扰基站都近似在距离 D；接收功率 ∝ d−n：
S/I = R−n / (6D−n)
 = (D/R)n/6 = Qn/6
2
Derivation: substitute Q and n = 4: hexagonal geometry gives the co-channel reuse ratio Q = D/R = √(3N) (p.78). For n = 4, Q⁴ = (3N)² = 9N²:推导：代入 Q 和 n = 4：六边形几何给出同频复用因子 Q = D/R = √(3N)（p.78）。n = 4 时 Q⁴ = (3N)² = 9N²：
S/I = 9N²/6 = 1.5N²
SIRdB = 10 log₁₀ 1.5 + 10 log₁₀ N²
 = 1.76 + 20 log₁₀ N
where 10 log₁₀ 1.5 = 1.761 and 10 log₁₀ N² = 20 log₁₀ N. QED.
3
(i) Substitute N = 7:
20 log₁₀ 7 = 20 × 0.8451 = 16.90 dB
SIR = 1.76 + 16.90 = 18.66 dB
Direct check: Q = √21 = 4.583, Q⁴/6 = 441/6 = 73.5, 10 log₁₀ 73.5 = 18.66 dB ✓. Comment: this is just above the roughly 18 dB needed for voice quality (notes p.89), which is why 7-cell reuse is the most common. But the simplified model puts all 6 interferers at D, which is optimistic; the worst case (p.91) with n = 4 gives only 17.27 dB, below 18 dB.直接验算：Q = √21 = 4.583，Q⁴/6 = 441/6 = 73.5，10 log₁₀ 73.5 = 18.66 dB ✓。评论：刚好高于语音质量所需的约 18 dB（讲义 p.89），所以 7 小区复用最常用。但简化模型把 6 个干扰都放在 D，偏乐观；最坏情况（p.91）在 n = 4 时只有 17.27 dB，低于 18 dB。
4
(ii) Solve for n: we need SIR ≥ 20 dB, i.e. a linear value of 1020/10 = 100; take log₁₀ of both sides:(ii) 反求 n：要 SIR ≥ 20 dB，换成线性值 1020/10 = 100，两边取 log₁₀：
Qn/6 ≥ 100 → Qn ≥ 600
n log₁₀ Q ≥ log₁₀ 600
log₁₀ Q = ½ log₁₀ 21 = ½ × 1.3222 = 0.6611
n ≥ 2.7782 / 0.6611 ≈ 4.20
Check: 4.5834.2 = 597.9, 597.9/6 = 99.7 → 19.99 dB ≈ 20 dB ✓. With n larger than 4, the signal decays faster with distance, so the distant interferers are weaker and the SIR is high enough.验算：4.5834.2 = 597.9，597.9/6 = 99.7 → 19.99 dB ≈ 20 dB ✓。n 比 4 大，信号随距离衰减更快，远处的干扰就更弱，SIR 才够。
5
(iii) Worst case (omnidirectional antennas): the mobile is at a cell corner, with 2 interferers at D − R, 2 at D and 2 at D + R (p.91); dividing by R gives Q − 1, Q and Q + 1. With n = 4.2:(iii) 最坏情况（全向天线）：手机在小区角上，2 个干扰在 D − R，2 个在 D，2 个在 D + R（p.91），除以 R 后就是 Q − 1、Q、Q + 1。n = 4.2：
(Q − 1)4.2 = 3.5834.2 = 212.6
Q4.2 = 4.5834.2 = 597.9
(Q + 1)4.2 = 5.5834.2 = 1370
Denominator = 2/212.6 + 2/597.9 + 2/1370
 = 0.00941 + 0.00334 + 0.00146
 = 0.01421
SIR = 1/0.01421 = 70.4 → 18.5 dB
6
(iii) Comment: 18.5 dB < 20 dB, so the requirement is not met. The reason is that two interferers are only D − R away, and these two terms alone make up about 2/3 of the denominator (0.00941/0.01421 = 0.66). So the n found from the simplified model is not enough at the worst-case position.(iii) 评论：18.5 dB < 20 dB，没达到要求。原因是两个干扰只隔 D − R，单这两项就占分母的约 2/3（0.00941/0.01421 = 0.66）。所以按简化模型定出的 n，在最坏位置不够用。
7
(iv) 120° sectors: each sector antenna radiates only into its 120° sector, so only 2 first-tier interferers remain, at worst-case distances D and D + 0.7R (notes p.145):(iv) 120° 扇区：每个扇区天线只朝 120° 方向发射，第一层只剩 2 个干扰，最坏情况距离为 D 和 D + 0.7R（讲义 p.145）：
Q + 0.7 = 5.283, 5.2834.2 = 1086
SIR = 1/(1/597.9 + 1/1086)
 = 1/(0.001672 + 0.000921)
 = 1/0.002593 = 385.7 → 25.9 dB
8
(iv) Compare with (iii) and comment: 25.9 − 18.5 = 7.4 dB; with sectoring the 20 dB target is met with about 5.9 dB to spare (notes p.145: 24.5 dB for n = 4; higher for larger n, so the trend is consistent ✓). Cost: each sector has only 1/3 of the channels, so trunking efficiency falls; there are more handoffs and the system is more complex (p.146). Benefit: this margin can be used to reduce the cluster size N, raising frequency reuse and capacity (p.144).(iv) 和 (iii) 比较并评论：25.9 − 18.5 = 7.4 dB，扇区化后满足 20 dB 还有约 5.9 dB 余量（讲义 p.145：n = 4 时为 24.5 dB；n 变大后更高，趋势一致 ✓）。代价：每扇区只有 1/3 的信道，集群效率下降；切换次数增多，系统复杂度增加（p.146）。好处：可以用这个余量减小簇 N，提高频率复用和容量（p.144）。
(i) 18.66 dB; (ii) n ≈ 4.2; (iii) 18.5 dB; (iv) 25.9 dB
◆ Key points
What it tests
Deriving the SIR formula, solving back for the path-loss exponent, worst-case SIR, 120° sectoring (Part A co-channel interference).SIR 公式推导、反求路径损耗指数、最坏情况 SIR、120° 扇区（Part A 同频干扰）。
Knowledge used
Q = D/R = √(3N); simplified model S/I = Qn/6 (all 6 interferers at distance D); worst case: two at D − R, two at D, two at D + R; with 120° sectors 2 interferers remain, at distances D and D + 0.7R.Q = D/R = √(3N)；简化模型 S/I = Qn/6（6 个干扰都在距离 D）；最坏情况：两个在 D − R、两个在 D、两个在 D + R；120° 扇区剩 2 个干扰，距离 D 和 D + 0.7R。
Method
Derivation: substitute n = 4 and Q² = 3N, then convert to dB; (ii) Qn/6 ≥ 100, take logs of both sides and solve for n; (iii)(iv) put the distances (in units of R: Q − 1, Q, Q + 1) into the sum.推导：代入 n = 4、Q² = 3N，取 dB；(ii) Qn/6 ≥ 100，两边取对数解 n；(iii)(iv) 把距离（以 R 为单位：Q − 1、Q、Q + 1）代入求和。
Common mistakes
20 dB is 100 in linear terms; worst-case distances are in units of R; in the sectored case only 2 interference terms remain, so do not still write 6.20 dB 是线性 100；最坏情况的距离以 R 为单位；扇区情况只剩 2 个干扰项，别还写 6 个。
Conclusion
The simplified model is optimistic; the worst case falls below 20 dB. Sectoring cuts the interferers from 6 to 2 and raises SIR by about 7 dB, at the cost of lower trunking efficiency and more handoffs.简化模型偏乐观，最坏情况会低于 20 dB；扇区化把干扰从 6 个减到 2 个，SIR 高约 7 dB，代价是集群效率下降、切换增多。
Concept + Step by step: SIR formula derivation, solving for n, worst case and sectors

ConceptCo-channel interference and Q = D/R

In a cellular system, each cluster of size N uses all the channels, and cells a certain distance D apart reuse the same set of frequencies (co-channel cells). The larger D, the less interference. Hexagonal geometry gives Q = D/R = √(3N) (notes Part A p.78); Q is called the co-channel reuse ratio.蜂窝系统里，簇大小为 N 的每个簇用完全部信道，相隔一定距离 D 的小区重复使用同一组频率（同频小区）。D 越大干扰越小。六边形几何给出 Q = D/R = √(3N)（讲义 Part A p.78），Q 叫同频复用比（co-channel reuse ratio）。

Assumptions of the simplified analysis on notes p.88: only the 6 first-tier co-channel interferers are counted; the MS is at the cell edge, at distance R from its own BS; the 6 interfering BSs are all at about D from the MS; received power is proportional to distance to the power −n (n is the path loss exponent).讲义 p.88 的简化分析假设：只算第一层 6 个同频干扰；手机在小区边缘，到本基站距离 R；6 个干扰基站到手机都近似为 D；接收功率与距离的 −n 次方成正比（n 是路径损耗指数）。

S/I = R−n / (6D−n) = (D/R)n/6 = Qn/6
CaseFormulaN = 7, n = 4 (notes)
Simplified (all 6 at D)Qn/618.66 dB (p.89)
Worst-case omni (2 at D−R, 2 at D, 2 at D+R)最坏全向（2 个 D−R、2 个 D、2 个 D+R）1/[2(Q−1)−n + 2Q−n + 2(Q+1)−n]17.27 dB (p.91)
120° sectors (only 2 left)1/[Q−n + (Q+0.7)−n]p.145

Step by stepDerive SIRdB = 1.76 + 20 log₁₀N

  1. Start from S/I = Qn/6 and substitute Q = √(3N), n = 4: Q⁴ = (3N)².
  2. S/I = (3N)²/6 = 9N²/6 = 1.5N²
  3. Take 10 log₁₀:
    SIRdB = 10 log₁₀1.5 + 10 log₁₀N² = 1.76 + 20 log₁₀N

Step by step(i) N = 7

SIRdB = 1.76 + 20 log₁₀7 = 1.76 + 16.90 = 18.66 dB

Comment: slightly above the roughly 18 dB needed for voice quality (notes p.89 say N = 7 is the optimum cluster size), which is why 7-cell reuse is the most common. But this model puts all 6 interferers at D and ignores the MS being closer to some interfering cells, so it is optimistic; n = 4 is also an assumption.评论：比语音质量需要的约 18 dB 稍高（讲义 p.89 说 N = 7 是最优簇大小），所以 7 小区复用最常用。但这个模型把 6 个干扰都放在 D，忽略了手机靠近某些干扰小区的情况，偏乐观；n = 4 也是假设。

Step by step(ii) Solve for n

The "SNR" written in the question means SIR here. 20 dB → linear 100:题目写的 "SNR" 这里指 SIR。20 dB → 线性 100：

Qn/6 ≥ 100 → Qn ≥ 600, Q = √21 = 4.583
n = log₁₀600 / log₁₀4.583 = 2.778/0.661 ≈ 4.20

Why use logs: the unknown is in the exponent; taking the log of both sides brings it down.为什么用对数：未知数在指数上，两边取 log 把它拿下来。

Step by step(iii) Worst case (n = 4.2)

(Q − 1)4.2 = 3.5834.2 = 212.6; Q4.2 = 597.9; (Q + 1)4.2 = 5.5834.2 = 1370
SIR = 1/(2/212.6 + 2/597.9 + 2/1370) = 1/0.0142 ≈ 70.4 → 18.5 dB

Calculator: compute a4.2 with the xy key, or as 10^(4.2 × log₁₀a). The result is below 20 dB: with the MS at the cell edge, two interfering BSs are only D − R away, and these two nearest terms contribute well over half of the interference.计算器：a4.2 用 xy 键，或 10^(4.2 × log₁₀a)。结果低于 20 dB：手机在小区边上时有两个干扰基站只隔 D − R，最近的两项贡献了一大半干扰。

Step by step(iv) 120° sectors (n = 4.2)

(Q + 0.7)4.2 = 5.2834.2 = 1086
SIR = 1/(1/597.9 + 1/1086) ≈ 385.7 → 25.9 dB

Comment: about 7.4 dB higher than (iii); it meets 20 dB with about 6 dB of margin left. The reason is that the directional antenna "sees" only 2 co-channel interferers. Cost: each sector has only 1/3 of the channels, trunking efficiency drops and handoffs increase; the extra SIR margin can be used to shrink the cluster and increase capacity.评论：比 (iii) 高约 7.4 dB，满足 20 dB 还剩约 6 dB 余量。原因是定向天线只"看见"2 个同频干扰。代价：每扇区信道只有 1/3，集群效率下降，切换增多；多出的 SIR 余量可以用来缩小簇、提高容量。

PitfallsWatch out

  • 20 dB is 100 in linear terms, not 20.
  • Worst-case distances in units of R: Q − 1, Q, Q + 1, two of each.最坏情况的距离以 R 为单位：Q − 1、Q、Q + 1，各 2 个。
  • The sectored case has only 2 terms left; do not keep writing 6 terms.扇区情况只剩 2 项，别还写 6 项。
  • In the derivation, 10 log₁₀N² = 20 log₁₀N; write this step out.推导里 10 log₁₀N² = 20 log₁₀N，这一步要写出来。

ExamHow to write it in English

Derivation: assume only the six first-tier co-channel interferers, the mobile at the cell edge (distance R from its own base station) and all interferers at distance D. With received power proportional to d−n, S/I = R−n/(6D−n) = Qn/6, where Q = D/R = √(3Nc). With n = 4, S/I = (3Nc)²/6 = 1.5Nc², so SIRdB = 10 log₁₀1.5 + 20 log₁₀Nc = 1.76 + 20 log₁₀Nc.

(i) For Nc = 7: SIRdB = 1.76 + 20 log₁₀7 = 18.66 dB. This just exceeds the 18 dB needed for good voice quality, which is why Nc = 7 is widely used; however, the simplified model is optimistic because it places all six interferers at distance D.

(ii) For SIR ≥ 20 dB = 100: Qn/6 ≥ 100 with Q = √21 = 4.583, so n = log₁₀600 / log₁₀4.583 ≈ 4.2.

(iii) With n = 4.2: SIR = 1/[2(3.583)−4.2 + 2(4.583)−4.2 + 2(5.583)−4.2] = 1/0.0142 ≈ 70.4, i.e. 18.5 dB, which is below the 20 dB requirement.

(iv) With 120° sectoring only two interferers remain: SIR = 1/[Q−n + (Q + 0.7)−n] = 1/[(4.583)−4.2 + (5.283)−4.2] ≈ 386, i.e. 25.9 dB. This is about 7.4 dB better than the worst-case omnidirectional result and meets the 20 dB requirement with margin, because the directional antennas reduce the number of interferers from six to two. The cost is fewer channels per sector, lower trunking efficiency and more handoffs.

In one line: S/I = Qn/6, Q² = 3N, n = 4 → 1.5N² → 1.76 + 20 log N; N = 7 gives 18.66 dB; 20 dB needs n ≈ 4.2; worst-case omni 18.5 dB, 120° sectors 25.9 dB.一句话：S/I = Qn/6、Q² = 3N、n = 4 → 1.5N² → 1.76 + 20 log N；N = 7 得 18.66 dB；要 20 dB 需 n ≈ 4.2；最坏全向 18.5 dB，120° 扇区 25.9 dB。
