Past final exam
2025-26 S1Q3(c)4 marks
Topics: fixed channel assignment (FCA) vs dynamic channel assignment (DCA)考点：固定信道分配 FCA 与动态信道分配 DCA
Original question (verbatim)

(c) Briefly describe the concept of fixed and dynamic channel assignment for a cellular system.

(4 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
Fixed Channel Assignment (FCA) (notes Part A p.92): each cell (base station) is allocated a fixed set of channels in advance, and a call in a cell can only use an idle channel of that cell. Reason: the channel sets are planned in advance according to the cluster and the reuse distance, so co-channel interference is already controlled at the design stage and nothing needs to be computed during operation.固定信道分配（Fixed Channel Assignment，FCA）（讲义 Part A p.92）：每个小区（基站）预先分到一组固定的信道，小区内的呼叫只能使用本小区空闲的信道。原因：信道组是按簇和复用距离事先规划好的，同频干扰在设计时就已控制住，运行时不需要再计算。
2
Two forms of FCA and its drawback: in uniform FCA (UFCA) every cell has the same number of channels, e.g. 210 in total with N = 7 → 30 per cell (1 control, 29 traffic, p.93); non-uniform FCA gives each cell a different number according to its traffic load. Drawback (p.94): once all the channels of a cell are in use, a new call is blocked, even if neighbouring cells still have idle channels. This is because the channels are "locked" into the cell and cannot move as the traffic changes. Simple, but poorly adaptive.FCA 的两种形式和缺点：均匀 FCA（UFCA）每个小区信道数相同，例如共 210 条、N = 7 → 每小区 30 条（1 条控制，29 条话务，p.93）；非均匀 FCA 按各小区的业务量分配不同数量。缺点（p.94）：本小区信道用完，新呼叫就被阻塞，即使相邻小区还有空闲信道。原因是信道被“锁死”在小区里，不能随业务量的变化流动。简单，但适应性差。
3
Dynamic Channel Assignment (DCA) (p.95): channels are not permanently allocated to cells; when a new call arrives, any base station may use any channel according to some algorithm, as long as the co-channel interference constraint is not violated. The simplest form is channel borrowing: cell A borrows an idle channel from cell C, monitors it throughout the call and returns it afterwards.动态信道分配（Dynamic Channel Assignment，DCA）（p.95）：信道不永久分给小区；新呼叫到来时，任何基站都可以按某种算法使用任意信道，只要不违反同频干扰约束。最简单的形式是信道借用（channel borrowing）：小区 A 借用小区 C 的空闲信道，通话期间持续监测，结束后归还。
4
DCA rules, pros and cons (p.96): the algorithm is based on the predicted future blocking, the reuse distance of the channel and other cost functions. Basic constraint: while a channel is in use in one cell, no other cell within the reuse distance D may use it at the same time, otherwise the co-channel interference exceeds the limit. Advantage: heavily loaded cells can use more channels, so it is flexible and gives low blocking. Cost: channels must be monitored in real time, which needs centralised control and more computation, so it is more complex.DCA 的规则和优缺点（p.96）：算法依据对未来阻塞的预测、信道的复用距离和其他代价函数；基本约束：一个信道在某小区使用时，复用距离 D 以内的其他小区不能同时使用它，否则同频干扰超标。优点：业务量大的小区可以用更多信道，灵活、阻塞率低；代价：要实时监测信道，需要集中控制和更多计算，更复杂。
FCA: fixed groups, simple but inflexible; DCA: assigned on demand, constrained by the reuse distance, flexible but complexFCA：固定分组、简单但不灵活；DCA：按需分配、受复用距离约束、灵活但复杂
◆ Key points
What it tests
Fixed channel assignment (FCA) vs dynamic channel assignment (DCA) (Part A p.92–96).固定信道分配 FCA 与动态信道分配 DCA（Part A p.92–96）。
Answer points
FCA: each cell gets a fixed set of channels in advance; once they are used up, calls are blocked even if neighbouring cells have free channels; simple, but adapts poorly to traffic changes. DCA: channels are not fixed; when a call arrives, an algorithm picks one from a common pool, as long as the reuse distance is respected; flexible with low blocking, but needs centralised control and more computation.FCA：每个小区预先分到固定的一组信道，用完就阻塞，即使邻区空闲；简单，适应业务变化差。DCA：信道不固定，呼叫到来时按算法从公共池中选，只要不违反复用距离；灵活、阻塞低，但需要集中控制和更多计算。
Compare and memorise
Fixed vs on demand; simple vs complex; inflexible vs flexible.固定 vs 按需；简单 vs 复杂；不灵活 vs 灵活。
Common mistakes
DCA must also respect the co-channel reuse distance; channel borrowing is a form of DCA.DCA 也必须满足同频复用距离约束；信道借用是 DCA 的一种形式。
Extension (beyond the notes)
Classic result: at light and medium load DCA has lower blocking; at very heavy load FCA is no worse than DCA.经典结论：轻、中负载时 DCA 阻塞率更低；负载很重时 FCA 不比 DCA 差。
Concept + Step by step: fixed and dynamic channel assignment

ConceptWhy channel assignment matters

Spectrum is limited and users are many. Channel assignment decides "which cell may use which channels"; a good assignment lets the same spectrum carry more calls (Part A p.92). There are two basic methods: fixed channel assignment (FCA) and dynamic channel assignment (DCA).频谱有限，用户很多。信道分配（channel assignment）决定"哪个小区可以用哪些信道"，分得好，同样的频谱能接更多的呼叫（Part A p.92）。两种基本方法：固定分配（FCA，Fixed Channel Assignment）和动态分配（DCA，Dynamic Channel Assignment）。

ConceptFCA: fixed in advance

  • Each cell (base station) is given a fixed set of channels in advance (p.92).每个小区（基站）预先分到一组固定的信道（p.92）。
  • A call in a cell can use only free channels of its own cell; if all of the cell's channels are busy, the new call is blocked, even if a neighbouring cell has free channels (example on p.94).小区里的呼叫只能用本小区空闲的信道；本小区的信道全忙，新呼叫就被阻塞，即使邻区有空闲信道也不能用（p.94 的例子）。
  • Uniform FCA (UFCA): every cell in the cluster gets the same number, e.g. 210 channels with N = 7 gives 30 per cell, 1 of which is a control channel, leaving 29 (p.93). Non-uniform FCA: cells get different numbers according to their traffic.均匀 FCA（UFCA）：簇内每个小区分到相同数量，例如 210 条信道、N = 7，每小区 30 条，其中 1 条作控制信道，剩 29 条（p.93）；非均匀 FCA：按各小区的业务量分不同数量。
  • Advantage: simple and easy to manage. Disadvantage: it cannot adapt to changing traffic (busy cells run short, quiet cells waste channels).优点是简单、容易管理；缺点是适应不了业务量的变化（忙的小区不够用，闲的小区浪费）。

ConceptDCA: assigned on demand

  • Channels are not permanently assigned to cells but kept in a common pool. When a new call arrives, any base station may use any channel according to an algorithm, as long as it does not violate the interference constraint (p.95).信道不永久分给小区，放在一个公共池里。新呼叫到来时，任何基站都可以按一定算法使用任何信道，只要不违反干扰约束（p.95）。
  • Basic interference constraint: while a channel is in use in a cell, no other cell within the reuse distance D may use it at the same time (p.96).基本干扰约束：一条信道在某小区使用时，复用距离 D 以内的其他小区不能同时用它（p.96）。
  • The algorithm is based on: prediction of future blocking, the reuse distance of the channel, and other cost functions (p.96).算法的依据：对未来阻塞的预测、信道的复用距离、其他代价函数（p.96）。
  • Channel borrowing is an example of DCA: cell A borrows a channel from neighbouring cell C, monitors it during the call, and returns it when the call ends (p.95).信道借用（channel borrowing）是 DCA 的一个例子：小区 A 向邻区 C 借一条信道，通话期间持续监测，通话结束后归还（p.95）。
  • Cells with heavy traffic can use more channels, so it is flexible and has lower blocking; the cost is central control, more computation and more signalling.业务量大的小区可以用更多信道，所以灵活、阻塞率低；代价是需要集中控制、更多的计算和信令。

The lecturer said in class: fixed assignment is simple but inflexible; dynamic assignment and channel borrowing are more flexible; borrowing must still respect the reuse distance and must not cause co-channel interference.老师课上说：固定分配简单但不灵活，动态分配和信道借用更灵活；借用时仍要满足复用距离，不能造成同频干扰。

Step by stepAnswer points (4 marks)

FCADCA
Channel ownershipEach cell is assigned a fixed set of channels in advance每小区预先分配一组固定信道Common pool; channels are assigned only when a call arrives公共池，呼叫到来时才分配
When all are busyBlocked, even if a neighbouring cell has free channels阻塞，即使邻区空闲Can use any free channel that satisfies the reuse distance可以用任何满足复用距离的空闲信道
AdvantageSimpleFlexible, low blocking, adapts to traffic changes灵活，阻塞率低，适应业务变化
DisadvantagesInflexible, low channel utilisation不灵活，信道利用率低Needs central control, computationally complex需要集中控制，计算复杂

A 4-mark question is usually "2 marks each": 1 mark for the concept + 1 mark for the features (pros and cons). Write both concepts and include a comparison.4 分题一般是"每种 2 分"：概念 1 分 + 特点（优缺点）1 分。两个概念都要写，并写出对比。

Beyond the slides(not in the notes; no marks lost if you leave it out)

Classic research result: at light to moderate traffic DCA has lower blocking than FCA; at very heavy traffic all cells are busy, DCA has no free channels to reallocate, and it performs no better than FCA.经典研究结论：业务量轻到中等时 DCA 阻塞率比 FCA 低；业务量很重时，所有小区都忙，DCA 没有空闲信道可调，性能不比 FCA 好。

PitfallsCommon ways to lose marks

  • Saying DCA "uses any channel freely" and leaving out "it must not violate the co-channel interference constraint of reuse distance D".说 DCA"随便用任何信道"，漏了"不能违反复用距离 D 的同频干扰约束"。
  • For FCA writing only "fixed" without "blocked when all channels are busy, even if a neighbouring cell has free channels".FCA 只写"固定"，没写"全忙就阻塞，即使邻区有空闲信道"。

ExamHow to write it in English

Fixed channel assignment (FCA): each cell (base station) is allocated a predetermined set of channels. A call in a cell can only use the unused channels of that cell; if all of them are busy, the call is blocked even if there are free channels in neighbouring cells. The channels may be allocated equally to all cells in a cluster (uniform FCA) or according to the traffic load of each cell (non-uniform FCA). FCA is simple to implement but cannot adapt to changes in traffic.

Dynamic channel assignment (DCA): channels are not allocated to cells permanently but are kept in a common pool. When a new call arrives, any base station can use any channel, chosen by an algorithm based on, e.g., the predicted future blocking, the reuse distance and other cost functions, as long as the interference constraint is not violated (the same channel cannot be reused within the reuse distance D). Channel borrowing is one example. A cell with high traffic can therefore use more channels, which gives more flexibility and lower blocking, at the cost of centralised control and more computation.

In one line: FCA gives each cell a fixed set of channels in advance: simple but inflexible. DCA assigns channels on demand from a common pool when calls arrive, subject to the reuse distance: flexible but complex.一句话：FCA 是每个小区预先分好一组固定信道，简单但不灵活；DCA 是呼叫到来时从公共池按需分配，只要满足复用距离，灵活但复杂。
→ Back to the learning page: Part A Ch. 7 Co-channel interference and how to assign channels→ 回到讲解：Part A 第七章 同频干扰与信道该怎么分配

Ch. 8 · Traffic engineering: using queueing theory to check "is it enough?"

4 practice · 4 past-examNotes →
Lecture example
p.121–122

Traffic and trunking gain

Original questionSlides 121–122

Typical call arrival rate λ in a large population of mobile users, during the busy hour can range from 0.4 calls/hr/per subscriber to 1.2 calls/hr/per subscriber.

Typical holding time 1/μ can be around 100 seconds. Thus, it can give rise to an offered traffic of λ/μ = (1.2)(100/3600) = ? Erlangs.

Typical values of blocking probability are:

  • For PB = 0.05, M = 10, A = 6.2, M = 20, A = 15.2, M = 50, A = 44.3
  • For PB = 0.02, M = 10, A = 5.08, M = 20, A = 13.2, M = 50, A = 40.3

A cell with 50 channels would be able to handle 40.3 Erlangs with PB = 2%. This is equivalent to handling ? mobile subscribers with 2% GoS during busy hour traffic.

Trunking gain is defined as: Trunking gain = the number of users served by a set of channels (or trunks) with a specified GOS / the number of channels (or trunks). In the mobile environment, under busy hour traffic conditions, the trunking gain is ≈ ? for a GoS of 2%.

An explanatory example whose original text includes the results. The original is reproduced below, with the results replaced by ?.讲解型例题，原文自带结果。下面照录原文，结果用 ? 代替。
In the busy hour each user makes 0.4–1.2 calls per hour, with a mean call of 100 seconds. Find how many users a cell with 50 channels and GoS 2% can serve, and the trunking gain.忙时每用户每小时呼叫 0.4–1.2 次，平均通话 100 秒。求一个 50 信道、GoS 2% 的小区能服务多少用户，以及干线增益。
  1. Traffic per user: Au = λ/μ = call rate × mean call duration (p.118). Take the busy-hour upper limit λ = 1.2 calls/hour, 1/μ = 100 s = 100/3600 h:每用户话务量：Au = λ/μ = 呼叫率 × 平均通话时长（p.118）。取忙时上限 λ = 1.2 次/小时，1/μ = 100 s = 100/3600 h：
    Au = 1.2 × 100/3600 = 0.0333 Erlang (exact value 1/30)
  2. Read the Erlang B table: the table values given in the notes are below; this question uses M = 50, GoS 2% → A = 40.3 Er:查 Erlang B 表：讲义给出的表值如下，本题用 M = 50、GoS 2% → A = 40.3 Er：
    GoSM = 10M = 20M = 50
    5%6.215.244.3
    2%5.0813.240.3
  3. Number of users: total traffic the cell can carry ÷ traffic per user:用户数：小区能承载的总话务 ÷ 每人的话务：
    U = A / Au = 40.3 ÷ (1/30) = 40.3 × 30 = 1209 ≈ 1210 users
    Use the exact value 1/30; dividing by the rounded 0.033 gives 1221, which does not match the 1210 in the notes.要用 1/30 的精确值；如果拿四舍五入后的 0.033 去除，会得到 1221，和讲义的 1210 对不上。
  4. Trunking gain: definition (trunking gain, p.122) = number of users ÷ number of channels:干线增益：定义（trunking gain，p.122）= 用户数 ÷ 信道数：
    1210 ÷ 50 = 24.2 users/channel
    Each channel serves 24 users on average, because not everyone talks at the same time.每条信道平均服务 24 人，因为不会所有人同时通话。
  5. Verify the p.122 trends with the table values: at the same GoS 2%, M = 10 gives 5.08 × 30 = 152 users, gain 152 ÷ 10 = 15.2, smaller than 24.2 (larger M, larger gain) ✓; at the same M = 50, GoS 5% gives 44.3 × 30 = 1329 users, gain 26.6, larger than 24.2 (looser GoS, larger gain) ✓.用表值验证 p.122 的规律：同样 GoS 2%，M = 10 时 5.08 × 30 = 152 人，增益 152 ÷ 10 = 15.2，比 24.2 小（M 越大增益越大）✓；同样 M = 50，GoS 5% 时 44.3 × 30 = 1329 人，增益 26.6，比 24.2 大（GoS 越宽松增益越大）✓。
About 1210 users · trunking gain 24.2约 1210 个用户 · 干线增益 24.2
Au = calls × seconds ÷ 3600. 50 channels can serve about 1200 people, i.e. each channel serves 24 people. The larger M and the looser the GoS, the larger the trunking gain.Au = 次数 × 秒 ÷ 3600。50 条信道约能服务 1200 人，相当于每条信道服务 24 人。M 越大、GoS 越宽松，干线增益越大。
Users and channels are not the same thing. There are far more users than channels because not everyone calls at the same time.用户数和信道数不是一回事。用户远多于信道，是因为不会所有人同时打电话。
Exact formula value: for M = 50 and GoS 5%, A = 44.53 (the notes give 44.3); the other table values agree with the formula.公式精确值：M = 50、GoS 5% 时 A = 44.53（讲义写 44.3）；其余表值与公式一致。
Concept + Step by step: Erlang, number of users and trunking gain

ConceptErlang, Erlang B and trunking gain

Traffic A (in Erlang), notes Part A p.118: A = λ/μ = λ × h. λ is the mean call arrival rate (calls/hour) and 1/μ = h is the mean call duration (hours). Intuitively: the average number of channels busy at the same time. 1 Erlang = one channel busy continuously for one hour.话务量 A（traffic，单位 Erlang），讲义 Part A p.118：A = λ/μ = λ × h。λ 是平均呼叫到达率（次/小时），1/μ = h 是平均通话时长（小时）。直观意思：平均有多少条信道同时在忙。1 Erlang = 一条信道连续忙一小时。

Blocked calls cleared (blocked model) (p.118–119): when all channels are busy, a new call is rejected straight away with no queueing; the M/M/m/m model and the Erlang B formula give the blocking probability PB, and PB is the grade of service GoS (p.116: 1%–2% is very good, above 5% is unacceptable to users). In the exam, use the table: given M and GoS, read off the maximum A.呼损制（blocked model）（p.118–119）：信道全忙时新呼叫直接被拒绝，不排队，用 M/M/m/m 模型和 Erlang B 公式算阻塞概率 PB，PB 就是服务等级 GoS（p.116：1%–2% 很好，超过 5% 用户不能接受）。考试查表：已知 M 和 GoS，读出最大 A。

Carried traffic (p.120): C = A(1 − PB); the rejected part is A·PB. When PB is small, C ≈ A.承载话务量（carried traffic，p.120）：C = A(1 − PB)，被拒绝的部分是 A·PB。PB 小时 C ≈ A。

Trunking gain (p.122) = number of users a group of channels can serve at a given GoS ÷ number of channels, i.e. "how many users one channel supports on average". There are far more users than channels because people do not all call at once. Two rules from p.122: at fixed GoS, larger M gives larger gain; at fixed M, a looser GoS (larger value) gives larger gain.干线增益（trunking gain，p.122）= 一组信道在给定 GoS 下能服务的用户数 ÷ 信道数，即"一条信道平均养活几个用户"。用户远多于信道，是因为大家不会同时打电话。p.122 两条规律：GoS 固定时 M 越大，增益越大；M 固定时 GoS 放宽（数值变大），增益越大。

Step by stepThree steps: traffic per user → number of users → gain

  1. Traffic per user: take the busy-hour upper value of 1.2 calls/hour and a call duration of 100 s = 100/3600 hours.每用户话务量：取忙时上限 1.2 次/小时，通话 100 s = 100/3600 小时。
  2. Read the table: M = 50, PB = 2% → A = 40.3 Er (given in the notes).查表：M = 50、PB = 2% → A = 40.3 Er（讲义已给）。
  3. Number of users = total traffic the cell can carry ÷ traffic per user. The exact Au is 1/30, and dividing by 1/30 means multiplying by 30.用户数 = 小区能承载的总话务 ÷ 每人话务。Au 精确值是 1/30，除以 1/30 就是乘 30。
  4. Trunking gain = number of users ÷ number of channels.干线增益 = 用户数 ÷ 信道数。
Au = 1.2 × 100/3600 = 0.0333 Er (= 1/30)
Users = 40.3 ÷ (1/30) = 40.3 × 30 = 1209 ≈ 1210
Trunking gain = 1209 ÷ 50 = 24.2
Carried traffic C = 40.3 × (1 − 0.02) = 39.5 ErAu = 1.2 × 100/3600 = 0.0333 Er（= 1/30）
用户数 = 40.3 ÷ (1/30) = 40.3 × 30 = 1209 ≈ 1210
干线增益 = 1209 ÷ 50 = 24.2
承载话务 C = 40.3 × (1 − 0.02) = 39.5 Er

Note: if you first round Au to 0.033 and then divide, 40.3 ÷ 0.033 = 1221, which does not match the notes' 1210. The notes' 1210 uses the exact 1/30; in the exam, writing "40.3 × 30 = 1209 ≈ 1210" is safest.注意：如果把 Au 先四舍五入成 0.033 再除，40.3 ÷ 0.033 = 1221，和讲义的 1210 对不上。讲义的 1210 是用精确的 1/30 算的，考试写"40.3 × 30 = 1209 ≈ 1210"最稳。

Checking the two rules of p.122 with the six table values in the notes (users = A × 30, gain = users ÷ M):用讲义的六个表值验证 p.122 的两条规律（用户数 = A × 30，增益 = 用户数 ÷ M）：

GoSM = 10M = 20M = 50
2%5.08 Er → 152 users → 15.213.2 Er → 396 users → 19.840.3 Er → 1209 users → 24.2
5%6.2 Er → 186 users → 18.615.2 Er → 456 users → 22.844.3 Er → 1329 users → 26.6

Each row increases from left to right (larger M is more efficient), and each column increases from top to bottom (looser GoS serves more users). (The exact formula gives 44.53 Er for M = 50, 5%; the notes write 44.3, which does not change the conclusion.)每一行从左到右增大（M 越大越划算），每一列从上到下增大（GoS 越宽松越多人）。（用公式精确算 M = 50、5% 是 44.53 Er，讲义写 44.3，不影响结论。）

Variation: with the busy-hour lower value of 0.4 calls/hour, Au = 0.4 × 100/3600 = 1/90 Er, and the same cell can serve 40.3 × 90 = 3627 users.变式：如果取忙时下限 0.4 次/小时，Au = 0.4 × 100/3600 = 1/90 Er，同一个小区能服务 40.3 × 90 = 3627 人。

Pitfalls

  • Convert h to hours: 100 s ÷ 3600.h 的单位换成小时：100 s ÷ 3600。
  • Trunking gain is "users ÷ channels", not "traffic ÷ channels" (the latter is trunking efficiency, see p.123).干线增益是"用户数 ÷ 信道数"，不是"话务量 ÷ 信道数"（后者是干线效率，见 p.123）。
  • When reading the Erlang B table, pick the right GoS column; 2% and 5% differ a lot.查 Erlang B 表时看准 GoS 列，2% 和 5% 差别不小。

ExamHow to write it in English

Offered traffic per user Au = λ/μ = 1.2 × 100/3600 = 0.0333 Erlang. A cell with M = 50 channels at PB = 2% can carry A = 40.3 Erlangs (Erlang B table), so it can support 40.3/0.0333 ≈ 1210 subscribers during the busy hour. Trunking gain = number of users served / number of channels = 1210/50 ≈ 24.2 at a GoS of 2%. The trunking gain increases with M for a fixed GoS, and increases as the GoS value increases for a fixed M.

In one line: Au = 1.2 × 100/3600 = 1/30 Er; 50 channels at 2% carry 40.3 Er, serving about 1210 users, with a trunking gain of 24.2.一句话：Au = 1.2 × 100/3600 = 1/30 Er，50 条信道 2% 下承载 40.3 Er，可服务约 1210 人，干线增益 24.2。
Lecture example
p.123–124

Trunking efficiency: one group of 10 channels vs two groups of 5

Original questionSlides 123–124 · “Trunking Efficiency”

Trunking efficiency: 10 trunked channels at a GoS of 0.01 can support ? Erlangs of traffic. Two groups of 5 trunked channels at the same GoS (0.01) support 2 × ? = ? Erlangs of traffic.

Trunking efficiency: is expressed as value between 0 and 1 and is the carried traffic in Erlangs/channel. It is a function of the number of channels per cell for a specified GOS parameter i.e. P(blocking) = 0.01 for Erlang B a fixed channel C = 10.

For 1st case: Trunking efficiency is = ?
For 2nd case: Trunking efficiency is = ?

So 1 group of 10 channels support ?% more traffic than 2 groups of 5 channels. But the SIR for 2 groups would probably be better.

An explanatory example whose original text includes the results. The original is reproduced below, with the results replaced by ?.讲解型例题，原文自带结果。下面照录原文，结果用 ? 代替。
GoS = 1%. Compare the traffic carried and the trunking efficiency when 10 channels are pooled in one group and when they are split into two groups of 5.GoS = 1%。比较 10 条信道集中成一组，与分成两组各 5 条时能承载的话务量和干线效率。
  1. One group of 10: read the table: Erlang B table, M = 10, GoS = 0.01 → A = 4.46 Er (formula 4.461).一组 10 条：查表：Erlang B 表 M = 10、GoS = 0.01 → A = 4.46 Er（公式 4.461）。
  2. One group of 10: trunking efficiency: trunking efficiency (p.124) = carried traffic ÷ number of channels, in Er/channel:一组 10 条：干线效率：干线效率（trunking efficiency，p.124）= 承载的话务 ÷ 信道数，单位 Er/信道：
    ηt = 4.46 ÷ 10 = 0.446 = 44.6%
  3. Two groups of 5: read the table: M = 5, GoS = 0.01 → 1.36 Er per group (formula 1.361). The two groups cannot borrow from each other, so simply add the traffic:两组各 5 条：查表：M = 5、GoS = 0.01 → 每组 1.36 Er（公式 1.361）。两组互不借用，话务直接相加：
    2 × 1.36 = 2.72 Er
  4. Two groups of 5: trunking efficiency: the denominator is still the total of 2 × 5 = 10 channels:两组各 5 条：干线效率：分母仍是总共 2 × 5 = 10 条：
    ηt = 2.72 ÷ 10 = 0.272 = 27.2%
  5. Compare:
    4.46 ÷ 2.72 = 1.64 → one pool carries 64% more (the notes say about 60%)4.46 ÷ 2.72 = 1.64 → 集中多承载 64%（讲义说约 60%）
    Put the other way, after splitting, (4.46 − 2.72) ÷ 4.46 = 39% less is carried. For "how much more", use the smaller value as the base; for "how much less", use the larger one. Self-check: the efficiency ratio 0.446 ÷ 0.272 = 1.64, the same as the traffic ratio (same total number of channels) ✓.反过来说，拆开后少承载 (4.46 − 2.72) ÷ 4.46 = 39%。问"多多少"以小的为基准，问"少多少"以大的为基准。自检：效率之比 0.446 ÷ 0.272 = 1.64，和话务之比相同（总信道数一样）✓。
  6. Comment: with all 10 channels pooled, any call can use any free channel of the 10; once they are split into two groups, a call is blocked as soon as its group is full, and the free channels of the other group cannot help, so the large pool is more efficient. On the trade-off, notes p.123 adds: the two groups (e.g. two sectors) may have a better SIR, because each group sees only part of the co-channel interference.评述：10 条合在一起时，任何一个呼叫都能用 10 条里的任一条空闲信道；拆成两组后，一组占满就阻塞，另一组的空闲信道帮不上忙，所以大池子更划算。代价方面讲义 p.123 补一句：两组（例如两个扇区）的 SIR 可能更好，因为每组只受到一部分同频干扰。
Pooled: 4.46 Er (44.6%) · split: 2.72 Er (27.2%) · pooling carries about 60% more集中：4.46 Er（44.6%） · 分散：2.72 Er（27.2%） · 集中多承载约 60%
One big pot holds 60% more than two small pots. This is the principle behind the later sectoring and operator-comparison examples.一大锅比两小锅多 60%。这是后面扇区化和运营商对比两道题的原理。
In your discussion, add one sentence: with two groups the SIR may be better. If you write only about capacity and leave out this SIR side of the trade-off, the answer is incomplete.评述时要补一句：分成两组后 SIR 可能更好。只写容量，不写 SIR 这个代价，答案不完整。
Concept + Step by step: trunking efficiency, why a big pool is better

ConceptTrunking efficiency

Notes Part A p.124 define: trunking efficiency = traffic carried per channel at a specified GoS (Erlang/channel), between 0 and 1. It means the same as ηt = traffic ÷ number of channels on p.42.讲义 Part A p.124 定义：干线效率 = 在指定 GoS 下每条信道承载的话务量（Erlang/信道），在 0 和 1 之间。它和 p.42 的 ηt = 话务量 ÷ 信道数是同一个意思。

Why pooling channels is better: calls arrive randomly. With two separate groups, group A may have all 5 channels busy and reject a new call while group B has idle channels it cannot lend. In one big group of 10, any idle channel can take any call, so busy and idle periods balance out. To keep the same 1% blocking, small groups must keep more spare capacity, so their average utilisation is lower. This is the trunking effect, like one queue for several bank counters being more efficient than a separate queue at each counter.为什么信道合在一起更划算：呼叫是随机到达的。两个小组分开时，可能 A 组 5 条全忙、新呼叫被拒，同时 B 组还有空闲信道却用不上。合成一个 10 条的大组后，任何空闲信道都能接任何呼叫，"忙闲互补"。为了保持同样的阻塞率 1%，小组必须留更多余量，所以平均利用率低。这叫集群效应（trunking），像银行一条队对多个窗口，比每个窗口各排一队效率高。

What it costs: channels are usually split into two groups because they go to two sectors or two cells, and each group then faces less co-channel interference, so SIR may be better (last sentence of p.123). This is exactly the trade-off of sectoring later (p.145, p.148).代价是什么：把信道分成两组通常是因为分给了两个扇区或两个小区，每组面对的同频干扰更少，SIR 可能更好（p.123 原文最后一句）。这正是后面扇区化（p.145、p.148）的取舍。

Step by stepRead the table → find the efficiency → compare

  1. One group of 10: Erlang B table M = 10, GoS = 0.01 → A = 4.46 Er.
  2. Two groups of 5: M = 5, GoS = 0.01 → 1.36 Er per group, 2 × 1.36 for both.两组各 5 条：M = 5、GoS = 0.01 → 每组 1.36 Er，两组共 2 × 1.36。
  3. Trunking efficiency: divide both by the total of 10 channels.干线效率：都除以总信道数 10。
  4. Compare: divide the larger by the smaller and subtract 1 to get "how many percent more".比较：用大的除以小的，减 1 就是"多出百分之几"。
One group: A = 4.46 Er, efficiency = 4.46 ÷ 10 = 0.446 = 44.6%
Two groups: A = 2 × 1.36 = 2.72 Er, efficiency = 2.72 ÷ (2 × 5) = 0.272 = 27.2%
Ratio = 4.46 ÷ 2.72 = 1.64 → carries 64% more (the notes say "60%", a rounded figure)一组：A = 4.46 Er，效率 = 4.46 ÷ 10 = 0.446 = 44.6%
两组：A = 2 × 1.36 = 2.72 Er，效率 = 2.72 ÷ (2 × 5) = 0.272 = 27.2%
比值 = 4.46 ÷ 2.72 = 1.64 → 多承载 64%（讲义写"60%"，是取整的说法）

(Exact formula values: 4.461 for M = 10 and 1.361 for M = 5, so the table values are correct.)（公式精确值：M = 10 为 4.461，M = 5 为 1.361，表值正确。）

The other way round: after splitting into two groups, the carried traffic drops by (4.46 − 2.72) ÷ 4.46 = 39%. If an exam question asks "how much more", use the smaller value as the base (64%, about 60%); if it asks "how much less", use the larger value as the base (39%). Do not mix up the base.反过来说：拆成两组后承载量少了 (4.46 − 2.72) ÷ 4.46 = 39%。考试题如果问"多多少"，以小的为基准（64%，约 60%）；问"少多少"，以大的为基准（39%）。基准别弄反。

Pitfalls

  • Multiply the two-group traffic by 2; the efficiency's denominator is the total of 10 channels.两组的话务量要乘 2，效率的分母是总共 10 条信道。
  • Your comment must cover both sides: capacity (trunking efficiency) drops, but SIR may be better. Writing only about capacity is incomplete.评述要两面写：容量（干线效率）下降，但 SIR 可能更好。只写容量不完整。
  • The GoS for the table lookup is 0.01 (1%), not 2%.查表时 GoS 是 0.01（1%），不是 2%。

ExamHow to write it in English

From the Erlang B table at GoS = 0.01, 10 trunked channels support 4.46 Erlangs, while two groups of 5 channels support 2 × 1.36 = 2.72 Erlangs. Trunking efficiency (carried Erlangs per channel) is 4.46/10 = 0.446 (44.6%) for one group and 2.72/10 = 0.272 (27.2%) for two groups. Hence one group of 10 channels carries about 60% more traffic (4.46/2.72 = 1.64) than two groups of 5 channels, because a larger trunk pool shares idle channels among all calls. However, splitting into two groups (e.g. two sectors) would probably give a better SIR.

In one line: at the same 1% blocking, 10 pooled channels carry 4.46 Er (44.6%), while 5 + 5 carry only 2.72 Er (27.2%); pooling carries about 60% more, at the cost of a worse SIR than split groups.一句话：同样 1% 阻塞，10 条合用承载 4.46 Er（44.6%），拆成 5 + 5 只有 2.72 Er（27.2%），合用多约 60%，代价是 SIR 不如分组。
Lecture example
p.130–132

Market penetration of three operators

Original questionSlide 130

In a residential area with 1.2 million people, there are 3 service providers (Singa, Mobi, Hubba). Singa has 380 cells with 20 channels each. Mobi has 100 cells with 60 channels each. Hubba has 60 cell with 100 channels each.

Find the number of users supported by each blocked system with GoS of 2%. Given that each user has average 3 calls per hour with an average call duration of 5 minutes. Assuming that all 3 service provider operates at maximum capacity, compute the percentage market penetration for each provider.

A residential area has 1.2 million people. Three operators all run at full load with GoS 2%. Each user makes 3 calls per hour, 5 minutes each. Find the number of users each operator supports and its market penetration.某住宅区 120 万人，三家运营商都满负荷运行，GoS 2%。每用户每小时 3 次、每次 5 分钟。求各家支持的用户数和市场渗透率。
Singa: 380 cells × 20 channelsMobi: 100 cells × 60 channelsHubba: 60 cells × 100 channelsSinga：380 小区 × 20 信道Mobi：100 小区 × 60 信道Hubba：60 小区 × 100 信道
  1. Traffic per user: Au = calls per hour × duration per call, with 5 minutes converted to hours:每用户话务量：Au = 每小时呼叫数 × 每次时长，5 分钟换成小时：
    Au = 3 × 5/60 = 0.25 Erlang
  2. Read the Erlang B table (GoS = 0.02): M = 20 → 13 Er, M = 60 → 50 Er, M = 100 → 90 Er (the rounded values used on notes p.131).查 Erlang B 表（GoS = 0.02）：M = 20 → 13 Er，M = 60 → 50 Er，M = 100 → 90 Er（讲义 p.131 取的整数）。
  3. Users per cell → total users → penetration: the same three steps for all three operators: users per cell U = A ÷ Au (÷ 0.25 is the same as × 4), then × the number of cells, then ÷ the total population of 1,200,000 to get the market penetration:每小区用户 → 总用户 → 渗透率：三家用同一套三步：每小区用户 U = A ÷ Au（÷ 0.25 就是 × 4），再 × 小区数，再 ÷ 总人口 1,200,000 得市场渗透率（market penetration）：
    OperatorMAUsers/cellTotal usersPenetration
    Singa20135219,7601.65%
    Mobi605020020,0001.67%
    Hubba1009036021,6001.80%
    E.g. Singa: 13 ÷ 0.25 = 52 users/cell, 52 × 380 = 19,760 users, 19,760 ÷ 1,200,000 = 1.65%.例如 Singa：13 ÷ 0.25 = 52 人/小区，52 × 380 = 19,760 人，19,760 ÷ 1,200,000 = 1.65%。
  4. Total:
    19,760 + 20,000 + 21,600 = 61,360 users
    61,360 ÷ 1,200,000 = 5.11%
    Self-check: 1.65% + 1.67% + 1.80% = 5.12%, which differs from 5.11% only by rounding ✓.自检：1.65% + 1.67% + 1.80% = 5.12%，和 5.11% 只差四舍五入 ✓。
  5. Why Hubba has the most: compare the trunking efficiency A/M: Singa 13/20 = 0.65, Mobi 50/60 = 0.83, Hubba 90/100 = 0.90. Singa has the most channels in total (380 × 20 = 7600; the other two have 6000 each), but only 20 per cell, so its efficiency is the lowest and, with the table values, it actually has the fewest users. This is the same idea as "one big pot beats two small pots" on p.123. (With the exact formula values, Singa ≈ 20,036 users (1.67%), which would rank ahead of Mobi's 19,858 users; Hubba is still first. See the check box below.)为什么 Hubba 最多：比干线效率 A/M：Singa 13/20 = 0.65，Mobi 50/60 = 0.83，Hubba 90/100 = 0.90。Singa 总信道最多（380 × 20 = 7600 条，另两家各 6000 条），但每小区只有 20 条，效率最低，按表值用户反而最少。这和 p.123"一大锅比两小锅强"是同一个道理。（按公式精确值 Singa ≈ 20,036 人（1.67%），会排到 Mobi 19,858 人前面，Hubba 仍然第一，见下方核对框。）
Singa 19,760 (1.65%) · Mobi 20,000 (1.67%) · Hubba 21,600 (1.80%) · total 5.11%
Singa has the most channels in total (7600), and Mobi and Hubba both have 6000, but Hubba has the most users, because its channels are concentrated in a few cells. This is the same principle as the previous question: "one big pot beats two small pots".总信道数 Singa 7600 最多，Mobi 和 Hubba 都是 6000，但 Hubba 用户最多，因为它的信道集中在少数小区里。这和上一题「一大锅比两小锅强」是同一个道理。
The denominator of the penetration is the total population of 1.2 million. Convert the unit of Au from minutes to hours (÷ 60).渗透率的分母是 120 万总人口。Au 的单位要从分钟换算成小时（÷ 60）。
The table values in the notes are rounded. Exact values from the formula: Mobi with M = 60 gives A = 49.6, Hubba with M = 100 gives A = 88.0, i.e. penetration of about 1.65% and 1.76%; Singa with M = 20 gives A = 13.18, about 20,036 users (1.67%). Hubba still has the most users and the conclusion stands; only Singa and Mobi swap places (they differ by about 1%). In the exam, use the table values.讲义表值取了整数。公式精确值：Mobi M = 60 时 A = 49.6，Hubba M = 100 时 A = 88.0，渗透率约 1.65% 和 1.76%；Singa M = 20 时 A = 13.18，约 20,036 人（1.67%）。Hubba 仍然最多，结论不变，只是 Singa 和 Mobi 的先后对调（两家只差约 1%）。考试按表值写即可。
Concept + Step by step: users and market penetration of three operators

ConceptFrom "number of channels" to "market penetration"

This question applies Erlang B to comparing operators (notes Part A p.130–132). It uses three concepts:这道题把 Erlang B 用到运营商对比上（讲义 Part A p.130–132）。用到三个概念：

  • Traffic per user Au = calls per hour × duration of each call (hours), p.118.每用户话务量 Au = 每小时呼叫次数 × 每次时长（小时），p.118。
  • Maximum traffic per cell A: read from the Erlang B table (M = channels per cell, GoS = 2%), p.119–121. "Operating at maximum capacity" in the question means every cell runs at the A for 2% blocking.每小区最大话务量 A：查 Erlang B 表（M = 每小区信道数，GoS = 2%），p.119–121。题目说"满负荷运行"（maximum capacity），就是每个小区都跑到 2% 阻塞时的 A。
  • Market penetration = number of users the operator can serve ÷ total population of the area.市场渗透率（market penetration）= 运营商能服务的用户数 ÷ 区域总人口。

Calculation chain: table gives A → users per cell U = A/Au → times number of cells gives total users → divide by total population.计算链：查表得 A → 每小区用户 U = A/Au → 乘小区数得总用户 → 除以总人口。

The deeper principle here is trunking efficiency (p.123–124): the more channels per cell, the more traffic each channel carries. So more channels in total does not necessarily mean more users; what matters is whether the channels are concentrated.本题的深层道理是干线效率（p.123–124）：每小区信道越多，每条信道承载的话务越多。所以总信道数多不一定用户多，关键看信道是否集中。

Step by stepThe same three steps, done three times

  1. Au: 3 calls/hour × 5 minutes, with 5 minutes = 5/60 hours.Au：3 次/小时 × 5 分钟，5 分钟 = 5/60 小时。
  2. Read the table: GoS = 0.02, M = 20, 60, 100 give 13, 50, 90 Erlang respectively (integers taken by the notes).查表：GoS = 0.02，M = 20、60、100 分别读出 13、50、90 Erlang（讲义取的整数）。
  3. Users per cell = A ÷ 0.25, i.e. A × 4.每小区用户 = A ÷ 0.25，即 A × 4。
  4. Total users = users per cell × number of cells.总用户 = 每小区用户 × 小区数。
  5. Penetration = total users ÷ 1,200,000.渗透率 = 总用户 ÷ 1,200,000。
Au = 3 × 5/60 = 0.25 Er
Singa: 13 ÷ 0.25 = 52 users/cell, 52 × 380 = 19,760 users, 19,760 ÷ 1,200,000 = 1.65%
Mobi: 50 ÷ 0.25 = 200 users/cell, 200 × 100 = 20,000 users, 1.67%
Hubba: 90 ÷ 0.25 = 360 users/cell, 360 × 60 = 21,600 users, 1.80%
Total: 61,360 ÷ 1,200,000 = 5.11%Au = 3 × 5/60 = 0.25 Er
Singa：13 ÷ 0.25 = 52 人/小区，52 × 380 = 19,760 人，19,760 ÷ 1,200,000 = 1.65%
Mobi：50 ÷ 0.25 = 200 人/小区，200 × 100 = 20,000 人，1.67%
Hubba：90 ÷ 0.25 = 360 人/小区，360 × 60 = 21,600 人，1.80%
合计：61,360 ÷ 1,200,000 = 5.11%

Why Hubba wins: look at each operator's trunking efficiency and "users per channel".为什么 Hubba 赢：看每家的干线效率和"每条信道的用户数"。

OperatorTotal channelsTrunking efficiency A/MUsers/channel
Singa380 × 20 = 760013/20 = 0.652.6
Mobi100 × 60 = 600050/60 = 0.833.33
Hubba60 × 100 = 600090/100 = 0.903.6

Singa has the most channels, but because each cell has only 20 channels and its trunking efficiency is only 65%, it has the fewest users. This is the same principle as p.123: "one big pot beats two small pots".Singa 信道最多，却因为每小区只有 20 条、干线效率只有 65%，用户反而最少。和 p.123"一大锅比两小锅强"是同一个道理。

Exact values: from the Erlang B formula, M = 20 gives 13.18, M = 60 gives 49.64 and M = 100 gives 87.97 (the notes use 90). With exact values Hubba has 87.97 × 4 × 60 = 21,113 users (1.76%), Mobi 19,858 users (1.65%) and Singa about 13.18 × 4 × 380 ≈ 20,036 users (1.67%). Hubba still has the most and the conclusion stands; only Singa and Mobi swap places (they differ by about 1%). In the exam, use the table values.精确值说明：用 Erlang B 公式算，M = 20 为 13.18，M = 60 为 49.64，M = 100 为 87.97（讲义取 90）。按精确值 Hubba 是 87.97 × 4 × 60 = 21,113 人（1.76%），Mobi 19,858 人（1.65%），Singa 约 13.18 × 4 × 380 ≈ 20,036 人（1.67%）。Hubba 仍然最多，结论不变；只是 Singa 和 Mobi 的先后对调了（两家只差约 1%）。考试按表值写。

Pitfalls

  • Divide 5 minutes by 60 to get hours; writing 3 × 5 = 15 Er is off by a factor of 60.5 分钟要除以 60 换成小时，写成 3 × 5 = 15 Er 就错了 60 倍。
  • The penetration denominator is the total population of 1.2 million, not the sum of the three operators' users.渗透率分母是 120 万总人口，不是三家用户之和。
  • Multiply each operator by its own number of cells (380, 100, 60); do not mix them up.每家都要乘自己的小区数（380、100、60），别混。

ExamHow to write it in English

Traffic per user Au = 3 × 5/60 = 0.25 Erlang. Singa: from the Erlang B table (GoS = 0.02, M = 20), A = 13 Erlangs, so U = A/Au = 52 users per cell and 52 × 380 = 19 760 users. Mobi: M = 60 gives A = 50 Erlangs, U = 200 users per cell, 200 × 100 = 20 000 users. Hubba: M = 100 gives A = 90 Erlangs, U = 360 users per cell, 360 × 60 = 21 600 users. Market penetration: Singa 19 760/1 200 000 = 1.65%, Mobi 1.67%, Hubba 1.80%; total 61 360/1 200 000 = 5.11%. Hubba supports the most users with the fewest cells because more channels per cell give a higher trunking efficiency.

In one line: Au = 0.25 Er; table → ÷ 0.25 → × number of cells → ÷ 1.2 million gives 1.65%, 1.67%, 1.80%, total 5.11%; the more concentrated the channels, the higher the trunking efficiency.一句话：Au = 0.25 Er，查表 → ÷ 0.25 → × 小区数 → ÷ 120 万，得 1.65%、1.67%、1.80%，合计 5.11%；信道越集中，干线效率越高。
Lecture example
p.133–134

Urban cellular system planning

Original questionSlide 133

A city has an area of 1300 km2 and is covered by a seven-cell reuse pattern system. Each cell has an area of 41.5 km2, and each cluster is allocated 40MHz of spectrum with a full duplex channel bandwidth of 60kHz. Assume a GoS of 2% for an Erlang B system is specified. If the offered traffic per user is 0.03 Erlangs, Compute:

  • Number of cells in the service area
  • Number of channels per cell
  • Traffic intensity of each cell
  • Maximum traffic
  • Total number of users that can be served for 2% GoS
  • Numbers of mobiles per unique channel
  • Theoretical maximum number of users that could be served at one time by the system
A city covers 1300km², with seven-cell reuse, 40MHz allocated per cluster, and Erlang B with GoS 2%. Find in turn: the number of cells, channels per cell, traffic per cell, maximum traffic, number of users served, users per unique channel, and the theoretical maximum number of users served simultaneously.城市面积 1300km²，七小区复用，每簇分配 40MHz，采用 Erlang B、GoS 2%。依次求：小区数、每小区信道数、每小区话务量、最大话务量、可服务用户数、每个唯一信道的用户数、理论最大同时服务数。
Cell area 41.5km²Full-duplex channel 60kHz0.03 Er per user小区面积 41.5km²全双工信道 60kHz每用户 0.03 Er
  1. ① Number of cells: total area ÷ area per cell: 1300 ÷ 41.5 = 31.3 → 31 cells (cells must be a whole number; notes p.134 takes 31).① 小区数：总面积 ÷ 每小区面积：1300 ÷ 41.5 = 31.3 → 31 个小区（小区取整数，讲义 p.134 取 31）。
  2. ② Channels per cell: each cluster has 40 MHz = 40,000 kHz, cut into full-duplex channels of 60 kHz each, then shared among 7 cells:② 每小区信道数：每簇 40 MHz = 40,000 kHz，按 60 kHz 一条全双工信道切，再分给 7 个小区：
    M = 40,000 ÷ (60 × 7) = 95.2 → 95 channels/cell
    60 kHz is already the full-duplex width (uplink and downlink together), so do not multiply by 2 again; round the channel count down.60 kHz 已经是全双工（上下行合计）的宽度，不要再乘 2；信道数向下取整。
  3. ③ Traffic per cell: Erlang B table, M = 95, GoS = 0.02 → A = 84 Erlang/cell (table value in the notes; exact formula value 83.1).③ 每小区话务量：查 Erlang B 表 M = 95、GoS = 0.02 → A = 84 Erlang/小区（讲义表值；公式精确值 83.1）。
  4. ④ Maximum traffic: whole system = traffic per cell × number of cells: 31 × 84 = 2604 Erlang④ 最大话务量：全系统 = 每小区话务 × 小区数：31 × 84 = 2604 Erlang
  5. ⑤ Number of users that can be served: total traffic ÷ traffic per user: 2604 ÷ 0.03 = 86,800 users⑤ 可服务用户数：总话务 ÷ 每用户话务：2604 ÷ 0.03 = 86,800 用户
  6. ⑥ Users per unique channel: unique channels = the distinct channels in one cluster = 95 × 7 = 665; the whole system just reuses these 665 channels over and over:⑥ 每个唯一信道的用户数：唯一信道（unique channel）= 一簇里互不相同的信道 = 95 × 7 = 665 条，全系统只是把这 665 条反复复用：
    86,800 ÷ 665 = 130.5 ≈ 130 users/channel
    Check: the whole area has 95 × 31 = 2945 physical channels, each with 86,800 ÷ 2945 = 29.47 users; each unique channel is reused 31 ÷ 7 = 4.429 times, 29.47 × 4.429 = 130.5 ✓.验算：全区物理信道 95 × 31 = 2945 条，每条 86,800 ÷ 2945 = 29.47 人；每个唯一信道被复用 31 ÷ 7 = 4.429 次，29.47 × 4.429 = 130.5 ✓。
  7. ⑦ Theoretical maximum number served at the same time: a channel can be used by only one user at a time, so this equals the total number of channels in the area:⑦ 理论最大同时服务数：一条信道同一时刻只能给一个人用，所以等于全区信道数：
    95 × 31 = 2945 users; 2945 ÷ 86,800 = 3.4%
    At most 3.4% of the users can be talking at the same time, yet the system serves 86,800 users, because each user averages only 0.03 Er (talking 3% of the time in the busy hour). Check: 3.4% = Au ÷ trunking efficiency = 0.03 ÷ (84/95) = 0.03 ÷ 0.884 ✓.同时最多只有 3.4% 的用户在通话，系统却能服务 86,800 人，因为每人平均只占 0.03 Er（忙时 3% 的时间在通话）。检查：3.4% = Au ÷ 干线效率 = 0.03 ÷ (84/95) = 0.03 ÷ 0.884 ✓。
31 cells · 95 channels/cell · 84 Er/cell · 2604 Er · 86,800 users · 130 users/channel · 2945 (3.4%)31 个小区 · 95 信道/小区 · 84 Er/小区 · 2604 Er · 86,800 用户 · 130 用户/信道 · 2945（3.4%）
The seven parts form one chain, in order: area ratio → bandwidth ratio → table lookup → × number of cells → ÷ Au → ÷ 665 → × 31.七问按顺序是一条链：面积比 → 带宽比 → 查表 → 乘小区数 → 除 Au → 除 665 → 乘 31。
① 60kHz is already the full-duplex channel width, so do not multiply by 2 again; ② "unique channels" means 665 (one cluster, 95 × 7), not the system-wide 2945.① 60kHz 已经是全双工信道宽度，不要再乘 2；② 「唯一信道」是 665（一簇 95 × 7），不是全系统的 2945。
Exact value from the formula: with M = 95 and GoS 2%, A = 83.1 (the notes use 84), giving about 85,900 users.公式精确值：M = 95、GoS 2% 时 A = 83.1（讲义取 84），用户数约 85,900。
Concept + Step by step: seven questions on urban cellular system planning

ConceptWhat a complete system plan computes

Notes Part A p.133–134 link everything learnt so far into one chain: area → number of cells; spectrum → channels per cell; Erlang B → traffic per cell; then number of users. First get a few terms clear:讲义 Part A p.133–134 把前面学的东西串成一条链：面积 → 小区数；频谱 → 每小区信道数；Erlang B → 每小区话务量；再到用户数。先搞清几个词：

  • Full duplex channel bandwidth 60 kHz: this already includes uplink and downlink; one duplex channel takes 60 kHz, so do not multiply by 2 again (compare p.82, which gives a simplex 25 kHz).全双工信道带宽 60 kHz（full duplex channel bandwidth）：已经包含上下行，一个双工信道就占 60 kHz，不用再乘 2（对比 p.82 给的是单工 25 kHz）。
  • 40 MHz per cluster: the 7 cells of a cluster share these 40 MHz, so channels per cell = 40 MHz ÷ (60 kHz × 7).每簇 40 MHz：一簇 7 个小区共用这 40 MHz，所以每小区信道数 = 40 MHz ÷ (60 kHz × 7)。
  • Unique channels: all the distinct channels in one cluster, 95 × 7 = 665 in total. The other clusters in the area just reuse these 665.唯一信道（unique channel）：一簇里所有不同的信道，共 95 × 7 = 665 条。全区其他簇只是重复使用这 665 条。
  • Theoretical maximum served at once: the number of calls when every channel in every cell is busy = channels per cell × number of cells.理论最大同时服务数：所有小区所有信道同时被占满时的通话数 = 每小区信道数 × 小区数。

Erlang B table lookup (p.119–121): Lecturer's emphasis: use the table only; for channel numbers not in the table, interpolate linearly (p.127).Erlang B 查表（p.119–121）：老师课上强调只查表，表里没有的信道数用线性插值（p.127）。

Step by stepSeven questions, one chain

  1. Number of cells: total area ÷ area per cell = 31.3; the notes take 31 (a whole number of cells).小区数：总面积 ÷ 每小区面积 = 31.3，按讲义取 31（整数个小区）。
  2. Channels per cell: 40,000 kHz ÷ (60 × 7) = 95.2, round down to 95.每小区信道数：40,000 kHz ÷ (60 × 7) = 95.2，向下取整 95。
  3. Traffic per cell: Erlang B table M = 95, GoS = 0.02 → A = 84 Erlang/cell (value in the notes).每小区话务量：Erlang B 表 M = 95、GoS = 0.02 → A = 84 Erlang/小区（讲义值）。
  4. Maximum traffic: 31 cells × 84.最大话务量：31 个小区 × 84。
  5. Number of users: total traffic ÷ 0.03 Er per user.用户数：总话务 ÷ 每用户 0.03 Er。
  6. Users per unique channel: number of users ÷ 665.每个唯一信道的用户数：用户数 ÷ 665。
  7. Theoretical maximum served at once: 95 × 31, then compare with the total number of users.理论最大同时服务数：95 × 31，再和总用户数比。
① 1300 ÷ 41.5 = 31.3 → 31 cells
② 40000 ÷ (60 × 7) = 95.2 → 95 channels/cell
③ A = 84 Er/cell
④ 31 × 84 = 2604 Er
⑤ 2604 ÷ 0.03 = 86,800 users
⑥ unique channels 95 × 7 = 665; 86,800 ÷ 665 = 130.5 ≈ 130 users/channel
⑦ 95 × 31 = 2945; 2945 ÷ 86,800 = 3.4%① 1300 ÷ 41.5 = 31.3 → 31 个小区
② 40000 ÷ (60 × 7) = 95.2 → 95 条/小区
③ A = 84 Er/小区
④ 31 × 84 = 2604 Er
⑤ 2604 ÷ 0.03 = 86,800 用户
⑥ 唯一信道 95 × 7 = 665；86,800 ÷ 665 = 130.5 ≈ 130 用户/信道
⑦ 95 × 31 = 2945；2945 ÷ 86,800 = 3.4%

Check ⑥: there are 2945 physical channels in the area, each serving 86,800 ÷ 2945 = 29.47 users on average; each unique channel is reused 31 ÷ 7 = 4.429 times across the area, and 29.47 × 4.429 = 130.5, matching ⑥.验算⑥：全区物理信道 2945 条，每条平均 86,800 ÷ 2945 = 29.47 人；每个唯一信道在全区被重复使用 31 ÷ 7 = 4.429 次，29.47 × 4.429 = 130.5，和⑥一致。

What ⑦ means: at any instant the system can let at most 3.4% of users talk, yet it serves 86,800 people, because each person averages only 0.03 Er (on a call 3% of the busy hour).⑦ 的意义：系统同一时刻最多只能让 3.4% 的用户通话，却能服务 86,800 人，因为每人平均只占 0.03 Er（忙时 3% 的时间在打电话）。

Note on exact values: the Erlang B formula gives 83.1 Er for M = 95 at 2% (the notes use 84); with the exact value there are about 85,900 users. In the exam, use the table value, or state that it was read from the table.精确值说明：Erlang B 公式算 M = 95、2% 是 83.1 Er（讲义取 84），按精确值用户数约 85,900。考试按表值写，或注明查表所得。

Pitfalls

  • 60 kHz is already the full-duplex bandwidth; do not multiply by 2 again.60 kHz 已是全双工带宽，不要再乘 2。
  • "Unique channels" are the 665 of one cluster, not the 2945 of the whole area."唯一信道"是一簇的 665 条，不是全区的 2945 条。
  • ⑦ is channels × cells, not the number of users.⑦ 是信道数 × 小区数，不是用户数。

ExamHow to write it in English

(1) Number of cells = 1300/41.5 ≈ 31 cells. (2) Channels per cell M = 40 000 kHz/(60 kHz × 7) ≈ 95 channels. (3) From the Erlang B table (GoS = 0.02, M = 95), A = 84 Erlangs/cell. (4) Maximum traffic = 31 × 84 = 2604 Erlangs. (5) Number of users = 2604/0.03 = 86 800 users. (6) Number of unique channels = 95 × 7 = 665, so mobiles per unique channel = 86 800/665 ≈ 130. (7) Theoretical maximum number of users served at one time = 95 × 31 = 2945, which is about 3.4% of the subscribers.

In one line: area ratio gives 31 cells, bandwidth ratio gives 95 channels, the table gives 84 Er, × 31 = 2604 Er, ÷ 0.03 = 86,800 users, ÷ 665 ≈ 130 users/channel, and at most 2945 people can talk at once (3.4%).一句话：面积比得 31 个小区，带宽比得 95 条信道，查表 84 Er，× 31 = 2604 Er，÷ 0.03 = 86,800 人，÷ 665 ≈ 130 人/信道，同时最多 2945 人通话（3.4%）。

Topics: cell radius from Erlang B · trunking gain · the cost of 120° sectoring考点：Erlang B 反推小区半径 · 集群增益 · 120° 扇区化的代价
Original question (verbatim)

3. (a) A heavily populated small island has a user density of 720 users per km2 for the service area. The operator A decides to select a cellular system that has a cluster size Nc = 7 and a total of 399 duplex traffic channels. The system uses a fixed channel assignment, blocked calls cleared scheme and omni-directional antennas at the base station (BS). During the busy hour, on the average, a user generates 0.9 call with a holding time of 90 seconds. The expected Grade of Service (GOS) is given by 1% blocking probability. The service area will be covered by hexagonal cells with radius R. Note: The area of each hexagonal cell is Ace = (3√3/2)R2. State and justify any necessary assumptions.

(i) Determine the number of channels per cluster and the offered traffic supported by the GOS.

(ii) Determine the number of users m and the offered traffic generated by users in each cell.

(iii) Determine the cell radius R, when the offered traffic generated by users is equal to the offered traffic supported for the given GOS for each cell.

(iv) Determine the trunking gain Tg of the system.

(v) Suppose the operator A decides to improve the hexagonal cellular design further where one uses the 120-degree sector being deployed in each cell for the BS. For this new design, calculate the new value of R and Tg. State your observation and comment on the changes to the results from the operator's perspective.

(20 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
Assumptions: ① fixed, uniform channel allocation (UFCA), with the same number of channels in every cell; ② blocked calls cleared (blocked calls are dropped, not queued) → use Erlang B; ③ all 399 are traffic channels (the question says traffic channels, so no control channels are subtracted); ④ users are uniformly distributed over the service area, and every user offers the same busy-hour traffic.假设：① 固定、均匀信道分配（UFCA），每小区信道数相同；② blocked calls cleared（被阻塞的呼叫直接丢弃、不排队）→ 用 Erlang B；③ 399 条全是话务信道（题目说 traffic channels，不扣控制信道）；④ 用户在服务区内均匀分布，忙时每个用户的话务量相同。
2
(i) Channels per cluster and per cell: one cluster uses all the channels exactly once, so there are 399 per cluster, shared equally by Nc = 7 cells:(i) 每簇、每小区信道数：一个簇正好把全部信道用一遍，所以每簇 399 条；Nc = 7 个小区平分：
399 / 7 = 57 channels/cell
(57 × 7 = 399 ✓, divides exactly)
3
(i) Read the Erlang B table: Erlang B formula B = (AM/M!) / Σk=0M(Ak/k!) (notes Part A p.118–119). Read row M = 57, column B = 1%:(i) 查 Erlang B 表：Erlang B 公式 B = (AM/M!) / Σk=0M(Ak/k!)（讲义 Part A p.118–119）。查表 M = 57 行、B = 1% 列：
A ≈ 44.2 Erlang / cell
Check: putting A = 44.22 and M = 57 back into the formula gives B = 0.0100 ✓. This is the maximum offered traffic per cell allowed by the GoS.验算：把 A = 44.22、M = 57 代回公式，B = 0.0100 ✓。这就是 GoS 允许的每小区最大提供话务量（offered traffic）。
4
(ii) Traffic per user: Au = call rate × mean call duration, with the duration in hours:(ii) 每用户话务量：Au = 呼叫率 × 平均时长，时长换成小时：
Au = 0.9 calls/h × (90/3600) h
 = 0.9 × 0.025 = 0.0225 Erlang
5
(ii) Users per cell: m users in a cell offer m × 0.0225 E of traffic. Set this equal to the 44.22 E the cell can support:(ii) 每小区用户数：小区内 m 个用户产生的话务量 = m × 0.0225 E。令它等于小区能支持的 44.22 E：
m = 44.22 / 0.0225 = 1965.3
→ 1965 users/cell
Round down so that blocking does not exceed 1%. Traffic offered by the users in each cell = 1965 × 0.0225 ≈ 44.2 E.向下取整，保证阻塞不超过 1%。每小区用户产生的话务量 = 1965 × 0.0225 ≈ 44.2 E。
6
(iii) Area → radius: area per cell = number of users / user density; then invert the hexagon area formula to get R:(iii) 面积 → 半径：每小区面积 = 用户数 / 用户密度，再用六边形面积公式反求 R：
Ace = 1965.3 / 720 = 2.730 km²
(3√3/2)R² = 2.598R² = 2.730
R² = 2.730 / 2.598 = 1.051
R = √1.051 ≈ 1.03 km
Check: 2.598 × 1.025² × 720 ≈ 1965 users ✓.
7
(iv) Trunking gain: notes p.122: trunking gain = number of users a group of channels can serve at the given GoS ÷ number of channels:(iv) 集群增益：讲义 p.122：集群增益（trunking gain）= 在给定 GoS 下一组信道能服务的用户数 ÷ 信道数：
Tg = 1965 / 57 ≈ 34.5 users/channel
Also: trunking efficiency = 44.22/57 = 77.6% (each channel is busy 77.6% of the time on average).顺带：集群效率 = 44.22/57 = 77.6%（每条信道平均有 77.6% 的时间在忙）。
8
(v) 120° sectors: recalculate: the 57 channels per cell are split among 3 sectors, 57/3 = 19 per sector, and each sector becomes a separate channel pool (users in one sector cannot borrow idle channels from another sector). From the Erlang B table (M = 19, B = 1%):(v) 120° 扇区：重新计算：每小区 57 条信道分给 3 个扇区，每扇区 57/3 = 19 条，各自成为独立的信道池（一个扇区的用户借不到另一个扇区的空闲信道）。查 Erlang B（M = 19，B = 1%）：
A ≈ 11.23 E/sector
Per cell: 3 × 11.23 = 33.69 E
m = 33.69 / 0.0225 = 1497 users
Area = 1497 / 720 = 2.080 km²
R = √(2.080 / 2.598) = √0.800 ≈ 0.89 km
Tg = 1497 / 57 ≈ 26.3A ≈ 11.23 E/扇区
每小区 3 × 11.23 = 33.69 E
m = 33.69 / 0.0225 = 1497 用户
面积 = 1497 / 720 = 2.080 km²
R = √(2.080 / 2.598) = √0.800 ≈ 0.89 km
Tg = 1497 / 57 ≈ 26.3
9
(v) Observations and comments: the total number of channels is unchanged, but it is cut into 3 small pools, so trunking efficiency drops: the 57 channels together carry 44.2 E, but split up they carry only 33.7 E, about 24% less (1 − 33.69/44.22 = 0.238). So each cell covers a smaller area (R falls from 1.03 to 0.89 km), the same service area needs about 31% more base stations (44.22/33.69 = 1.31), and the trunking gain falls from 34.5 to 26.3. The benefit for the operator is in the SIR: first-tier co-channel interferers drop from 6 to 2, giving about 24.5 dB for N = 7, n = 4 (notes p.145), about 6 dB above the 18.7 dB of omnidirectional cells. This margin is what lets you move to a smaller cluster size N (p.144), which gives more channels per cell; only then does sectoring actually buy capacity. Adding sectors alone, with N unchanged, buys only an interference improvement, paid for with coverage, trunking efficiency and more handoffs (p.146).(v) 观察与评论：信道总数不变，但被切成 3 个小池，集群效率下降：57 条合用能承载 44.2 E，切开只有 33.7 E，少了约 24%（1 − 33.69/44.22 = 0.238）。所以每个小区覆盖的面积变小（R 从 1.03 降到 0.89 km），同样的服务区要多约 31% 的基站（44.22/33.69 = 1.31），集群增益从 34.5 降到 26.3。对运营商的好处在 SIR：第一层同频干扰从 6 个降到 2 个，N = 7、n = 4 时约 24.5 dB（讲义 p.145），比全向的 18.7 dB 高约 6 dB。有了这个余量才能改用更小的簇 N（p.144），每小区信道变多，扇区化才真正换来容量；在 N 不变的前提下单纯加扇区，只换来干扰改善，付出的是覆盖、集群效率和更多切换（p.146）。
57 channels/cell, A ≈ 44.2 E; m ≈ 1965; R ≈ 1.03 km; Tg ≈ 34.5; after sectoring R ≈ 0.89 km, Tg ≈ 26.357 条/小区，A ≈ 44.2 E；m ≈ 1965；R ≈ 1.03 km；Tg ≈ 34.5；扇区化后 R ≈ 0.89 km，Tg ≈ 26.3
Note: the Erlang B values of A were computed exactly from the formula (44.22, 11.23); they match the table in the paper to one decimal place.注：Erlang B 的 A 值用公式精确算出（44.22、11.23），和考卷附表读数相同到小数点后一位。
◆ Key points
What it tests
Erlang B table lookup, users per cell, cell radius from user density, trunking gain, the cost of sectoring (Part A traffic, notes p.122, p.145).Erlang B 查表、每小区用户数、由用户密度反推小区半径、集群增益、扇区化的代价（Part A 话务，讲义 p.122、p.145）。
Knowledge used
Channels per cell = total channels / N; Au = λH; number of users = A/Au; hexagon area (3√3/2)R²; trunking gain = users / channels.每小区信道 = 总信道 / N；Au = λH；用户数 = A/Au；六边形面积 (3√3/2)R²；集群增益 = 用户数 / 信道数。
Method
Channels → A from Erlang B → number of users → area → R. Sectoring: channels per sector = channels per cell / 3; look up the table per sector, multiply by 3, then continue as before.信道 → 查 Erlang B 得 A → 用户数 → 面积 → R。扇区化：每扇区信道 = 每小区 / 3，按扇区查表再乘 3，后面同样算。
Common mistakes
Au = 0.9 calls/hour × 90 s ÷ 3600 = 0.0225 E, so keep the time units consistent; after sectoring you cannot look up all 57 channels as one pool; use the hexagon formula for the area, not πR².Au = 0.9 次/小时 × 90 s ÷ 3600 = 0.0225 E，时间单位要统一；扇区化后不能再按 57 条整体查表；面积用六边形公式，不是 πR²。
Conclusion
Smaller channel pools mean lower trunking efficiency (44.2 E → 33.7 E, 24% less). The benefit of sectoring is SIR; with N unchanged, adding sectors does not increase capacity.信道池切小，集群效率下降（44.2 E → 33.7 E，少 24%）。扇区化的好处是 SIR；N 不变、只加扇区，不增加容量。
Concept + Step by step: cell radius from Erlang B, trunking gain and sectoring

ConceptTraffic, Erlang B and trunking gain

  • Traffic: A = λH, where λ is the number of calls per hour and H is the average call duration (in hours). The unit is the Erlang (E); 1 E = one channel fully occupied all the time. Traffic per user Au = calls per hour × call duration / 3600 (notes Part A p.115–116).话务量（traffic）：A = λH，λ 是每小时呼叫次数，H 是平均通话时长（小时）。单位 Erlang（E），1 E = 一条信道一直被占满。每用户话务量 Au = 每小时呼叫数 × 通话时长 / 3600（讲义 Part A p.115–116）。
  • Erlang B: the blocking probability PB with M channels and traffic A when blocked calls are cleared (blocked calls are dropped, not queued) (p.118–120). In the exam you use the table: given M and PB (GoS), read off the traffic A it can carry. The lecturer said in class that although the appendix gives the formula, he has never seen it actually used for calculation; it is always the table, and you must be able to interpolate linearly.Erlang B：blocked calls cleared（被阻塞的呼叫直接丢弃、不排队）时，M 条信道、话务量 A 下的阻塞概率 PB（p.118–120）。考试查表：已知 M 和 PB（GoS），读出能承载的 A。老师课上说附录虽给公式但从没见过真用它算，都是查表，要会线性插值。
  • Trunking: many users share a pool of channels because not everyone calls at the same time. The larger the channel pool, the more traffic each channel can carry on average (higher trunking efficiency). Trunking gain Tg = number of users a group of channels can serve at the given GoS ÷ number of channels (p.122).集群（trunking）：很多用户共用一组信道，因为不会所有人同时打电话。信道池越大，每条信道平均能多承担话务（集群效率高）。集群增益 Tg = 一组信道在给定 GoS 下能服务的用户数 ÷ 信道数（p.122）。
  • Sectoring: 120° directional antennas split a cell into 3 sectors, the number of co-channel interferers drops from 6 to 2 and the SIR improves; but each sector has only 1/3 of the channels as a separate pool, so trunking efficiency drops (p.143–149). The lecturer stressed in class that you must be able to explain this. The worked example on notes p.148–149 is also "57 channels, 1%, 120° sectors with 19 channels each, 24% less", the same numbers as this question.扇区化（sectoring）：用 120° 定向天线把一个小区分成 3 个扇区，同频干扰源从 6 个减到 2 个，SIR 提高；但每个扇区只有 1/3 的信道，各成独立的池，集群效率下降（p.143–149）。老师课上强调这一点要会讲。讲义 p.148–149 的例题正好也是"57 条信道、1%、120° 扇区每扇区 19 条、少了 24%"，和本题同一组数。

Step by stepState the assumptions first (the question asks you to "State and justify")

  • Uniform fixed channel assignment (UFCA): every cell has the same number of channels;均匀固定信道分配（UFCA）：每个小区信道数相同；
  • All 399 are traffic channels (the question says traffic channels); control channels are counted separately;399 条都是话务信道（题目已说 traffic channels），控制信道另算；
  • Blocked calls cleared → use Erlang B; calls arrive as a Poisson process, with many users;blocked calls cleared → 用 Erlang B；呼叫按泊松到达，用户数很多；
  • Users are uniformly distributed over the service area, the design uses busy-hour traffic; hexagonal cells.用户在服务区内均匀分布，按忙时（busy hour）话务设计；六边形小区。

Step by step(i)–(iv) Step by step

  1. Channels per cell: one cluster uses all 399 channels,每小区信道：一个簇用完全部 399 条，
    M = 399/7 = 57 channels/cell
  2. Erlang B table lookup (M = 57, PB = 1%):
    A ≈ 44.2 E/cell
  3. Traffic per user (watch the units: seconds → hours):每用户话务量（注意单位：秒 → 小时）：
    Au = 0.9 × 90/3600 = 0.0225 E
  4. Users per cell: set the traffic generated by the users equal to the traffic the cell can carry,每小区用户数：令用户产生的话务量 = 小区能承载的话务量，
    m = 44.2/0.0225 ≈ 1965 users/cell; traffic per cell = 1965 × 0.0225 ≈ 44.2 Em = 44.2/0.0225 ≈ 1965 用户/小区；每小区话务量 = 1965 × 0.0225 ≈ 44.2 E
  5. Cell area and radius:小区面积和半径：
    Area = 1965/720 = 2.73 km²
    R = √(2.73/2.598) = √1.051 ≈ 1.03 km
    Calculator: 3√3/2 = 2.598.
  6. Trunking gain:
    Tg = 1965/57 ≈ 34.5 users/channel
    (Compare the example on notes p.122: 24.2 for 50 channels at 2%. More channels give a larger Tg.)（对照讲义 p.122 例子：50 条、2% 时为 24.2。信道多了，Tg 也大。）

Step by step(v) 120° sectoring

  1. 57/3 = 19 channels per sector; table lookup (M = 19, 1%): A ≈ 11.2 E/sector, per cell 3 × 11.23 = 33.7 E.每扇区 57/3 = 19 条，查表（M = 19，1%）：A ≈ 11.2 E/扇区，每小区 3 × 11.23 = 33.7 E。
  2. m = 33.7/0.0225 ≈ 1497; area = 1497/720 = 2.08 km²; R = √(2.08/2.598) ≈ 0.89 km
  3. Tg = 1497/57 ≈ 26.3
  4. Comparison: the traffic each cell can offer (table value A) drops from 44.2 E to 33.7 E (about 24% less); trunking efficiency A/M drops from 0.78 to 0.59; the cells get smaller, so covering the same island needs about 2.73/2.08 ≈ 1.31 times as many base stations.对比：每小区能提供的话务量（表值 A）从 44.2 E 降到 33.7 E（少约 24%）；集群效率 A/M 从 0.78 降到 0.59；小区面积变小，覆盖同一个岛需要约 2.73/2.08 ≈ 1.31 倍的基站。

Comment from the operator's point of view: adding sectors alone while keeping the cluster size N = 7 buys a better SIR (interferers 6 → 2) at the cost of trunking efficiency, coverage area and more handoffs; sectoring only really increases capacity if the SIR margin is used to shrink the cluster (e.g. N = 7 → 4).运营商角度的评论：在簇大小 N = 7 不变的前提下单纯加扇区，换来的是更好的 SIR（干扰源 6 → 2），付出的是集群效率、覆盖面积和更多的切换；只有利用 SIR 余量缩小簇（例如 N = 7 → 4），扇区化才能真正提高容量。

PitfallsWatch out

  • Units of Au: divide 90 s by 3600 to get hours.Au 的单位：90 s 要除以 3600 变成小时。
  • After sectoring, look up the table with 19 channels and multiply by 3; do not look up 57 channels again.扇区化后要按 19 条查表再乘 3，不能还按 57 条查。
  • Use the hexagon formula (3√3/2)R² for the area, not πR².面积用六边形公式 (3√3/2)R²，不是 πR²。
  • When using the table, make sure it is the Erlang B table and the 1% column.查表时确认是 Erlang B 表、1% 那一列。
  • Round the number of users down (1965); one more user would exceed 1% blocking.用户数取整时向下取（1965），多一个人就超过 1% 阻塞。

ExamHow to write it in English

Assumptions: uniform fixed channel assignment (equal channels per cell); all 399 channels are traffic channels; blocked calls are cleared, so the Erlang B model applies (Poisson arrivals, large user population); users are uniformly distributed and the design is for the busy hour.

(i) Channels per cluster = 399, so channels per cell = 399/7 = 57. From the Erlang B table with M = 57 and GOS = 1%, the offered traffic supported is A ≈ 44.2 Erlangs per cell.

(ii) Traffic per user Au = 0.9 × 90/3600 = 0.0225 E. Number of users per cell m = 44.2/0.0225 ≈ 1965, and the offered traffic generated by these users is 1965 × 0.0225 ≈ 44.2 E per cell.

(iii) Cell area = 1965/720 = 2.73 km² = (3√3/2)R², so R = √(2.73/2.598) ≈ 1.03 km.

(iv) Trunking gain Tg = users served / number of channels = 1965/57 ≈ 34.5 users per channel.

(v) With 120° sectoring each sector has 57/3 = 19 channels. From the Erlang B table, A ≈ 11.2 E per sector, i.e. 33.7 E per cell. Users per cell = 33.7/0.0225 ≈ 1497, cell area = 1497/720 = 2.08 km², R ≈ 0.89 km, and Tg = 1497/57 ≈ 26.3.

Observation: the traffic carried per cell falls by about 24% because the channels are split into three smaller trunk groups, so the trunking efficiency drops (0.78 to 0.59). The cell radius must be reduced from 1.03 km to 0.89 km, so about 31% more base stations are needed. From the operator's perspective, sectoring with the same cluster size only improves the SIR (interferers reduced from 6 to 2) at the cost of capacity, coverage and more handoffs; it increases capacity only if the improved SIR is used to reduce the cluster size.

In one line: 57 channels/cell → table 44.2 E → 1965 users → 2.73 km² → R ≈ 1.03 km, Tg ≈ 34.5; sectoring splits the channel pool into 3, dropping to 33.7 E, R ≈ 0.89 km, Tg ≈ 26.3, and the only gain is SIR.一句话：57 条/小区 → 查表 44.2 E → 1965 人 → 2.73 km² → R ≈ 1.03 km，Tg ≈ 34.5；扇区化把信道池切成 3 份，降到 33.7 E、R ≈ 0.89 km、Tg ≈ 26.3，换来的只是 SIR。

2024-25 S2Q4(c)9 marks≡ HW1 Q1(b)
Topics: Erlang B: carried traffic · trunking efficiency · number of users · changing the cluster size考点：Erlang B：承载话务量 · 中继效率 · 用户数 · 换簇大小
Original question (verbatim)

(c) For a cellular system, suppose you selected the cluster size of Nc = 9, with a total number of available channels of 504. Assume that the average users place 2 calls of 15 minutes duration per hour for the given cellular system.

(i) Determine the carrier load per cell and the trunking efficiency for a 2% Grade of Service (GOS)?

(ii) Calculate the number of users that can be accommodated for this cell at that given GOS.

(iii) Compute the carried load and trunking efficiency if the cluster size is changed to Nc=7. Comment on your results.

(9 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
(i) Channels per cell:(i) 每小区信道数：
M = 504/9 = 56 channels/cell
2
(i) Look up the Erlang B table: M = 56, GOS (blocking probability) = 2% → supportable traffic A ≈ 45.9 E (the same number as the AMPS worked example on notes Part A p.44: 56 channels, 2% → 45.9 E).(i) 查 Erlang B 表：M = 56、GOS（阻塞率）= 2% → 可承载的话务量 A ≈ 45.9 E（和讲义 Part A p.44 AMPS 例题同一个数：56 条、2% → 45.9 E）。
3
(i) Carried traffic: "carrier load" in the question is a typo for carried load. Strictly, C = A(1 − PB) (notes Part A p.120):(i) 承载话务量：题目的 "carrier load" 是 carried load（承载话务量）的笔误。严格定义 C = A(1 − PB)（讲义 Part A p.120）：
C = 45.9 × (1 − 0.02) = 45.9 × 0.98 = 45.0 E
When the blocking probability is small, C ≈ A, so 45.9 E is also an acceptable answer.阻塞率小时 C ≈ A，所以答 45.9 E 也可以。
4
(i) Trunking efficiency: trunking efficiency = the average number of Erlangs carried per channel (notes Part A p.124):(i) 中继效率：中继效率（trunking efficiency）= 每条信道平均承载的 Erlang 数（讲义 Part A p.124）：
η = 45.9/56 ≈ 0.82
(using 45.0: 45.0/56 = 0.80)
5
(ii) Number of users: traffic per user = calls per hour × duration per call (in hours):(ii) 用户数：每用户话务量 = 每小时呼叫数 × 每次时长（小时）：
Au = 2 × 15/60 = 0.5 E/user
U = A/Au = 45.9/0.5 = 91.8 → 91 users
Round down: 91 × 0.5 = 45.5 E ≤ 45.9 ✓; 92 × 0.5 = 46.0 E > 45.9, so the blocking probability would exceed 2%.向下取整：91 × 0.5 = 45.5 E ≤ 45.9 ✓；92 × 0.5 = 46.0 E > 45.9，阻塞率会超过 2%。
6
(iii) Change to N = 7:
M = 504/7 = 72 channels/cell
Erlang B (72, 2%): A ≈ 61.0 E
Carried = 61.0 × 0.98 = 59.8 E
η = 61.0/72 ≈ 0.85 (using 59.8: 0.83)
Users = 61.0/0.5 = 122M = 504/7 = 72 条/小区
Erlang B（72，2%）：A ≈ 61.0 E
承载 = 61.0 × 0.98 = 59.8 E
η = 61.0/72 ≈ 0.85（用 59.8 算：0.83）
用户 = 61.0/0.5 = 122 人
7
(iii) Comment: with the smaller cluster, the channels per cell grow by 72/56 = 1.29 times (+29%), but the supportable traffic grows by 61.0/45.9 = 1.33 times (+33%), and the trunking efficiency rises from 0.82 to 0.85: the larger the channel pool, the higher the trunking efficiency (notes Part A p.123–124). The price is that co-channel cells are closer together, Q = √(3N) becomes smaller and the SIR drops (with n = 4):(iii) 评论：簇变小，每小区信道变成 72/56 = 1.29 倍（+29%），可承载话务量却变成 61.0/45.9 = 1.33 倍（+33%），中继效率从 0.82 升到 0.85：信道池越大，中继效率越高（讲义 Part A p.123–124）。代价是同频小区离得更近，Q = √(3N) 变小，SIR 下降（按 n = 4）：
N = 9: Q⁴/6 = 27²/6 = 121.5 → 20.8 dB
N = 7: Q⁴/6 = 21²/6 = 73.5 → 18.7 dB
(Same as the table on notes Part A p.89.) As long as the SIR requirement is no more than 18 dB, N = 7 is the better choice.（同讲义 Part A p.89 的表。）只要 SIR 要求不超过 18 dB，N = 7 更划算。
N = 9: 45.9 E, η ≈ 0.82, 91 users; N = 7: 61.0 E, η ≈ 0.85, 122 users
◆ Key points
What it tests
Erlang B: carried traffic, trunking efficiency, number of users, changing the cluster size (Part A traffic, AMPS example in notes p.44).Erlang B：承载话务量、中继效率、用户数、换簇大小（Part A 话务，讲义 p.44 AMPS 例题）。
Knowledge used
Carried traffic = A(1 − PB); trunking efficiency = A/M; users = A/Au, rounded down.承载话务 = A(1 − PB)；中继效率 = A/M；用户数 = A/Au，向下取整。
Method
M = 504/N → table → efficiency → users; change N and repeat to compare.M = 504/N → 查表 → 效率 → 用户数；换 N 再算一遍对比。
Common mistakes
Round users down (91, not 92); Au = 2 calls/hour × 15/60 hour = 0.5 E; "carrier load" is a typo for carried load.用户数向下取整（91，不是 92）；Au = 2 次/小时 × 15/60 小时 = 0.5 E；"carrier load"是 carried load 的笔误。
Conclusion
Smaller cluster → more channels per cell → higher trunking efficiency (0.82 → 0.85); the cost is a lower SIR (20.8 → 18.7 dB).簇变小 → 每小区信道多 → 集群效率高（0.82 → 0.85）；代价是 SIR 下降（20.8 → 18.7 dB）。
Concept + Step by step: carried traffic, trunking efficiency and changing the cluster size

ConceptOffered traffic, carried traffic and trunking efficiency

  • Offered traffic A: the total traffic the users want to make. The Erlang B table gives the maximum A that M channels can accept at blocking probability PB (notes Part A p.118–120).提供话务量（offered traffic）A：用户想打的话务总量。Erlang B 表给的是在 M 条信道、阻塞率 PB 下能接受的最大 A（讲义 Part A p.118–120）。
  • Carried traffic: the part that is actually connected; blocked calls do not count: C = A(1 − PB) (p.120). "carrier load" in the question is a typo for carried load.承载话务量（carried traffic）：真正接通的部分，被阻塞的那部分不算：C = A(1 − PB)（p.120）。题目里的 "carrier load" 是 carried load 的笔误。
  • Trunking efficiency: the average traffic per channel, between 0 and 1 (p.123–124). The example in the notes uses A/M (10 channels at 1%: 4.46/10 = 44.6%); strictly, using carried traffic it is A(1 − PB)/M. Writing both is safest.中继效率（trunking efficiency）：每条信道平均承担的话务，取值 0–1（p.123–124）。讲义例子用 A/M（10 条、1% 时 4.46/10 = 44.6%）；严格按承载话务算是 A(1 − PB)/M。两种都写上最保险。
  • Number of users = A/Au, where Au = calls per hour × duration per call (hours).用户数 = A/Au，Au = 每小时呼叫数 × 每次时长（小时）。
  • The AMPS example on notes p.44 is also "56 channels, 2% → 45.9 E", so you can compare.讲义 p.44 的 AMPS 例题正好也是"56 条、2% → 45.9 E"，可以对照。

Step by step(i) N = 9

  1. Channels per cell M = 504/9 = 56
  2. Erlang B table (M = 56, PB = 2%):
    A ≈ 45.9 E
  3. Carried traffic:
    C = 45.9 × (1 − 0.02) = 45.0 E
  4. Trunking efficiency:
    η = 45.9/56 ≈ 0.82 (using carried traffic, 45.0/56 ≈ 0.80)

Step by step(ii) Number of users

Au = 2 × 15/60 = 0.5 E per user
U = 45.9/0.5 = 91.8 → 91 users

Why round down: 92 users would generate 46 E, more than 45.9 E, so blocking would exceed 2%.为什么向下取整：92 个人会产生 46 E，超过 45.9 E，阻塞率就会超过 2%。

Why a larger channel pool is more efficient (needed in the next part): calls arrive randomly, so the traffic fluctuates around its mean. With few channels, a large share of them must sit idle most of the time so that even occasional peaks see only 2% blocking. With many channels, the fluctuations of many users cancel out, the relative swing around the mean is smaller, and each channel can be busier on average. So for the same GoS, A/M grows with M (notes p.122–124: "one group of 10 channels carries 60% more traffic than two groups of 5").为什么信道池越大效率越高（下一问要用）：呼叫是随机到达的，话务量围绕平均值上下波动。信道少时，为了让偶尔的高峰也只有 2% 被阻塞，平时必须空着很大一部分信道；信道多时，大量用户的波动互相抵消，相对平均值的起伏变小，可以让每条信道平均更忙。所以同样的 GoS 下，A/M 随 M 增大而增大（讲义 p.122–124："1 组 10 条比 2 组 5 条多承载 60% 的话务"）。

Step by step(iii) Changing to N = 7

  1. M = 504/7 = 72; the table gives A ≈ 61.0 E
  2. Carried C = 61.0 × 0.98 = 59.8 E; η = 61.0/72 ≈ 0.85 (0.83 using carried traffic)
  3. Users = 61.0/0.5 = 122

Comment: with the smaller cluster, channels per cell rise from 56 to 72 (29% more), while the traffic a cell can offer (table value A) rises from 45.9 to 61.0 E (33% more) and trunking efficiency rises from 0.82 to 0.85 — a bigger channel pool trunks more efficiently. The price is that co-channel cells are closer: with the simplified n = 4 model, SIR falls from 20.85 dB (N = 9) to 18.66 dB (N = 7) (notes p.89), so the margin shrinks.评论：簇变小，每小区信道从 56 增到 72（多 29%），能提供的话务量（表值 A）却从 45.9 增到 61.0 E（多 33%），中继效率从 0.82 升到 0.85——信道池越大，集群效率越高。代价是同频小区离得更近，按 n = 4 的简化模型 SIR 从 20.85 dB（N = 9）降到 18.66 dB（N = 7）（讲义 p.89），余量变小。

PitfallsWatch out

  • Au = 2 calls/hour × 15/60 hour = 0.5 E; convert 15 minutes to hours.Au = 2 次/小时 × 15/60 小时 = 0.5 E，15 分钟要换成小时。
  • Use the 2% column, not 1%.查 2% 那一列，不是 1%。
  • Round the number of users down (91, not 92).用户数向下取整（91，不是 92）。
  • The comment must cover both sides: capacity and efficiency go up, SIR goes down.评论要两面写：容量和效率提高，SIR 下降。

ExamHow to write it in English

(i) Channels per cell = 504/9 = 56. From the Erlang B table with M = 56 and GOS = 2%, the offered traffic is A ≈ 45.9 Erlangs per cell, so the carried load is A(1 − PB) = 45.9 × 0.98 ≈ 45.0 E. Trunking efficiency = 45.9/56 ≈ 0.82 (or 45.0/56 ≈ 0.80 using the carried load).

(ii) Traffic per user Au = 2 × 15/60 = 0.5 E. Number of users = 45.9/0.5 = 91.8, so 91 users can be accommodated per cell (rounded down to keep the blocking at or below 2%).

(iii) For Nc = 7: channels per cell = 504/7 = 72, A ≈ 61.0 E, carried load = 61.0 × 0.98 ≈ 59.8 E, trunking efficiency = 61.0/72 ≈ 0.85 (0.83 using the carried load), and about 122 users per cell. Comment: a smaller cluster gives more channels per cell (+29%) and the traffic capacity increases even more (+33%) because a larger trunk group has a higher trunking efficiency. However, co-channel cells are closer, so the co-channel interference increases (SIR falls from about 20.9 dB to 18.7 dB for n = 4), reducing the margin above the required SIR.

In one line: 56 channels per cell → the table gives 45.9 E, carried 45.0 E, η ≈ 0.82, 91 users; with N = 7: 72 channels, 61.0 E, η ≈ 0.85, 122 users. Capacity and efficiency both go up, but SIR goes down.一句话：56 条/小区查表 45.9 E，承载 45.0 E，η ≈ 0.82，91 人；换 N = 7 后 72 条、61.0 E、η ≈ 0.85、122 人，容量和效率都升，但 SIR 降。

Past final exam
2025-26 S1Q3(b)9 marks
Topics: Erlang C (5% delay probability) · users per km² · mean call holding time考点：Erlang C（5% 延迟概率）· 每 km² 用户数 · 平均通话时长
Original question (verbatim)

(b) A cellular system has a cluster size of 9. In the system, there are 1001 radio channels for traffic. The area of each cell is 4 km2. The entire service area of the system is 3500 km2. Given that the traffic load per user is 0.03 Erlangs and the average number of calls per hour per user is 1.5. For an Erlang C system with a blocking probability of 5%, determine the following:

(i) The traffic load per cell;

(ii) The number of users per km2; and

(iii) The average call duration of a call.

(9 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
(i) Channels per cell: cluster size 9, and the 1001 traffic channels are shared equally:(i) 每小区信道数：簇大小 9，1001 条话务信道均分：
M = 1001 / 9 = 111.2 → 111 channels/cell
Channels come in whole numbers, so round down.信道只能取整数，向下取。
2
(i) Look up the Erlang C table: Erlang C is the queuing (blocked calls wait) model (notes Part A p.125); the 5% in the question is the probability that a call has to wait (probability of non-zero delay). Above 100 channels the appendix table has one row every 5 channels, so there is no row for 111; take the two neighbouring rows in the 0.05 column:(i) 查 Erlang C 表：Erlang C 是排队（呼叫等待）模型（讲义 Part A p.125），题中的 5% 是呼叫需要等待的概率（probability of non-zero delay）。附录表在 100 条以上每 5 条一行，没有 111，取 0.05 列的相邻两行：
M = 110 → A = 92.519 E
M = 115 → A = 97.108 E
3
(i) Linear interpolation (notes p.127; the appendix also gives the formula f(x) = f(xi) + (x − xi)/(xi+1 − xi) · [f(xi+1) − f(xi)]):(i) 线性插值（讲义 p.127，附录也给了公式 f(x) = f(xi) + (x − xi)/(xi+1 − xi) · [f(xi+1) − f(xi)]）：
A = 92.519 + (111 − 110)/(115 − 110) × (97.108 − 92.519)
= 92.519 + 0.2 × 4.589 = 92.519 + 0.918 = 93.44 E
Solving the Erlang C formula exactly also gives 93.44 E, so the interpolation error is negligible ✓. The traffic per cell is therefore ≈ 93.4 Erlang.用 Erlang C 公式精确求解也是 93.44 E，插值误差可忽略 ✓。所以每小区话务量 ≈ 93.4 Erlang。
4
(ii) Users per km²: each user contributes Au = 0.03 E, and the cell area is 4 km²:(ii) 每 km² 用户数：每个用户贡献 Au = 0.03 E，小区面积 4 km²：
Users per cell U = A/Au = 93.44 / 0.03 = 3114.7
Users per km² = 3114.7 / 4 = 778.7 ≈ 779 users/km²每小区用户 U = A/Au = 93.44 / 0.03 = 3114.7
每 km² 用户 = 3114.7 / 4 = 778.7 ≈ 779 用户/km²
5
(iii) Average call holding time: traffic per user = call rate × average holding time, Au = λuH (the λ/μ of notes p.121):(iii) 平均通话时长：每用户话务量 = 呼叫率 × 平均时长，Au = λuH（讲义 p.121 的 λ/μ）：
H = Au/λu = 0.03 E / (1.5 calls/hour) = 0.02 hour
0.02 × 3600 s = 72 s
Check: 1.5 × 72/3600 = 0.03 E ✓.
(i) ≈ 93.4 E (ii) ≈ 779 users/km² (iii) 72 s
Note: the 3500 km² figure is not needed in any of the three parts (you could use it to get the total number of cells, 875).注：3500 km² 这个条件在三小问里都用不到（可以用来算总小区数 875 个）。
◆ Key points
What it tests
Erlang C table lookup (delay probability), user density, mean call holding time (Part A traffic).Erlang C 查表（延迟概率）、用户密度、平均通话时长（Part A 话务）。
Knowledge used
Erlang C is for blocked calls that queue and wait (blocked calls delayed); Au = λH.Erlang C 用于"被阻塞的呼叫排队等待"（blocked calls delayed）；Au = λH。
Method
Channels per cell → Erlang C table (interpolate) → number of users → per km² → H = Au/λ.每小区信道 → 查 Erlang C 表（要插值）→ 用户数 → 每 km² → H = Au/λ。
Common mistakes
Do not mix up Erlang B (blocked calls cleared) and Erlang C (queued): if the question gives a delay probability, use C; λ is per hour, so convert H to seconds at the end.Erlang B（阻塞清除）和 C（排队）别混：题目给延迟概率就用 C；λ 是每小时，H 最后换成秒。
Interpolation formula
A = A₁ + (M − M₁)(A₂ − A₁)/(M₂ − M₁), given in the appendix.
Concept + Step by step: Erlang C table lookup and call duration

ConceptTraffic, Erlang B and Erlang C

Traffic (traffic intensity) A = λH, in Erlang: λ is the number of calls per unit time and H the average call duration (holding time) (Part A p.104, p.115). If a user makes λu calls per hour, each lasting H hours, the user's traffic is Au = λuH. 1 Erlang means one channel fully occupied all the time.话务量（traffic intensity）A = λH，单位 Erlang：λ 是单位时间的呼叫次数，H 是平均通话时长（holding time）（Part A p.104、p.115）。一个用户每小时打 λu 次、每次 H 小时，他的话务量 Au = λuH。1 Erlang 相当于一条信道被一直占满。

What happens to a new call when all channels are busy? There are two models:所有信道都忙时，新呼叫怎么办？两种模型：

Erlang BErlang C
New call finds all channels busy新呼叫遇到全忙Rejected at once (blocked calls cleared)Waits in a queue (blocked calls delayed)
Probability given in the question题目给的概率Blocking probability (GoS)Probability that a call is delayed (has to queue)呼叫被延迟（要排队）的概率
NotesPart A p.118–119Part A p.125–126 (Queued Model)

The exam appendix gives the Erlang B and C tables; the lecturer said that in practice you always use the table, and reminded you to check first that you are using the right table. For channel numbers not in the table, use linear interpolation (p.127): A = A₁ + (M − M₁)(A₂ − A₁)/(M₂ − M₁).考试附录给 Erlang B 表和 C 表，老师说实际都是查表，并提醒先确认用对表。表里没有的信道数用线性插值（p.127）：A = A₁ + (M − M₁)(A₂ − A₁)/(M₂ − M₁)。

Step by step(i) Traffic per cell

  1. Channels per cell = 1001/9 = 111.2 → 111 (round down; half a channel cannot be used).每小区信道数 = 1001/9 = 111.2 → 111 条（向下取整，半条信道不能用）。
  2. The question says "Erlang C system" with probability 5%, so use the 5% column of the Erlang C table.题目说"Erlang C system"、概率 5%，所以查 Erlang C 表的 5% 列。
  3. Above 100 channels the table goes in steps of 5, so interpolate between 110 and 115. Table values computed from the formula are about A(110) ≈ 92.5 and A(115) ≈ 97.1 (use the exam appendix as the reference):表在 100 条以上每 5 条一档，在 110 和 115 之间插值。按公式算出的表值约为 A(110) ≈ 92.5、A(115) ≈ 97.1（以考场附录为准）：
    A(111) ≈ 92.5 + (111 − 110)/(115 − 110) × (97.1 − 92.5) = 92.5 + 0.92 ≈ 93.4 Erlang/cell

Step by step(ii) Users per km²

Users per cell = A / Au = 93.44 / 0.03 ≈ 3114 users
Per km² = 3114 / 4 ≈ 779 users/km²每小区用户数 = A / Au = 93.44 / 0.03 ≈ 3114 用户
每 km² = 3114 / 4 ≈ 779 用户/km²

Step by step(iii) Average call duration

Au = λu × H → H = 0.03 / 1.5 = 0.02 hour = 0.02 × 3600 = 72 seconds

Sanity check: 72-second calls at 1.5 calls per hour give 108 seconds of calling per hour, i.e. 3%, which is exactly 0.03 Erlang. The 3500 km² in the question is not needed in any of the three parts; it could be used to find the total number of cells, 3500/4 = 875, and about 3114 × 875 ≈ 2.72 million users in the whole system.合理性检查：72 秒一次通话、每小时 1.5 次，每小时打电话 108 秒，占 3%，正好是 0.03 Erlang。题目给的 3500 km² 三问都用不到，它可以用来算总小区数 3500/4 = 875 个，全系统约 3114 × 875 ≈ 272 万用户。

PitfallsCommon ways to lose marks

  • Using the Erlang B table: the question clearly says Erlang C (queueing).用了 Erlang B 表：题目明确是 Erlang C（排队）。
  • Looking up the table with 111.2 channels without rounding, or not interpolating and just taking the 110 or 115 row.信道数 111.2 不取整就去查表，或者不会插值直接取 110 或 115 那一行。
  • λ is "per hour", so H comes out in hours and must be converted to seconds; give units in the answer.λ 是"每小时"，H 算出来是小时，要换成秒；答案要写单位。
  • Users = traffic ÷ traffic per user; do not invert it.用户数 = 话务量 ÷ 每用户话务量，别乘反了。

ExamHow to write it in English

(i) Channels per cell = 1001/9 = 111.2, i.e. 111 channels. From the Erlang C table with a delay probability of 5%, interpolating between M = 110 (A ≈ 92.5 E) and M = 115 (A ≈ 97.1 E): A ≈ 92.5 + (1/5)(97.1 − 92.5) ≈ 93.4 Erlangs per cell.

(ii) Users per cell = 93.4/0.03 ≈ 3114 users. Cell area = 4 km², so the user density ≈ 3114/4 ≈ 779 users/km².

(iii) Au = λH, so H = Au/λ = 0.03/1.5 = 0.02 h = 72 s.

In one line: 111 channels, Erlang C table at 5% with interpolation gives about 93.4 E per cell; ÷0.03 ÷4 gives about 779 users/km²; H = 0.03/1.5 hour = 72 seconds.一句话：111 条信道查 Erlang C 表 5% 并插值得约 93.4 E/小区，÷0.03 ÷4 得约 779 用户/km²，H = 0.03/1.5 小时 = 72 秒。
