Topics: Erlang C (5% delay) · users per km² · mean call holding time · M/M/m state transition diagram and Pk考点：Erlang C（5% 延迟）· 每 km² 用户 · 平均通话时长 · M/M/m 状态转移图与 Pk
Original question (verbatim)

(b) For the cluster size of 7 in the cellular network in Part 3(a), the operator obtained the survey results that it has traffic load per user of 0.03 Erlangs and an average number of 1.2 calls per hour per user for an Erlang C system, with a probability of delaying a call being 5%. Determine the following results.

(i) Traffic load per cell.

(ii) The number of users per km2 that can be supported by the cellular system.

(iii) The mean duration of a call in seconds.

(8 Marks)

(c) The traffic performance of cellular network can be modeled using a simple Markovian queueing model such as M/M/m with m servers representing each channel in the cell.

(i) Draw the state transition diagram for the M/M/m model with the various arrival rates λk and service rates μk given by the following recursive equations, λk = λ for k = 0, 1, 2, …; μk = kμ for k = 1, 2, … m−1; μk = mμ for k = m, m+1, m+2, … k μ Pk = λ Pk−1 for k ≤ m; m μ Pk = λ Pk for k ≥ m where Pk represents the state probability of the system state being at k and system utilization ρ = λ/μ.

(ii) Derive the probability Pk in terms of m, ρ, and the probability of state zero P0 for the two cases where k ≤ m and k ≥ m, respectively.

(11 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
(b)(i) Look up the Erlang C table: from 3(a), each cell has m = 153 channels; delay probability PD = 5% → the 0.05 column of the table. There is no row for 153, so take the two neighbouring rows:(b)(i) 查 Erlang C 表：由 3(a)，每小区 m = 153 条信道；延迟概率 PD = 5% → 表的 0.05 列。表里没有 153，取相邻两行：
150 channels → 129.490 E
155 channels → 134.137 E
2
(b)(i) Linear interpolation: use the formula from Appendix A, f(x) = f(xi) + (x − xi)/(xi+1 − xi) × [f(xi+1) − f(xi)]:(b)(i) 线性插值：用附录 A 的公式 f(x) = f(xi) + (x − xi)/(xi+1 − xi) × [f(xi+1) − f(xi)]：
A = 129.490 + (153 − 150)/(155 − 150) × (134.137 − 129.490)
= 129.490 + 0.6 × 4.647
= 129.490 + 2.788 = 132.28 ≈ 132.3 E/cell

(Solving the Erlang C formula numerically gives 132.24 E, so the interpolation error is small.) Check: load per channel A/m = 132.28/153 = 0.865 < 1, so the queue is stable ✓
（用 Erlang C 公式直接数值求解得 132.24 E，插值误差很小。）检查：每信道负载 A/m = 132.28/153 = 0.865 < 1，排队系统稳定 ✓
3
(b)(ii) Users per km²: the traffic per user is Au = 0.03 E, so the number of users each cell can support and the user density are:(b)(ii) 每 km² 用户数：每用户话务量 Au = 0.03 E，所以每小区能支持的用户数和用户密度：
U = A/Au = 132.28/0.03 = 4409 users/cell
Density = 4409 / 6 km² = 734.8 ≈ 735 users/km²U = A/Au = 132.28/0.03 = 4409 用户/小区
密度 = 4409 / 6 km² = 734.8 ≈ 735 用户/km²
4
(b)(iii) Average call holding time: traffic per user Au = λuH (notes Part A p.121), with λu = 1.2 calls/hour:(b)(iii) 平均通话时长：每用户话务量 Au = λuH（讲义 Part A p.121），λu = 1.2 次/小时：
H = Au/λu = 0.03/1.2 = 0.025 h
= 0.025 × 3600 s = 90 s

Self-check: 1.2 calls/h × 90 s ÷ 3600 s/h = 0.03 E ✓
5
(c)(i) State transition diagram: state k = the number of calls in the system (in progress + queued).
• Rightwards k → k+1: a new call arrives; Poisson arrivals at rate λk = λ, independent of k.
• Leftwards k → k−1: a call ends. For k ≤ m all k calls occupy channels and each ends at rate μ, giving kμ in total; for k ≥ m only m channels are serving and the rest are queued, so the rate is capped at mμ.(c)(i) 状态转移图：状态 k = 系统里的呼叫数（正在通话 + 排队）。
• 向右 k → k+1：来一个新呼叫，Poisson 到达，速率 λk = λ，与 k 无关。
• 向左 k → k−1：结束一个呼叫。k ≤ m 时 k 个呼叫都在占用信道，各以速率 μ 结束，合起来 kμ；k ≥ m 时只有 m 条信道在服务，其余在排队，速率封顶 mμ。
Birth–death process of M/M/m. State k = number of calls in the system (including those in the queue).M/M/m 的生灭过程。状态 k = 系统里的呼叫数（含排队）。
6
(c)(ii) Balance equations: in steady state the flow between two neighbouring states balances: flow rightwards out of k−1 = flow leftwards out of k (notes Part A p.106):(c)(ii) 平衡方程：稳态时相邻两个状态之间的流量平衡：从 k−1 往右流的 = 从 k 往左流的（讲义 Part A p.106）：
λPk−1 = μkPk

The k ≥ m equation in the question, written as mμPk = λPk, is a typo (it would give λ = mμ); notes p.106 has λPk−1. ρ = λ/μ.
题中 k ≥ m 那一式写成 mμPk = λPk 是笔误（那样会得出 λ = mμ），讲义 p.106 是 λPk−1。ρ = λ/μ。
7
(c)(ii) k ≤ m: μk = kμ, so Pk = (λ/kμ)Pk−1 = (ρ/k)Pk−1; recurse all the way from P₀:(c)(ii) k ≤ m：μk = kμ，所以 Pk = (λ/kμ)Pk−1 = (ρ/k)Pk−1，从 P₀ 一路递推：
P₁ = ρP₀
P₂ = (ρ/2)P₁ = (ρ²/2!)P₀
P₃ = (ρ/3)P₂ = (ρ³/3!)P₀
⋯
Pk = P₀ · ρk/k!, k ≤ m
8
(c)(ii) k ≥ m: μk = mμ, so Pk = (ρ/m)Pk−1. Start from Pm = P₀ρm/m! and multiply by ρ/m another (k − m) times:(c)(ii) k ≥ m：μk = mμ，所以 Pk = (ρ/m)Pk−1。从 Pm = P₀ρm/m! 出发，再乘 (k − m) 次 ρ/m：
Pk = Pm(ρ/m)k−m
= P₀ · (ρm/m!) · ρk−m/mk−m
= P₀ · ρk/(m! · mk−m), k ≥ m

Self-check: at k = m both expressions equal P₀ρm/m! ✓. P₀ follows from ΣPk = 1: P₀ = [Σk=0m−1 ρk/k! + ρm/(m!(1 − ρ/m))]−1, where the geometric series converges only if ρ/m < 1. Computing P(k ≥ m) from this gives the Erlang C formula in the appendix (the appendix's A is ρ here, and the appendix's ρ is ρ/m here).
自检：k = m 时两式都等于 P₀ρm/m! ✓。P₀ 由 ΣPk = 1 求出：P₀ = [Σk=0m−1 ρk/k! + ρm/(m!(1 − ρ/m))]−1，其中几何级数收敛要求 ρ/m < 1。再求 P(k ≥ m) 就得到附录里的 Erlang C 公式（附录的 A 就是这里的 ρ，附录的 ρ 是这里的 ρ/m）。
(b) ≈ 132.3 E/cell (table interpolation 132.28); ≈ 735 users/km²; 90 s (c) Pk = P₀ρk/k! (k ≤ m), P₀ρk/(m!mk−m) (k ≥ m)(b) ≈ 132.3 E/小区（查表插值 132.28）；≈ 735 用户/km²；90 s (c) Pk = P₀ρk/k!（k ≤ m），P₀ρk/(m!mk−m)（k ≥ m）
◆ Key points
What it tests
Erlang C table lookup, user density, mean call holding time; M/M/m state transition diagram and derivation of Pk (Part A queueing theory, p.106).Erlang C 查表、用户密度、平均通话时长；M/M/m 状态转移图和 Pk 的推导（Part A 排队论，p.106）。
Knowledge used
Birth–death balance: between two adjacent states, flow in = flow out, λPk−1 = μkPk; service rate μk = kμ (k ≤ m), mμ (k ≥ m).生灭过程平衡：相邻两状态之间流入 = 流出，λPk−1 = μkPk；服务速率 μk = kμ（k ≤ m），mμ（k ≥ m）。
Method
(b) Same as 2025-26 S1 Q3(b): table lookup with interpolation → users → per km² → H; (c) draw the state diagram → write the balance equations → recurse over the two ranges → fix P₀ with ΣPk = 1.(b) 同 2025-26 S1 Q3(b)：查表插值 → 用户 → 每 km² → H；(c) 画状态图 → 列平衡式 → 分两段递推 → 用 ΣPk = 1 定 P₀。
Common mistakes
The question's λPk is a typo and should be λPk−1; for k ≥ m the service rate is capped at mμ; stability condition ρ/m < 1.题目中 λPk 是笔误，应为 λPk−1；k ≥ m 后服务速率封顶 mμ；稳定条件 ρ/m < 1。
Links
From Pk, the probability that "all channels are busy", ΣPk (k ≥ m), is the Erlang C formula.由 Pk 求出"所有信道都忙"的概率 ΣPk（k ≥ m），就是 Erlang C 公式。
Concept + Step by step: Erlang C and M/M/m

Concept(b) Traffic and Erlang C

Traffic A = λH (Erlang); traffic per user Au = λuH (Part A p.104, p.115). The question describes an Erlang C system: when all channels are busy, new calls wait in a queue (blocked calls delayed, p.125), and the given 5% is "the probability that a call has to wait". Look up the 5% column of the Erlang C table in the appendix, and use linear interpolation for channel counts not in the table (p.127). The lecturer's reminder: first make sure you are using the right table (B or C).话务量 A = λH（Erlang），每用户话务量 Au = λuH（Part A p.104、p.115）。题目说的是 Erlang C 系统：所有信道都忙时，新呼叫排队等待（blocked calls delayed，p.125），给的 5% 是"呼叫需要等待的概率"。查附录 Erlang C 表的 5% 列，表里没有的信道数用线性插值（p.127）。老师提醒先确认用对表（B 还是 C）。

Concept(c) M/M/m queueing model and birth–death process

M/M/m: Poisson arrivals (M), exponentially distributed service times (M), m servers (m channels) (Kendall notation, p.102). State k = total number of calls in the system, both in service and waiting.M/M/m：到达是泊松过程（M）、服务时间是指数分布（M）、有 m 个服务台（m 条信道）（Kendall 记号，p.102）。状态 k = 系统里正在通话和排队的呼叫总数。

  • Arrival rate λk = λ: new calls arrive at rate λ no matter how many are in the system (k → k+1).到达率 λk = λ：不管系统里有多少人，新呼叫都以速率 λ 到来（k → k+1）。
  • Service rate μk: each busy channel ends its call at rate μ. For k ≤ m all k calls are being served, so μk = kμ; for k ≥ m there are only m channels and the rest wait, so μk is capped at mμ (p.106).服务率 μk：每条忙的信道以速率 μ 结束通话。k ≤ m 时 k 条信道都在服务，μk = kμ；k ≥ m 时只有 m 条信道，其余在排队，μk = mμ 封顶（p.106）。
  • Balance equation: in steady state, between two neighbouring states "probability flow to the right = probability flow to the left": λPk−1 = μkPk.平衡方程：稳态时，相邻两个状态之间"向右流的概率流 = 向左流的概率流"：λPk−1 = μkPk。

The lecturer said you must be able to draw the M/M/m state-transition diagram, write the balance equations and solve recursively for Pk and P₀; part (c) of this question tests exactly that.老师说 M/M/m 的状态转移图要会画，会列平衡方程、递推求 Pk 和 P₀，本题 (c) 就考了。

Step by step(b) The three sub-parts

  1. (i) 1071/7 = 153 channels per cell; look up the 5% column of the Erlang C table and interpolate between 150 and 155. Table values computed from the formula are about A(150) ≈ 129.5 and A(155) ≈ 134.1 (use the appendix given in the exam):(i) 每小区 1071/7 = 153 条信道，查 Erlang C 表 5% 列，在 150 和 155 之间插值。按公式算出的表值约为 A(150) ≈ 129.5、A(155) ≈ 134.1（以考场附录为准）：
    A(153) ≈ 129.5 + (153 − 150)/(155 − 150) × (134.1 − 129.5) = 129.5 + 2.76 = 132.26 ≈ 132.3 Erlang/cell (interpolating with the appendix table values 129.490, 134.137 gives 132.28)A(153) ≈ 129.5 + (153 − 150)/(155 − 150) × (134.1 − 129.5) = 129.5 + 2.76 = 132.26 ≈ 132.3 Erlang/小区（用附录表值 129.490、134.137 插值是 132.28）
  2. (ii)
    Users per cell = 132.28 / 0.03 ≈ 4409; per km² = 4409 / 6 ≈ 735 users/km²每小区用户 = 132.28 / 0.03 ≈ 4409；每 km² = 4409 / 6 ≈ 735 用户/km²
  3. (iii)
    H = Au/λu = 0.03/1.2 hour = 0.025 h = 0.025 × 3600 = 90 s

Step by step(c)(i) Drawing the state-transition diagram

How to draw it: a row of circles labelled 0, 1, 2, …, m−1, m, m+1, …; between each pair of neighbouring circles, draw a pair of arrows. The upper, rightward arrows are all labelled λ; the lower, leftward arrows are labelled μ, 2μ, 3μ, …, mμ in turn (the rate from state k back to k−1 is μk), and from m → m−1 onwards they are all mμ. Finally draw an ellipsis on the right to show infinitely many states (an infinite queue).画法：一排圆圈标 0, 1, 2, …, m−1, m, m+1, …；每两个相邻圆圈之间画一对箭头。上面向右的箭头全标 λ；下面向左的箭头依次标 μ, 2μ, 3μ, …, mμ（从状态 k 回到 k−1 的速率是 μk），从 m → m−1 起一直都是 mμ。最后在右边画省略号表示状态无限多（队列无限长）。

Step by step(c)(ii) Deriving Pk

  1. k ≤ m: kμPk = λPk−1 → Pk = (ρ/k)Pk−1, ρ = λ/μ. Recurse all the way down:k ≤ m：kμPk = λPk−1 → Pk = (ρ/k)Pk−1，ρ = λ/μ。一路往下递推：
    P₁ = ρP₀, P₂ = (ρ/2)P₁ = (ρ²/2!)P₀, …, Pk = P₀ρk/k!, k ≤ m
  2. k ≥ m: mμPk = λPk−1 → Pk = (ρ/m)Pk−1. Start from Pm = P₀ρm/m! and multiply by ρ/m another (k − m) times:k ≥ m：mμPk = λPk−1 → Pk = (ρ/m)Pk−1。从 Pm = P₀ρm/m! 出发，再乘 (k − m) 次 ρ/m：
    Pk = P₀(ρm/m!)(ρ/m)k−m = P₀ρk/(m!·mk−m), k ≥ m
  3. Check: at k = m both expressions equal P₀ρm/m!, so they agree.检查：k = m 时两式都等于 P₀ρm/m!，一致。
  4. P₀ (not asked, but the lecturer said you should know it): from ΣPk = 1; the k ≥ m part is a geometric series with ratio ρ/m, which requires ρ/m < 1 (otherwise the queue grows without bound):P₀（题目没要求，但老师说要会）：由 ΣPk = 1，k ≥ m 的部分是公比 ρ/m 的等比数列，要求 ρ/m < 1（否则队列无限增长）：
    P₀ = [Σk=0m−1 ρk/k! + (ρm/m!)·1/(1 − ρ/m)]⁻¹
    The probability that "all channels are busy and the call must wait", ΣPk (k ≥ m), is the Erlang C formula (p.110)."所有信道都忙、必须排队"的概率 ΣPk（k ≥ m）就是 Erlang C 公式（p.110）。

Small numerical example (to check your own work): m = 3, ρ = 2. P₀ = 1/[1 + 2 + 2 + (8/6) × 3] = 1/9; probability of waiting = (8/6)(1/9) × 3 = 4/9 ≈ 0.444, the same as E2,3(2) from the Erlang C formula.数字小例子（自己验算用）：m = 3、ρ = 2。P₀ = 1/[1 + 2 + 2 + (8/6) × 3] = 1/9；排队概率 = (8/6)(1/9) × 3 = 4/9 ≈ 0.444，和 Erlang C 公式算出的 E2,3(2) 相同。

PitfallsCommon ways to lose marks

  • (b) Using the Erlang B table; not interpolating for 153 channels.(b) 用了 Erlang B 表；153 条不插值。
  • (b)(iii) Getting H = 0.025 and not converting it to seconds (the question asks for seconds).(b)(iii) H 算出 0.025 后不换成秒（题目要秒）。
  • (c) Labelling all leftward arrows μ, or still writing kμ for k ≥ m: the service rate is at most mμ.(c) 向左箭头全写 μ，或 k ≥ m 后还写 kμ：服务率最多 mμ。
  • The question writes the balance equation as "mμPk = λPk"; it should be λPk−1 (notes p.106). Derive with Pk−1; you may point this out on your answer script.题目平衡式写成"mμPk = λPk"，应是 λPk−1（讲义 p.106），按 Pk−1 推导，可在答卷上注明。
  • Notation: the question's ρ = λ/μ (which is the traffic A); notes p.105 call ρ = λ/(mμ) the utilisation. Follow the question's definition; the stability condition is then ρ/m < 1.记号：题目的 ρ = λ/μ（就是话务量 A）；讲义 p.105 把 ρ = λ/(mμ) 叫利用率。按题目的定义写，稳定条件就是 ρ/m < 1。

ExamHow to write it in English

(b)(i) Channels per cell = 1071/7 = 153. From the Erlang C table with a delay probability of 5%, interpolating between M = 150 (A ≈ 129.5 E) and M = 155 (A ≈ 134.1 E): A ≈ 129.5 + (3/5)(4.6) ≈ 132.3 Erlangs per cell.

(ii) Users per cell = 132.28/0.03 ≈ 4409. Users per km² = 4409/6 ≈ 735 users/km².

(iii) H = Au/λ = 0.03/1.2 h = 0.025 h = 90 s.

(c)(i) [Sketch: states 0, 1, 2, …, m − 1, m, m + 1, … in a row. Each forward transition k → k + 1 has rate λ. Each backward transition k → k − 1 has rate kμ for k ≤ m (μ, 2μ, …, mμ) and mμ for k > m.]

(ii) For k ≤ m: kμPk = λPk−1, so Pk = (ρ/k)Pk−1. Applying this recursively, Pk = P₀ρk/k!.

For k ≥ m: mμPk = λPk−1, so Pk = (ρ/m)Pk−1. Starting from Pm = P₀ρm/m!, Pk = P₀(ρm/m!)(ρ/m)k−m = P₀ρk/(m!·mk−m).

Both expressions agree at k = m. P₀ is obtained from ΣPk = 1, which requires ρ/m < 1.

In one line: for 153 channels, interpolating the Erlang C table at 5% gives about 132.3 E; ÷0.03 ÷6 ≈ 735 users/km²; H = 0.025 h = 90 s. For M/M/m, use the recursion λPk−1 = μkPk: P₀ρk/k! for k ≤ m, and P₀ρk/(m!mk−m) for k ≥ m.一句话：153 条查 Erlang C 表 5% 插值约 132.3 E，÷0.03 ÷6 ≈ 735 用户/km²，H = 0.025 h = 90 s；M/M/m 由 λPk−1 = μkPk 递推，k ≤ m 时 P₀ρk/k!，k ≥ m 时 P₀ρk/(m!mk−m)。

Ch. 9 · When channels run out: cell splitting and sectoring

4 practice · 1 past-examNotes →
Lecture example
p.136

Power reduction in cell splitting

Original questionSlide 136 · “Cell Splitting”

Subdivide congested cell into smaller cells (microcells), each with its own base station. These smaller cells have lower antenna height and smaller transmit power. Capacity is increased due to additional channels per unit area.

If microcells have half of the radius of original cell,

Pr[original cell] ∝ Pt1R−n
Pr[microcell] ∝ Pt2(R/2)−n

If path loss exponent n = 4, Pt2 = ?. Transmitted power for microcell has to be reduced by ? dB in order to maintain the same SIR.

An explanatory example whose original text includes the results. The original is reproduced below, with the results replaced by ?.讲解型例题，原文自带结果。下面照录原文，结果用 ? 代替。
The microcell radius is half the original cell radius, and the path loss exponent is n = 4. To keep the same SIR, by how much must the microcell transmit power be reduced?微小区半径是原小区的一半，路径损耗指数 n = 4。为保持相同的 SIR，微小区的发射功率要降低多少？
  1. Set up the equation: to keep the same SIR, the power received at the microcell edge (distance R/2) must equal that at the original cell edge (distance R). Received power ∝ Pt × distance−n (p.136), n = 4:列等式：要保持相同的 SIR，微小区边缘（距离 R/2）收到的功率要和原小区边缘（距离 R）一样。接收功率 ∝ Pt × 距离−n（p.136），n = 4：
    Pt1 R⁻⁴ = Pt2 (R/2)⁻⁴
    Why this keeps the SIR unchanged: all cells shrink by half together, so D and R are both halved and Q = D/R stays the same; the power is then lowered by the same factor everywhere, so signal and interference shrink in proportion.为什么这样 SIR 就不变：所有小区一起缩小一半，D 和 R 同时减半，Q = D/R 不变；功率再按同一比例降低，信号和干扰同比例变小。
  2. Simplify: (R/2)⁻⁴ = 2⁴R⁻⁴ = 16R⁻⁴; cancel R⁻⁴ on both sides:化简：(R/2)⁻⁴ = 2⁴R⁻⁴ = 16R⁻⁴，两边约掉 R⁻⁴：
    Pt1 = 16 Pt2 → Pt2 = Pt1/16
  3. Convert to dB:
    10 log 16 = 4 × 10 log 2 = 4 × 3.01 = 12.04 dB ≈ 12 dB
    So the microcell transmit power must be reduced by 12 dB. General rule: if the radius becomes R/k, reduce the power by 10n log k dB.即微小区发射功率要降低 12 dB。通式：半径变为 R/k，功率降低 10n log k dB。
  4. Substitute back to check: the microcell edge receives (Pt1/16) × (R/2)⁻⁴ = (Pt1/16) × 16R⁻⁴ = Pt1R⁻⁴, the same as the original cell edge ✓.代回检查：微小区边缘收到 (Pt1/16) × (R/2)⁻⁴ = (Pt1/16) × 16R⁻⁴ = Pt1R⁻⁴，和原小区边缘一样 ✓。
Transmit power drops to 1/16, i.e. a reduction of 12dB发射功率降为 1/16，即降低 12dB
Radius ÷ k, power ÷ kⁿ. 2⁴ = 16; each factor of 2 is 3dB, so four of them give 12dB.半径除以 k，功率除以 kⁿ。2⁴ = 16，每个 2 倍是 3dB，4 个就是 12dB。
For a 3:1 split the radius becomes 1/√3, so power is divided by (√3)⁴ = 9, a reduction of 9.54dB, not 12dB.3:1 分裂时半径是 1/√3，功率除以 (√3)⁴ = 9，降低 9.54dB，不是 12dB。
Concept + Step by step: how much to reduce power in cell splitting

ConceptCell splitting

When traffic grows until channels run short, notes Part A p.135–139 give two ways to add capacity: cell splitting and sectoring. Cell splitting: split a congested large cell into several microcells, each with its own base station, lower antennas and lower power. More base stations per unit area means more channels, so capacity rises.话务增长到信道不够时，讲义 Part A p.135–139 给出两种扩容方法：小区分裂和扇区化。小区分裂：把一个拥挤的大小区拆成若干微小区（microcell），每个都有自己的基站，天线更低、功率更小。单位面积里的基站多了，信道就多了，容量上升。

Why reduce power: after splitting, all cells shrink in proportion and D/R stays the same, so as long as each base station produces the same received power at its own cell edge as before, SIR is unchanged. If a microcell kept the original high power, it would reach much farther and interfere with distant co-channel cells.为什么要降功率：分裂后所有小区按比例缩小，D/R 不变，所以只要每个基站在自己小区边缘产生的接收功率和原来一样，SIR 就保持不变。如果微小区仍用原来的大功率，它会覆盖到更远处，干扰远处的同频小区。

Received power Pr ∝ Pt × distance−n (n is the path loss exponent). At the cell edge, the distance is R for the original cell and R/2 for the microcell.接收功率 Pr ∝ Pt × 距离−n（n 是路径损耗指数）。在小区边缘，原小区距离 R，微小区距离 R/2。

p.138–139: a 4:1 split gives a new radius of R/2, and a 3:1 split gives R/√3; smaller cells mean more frequent handoffs (a 4-times smaller radius increases the handoff rate per user by about 10 times).p.138–139：4:1 分裂新半径是 R/2，3:1 分裂新半径是 R/√3；小区越小，切换越频繁（半径缩小 4 倍，每用户切换率约增加 10 倍）。

Step by stepSet the received power at the two cell edges equal

  1. Write the equation: Pt1 R−n = Pt2 (R/2)−n.
  2. Simplify: (R/2)−n = 2n R−n; cancel R−n on both sides, Pt1 = Pt2 × 2n, so Pt2 = Pt1/2n.化简：(R/2)−n = 2n R−n，两边约掉 R−n，Pt1 = Pt2 × 2n，所以 Pt2 = Pt1/2n。
  3. Substitute n = 4: 2⁴ = 16.
  4. Convert to dB: a reduction of 10 log1016 dB.
Pt2 = Pt1 / 2⁴ = Pt1 / 16
10 log1016 = 4 × 10 log102 = 4 × 3.01 = 12.04 dB ≈ 12 dB

General formula: if the radius shrinks to R/k, power drops by 10n log10k dB.通用公式：半径缩小为 R/k，功率降低 10n log10k dB。

Split typen = 2n = 3n = 4
4:1 (R/2)6.02 dB9.03 dB12.04 dB
3:1 (R/√3)4.77 dB7.16 dB9.54 dB

Why SIR then stays the same: the simplified formula is S/I = Qn/6 with Q = D/R (p.88). When all cells shrink by half together, D and R are both halved and Q is unchanged; with power reduced by 2n, the wanted signal and the interference shrink in the same proportion, so the ratio is unchanged.为什么这样 SIR 就不变：简化公式 S/I = Qn/6，Q = D/R（p.88）。所有小区一起缩小一半，D 和 R 同时减半，Q 不变；功率按 2n 降低后，有用信号和干扰按同样比例变小，比值不变。

Substitute back to check: at the microcell edge R/2 the received power is (Pt1/16) × (R/2)−4 = (Pt1/16) × 16R−4 = Pt1R−4, exactly the same as at the original cell edge.代回检查：微小区边缘 R/2 处收到 (Pt1/16) × (R/2)−4 = (Pt1/16) × 16R−4 = Pt1R−4，和原小区边缘完全一样。

Capacity change: radius halved → each cell's area becomes 1/4 → base stations in the same area × 4 → channels × 4 (this is the conclusion of the example on p.140–142).容量变化：半径减半 → 每个小区面积变 1/4 → 同样面积里基站数 × 4 → 信道数 × 4（p.140–142 的例题就是这个结论）。

Pitfalls

  • Power drops to 1/16, i.e. a reduction of 12 dB; not a reduction of 1/16 dB or 16 dB.是功率降为 1/16，即降低 12 dB，不是降低 1/16 dB 或 16 dB。
  • For a 3:1 split the radius is R/√3 and the result is 9.54 dB; do not copy 12 dB.3:1 分裂的半径是 R/√3，结果是 9.54 dB，不能照搬 12 dB。
  • The exponent is n, not 2: for n = 4, 2⁴ = 16.指数是 n，不是 2：n = 4 时 2⁴ = 16。

ExamHow to write it in English

To keep the same SIR, the received power at the boundary of the microcell must equal that at the boundary of the original cell: Pt1·R−n = Pt2·(R/2)−n. Hence Pt2 = Pt1/2n. For n = 4, Pt2 = Pt1/16, i.e. the transmit power of the microcell must be reduced by 10 log 16 = 12 dB. Since the cell area is reduced to 1/4, the number of channels per unit area (and hence capacity) increases about four times.

In one line: equal received power at the cell edge → Pt2 = Pt1/2ⁿ; for n = 4 power drops to 1/16, a reduction of 12 dB.一句话：边缘接收功率相等 → Pt2 = Pt1/2ⁿ，n = 4 时降为 1/16，即降低 12 dB。

p.140–142

Number of channels after cell splitting

Original questionSlide 140

For the above figure, each base station uses 60 channels regardless of cell size. If original cell radius is 1km and microcell has 0.5km radius, find the number of channels contained in a 3km by 3km square centered around A, under following conditions:

  • Without microcells
  • With the microcells used
Each base station has a fixed 60 channels. The original cell radius is 1km and the microcell radius is 0.5km. Find the number of channels in a 3km × 3km square centred on base station A: (a) without microcells; (b) with microcells.每个基站固定 60 条信道。原小区半径 1km，微小区半径 0.5km。求以基站 A 为中心、3km × 3km 正方形区域内的信道数：(a) 不用微小区；(b) 使用微小区。
  1. Define the area: the 3 km × 3 km square is centred on A, so it extends 1.5 km up, down, left and right of A (p.141); its area is 9 km².定范围：3 km × 3 km 正方形以 A 为中心，所以从 A 向上下左右各延伸 1.5 km（p.141），面积 9 km²。
  2. (a) Count the large cells: the large cells have radius R = 1 km; counting on the figure, the square contains about 4 large cells (4 base stations). The notes say this can only be an estimate, because the cells at the edges lie only partly inside the square.(a) 数大小区：大小区半径 R = 1 km，从图上数，正方形里约有 4 个大小区（4 个基站）。讲义说这只能估计，因为边上的小区只有一部分在正方形里。
  3. (a) Number of channels: each base station has 60 channels, regardless of cell size:(a) 信道数：每个基站 60 条信道，与小区大小无关（regardless of cell size）：
    4 × 60 = 240 channels
  4. (b) Count the microcells: radius halved → area becomes (1/2)² = 1/4 → the same area holds 4 times as many cells:(b) 数微小区：半径减半 → 面积变为 (1/2)² = 1/4 → 同样面积能放 4 倍的小区：
    At most (R ÷ R/2)² × 4 = 2² × 4 = 16; about 15 estimated from the figure最多 (R ÷ R/2)² × 4 = 2² × 4 = 16 个；从图上估计约 15 个
  5. (b) Number of channels: microcells also have 60 channels per base station:(b) 信道数：微小区也是每站 60 条：
    15 × 60 = 900 channels (with 16 cells: 16 × 60 = 960 channels)
  6. Compare and self-check: 900 ÷ 240 = 3.75 ≈ 4 times, consistent with the area ratio (R ÷ R/2)² = 4 ✓. The capacity gain comes from having more base stations (channels) per unit area (p.136).比较自检：900 ÷ 240 = 3.75 ≈ 4 倍，和面积比 (R ÷ R/2)² = 4 一致 ✓。容量提升的来源是单位面积里的基站（信道）变多（p.136）。
(a) 240 channels · (b) 900 channels, about 4 times
Radius ÷ 2 → area ÷ 4 → base stations × 4 → channels × 4.半径 ÷ 2 → 面积 ÷ 4 → 基站 × 4 → 信道 × 4。
The notes use 15 rather than 16 because it is an estimate counted from the figure. Writing 16 × 60 = 960 is also fine, but state that it is an estimate.讲义取 15 而不是 16，因为这是从图上数出来的估计值。写 16 × 60 = 960 也可以，但要注明是估计。
Concept + Step by step: channels in a 3km×3km area before and after splitting

ConceptChannels in an area = number of base stations × channels per station

The example in notes Part A p.140–142: every base station has a fixed 60 channels regardless of size. So the number of channels in an area depends only on how many base stations it contains. Cell splitting (p.136) shrinks the radius, raises the base station density, and so raises the channel density.讲义 Part A p.140–142 的例题：每个基站不管大小都固定 60 条信道。所以一块区域里有多少信道，只取决于这块区域里有几个基站。小区分裂（p.136）把半径缩小，基站密度增大，信道密度就增大。

Area and radius: cell area ∝ R². Halving the radius makes the area 1/4, so the same piece of land needs 4 times as many cells. This is where "radius ÷ 2 → capacity × 4" comes from.面积与半径的关系：小区面积 ∝ R²。半径变成 1/2，面积变成 1/4，同一块地要的小区数变成 4 倍。这就是"半径 ÷ 2 → 容量 × 4"的来源。

The question requires counting cells on the figure (the figure is on notes p.140), so the notes say the count "can only be an estimate", because cells on the edge of the square are only partly inside it.题目要在图上数小区（图在讲义 p.140），所以讲义说个数"只能估计"（can only be an estimate），因为正方形边上的小区只被切进去一部分。

Step by stepFix the area, count the cells, then multiply by 60

  1. Fix the area: the 3 km × 3 km square is centred on A, so it extends 1.5 km up, down, left and right of A.定范围：3 km × 3 km 正方形以 A 为中心，所以从 A 向上下左右各延伸 1.5 km。
  2. (a) Without microcells: large-cell radius 1 km; counting on the figure, the square contains about 4 large cells (base stations).(a) 不用微小区：大小区半径 1 km，从图上数，正方形里大约有 4 个大小区（基站）。
  3. (b) With microcells: microcell radius 0.5 km, area 1/4 of a large cell, so at most (R ÷ R/2)² × 4 = 4 × 4 = 16; counting on the figure gives about 15 (some at the edge are incomplete).(b) 用微小区：微小区半径 0.5 km，面积是大小区的 1/4，所以最多 (R ÷ R/2)² × 4 = 4 × 4 = 16 个；从图上数约 15 个（边缘有些不完整）。
  4. Multiply by the channels per station, 60.乘每站信道数 60。
(a) 4 × 60 = 240 channels
(b) at most (1/0.5)² × 4 = 16 microcells; estimating 15 from the figure: 15 × 60 = 900 channels
Growth factor 900 ÷ 240 = 3.75 ≈ 4 times (with 16 cells, 16 × 60 = 960 channels, exactly 4 times)(a) 4 × 60 = 240 条
(b) 最多 (1/0.5)² × 4 = 16 个微小区；按图估 15 个：15 × 60 = 900 条
增长倍数 900 ÷ 240 = 3.75 ≈ 4 倍（取 16 个则 16 × 60 = 960 条，正好 4 倍）

Beyond the slidesA rough area check (not in the notes)

Area of a regular hexagon = (3√3/2)R² ≈ 2.6R². For R = 1 km it is about 2.6 km², so the 9 km² square holds about 9 ÷ 2.6 = 3.5 cells; for R = 0.5 km it is about 0.65 km², holding about 13.9. The ratio is still 4 times. The notes count 4 and 15 from the figure because cells partly inside the edge are also counted, so the counts are slightly larger; this is a normal estimate.正六边形面积 = (3√3/2)R² ≈ 2.6R²。R = 1 km 时约 2.6 km²，正方形 9 km² 约能放 9 ÷ 2.6 = 3.5 个；R = 0.5 km 时约 0.65 km²，能放约 13.9 个。比例仍是 4 倍。讲义从图上数出 4 和 15，是把边上被切进去一部分的小区也算上了，所以略大，属正常估计。

Pitfalls

  • The area ratio is the square of the radius ratio: radius ÷ 2 → number of cells × 4, not × 2.面积比是半径比的平方：半径 ÷ 2 → 小区数 × 4，不是 × 2。
  • Each base station has 60 channels "regardless of cell size", so a microcell also has 60.每个基站 60 条信道"regardless of cell size"，微小区也是 60 条。
  • Both 15 and 16 are acceptable, but state clearly that it is an estimate and give the conclusion "about 4 times".15 和 16 都可以，但要写清是估计，并说明结论"约 4 倍"。

ExamHow to write it in English

The 3 km × 3 km square extends 1.5 km above, below, left and right of base station A. (a) Without microcells: from the figure, about 4 large cells (base stations) lie within the square, so the number of channels is 4 × 60 = 240. (b) With microcells of half the radius, each cell area is reduced to 1/4, so there are at most (R/(R/2))² × 4 = 16 small cells; from the figure about 15. The number of channels is 15 × 60 = 900, which is about a four-fold increase.

In one line: channels = base stations × 60; halving the radius multiplies base stations by about 4, so 240 channels become about 900.一句话：信道数 = 基站数 × 60；半径减半，基站数约 × 4，所以 240 条变成约 900 条。
Lecture example
p.144–145

SIR improvement from sectoring (N = 7, n = 4)

Original questionSlides 144–145 · “Sectoring” / “Cell Sectoring”

By using 120 degree sectoring, first tier interference can be reduced to ?. SIR is found to be ? dB as compared to 18dB for omni-directional without sectoring, which is a significant improvement.

The improvement in SIR decreases cluster size N, improves frequency reuse, thus system capacity. If SIR for 7 cell is 18dB, with 120 degree, the SIR improved is comparable to 12 cells. Therefore, increase in channel capacity by a factor of ?.

Co-channel interference reduction with cell sectoring due to use of directional antennas:

3-sector, worst case:

S/I = R−n / {D−n + (D + 0.7R)−n} = 1 / {Q−n + (Q + 0.7)−n}

When N = 7 and n = 4, S/I = ? dB

6-sector, worst case:

S/I = R−n / (D + 0.7R)−n = 1 / (Q + 0.7)−n

When N = 7 and n = 4, S/I = ? dB

This is a worked example in the notes, and the source gives the results. The text below follows the source, with the results replaced by ? (the source on p.145 itself writes "S/I = ? dB").讲解型例题，原文自带结果。下面照录原文，结果用 ? 代替（p.145 原文本身就写着 “S/I = ? dB”）。
Find the worst-case S/I for 3 sectors (120°) and 6 sectors (60°), and explain the capacity change brought by 120° sectoring.分别求 3 扇区（120°）和 6 扇区（60°）的最坏情况 S/I，并说明 120° 扇区化带来的容量变化。
  1. Work out the fourth powers first: N = 7, Q = √21 = 4.5826, Q⁴ = (3N)² = 21² = 441; Q + 0.7 = 5.2826, using x⁴ = (x²)²:预先算好四次方：N = 7，Q = √21 = 4.5826，Q⁴ = (3N)² = 21² = 441；Q + 0.7 = 5.2826，用 x⁴ = (x²)²：
    5.2826² = 27.906, 27.906² = 778.7
  2. 3 sectors (120°): a directional antenna radiates only over 120°, so of the 6 first-tier interferers only 2 reach this sector; in the worst case their distances are D and D + 0.7R (p.145). Divide numerator and denominator by R−n:3 扇区（120°）：定向天线只朝 120° 范围发射，第一层 6 个干扰源只剩 2 个能照到本扇区，最坏情况距离是 D 和 D + 0.7R（p.145）。分子分母同除 R−n：
    S/I = 1 / [Q⁻⁴ + (Q+0.7)⁻⁴]
    = 1 / (1/441 + 1/778.7)
    = 1 / (0.002268 + 0.001284)
    = 1/0.003552 = 281.6 → 10 log 281.6 = 24.5 dB
    There is no "÷ 6" here: the denominator gets one term per interferer.这里没有"÷ 6"：有几个干扰源，分母就加几项。
  3. 6 sectors (60°): only 1 interferer is left, at distance D + 0.7R:6 扇区（60°）：只剩 1 个干扰源，距离 D + 0.7R：
    S/I = 1/(Q+0.7)⁻⁴ = (Q+0.7)⁴ = 778.7 → 10 log 778.7 = 28.9 dB
  4. Compare and self-check: interferers 6 → 2 → 1, SIR 18.66 dB (omni, p.89) → 24.5 dB → 28.9 dB, rising at each step ✓.对比自检：干扰源 6 → 2 → 1，SIR 18.66 dB（全向，p.89）→ 24.5 dB → 28.9 dB，逐级升高 ✓。
  5. Change in capacity: the SIR after 120° sectoring (about 23 dB on p.144, 24.5 dB from the formula) matches the 23.34 dB of omni N = 12 (table on p.89). An SIR that used to need N = 12 is now reached with N = 7; channels per cell = S/N, so capacity increases by容量变化：120° 扇区化后的 SIR（p.144 写约 23 dB，按公式 24.5 dB）相当于全向 N = 12 的 23.34 dB（p.89 表）。原来要 N = 12 才能达到的 SIR，现在 N = 7 就够了；每小区信道数 = S/N，所以容量提高
    12/7 = 1.714 times
3 sectors 24.5 dB · 6 sectors 28.9 dB · 120° sectoring capacity about ×1.7143 扇区 24.5 dB · 6 扇区 28.9 dB · 120° 扇区化容量约 ×1.714
3 sectors leave 2 interferers (Q and Q + 0.7); 6 sectors leave only 1 (Q + 0.7). Omnidirectional has 6 interferers → 3 sectors 2 → 6 sectors 1.3 扇区留 2 个干扰源（Q 和 Q + 0.7），6 扇区只留 1 个（Q + 0.7）。全向时是 6 个干扰源 → 3 扇区 2 个 → 6 扇区 1 个。
The sectoring formula has no division by 6. The denominator has one term per interferer.扇区化公式里没有除以 6。有几个干扰源，分母就加几项。
Concept + Step by step: SIR and capacity after sectoring

ConceptSectoring: a pair of "directional eyes"

An omni-directional antenna receives from all directions, so it "hears" all 6 first-tier co-channel interfering cells. Sectoring (notes Part A p.143–146) divides a cell into several sectors, each served by a directional antenna that transmits and receives in one direction only:全向天线（omni-directional）四面八方都收，第一层 6 个同频干扰小区全能"听到"。扇区化（讲义 Part A p.143–146）把一个小区分成几个扇区，每个扇区用一根定向天线，只朝一个方向收发：

  • 120° sectors (3 sectors): each antenna sees only 2 of the 6 interferers.120° 扇区（3 扇区）：每根天线只看到 6 个干扰源中的 2 个。
  • 60° sectors (6 sectors): it sees only 1.60° 扇区（6 扇区）：只看到 1 个。

Worst-case formula (p.145): the mobile is at the sector edge, and the remaining interferers are at distances D and D + 0.7R (a geometric approximation).最坏情况公式（p.145）：手机在扇区边缘，剩下的干扰源距离分别是 D 和 D + 0.7R（几何近似）。

3 sectors: S/I = 1 / [Q−n + (Q + 0.7)−n]; 6 sectors: S/I = 1 / (Q + 0.7)−n = (Q + 0.7)n.

Capacity logic (p.144): once SIR improves, a smaller cluster size N can reach the same quality, reuse is denser, and capacity rises. As the notes put it: omni N = 7 gives about 18 dB; with 120° sectoring the SIR is comparable to omni N = 12 (23.34 dB for N = 12 with the simplified formula, see p.89), so a system that would need N = 12 can use N = 7 instead, and channels per cell grow by × 12/7.容量逻辑（p.144）：SIR 变好以后，就可以用更小的簇尺寸 N 达到同样质量，复用更密，容量提高。讲义的说法：全向 N = 7 约 18 dB；120° 扇区化后的 SIR 和全向 N = 12 相当（简化公式下 N = 12 是 23.34 dB，见 p.89），所以本来需要 N = 12 的系统可以改用 N = 7，每小区信道数 × 12/7。

Cost: each sector gets only 1/3 or 1/6 of the channels, so trunking efficiency drops (p.145, p.148) and handoffs increase (p.146). Lecturer's emphasis: sectoring improves SIR, but each sector has fewer channels and trunking efficiency falls; you must be able to explain this.代价：每个扇区只分到 1/3 或 1/6 的信道，干线效率下降（p.145、p.148），切换增多（p.146）。老师课上强调：扇区化提高 SIR，但每扇区信道变少，集群效率下降，这一点要会讲。

Step by stepCompute the fourth powers of Q and Q + 0.7, then substitute

  1. Q = √(3 × 7) = 4.583, Q⁴ = 21² = 441.
  2. Q + 0.7 = 5.2826; compute the fourth power as (x²)², keeping more decimals in between.Q + 0.7 = 5.2826，四次方用 (x²)²，中间多留几位小数。
  3. 3 sectors: add the two interference terms, then take the reciprocal.3 扇区：两个干扰项相加，再取倒数。
  4. 6 sectors: only one term is left, so S/I is simply (Q + 0.7)⁴.6 扇区：只剩一项，S/I 直接等于 (Q + 0.7)⁴。
  5. Capacity factor: 12/7.
5.2826² = 27.906, 27.906² = 778.7
3 sectors: 1/441 + 1/778.7 = 0.002268 + 0.001284 = 0.003552
S/I = 1 ÷ 0.003552 = 281.6 → 10 log 281.6 = 24.5 dB
6 sectors: S/I = 778.7 → 10 log 778.7 = 28.9 dB
Capacity × 12/7 = 1.7145.2826² = 27.906，27.906² = 778.7
3 扇区：1/441 + 1/778.7 = 0.002268 + 0.001284 = 0.003552
S/I = 1 ÷ 0.003552 = 281.6 → 10 log 281.6 = 24.5 dB
6 扇区：S/I = 778.7 → 10 log 778.7 = 28.9 dB
容量 × 12/7 = 1.714
N = 7, n = 4No. of interferersSIR
Omni, simplified (p.89)618.66 dB
Omni, worst case 1 (p.91)全向，最坏情况 1（p.91）617.27 dB
120°, worst case (p.145)224.5 dB
60°, worst case (p.145)128.9 dB

Note: the text on p.144 says "SIR about 23 dB", while the formula on p.145 gives 24.5 dB. Both are much better than 18 dB and on the same level as the 23.34 dB of omni N = 12. If the exam asks for the p.145 formula, write 24.5 dB; when restating the p.144 conclusion you can write "about 23–24.5 dB".说明：p.144 文字写的是"SIR 约 23 dB"，p.145 按公式算是 24.5 dB。两者都比 18 dB 好很多，都和全向 N = 12 的 23.34 dB 同一水平。考试如果问 p.145 的公式，写 24.5 dB；复述 p.144 的结论时可以写"about 23–24.5 dB"。

Pitfalls

  • There is no "÷ 6" in the sectoring formula: the denominator gets one term per interferer (2 terms for 3 sectors, 1 term for 6 sectors).扇区化公式里没有"÷ 6"：有几个干扰源，分母就加几项（3 扇区 2 项，6 扇区 1 项）。
  • (Q + 0.7) means Q plus 0.7, not Q × 0.7.
  • Writing only "SIR improves" is incomplete; also state that trunking efficiency drops and handoffs increase.只写"SIR 提高"不完整，要同时写干线效率下降、切换增多。

ExamHow to write it in English

For N = 7, Q = √21 = 4.583. With 120° sectoring only 2 of the 6 first-tier interferers remain. Worst case: S/I = 1/[Q⁻⁴ + (Q+0.7)⁻⁴] = 1/(1/441 + 1/778.7) = 281.6, i.e. 24.5 dB. With 60° sectoring only 1 interferer remains: S/I = (Q+0.7)⁴ = 778.7, i.e. 28.9 dB. Compared with about 18 dB for the omni-directional case, the SIR with 120° sectoring is comparable to that of a 12-cell cluster, so the cluster size can be reduced from 12 to 7 and the capacity increases by a factor of 12/7 ≈ 1.714. The drawbacks are lower trunking efficiency and more handoffs.

In one line: a 120° sector leaves 2 interferers, S/I = 24.5 dB; 60° leaves 1, 28.9 dB. The SIR matches omni N = 12, so capacity rises by about × 12/7 = 1.714, at the cost of lower trunking efficiency.一句话：120° 扇区剩 2 个干扰源，S/I = 24.5 dB；60° 剩 1 个，28.9 dB；SIR 相当于全向 N = 12，容量约 × 12/7 = 1.714，代价是干线效率下降。
Lecture example
p.148–149

Calls per hour after sectoring

Original questionSlide 148

A system has an average call duration of 2 minutes with the probability of blocking no more then 1%. Assume that this is a blocked system and each user makes 1 call per hour on average, if there are 395 traffic channels for a 7 cell reuse system, there will be 57 channels per cell.

Find the number of calls per hour if no sectoring is used.

Compute the number of calls per hour when 120 degree and 60 degree sectoring is used.

Blocked-calls-cleared system, average call 2 minutes, blocking probability no more than 1%, 1 call per user per hour. 7-cell reuse with 395 traffic channels in total, i.e. 57 per cell. Find the calls per hour with no sectoring, 120° sectors and 60° sectors.呼损制系统，平均通话 2 分钟，阻塞率不超过 1%，每用户每小时 1 次。7 小区复用共 395 条业务信道，即每小区 57 条。求：不分扇区、120° 扇区、60° 扇区时每小时的呼叫数。
  1. Traffic → calls: A = calls per hour × h, h = 2 min = 2/60 h, so话务量 → 呼叫数：A = 每小时呼叫数 × h，h = 2 min = 2/60 h，所以
    Calls per hour = A ÷ h = A × 60/2 = A × 30每小时呼叫数 = A ÷ h = A × 60/2 = A × 30
    Each user makes 1 call per hour, so the number of calls is also the number of users that can be served.每用户每小时打 1 次，所以呼叫数也就是能服务的用户数。
  2. (a) No sectoring: M = 57, read the Erlang B table in the GoS = 0.01 column:(a) 不分扇区：M = 57，查 Erlang B 表 GoS = 0.01 列：
    A = 44.2 Er → 44.2 × 30 = 1326 calls/hour
  3. (b) 120°: channel groups: each directional antenna uses only 1/3 of the cell's channels (p.149): 57 ÷ 3 = 19 channels/sector. Sectors cannot borrow each other's channels, so this is like splitting one big pool into 3 small pools.(b) 120°：信道分组：每根定向天线只用本小区 1/3 的信道（p.149）：57 ÷ 3 = 19 条/扇区。各扇区的信道不能互借，相当于把一个大池子拆成 3 个小池子。
  4. (b) 120°: read the table and add: M = 19, GoS = 0.01:
    A = 11.2 Er/sector → 11.2 × 30 = 336 calls/hour/sector
    3 sectors: 3 × 336 = 1008 calls/hour/cellA = 11.2 Er/扇区 → 11.2 × 30 = 336 次/小时/扇区
    3 个扇区：3 × 336 = 1008 次/小时/小区
  5. (b) Percentage drop:
    1 − 1008/1326 = 1 − 0.760 = 0.24 → a 24% drop
    Check: the traffic ratio gives the same result, 1 − (3 × 11.2)/44.2 = 1 − 33.6/44.2 = 24% ✓.验算：用话务量比也一样，1 − (3 × 11.2)/44.2 = 1 − 33.6/44.2 = 24% ✓。
  6. (c) 60° sectors: 57 ÷ 6 = 9.5 channels per sector, which is not an integer, and the notes do not say how to handle it. Interpolate linearly (p.127) between M = 9 (3.78 Er) and M = 10 (4.46 Er) and take the midpoint:(c) 60° 扇区：每扇区 57 ÷ 6 = 9.5 条，不是整数，讲义没写怎么算。用 M = 9（3.78 Er）和 M = 10（4.46 Er）线性插值（p.127）取中点：
    A(9.5) = 3.78 + 0.5 × (4.46 − 3.78) = 4.12 Er/sector
    6 × 4.12 = 24.72 Er → 24.72 × 30 = 741.6 ≈ 742 calls/hour
    Drop: 1 − 24.72/44.2 = 0.44 → 44%A(9.5) = 3.78 + 0.5 × (4.46 − 3.78) = 4.12 Er/扇区
    6 × 4.12 = 24.72 Er → 24.72 × 30 = 741.6 ≈ 742 次/小时
    下降 1 − 24.72/44.2 = 0.44 → 44%
    This is the "degrades by 44%" on notes p.149.这就是讲义 p.149 的 "degrades by 44%"。
  7. Comment: trunking efficiency A/M falls from 44.2/57 = 0.78 (no sectoring) to 33.6/57 = 0.59 (120°) and 24.72/57 = 0.43 (60°); on the other hand the SIR rises (60° leaves only 1 interferer, about 29 dB, p.145), and the number of handoffs increases. Write both sides.评述：干线效率 A/M 从 44.2/57 = 0.78（不分扇区）降到 33.6/57 = 0.59（120°）、24.72/57 = 0.43（60°）；但 SIR 升高（60° 只剩 1 个干扰源，约 29 dB，p.145），切换次数增加。两个方向都要写。
No sectoring 1326 · 120° 1008 (−24%) · 60° about −44%
With 2-minute calls, Erlang × 30 = calls per hour. This question reaches the same conclusion as p.123: 3 small groups of 19 channels carry less than 1 large group of 57 channels.通话 2 分钟时，Erlang × 30 = 每小时呼叫数。这题和 p.123 是同一个结论：3 个 19 信道的小组，不如 1 个 57 信道的大组。
For sectoring, always state both effects: SIR rises, trunking efficiency falls. Stating only one makes the comment incomplete.扇区化要同时写两个方向：SIR 升高，干线效率下降。只写其中一个，评述不完整。
The notes do not show how 44% is obtained. It comes from interpolating the table values for M = 9 and M = 10: (3.78 + 4.46)/2 = 4.12 Er, 6 sectors give 24.7 Er in total, and 1 − 24.7/44.2 = 44%.讲义没给出 44% 的算法。它是对 M = 9 和 M = 10 的表值插值得到的：(3.78 + 4.46)/2 = 4.12 Er，6 个扇区共 24.7 Er，1 − 24.7/44.2 = 44%。
Concept + Step by step: calls per hour drop after sectoring

ConceptThe other side of sectoring: lower trunking efficiency

p.145 showed that sectoring improves the SIR; this question (notes Part A p.148–149) works out its cost. After sectoring, the 57 channels of a cell are split among 3 or 6 sectors, and each sector can only use its own share. By the argument on p.123, several small pools carry less total traffic than one large pool.p.145 讲了扇区化让 SIR 变好；这道题（讲义 Part A p.148–149）算它的代价。扇区化后，一个小区的 57 条信道被拆给 3 个或 6 个扇区，每个扇区只能用自己那一份。由 p.123 的道理，几个小池子承载的总话务比一个大池子少。

Conversion used: traffic A = calls per hour × h (h in hours, p.118), so calls per hour = A ÷ h. h = 2 minutes = 1/30 hour, so calls per hour = A × 30.用到的换算：话务量 A = 每小时呼叫数 × h（h 用小时，p.118），所以 每小时呼叫数 = A ÷ h。h = 2 分钟 = 1/30 小时，所以每小时呼叫数 = A × 30。

Read A per sector from the Erlang B table (GoS = 1%). For a channel count not in the table, use linear interpolation (notes p.127): f(x) = f(xi) + (x − xi)/(xi+1 − xi) × [f(xi+1) − f(xi)]. The lecturer stressed in class that you must be able to interpolate.每扇区的 A 用 Erlang B 表（GoS = 1%）查。表里没有的信道数用线性插值（讲义 p.127）：f(x) = f(xi) + (x − xi)/(xi+1 − xi) × [f(xi+1) − f(xi)]。老师课上强调插值要会。

Step by stepWork out the three cases one by one

  1. No sectoring: M = 57, GoS = 1%, table gives A = 44.2 Er; multiply by 30.不分扇区：M = 57，GoS = 1%，查表 A = 44.2 Er，乘 30。
  2. 120° sectors: 57 ÷ 3 = 19 channels per sector, table gives A = 11.2 Er; multiply by 30 for calls per sector, then × 3 sectors.120° 扇区：每扇区 57 ÷ 3 = 19 条，查表 A = 11.2 Er，乘 30 得每扇区呼叫数，再 × 3 个扇区。
  3. Percentage drop: 1 − after sectoring ÷ before sectoring.下降比例：1 − 扇区化后 ÷ 扇区化前。
  4. 60° sectors: 57 ÷ 6 = 9.5 channels per sector, not an integer, and the notes do not say how to handle it. Interpolate between M = 9 (3.78 Er) and M = 10 (4.46 Er), take the midpoint, then × 6.60° 扇区：每扇区 57 ÷ 6 = 9.5 条，不是整数，讲义没写怎么算。用 M = 9（3.78 Er）和 M = 10（4.46 Er）插值取中点，再 × 6。
No sectoring: 44.2 × 30 = 1326 calls/hour
120°: 11.2 × 30 = 336 calls/hour/sector, × 3 = 1008 calls/hour
Drop: 1 − 1008/1326 = 0.24 → 24%
60°: A(9.5) = 3.78 + 0.5 × (4.46 − 3.78) = 4.12 Er/sector
6 × 4.12 = 24.72 Er → 24.72 × 30 = 741.6 ≈ 742 calls/hour
Drop: 1 − 24.72/44.2 = 0.44 → 44%不分扇区：44.2 × 30 = 1326 次/小时
120°：11.2 × 30 = 336 次/小时/扇区，× 3 = 1008 次/小时
下降：1 − 1008/1326 = 0.24 → 24%
60°：A(9.5) = 3.78 + 0.5 × (4.46 − 3.78) = 4.12 Er/扇区
6 × 4.12 = 24.72 Er → 24.72 × 30 = 741.6 ≈ 742 次/小时
下降：1 − 24.72/44.2 = 0.44 → 44%

(Exact values from the formula: 44.22 for M = 57, 11.23 for M = 19, 3.78 for M = 9, 4.46 for M = 10, so the table values are correct.) If for 60° you use 9 channels per sector (rounding down): 6 × 3.78 = 22.68 Er, a 49% drop. The 44% in the notes corresponds to the interpolation method.（公式精确值：M = 57 为 44.22，M = 19 为 11.23，M = 9 为 3.78，M = 10 为 4.46，表值正确。）如果 60° 时按每扇区 9 条（向下取整）算：6 × 3.78 = 22.68 Er，下降 49%。讲义的 44% 对应插值的做法。

In terms of trunking efficiency: no sectoring 44.2/57 = 0.78; 120° 33.6/57 = 0.59; 60° 24.72/57 = 0.43. The more sectors, the less traffic each channel carries.用干线效率看：不分扇区 44.2/57 = 0.78；120° 33.6/57 = 0.59；60° 24.72/57 = 0.43。扇区越多，每条信道承载的话务越少。

Number of users: each user makes 1 call per hour, so calls per hour equals the number of users that can be served: 1326 users → 1008 users.用户数：每用户每小时 1 次，所以每小时呼叫数就等于能服务的用户数：1326 人 → 1008 人。

SIR side: p.149 says that with 60° sectors the SIR rises to about 29 dB (28.9 dB from the p.145 formula), with only 1 first-tier interferer left; but the number of handoffs increases.SIR 方面：p.149 说 60° 时 SIR 提高到约 29 dB（p.145 公式算 28.9 dB），第一层干扰源只剩 1 个；但切换次数增加。

Pitfalls

  • For 120° you must multiply by 3 sectors before comparing with 1326; do not compare 336 with it.120° 要 × 3 个扇区再和 1326 比，不能拿 336 去比。
  • GoS is 1%, so read the 0.01 column.
  • The comment must cover both sides: SIR goes up, trunking efficiency (capacity) goes down.评述一定要两面写：SIR 升高，干线效率（容量）下降。

ExamHow to write it in English

With a 2-minute holding time, calls per hour = A × 60/2 = 30A. Unsectored: from the Erlang B table (M = 57, GoS = 1%), A = 44.2 Erlangs, i.e. 44.2 × 30 = 1326 calls/hour. 120° sectoring: each sector has 57/3 = 19 channels, A = 11.2 Erlangs, i.e. 336 calls/hour per sector and 3 × 336 = 1008 calls/hour per cell, a 24% decrease. 60° sectoring: each sector has 9.5 channels; by interpolation A ≈ 4.12 Erlangs per sector, 6 × 4.12 = 24.7 Erlangs (about 742 calls/hour), a decrease of about 44%. Sectoring improves the SIR but reduces trunking efficiency and increases the number of handoffs.

In one line: calls per hour = A × 30; no sectoring 1326, 120° only 1008 (−24%), 60° about 44% lower: SIR goes up, trunking efficiency goes down.一句话：每小时呼叫数 = A × 30；不分扇区 1326，120° 只剩 1008（−24%），60° 约降 44%：SIR 升高，干线效率下降。
Past final exam
2024-25 S2Q325 marks
Topics: FDD-TDMA channel count · choosing the cluster size from SIR · Erlang B · cell splitting · re-choosing the cluster with three sectors考点：FDD-TDMA 信道数 · 由 SIR 选簇 · Erlang B · 小区分裂 · 三扇区重新选簇
Original question (verbatim)

3. A particular city deploys a frequency division duplexing-time division multiple access (FDD-TDMA) cellular network. The cellular network has a total of 60 cells with a cell radius of 1,000 meters. An omni-directional antenna is used in the system. A total of 40 MHz bandwidth is allocated to the system. Each link (uplink or downlink) uses 2 MHz of bandwidth for control and signalling transmission. The carrier frequency is 200 KHz and each frame has 8 timeslots. The minimum acceptable signal-to-interference ratio (SIR) is 18 dB for the downlink. There is a potential subscriber density of 2,000 subscribers/km2 in the system and the traffic loads are uniformly distributed over the city and covered by the cellular network. On average, each user generates about 0.03 Erlangs of traffic. The path-loss exponent is assumed to be 3.7.

Assume that the co-channel cells in the first tier create significant interference and all the interfering base stations are equidistant from the desired mobile unit which is located at the edge of the cell. You may use any suitable assumptions and approximation to answer the following questions.

Note: A hexagonal-shaped cell is assumed in the analysis and the area of the hexagonal cell with the cell radius R is given by Ace = (3√3/2)R2.

(a) Determine the number of duplex channels per cell. (6 Marks)

(b) Can the system support 1% call blocking probability? (6 Marks)

(c) Show that the cell splitting technique can be used to get 1% call blocking probability. Determine the new cell radius. (4 Marks)

(d) If a 3-sector directional antenna is used, how many cells are required in order to have a 1% call blocking probability? Assume that a single carrier can be shared between two sectors. (9 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
(a) Bandwidth → number of channels: FDD uses one half for the uplink and one half for the downlink: 40/2 = 20 MHz per direction; in each direction subtract 2 MHz for control signalling, which leaves 18 MHz for traffic. Read "carrier frequency is 200 KHz" as a bandwidth of 200 kHz per carrier (GSM-style FDD-TDMA):(a) 带宽 → 信道数：FDD 上下行各用一半：40/2 = 20 MHz 每方向；每个方向扣掉 2 MHz 控制信令，剩 18 MHz 给业务。"carrier frequency is 200 KHz" 应理解为每个载波带宽 200 kHz（GSM 式 FDD-TDMA）：
Number of carriers = 18 MHz / 200 kHz = 90
Duplex channels = 90 × 8 time slots = 720载波数 = 18 MHz / 200 kHz = 90
双工信道 = 90 × 8 时隙 = 720
Each time slot is used once on the uplink and once on the downlink, which pairs up into one duplex channel. These 720 channels are the total shared by one cluster.每个时隙在上行、下行各占一个，配成一条双工信道（duplex channel）。这 720 条是一个簇（cluster）共用的总数。
2
(a) Lower bound on the cluster size from the SIR: the mobile is at the cell edge, and the 6 first-tier co-channel base stations are all at distance D (notes Part A p.88):(a) 由 SIR 求簇大小下限：手机在小区边缘、第一层 6 个同频基站等距 D（讲义 Part A p.88）：
S/I = R−n/(6D−n) = Qn/6
Q = D/R = √(3N)
Requirement S/I ≥ 18 dB = 101.8 = 63.1, n = 3.7:
Q3.7 ≥ 6 × 63.1 = 378.6
Q ≥ 378.61/3.7 = 4.975
N = Q²/3 ≥ 4.975²/3 = 8.25
3
(a) Choose a valid N: a hexagonal cluster size can only be N = i² + ij + j² = 1, 3, 4, 7, 9, 12, …; the smallest value ≥ 8.25 is N = 9 (i = 3, j = 0). Check:(a) 选合法的 N：六边形簇大小只能是 N = i² + ij + j² = 1, 3, 4, 7, 9, 12, …，≥ 8.25 的最小值是 N = 9（i = 3, j = 0）。验算：
N = 7: Q = √21 = 4.583, Q3.7/6 = 46.6 → 16.7 dB ✗
N = 9: Q = √27 = 5.196, Q3.7/6 = 74.1 → 18.7 dB ✓
Channels per cell = 720/9 = 80 duplex channels每小区信道 = 720/9 = 80 条双工信道
4
(b) Traffic per cell:(b) 每小区的话务量：
Ace = (3√3/2) × 1² = 2.598 km²
Users = 2.598 × 2000 = 5196
Traffic = 5196 × 0.03 = 155.9 EAce = (3√3/2) × 1² = 2.598 km²
用户数 = 2.598 × 2000 = 5196
话务量 = 5196 × 0.03 = 155.9 E
5
(b) Compare with the Erlang B table: for M = 80 channels and 1% blocking, the table gives a supportable traffic of A ≈ 65.4 E. The required 155.9 E is far above 65.4 E, so the 1% blocking probability cannot be met. Putting A = 155.9 and M = 80 back into the Erlang B formula gives a blocking probability of about 49%, far off the target.(b) 查 Erlang B 表比较：M = 80 条、阻塞率 1% 时，表中可承载的话务量 A ≈ 65.4 E。需要 155.9 E，远大于 65.4 E，所以不能满足 1% 阻塞率。把 A = 155.9、M = 80 代回 Erlang B 公式，阻塞率约 49%，差得很远。
6
(c) Why cell splitting works: cell splitting (notes Part A p.135–136) keeps N = 9 and shrinks D and R in the same proportion, so Q = D/R is unchanged and so is the SIR; each cell still has 80 channels and can still carry 65.4 E. But each cell is now smaller and covers fewer users. If the cells are small enough, the traffic per cell drops below 65.4 E.(c) 为什么小区分裂可行：小区分裂（cell splitting，讲义 Part A p.135–136）保持 N = 9 不变，D 和 R 同比例缩小，Q = D/R 不变，所以 SIR 不变，每小区仍是 80 条信道、仍能承载 65.4 E；但每个小区面积变小，覆盖的用户变少。只要小区够小，每小区的话务量就能降到 65.4 E 以下。
7
(c) New radius: traffic per unit area = 2000 × 0.03 = 60 E/km²:(c) 新半径：单位面积话务量 = 2000 × 0.03 = 60 E/km²：
Cell area ≤ 65.4/60 = 1.09 km²
2.598R² ≤ 1.09 → R² ≤ 0.4196
R ≤ 0.648 km (about 650 m)
Self-check: with R = 0.648 km, area = 2.598 × 0.648² = 1.09 km² and traffic = 1.09 × 60 = 65.4 E ✓. The whole city of 155.9 km² needs 155.9/1.09 ≈ 143.0 → about 144 cells (originally 60, about 2.4 times as many).自检：R = 0.648 km 时面积 = 2.598 × 0.648² = 1.09 km²，话务量 = 1.09 × 60 = 65.4 E ✓。全城 155.9 km² 需要 155.9/1.09 ≈ 143.0 → 约 144 个小区（原来 60 个，约 2.4 倍）。
8
(d) Choose the cluster again with three sectors: with 120° three-sector cells, each sector has only 2 first-tier co-channel interferers; in the worst case (notes Part A p.145):(d) 三扇区后重新选簇：120° 三扇区时，每个扇区第一层只剩 2 个同频干扰，最坏情况（讲义 Part A p.145）：
S/I = 1/(Q−n + (Q + 0.7)−n)
The SIR is better, so a smaller cluster can be used (notes p.143–146):SIR 变好了，可以用更小的簇（讲义 p.143–146）：
N = 3: Q = 3
 3−3.7 + 3.7−3.7 = 0.01717 + 0.00790 = 0.02507
 S/I = 39.9 → 16.0 dB ✗
N = 4: Q = √12 = 3.464
 3.464−3.7 + 4.164−3.7 = 0.01008 + 0.00510 = 0.01518
 S/I = 65.9 → 18.2 dB ✓
Take N = 4.
9
(d) Channels per sector:(d) 每扇区信道数：
Per cell: 720/4 = 180 channels (90/4 = 22.5 carriers)
Per sector: 22.5/3 = 7.5 carriers = 7.5 × 8 = 60 channels每小区 720/4 = 180 条（90/4 = 22.5 个载波）
每扇区 22.5/3 = 7.5 个载波 = 7.5 × 8 = 60 条
How do you split half a carrier? The question says "a single carrier can be shared between two sectors" (each side uses 4 of the 8 time slots), which gives exactly 7.5 carriers = 60 channels per sector. Without sharing, each sector could have only 7 carriers = 56 channels.半个载波怎么分？题目说"一个载波可被两个扇区共用"（8 个时隙两边各用 4 个），正好让每扇区分到 7.5 个载波 = 60 条。如果不能共用，每扇区只能有 7 个载波 = 56 条。
10
(d) Number of cells required: Erlang B (M = 60, 1%) → A ≈ 46.95 E per sector, so each cell carries 3 × 46.95 = 140.8 E. Area and total traffic of the whole city:(d) 所需小区数：Erlang B（M = 60，1%）→ A ≈ 46.95 E/扇区，每小区 3 × 46.95 = 140.8 E。全城的面积和总话务量：
Area = 60 × 2.598 = 155.9 km²
Total traffic = 155.9 × 60 = 9353 E
Number of cells = 9353/140.8 = 66.4 → 67面积 = 60 × 2.598 = 155.9 km²
总话务量 = 155.9 × 60 = 9353 E
小区数 = 9353/140.8 = 66.4 → 67 个
Self-check: with 67 cells, each cell has area 155.9/67 = 2.327 km² (R ≈ 0.95 km) and traffic 2.327 × 60 = 139.6 E ≤ 140.8 E ✓.自检：67 个小区，每个面积 155.9/67 = 2.327 km²（R ≈ 0.95 km），话务量 2.327 × 60 = 139.6 E ≤ 140.8 E ✓。
11
(d) Comparison: if you only add sectors without changing the cluster (still N = 9, about 26–27 channels per sector), each cell can carry only about 52.6 E and you need about 178 cells, even more than the omnidirectional cell splitting in (c) (about 144): sectoring cuts the channel pool into smaller pieces, so trunking efficiency drops (notes Part A p.148–149). So sectoring only pays off when it is combined with a smaller cluster.(d) 对比：如果只加扇区、不改簇（仍 N = 9，每扇区约 26–27 条），每小区只能承载约 52.6 E，需要约 178 个小区，比 (c) 的全向小区分裂（约 144 个）还多：扇区把信道池切小，中继效率下降（讲义 Part A p.148–149）。所以扇区化必须配合缩小簇才划算。
(a) N = 9, 80 channels/cell; (b) needs 155.9 E but can carry only 65.4 E, so no; (c) R ≈ 0.65 km; (d) N = 4, 60 channels per sector, about 67 cells(a) N = 9，80 条/小区 (b) 需 155.9 E，只能承载 65.4 E，不能 (c) R ≈ 0.65 km (d) N = 4，每扇区 60 条，约 67 个小区
Note: part (d) can be read in different ways. Here we take "sectoring → a smaller cluster is allowed → more channels per cell", and also give the result of adding sectors without changing the cluster.注：(d) 的题意有不同理解，这里采用"扇区化 → 允许更小的簇 → 每小区信道更多"的思路，并说明了只加扇区不改簇的结果。
◆ Key points
What it tests
FDD-TDMA channel count, choosing the cluster size from SIR, Erlang B, cell splitting, re-choosing the cluster with three sectors (Part A combined question, 25 marks).FDD-TDMA 信道数、由 SIR 选簇、Erlang B、小区分裂、三扇区重新选簇（Part A 综合题，25 分）。
Knowledge used
FDD: half uplink, half downlink; channels = carriers × time slots; S/I = Qn/6, N = Q²/3, take a valid value i² + ij + j²; sectored S/I = 1/(Q−n + (Q + 0.7)−n).FDD 一半上行一半下行；信道数 = 载波数 × 时隙数；S/I = Qn/6，N = Q²/3，取合法值 i² + ij + j²；扇区 S/I = 1/(Q−n + (Q + 0.7)−n)。
Method
(a) subtract control → number of carriers → ×8 → choose N → channels per cell; (b) compare the traffic demand with the table value; (c) traffic per cell ≤ table value → area → R; (d) after sectoring try a smaller N, table value ×3, total traffic ÷ traffic per cell.(a) 扣控制 → 载波数 → ×8 → 选 N → 每小区信道；(b) 话务需求和查表值比较；(c) 每小区话务 ≤ 表值 → 面积 → R；(d) 扇区后试更小的 N，查表 ×3，总话务 ÷ 每小区话务。
Common mistakes
Valid cluster sizes: 1, 3, 4, 7, 9, 12, 13…; after cell splitting the channels per cell stay the same (SIR depends only on Q); round the number of cells up.合法簇大小：1、3、4、7、9、12、13…；小区分裂后每小区信道数不变（SIR 只看 Q）；小区数向上取整。
Conclusion
Sectoring only pays off with a smaller cluster: N = 4 with three sectors needs about 67 cells; N = 9 with sectors alone needs about 180.扇区化必须配合缩小簇才划算：N = 4 加三扇区约 67 个小区，N = 9 只加扇区约 180 个。
Concept + Step by step: FDD-TDMA channels, cluster choice, Erlang B, cell splitting and sectoring

ConceptThe five pieces of knowledge used here

StepTopicNotes Part A
Counting channelsFDD: half uplink, half downlink; number of channels = number of carriers × time slots per frameFDD：一半上行一半下行；信道数 = 载波数 × 每帧时隙数p.37, p.82
Choosing the clusterS/I = Qn/6, Q = √(3N); valid N = i² + ij + j² = 1, 3, 4, 7, 9, 12…p.75–78, p.88–89
Can the GoS be met?Erlang B table: given M and 1%, read off the traffic A that can be carriedErlang B 查表：已知 M 和 1%，读出能承载的 Ap.118–120
Cell splittingSmaller cells, same number of channels per cell (SIR depends only on Q = D/R), fewer users per cell小区变小，每小区信道数不变（SIR 只看 Q = D/R），每小区用户变少p.135–138
SectoringWith 3 sectors only 2 interferers remain: S/I = 1/[Q−n + (Q+0.7)−n], so a smaller cluster can be used3 扇区只剩 2 个干扰：S/I = 1/[Q−n + (Q+0.7)−n]，可以用更小的簇p.143–146

Lecturer's emphasis: sectoring improves SIR, but each sector has fewer channels and trunking efficiency drops; you must be able to explain this. Always use the table for Erlang B.老师课上强调：扇区化提高 SIR，但每个扇区信道变少、集群效率下降，这一点要会讲；Erlang B 一律查表。

Step by step(a) Duplex channels per cell

  1. FDD: of the 40 MHz, half is uplink and half downlink, i.e. 20 MHz each way; subtracting 2 MHz for control signalling leaves 18 MHz.FDD：40 MHz 一半上行、一半下行，每方向 20 MHz；扣掉控制信令 2 MHz，剩 18 MHz。
  2. "carrier frequency is 200 KHz" is read as a carrier bandwidth of 200 kHz (GSM style):"carrier frequency is 200 KHz" 理解为每个载波带宽 200 kHz（GSM 式）：
    Carriers = 18 MHz / 200 kHz = 90; duplex channels = 90 × 8 = 720载波数 = 18 MHz / 200 kHz = 90；双工信道 = 90 × 8 = 720
  3. Choosing the cluster: need S/I ≥ 18 dB = 101.8 = 63.1:
    Q3.7/6 ≥ 63.1 → Q3.7 ≥ 378.6 → Q ≥ 378.61/3.7 = 4.98
    N = Q²/3 ≥ 4.98²/3 = 8.25 → take the valid value N = 9
    Check: N = 7 gives only 16.7 dB ✗; N = 9 gives 18.7 dB ✓.
  4. Channels per cell = 720/9 = 80 duplex channels每小区信道 = 720/9 = 80 条双工信道

Step by step(b) Can 1% blocking be met?

Cell area = 2.598 × 1² = 2.598 km²; users = 2.598 × 2000 = 5196; traffic demand = 5196 × 0.03 = 155.9 E小区面积 = 2.598 × 1² = 2.598 km²；用户 = 2.598 × 2000 = 5196；话务需求 = 5196 × 0.03 = 155.9 E
Erlang B (M = 80, 1%): it can carry A ≈ 65.4 E

155.9 E is far above 65.4 E, so it cannot be met. From the Erlang B formula, 80 channels offered 155.9 E give a blocking rate of about 49%.155.9 E 远大于 65.4 E，不能满足。按 Erlang B 公式算，80 条信道承受 155.9 E 时阻塞率约 49%。

Step by step(c) Cell splitting

  1. Why splitting helps: when cells shrink, D and R shrink in proportion, so Q is unchanged; N = 9 and 80 channels per cell stay the same, but each cell covers fewer users.为什么分裂有用：小区缩小后 D 和 R 同比例缩小，Q 不变，所以 N = 9、每小区 80 条都不变；但每个小区覆盖的用户变少。
  2. Require traffic per cell ≤ 65.4 E:要求每小区话务 ≤ 65.4 E：
    Area ≤ 65.4/(2000 × 0.03) = 1.09 km²
    R = √(1.09/2.598) ≈ 0.648 km ≈ 650 m
  3. Cost: the 155.9 km² city needs about 155.9/1.09 ≈ 144 cells (60 before, so about 2.4 times as many base stations).代价：全城 155.9 km² 需要约 155.9/1.09 ≈ 144 个小区（原来 60 个，约 2.4 倍基站）。

Step by step(d) Three sectors

  1. With sectoring only 2 interferers remain, so try a smaller cluster:扇区化后只剩 2 个干扰，试更小的簇：
    N = 3: Q = 3 → 16.0 dB ✗; N = 4: Q = √12 = 3.46 → 18.2 dB ✓
  2. N = 4: 720/4 = 180 channels per cell, 60 per sector. Each cell has 90/4 = 22.5 carriers, i.e. 7.5 per sector over 3 sectors. The half carrier works because "one carrier can be shared by two sectors" (split by time slot): 7.5 × 8 = 60 channels.N = 4：每小区 720/4 = 180 条，每扇区 60 条。每小区 90/4 = 22.5 个载波，分给 3 个扇区每个 7.5 个——半个载波正是靠"一个载波可以被两个扇区共用"（按时隙分）实现，7.5 × 8 = 60 条。
  3. Erlang B (M = 60, 1%): A ≈ 46.95 E per sector, so per cell 3 × 46.95 = 140.8 E.
  4. City area 60 × 2.598 = 155.9 km², total traffic 155.9 × 2000 × 0.03 = 9353 E:全城面积 60 × 2.598 = 155.9 km²，总话务 155.9 × 2000 × 0.03 = 9353 E：
    Number of cells = 9353/140.8 = 66.4 → 67 (radius about 0.95 km)小区数 = 9353/140.8 = 66.4 → 67 个（半径约 0.95 km）

Compare: keeping the cluster (N = 9) and only adding sectors gives about 26–27 channels per sector and needs about 178 cells, even more than splitting. Sectoring pays off only together with a smaller cluster.对比：不改簇（N = 9）只加扇区，每扇区约 26–27 条，需要约 178 个小区，比分裂还多。扇区化必须配合缩小簇才划算。

PitfallsWatch out

  • With FDD, halve the bandwidth first, then subtract the control channels.FDD 要先把带宽对半分，再扣控制信道。
  • N must be a valid value (i² + ij + j²): 8.25 → 9, not 8.N 必须取合法值（i² + ij + j²），8.25 → 9，不是 8。
  • 18 dB is 63.1 in linear terms; n = 3.7, not 4.
  • Cell splitting does not change the channels per cell; round the number of cells up.小区分裂不改每小区信道数；小区数向上取整。
  • Part (d) can be read in different ways; state your assumption clearly in the answer (why you chose N = 4).(d) 题意可以有不同理解，答卷上写清自己的假设（选 N = 4 的理由）。

ExamHow to write it in English

Assumptions: hexagonal cells, uniform traffic, Erlang B (blocked calls cleared), six equidistant first-tier interferers with the mobile at the cell edge, each carrier has a bandwidth of 200 kHz.

(a) FDD: 40 MHz is split into 20 MHz per direction; removing 2 MHz for control leaves 18 MHz. Number of carriers = 18 MHz / 200 kHz = 90, so the system has 90 × 8 = 720 duplex channels. SIR requirement: Qn/6 ≥ 101.8 = 63.1, so Q3.7 ≥ 378.6, Q ≥ 4.98 and N = Q²/3 ≥ 8.25. The smallest valid cluster size is N = 9 (SIR = 18.7 dB; N = 7 gives only 16.7 dB). Channels per cell = 720/9 = 80.

(b) Cell area = (3√3/2)(1)² = 2.598 km²; subscribers per cell = 2.598 × 2000 = 5196; offered traffic = 5196 × 0.03 = 155.9 E. From the Erlang B table, 80 channels at 1% blocking support only about 65.4 E. Since 155.9 E is much larger than 65.4 E, the system cannot support 1% blocking.

(c) With cell splitting the cluster size and the 80 channels per cell are unchanged (the SIR depends only on Q = D/R), but each smaller cell serves fewer users. Requiring the traffic per cell to be at most 65.4 E: area ≤ 65.4/(2000 × 0.03) = 1.09 km², so R = √(1.09/2.598) ≈ 0.65 km. Hence cell splitting achieves 1% blocking with a new cell radius of about 650 m.

(d) With 3-sector antennas only two interferers remain: SIR = 1/[Q−n + (Q + 0.7)−n]. N = 3 gives 16.0 dB (not enough) and N = 4 gives 18.2 dB, so N = 4 is used. Channels per cell = 720/4 = 180, i.e. 60 per sector (22.5 carriers per cell; sharing a carrier between two sectors gives 7.5 carriers = 60 channels per sector). From the Erlang B table, A ≈ 46.9 E per sector, 140.8 E per cell. Total area = 60 × 2.598 = 155.9 km², total traffic = 155.9 × 2000 × 0.03 = 9353 E, so the number of cells required = 9353/140.8 = 66.4, i.e. 67 cells.

In one line: 720 channels, SIR gives N = 9 → 80 channels per cell carry only 65.4 E, far below 155.9 E; splitting to R ≈ 0.65 km is enough; three sectors bring N down to 4, 60 channels per sector, about 67 cells.一句话：720 条信道、SIR 选 N = 9 → 每小区 80 条只能承载 65.4 E，远低于 155.9 E；分裂到 R ≈ 0.65 km 即可；三扇区让 N 降到 4，每扇区 60 条，约 67 个小区。

Ch. 10 · Handover and power control: so you notice nothing while on the move

0 practice · 1 past-examNotes →
Past final exam
2025-26 S2Q4(a)4 marks
Topics: hard and soft handoff, and the systems that use each考点：硬切换与软切换及各自使用的系统
Original question (verbatim)

4. (a) For terrestrial cellular systems there are two types of handovers. Describe the basic mechanisms of these two handovers and identify the types of cellular systems that deploy each of these two handovers respectively.

(4 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
Hard handover (break before make) (notes Part A p.154):
• Mechanism: the channel to the old base station is released first, then a new channel is set up on the new base station; at any moment the mobile is connected to only one base station.
• Features: only one link is maintained at a time, so it is simple to implement; but there is a gap between breaking and making, so communication is briefly interrupted; if the new cell has no free channel or the handover fails, the call is dropped (call dropping).
• Systems: FDMA/TDMA systems, e.g. GSM, IS-136 (and AMPS). Reason: adjacent cells use different frequency sets, and the mobile's transceiver can be tuned to only one frequency at a time, so it must leave the old frequency before it can move to the new one.硬切换（hard handover，break before make，先断后连）（讲义 Part A p.154）：
• 机制：先释放与旧基站的信道，再在新基站上建立新信道；任何时刻手机只连一个基站。
• 特点：一次只维护一条链路，实现简单；但断开和接上之间有空档，通信会短暂中断；新小区没有空闲信道或切换失败时就会掉话（call dropping）。
• 使用系统：FDMA/TDMA 系统，如 GSM、IS-136（以及 AMPS）。原因：相邻小区用不同的频率组，手机的收发机一次只能调在一个频率上，必须先离开旧频率才能换到新频率。
2
Soft handover (make before break) (p.155):
• Mechanism: a channel to the new base station is set up first; the old and new channels are used for communication at the same time, and the old one is released only once the new link is confirmed to be reliable.
• Features: no interruption during the handover; at the cell boundary the mobile receives both base stations at once, which gives a diversity gain and better performance at the boundary.
• Systems: CDMA systems, e.g. IS-95, WCDMA, cdma2000. Reason: adjacent CDMA cells use the same frequency and separate users by different codes, so the mobile can communicate with two base stations at once without changing frequency.软切换（soft handover，make before break，先连后断）（p.155）：
• 机制：先和新基站建立信道，新旧两条信道同时用于通信，确认新链路可靠后再断开旧的。
• 特点：切换期间通信不中断；在小区边界上同时收两个基站的信号，有分集增益，边界性能改善。
• 使用系统：CDMA 系统，如 IS-95、WCDMA、cdma2000。原因：CDMA 相邻小区用同一个频率、靠不同的码区分用户，手机不用换频就能同时和两个基站通信。
Hard handoff: break before make, GSM/IS-136; soft handoff: make before break, IS-95/WCDMA/cdma2000硬切换：先断后连，GSM/IS-136；软切换：先连后断，IS-95/WCDMA/cdma2000
◆ Key points
What it tests
Hard and soft handoff and the systems that use them (Part A p.154–155).硬切换与软切换及使用的系统（Part A p.154–155）。
Answer points
Hard handoff: break before make; simple but with a brief interruption; used in FDMA/TDMA, e.g. GSM, IS-136, AMPS. Soft handoff: make before break; at the boundary the mobile is connected to two base stations at once, giving diversity gain and no dropped calls; used in CDMA, e.g. IS-95, WCDMA, cdma2000.硬切换：先断后连（break before make），简单但有短暂中断，用于 FDMA/TDMA，例 GSM、IS-136、AMPS。软切换：先连后断（make before break），边界上同时连两个基站，有分集增益、不掉话，用于 CDMA，例 IS-95、WCDMA、cdma2000。
Memory aid
"Hard" means break, then connect; "soft" means connect, then break."硬"是断了再接，"软"是接上再断。
Why CDMA can use soft handoff
Neighbouring cells use the same frequency, so the mobile can talk to two base stations at once without changing frequency; in FDMA/TDMA neighbouring cells use different frequencies, so the mobile must disconnect first and then retune.相邻小区用同一个频率，手机不用换频就能同时和两个基站通信；FDMA/TDMA 相邻小区频率不同，只能先断开再换频。
Concept + Step by step: hard and soft handover

ConceptWhat a handover is

When a phone moves from one cell to another during a call, the signal gets weaker and the call must be passed from the old base station to the new one: this is handover (handoff). Handover must start when the received signal drops to the handover threshold PHO (slightly above the minimum usable level Pmin) (Part A p.153); if the new cell has no free channel, the switching centre is too slow, or the target link fails, the call is dropped. Terrestrial cellular systems have two kinds of handover (p.154–155).手机通话时从一个小区移动到另一个小区，信号越来越弱，必须把通话从旧基站转交给新基站，这就是切换（handover / handoff）。基站收到的信号降到切换门限 PHO（略高于最低可用电平 Pmin）时就要开始切换（Part A p.153）；如果新小区没有空闲信道、交换中心处理太慢，或者目标链路失败，通话就会掉线。地面蜂窝系统有两种切换（p.154–155）。

Step by stepThe two kinds of handover in detail

  1. Hard handover: "break before make" (p.154):硬切换（hard handover）——"先断后连"（break before make）（p.154）：
    • Mechanism: first release the channel to the old base station, then set up a new channel with the new one. At any moment the phone is connected to only one base station.机制：先释放和旧基站之间的信道，再和新基站建立新信道。任何时刻手机只连一个基站。
    • Features: simple to implement, but there is a short interruption and the call may be dropped.特点：实现简单；但有短暂的通信中断，可能掉话。
    • Systems: FDMA/TDMA-based systems, e.g. GSM, IS-136.使用的系统：基于 FDMA/TDMA 的系统，如 GSM、IS-136。
  2. Soft handover: "make before break" (p.155):软切换（soft handover）——"先连后断"（make before break）（p.155）：
    • Mechanism: first set up a channel with the new base station; the old and new channels are used together, and the old one is released only after the new link is confirmed to be reliable.机制：先和新基站建立信道，新旧两条信道同时用于通信，确认新链路可靠后才断开旧的。
    • Features: at the cell boundary the phone receives from two base stations at once, which gives diversity gain and better quality at the boundary; communication is not interrupted during the handover.特点：在小区边界上同时收两个基站的信号，有分集增益，边界上的通信质量改善；切换过程中通信不中断。
    • Systems: CDMA-based systems, e.g. IS-95, WCDMA, cdma2000.使用的系统：基于 CDMA 的系统，如 IS-95、WCDMA、cdma2000。

Why the split is like this (not in the notes; added for understanding): in CDMA, neighbouring cells use the same frequency and are separated by different codes, so the phone can talk to two base stations at once without changing frequency, which makes soft handover possible; in FDMA/TDMA, neighbouring cells use different frequencies and the phone usually has only one transceiver, so it has to break first and then retune to the new frequency.为什么是这样分（讲义没写，是理解用的补充）：CDMA 相邻小区用同一个频率，靠不同的码区分，手机不用换频就能同时和两个基站通信，所以能做软切换；FDMA/TDMA 相邻小区频率不同，手机一般只有一套收发信机，只能先断开再换到新频率。

Memory hook: "hard" = break, then connect; "soft" = connect, then break. 4-mark question: for each kind, 1 mark for the mechanism + 1 mark for the systems.记忆："硬"是断了再接，"软"是接上再断。4 分题：每种机制 1 分 + 系统 1 分。

PitfallsCommon ways to lose marks

  • Swapping "break before make" and "make before break".
  • Giving the mechanism without the systems, or writing only "CDMA" without naming specific systems; naming GSM, IS-136, IS-95, WCDMA, cdma2000 is safer.只写机制不写系统，或者只写"CDMA"不举具体系统名；写出 GSM、IS-136、IS-95、WCDMA、cdma2000 更稳。
  • Giving "simpler" as an advantage of soft handover: soft handover is more complex; its advantages are no interruption and diversity.把软切换的优点写成"更简单"：软切换更复杂，优点是不中断、有分集。

ExamHow to write it in English

Hard handover ("break before make"): the current channel with the old base station is released before the new channel with the new base station is set up, so the mobile is connected to only one base station at a time. It is simple to implement, but there is a short interruption of communication and the call may be dropped. Hard handover is used in FDMA/TDMA-based systems such as GSM and IS-136.

Soft handover ("make before break"): a new channel with the new base station is set up in parallel with the current channel with the old base station, and both channels are used simultaneously before the old one is released. The availability of diversity improves the link at the cell boundary, and there is no interruption of communication during the handover. Soft handover is used in CDMA-based systems such as IS-95, WCDMA and cdma2000.

In one line: hard handover is break before make, simple but with an interruption, used in FDMA/TDMA (GSM, IS-136); soft handover is make before break, with old and new links used together, giving diversity and no interruption, used in CDMA (IS-95, WCDMA, cdma2000).一句话：硬切换先断后连，简单但有中断，用于 FDMA/TDMA（GSM、IS-136）；软切换先连后断，新旧同时用、有分集不中断，用于 CDMA（IS-95、WCDMA、cdma2000）。

Part A one-page summary

dB mental arithmetic

  • 10 log 2 = 3.01 · 10 log 3 = 4.77 · 10 log 5 = 6.99 · 10 log 7 = 8.45
  • × 2 adds 3dB, × 10 adds 10dB. Example: 73.5 = 100 ÷ 1.36, so 10 log 73.5 = 20 − 1.34 = 18.66dB乘 2 加 3dB，乘 10 加 10dB。例：73.5 = 100 ÷ 1.36，所以 10 log 73.5 = 20 − 1.34 = 18.66dB

Part B / Part C: no calculation questions, but memorise these numbers

Part B wireless systems

  • WLAN coverage 50–500m, data rate 1–54Mbps
  • 802.11b: 2.4GHz DSSS 11Mbps; 802.11a: 5GHz OFDM 54Mbps
  • SIFS < PIFS < DIFS; CWmin = 32, CWmax = 256
  • EDCA has 8 traffic classes

  • LTE frame 10ms = 10 subframes, each 1ms = 2 slots of 0.5ms; 1 RB = 12 subcarriers × 7 symbols (6 with extended CP)LTE 帧 10ms = 10 个子帧，每个 1ms = 2 个 0.5ms 时隙；1 RB = 12 个子载波 × 7 个符号（扩展 CP 为 6 个）
  • Bluetooth PAN radius about 10m蓝牙个域网半径约 10m

Part C satellite communications

  • GEO 35,863km; MEO 8,000–18,000km; LEO 500–1,500km
  • 3 GEO satellites 120° apart cover almost the whole globe; GEO delay 0.24s3 颗 GEO 相隔 120° 覆盖近全球；GEO 时延 0.24s
  • GPS uses 24 MEO satellites
  • Little LEO <1GHz, <5MHz, ≤10kbps; Big LEO >1GHz, up to several Mbps
  • Earth station antennas: large 10–60m, small 1–10m, VSAT 0.3–0.9m地球站天线：大型 10–60m，小型 1–10m，VSAT 0.3–0.9m
  • C-band 500MHz is split into 24 channels of 40MHz, each including a 4MHz guard bandC 波段 500MHz 分成 24 个 40MHz 信道，每个含 4MHz 保护频带
  • CSC frame has 50 slots in total (1 sync + 49 stations); SS/TDMA needs N! patternsCSC 帧共 50 个时隙（1 个同步 + 49 个站）；SS/TDMA 需 N! 种模式
  • Without inter-satellite links: 2 uplinks + 2 downlinks; with inter-satellite links: 1 uplink + 1 downlink无星间链路：2 上行 + 2 下行；有星间链路：1 上行 + 1 下行

Past final exam
2025-26 S1Q4(a)8 marks
Topics: how a node joins an AP: scanning → authentication → association考点：接入 AP 的过程：扫描 → 认证 → 关联
Original question (verbatim)

4. (a) An Access Point (AP) is a portal of a Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN), which can be used to connect to the Internet. When a user tries to connect to an AP, there will be a connection establishment procedure. Describe the connection establishment process and explain the function of the authentication process.

(8 Marks)

Show solution and key points (try it yourself first)
1
① Obtain synchronisation information (scanning) (notes Part B p.31): to join an existing BSS, a node must first obtain synchronisation information from the AP; otherwise it does not know that the AP exists or what its parameters are. Two ways: passive scanning: wait for the Beacon Frame that the AP broadcasts periodically; active scanning: the node sends a Probe Request frame and waits for the AP to reply with a Probe Response frame. Passive scanning only needs to receive; active scanning does not wait for the next beacon, so it finds the AP faster.① 获取同步信息（扫描，scanning）（讲义 Part B p.31）：节点要加入已有的 BSS，必须先从 AP 获得同步信息，否则不知道 AP 的存在和参数。两种方式：被动扫描（passive），等待 AP 周期性广播的信标帧（Beacon Frame）；主动扫描（active），节点发送探测请求帧（Probe Request），等待 AP 回复探测响应帧（Probe Response）。被动扫描只需接收，主动扫描不用等下一个信标，找 AP 更快。
2
② Authentication (p.32): after finding the AP, the node and the AP exchange information, and each side proves that it knows the agreed password. Purpose: confirm that the other side is a legitimate user / legitimate AP, so that only authorised devices can access the network and unauthorised users cannot take resources or steal data. It is the "gatekeeper" before association: if authentication fails, the next step cannot take place.② 认证（Authentication）（p.32）：找到 AP 后，节点和 AP 交换信息，双方各自证明知道约定的密码。作用：确认对方是合法用户 / 合法 AP，只让授权设备接入网络，防止未授权用户占用资源或窃取数据。它是关联之前的“门禁”：认证不通过就不能进行下一步。
3
③ Association (p.32): after successful authentication, association begins: the node and the BSS exchange capability information, and the node's current location is reported to the distribution system (DSS, the set of all APs). Why register the location: the distribution system must know which AP the node is attached to, so that data addressed to the node can be forwarded to the right AP.③ 关联（Association）（p.32）：认证通过后开始关联，交换节点和 BSS 的能力信息，并把节点当前的位置通知分布系统（DSS，所有 AP 的集合）。为什么要登记位置：分布系统要知道这个节点挂在哪个 AP 下，发给它的数据才能转发到正确的 AP。
4
④ Start data transfer: only after association is complete can the node send and receive data frames. The order is fixed: scanning → authentication → association → data; a step cannot start until the previous one is complete.④ 开始传数据：只有关联完成后，节点才能收发数据帧。顺序是固定的：扫描 → 认证 → 关联 → 数据，前一步不完成，后一步无法进行。
Scanning (passive/active) → authentication (prove the password to each other, block unauthorised access) → association (exchange capabilities, register location) → start data transfer扫描（被动/主动）→ 认证（互证密码，防止非法接入）→ 关联（交换能力、登记位置）→ 开始传数据
◆ Key points
What it tests
How a node joins an AP (Part B p.31–32).节点接入 AP 的过程（Part B p.31–32）。
Answer points
① Scanning to get synchronised: passive (wait for a Beacon) or active (send a Probe Request, receive a Probe Response); ② authentication: both sides prove they know the agreed key, keeping out unauthorised stations; ③ association: exchange capability information and report the node’s location to the distribution system DS; only then can data be sent and received.① 扫描获取同步：被动（等 Beacon）或主动（发 Probe Request、收 Probe Response）；② 认证：双方证明知道约定的密码，防止非法接入；③ 关联：交换能力信息，并把节点位置告诉分布系统 DS；之后才能收发数据。
Memory aid
"Scan → authenticate → associate → transmit".
Common mistakes
Do not swap authentication and association; association lets the DS know which AP to deliver the data to.认证和关联的顺序别反；关联的作用是让 DS 知道把数据送到哪个 AP。
Concept + Step by step: scanning, authentication and association to an AP

ConceptFirst, a few terms

  • AP (Access Point): the "gate" between the WLAN and the wired network; the WLAN equivalent of a base station.AP（Access Point，接入点）：WLAN 和有线网络之间的"门"，相当于无线局域网的基站。
  • BSS (Basic Service Set): one AP plus the stations under it, forming one "cell" (Part B p.10).BSS（Basic Service Set，基本服务集）：一个 AP 和它下面的站点组成的一个"小区"（Part B p.10）。
  • DS (Distribution System): the backbone that interconnects several APs (several BSSs) (p.10). The notes on p.32 write it as DSS, meaning "the set of all APs".DS（Distribution System，分布系统）：把多个 AP（多个 BSS）连起来的骨干网（p.10）。讲义 p.32 写作 DSS，指"所有 AP 的集合"。

A node (phone, laptop) that wants Internet access through an AP cannot just start sending data. It must first complete a connection set-up procedure (Part B p.31–32), which has three steps.一个节点（手机、电脑）想通过 AP 上网，不能直接发数据，要先完成一个建立连接的过程（connection set up，Part B p.31–32），一共三步。

Step by stepThe three steps in detail

  1. Scanning (obtaining synchronisation information): to join an existing BSS, the node first gets synchronisation information (timing, parameters) from the AP. Two ways:扫描、获取同步信息（scanning）：节点要加入一个已有的 BSS，首先要从 AP 那里得到同步信息（时间、参数）。两种方式：
    • Passive scanning: the node just waits for the Beacon Frame that the AP broadcasts periodically. Saves power, but the node has to wait.被动扫描（passive scanning）：节点只是等待 AP 周期性广播的信标帧（Beacon Frame）。省电，但要等。
    • Active scanning: the node sends a Probe Request Frame and waits for the AP to reply with a Probe Response. Faster, but costs extra frames.主动扫描（active scanning）：节点主动发探测请求帧（Probe Request Frame），等 AP 回探测响应帧（Probe Response）。快，但要多发帧。
  2. Authentication: once the AP is found, the node and the AP exchange information, and each side proves that it knows the agreed password (p.32).认证（authentication）：找到 AP 后，节点和 AP 交换信息，双方都要证明自己知道约定的密码（p.32）。
    • Purpose: confirm that the other party's identity is legitimate, preventing unauthorised devices from accessing the network, using network resources or eavesdropping; the node also confirms that it is connected to a legitimate AP.作用：确认对方的身份是合法的，防止未授权的设备接入网络、使用网络资源或窃听；同时节点也确认自己连的是合法的 AP。
    • The lecturer singled out this step in class and reminded everyone to always set a password on their own Wi-Fi.老师课上特别提到这一步，提醒大家自己的 Wi-Fi 一定要设密码。
  3. Association: starts only after authentication succeeds. The node and the AP exchange information on the capabilities of the node and the BSS (e.g. supported rates), and the node's current location is reported to the DS, so that data for this node can be sent to the right AP (p.32).关联（association）：认证通过后才开始关联。节点和 AP 交换关于节点和 BSS 能力（capabilities，如支持的速率）的信息，并把节点当前的位置告诉 DS，这样发给这个节点的数据才知道该送到哪个 AP（p.32）。
  4. Start communicating: only after association is complete can the node send and receive data frames (p.32).开始通信：只有关联完成以后，节点才能收发数据帧（p.32）。

Memory hook: "scan → authenticate → associate → transmit". The question asks two things: the procedure (three steps) and the purpose of authentication. Write the second one out separately; do not just write the single word "authentication".记忆："扫 → 认 → 联 → 传"。题目问了两件事：过程（三步），和认证的作用，第二件要单独写清楚，不要只写一句"认证"。

Beyond the slides(not in the notes; no marks lost if you leave it out)

The 802.11 standard has open-system authentication and shared-key authentication; today's WPA2/WPA3 add a "four-way handshake" after association to generate the encryption keys. In the exam, the three steps from the notes are enough.802.11 标准里有开放系统认证和共享密钥认证；现在常用的 WPA2/WPA3 在关联之后还有一个"四次握手"来生成加密密钥。考试按讲义的三步写就够了。

PitfallsCommon ways to lose marks

  • Swapping authentication and association: authenticate first, then associate.认证和关联的顺序写反：先认证，后关联。
  • Giving only one scanning method: write both passive and active, with the frame names (Beacon, Probe Request/Response).扫描只写一种方式：被动和主动都要写，并写出对应的帧名（Beacon、Probe Request/Response）。
  • Writing just "security" as the purpose of authentication: write "both sides prove they know the password → identity confirmed as legitimate → unauthorised access prevented".认证的作用只写"安全"两个字：要写"双方证明知道密码 → 确认合法身份 → 防止未授权接入"。
  • Leaving out the last sentence, "data can be sent only after association is complete".漏了最后一句"关联完成后才能传数据"。

ExamHow to write it in English

The connection establishment between a node and an AP has three steps.

1. Scanning (synchronization): to join an existing BSS, the node first obtains synchronization information from the AP. In passive scanning, the node simply waits to receive a Beacon frame that the AP broadcasts periodically. In active scanning, the node transmits Probe Request frames and waits for a Probe Response from the AP.

2. Authentication: once the node has found an AP, the node and the AP exchange information in which each side proves the knowledge of a given (shared) password. The function of authentication is to verify that the node is a legitimate user (and that the AP is a legitimate AP), so that unauthorised devices are prevented from accessing the network and its resources.

3. Association: after the node is authenticated, it starts the association process, in which the node and the AP exchange information about the node and BSS capabilities, and the distribution system (the set of APs) is informed of the current position of the node, so that frames for the node can be delivered through the correct AP.

Only after the association is completed can the node transmit and receive data frames.

In one line: scanning (passive: wait for Beacon / active: send Probe) → authentication (both sides prove they know the password; blocks illegal access) → association (exchange capabilities, register location with the DS) → only then send and receive data.一句话：扫描（被动等 Beacon / 主动发 Probe）→ 认证（双方证明知道密码，防止非法接入）→ 关联（交换能力、向 DS 登记位置）→ 才能收发数据。
